Are you with the Enforcers? Have you found my goods amongst the contraband? I really need them returned, or my shop is ruined!\n\nHow can an honest merchant make a living with all these thieves running around? If I had the gold, I'd hire a guard!

Yes, I'm with the Enforcers. What I do is, I go to the scene of a murder—you know, when it's uncertain who the perpetrator is—and I look around, talk to the witnesses.\n\nI don't suppose it would interest you much. Not glamorous work, exactly.
I told him it could not be. We are from opposite banks of the same river, you see. The current is too powerful for us to overcome.

I employ the latest alchemical and arcane techniques to solve crimes and capture my bounties.\n\nMy fellow Enforcers find my methods strange, but they can't argue with the results. I always get my prey.
Criminals are a scourge on the face of the Summerset Isles. Is it any wonder we have Daedric Princes invading willy-nilly, when we tolerate such forces of chaos in our society?
I am here to register a formal complaint. Too many times, certain overzealous Enforcers have caused grievous bodily injury to innocents. They must know the people of Auridon shall not stand for it.

The only way to deal with a bounty is to eliminate it—with extreme prejudice. Otherwise, the criminal scum just commits the same crime again.\n\nMy way improves things for everyone. Well, except for the criminal.
I've been hunting werewolves a long time, and I've got the scars to prove it. Never turned, though. Too smart for that. I know the tricks.
Um, excuse me, could you tell me where I could find the, um—I was told there was someone here who buys goods that are, um, second-hand, if you know what I mean.

These new Enforcers! So young, so naive! In my day, we didn't have to wait for bounties to take action. We stopped the real crimes before they occurred!\n\nBut now we have rules, regulations. Such a sad state of affairs.
I'm looking for a Dark Elf named Mel Adrys. Have you seen him? We came here hunting vampires together and he just ditched me.
Not all crimes are equal. Some were committed by devious masterminds of the magical arts. It's my job to read the traces of spells and track down the culprit.

I seem to have misplaced my list of bounties for the day. Again.\n\nHave you seen a crumpled sheet of parchment with a beverage stain? Slightly torn on one corner? Well, if you spot it, please let me know.
It wasn't enough that they killed my husband and my son. They didn't stop when they killed my dog, my cat, and my bantam guar.\n\nNo, they had to crush my prize-winning pumpkins as well.
Oh dear. You can't expect me to solve any crimes until I've had at least a snifter of something bracing. Need to keep the mental machinery lubricated.
It's true. I'm a master of disguise. When a job requires subterfuge and guile, I'm the one the Enforcers call. And they pay handsomely to acquire my talents. I'm in very high demand!
Oh, don't mind me, I'm just hoping to get a glimpse of my little kitty-wittens. I'm sure you've heard of him. Razum-dar? He called me "sweetmeat" once!
You have to get out of here. Please, just run!
No, I'm not taking any more jobs. Don't need to. Finally made enough coin to retire. It's nothing but the good life for me from here on out.

Don't mind me. I've been tracking bounties for three days straight. I almost had them a few times, but this group is tricky. So I came in here for a moment's rest. If I doze off, give me a poke, all right?
Yes, I served in the Alliance war. Then they said I was too "insubordinate." Whatever that means.\n\nGlad I'm rid of them. Enforcing pays better, anyway.
"You're too old-fashioned," they said. "The world's moved on," they said. "You can't just put an arrow in a kid's eye because he stole a cheese wheel," they said.
You never saw me. If anyone asks, I was never here.
Hmm. I don't know what your deal is, but stay away from the Bank of Daggerfall. That place is all mine. I've been planning this heist for ages!
You've done the Guild and the city a great service, comrade. Come back soon. We'll likely have need of you again.
So, does the crow bark at midnight? Oh, never mind. I thought you were someone else—forget I said anything.\n\nI'm not one of the king's spies! Psh … who said anything about spies? Not me!

Yes, I'm that Efreghar. Accidentally burn down one tree in Valenwood and it follows you everywhere! You'd think no one ever mistakenly cast a firebolt among the trees before. One or two lousy trees. Or twenty.\n\nStupid Green Pact.

If you know of any work, I'm all ears. I was part of a crew going to Sanguine Barrows, but our boss got cold feet and cancelled the job. I was really looking forward to extracting corpses from that graveyard.

Those high and mighty nobles of House Ravenwatch get to prance around like kings of the kingdom, while I hide out down here.\n\nYou do know they're all vampires, don't you? Well so am I! But that and a sack of gold won't get me out of this rat hole!
I'm only hiding out here because I was set-up. Driven out of house and home by pernicious rumors.
I will hurt you. It's what I do. Now, get out of my shadow and walk away.

Isn't Fahdah wonderful? Her brawn is matched only by her stunning beauty. I've had the opportunity to work with her and let me tell you, her beatings are legendary!\n\nBut what she accomplishes with just a look and a snarl? Magnificent!
I sell hundreds of poisons a year, and just because one ends up in the goblet of King Fahara'jad's taster, I'm some kind of criminal?

I'm not in this for the gold. I'm going to be the most famous thief in all of Tamriel! More famous even than Morella the Cruel.\n\nI just need to steal something special, something that will make me a legend. Let me know if you have any leads.
You look like a real outlaw … dangerous, desperate. I like dangerous.\n\nSo, what do you say? Want to find a dark corner and show me how dangerous you really are? Come on … you know you want to.
If you'd seen what I've seen, you'd do what I did.

Have you read the tales of the Green Hood? The masked Argonian hero?\n\nWell, I've been thinking. If there can be a heroic do-gooder, why not a masked villain? Eh? Now I just need to come up with a code-name to call myself!

I'm innocent I tell you, innocent! It wasn't me. I could never commit such a heinous crime! It was the tailless Argonian, it must have been!\n\nBut will the Guard listen to me? No! I'll have to find that Argonian myself.
Uh-uh. No. You did not see me here. I am invisible, and I am staying put.
Don't mind me. I'm just laying low until my next contract arrives.\n\nBut don't ask me any questions. If you knew who I really work for, I'd have to kill you. Literally.

We have an arrangement, the clerk and I. I provide information about my fellow nobles, their comings and goings, their valuables. Then I get the first opportunity to purchase the fruit of that seed. And at a special price, no less!
Ah, don't worry. It's just an illusion gone wrong. I'm not really a talking skeleton. \n\nNo, that would be preposterous. How would that even work? I mean—no windpipes.

I knew it was a Nord insult, but I never thought it was actually illegal! I refused to drink their foul mead and now I've been accused of "milk-drinking?"\n\nAbsurd, I know, but I plan to remain here until the Konunleikar comes to an end.

If you like what you see and have gold to spare, I'm sure we could come to some sort of mutual arrangement. I'm off duty, so to speak, but I'm sure I could be coaxed into service for the right … motivation.
Don't matter what you say. I'll never tell you where the bodies are buried.

Most of the riffraff down here seeks some amount of fame and fortune. I'm not like these hooligans. I steal for one reason and one reason only—I'm a collector. If I do wind up selling something, it's just to finance the next item for my collection.

Probably better to keep your distance. Bad luck follows me like a bull netch follows a betty. I can't even consider stealing something without the Guard showing up.\n\nIf I was even half-way decent at anything else, I'd quit this life in a heartbeat.
I wish all these criminals would leave my final resting place in peace. It's rude to just move in and set up shop like this.
Ah, another admirer come, no doubt, to study at my feet! I'm afraid I'm not taking apprentices currently.
So I had a little run-in with this farming village in the hills. They were so delicious.

When someone needs muscle for a job, they call on me. I've crossed swords with everything from guards and soldiers to monsters and Daedra, and I lived to tell the tale.\n\nIf you need an army, hire me and my crew. We're the best there is.
Stupid guar. Doesn't listen to a thing I say.
Ssh. The walls have ears. They were enchanted by mages at the orders of the Dark Elf Tribunal, so that they could learn our secrets.

Some secrets are meant to remain buried—and those are the ones I love to dig up! When tomb raiders or dungeon looters need help with arcane lore, they call upon me. I've never met a secret I couldn't solve.
Yes, well, it's, you see, I need a problem … solved. That is to say, I have a thorn I need … removed. There is a blot of ink that I need … rubbed out.
I used to be the greatest actor in the Summerset Repertory Players, but I was dead broke.

Oh, you probably think you have all the angles figured out—that you have a plan. I'm here to tell you that you're wrong. You didn't take everything into account.\n\nWhat you need is a mastermind! Of course, you can't afford me … just so you know.
It was an accident. I just … needed some light, so I lit a torch. And then there was a breeze, and first one tree caught fire, then the other ….
Listen. I've been in this game a long time, and take my advice—it's not worth it.
Pirates in Haven. Pirates! Months of delicate negotiations, cultivating contacts, and finding a workable distribution chain.\n\nAll of it up in smoke because of thrice-damned pirates!
Everything was going just fine. Until I tripped and knocked over that vase.
Oh! Are you a thief? What did you steal? Was it dangerous?
I'm a guard, but don't worry. I have no love of the law. As long as your patron keeps me supplied with gold and glitter, I'll make sure the rest of the Guard never touches this place.
So I told him, I said, how come when the queen sends her armies into war, that's noble, but when I burn down the barracks with everyone inside, that's a crime?
I guess you'd say I clean up messes. Make certain problems go away. I specialize in bloodstains, if you get my meaning.
It's true! I am a master of disguise. When a job requires subterfuge and guile, I am the one they call … and they pay handsomely to acquire my talents.\n\nI am in very high demand.
What fascinates me most is the criminal's way of justifying even the most heinous of actions.
Did anyone ever tell you how nice you smell?\n\nYou smell … delicious.

I used to be a respected scholar and historian. On one of my expeditions, I decided to keep a small, insignificant relic for myself. And what happened?\n\nThey called me a looter. A tomb raider! Now I have to rob tombs just to keep food on my table.
I apologize if I'm mispronouncing these names. I assure you, I mean no disrespect.
Tanval's given you a mission, eh? Back in the Akaviri war, whatever it took, he got it done.
Retrieve the relic. Return to me. And then I will defeat these wretched n'wah.
I won't doubt my father's wisdom. Whatever he has you doing, it's for the safety of Stonefalls.
<The creature eyes you warily. A thin line of drool forms at the corner of its mouth.>
Let's keep moving!
Aim for the knee! Aim for the knee!
Don't let up! Hit the Winterborn with everything we've got!
I wish Lord Ethian would make a decision. If Lady Sovelle were here, we would be half way to Orsinium by now.
You'll be nothing but ash!
For Orsinium! For the king!
The work of a healer is never done.
Those Winterborn bastards! There's blood to pay or I'll be a horker's hearth-wife!
Even though our old chief doesn't know what's going on half the time, he still knows more than our new chief does.
We have a challenger! Activate the automata!
The challenger approaches! Release the defenders!
You've entered the ring! We've prepared a gigantic welcome for you!
The challenger succeeds! We have a winner!
I'll wager that will leave a mark.
Orcs talk big, but most are scared of their own shadows.
We need to stop relying on outsiders. Helping hands often hide sharp blades, or so my hearth-mother always said.
I like it out here, far from the other clans. Gives me space to think.\n\nNow if you don't mind, I have deep thoughts to think about.
What's a Narsis Dren? Some kind of fish?\n\nIt doesn't sound tasty at all.
And now, another attempt!
The Winterborn kept shouting "For Ice-Heart! For Ice-Heart!" Must be their warlord or something, I guess.
Don't worry about me. It's just a flesh wound.
Eveli wants us to help the Orcs, but I'm not going in there! Not with all those Winterborn marauders!
Keep your head down if you don't want one of the Winterborn to chop it off!
We should have never come here. This isn't our fight.
This one has never seen anything like it! Fierce Winterborn warriors shouting the name Urfon Ice-Heart over and over. It was terrifying!
My spell has revealed the rifts! Destroy them!

I met Kurog back in Wayrest. He was a regular in my father's tavern and we became good friends.\n\nWhen he wrote and offered me this fine establishment, I was on the first caravan heading in this direction!
I used to be a warrior like you, but it turns out I like chopping vegetables better than chopping limbs. So here I am!
Orutha and I are ever so glad that the king offered us a place in his city. We were terribly unhappy in our clan's stronghold.
Ufgel and I grew up in our clan's stronghold, but we hated it there. And neither of us had the slightest desire to marry our nasty, old chief.
I gave up my life in Wayrest to become a part of this. Orsinium reborn! Doesn't it make your spine tingle just thinking about what we're accomplishing here?
Only the strong may keep Malacath's favor!
Accept the word of Trinimac or die!
Trinimac has not abandoned us!
Where's a good-for-nothing guard when you really need one?
I suppose you expect me to thank you.

This won't do. This just won't do at all. What were the Orcs thinking, giving us this decrepit old building? This is hardly a proper location for the Mages Guild.\n\nOh, I'm sorry. Is there something I can help you with?
Up! Out of tunnels! Attack!
No! You no crush me!
Traitorous Orc! Accept Trinimac or die!
We tricked you! You are as stupid as they said!
Why? My echalettes were innocent!
Why am I paying you if you can't deal with a few mangy bandits?
Do you really want to get into this now? I'm kind of busy here!
You know what I'd say if King Kurog walked by right now? Tusk off, you tyrant! That's what I'd say.
I'm a little busy at the moment. Why don't you go and bother my father, Mazabakh. I'm sure he'd be happy to help you.
My poor loyal beast, what a shame. You will not be forgotten.
I'm not carrying that load. Let's get going before more of them come.
We don't have time to exchange pleasantries just now, overseer.\n\nThey're waiting for you in the Chamber of Loyalty.
That's it! I've had enough of your insults!
You want a fight? You don't stand a chance!
You never should have gotten involved, stranger!
Start digging faster!
I'm digging as fast as I can.
Hail, friend! If I might have a moment of your time ….
Another lost opportunity ….
Mighty Corintthac shall feast upon your bones!
Spread the word! Orsinium rises again!
You shall not fall, my son! Take my power.
Show our enemies no mercy. People fear the Daedra—I would have them fear us more.
Can't turn my back for a moment in this city! Who keeps taking my goods?
We do keep a few supplies on hand for our guests. Is there anything you need?
Watch your step, <<1>>! You know I'm not catching you if you fall, right?
Oooh! That'll leave a mark!
Kill. No survivors.
Rejoin me! I command it!
I hate this place. Nothing but dry bread and old turnips to eat. I never should have gotten on that cart.
Grow, my little echalettes. Grow for your papa!
Kynareth take you!
What are you doing? Not that one!
Rebuilding Orsinium means opportunity … and not just for the Orcs.
Two Orcs walk into a bar. An hour later, they come out.\n\nHow many Orcs does it take to rebuild the bar?
Ha! That is so true!
Such is the fate of all traitors.
We are seriously late. Where is he?
Excuse me, I'm busy.
It looks high enough, just need to lean forward so I land on my head.
Why is she still there?
C'mon, let me in! I promise, I've got good stuff this time!
So cold …. A few gold pieces for something warm to eat? Or perhaps a blanket? Please … anything will help.
Are you all right?
Don't you tell me how to drink my life!
There's always room for a rune!\n\nSorry, a little arcane humor, there.
Ah, this food smells so good. If only I had some gold.
Come on, fishy-fishies. Take the nice bait.
None will stop us from building the dolmen!
There is some fascinating architecture here! Amazing!
Can I interest you in some of my wares? Everything an adventurer might need.
The fools will never expect us to tunnel beneath them. Dig faster, you undead cretin!
Your herd is dead! Join us or you're next!
I have to find this relic. Our future depends on it.
That's going to leave a scar!
Ah! Nothing's better than a good bloodsport!
Thirsty? C'mon over and have a drink … if you've got the gold, of course. Had one of those damn Argonians try to pay me in snail shells the other day.
Hit someone already!
I must thank you again, my friend. Studying those relics will keep me busy for months!\n\nPerhaps we can work together again in the near future. Yes, I think I'd like that!
Mazgroth? Is that you?
Now that's action!
Ouch! Well played!
A challenger approaches! Prepare the monstrosities!
Come in, challenger! Are you shivering yet?
And now—everything that wriggles and writhes!
This will be hot! Pun entirely intended.
What surprises have we this time? Let's see!
And now, dance! Dance around the Tree of Death!
Careful! It's not all clanking clockworks, you know!
Do you like lizards, challenger? Watch the shadows!
Don't succumb to the Theater of Despair! Fight, and fight fiercely!
What is this, a lovefest?
Well struck!
Hey! I came to see a fight!
I thought this was a combat arena! Hit 'em!
Oh, good one!
Servant! Another drink!
Go on! Fight!
A challenger is near!
No one escapes!
This looks promising!
You can take it, challenger!
That's it! Fight like you mean it!
Your flesh … so pliable. Slip into the shadows with me!
Huh?
Troublesome! Yet so very small ….
[Bellows loudly]
Hmm ….
[Surprised screech]
What a supple soul you've brought!
Raaaaaagh!
Ha ha!
Feast, my children! Feast upon its succulent flesh!
[Sheets of ice grinding together threateningly]
Take that door down!
Devour that, ignoble savage!
Every mistake represents a chance to learn a valuable lesson.
Trinimac smiles on everyone, Orcs and non-Orcs alike!
I've convalesced here since a Dremora punctured my lung. I can still do my part for the Queen.
Trinimac smiles upon you, brave and faithful Orc!
There must be a greater purpose to this Daedric invasion …. Oh! Can I help you?
The true enemy down here is boredom.
Sometimes I call myself "this one" so customers think I'm a bumpkin. Makes it easier to haggle.
I'm missing the Skywatch festival for this?
It is time to feed, my pet!
Malacath's fury isn't for the likes of you, tuskless one!
Behold, the price of failure!
Malacath's fury upon you, brave and faithful Orc!
We're winning, aren't we? We're in the Imperial City—we have to be winning!
There are secrets beneath the Imperial City … if you know where to look.
Hmm? Yes, you're welcome to browse.
We think these books are a hidden collection from the Imperial Archives.
I don't know much about dogs. Oh, don't feed them daedrat. Everyone pays for it later.
Curse the Worm Cult! What they did to this city is an abomination.
Try not to track any dirt in here. I just swept the place.
The water's sound reminds this one of home. The taste … not so much.
I said I wanted to serve the Pact. This isn't what I expected, but I make do.
Mother will soil her breeches when she learns where I'm stationed.
Can I … interest you in something?
The Xivkyn hunt mortals for sport. Do not underestimate their cruelty.
Our leaders had a wonderful plan—strand us beneath a city full of Daedra. Blood for the Pact.
He might have been an impulsive child with half the sense Malacath gave the horker, but he tried to do right at the end.\n\nHere's to Lord Ethian, the stupid little milksop.

I haven't had a moment to myself since we arrived in this city. I'm afraid that the Orc nation isn't quite as stable as we were led to believe.\n\nI need to send a report to the High King immediately!
Bite harder, my pets!
Come, my scaly ones!
Got nothing to add to the wrack yet, <<1>>. Looks like you're having some luck, though.
Where is she? She's supposed to be here!
<<1>>, where are you?
We'll head out soon, pup, I promise.
You subvert the master. His will shall not be denied.
<evil laughter 1>
What's that? Did you find something valuable?
Worship Trinimac, Trinimac is good. I worship Trinimac. I will be good.
Trinimac. I serve Trinimac. Just leave me be.
I never survived a disaster before. Luckily, I was able to salvage some of my goods, so it wasn't a total loss.\n\nIf you need anything, feel free to let me know.
Trinimac guide my blade!
I help out around here, but they won't let me pour drinks or collect gold.\n\nIf you want something substantial, go talk to Batorabesh. She'd be glad to help you out.
You won't escape us!
Don't let the menders extinguish the fire!
The tree! Protect the tree!
I find a nice walk in the wilderness to be rather soothing. So long as I don't run into any of those Vosh Rakh heathens or Winterborn savages.\n\nWould you like to see my wares?
You're standing in my drinking space.
This one is glad to see you. It gets lonely out here on the road.\n\nPerhaps you'd like to visit for awhile—after you buy something, of course.
I think we lost the trail. I'll head back to Shatul.
This is our spot. Go find your own!\n\nWe'll set up our stall when we're good and ready, and not a moment before.
This land presents us with amazing opportunities.\n\nI just wish it wasn't so damn cold all the time.
Damn, no <<z:1>>.
Kurog's soldiers are here! I have to warn the others!
Normally I only mix potions and salves for the clan's benefit, but since you've already interrupted me … is there something you need?
Nothing will ruin your day like a sack of echatere manure bursting over your shoulder. You need good strong bags to make it out here.
Ah! Finally, a fellow tusker with a taste for Morkul brew! Been swimming in outsiders lately. What can I get you?
Think you can handle a stout Orcish brew? Ha! Let's find out, eh?
The locals eat nothing but meat and turnips. You, though … I bet you're looking for something exotic. Am I right?
Wrothgar is no place for unskilled riders. Keep yourself sharp.
My clan-mates are … not enthusiastic about my work. You might see them spit on me or the equipment. All in good fun, though!
It's true the clan is more well-known for our metalwork, but I don't see why we shouldn't perfect the finer things, too.
Here to use the forge? Well, I won't stop you. Just don't get in my way.
I'll tell you, it's good to see another Orcish face. Let's show them how smithing is done, eh?
Got a lot of work to do, stranger. You need something?
Your belly's grumbling like a horker, you know that? What can I get you?
This shipment is bound for market in Orsinium. If you want to buy it directly, you're welcome to take a look.
Well, hello there! Don't see many tuskless faces out here on the coast. Just let me know if you see anything you like.
You're not from around here, are you? It's tough to tell since you all look …. I mean, you don't all look the same. I just … you want to buy something?
You need soul gems? Of course you do. Let's make a deal.
All weapons are Morkul-forged, honed and blooded. Fit for a chief or king.
A customer … excellent!
You need something? Spit it out.
If you've got the coin, I've got the, uh …. Damn, I don't know. Something worth buying, probably.
No hustle. No scams. Just honest trade at a fair price.
We will not be defeated!
You murdered my mother!
I can't wait to leave this ugly, arse-pit clanhold. I'll head to Orsinium as soon as I complete my apprenticeship.
Burn in the fires of the Forge-Mother!
Tough break for those miners, eh? We should drink to their memory.
Way I hear it, you found a whole bunch of Dwarf constructs down in the mine. Bet I could make a damn fine still out of all that junk.
Come here, squirt. Let's get some meat on those bones!
You heard about that business in the quarry? Dangerous times. I'd stock up on supplies if I were you.
Didn't bring any Dwarven scrap back with you, did you? I bet I could make a clean profit on—wait, what am I talking about? Keep that junk away from me.
The damn quarry workers and their jibes! Soul gems aren't that much different from graystone. Just lighter. And more purple.
Glad that business in the mine is cleared up. Now if only you could fix this leg of mine. Ugh.
That's not quite right. I tried that one as well.
Hmph. I don't like your look.
Hmm. We can deal, but I'm watching you.
All right, all right, let me see what you've got.
I know you brought me something good today, yes?
Guard? I'm not a Guard! What in the world ever gave you that crazy idea?\n\nI'm a hardened criminal. Just like you!
You know what I hate about places like this?\n\nThey're swarming with criminal elements. Makes my skin crawl!
Are you a real outlaw? That's my dream! I plan to become the greatest outlaw in the three alliances!\n\nIf you have any pointers, I'm happy to take notes!
You, uh … know where I can buy some skooma? No? That's all right.
"Trinimac is strong, not brutish. He is wise, not murderous. Trinimac is life."
I still don't understand the difference between Malacath and Trinimac. Sounds like a lot of noise about nothing to me.
Protect our catch! Kill anyone you don't know!
Kill everyone! The snow rat only breeds for us!
Skeeving fetcher! I'll kill you!
They're here to steal the beasts!
You'll pay for your intrusion!
Let's feed this one to Snagara!
I'll stab you in the eye for that!
These echateres belong to us!
Have you come to study the arcane arts? You won't be disappointed. I've already learned so much, and I've only been here a short while.
You've come to buy, yes? Then buy.
Impressive huh?
I tell you, we're going to run out of food if someone doesn't do anything about it soon.
I'm sure the city will manage, they don't want us working on an empty stomach.
Some day we might expand this place to accommodate all you adventurers. For now we can offer good drinks and a warm hearth.
You've got to eat, sure, but why settle for someone else's cooking? I bet you can do better.
Puzzle locks can be tricky. Go ahead and give it another try.
I come here after each hunt. It calms me to watch the local wildlife.
I don't need your pity. I'll be hunts-wife again. One day.
Who dares summon me?
<<1>> has truly outdone herself!
I could eat, if you can.
She won't just give away her food. Well … would she? Do you think?
The master rests. Best not wake him!
Why does this filth approach?
He shall burn this land with a cold flame! None shall survive!
Another whelp? I deserve a worthier sacrifice!
Spill the blood of the innocent! Desecrate the stones!
He shall be reborn. We dedicate this anchor to him!
Run and hide, prey!
Agag gor yarg!
Aga yor yar!
I'll fry you like a fish!
Embrace your death, mortal!
I summon your death!
Now I shall reveal my true power!
You shall burn, weakling!
Enough play! Time to end this game.
I'm going to add your bones to my armor.
Burn, mortal. Burn!
Puny mortal! Now you face a titan!
I win! I always win.
This one's mine, sisters!
This will finish you!
Stupid mortal! That won't stop me!
This one will turn you to dust!
Mephala take you!
Do you know who I am? Your death.
My blades are sharp and ready for your flesh!
Ready to die, mortal?
Poison take you, mortal!
You dare attack my children!
I would kill anyone for my queen!
Let's get this over with.
You! Fight me!
They say you can give a good death!
Enough! I will silence you and these devices!
Will you not fight?
Come, face me!
I should have known you could not face me!
Care for a swim?
No match at all!
The Spider Daedra never fail!
The Reach will not be kept from their lands for long. I will destroy all who stand in our way!
My work is complete! May the armies of Tamriel shudder at my name!
The city's construction has begun. So far things are coming along nicely.
Hey, isn't that the king-slayer? Good work, outlander! Never liked that son of a horker anyway!
Morkul wares are now at the forge, and now I see people willing to spend. Do you not agree?
All right. Let's find <<1>>.
Is that a track? It's … no, sorry. Just some melted snow.
Wrong.
Is brisk, yes? This one is lucky to have such a sumptuous winter coat!
Malacath thump it! What do you want?
Oh. Ow! This is … ow! This is excruciating!
Watch yourself. Winterborn raiders are everywhere.
I keep moving the dirt around, but nobody ever gets excited about it. Not like the others.\n\nMaybe I'm shoveling wrong.
Hungry? I know I am.
Got plenty of brews to warm your belly if that's what you're looking for.
<<1>> keeps the scholars well supplied. She can do the same for you … provided you have coin.
I'm just here until I can fix my wagon. I do have some fine armor if you're in the market.
Who would've thought they'd turn an old ruin like this into a safe haven for travelers? They even have a few decent books.
Let our relationship be clear! She has fine things, and loves only gold.
Come and see, come and see! Goods for you, gold for me!
The wealth of the Summerset Isles, of Valenwood, of Elsweyr compares not to the wealth this one commands.
Do you know the old saying? Neither a borrower, nor a spendthrift be.
Are you close to the Almalexia goddess, of golden skin? This one wonders if fur of true gold is a thing that one could have.
Is your purse as golden as you are? Please, show us!
This one does not accept barter of sap or dark deeds. Gold, only.
This one does not accept barter of meat and bone. Gold, only.
It is often said the nobles of High Rock build their keeps upon vast treasuries. Is this true? How do you know?
Wealth beyond measure, muthsera?
The Red Diamond, the Ruby Throne, the White Gold Tower — Many riches in Cyrodiil, yes?
Bright moons, walker. Brighter yet if clad in gold, yes?
Be assured and rest easy - nothing here was pillaged from any ancient tomb!
An old Orcish saying about money: "Give me your money."
Many riches in the Alik'r desert, it is said. Are you they?
Gold! As golden as sunlight, as golden as hope — under this fine sun, trade yours to me.
The night, so dark. Brighten my night by passing me your gold? This one has much to interest you!
This one does not accept barter of shed fur, whether damp or dry. Gold, only.
This one does not accept barter of blood or vexation. Gold, only.
You have a fondness for prisms and light? Is there money in that? As much money as killing daedra, perhaps?
Affairs in Eyevea, it is certain, go well enough. Well enough to spend freely and have not a care!
Undaunted! Undaunted? Dauntlessly spend your money here, friend.
Advice from me, advice for free — Reconsider your lifestyle of poverty.
Ah! You must be what we call "the middle class." Feel free to purchase, but be careful to not be too poor.
One so seasoned as you surely must possess vast wealth. Feel free to browse, spend, and enjoy!
Fresh-cheeked and somewhat, mostly unscarred! Are you certain you can afford these wares?
From the east to the west, we always welcome familiar faces. What can this one do for you?
Good people of Tamriel! The Bountiful Bazaar is open for business! Give me your money!
Farewell, good people of Tamriel! This one must now rest her head upon its bed of silks and gold!
Thank you for the shipment.
A dry bed and a hot bowl—that's what we offer at Skalar's Hostel. Nothing fancy, but we're clean and we're cheap.
Got nothin' for sale, friend. You'll have to check the market.
If you see a bat, and it's holding a baby, that's … my … baby!
I'm happy to help these poor monks. I can always use a few more blessings.
Anything you'd care to … stow in our vaults?
My time is important. Don't waste it.
People who need personal storage come to me.
I have all the style materials you need under one roof!
Are you new here? I am bad with faces.
I usually ply my trade for half-wits, but not today. I can tell you're a connoisseur.
No thievery in my shop. If you aren't here for supplies, you must go.
I have art to make. What do you want?
If you're in Abah's, you're either desperate or stupid. So? Which is it?
This one has many fabrics to offer. See how they glint. A true bargain.
My records are meticulous. I know exactly what is stolen each week!
I can handle my rotmeth. After a nap, it will all balance out.
You looking for magical trinkets? Staves, gems, enchanted jewelry?
The interior designs of my leathers are … quite prurient. Absolutely no returns.
Huh.
Who … who sent you? No, no. Don't tell me.
Let's go find some treasure!
A passable selection of drinks, here. Still, a good red wine is the hardest to find.
Turap'su prays that these monks can shake off the Bent Dance. If they don't … this one must do what is necessary.
Teifi travels with the Twilight Cantors. Most of the time, it is a joy. But not this time.
What can I get you? If you want. You aren't required to buy anything.
No discount for bringing your own hammock.
That's not good. Look out!
Kneel before the void-crown! Kneel!

I wasn't a part of the guild for very long before everything went to Oblivion in an ore cart and I was forced to hide from the Iron Wheel.\n\nTrust me, once I'm in charge we'll never have to run or hide again.

I blame those stiff collars who lord over the rest of us like they were born with silver spoons up their arses. If not for them, we wouldn't be in these dire straights, now would we?\n\nIf you'll excuse me, I need to prepare for my next performance.

My sponsor? That would be Thrag. I find his dedication and training techniques to be excellent.\n\nI also enjoy watching the way the sweat glistens off his rock-hard muscles. It pleases me a great deal.

Isn't Walks-Softly sleek? If not for him, I'd be rotting away in a dungeon somewhere instead of hiding in this amazing cistern, waiting for my next job to come along.\n\nThat came out sounding terrible, but I really do appreciate what he did for me.
I'm not half as good at alchemy as Velsa, but I'm better than anyone else you've ever met. I don't know why people don't like her. Sure, she's abrasive, but so are most of the chemicals I work with.

Have you read the latest Investigator Vale book? I'd never leave such an obvious clue behind. That's just sloppy work on the part of the villain, and I detest sloppy work.\n\nI have no doubt that I would be able to outsmart Vale. I'm just that good.
Our quarry approaches ….

Common thieves only consider the horizontal. They never think about the vertical and how it relates to our chosen profession.\n\nMe? I'm always looking up! That's usually where the wealthy marks keep their best stuff.

Crime is nothing more than a series of calculations and figures in a ledger. Understand the numbers and the world is your goblet of golden wine. As soon as the guild is back to full strength, I can have us profitable in no time.
Moon-swine! Crush them!
Namiira speaks and we obey.
Your suffering will be exquisite.
The guild needs me and my brawlers around for when things go wrong. And trust me. No matter how well planned a caper might be, something always goes wrong.

The Mad Alchemist? Do they really call me that? No? Well, they should. I think the title suits me.\n\nNow if you'll excuse me, I have to dose myself with a few tinctures and concoctions—purely for scientific purposes, you understand.

I almost left all this behind me. I was half-way up the boarding ramp to a ship bound for High Rock when I decided I wasn't done with Abah's Landing quite yet.\n\nI want to make the Iron Wheel pay for what they did to us—I want them to pay dearly.

I know what the new recruits say about me, how they call me "the Lizard of Hew's Bane." They say I do unspeakable things. They are not wrong.\n\nNah, just pulling your tail! I just like to keep the new recruits on their toes. Builds character.
Those Iron Wheel bastards! Good riddance, I say!\n\nZeira brought the guild back from the brink of extinction, and I for one am certainly glad she did.
Your wards are weak!
Rise, child of Lorkhaj.
Drown in shadow!
Ziss ra'ham! Those shades are back!
Hurry, friends! The breach is near to breaking!
Huh, not here. Good time to sharpen a knife.
Well done, walker! Now flee this place!
You only delay the inevitable.
Little rat must be ducking me.
The Moons have forsaken you! All that remains is shadow and death!
Scatter, friends! Seek the moonlight!
What'll I do?
Show them the wrath of Namiira!
The storm approaches ….
Kneel!
Back, vermin!
There is no escape!
Sar-m'Athra! Your banquet awaits!
Back to the darkness, churl.
<evil laughter>

This cafe is adequate, but I prefer the level of service at the Winsome Welwa.\n\nUnfortunately, Lady Ylanie told me in no uncertain terms that I was not welcome in her establishment any more. So now I eat here, with the rest of the unwashed masses.
I miss the music of Vvardenfell, but this cacophony does have its charms.\n\nI find it particularly appealing after half a jar of sujamma, for example.
I post new listings on the board daily. Check back often if you're looking for side jobs.
You shouldn't wander alone in dark alleys, my friend. All the worst thugs and cutthroats linger in such places.\n\nPeople just like me.

New in town? Don't let any of those crooked escorts rob you blind. Nobody knows Abah's Landing half as good as old Sig!\n\nI'm busy right now, but if you come back in a little while I'd be happy to show you around town.

Damn right I'm a pirate! Hot off the Dreamsnake and looking for trouble!\n\nI'm here to eat, drink, and watch that half-naked sweetroll prance across the stage. Now get out of my face and let me enjoy the show.
Any luck?
Have you seen Thazahrr Goldfang prancing down the boulevard as fancy as you please? Only that Cartel cat would be so bold as to wear stripes to the annual Folly Festival. That's just not done!
I like to watch half-naked men dance. What of it? Don't you judge me!\n\nNow get out of my face and let me enjoy the show.
Nothing is lost in Abah's Landing, only finding another path.
Grr, this one does not like the cold and damp.
Enter and be welcome, friend! Show me your gold and we'll show you our hospitality!
Why let tax and tariff take the lion's share when there are those who can look the other way?
Just don't get forgetful when it comes time to settle up.
Better to stock up here than with those crooks in Abah's Landing.
I have a trifle here and there. Speak up if something interests you.
They complain about the heat of my forge, but it will do if you need to take hammer to metal.
We run an honest bank here, believe you me! There's no safer place on the Gold Coast for your valuables than the Anvil Repository.
Another pointless attempt? So be it!
If you're going to get so close, the least you could do is buy me dinner!
I will not beg for mercy from the likes of you.
Shark's Teeth rule!\n\nUnless you're one of those pirates. Then, boo Shark's Teeth, boo.
Watch your step and don't trip over any of my goats. No free samples, either. Wheat doesn't grow on … oh, never mind.
My Emperor? Oh, it is you! You came back! I knew you hadn't forgotten about me. I kept the forges burning like you asked. The troops can restock here, just like you planned!
Anything for the guild's finest.
I regret I can carry no more.
Arms for a poor lizard! Oh, that's not right. I mean, alms for a poor lizard! Spare some gold for this truly pathetic beggar!
My chains or Molag Bal's, choose your fate!
You'll be lashed to the bone for this!
I don't care what you're worth. Now you die!
Keelcutters! To me!
Bring down the thunder!
Feel the wrath of the stormy sea!
I'm so bored! Nothing ever happens at <<1>>.
How hard can it be to find one old Dark Elf woman?
Hew's Bane? More like Hew's Barf!
No mead on duty, pah, what kind of order is that?
Open the door or lose it!
What self-respecting person could live in Hew's Bane?
Why protect a plundered tomb? We should be avenging the loss.
An empty tomb? What did I do to deserve this posting?
I wonder if we'll get any cake. I love cake.
I can't wait to sleep in my own bed again.
No one is to see <<1>>. Not even family. Especially drunk family.
No more filthy mire, or filthy criminals, at last.
Who dares disturb my eternal slumber?
I will feast upon your life!
Attack, my guardians!
It's me, Hilde! Your big brother!
This entire region languishes under a cloud of lawlessness and imminent danger. It's a disgrace! I rarely feel safe or secure walking the streets of Anvil—and I'm a member of the damn Fighters Guild!

I remember when Anvil was ruled by a true Imperial governor and the Gold Coast Trading Company wasn't quite the nest of pirates and smugglers it is now.\n\nPersonally, I prefer the new regime. The opportunities are more … intriguing.
When they built Varen's Wall, certain avenues were closed to us. But when one door shuts, another usually opens.\n\nThese are interesting times in Anvil, interesting times ….

Consider this humble Mages Guildhall to be a serene respite from the mean and angry streets of Anvil.\n\nYou'd be surprised how few pirates care to peruse our collection of tomes and scrolls—not that I'm complaining, mind you.
Study and meditation, that's what the true mage craves. And this is the perfect guildhall for such activities—provided you can ignore the temptations of Anvil's more illicit entertainments.

I love a good fire! Not only can you use it to instigate all kinds of alchemical reactions, it's warm and cozy as all get out.\n\nSometimes I just want to curl up on the warm stone and bask in all that wonderful heat!

Don't tell anyone, but I'm the person who keeps stacking up all the books! I know it drives the magister crazy, seeing all those books piled up like little towers.\n\nHave you been upstairs yet? I'm particularly proud of the mountain I built up there.

I wouldn't keep anything in this bank if I were you. The place has a reputation for sloppy bookkeeping, if I may be so bold.\n\nAlternatively? You can certainly do worse than one of my roomy storage satchels.
I hate being this far from Wrothgar and my clan stronghold, but there are more opportunities for a good stablemaster here on the Gold Coast.\n\nAt least, that's what everybody keeps telling me.

This crowd loves to drink and sing along with whatever entertainer Pius has procured for the evening. It's kind of a tradition.\n\nI just hope whoever he's hired is better than the last poor sod who tried to take the stage. That incident was ugly!

I used to be the cook on the pirate ship Strong Wind, but I much prefer preparing food on dry land. If my pots and pans are going to spin around, I want it to be because I'm drunk and not because the sea is choppy.
This one would welcome you to Anvil, but this is a terrible place. Crime, pirates, bad food … but not mine, mind you. My groceries are perfect.
I get most of the materials I use from the Thazahrr Cartel out of Abah's Landing. The prices make my head hurt, but at least the quality is mediocre.
I never enjoyed sharing a shop with another merchant, especially not someone as obnoxious and full of herself as that Dark Elf, but space is at a premium in Anvil these days.
Have you visited the Cathedral in Kvatch yet? What a beautiful building! And I love going inside and listening to the Sermonizers. All that talk about time and the Dragon makes my scales tingle!
Yes, I have an unusual name. Yes, I like to do all of those things, though not necessarily in that order.\n\nIs there some other trivial matter you wish to discuss or can I get back to work now?
Look at what walked into my shop! You're as yummy as a sweetroll, you are!\n\nLet's finish up our business so we can get right to the pleasure, you adorable little monkey!

There's no one in a city full of pirates who's more in demand than a good carpenter, damn the luck! Can I take a day off? No. Can I even eat my lunch in peace? Never going to happen.\n\nSpeaking of which, I suppose you want something, hmm?

We're so fortunate here in Kvatch! Not only does the good Count Carolus watch over us like a mother hen, but we also have the great Cathedral and the Order of the Hour to protect us.\n\nThat's why nothing bad ever happens here!

I've always been so proud of the Order of the Hour. What other city has such holy and noble knights dedicated to protecting it?\n\nBut the newest members of the Order don't seem to be quite up to their usual standards. They seem a bit … rough to me.
Safe and safe your valuables will be! Our vault seals tighter than the primate's gold pouch—and we all know how rarely his holiness opens that little velvet bag.
Prim and proper, that's the Kvatch way! Of course, that doesn't mean we can't also be a little stylish, am I right? Feel free to examine my wares.

Have you heard the legends of the Dark Brotherhood? Is it truly possible for a cartel of assassins to operate without anyone suspecting?\n\nI don't believe it for a moment, but I probably won't rest easily this night with such thoughts in my head.

The wonders contained within this shop are not for the faint of heart. Are you certain you wish to proceed?\n\nAh, I see you aren't one of the usual bores who wander in hoping to see an amazement of some sort. Please feel free to look around.

"The jaunt, the bounce, the swaying tail. Like a ship on four legs, pounding down the trail."\n\nThat's one of my favorite lines from the poems of Drusk the Would-Be Bard. It describes my favorite animal perfectly!
"Herein lie the countless damned, their worth measured only by the weight of the gold that condemned them. Cast your eyes upon the herd and single out your prey."
This way! Hurry!
Hurry, follow me!
Keelcutters! To me!
The guild coffers are really starting to fill up. Wait—don't repeat that … I'd better do another count.
Can I help you?
How can I help you?
Don't stand on the metal grate!
When the Black Hand sealed the Sanctuary, I had no idea they left the bodies where they fell. Let's see what the resin reveals.
Lyra …?
It is good to shop now, you see, for it is nearly time for this one to leave and sleep upon her gold for a time.
<Anvil's bounty board may be its most commonly used fixture. Requests from up and down the Gold Coast can be found here.>
My blades are the sharpest in Anvil. Go ahead and take a look.
Doesn't matter where it came from. You'll get no questions from me.
Why not take a load off? You look like you've been working yourself to the bone.
Ah, another customer! And the merchants back in Anvil said I was crazy to set up shop out here. What do those pirate-lovers know?
I carry only the best goods. Your gold will go a long way here.
There's a hidden evil corrupting Kvatch.
Murder is a filthy business in the eyes of Akatosh!
It's good to see you again, friend!
The way you drove your blade home, that was a magnificent kill, Silencer. Artorius experienced the requisite amount of fear, anger, and pain just before you finished him off.\n\nGood job!
The Grand Sermonizer, called home to Akatosh before her time!
It's all right to be angry, you faithful of Akatosh!

I've got more bounties on my head than anyone else in the Sanctuary!\n\nIt's not that I get caught in the act of killing, Night Mother forbid! It's just that I appreciate a good challenge, so I let a witness notice me every so often.
Edwina! Another stray animal has wandered into my court. Edwina! Where is that girl?\n\nWell, what do you want?
She smells you. Head to the food tables!
Did that cabinet just … click?
Let's split up. I'll meet you at <<c:1>>. The others need to hear what happened.
More rats? You die!
You stay down, or I make you dead again!
Nothing.
Please! Anything would help.
Get away from me!
I'll have no trouble. The Red Sails guaranteed a safe haven to do business.
<<1>> is a liar. I don't have the Knahaten Flu.
Less talking, more laundering. We both have a quota, so stop wasting my time.
You break chain, Xal-Nur breaks you!
Die! Die! Die!
Puny rats fall down!
Hahahahaha!
One of the beasts is loose!
You not be clean for long!
This place is not meant for you. Get out!
A gladiator's life is simple. Fight and live or fight and die. Sometimes I envy that.
Trespassers!
Drown in darkness!
<The Kvatch bounty board is neatly organized, displaying odd jobs from private citizen in an orderly fashion.>
Shadows may waver in the light, but not this.
Drink deep of my power, beast. Become the avatar of my wrath!
The beast and I are one! Our victory is assured!
The darkness weighs heavy. So tired. I must … rest.

Let me guess. Looking to hear my life story? Hoping we can be fast friends, clasp hands and go on a killing spree? I propose an alternative. Step away from me or we'll need a broom to clean up your remains.

I'm glad Artorius is dead. Does that make me a bad person?\n\nHe took Mirabelle and Cimbar and the others away from us. Ultimately, their deaths are on his head. I'm glad I was there to see you finish him off, Silencer.
I look forward to working with you again, Silencer. Perhaps we could share a murder spree sometime soon, yes?
You made the rank of Silencer faster than anyone I've ever known. Not bad for a wet-behind-the-ears New-blade.
Silencer. I hope you carry the title with pride. You don't answer to me anymore, but we're happy to have you work with us whenever you wish.
The Order will make quick work of you!
You will be judged!
There's no escape from the cleansing flame!
Cool your fevered head, for your victory is at an end.
My rippers will make short work of you!
Business is looking up and mother is so pleased! And it's all because of that charming Lord Jarol. He's always so patient and kind toward me.
Why do you disturb me, Initiate?
Yes, Assassin?
Night Mother smile upon you, Silencer.
Your task is clear, Initiate. Execute it.
Is it done, Initiate?
Was there something else, Assassin?
Welcome back, Assassin. What of your task?
I trust it's done, Silencer.
You know how best to conduct your work, Silencer.
Don't kill me.
Don't kill me.
No, Initiate. First you finish the contract, then you speak to me.
If you're displeased with the selection of contracts, give it a day or so. There's a high turnover.
For a Silencer, you do seem to enjoy talking. It's slightly charming.
It's not my gold, but I'd suggest you get to work on that contract.
You should know how this relationship works by now, Assassin. Something you wanted?
I expect that contract won't take long, Silencer.
Aren't you finished yet, Initiate?
Another notch on your belt, Assassin?
How many souls did you offer up to Sithis today?
I heard apples are poisonous to minotaurs. That's why I eat three of them daily when I'm on the road.
Yes, the sign says eighty-three ales on tap. But we have eighty-two empty barrels, so you'll order what's left.
Bah. Some Chapel of Dibella …. Goddess of love my arse. Ain't seen a single strumpet since I came ashore!
If you're looking for a warm welcome, you've come to the wrong place. This castle's just a pirate's roost nowadays.
I saw what you did. Got my eye on you. Both of them.
Sorry friend, we're between games. You wouldn't wanna play me anyway. Nobody plays Fool-Me Dice like Ginereth.
If you're looking for work, shove off. Got no room for unhinged adventurers on this boat. People like you bring nothing but trouble.
The lighthouse is beautiful to look at, but you couldn't pay me enough to go inside. Too many rumors, friend. Dark rumors.
Chapel of Dibella my big toe! When I was your age, the priests would dance down the lane every morning—naked as a noon-day sparrow! Now? Robes from chin to ankle. \n\nShameful!
These Sermonizers are everywhere! I can tell you, they're not doing Akatosh any favors. If I didn't like him before, I sure hate him now!
You approach the Tower of Judgment. I hope you do so with a pious heart. I'd hate to have you removed like those stumble-drunk criminals that blunder in here at all hours of the night.
Best watch your back. Dangerous folk skulking about—and I don't mean those pirates. Don't worry though. Gristle and I are on the hunt. These murderers can't hide forever.
Time is on my side, assassins!
My followers will deal with the likes of you!
By the Eight … where could he be?
It's all right, Plautus. Just stay calm ….
Does watching battling criminals make you thirsty? Why not purchase a cold drink?
More blood for the roots!
Invaders! Put them in shackles!
Claim their skins for Na-Kesh!
Submit, beast!
Drink deep, and fall to madness!
You would face me again? Foolish.
Your blood and water are mine.
What do you think? The resemblance is uncanny, isn't it? My ancestor, carved in stone.\n\nThe family has fallen on hard times. Shouldn't have hitched our wagons so firmly to Varen Aquilarios.

I have never been accused of illicit activity in my life, yet that horrid chanter claimed I was part of the Dark Brotherhood!\n\nIt's all just a ploy to claim my holdings for the Cathedral of Akatosh. Everyone knows.
Used to call Fortunata my friend before her "promotion." Now she won't give me the time of day.\n\nTypical.
Fortunata did love her drink. I always said it would be the death of her.
The Naughty Nereid Players are amazing! They made me look at "Netches, Netches, All Around" in a whole new light!
<Remains silent.>
Entrust your worth to no other.
I don't care what anyone else says, men in skirts are quite fetching.\n\nEspecially those Legionaries.
Entrust your worth to no other.
I don't care what anyone else says, men in skirts are quite fetching. Especially those Legionaries.
Refresh your libations, citizens. The next fight is about to begin!
And we have our winners! Freedom is their reward!
Drown in the dark!
Mistress hear my call!
She will strangle the light!
Care to dance?
And who will die next?
Too slow.
I don't die that easy.
Not afraid of the dark, are you?
I knew you'd come back to me!
Who—who's there?
Surprise.
For Mephala, and the Skein!
Come, I have a secret to tell.
The darkness binds you.
For Mephala!
The poor little morsel, succumbed to the dark.
You're mine! All mine!
Hahaha! Stop wriggling!
Time to season the meat!
One hero, finely minced!
You look good enough to eat!
Let that meat rest!
Dinner is served!
Poor things, never had a chance.
Don't be shy! Join us!
The Scaled Court claims this place. Do not resist. You will become thralls, just like the Sword-Disciples.
This won't take long.
Onward and inward.
You will not live long, intruders.
Wait … wait. Where'd my tail go? Did you—oh, there it is. Close call.
Look at this pile of debris! Sahalu will die of old age before it is cleared. Poor Sahalu.
Norgim do Khersim! Osh! Osh!
Ignore these dull-clawed miners and traders—nothing but thieves and swindlers, the lot of them. The best deals happen here, with Shurami!
Mauloch's third jaw-bone! How do those spindly legs hold you up? Let's put some meat on that skinny frame!
If you plan on thumping some Iron Orcs, that's dangerous business. Need a little liquid courage? I have a few select brews you might want to try.
There's nothing but brambles and poison berries out there in the crags, friend. If you need quality provisions, I'm the Breton to talk to.
Iron Orcs? Pshaw! More like … like … paper Orcs! Gonna write some bad words on them, fold them up, and post them back to their ugly Orc mothers! Har!
Damned miners keep dragging that red stone down here. Nothing but worthless rock, if you ask me.

Been days since we've seen an ore wagon. Bah. A mine's just a hole in the ground if you can't trade what you chip out of it. \n\nBeen hauling red brittle just to make ends meet. That's how desperate it's gotten. Damned Iron Orcs ….
Just need … a moment. I'll be fine. Just let me rest for a bit?
Would it kill the workers to just use the ramps? This winch is about as reliable as a three-legged mule with the red brittle shakes.
I like it up here. A brisk wind blows off the slopes, and you can't beat the view.
Another victim of this monument to greed. I'm afraid it's going to get worse before it gets any better.
With the mine closed, we only have to work when we want to. That gives me much more time to work on my epic story!\n\nI'm going to be a famous storyteller, just like Veesk-Olan and Fjokki the Bard.
Let those other fools mine red brittle. Azzaril prefers iron and orichalc ore. Gold is much better than the shakes, yes?
What are you looking at, you faithless coward? This is the Blood-Feathers' camp. You are not worthy to look upon our greatness!

I think this axe is too heavy. Does it look too big to you? I should have gotten a spear. A really long spear. Don't want to get too close when you stick an enemy, right? I heard the blood spurts all over the place.

My accompaniment had to sail back to Auridon. Alas, he lost all the fingers on his playing hand in a tragic accident. \n\nBut do not concern yourself. It was a favor to everyone near and far. His music was terrible, even before the accident.
This architecture is really something, isn't it? Those old Nords really knew what they were doing. Hard to believe it was made by hands as big and clumsy as mine.
This table is off limits. Taken. Reserved.\n\nThat means keep walking, pudding pie.
Best lighten that purse before someone puts a hole in it. Let's make a deal!
I hate waiting around! I didn't march half-way across Cyrodiil to fight practice mannequins!\n\nIf we don't get to kill something soon, I might have to go pick a fight with the Blood Feathers!

Hello. I'm the healer for the Diamond's Daughters. And it's thirsty work! Keeping these sods alive is like trying to grow dragonthorn in saltwater.\n\nBut lucky for them, I have plenty to drink and I'm equal to the challenge.
Plan to compete in the Arena? Well, mind the traps. A spike in the arse will kill you just as dead as a sword in the belly.
No utensils required! We don't stand on ceremony here. Dig in!
Shaveskins laugh at this one's belly. Lucky for them, Sugar-Dance has plenty of self-confidence and a very calm demeanor.

Dahnkin is a very good listener and has heard many things about the Arena. More than just fighters roam the Arena—much more. \n\nThis one does not know how they get all the strange creatures inside, but this one promises to find out.
When so many warriors gather, egos become as fragile as egg shells. Walk softly and try not to step on too many as you go.
Halt. We've no rations to spare and we keep our own council. Now move along. We're really quite busy.
What do you want? Can't you see I'm busy?
You have wandered into the Five Claws camp. Are you lost?
Many greetings, my friend. Glorious view, don't you think?
Why go to Cyrodiil when we can bring Cyrodiil to you? Have a look!
Everyone's got a story to tell and I'm here to listen.
Feh. These gray Orcs smell like a mammoth's armpit, but this red metal will fetch a fine price, yes?
I hear that they punish deserters in my cohort by drowning them in a well. I guess that's all right. It's pretty difficult to drown an Argonian.
Fighting for Isrudde's a real joy, let me tell you. Queen Ayrenn's nice on the eyes, sure, but she pays about as well as a one-legged farmer. Now I earn more in a week than I did in a year.
Beat one rotten soldier to death and you're ostracized for life.
In search of high-quality equipment at a fair price? You've come to the right place.
The merchandise is over there. Purchase something or be on your way.
Victory for Dragonstar!
Your gifts go to support the defense of Craglorn.
May you inherit a country flowing with waters.
You wouldn't by any chance know where I could acquire fresh corpses?
Used to make my bread in Wayrest fighting anyone who'd fight back, until High King Emeric shut us down.

I've traveled all across the land, but wherever I go I follow one rule. I never tell anyone my name.\n\nYou'd do well not to spread your name around, but it's probably too late for that now. Ah, well.
Release the gladiators!
They're off their leash and out for blood!
Refresh your libations, citizens. The next fight is about to begin!
And we have our winners! Freedom is their reward!
Release the gladiators!
They're off their leash and out for blood!
Why don't you come a little closer?
Come, children, your dinner awaits!
Vengeance for our children!
Hmm, I should have toyed with them a little longer.
You've worn out your welcome.

You know those giant chains that smash down with the anchors? I've climbed them. Was curious what was up top. Ended up destroying it from inside Coldhabour.\n\nFell out of the sky like a rock after that. Killed at least ten daedra by landing on them.
We will bury you!
Bad move, trespassers!
Spill their blood for the Lady!
Our thanks, we were growing hungry!
This is our domain!
Pacrooti has three simple rules for life: When something is empty, fill it. When something is full, empty it. When something is itchy, scratch it.
Select your rewards, my friend.
Wabbacat! A bonus reward!
Pacrooti is pleased to see you!
Pacrooti welcomes you! So much of his business is carried out through couriers, it is nice to finally place names with faces!
Farewell.
This one invites you to try again!
Not bad at all!
Admirable!
Exceptional!
Sweet Riddle'Thar!
Simply breathtaking!
A monumental reward!
Come, little ones. Make yourselves useful!
You dare sully this ritual with your mortal eyes? You will burn!
The Order had more visions of a relic from the Shivering Isles.
Take care when handling any of the Mad God's relics. They are not to be trifled with.
The Order thanks you for your assistance, Adept. There may be more relics you can recover for us soon enough. Check with me tomorrow, I may have something for you.
<Evil Laugh>
Another day, another dolmen.
The Fighters Guild goes where the battle takes us. Even this land of puny Dark Elves and bugs as big as a mammoth!

We're the Fighters Guild. We don't care about race, politics, or religious affiliation, just so long as you're willing to fight.\n\nWell, unless you worship a Daedric Prince. We do kind of frown upon that sort of behavior.
We are the Mages Guild. We care nothing for borders or alliances—they just get in the way of our important and singular purpose.

I find this land … strange. I appreciate the long and cherished magical tradition, really I do. But all the insects and giant fungi? Well, to be honest, the whole country makes the hair on the back of my neck stand on end.
Welcome to the Mages Guild, my friend. Are you already a member? If not, you'll want to speak to the magister about the benefits of joining our illustrious guild.

Did you feel that just now? Was that another rumble? Sorry, but that smoldering mountain has my teeth on edge. We don't have anything like that back in Skyrim.\n\nOh where are my manners? Would you like to see my wares?

This one doesn't know what to think about his Telvanni customers. On one paw, they keep people like me as slaves. On the other, their pouches overflow with more gold than this one has ever seen.\n\nWhat to do? What to do?
Oh, don't mind the big chunk of stone floating above the city. It's perfectly safe. Lord Vivec sees to that!
House Hlaalu maintains this fine financial institution. Your gold and precious goods won't find a safer home anywhere in Tamriel, I give you my word on that.

How do they keep that rock floating up there do you suppose? Annkur said it was full of torchbugs, but that sounds kind of silly to me.\n\nNetches, I could understand. Torchbugs? They would make it glow, right?
I learned my craft studying at Voljar's Meadery and the Fire-Hearth Brewery. You won't find a better beverage in all of Vvardenfell.
Working with wood isn't quite the same as working with stone or metal, but hey, it's a living.
They say the fastest way to your lover's heart is through the stomach. And what's the fastest way to the stomach? Why, with a delicious meal, of course!
There's no excuse for not looking your best in this day and age. Do you need any components to freshen up a bit?
If food were gold, then I'd be the richest merchant in Vivec City. But alas, all I have is food, food, and more food.\n\nCare to buy some food before it all spoils?
Come in and rest those weary bones! And welcome to the friendliest public house in all of Vvardenfell—you can bet your last gold piece on that!
Are you sure you've come to the right place? You don't seem like my usual sort of customer.
Trade has been slow ever since the mountain started rumbling. Please, if you have even a shred of compassion, buy something from me today!
They said I could make a fortune here, now that slavery was abolished. I just never expected there to be so many Dark Elves all over the place!
Best mounts in all of Vvardenfell, right here! Come in and see what's available today!
That does look good on you, but I can see a little wear and tear around the shoulders. Won't you let me put you in something that matches your eyes?
Days like these, boredom sets in like a ship dropping anchor in the bay. Please oh please, bring some excitement into Old Amarz's dull life and buy something! Preferably something expensive.
Yes, yes, your goods will be perfectly safe. I personally guarantee it.
All are welcome, so come in and enjoy yourself, my friend!
Dark Elves! Put a little fermented meat in the brew and they call out the Redoran soldiers! I don't know why I try to share my stash with such ungrateful skeevers.
Your custom is welcome here.
Dark Elves have unusual tastes, at least in my experience. I'll cater to those tastes, mind you, just don't ask me to eat any slime or beetle curds—thank you very much!
The golden guar sleeps quietly in the night. Pass it on.
Best mind your manners around these Dark Elves. They'd sooner put you in chains than look at you. But enough of that. You need something?
I can't speak for all Dark Elves, but I've found that a cheerful attitude can go a long way when one serves the public.
I'll not haggle with you. Prices are what they are. Take it or leave it.
My master bids you welcome. What can I help you with today?
I make sure to give all the food a … personal touch.
Come, outlander! Join me for a drink! I could use some pleasant company. These Telvanni just don't know how to relax.
This life is not so bad. Short-Leash keeps to himself. Stays quiet. No one gives him a second look. As long as he does not fail, all is good.
A new face—and not a moment too soon. What can I do for you?
Honor to you, sera. I'm certain I have something of interest to a seasoned traveler.
The Telvanni mages kind of make my skin crawl, but they certainly know how to drink.\n\nI can appreciate that.
How nice to meet you! I hope you're enjoying your stay! Watch your step, if you don't mind, I tend to get underfoot when I'm going about my routine.

The poor miners! No way to put food on their tables while the glass mine remains closed. That's why Sevus offers our regular customers a generous line of credit.\n\nYes, his rates are high, but an Elf's got to make a living.
The pilgrims visiting the sites sacred to Almalexia usually fill this place to the rafters, but not now. It's like I always say. Trouble is bad for business.

You probably wouldn't guess it, but I'm a native. Vvardenfell born and raised. My parents came here for a visit and decided to stay, so here I am!\n\nAnd I really enjoy helping the pilgrims in any way I can.
Honor to you and your house, sera. Looking for something in particular or just browsing?
You're back. And you have all the pieces you left with.\n\nUnless you had an extra finger and now you don't? In which case, cheer up, no more gold spent on custom gloves.
I've seen tougher meat horked up by a mama wolf for her cubs.\n\nWell … you may have a bit of gristle to you. And I might have some work.

Vvardenfell can be a dangerous place. Slavers, rocks falling from the sky, a mountain threatening to explode … makes me wonder what I'm still doing here. But who would feed these people if I left? I don't want that on my conscience.
Do you like firm, juicy tomatoes? I've been told that mine are the best in the city. Go ahead and see for yourself.

Remember, your allegiance is to the Fighters Guild. We don't care about race, politics, or religious affiliation, as long as you're willing to fight.\n\nWell, unless you worship a Daedric Prince. We frown upon that sort of behavior around here.
Greetings, outlander. If you come in good faith, I have goods to sell.
Welcome, seeker of knowledge and connoisseur of magicka! I look forward to examining the tomes you've recovered when time permits.
Have you returned with the wayward relic?
I have more Fighters Guild work, if you need it.
Oh, a free-scale deigns to enter my kitchen. How can a humble, malnourished slave help you today?
You should not be here, egg-kin. Make your purchase and flee this place.

I feel so much safer now that the mountain has stopped rumbling. It was like Shor himself was stoking his forge and rattling the land with every blow of his hammer. I wonder what he crafted under there?\n\nSpeaking of which, need any armor today?
This one will try to be patient with your impatience!
I thought for sure that the floating rock was going to crash into the city, but everything seems fine now. Which means life goes on, so let's get down to business.
So Savarak's gone then? At last, commerce can resume in earnest! What can I do for you?
It's good to have Mistress Dratha back. She's a cold kwama, but good for business. What can I get you?
More thieves! Stop them!
Ashlander thief! You can't hide from me.
Do you think we can complete the ritual with a different item?
I say we go out and slaughter every Ashlander tribe in Vvardenfell.
The High Priestess will figure something out, just as she always does.
Give me a moment with one of the survivors and I'll find out where they took our relic.
I was really looking forward to becoming a god.
How bad is it? Can the High Priestess replace the item?
Do you think the miners were feeding that troll?
How did the Ashlanders find out about the relic?
Would our Daedric Lord betray us like this?
Show your teeth when you see me, Undaunted. You might not have them for long.\n\nCome, take your pledge with a smile!
The day's work is done. Raise a mug and let the night's work begin!
You can study my countenance as much as you like. Wouldn't you rather have a reward?
Did you not want your reward? Or was this just an excuse to come see me?
Is that really necessary?
What is this? Control your people, <<1>>!
I should have let Rigurt have this posting.
No home? Then where is this one supposed to deliver your goods?
Homeless? And you still want to shop here? Good enough for me.
Weather in this part of the world can be brutal when you don't have a roof over your head.
Homeless? What a shame. Even lowly Scamps can find a dark hole to hide in.
You don't have a place to sleep at night? Not even a branch high in a tree? I'm at a loss for words!
A home is like an egg. Soft and comfortable on the inside, hard and protective on the outside. You really should get a home.
No home? I can sympathize. I was in your boots not too long ago myself.
You don't have a home? Where do you hang your pictures?
A home calls to you like the heart yearns for Mara. Answer that call.
The furnishings I deal in require a clientele of a certain pedigree. Without a home of your own, you hardly qualify, but feel free to look around.
Home goods for sale! Compliant with the Moons, the Green Pact, and the Eight!
Something frivolous for your home?
A home is more than a roof and four walls. I'm sure I have something else you need.
If your home desperately needs something Daedric, you've come to the right place. I can set you up with the most unsettling pieces.
Add a few of these priceless heirlooms to your home and you'll be one step closer to perfection. Just like me.
Are you someone famous? Perhaps I've heard of you. Well, in that case, let me show you my stock.
Now you I've heard of! I saved something special just for you!
It's you! It's really you! I hope to prove my worth by showing you something truly special today!
A reputation clings to a person like mud clings to a boot. Always make sure yours is a good one.
Choose a crate, my friend.
Select the crate, and we can begin.
There are no crates remaining. Purchase more if you wish to try your luck again!
Jone and Jode! Do you realize we under attack?
Tales of your exploits fill the taverns. Allow me the honor to provide you with something to commemorate your accomplishments. You can display it in your home or not. That's entirely up to you.
I am not worthy to wallow in the mud of your greatness. Even so, I have something special for your home, if that appeals to you.
Some days, you just have to say "tusk it" and do something crazy and extravagant. I can help you with that.
Careful, friend. The bigger your legend grows, the more people will try to cut you down. In the meantime, let's talk home furnishings.
I could have been as famous and esteemed as you, but another path called to me. Now I serve those of prestige and honor by filling their homes with priceless treasures.
You should be honored. I only sell quite interesting things to quite interesting people.
Now you I know and respect! Let's get right down to business, shall we?
You're here? You're really here! You honor me, champion. Now let me honor you. I only show these furnishings to a select few.
A reputation is like a fine wine, and as such, it deserves the proper vessel to contain it. The same is true for my wares. Does your home fit the bill?
You're building something of a reputation, aren't you? Good for you! Now, what can I sell you for your home?
When someone of your caliber decides to grace me with their presence, the least I can do is break out my exclusive stock.
Kindle and burn!
A wonderful selection of rewards!
Your luck amazes Pacrooti! Perhaps he needs to shuffle better.
Pacrooti welcomes you! Are you interested in excitement and valuable rewards? This one can help!
Greetings, my friend! Are you ready for excitement and outstanding rewards?
Ooo, did you see that? You can only receive one unique reward, so you get sparkly gems instead! These are very valuable.
Jone and Jode! You have opened more crates than any other player on this day!
My friend! You are now the greatest player in the history of this game! You should be very proud!
You ready to drop the goods off?
Hey there. Looking for me?
Excellent. I'll get this to the right hands.
Do you drink this? Is that the right color? No matter, no matter.
Nice. How do you bend the metal like that? Anyway, here's your fee.
Very nice. What else can I say? You definitely made it work. I'll get this to the client.
I can read these. Most in my line of work can. They're like notes to us. Here's your fee.
Quite a pairing and quite a feast. Don't worry about packing it up. The client will take it like it is.
Finely engraved, solid and sturdy. Nice polish, too. Here's your fee.
Ow! Something just shocked me!
We depart within the hour. Where are you headed?
I won't promise comfortable accommodations.
You are ready? We soon depart for distant lands.
Activated, but not in the proper sequence. Try again.
Everyone celebrates the New Life their own way. I do so love the variety.
The brazier ignited. That's a good sign.
Cracked any more snail shells lately? Actually, if you do, bring me the mucus.
Ah, nothing says luxury like dust covering every inch of your store. It's only matched by the sounds of construction day and night. Lovely, isn't it?\n\nWhat can I get you today?
The study of alchemy is a time-honored tradition, passed down from generation to generation. So I expect no silliness here, understood?\n\nNow, what are you in need of?
Vvardenfell will soon need the services of the Fighters Guild. We are looking for recruits.
The Mages Guild could use a recruit of your caliber. We should talk.
Here to do a bit of enchanting? Well, you've enchanted me already. What can I do for you?
Well, your hands are a bit chubby for fine measurements, but we all have our burdens to bear.
Pacrooti sees that you are ready to play! Excellent!
Sister, is that the best you can do?
Shiny gems! My compliments!
Ahem.
Mmm hmmm.
Ha haaa.
<humming>
Hm hmmm!
An excellent selection!
Pacrooti has three simple rules for life: When something is empty, fill it. When something is full, empty it. When something is itchy, scratch it.
Mmm hmmm.
I got what you need.
You want something special, yes?
Kizmar should be hard at work, but it is good to sit. Either way, this one is not paid, so what does it matter?
What secrets could this building hold? We'll have to dig deep in order to find out.
I don't like the feel of this place. Too much magic.
Smuggling? Who said anything about smuggling? I run an honest transportation service. Above board and squeaky clean, that's our motto.
Ah! Another weary traveler looking to reach the glorious land of Vvardenfell. Are you ready for the journey?
Vvardenfell? I may have room in my hold for one more passenger.
Vvardenfell? Well, yes, my ship goes to Vvardenfell.
My ship's the fastest vessel to sail the Vvardenfell waterways. We never run aground!
Sea travel seems to be all the rage these days. Are you looking for passage on a ship?
My ship is at your service. Discreetly, of course. Just let me know which authorities to avoid.
Nothing happened. Something really should have happened.
Where's the ink? Damn.
We're just about ready to set sail. I don't know about you, but the moonlet is looking a little too close for comfort these days.
You don't understand! I need to see Lord Vivec!
The priests seem nervous today.
Baar Dau! It's moving!
Someone stop that swine!
Here pig! Here piggy pig pig! Piggy?
Now, where did I put those sketches?
Always glad to see a fellow adept returning to our halls! I trust your search for knowledge goes well?
Ah! Another member of our ranks. It's times like these when I love the Fighters Guild!
All things grow. All things need tending. How can I tend to you, friend?
Earlier, I thought the mountain was exploding, but it was just one of those netch passing overhead. Nothing makes me want to shop like a little brush with death. How about you?
Even in these troubled times there are fair winds and fair trades. Wares of all kinds, here for your pleasure.
This doesn't look right.
Ah, a customer! Welcome to this one's humble shop.
See what wonders the Telvanni have brought to us!
Welcome to Tel Naga, the best smelling trading hub in all of Sadrith Mora. What can I do for you?
Pay no heed to these Telvanni charlatans. Join the Mages Guild and learn from the true masters of the arcane arts!
Sadrith Mora. Ha! A monument to wasted potential. These Telvanni fools think they possess true power. We know better, don't we?
Looking for more adventure than you can find in this fetid swamp? Then fight against the oppression of Molag Bal. Join the Fighters Guild!
Not even the expansive shadow of Tel Naga can dim my pleasure in seeing another member of our ranks. Welcome!
She'll know you're coming! She always knows.
They worked my son until he collapsed and sent him to the Forge. It's been days since I've seen him ….
