True prey at last!
You think you can defy me? Fool!
Dwemer, obey my call!
Hunt-Father! I pledge this feast to you!
The land's blood is my blood!
Don't be crude! Telvanni!
Hail, Redoran!
House Hlaalu?
House Hlaalu?
House Hlaalu!
Fair travels and good fortune!
House Redoran?
House Redoran!
Honor for the House.
House Telvanni, I presume?
Telvanni, of course!
Shall we travel together?
The Scarlet Judge! I thought that was just a legend!
Praise Vivec! A legend walks among us!
And a blessed day to you, Scarlet Judge.
Is that the Scarlet Judge? What an … interesting outfit choice.
What was that?
Wait, this isn't right.
This one has many pretty things for a fine homeowner such as yourself. Would you like to see?
This one is saddened to see a fine individual such as yourself without a home. Rest your eyes upon the wonders that could be yours. Oh, if only you had lodging. Well-kept, well furnished lodging.
A reputation clings to a person like mud clings to a boot. Always make sure yours is a good one.
Tales of your exploits fill the taverns. Allow me the honor to provide you with something to commemorate your accomplishments.
I am not worthy to wallow in the mud of your greatness. Even so, I have something special for your home.
A hero without a home is like a tree without roots. Lucky for you there are many houses to plant yourself in.
An honor to see you, Emperor. How can my humble shop be of service to one as great as yourself?
It's not often a warrior of your esteem visits Vvardenfell. How can my humble shop be of service to your home?
Even a grizzled warrior such as yourself deserves a nice home to return to.
It's my honor to serve you. How may my most worthy shop be of service, Emperor? Are you seeking pieces to display of your most esteemed accomplishments?
It's not often a warrior of your esteem visits Vvardenfell. Why not show off your great deeds with some fine pieces of furniture?
A warrior has to prove themselves constantly in these parts. I have the best furniture around to prove you did just that.
Yes, um, well, yes, hello! Nice to, well, meet you. Um….\n\nHow can I best be helping you? Oh drat, I mean, help you! How can I best help you!
Come see the best wares in all Vivec City! No, in all of Vvardenfell! No, in all of Tamriel! Yes, the best goods this side of Nirn, right here for your convenience!
More constructs! Use my sigils!
I hear that the House Guard broke up a band of slavers operating on one of the nearby islands. I'm glad for that, but the slavers will probably be back in business before you know it.
Oh dear. I believe we've made another wrong turn.
We're still looking for that murderer Omellian. He can't be far now.
We're still looking for that scoundrel Omellian. He can't be far now.
You might be a big deal in Cyrodiil, Emperor, but in Ularra? In there, it's a whole other deal.
Ularra's a dangerous place, but you look like the type of warrior who can hold your own. You might just come out of these old ruins in one piece.
Ah, a fresh face. Ripe for the battleground of Ularra. May the Tribunal help you. You'll need it.

Ah, the Emperor of Cyrodiil. I got wind that you were visiting these parts. \n\nHeading into Ald Carac? Good luck. You're going to need it. The teams fight harder in there than in any war I've ever heard of.

I've seen that look before. You have the eyes of my mentor before he leaped into a philosophical debate. And he didn't often lose. Unlike the last fifteen fools I've seen step foot onto that field. You should do well in Ald Carac.
Why anyone would want to fight in the battlegrounds is beyond me. Who would want to waste their life in combat? I much prefer scientific debate.
I don't care if you are the Emperor of Cyrodiil, you're going to have to wait. As long as there's fighting going on, the stone from Foyada Quarry is staying right where it is.
You! You look like just the sort of person I need. Someone has to get into that quarry and knock some sense into those fools. I need more stone to build the city.
Foyada Quarry! Why me? Of all the quarries in Vvardenfell, why did I have to get the one that everyone wants to fight over? I'll never provide enough stone for Vivec City at this rate.
Trespasser signatures in transport circuit. <<1>> required for eviction.
<<1>> malfunction. Logging error. Replacement request processing.
Breach of interstitial corridors detected. Activating localized security systems.
Yes! Another victory for the glorious Pit Daemons! We're unstoppable!
Me? Cheer for the Storm Lords? For the Pit Daemons? Never!\n\nFire Drakes forever!
Storm Lords are the fiercest competitors. They'll always win!
It does not much matter what team Fezreba plays for, as long as the gold is right.
I came all the way from Abah's Landing to fight in the Battlegrounds. I can't wait to get back on the field again!
Dayas just wants the fighting to stop. Me? I want it to go on forever!
Before the battlegrounds, all I watched was stones being moved. Now my eyes feast upon never-ending battle. I hope the fighting goes on forever.
Foreman Mevel needs to relax. We let his workers gather stone between fights.
Overseer Shiralas is going to kill me if we don't get more stone in soon. But do I have a say in that? No, of course I don't. A senseless death if I ever heard one!
Jump through the Slowfall sigil before you're disintegrated!
Attack the secondary terminals!
Temperature threshold critical. Ventilating system.
Structural integrity failure imminent. Emergency shutdown initiated.
Come back, Rosy!
Who's a good little netch? You are!
My workers might be the laziest in Vvardenfell. We need to draw more stone from the quarry, but all they want to do is watch the battles.
The Black Snails attacked the field hands again. Magistrate Fels is going to find a way to help. Soon. I think.
I guess I should be happier that he's gone, but I really liked Magistrate Fels. I'm going to miss him.
Ever since Mistress Dratha became ill, I have been miserable. I hope she gets well soon.
I wonder if any magistrate ever really cares about us.
I've never worked so hard in all my days, but Lord Vivec's worth it. I'm helping make the greatest city in the whole of Nirn!
I'm glad I'm not actually in the city. Baar Dau is about to crush it flat!
Lord Vivec actually spoke to you! Spoke! To you! Do you know how lucky you are? If I work harder, perhaps he'll speak to me too!
This banning of slavery is so irksome. Why must I suffer through the slowness of these free workers?
No! Baar Dau can't come down! Everything will be ruined!
Everyone is working faster now that the moonlet is stable again, but the number of breaks they take! Ugh! If I had a contingent of tireless slaves, we'd be done by now.
This city will be the pride of all of Vvardenfell one day, mark my words. And we, my friend, get to watch it grow, one stone at a time.\n\nIt makes me all atingle!
Vivec protect us! Baar Dau is falling!
Baar Dau is much closer now that that harrowing experience has come to an end.\n\nI think I like it better this way. You can practically see every crack and crevice now.
Only the most faithful can join the personal guard of Lord Vivec. I'm honored to serve among their number as a Buoyant Armiger.
Quickly, find cover! Lord Vivec will set things right, but until then it's best not to stand around in the open.
It was all just an elaborate test. Lord Vivec wanted to make sure our faith was strong.\n\nI think we passed with flying colors.

Since the Pact ordered all slaves to be set free, everything has changed. Oh, I still work long hours and get told exactly what to do. But at least now I get paid for my efforts.\n\nThat makes all the difference.
I'm free and things are finally looking up for me, and this happens? Why does the swamp hate me?
The disaster has passed and I've been given a second chance. A third chance? Whatever number this is, I'm eternally grateful.
Heading to the battlegrounds? I have just the thing for you.
Something catch your eye? Something hard to find? Something exotic, perhaps?
That creature's using my power as an anchor!

When I left Daggerfall, I never thought I'd end up working for the Tribunal. May the Eight Divines forgive me! \n\nIt does take some getting used to, having your God walk around like a regular person. Almost makes me want to convert.
Not now … not yet. The fire. The unmourned house. Must … be ready.
I smell a mortal.
Fetch me that thing's heart.
Hurt it, hurt it!
Me no wretch.
The Master promised treasures, but all I see is dust.
Did you see the way those priests ran?
Me hate spirits.
You took it. You eat it.
Plenty of jobs coming in all the time for an adventurer such as yourself. Come and see me any time you're looking for work.
Nothing's available at the moment. Come back later and I may have something for you.
Well this is odd. I could have sworn I've given you a job. Shouldn't you be off doing it?
The Temple cannot spare the resources to handle every problem that comes our way. But perhaps you can.
Your compassion is your strength. To aid others is to enrich the spirit. Thank you for all that you've done.
Alas, I have nothing else to tell you on this matter. Speak with the one who made the request.
Good to see you again. Perseverance is the key to success!
You have completed all I can offer you today.
Complete your task and then we can talk about your reward.
Here comes the mighty champion!
The fabricants are reactivating!
The outlander returns. This land hasn't broken you yet? Good.\n\nReady for another hunt?
They're empowering one another!
One of them is overcharged!
They're at their limit! Link them!

Your skill impresses, but you want to pace yourself. The thrill of the hunt beckons, but even the best hunter requires rest and reflection after a successful foray into the wild.\n\nReturn later if you want to attempt to track another quarry.
Hunt and kill your prey, then bring me a trophy to prove that the deed was done.
And so the hunter returns. What trophy have you brought me?
Careful near the guar, outlander. You walk among the Ahemmusa. We will not tolerate interference with our herd.
Be warned, outlander. Weakness has no home in the Erabenimsun.
If you want to get into Tel Aruhn, just go through the door. If you want something else, go bother someone else.
Keep your head down and the mages will not notice you. That is how we get by here.
Not many outlanders come to Tel Branora. Most prefer the comforts of Vivec City.
Magister Therana doesn't entertain much. She lives way out here because she prefers solitude.\n\nI hope you take the hint.
I don't know why I bother to make the trip to Tel Branora. Between the hazards of the swamps and the reclusive mages, it's almost not worth the trouble.

I erect the spine of disappointment. How can one possibly study the effects of pilgrimage on a local economy if there are no pilgrims?\n\nI could prune my focus to a case study, but that would simply be a tree with no branches.
Don't tell my brother I'm here. He prides himself on his cooking, but he's made this resolution to not eat meat. I can't stand it.
This one does not mope around when there is work to be done!
The Tribunal's Blessings upon you, outlander. It is good to see you at the temple.
Did you hear that? No? Must be the wind.
My sweet Varona is counting on me to finish building this wonderful city. I'll try my best.
Thank the Three! I'm grateful Varona wasn't harmed when Baar Dau dropped.
Any day I don't have to go down in that pit is a good day.
Blessings of the Tribunal to you, my friend.
I hate garrison duty. It's an armiger's lot to charge into danger, not hide behind walls.
Keba's a good dog, but she doesn't like Baar Dau very much. Every time I take her outside she barks at the damn moonlet until her little voice gets hoarse.
This beautiful city must be a treat for an outlander like yourself. I'm sure you're ignorant of our many customs, but don't worry. No one expects that much from you.

A fellow Dark Elf! So good to see you! If I had to deal with one more ignorant n'wah from who knows where, I would have screamed.\n\nWhat can I help you with today, f'lah?
Yes? Can I help you? Or are you going to stand around slack-jawed all day?\n\nWell, where would you like to go?

I'm glad an outlander such as yourself is taking interest in silt strider traveling. You'll find it far more reliable than your typical caravan.\n\nWhere would you like to go today?

Surprised to see your face again.\n\nHere for a personal visit? Or just to get drunk? Either way, I wouldn't mind you buying me a drink.
You may have been impressive on Scalecaller, but that doesn't suddenly make us bosom buddies. Save your heartfelt reunions for someone else.
The antidotes finished! Here, take it!
If I had some beetle juice, I could work up an antidote!
Let's drain that pesky energy, shall we?
Your bodies shall wither away. Beautiful, beautiful!
Nasty, nasty! I'll drain that pesky magic!
I can use imp innards to create an antidote!
Stranglers' sap! That's just what I need!
Fools! Get in here and protect me!
Dwemer ruins give me the creeps. At least our constructs had a soul at some point.
Oh now that's a pretty jaw. I'll make something nice out of you.
Ghoulish mushrooms, feasting on the dead … bet you taste good.
Soon I'll shed my skin like Satak.
Going to volunteer for corpse hunting. Too cooped up down here.
Taking a life with your own two hands. That's the proper way.
Good poison in these mushrooms, ugly way to go.
Good rot on these. Give a nasty infection.
That geyser looks like it's about to blow!
The Matriarch is going in for the kill!
Oh, they hate it when you breathe.
You'll make a lovely corpse!
A new puppet for the master!
Your new life is just beginning!
Cut here, cut there, and keep the good bits!
Now I reap the harvest of the blade!
Your blood will flow black!
The master will want you in good condition.
New dangers darken our isle. You could offset this impropriety by taking on another assignment. Can I count on you?
You seem quite dedicated to your tasks. At least you're good for something, newcomer.
You have an assignment, newcomer. Attend to it at once.
Can I assume that your presence indicates a successful completion of your assignment? I eagerly await your report.
This will end your meddling, you nasty mage!
Agag gor yarg!
Who could be foolish enough to cross our master?
They've angered the master. Poor fools.
Kill them, but keep the bodies intact!
No more interruption to the master's work!
Aga yor yar!
Watch them dash like waves against me!
Pitiable souls, I'll make this quick.
These weak-willed souls are no match for me.
A little poison, some fumes. The ideal mixture for death!
Nasty, useless guards! Here, this will do you.
You returned just in time! A new spate of abyssal geysers have appeared across the island. We need to act quickly upon the information Cainar and Miriya gathered.
The abyssal geysers seem to be endless. It's best to make sure you're prepared.
You have your mission. Find and destroy as many of these abyssal geysers as you can.\n\nI have no soldiers to spare to assist you. I suggest you seek aid among the other newcomers to Summerset.
I haven't heard anything from the other groups I sent into the field. So give me your report. Have the abyssal geysers been dealt with?
Onward, sailors! What treasures await us?
No! Stay back, foul beast!
Find the Oracle!
The Oracle must be found!
Master Rolis keeps a very specific client list, you know. That may not seem fair, but I'm afraid I must hold to it.
Ah, good to see you. Care to browse the diverse wares offered for your discerning labor?
Curious that Master Rolis uses an unbacked token currency for his own store, isn't it?
Where are you going? The park is the other way.
Gah! Students!
You weaklings think you can fight me? Ha!
Z'Maja bids me to fight. And so I shall.
You were fools to battle me!
You fools dare challenge me?
No … how could I lose?
Z'Maja's power is absolute.
I'll make this quick.
I'm sorry … mistress.
I lost? How … unlikely.
You'll regret this fight!
Your death was long overdue.
You'll fall to my blade, like the rest of Cloudrest!
You challenge the power of the Sea Sload? It shall be your last mistake.
Have no worries. Your shadows shall remain.
My shadows will consume you!
At least the Welkynars … die with me.
Always an honor to serve Summerset's finest! What do you need?
Tenigwe is the kindest High Elf I've yet to meet. She always has my back. I'm sure she'd help you out too, if you need it!\n\nBut for now, what can I help you with?
Aren't all of these newcomers just grand? Never before have I had such interesting characters visit my inn. Everyday I seem to see or hear something new.
Barra! Just know, my inn accepts any and all. And if you have a problem with any of the guests? Just speak to me.
Ebon Stadmont may not exactly be bustling with business, but there's a fair amount of traffic along the outskirts of these woods.
In the market for some new armor? Look here. Every piece is brushed, oiled, and polished to a mirror-sheen.
No echateres, no mammoths …. An Orc leatherworker's got to get pretty creative here in Summerset. Lucky for you, ole Grashegg's got genius to spare!
Barra, traveler. While in Lillandril, why not make a purchase or two?
Are you going to look or are you going to buy? I have no time for de'nts in my shop.
Bah-rah, good patron. How can I help you today?
All my High Elf customers get upset over the smallest thing. I've become so stressed my spines have started to droop! Please, brighten my day with a purchase.
This beast is nothing we've seen before, I can tell you that much.
The swords these High Elves carry …. Pieces of unsteady scrap, I say.\n\nJoin the Fighter's Guild. Learn how to handle a real sword.
Keep your guard up. We may not be so lucky if more of these creatures attack.
Have you seen the type of swords these High Elves carry? Those pieces of unsteady scrap they call fencing foils?\n\nWe here at the Fighters Guild know how to handle a real sword, am I right?
I would move along quickly, if I were you. And keep your wits about you, in case there are more of these things still around.
I've never seen this creature's like, and I've been guarding Summerset for quite some time. How could something so vicious suddenly appear within our homeland?
Can those skinny arms even swing a blade? Well, I suppose I can't deny you a purchase.
So busy, so busy, and now I must entertain these guests?
Are you purposefully doing a poor job? Because I can come to no other conclusion!
This is absurd. No one can meet these standards, not even you!
The Archivist wants to see me tomorrow. I … I don't want to go.
The pack needs me. The pack needs me.
Hunters? Curses! Vykosa will not be pleased!
No! I won't be hunted again!
Got out of your cell, huh? Well, don't expect me to just put you back!
Too afraid to face my claws?
You may have won against fang and fury, but my magic is stronger than you can imagine.
Do you think you're the first to hunt Vykosa? Her whole life, she has been running.
Looks like I'll have a lovely meal tonight!
Vykosa shall be pleased.
You'll fall against my magic and might!
How unfortunate. You would have made wonderful additions to my pack.
In Hircine's name!
Praise to Hircine! Praise to the hunt!
We thought we were the hunters, but we were wrong. It was hunting us all along.
Come now, it's time to finish this little competition!
No, no! We can't give up now!
It seems the Great Hunt has come to an end.
Finally! Hircine's boon is mine!
If we were hunting wine instead of indriks, our hunt would be the stuff of legend.
You are aware that a welwa can smell us from over a league away. You, perhaps farther.
Any gryphon that could see us now would think this is a farce, not a hunting party.
Could you keep it down? At least one of us should know about giant salamanders before we face one.
Oh, put the book away, Paredan, you're sucking the fun out of this whole affair!
Go on then, you've got your pledge. Show me what you're made of.
Well, you certainly look alive. Unless a necromancer got to you? No, no, you'd smell far worse. So I can only guess you've completed your pledge!
Careful traipsing through the nearby brush. Those three might mistake you for our quarry, though odds are good they'd never hit you.
The—the funniest thing keeps happening. I keep pouring wine into my goblet—but it keeps disappearing! Paredan, look—look, I'm a magician!
Talking to Paredan, are you? Tell him he'd look more attractive if his fingers weren't always coated in ink.
Look at him over there like he wants nothing to do with me! His own brother! The nerve. Who reads on a hunt? Really?
Talking to my brother? A word of advice. Drink heavily first. It makes the boredom so much more bearable!
Ugh. Aldermil thinks herself sly, but even someone as drunk as Moladucil can see her mooning over Paredan.
Talking to Paredan is a sobering experience, is it not? I can't in good conscience recommend it.
Look, I apologized. And then I apologized again. What more do you want from me?
How dare you talk to me as equals! Anything less than groveling, on your knees, is an insult!
I really need to find my horse, so if you could just get on with an apology it would be appreciated.
I should not get upset. It is not as though you nebarra can help your poor horsemanship.
The Kinlady is about to learn that it's hard to talk down to someone with your face in the dirt.
Just when I thought things were going my way, I have a run-in with a noble. A noble, of all people.
The Elf thinks she can talk down to me as long as she's smiling. But she's just showing me which teeth to knock out first.
Whatever you wish to discuss can wait. Until this Orc addresses her slight to me, I will not yield my attention elsewhere.
Have you seen a horse? White, with tack and saddle?
If this is a solicitation for some sort of alms, take it elsewhere. I already have one fool to deal with.
I summon Ruella Many-Claws from the deep spawning pools!
Mortals make the perfect hosts for the eggs of Ruella Many-Claws.
I summon Churug of the Abyss to blind you with her light!
From the depths' darkness, Churug arises!
Sheefar, bane of sailors, K'Tora calls you forth!
Sheefar, bane of sailors, Nocturnal calls you forth!
Girawell, K'Tora orders you into the fray!
Let us see how you fare against Girawell the Erratic.
Muustikar, K'Tora has need of you, Wave-Eater!
Muustikar, Nocturnal has need of you, Wave-Eater!
Allow me to introduce Reefhammer, the bane of Ul'vor-Kus!
Reefhammer, destroy these fools!
Darkstorm the Alluring, drown these worms!
Let's see how you deal with Darkstorm's charms.
Feel the power of Eejoba the Radiant!
Eejoba take your will, mortal fools!
Tidewrack will break you in half!
I summon Tidewrack to end this.
K'Tora summons Vsskalvor to protect this geyser!
Vsskalvor, protect this geyser!
Land-crawling scum!
These mortals. They are so predictable.
What fools these mortals be!
You have meddled in our affairs for the last time!
You have meddled in my affairs for the last time!
I am the darkness lurking around you always. Beware.
<<Light coughing.>>
<<Light coughing.>>
Another visitor to Lillandril, how charming. Hopefully you're just passing through. We don't have much work for your … kind, around here.
Can you believe all these nebarra in Lillandril? Why, my ancestors are probably rolling in their graves, what with the state of Summerset right now!
With a port city like Lillandril, you can expect the occasional Maormer attack. We don't get it nearly as rough as Sunhold, though. They're usually the first to be hit.
It's time for the Welkynars to be reunited!
This hall shall run red with your blood!
So, standing around is a crime in Summerset?
Look, those birds tasted awful. I did that farmer a favor!
We both know the reason you're here. You're in love with me!
Keep it down! I'm trying to sleep here!
You know, I'm going to miss these little exchanges.
Yes, we even have a word for it: loitering. I suggest you learn it.
He's disinclined to agree.
I'm adding obscenity to the list of charges.
I know. That's the problem.
If you think I will just roll over and let this happen, you are mistaken.
The winds of death pass over you all.
Z'Maja's strength will eclipse you all.
Silaeda! Torch these whelps.
You'll find Belanaril most shocking!
Unleash your freezing winds, Falarielle!
So you're the ones causing trouble, are you? It's time to put end to your meddling!
Sunhold is already ours! Don't you see?
Do you truly think you can take Sunhold back?
I'm sorry, Orgnum. I … lost.
These foolish Sapiarchs believe only High Elves can be true mages. Perhaps I will show them the truth to such foolishness with a well placed fire spell.
The Sapiarchs only hate us because they fear the Guild's influence. Whatever would they do if their followers had access to boundless knowledge?
The House of Reveries …. Daring over there says they accept anyone, you know. Long as you got talent. Can't say that about most groups here in Summerset.
Oh, Paredan's leaving? I'll drink to that!
Do I look like I wanted company? I don't.
You can cut down our pack, but more will follow!
My ship is ready to sail. Looking to go on a voyage?
Only a great warrior could defeat Z'Maja with all three shadow warriors by her side.
You will tell me where the Kinlady is!
Resistance fighters? Attack them! Now!
Heed me, brothers and sisters! You look at one another and suspect nothing, but in any heart can lurk the taint of Daedric worship!
Especially now! See who crawls onto our shores? The bastard children of Malacath! The tainted Velothi! Even now the taint of Daedra walks across our Island uncontested!
We must beware! The gnarled root of cultists cannot gain purchase in the Island!
But know, brothers and sisters, that the warmth of the et'Ada can reach even those who wrongly turn away from their light.
Oh Auri-El, light of the soul of creation, give us the strength and purity to fight the incursions against your humble children!
Execute the nobles! Now!
Cloudrest has already fallen …. My death will not change that …!
I'll wipe your base filth from Summerset, and the world.
One day we'll stick it to that Sapiarch.
Smells worse than the Riften tavern in here.
Take that back to the ship. Quickly.
The wind blows and the sea provides.
And then I skewered him with his own sword!
It's a simple spell. Even an Altmer could cast it.
How dare you weave a plot against me?
Little friends? It's time to crawl out from the dark.
My brood hungers. Let us seek fresh blood.
Such an abundance of prey. We shall feast tonight.
Why can I never find a suitable subject for testing?
It's been too long since I dissected someone.
The Conservator will be pleased with this one.
This will do. The gryphons should deter the worst of the rabble.
We'll draw up the plans immediately.
Well? Drive it off!
Stand back, my lady!
This Elven wine is swill. You have to drink at least eight bottles before you even feel a thing!
I've seen dogs eat with more decorum than that Orc. Next he'll start gnawing the bones.
Why do these uppity Elves always put the best books on the highest shelves?
Yes! Come in, come in. You'll forgive me for drinking without you — needed to calm the nerves. First time doing this, you see ….?\n\nYou are the one Urawe told me about, yes? The, eh … dancer?
Going inside? Try not to soil the carpet. They get-they get so upset about little things like that.
Feeling lost, newcomer? You can find merchants in the center of town. Artisans and crafters are on the other side of the river.
I sold Queen Ayrenn her first pony. Frightfully energetic little scamp, he was. Got along just fine with our feisty princess.
You might think nobles have everything they could ever want. They don't. That place in between their reach and their grasp? That's where I come in.
Do not let Anirlo bother you. He merely makes certain no one causes me any trouble.\n\nHowever, I would recommend you not cause me any trouble.
Do you see the filth that Orc tracked into this carpet? It's like he danced in a sty before stumbling in here.

As if the Queen's decree wasn't bad enough, it brought with it dozens of new edicts. Now I have laborers stuck in Shimmerene undergoing cultural acclimation. I need to get my next shipment to Lillandril and I only have two workers!
Need a place to lie low? Just head into the door behind me.

I'm supposed to be guiding some dignitaries to Welenkin Cove, but the fools are late.\n\nThe last time this happened, they were all hungover. Do you know how hard it is to stalk springbok when everyone's vomiting?
These High Elves have no sense. They adore their greenery at the expense of their masonry. If I wasn't out here every day to pry away the roots and vines, the whole place would collapse!
I don't care what anyone else says. Anginil makes the best roasted haunch in Summerset!
These weapons are the best in Summerset. I assure you, no finer blade is made by man or mer.

Let's see …. She stared into the … bright? Shining? Oh! Star-filled! She stared into her lover's star-filled eyes, as she felt his … hmm. No, no, I must consider the rating. \n\nHis breath? Yes, that will do. As she felt his breath upon her neck.
It feels like the border just opened up yesterday. Yet we have so many new merchants in town!
I heard the High Elves here had amazing hair remedies. Nothing worked quite yet, but I'm still looking!
Need to see the wares? Go ahead.
I have no common curiosities here, I assure you.
I don't haggle. The price you see is the price you pay.
Well! Certainly warmer here than Wrothgar. How do the High Elves stand it?
Alinor is simply buzzin' for Huzzin's quality wares!
The ancestors shape all. Our livelihoods, our relationships, our very soul. Tell me, newcomer. Are you making your ancestors proud?
So much of the city's funding is now used to support the influx of newcomers. And so the monastery must suffer. We'll never get that new marble crowning at this rate!
"Faith is like a broom, sweeping the filth of sin and doubt from the soul."
This is the oldest tree in Alinor. It was planted when my grandmother was just a girl.
My family has actually owned this shop for generations. Before the borders were open, most thought me a curiosity. Now I'm just another newcomer.
Spare me your pitying gaze!
Fivefold venerations, Emperor. The winds of Cyrodiil speak of your deeds, but those winds do not blow in the Battlegrounds. I shall look forward to facing you.
Greetings. You look like the type of warrior who can hold your own. Perhaps you will do well in the Battlegrounds.
By the shining trees of Aldmeris, are you so eager to meet your doom that you cannot even wait to enter the Battlegrounds? May the light guide you. You shall need all the help you can get.
The entertainment provided by outsiders must be placed under strict scrutiny, lest we allow corrupting influence to take hold in the isles.
I just came from Shimmerene. Some rather nasty rumors going on about there. Apparently a giant rodent has taken over the sewers! They call it the Mother of Rats.
If you're trying to impress the High Elves here, you need to look your best.
The Mages Guild has had a somewhat shaky start in Alinor. But the Proxy Queen will make the Sapiarchs come to heel.
Have you heard a generational song? A High Elf tradition where the bards of a generation expand upon the works of the last. Beautiful, yes?
The young mistress tracked mud into the kitchen today. When I made note of it, she said the outside was too filthy. Now I must clean it. All of it.\n\nPlease, watch your step.
Watch your head. A lot of masonry here is in need of repair.
After nearly a year on the front lines of the Three Banners War, the Captain and I finally made it home. The air is almost as sweet as the wine.
This bridge is very useful for my experiments. Did you know a hundred oranges fall faster than a hundred feathers? The guards weren't nearly as intrigued.
This one applauds the Proxy Queen. Putting her palace high above her city, where no idle petitioners can bother her.
Please remember to conduct yourself appropriately within the grounds of the palace. Any sign of disrespect will not be taken lightly.
(Goblin GIbberish 01)
Make sure you conduct yourself in a way worthy of the Mages Guild. After all, our organization already seems to be on thin ice with the mages of Summerset.
So much knowledge that never crosses the shores of Summerset! How can the Elves justify keeping it all to themselves?
Gore and glory, eh? How may my shop be of service, Emperor? Are you seeking to display your war trophies?
Why not show off your greatest deeds with some fine pieces of furniture?
A warrior must prove themselves constantly. I have the best furniture around to show you did just that.
An honor to see you, Emperor. How can my humble shop be of service to one as great as yourself?
Tales of your deeds travel far and wide. Is there anything you need for your homestead?
Even a grizzled warrior such as yourself deserves a nice home to return to.
Heading to the Battlegrounds? I have just the thing for you.
Something catch your eye? Something hard to find? Something exotic, perhaps?
The High Elves jealously guard the secrets of their isles. It took many overtures from the Archmage for us to be allowed here.
As disappointing as it is to my parents, I have to say that joining the Mages Guild has made me happier than the College of Sapiarchs ever could.
For all their poise, you'd think the High Elves would have their house in order. But between strange geysers and sea-monsters, this island is as bad as the continent.
I'd never sell sub par wares to Fighters Guild members. By my ancestors, I swear it.
These Elves are too proud. They won't admit they can't fight, so we can't lend them a hand.
I am told even the pigs do not wallow here. Am I to have no reprieve from my scales crisping in the noonday sun?
What do you need? Quickly now, I haven't got all day.
Blasted High Elves! Why do they make their jewelry so frail!? I've snapped three rings just this week.
Plenty of money to be made, if you know where to look. And not be seen.
Tooth and Claw! How may this one be of service, Emperor? Are you seeking to display your vast collection of war trophies?
You wish to show off your greatest deeds, no? Why not do so with some fine pieces of furniture?
A warrior must constantly prove themselves in the Battlegrounds. This one has the best furniture around to prove you did just that.
An honor to see you, Emperor. How can my humble shop be of service to one as great as yourself?
It's not often a warrior of your esteem visits our camp. How can my humble shop be of service to your home?
Even a grizzled warrior such as yourself deserves a nice home to return to.
