Going on a job? Won't do to get caught unprepared. Better make sure you're supplied.
My rates are reasonable. Honest.
The Queen's decree is the best thing that ever happened to Summerset. With all the newcomers, no one's looking at High Elves when crimes are committed.
Imbeciles. Despite explicit wording in the ordinance, I've still uncovered seven different crates of netch eggs. Do people not even read the statutes?
Purani is but a simple dock hand, that is all. She never gets caught up in anything shady.
By the Hist, how long are they going to keep us waiting? Time is trade!
That Argonian better keep her tongue in check. I can keep her boat here indefinitely if I choose to.
I could be unloading the boat, I suppose, in the hopes that the customs inspection is finished soon. Or I could spend my time not being a fool.

The Divine Prosecution has been personally inspecting every ship that goes in and out of this port. Every day. Every ship.\n\nDo they know nothing about time tables? Or the demands of the citizens? The entire city may be ground to a halt!
Zandal hoped to find work on a ship. No one told him that the Divine Prosecution would be holding each ship in quarantine for several days.\n\nNo work for this one, then.
So if the books for the Sapiarchs came here by mistake, then … where did the Monastery's candle shipment go?
If you're here to pick up a shipment, don't bother. The Divine Prosecution isn't letting anything through.
Am I ever happy to see you! I don't get a lot of customers out here.
Excursions in this area are ill-advisable. Unless, that is, you are adequately prepared.
I was lucky to escape Sunhold with what I did. Please, any purchase you make will help me build a new life.
This may seem like an odd location for a shop, but I actually get quite a bit of business here. Not entirely sure why.
The Coral Forest may be beautiful, but don't let it catch you off-guard! My wares can make sure you're prepared for anything.
Fancy a trade?\n\nDon't give Duchess Fluffyface any mind, she won't bite you. Long as you keep your hands to yourself.
I would advise caution if you're passing Sil-Var-Woad. Creatures have escaped the menagerie, and most aren't exactly tame.
Watch yourself around those House of Reveries wastrels. One wrong word and you might find yourself in caught up in some ludicrous performance.\n\nWould you care to see my wares?
Some good carcasses came in today. Ever tried gryphon meat? Tastes like a cross between a goose and a cat.\n\nAnd no need to ask me how I know what a cat tastes like.
Before you ask, yes I've been cleared by the Sapiarch of Oceanic Occurrences to fish. All my casts are perfectly legal. \n\nIf you're looking to fish, take it up with the College.
Life in Lillandril has always revolved around the Sapiarchs. Or it did, until the Mages Guild came to town.

If I've told the Aldarch once, I've told him a thousand times. Allowing Wood Elves to tend to the city's flora is a mistake. They only care for nature in its wild state. Such untamed vegetation is an eyesore!
I wouldn't share any strong opinions about the Queen's decree if I were you. Tenigwe's already thrown two drunks out for nearly coming to blows over the topic.

So many of us are caught up in the doings of the Sapiarchs on their miserable rock, we forget the Mages Guild's true purpose. This one knows there is too much work to be done to debate local politics.
There's many volumes in this library, and yet it's just a fraction of what the College of Sapiarchs must contain. How can they justify hoarding that knowledge?
Ancestors take me, but the Hall Steward keeps it hot in here! I don't know how anyone else stands it!

Every tradesman from here to Alinor looks at the decree and thinks they'll suddenly have an army of cheap labor. But everyone knows the quality of High Elf work! If our crafts are left to the work of ephems, our reputation will grow tarnished.
Do yourself a favor. If someone gives you a mug of Shimmerene surprise? Drink it!
Everything in this city is so … fancy. It makes me kind of uncomfortable. Do you think this inn has a shabbier room?
While, there was some smoothing over to do with local bureaucrats, we've managed to establish several footholds for the guild in Summerset. I hope the effort proves worthwhile.

All these High Elves up in arms about visitors to the Isles, but none give me a second look. \n\nThing is, I wasn't born here. Grew up in Valenwood, of all places. I'm as much a newcomer as anyone else.
I've tried several times to obtain an audience with the Kinlady, but she's declared to be endlessly indisposed. Either she has a weak constitution, or I am undesirable company.
I've found a few references about the ruins near King's Haven Pass. Here's to hoping I can get an expedition together to visit them.

There's much to study if we want to even begin discussing research ventures with the High Elves. There are centuries of treatises in Summerset, and yet most officials know them like the back of their hands.
There's only one way to begin a journey though Summerset, and that's making sure you're adequately supplied.
That I choose to offer these goods for sale should vouchsafe their quality.
I only make fair deals. You get your items, I get the coin that's owed. Some merchants will gouge new arrivals, but not me.
My brother and I were separated at the docks. They took him to the Monastery for further inquiries, whatever that means.\n\nBut that was a while ago. I'm getting worried.
This city's a maze. Every time I try to visit the tavern, I end up at the dock.
With so many newcomers in Shimmerene, it's hard for all of us to find a place to stay. Luckily, the Fighters Guild will take anybody willing to get in a scrap.
It seems several of the dockworkers prefer to work without shirts on. I believe I'll be spending more of my days down here.
I tire of the constant complaints. If the ephems didn't want entrance processing to take so long, they could fill out the forms in advance.
Word is, there's a group of High Elves in the city's underground led by someone called the Mother of Rats. Doesn't sound like a lady you'd want to be messing with.
Though I'm pleased with Queen Ayrenn's decree, it has rather dominated the conversation within the city. Even my regular salons can't escape the topic.
Shimmerene is running out of quiet places to read at an alarming rate.
The only fish I've caught were sad things. I don't understand it. I've tried every cast, every kind of bait I know. I never had this much trouble in Abah's Landing!
Sometimes a scribble on a wall doesn't mean a thing, but sometimes it means everything.
Kinlady Avinisse has requested the assistance of the Divine Prosecution during this time of … newcomer infestation.
My husband was taken into the Monastery with several other new arrivals. But I'm sure he'll come out at some point!
Our ancestors can always be turned to in times of tribulation. Even if we do not fully understand their guidance, they always watch over us.
Enamored of my specimens? You and everyone else in Shimmerene. I should be charging admission!
With every crate moved, this one's bones ache more and more. Perhaps she grows too old for such work.

While, there was some smoothing over to do with local bureaucrats, we've managed to establish several footholds for the guild in Summerset. I hope the effort proves worthwhile.\n\nYou look promising. Ever considered joining the Fighters Guild?

For all their poise, you'd think the High Elves would have their house in order. But between strange geysers and sea-monsters, this island is as bad as the continent.\n\nSo I'm looking for new members. Interested in joining the Fighters Guild?
Here! This light will carve a path through the darkness!
We can't allow Z'Maja's gateway to remain open! It must be collapsed from within.
Hurry! Locate the power source of Z'Maja's gateway and destroy it.
Z'Maja's shade will soon be upon us. The gateway must be abolished!
My light will tear through the darkness!
Well done, my friends!
On your guard. Those tendrils look perilous.
Z'Maja's creatures flow through the gateway. Push them back!
Oghbro, veno agh mi!
Give in to darkness. There's no escape.
Disbagh tanta mallumon!
Your life force shall empower me!
Noghto favoran mig!
A wonderful addition to my army.
Inkaj bid ogh!
Ligh nah vogh on!
Teh naghto ell ragh!
All that struggle only fueled my power.
I won't be beaten! I'll smash this amulet if that's what it takes.
My gryphon will shred you to bits!
My gryphon shall bleed you dry!
Rip them apart, Falarielle!
You dare disrupt Z'Maja's magic?
How dare you close Z'Maja's gate?
Destroying that gate means nothing.
Our battle isn't done, Silaeda!
Return to me, Belanaril!
Now isn't the time for death, Falarielle!
Remember, you'll need to enter the gateway in order to destroy it.
My shadows are endless!
Feel the embrace of my tendrils of darkness!
You'll pay for harming my gryphon!
How dare you strike my gryphon?
You'll pay for harming Falarielle!
Tremble before my gryphon's wrath!
You shall feel my gryphon's might!
Allow me to show you a gryphon's strength.
You would think, with all these wealthy art patrons, I would have more customers. Hmm. Perhaps if I fancied my cart up a bit?
Rellenthil has performances, plays, even a bathhouse! The House of Reveries certainly has provided every comfort for their patrons.
You won't find prettier mer than those within the House of Reveries! Even with the masks. Or maybe it's because of the masks? Hey, imagination is always mightier than the truth!
Not every performer in the House of Reveries is an actor, you know. Several of us specialize in backstage production.
Adagio and I tend to partner up for performances. Our duets often leave the audience in tears. Or so I've been told.
This bathhouse is always so divine. I simply must come here every time I visit Rellenthil. It's become somewhat of a tradition.

The House of Reveries has long been honored as the greatest acting troupe within Summerset. \n\nThat's no coincidence, of course. The performers here have given up every aspect of their past in order to pursue the art of performance.
The House of Reveries is a lot more open to newcomers than the rest of Summerset, I'll tell you that. Even so, I was their first Nord. Maybe even their only Nord, truth be told!
Making a purchase would be a prudent choice, newcomer. You should prepare yourself before entering the acropolis.
This place is so … I don't know. Domestic? Where do you keep your trolls? You do have some trolls here, right? I was specifically told there would be trolls.
I have no armament for strangers. You may purchase rations and sundries, however.
Before I was a member of the Psijic Order, I was a simple shopkeeper's daughter. Even now, I find such work soothes me.
It's a relief to know the killer has been dealt with, but learning we had a Daedra in our midst is no comfort.
I have not seen you before. I cannot guarantee your safety in Cey-Tarn Keep at this time. Do not linger here.
Daedric incursion is a serious black mark on my record. I will take every measure to ensure it never happens again.
Psijic Domino Pigs are quite intelligent. I've known some who could even count to ten! And they all recognize their name, given enough time.
Relicmaster Glenadir may be a bit absent minded, but that's all right. After all, I'm here to make sure he doesn't get horribly cursed or some such.
Glad that's over with. If one more of these tuskless sots looked at me sideways, I really would have been guilty of murder.
For the last time, we don't eat people!\n\nSorry, thought you were another flat-tooth here to give me guff about these killings.
Ah! You're lucky I didn't take a swing at you! Don't you know there's something abducting people around here?\n\nMove on. And don't do that again!
I can finally make my rounds without constantly looking over my shoulder.
Is it strange that this one finds it much less like he's being watched while there is a killer about?\n\nWadaril has not been bothered about missing silverware for many moons.
This one had enjoyed being viewed without suspicion, even for so brief a time.
I'm afraid the Captain is unavailable. She has been tasked with composing a formal request to the Proxy Queen on behalf of Battlereeve Erriisse.\n\nShe's a bit more … tactful.
Please don't bother the Captain. Battlereeve Erriisse has been very demanding of her since all the trouble started.
Tranquil greetings. Please refrain from drinking the lights. It would make reading in here much more difficult. You would also become violently ill.
The hallmarks of a true Psijic monk are precision and artistry.  It is not enough to know a spell—you must learn to improve it.
You come to haggle over my goods? Well don't be shy, runt! Take a look!
We were fools to try to hunt it. And so are you!
You didn't speak to me during the recent unpleasantness, did you? I'm sorry if was uncouth. Can I help you find anything?
Every home needs a bit of sprucing up now and then. Perhaps my wares can help.
Browsing? Well, I suppose it never hurts to look. Though most of my customers actually own a home.
My furnishings are an excellent way to show off how your reputation has grown.
Great deeds surround your name. Allow me to provide you with something to commemorate your accomplishments.
Your great deeds are spoken throughout all of Summerset. But does your home say as much? My wares can help with that.
Not yet a homeowner? Too bad. Still, I won't stop you from looking around.
Hmm. Yes, I suppose I may have a few items available to one of your reputation. Come have a look.
Your achievements are certainly worthy of some of my furnishings. Not all, of course. Not yet.
I believe you'll find my selection far from lacking, given your current reputation.
Do you aspire to own a home? Feast your eyes on my wares and see what your future could hold.
My wares can help you display your modest accomplishments proudly.
Your deeds have grown, and so has my selection of wares. Please, have a look.
When you reach the pinnacle of fame and fortune, commonplace items just won't do. Of course, my furnishings are far from commonplace.
If anything can inspire you to purchase a home, it will be my wares.
Mind your step down here, mate. If you step on one of Mother's rats, I don't know what she'll do!
Stay as long as you like, outsider. You'll talk to an aprax Elf. That tells me all I need to know.
You are welcome to join us here if you wish. It may not look like much, but what it lacks in style it makes up for in kindness and freedom.
I was a Hlaalu coin-baron in Vvardenfell, did you know that? Now? Just look at this place! Look what I've fallen to!
You want a place here, you've got to earn it. Pitch in, keep your nose clean, and you'll do just fine.
Forgive me, friend of Valsirenn. These tomes require my strict attention. Some of them have a tendency to … misbehave.

Another visitor? Excellent!\n\nI can't tell you how desperate we are for fresh faces. When you see the same people every day, conversations can grow dull and uninteresting. But now, between you and Sotha Sil, we have an embarrassment of riches!
Terrible what happened to Halimorion. Yes, he was an insufferable arse. But he was our insufferable arse, you know?
You'll need to heal yourselves to overcome those shadows!
So you're the new ship captain, eh? Lucky you. What I wouldn't give to have my own vessel.
You own a ship, right? I wouldn't let the Divine Prosecution know about it, if I were you. Elsewise you'll be swimming in regulatory inspections and docking fees.
If you're ever looking to hire for your ship, consider Zandal. He is a most hardworking Khajiit, and the perfect addition to any crew.
There's plenty of rumors floating around about your vessel. The way I hear it, that ship's a thing of beauty.
Aren't you Alinor's newest captain? Impressive. Not just anyone can claim such a title.
I came to Summerset with many hopes. None which involved selling goods with an Outlaws Refuge, mind you.
I'll show you why I'm the one who runs this prison!
Vykosa calls for your death! And I obey.
Your corpses shall be useful for my next set of experiments.
You'll threaten Vykosa's pack no longer!
Don't you see? You're the Hare now, hunter!
I'll strike you down!
Freeze and perish!
Fire and ash! I'll burn you all!
Face my storm's wrath!
The feeling of death. I remember it well.
You think this one needs her pets to attack?
Come, my packmates! Feast upon these intruders!
That one shall start our feast!
My claws will tear you to shreds!
Ary! Zel! To me!
Your heads shall make fine trophies!
Guards! Empty the cells!
I'll show you my pack's more bestial nature!
Feel lightning's wrath!
Still you have not fallen? How surprising.
I'll crush you in my trap!
You shall fear Vykosa's might!
It seems a more advanced spell is needed!
Which one shall I choose?
Now you shall face my true power!
Those roots will crush you! Try to slip free!
Watch out for those thorns!
The Guardian is calling spriggans to aid it. You must stop them!
The spriggans are still out there! You must stop them!
Let the hunters come! I'll claw them to pieces!
<Low, quiet snarling.>
Oh, I can't wait for the next hunt.
<Aggressive barking.>
Looks like dinner's arrived early!
<Low, quiet snarling.>
You made a mistake coming here!
<Aggresive barking.>
I'm taking aim!
Stay hidden until our wisp can pull the indrik out of hiding!
Our wisp needs a nudge to keep searching.
Well done! We've found the indrik!
So many lovely dryskins coming into Lilmoth lately. It's unfortunate so many scorn a scaly touch. Ah, well.
The frogs croak, the birds sing, and I sell the wares of my guild. These truths are absolute.
I'm trying to convince the guild I work for to liven up the shop's name. Something like … Wading in Wares. Oh, oh! Muck and Merchandise! That's a good one.
Let's get down to business. And don't try to cheat me, you hear?
Now, I dare say, don't track mud into my stall! Wait, what am I saying. Everything's already covered in mud.
My guild has sent me to many places, but Murkmire has been my favorite by far. There is a romance in its mysteries, an allure that draws many.
Does your purse grow heavy, beeko? Why not leave your treasures with us?
Take my advice—in the swamp you should travel light. Offload your goods here and I assure you, we will take good care of them.
No weapons I can sell you will help against the dangers of quicksand. Careful where you step, traveler, else the ground may swallow you whole.
Ever tried asking an Argonian mage about their magical practices? Don't. My three year old gives more logical responses than those swamp lizards.
If you're planning to head out into the swamps, you might want to consider picking up a new pack. Your supplies are only as good as what you carry them in, after all.
Sun's greetings, beeko. If you mean to brew tinctures and toxins, you have come to the right place.
Always hated winters in Eastmarch. I'd huddle in front of my mother's forge, desperately seeking warmth. Here, I never have to worry about feeling a chill.
Lost my last shipment two weeks back. Caravan got stuck in the mud. You see some crates of swords in the swamp? Let me know.
You come for theilul and frog-songs, yes? Well, rest your heels and wallow, new-friend.
Have a care felling trees around here, friend. The locals don't like it when we cut down the ones with names.
Never thought I'd eat anything with more than four legs, but I got to tell ya—these lizards know how to cook a caterpillar!
What can I do for you?
You've come to do some enchanting, eh? I just might be able to help with that.
The Hist guides, but it does not protect. You will need my goods to survive the marsh.
Do not hesitate to make a purchase. My provender will suit even the most mundane palette.
You hero types always seem busy, rushing off to the next great adventure. Take time to celebrate your victories! Perhaps with some new furniture, ja?
At my inn, you shall always be known as beeko—a friend! Some outsiders, they think the word is an insult.\n\nI tell them, if we Saxhleel wish to insult you, we would be much more subtle than that.
None know leathers like we Argonians of Murkmire. Many dryskins wish to know the secret of our craft, but few have the patience needed to learn.
My tribe always believed I would become a tree-minder, but I wanted to explore, to leave the swamp behind. Yet here I am, back in the very home I once left.
Cloth rustles, threads intertwine. Laid before you is something new, something changed.
You come to make metal sing the fire song? You will need what I carry.
It seems every day I'm plagued by some new form of insect. Just yesterday I found spiny maggots eating away at my planks, each longer than the palm of my hand!
What's happening?
Don't give away your location. Remain hidden!
I'll trample you flat!
Feel my flames!
I'll shred you to pieces!
I'll crush you all!
Feel venom's sting!
I'll crush you underfoot!
A storm's fury is mine to wield!
I always hunt better in the dark!
I'm setting a trap for your enemy!
Quickly! Drive your enemy to my trap!
Hircine's boon shall be mine!
My spirit remains with you, sisters.
No worries, sisters. My spirit remains.
Stay strong, sisters! My spirit is with you.
So we have become the prey … how pathetic.
We will return, hunter …. Our spirits live on.
We failed, sisters …. But we shall hunt again.
Those spriggan saplings seem to … represent seasons?
The spriggan is gathering elemental energy! Quick, protect yourself!
Lord Hircine shall be pleased by our victory.
My, my. You all fell so easily.
Perhaps next time Lord Hircine will give us foes worth bragging about.
It appears Lord Hircine has gifted us with fresh prey.
Frozen in awe before our might? I can hardly blame you.
Hopefully you put up more of a fight than those Wood Elves.
It's time to take aim, hunters!
Get in position, hunters! The prey is upon us!
A blessing from Lord Hircine! Fresh blood to hunt!
Join us in the Hunting Grounds! In the eternal hunt!
The Hungry Cat demands blood!
The Hungry Cat has provided such lovely prey today!
Taking aim! Ready to fire!
Stay still, won't you?
They're here, you idiots! Get in formation!
I'll freeze you where you stand!
For the Moon Hunter Pack!
Well, don't you all look delicious!
I want to leave! Please, let me leave!
Here! This light will carve a path through the darkness!
We can't allow Z'Maja's gateway to remain open! It must be collapsed from within.
Hurry! Locate the power source of Z'Maja's gateway and destroy it.
Z'Maja's shade will soon be upon us. The gateway must be abolished!
These dungheaps took down the indrik? Ha!
Tusk it all, the hunters are here!
Your feeble tricks won't stop me!
Come forth, my servants! Show them the power I have bestowed upon you!
<prophetic Goblin gibberish.>
<condescending Goblin gibberish.>
<Triumphant Goblin gibberish.>
<Triumphant Goblin gibberish.>
Meridia's perfection is our own.
We are grateful for our lives.
Be cleansed!
Kneel and obey!
All their pleas fell on deaf ears. I can still hear their desperation.
There is no escape now. This will be your home or your grave.
You will be purified and you will serve.
Kneel before me, I will make you pure.
Their sacrifice was not in vain.
Meridia's light never fades.
Her order is restored.
Her will, is now your will. Rejoice.
<Taunting Goblin gibberish.>
A trip to Murkmire? Well, mother keeps saying I need to get out more ….
I see Kyne's wisdom! Your expedition will meet with clear skies.
<Bellowed Goblin warcry.>
<Mad cackling.>
Cyrodilic Collections could use your help again, my friend!
<Commanding Goblin gibberish.>
Cyrodilic Collections is most grateful for your help with our expedition. Most grateful!
Please be swift-swift, my friend. Our expedition depends on your help!
You return! Was your task a success?
Stay back!
<Annoyed Goblin gibberish.>

Cyrodilic Collections thanks you for your efforts on our behalf. I hope we can count on your continued assistance as we prepare for our expeditions to Murkmire.\n\nTalk to Jee-Lar and I'm sure he can find something for you to help with.
I think it's fully powered! Look out!
My wares are for only those of well renown. Glad to see you qualify!
Seems like every lizard in this swamp is whispering your name! And as such, I have quite the collection for you to peruse.
No home? No problem! Long as your gold is good, feel free to have a look.
Though the Argonians may be obsessed with impermanence, I assure you my furniture is built to last.
Though I have no idea why someone without a home would wish to purchase furniture, I suppose I cannot deny a sale. Come on then, have a look.
I've trained all my steeds to glide over mud like water over stone.
I am curious … do the Daedric Anchors not come to Murkmire? Or do they simply sink into the swamp?
Perhaps between bouts of hunting relics and traversing the swamps, you will find time to join the Fighters Guild, yes?
<Enraged Goblin gibberish>
While I wouldn't call the Argonians of Murkmire verbose, they've certainly been forthcoming about their practices. Now if I only understood half of what they say ….
Welcome to Lilmoth, meat. There's not much to see in this dump, but if you don't mind getting soggy, I might have work for you.
Ha! Famia hasn't gotten you killed yet? Well, in that case, let me have a go at it. Got a lead on a job that's right up your alley.
Sithis has not locked its eyes upon you, yet. If you kept your belly to the mud you would remain unnoticed, but you aren't here because you crawl through life like a worm.
Sithis cares nothing for your efforts, but they are appreciated by the devoted.
That's all I've got for you right now, but come around tomorrow and I'm sure there'll be something that needs doing.
Let us show them what the Blackguards are made of!
Finally, it is time for the real fight to begin!
Against all hope, the challengers succeed!
You're supposed to dodge, challenger!
Oh! Looks like our challengers haven't gotten enough!
So the challengers have some bite after all!
Finally, new challengers for our gauntlet!
Let's see if the challengers can outlast our first arena!
It's time for Tames-the-Beast to show off his collection!
How will challengers fair against our lovely Lady Minara?
Burning flames! Raging beasts! Malicious undead! Can our challengers handle them all?
At last, our challengers face the final arena! But will they stand against my might?
I state the following fact. Your assistance is not required. Return later.
You appear confused. Must I explain the task again?
I want to see a fight! Come on!
That's how the Blackguards do it!
Watch your backs, Blackguards!
My netches move faster than these so called challengers.
Finally, some action.
Finally, the challengers fight back.
The challengers today look absolutely delicious.
Why, our challengers are putting up quite the fight, aren't they?
Look how the challengers bleed. Such a lovely sight.
I say true, you have returned. Now you say true. Did you succeed?
Fancy a life of treasure hunting? Cyrodilic Collections needs you!
I present a task, kuuda. Though help is the last thing the Naga-Kur requires, I offer you the honor of assisting my tribe.
Your blood gives me strength!
This keeps getting worse and worse! If anyone were to discover that we lost eggs to the Veeskhleel … we'd never be trusted again.
Was your task successful, Rootmender?
May the Hist watch over your journey.
The Hist has awakened, the village lives. But still we are in need of aid. Will you help us once more, Rootmender?
Khajiit have laughter in their bellies. The Nords have mead in their blood. And the Wood Elves, well, they have plants for brains.\n\nBut the Argonians … they have an alluring air of mystery, no?
I came to Lilmoth on urgent business. Well, I thought it was urgent. My associate has yet to arrive. It's actually quite … worrisome.
Want to have a good time? Head over to Bright-Throat Village. Want a quick death? The Dead-Water tribe would be more than happy to accommodate you.
So long as the Hist remains, so too shall the Root-Whisper tribe.
After whittling the wood, I use slug mucus to paint the designs. It may be acidic, but the color always comes out just beautiful. Well worth the occasional burn.
Most visitors never leave Lilmoth, due to the dangers of the swamps. You want to truly visit Murkmire? Get your claws muddy!
Like my house? Genuine Imperial architecture! Far better than those mud huts the lizards sleep in.
Honei! Honei, where are you?
There's not exactly a legal system in Lilmoth. I've heard about a local judge, but no one really seems to want to talk about her. I believe her name is Sulahkeesh?

Look at this lot! Mewah-Jez tries, but how do you turn slugs into wamasu? Poor stances. Barely any coordination. No upper body strength. The swamp will eat them alive.\n\nIt must be the eggs. Our hatchlings just aren't as strong as they once were.
I state truth. I am the best hunter the Naga-Kur has. For what that is worth. As our tribe's novices die off, there is not as much need for the spoils of the hunt.
I shake my head and deliver sad news. This shop is closed. The owner has gone hunting. I am just keeping an eye on her stock.
If you seek to test yourself against the powerful Naga-Kur, speak to Mewah-Jez. She's always looking for nimble spear targets.
The Xinchei-Konu was created during our Days of Stone-Nests. Many tribes question why we work so hard to maintain it. \n\nBut I believe the wisdom of the calendar transcends our past follies.
Some of my egg-siblings love to hunt. I prefer the peace of fishing, for it gives me time to contemplate the mysteries of the Hist.
Ah! Nice to see a familiar face. I heard that a Hist had awakened in the deep swamp, so of course I had to see for myself.\n\nI just wish Stibbons would stop loafing around and hatch already.
If you get very close, you can hear poor Stibbons wimpering softly.
I've lived in Murkmire my entire life, and never even knew that this village existed. So strange. What other secrets might my homeland hold?
Xukas will lead our tribe with wit and words. Still, I worry that he may be lost if our tribe must enter into battle.
There is not much farmland to be cultivated in Root-Whisper Village. Still, we try to grow as much as we can.
We've got you now!
When I hatched, I licked the sap of my tribe's Hist, and so was given life. Now I have been tasked to die beneath the branches of Root-Whisper Village.
My nostrils flare! It's an attack!
Weapons out, traveler! They lie nearby.
Please, save me!
Quickly, before they return!
My apologies, traveler.
Now it is too late. What a shame.
Thank the Hist you've arrived! Come, untie me.
Run, you kuuda! They're going to attack!
They lay nearby! Quickly, run!
Wait, I think they're still nearby!
Quickly! Untie me, please!
Untie me! Quickly, before they return!
Be lost in the void of death!
Sithis, give me power!
In the beginning, there was void. That was Sithis. One day, all shall become void again.
Now you're done for!
Is this … is this supposed to be some kind of music?
You sniveling snake. That's my coin purse and you know it!
Your coin purse? It is I who found it. And so, it is now my coin purse.
Words have always been, "Blood sprayed across their snout, and their nostrils filled with the scent of despair!" Yet you speak of rubies and courage?
You have to understand. Some of the imagery you've presented ….
Fine. You may have won this round, you thieving snake, but you'll get what's coming to you!
Hmm?
Here is your coin purse. Lucky for you that someone would take pity on your spineless self.
I can't believe anyone would fall for that old trick!
Quickly, attack!
This is not what I paid for. There were bugs in my linens this morning. Bugs!
We are touring Black Marsh, my lady. Black. Marsh! How could you not expect such things?
Get me back to Lilmoth before something devours me and the gold is yours.
Oh no ….
Hurry it along. We can't afford to linger.
I don't care how difficult it is, you need to hurry!
Very well. I will take you back to Lilmoth … without any payment.
Watch your step. You never know what might jump out of the murk to kill you.
Strike the wall, and you gain one point. Unless it's raining, of course, and then you are awarded two.
I once ran with the Blackguards, back when I was a young kuuda. May you never make the same mistake.
Working for a guild is just the first step. Soon, I'll become the greatest thief Murkmire has ever known.
Suzali used to have this stall, but she kept complaining about her paws being wet. And me? I don't mind feeling the mud between my toes.
Kud-Mere tells me I am bossy, but this is not true. I simply know what I want, and I grasp it. Much like I wish to grasp your disreputable goods, walker.
I once had someone ask me to store their grave-stake. Quite the morbid tradition, if you ask me. They never did come back for it ….

Soon, my apprentice shall be overwhelmed by his fear, and see the truth that lies within it. And by doing so, he will learn but one aspect of Sithis.\n\nYou may want to leave before the crying starts.
And so my apprentice learns nothing. He will never become nisswo if we keep meeting such softhearted strangers.

When Nisswo Kahei first arrived in my village, I wanted nothing more than to learn by her side. She spoke of a change that I desperately needed, and so I begged to become her apprentice.\n\nA decision I'm seriously questioning now, of course.
You wish to talk? Oh, my apologies, but I'm far too busy contemplating my own death.
Have you seen my new Nord friend? She is pale and smooth as fired bone-clay. I went to bring her a drink and she was gone.\n\nI hope she did not think I abandoned her.
Tseedasi always brings so much back from her trips to Shadowfen. I only wish she kept it better organized.
Protect my root-kin!
Know anyone looking for a guide? I'm really good at it! I know all the best spots around the village, and um … some of the places around it too. \n\nI won't charge a thing. I like doing it!
I will hold my ground!
I need help over here!
I'm in trouble!
He burns through my shield!
Watch your step, ojel. I have not yet replaced all the planks that Sithis has its eye on. Care it does not take you when it comes to claim them.
Keep up the assault!
Behold the sun, focused on your demise!
We can do this! Keep up the defense!
If you are an angler, you have come to the right place. Our fish are very well-mannered. They will practically eat out of your hand!\n\nI would still recommend a hook though.

Have you seen bottles of Nord beer sitting around anywhere? I was going to offer them to my host for her kindness, but I think they walked off with the rest of my party.\n\nOrkey's knotty nose, they take the beer and forget me!
Looking for some treasure?
Strike quick and true!
Attend! Show me your proclivity for festivity.
Met the Witchmother? Wonderful person. Very… giving.
This season: The calendar turns! Everywhere has their own local custom, of course.
Perfect time to rally with some companions and conquer some… random foe.
I flick my tail in admiration, traveler.
I bare my fangs at you!
Why won't you just go away!
You have my gratitude, traveler.
Thank … thank you. That was a close one.
Get back you horrid beast!
Get back, foul creatures!
I owe you a great debt, traveler.
And so I live to see another day. My thanks, traveler.
Get away from her!
Someone! Please, someone help us!
Thank you for the rescue, traveler.
Hark! A curious, distant mechanical tone. What could that be?
I've been having dreams lately, of a tower exploded and a city in ruins. Fine time.
I've just come from the Morkul clanhold. Smells the same as it ever did.
Arena season! Nothing quite like being decorated in the front row.
Shall we go prank someone? … Oh, I shouldn't leave my wares. You do it.
This season: Theft and murder. Odd? Yes. Fashionable? Beyond so.
Given my particular diet, I've a mind to savor this cake all year.
You, there. Yes, you!
Those Cyrodilic do-gooders got to the relics before us.
A new shipment, you say? Just tell me where and when!
Cyrodilic Collections! I hate those guys!
Who do we get to murder today?
I don't know … I  kind of admire Famia.
That's mine. I won't tell you again.
We wallow when we should be raiding.
Did the dryskin break a nail?
When do I get to hit something?
I wonder how much gold we can get for that haul?
I find that hunting prey to be extremely therapeutic.
Have you read Investigator Vale? She could catch me any time!
Whose turn was it to cook? This nalduku tastes like … well, nalduku!
I took down three guards while you were hiding behind that tree.
I need more vials! Get me more vials!
Who's been in my jars and bottles again?
The swamp isn't so bad … except for the bugs and the mud.
What if Famia's people are planting fake relics just to confuse us?
You know, if we keep a little extra, no one will notice.
The next arrow goes right in your knee.
My magic is more powerful than your swords and arrows.
Another relic lost? This situation is becoming intolerable!
I appreciate that we share the spoils of our raids equally.
I need a long vacation.
I'm honored to be a part of this plan!
I win again! Pay up, you losers!
Which merchant wagon are we targeting this time?
A dull blade will get you killed, novice.
We're getting quite a few shipments from Lilmoth lately. It's surprising that Murkmire has become such a popular destination.
There used to be nothing here when I was young. Back then, it was just a good spot for fishing. A shame it's become so popular.
The catapault cabbage can knock a full grown Saxhleel right onto their tail. If they cannot be avoided, it's best to move swiftly past them.

To end up in Black Marsh, of all places. What a horrible shame.\n\nAh, well. It should only be for a little while longer. I just have to wait until things cool down back in Vvardenfell. Then I'll be on my very merry way.

Is everything in this swamp trying to kill me? I nearly got smashed to paste by a miregaunt, mauled by a salamander, strangled by no less than four types of vine …! I'm afraid to do business behind a bush for fear it'll take a swipe at me!

Mmm. The bonding season feasts are always sumptuous, but if you think brined leeches are delicious the first time, try regurgitating them from your crop in a few hours.\n\nThey are proof the Hist love us.
It takes much patience to keep a vossa-satl in tune. Especially if the frogs are in mating season. \n\nPlease excuse me.
Watch your step, ojel. As this place returns to the swamp, it becomes just as dangerous to the unwary.
Strange, isn't it? Coming to a home you weren't born in. These tribes are as foreign to me as any Nord.
Oh, I'm not local. I hope you're not looking for directions. I'm as lost as they come.
Be mindful of your head. This is a fruitful place to gather termite larva, if you are wary of the occasional falling plank.

Tell me, is it a dryskin custom to come gawk at this wreck? It is a lump of rotting wood. Not even good for burning anymore, yet ojel always ask to come. I will take their coin and put it to better use.

Hold on, hold on, watch where you're stepping. This is an anthropological site now. No place for tourists and hikers.\n\nAlthough, you have the look of an explorer about you. If you're with one of the expeditions, I suppose you could stay and observe.
Pah tzel tchee uvastei jel xul-uxith.
This used to be a place that only the tribes knew. I suppose those days are gone.\n\nI hope they return.
Tending above the water is not so hard—clip the vines, clear the path of moss—but below the surface the struggle against the muck is endless. A season of that is reminder enough of why dusk fell.
Streams become rivers, and rivers become the ocean wide. What path do you wish to take, traveler?
Alone I travel, alone I sleep. But if not for us coming together, no gold would I earn. Do you wish to see my wares?
The Xinchei-Konu is a shining example of Argonian magic. Powerful, ancient, and endlessly mysterious.
You're the outsider that walked the Path of the Lily? Really? Well, sometimes a dropped egg doesn't crack, I suppose.
These Hollow wither too quickly. At least their rot is of use to the sharith.
I blame the Bright-Throat eggs. They are plentiful, but weak like their tribe.

The tribes had trouble accepting my port at first. Said it was too deep in the swamp.\n\nThat's why I built the teeba-enoo court. It keeps the tribes happy, and that keeps my port safe from their warriors.
I cannot wait to see how Kishi's students handle the Path of the Lily. I already see vast improvements just watching them run through their training.
Let us pretend you are not an outsider and therefore are welcome in my store.\n\nThat way, you can purchase something and I can receive your gold.
Tsojei is still thirsty.
I've lit the trap! Drag the monster to it!
This way! Before he spits!
You're poisoned! Come here! I can help!
The Argonians here are just so droll. Insult one today, and they'll have forgotten by tomorrow. They're so … bestial in that way, don't you think?
It's better than being a mother like you!
You still think you're their mother? You aren't. You never were! You will always be their egg-tender!
My hands shake with worry for Root-Whisper Village. Many warriors have come, but from many different tribes. Can they ever fight alongside one another?
Your flesh will suffice, though I prefer a bit more meat on the bone.
Not bad. I see potential for your remains.
Die, wretched thing! Die so I can raise you!
Jaxsik-Orrn will lead our tribe with strength and skill. Still, I worry that she will struggle to keep peace with the neighboring tribes.
I can hear the Hist! Finally, I can hear it!
You cannot stop me!
Welcome to Seekhat Yol, ojel! See what the Hist provides.
The harbormaster lets me keep shop here, so long as I give him a piece of my profits.
Rootmender! I erect the spine of humility before your great accomplishments. How may I serve you?
Years as a warrior of Murkmire have given me confidence as a warrior, yes. But do I wish to use those skills for the good of Nords and Dark Elves? This, I am not sure.
I love this spot. Truly, there is no better spot to watch the torchbugs dance.
Don't you love the way the muck tingles your nose when mixed with the salty sea? I think the bog-eels like it too. That is where my traps are fullest!
I did not know how much like us the Nords are. This brew they make tastes like bark and gives me deep, warm sap feelings.

I'm as Lukiul as they come, truth be told. Just stopped by Lilmoth to do a spot of trading. But as soon as I left the ship, I just … had to come to this village.\n\nAh, well. Long as I'm here, why not take a look at my wares?
Use the vine-tongues!
Careful! You haven't fully disarmed it!
Her power is limitless, as are her legions!
Bask in her radiance and be made pure!
You have yet to taste her power! Gaze into the infinite!
This is our anguish!
Weep as I do!
Share in our grief, forever.
Gloom hangs over us all.
Nakiri has traveled to many places, seen many lands. But it is in Rimmen that he has finally decided to rest his weary bones. Fortunate for you, no?
You know, the Khajiit will do anything for a bit of gold. And I mean anything. It's never been so easy to recruit new test subjects!
Trust me on this, traveler. You want Imperial steel. Strong and Sturdy. That's exactly what I offer.
I have traveled all of Elsweyr to learn the skill of carpentry. You know what works best? Open ears and an open mind.
Some may call Sharazzur a fop of a feline, but at least he is well dressed.
I was first sent to Elsweyr to help fight the Knahaten Flu. At the height of that tragedy, we mages were regarded as saviors. Still are, actually.
How is Amajhan to sell his wares when siege weapons threaten us? Oh, this one should have moved to Riverhold when still there was a chance.
This one's guild is nice, yes? But if another one would make a better offer of employment …. Well, that would be that.
Are you newly arrived in Elsweyr, traveler? Come back to me when you have done great deeds, and I shall have more wares to offer.
Heading to the Abode of Ignominy? Then I'd advise some stronger armor. The dead swarm around that place like hungry skeevers, and your flesh is ripe cheese.
This one warns you that his brews are made in the Khajiiti fashion. That is to say, sweet. If that is not to your taste, it is best to move along.
The secret to Khajiiti cooking? Sugar, and lots of it. No one likes a sour meal.
This one's patrons refer to him as Mama Mizarr. He asks them, what is motherly about a Khajiit such as he? They simply laugh.
I've been nothing but impressed with the leather workers in Elsweyr. It's easy to see how much they respect the craft.
I know, I know. A proper High Elf maiden, selling cloth in a Khajiiti city? I'm sure my ancestors' ashes are rolling in their graves right now.
Your weapon must be an extension of your arm, walker. Quickly you strike, before the enemy has a chance to know you are there! That is the Khajiiti way.
Trust Abazbi, for she knows how to handle a fine piece of wood. Perhaps you are wishing for a firsthand experience, walker?
Worried about the quick claws of the city's many pickpockets? The Rimmen bank is honor bound to protect your goods!
I do not tolerate sticky fingers in my bank. Once your valuables have been secured, that is where they will stay.
I'm going to be honest, I don't know the first thing about furniture. But Lathahim inspected all our wares, so I know they're quality goods.
Rest your feet and wallow, oh weary traveler. I have many packs for you to peruse.
There must be a bond between the senche-mount and those who wish to ride them. Otherwise, you will find them most unwilling steeds.
You've got a need? Adi has the supplies. Have a look.
When I took this job, I had no idea how hard it would be to live among the Khajiit! I mean, there's plenty of meat to eat, but it's all glazed with sugar! Who does that?
Forgive me if I make a mistake. I was just hired by my guild, and I'm still learning the ropes.
When you get to be my age, there isn't much opportunity to meet new people. That's why I decided to take this job! Now I see new faces every day.
Many greetings, fair traveler. Might I interest you in some very fine wares? I assure you, my guild sells only the best.
I can't believe it! Dragons, flying over Elsweyr for the first time in centuries. I'd suggest you stock up on some reliable weapons, walker.
My Khajiiti soldiers are the finest around, and anyone who thinks otherwise can tell me so to my face. If they dare.

Yes, there is great beauty in the way Khajiiti storytellers weave their tales. \n\nBut is it not best to write these words down as well? After all, books are more likely to stand the test of time than spoken words.
Hmm? Need to make a purchase? Be quick about it.
My spines quiver when I think of our guild members in Summerset, for I am sure they suffer much disrespect from the High Elves.
The Khajiit are the cleverest thieves in all of Tamriel, make no mistake. As well as the finest fences, of course.
You want your goods spotless and clean? Make sure to come to me. Migarra's fencing work is about as shoddy as her thievery.
Every young thief who comes in here thinks they'll be the next Rajhin. Well, this Khajiit has seen them come and go, like so many flies. And not one has impressed her.
The High Elves decided long ago that they didn't want me to be a part of their society. So now I count pocket change in a cellar for the thieves of Rimmen. Well, it's a living.
Sure, the guild pays me well. But those Jovial Lambasters do more than pay well. Way I hear it, there's quite a few perks to being part of their gang.
Manasi is honored to offer his wares to warriors in such a noble rebellion. After all, no war can be won without the proper supplies.
Ah, to once more travel the warm sands of Elsweyr. My last trip took me to Skyrim. Miserable weather! It is no wonder the Nords drink so much.
Elsweyr's fine. I guess. But I'm here to tell you, friend—I could really do with a good pint of Valenwood jagga.\n\nHow about you? Looking for something in particular?
Ah, the smell of the sugar farms and stiff savannah breezes …. I could get used to this!\n\nHow about you? Need anything for your adventures here in Elsweyr?
Nomadic life can be hard, yes. But to be trapped within the walls of a city, confined to a shop for the rest of your days? Now that is a truly unfortunate fate.
Looking for furnishings, eh? Well let's get to it, then!
In the market for some furnishings? Everything's for sale. Except this chair. This chair's mine.
Blood sport. Hmph. Frankly, I find the whole business repugnant. But then again, gold is gold, yes?\n\nPlease, cerum, feel free to browse.
Plenty of gear here, five-claw! Bizdar wonders if you are strong enough to wield it.
You've underestimated me for the last time!
I may be dead, but you're all coming with me!
Back in your cell, Quintus!
Your technique seems adequate, if a bit unrefined.
I am every aspect of the light.
Her radiance lights the true path.
Hmm. The oil leaking from these pipes matches what we found deeper in the ruins. You've picked up the trail, for sure. Keep looking.
Scrapes in the stone. Those Dagon beasts dragged something out of here in a hurry. Keep going. The machine must be nearby.
Tall Papa's breeches, what is this place? Some kind of profane forge? We can't let them finish building this thing. Hurry!
The hero who saved Rimmen! Although Amajhan cannot afford to offer you a discount, he will offer you his thanks.
All day Tasheer slaves over his brews, and what do these outsiders tell him? "It is too sweet!" Too sweet? In Elsweyr, there is no such thing!
Nisuzi welcomes you back, walker! Did you finish the job?
This one appreciates your help—and your discretion, yes?\n\nHurry back when the job is done!
You are looking for honest work, yes? Or something like honest work? Nisuzi has a task for you.
Look who comes bounding back! To be young again …. But enough of that. You were victorious, yes?
Good fortune, youngster. Old Ri'hirr waits for your swift return.
Looking for work, walker? There is more than enough to go around.
Khajiiti weapons have no equal! Quickly we strike, before the enemy has the chance to know we are there. Of course, this you know.
You want furniture? But you don't have a house. Uh, well. I suppose that's all right.
I have heard a little of your adventures in Elsweyr. Still, I sense you have more to do, just as I will one day have more wares to offer.
Your great deeds echo across Elsweyr like a Dragon's roar. I am sure you'll be pleased with what I offer.
You wish to buy my furnishings, though you have no home? A bold choice, I suppose.
Dragons fly over Elsweyr and Dark Moons hang within our skies. We must find what light we can.
This one's fur rises at the thought of what blood-mixtures can be made from a Dragon.
Khajiit dabbles in the blood of many creatures, but never has she experimented on a Dragon.
Ah, rich blood for the next batch!
I'll boil your blood!
Trembling rats. You'll give me no sport.
Simple ones. It's the Dragons you should be fighting.
Nisaazda! It's not right!
I'll leave your sluggish blood for the rats.
At least, you've whet the Devourer's appetite.
And now, Dragon, I will finish what I started!
We are one with Maarselok.
Maarselok's embrace is a blessing.
You must join the fold.
The azure is everything.
I will walk out of here with my freedom!
Plant the seed in the source!
Choose surrender. Then the real fun begins.
Do you think you have me cornered?
You're next, warlock!
The seed! I'll cleanse it!
I've never cared for spiders, Changeling. They beg to be crushed.
Food for the roots.
You'll suffer for disturbing me.
Not so brave now. Grovel and I'll forgive your trespass.
You would make worthy slaves. Accept me as your god and I will overlook your rebelliousness.
Your ashes will be scattered to the farthest corners of the world.
Time for a well-deserved nap.
Mortals. How did you expect any other outcome?
By Jone and Jode, you're the Dragon slayer! Welcome, welcome! It is an honor to serve such a great warrior.
Rise from the ash, servants of flame!
Finish her. Show no mercy!
Run and hide, prey!
Meridia, lend me your power!
Red. The color of fiery passion and boiling blood!
He's breaking free!
Your ashes will be pure, at least.
There is order in ice. Rigid and pure.
The sun warms the righteous, and scorches the worm.
Her light will flash from the sky and smite you.
Now you will know despair!
<Mystic Goblin chanting.>
<Mystic Goblin chanting.>
Shoo! Shoo, shoo!
You made a wrong turn, friend!
So you've returned. Has your assignment been completed?
Dark moons.
Ah, apologies. This one is fine.
Enough! I'll turn your world to ash!
Watch out for Tajirri. She plays the fool, but there is no better gambler in all of Riverhold.
I don't think it likes you.
This one assumes no liability for lost goods, though he can lease you a lockbox at a very fair price.
Clean goods. Bought and sold.
Obey and she is pleased.
She is our light.
Her light blinds the unworthy.
When the world serves her, our existence will be perfect.
No-one defies her!
Life is hers to take!
Your will will be crushed!
Your corruption will be purged!
<Exasperated Goblin gibberish.>
It's blocked your retreat! You'll be cooked alive!
That field around its body is too strong! Find a more vulnerable target!
It's coming apart! Hit it with everything you've got!
If you're looking to travel south, I have one word of warning; don't. There's nothing down there but thieves and cutthroats. \n\nBest to stay up north where it's safe. Well, safer at least.

I tell you, Khajiiti traders are slipperier than buttered eels.\n\nSure, they're all pleasantries and compliments when the negotiations start. But try to cut yourself a fair deal? That's when they show you just how stubborn they can be!
Spare a coin, rhook? Anything … any gold you could part with would be a blessing.
Have a care around these Rimmenites, friend. Furry scamps will cut a throat just as quick as they cut a purse.\n\nMara's mercy, I hate it here.
Hey there, sweetmeat. What's your hurry? We could use some fresh faces here in Rimmen. Strangers are so much more … enticing.

I was ever so excited when Queen Euraxia invited me to visit Rimmen. I had never traveled outside of Summerset, and I thought it would be a grand opportunity to see new sights.\n\nLittle did I know I was walking into a battleground.
You know, I always did wonder what Dragon flesh tasted like. Glad to know I'll get the opportunity to find out!
Dragons! Real Dragons! I can scarcely believe it! If I could study just one of their scales and rush a treatise into print … Mara's heart, I could win the Gwylim Prize!
Filthy Euraxian muskarses! A reckoning is coming, walker. Rimmen will belong to the sons and daughters of Alkosh again. Very soon.

It takes only a single voice to plant the seed that will sprout into courage. Yet without the support of others, that sprout will never grow.\n\nBe the rain that soothes, the sun that shines. Be that which nourishes a hero's heart.
There are many different kinds of Khajiit; Pahmars, Dagis, Senches. \n\nEach has a certain form to suit a certain purpose. And all furstocks are granted due respect, regardless of size or shape.

This business with the Dragons? It's a tragedy. But Dragons or not, there's a war on.\n\nThe Dominion has its heel on the throat of both the Covenant and the Pact. If we redirect our forces here, we might suffer losses in Cyrodiil. We can't have that.

Ra'ri once thought to travel Tamriel in order to broaden his knowledge.\n\nHe made it as far as Grahtwood before realizing that few were willing to speak seriously to a "magical talking cat." And so he stays in Rimmen.
Have you finished your hunt? Knowing that there are fewer wings in the sky above us would ease the minds of many.
I appreciate the help. When you've finished your hunt, return to me. I'll have a reward for you.
Interested in taking down some Dragons? I can provide you with some information on where to go, plus a reward.
I finally have the chance to study Dragons, some of the most powerful, most elusive creatures that Tamriel has to offer.\n\nAnd where do they decide to appear? In Elsweyr, of all places.

Hey! Hey, you. You didn't … wait, let this one start again.\n\nYou don't think Samari is a monkey, do you? Alla time, people are saying, look at tha' silly monkey! But look! Does Samari wear a fez? Does Samari play a squeeze-box? Ziss'vo!
Euraxia Tharn has allowed the Mages Guild to continue to operate in Rimmen, albeit under close scrutiny. The moment we refuse a request or step out of line ….\n\nWell, it won't be pretty.
Chirba, sweet Chirba. What can I do to make you mine, and mine alone?
Swords! Axes! Staves! Bah. Nothing compares to the power and cunning of claw-to-claw combat. This, every Khajiit knows.\n\nWant to truly test your might? Throw down your weapons and put up your paws!

Dragons in Elsweyr! By Ysmir's beard, who would have thought it possible?\n\nIf only we had a Dragonborn around to give us a fighting chance. It's said they can suck the souls right out of Dragons! Can you imagine?
Ah, another beautiful day in Queen Euraxia's Rimmen!\n\nTamruz grows so tired of his compatriots' yowling. Rule by Imperial conqueror is a glorious thing, walker. A glorious, lucrative thing!

Euraxia was always a cruel ruler, but never did this one think her so desperate. Every day, all Tazzhid thinks about is one of those ballistae shooting into his home ….\n\nOh, this one's poor stomach.
Ranji is always welcoming to Rimmen's many, many visitors! Especially the ones who do not watch their purses, yes?
I still remember my first taste of moon-sugar. Never had I experienced something so simply divine, so sweetly seductive.\n\nIt's a small wonder that the Khajiit worship the stuff.
I'm proud to serve, but between you and me, Queen Euraxia's methods are causing more harm than good here. These Khajiit are kind, hardworking folk. I wish she could see that.
The Dragons took everything from this one. Her home, her hope, her future. Now Urbinna wanders Rimmen, hoping to find her faith once more.

The locals may chafe under Euraxia's rule, but they'd be lost without her. Everyone knows these Rimmenites don't have the capacity for self-governance. They're good for nothing but petty squabbles and superstition!

The High Elves have their magic and the Wood Elves have their bows. But when it comes to battle, they both know that it's the Khajiit who lead the charge.\n\nThat's why the Elves even bother to tolerate us as allies.
Don't get me wrong, I'm quite aware of just how much of a muskarse Euraxia is. But she pays her soldiers well, and on time to boot. \n\nHard for a mercenary to turn down steady work, is all.
This one was once the Clan Mother of her village, oh yes. It was her word as to when the moon-sugar was harvested, when our stories were told.\n\nBut that was another life, walker.
The Khajiit here have been just so kind! I've had several invite me to dinner with them, and several more offering gifts of welcome.\n\nWho knew that Elsweyr would be so welcoming to travelers?

The Jovial Lambasters are here to help! Any wish, any desire can be yours. Imagine the wealth, the power, the prestige!\n\nAll for a price, of course. Lord Clavicus Vile isn't one for charity, I'm afraid.
Never have I met a race more proud of their unscrupulous ways than the Khajiit. It's as if they've found a sense of honor in being so damned dishonorable.
I'll leave this refuge just as soon as those blasted Dragons are gone from the skies, and not a moment sooner.
Historically, Riverhold has passed back and forth between Anequina and Cyrodiil. Such difficulties can come with being a border town.\n\nHappily, we've been a part of Elsweyr for centuries now.

Lanasi cannot help tend the fields, due to her size. So instead she balances books and helps the farmers with their finances.\n\nShe does also tend to catch the occasional mouse, but that is just between us, yes?

Riverhold has always been known for our fertile farms and large harvests. Without our crops, the entire region would suffer.\n\nLet us just hope that the war does not get in the way of our good work, yes?

Have you met the new investigator in town? Mizzik Thunderboots, he calls himself.\n\nBah. Have you ever heard anything so ridiculous? If he actually ends up solving a case, I'll eat my own right boot. And that's a promise.

Unsurprisingly, the Alfiq are often disrespected outside of Elsweyr.\n\nHere, everyone knows we are just as clever as any other Khajiit. But outside of these lands? Well, there is a reason the Alfiq do not travel.

Euraxia must be stopped at all costs. And trust this one, there will be costs. That is why J'baanluk helps any way he can. No task is too small when there is so much to do. \n\nBut when the battle comes? He will fight tooth and claw.
Gharesh-ri may be our general, but on the battlefield? That's Captain Nala-do's domain. She leads every charge, make no mistake.
Thank goodness you and Razum-dar stopped those smugglers from harming any more farmhands! Shazari was sure that she was going to be next.
These darn Khajiit sprinkle sugar on everything. Their meat, their stews, their alcohol. By Oblivion, they even put sugar in their beer!
There's always the need for moon-sugar, walker! Every Khajiiti recipe, from our meats to our sweets, calls for it.\n\nSo even Merryvale's smaller farms never worry too much about profits.

We don't bother the Khajiit, and in turn? They don't bother us.\n\nOf course, the cats are happy to accept our gold and work out trades. And their bandits are more then ready to attack Hakoshae, should we let our guard down.
I can't believe our family's legacy is a lie.\n\nStill, I'm glad my sister told Hakoshae the truth. Our people deserve to know who we truly are, and what our ancestor did.
The world is without color these days. Red blood is spilled, green cane is harvested, colorful Dragons fly in the skies above. Yet all I see is shades of gray.\n\nI fear the color will never return.
I'm sick of this small town life. What adventure is there to be found in Hakoshae? The people here cling to our Akaviri culture because that's all we have left to be proud of.

Potentate Versidue-Shaie ruled Cyrodiil for hundreds of years before his death.\n\nNo one is quite sure what allowed this longevity, as it certainly isn't a common trait for the Akaviri to have. One can only guess that powerful magics were at play.
Why, if it isn't the hero of Riverhold! Manasi is honored that you have chosen to patronize his humble shop.
This one has known Razum-dar since she was but a little ja'khajiit.\n\nUnfortunately, he seems only think of her as one does a little sister. Ah, if only he could see the adult she has become ….
The Khajiit and Wood Elves have never gotten along.\n\nI mean, yes, we're in the same alliance now. But that means we just hate each other a little more quietly than usual.
Want some advice? Don't take this too seriously. War's a game, wayfarer. I don't know about you, but I intend to die laughing.

Need some tips? Right. Never polish your armor on a Sundas. And when you do polish it, make sure you start at the boots and work your way up … unless it's Frostfall, in which case start at the top and work your way down.\n\nAre you writing this down?
You seek an extravagant mount consistent with your noble magnificence, yes? I can help.
I can't believe the captain didn't assign me to the assassination squad ….
Over there! The queen wants them alive!
You'd think that Azurah would have warned the old loony to stay away from bandit dens.
What kind of fool walks into a bandit den? He's loony all right.
Come! This one can mend your wounds.
Have you enjoyed Rimmen so far, rhook? Of course, this one could help you enjoy it much more.
Kill the intruder. Only the strong can carry our message.
Curse these frothing, nativist malcontents! With Queen Euraxia gone, who will lead us? A foolish kitten and some doddering Mane?\n\nZiss on the lot of them!

Bright moons above! Once again, Khajiit, and not Imperials, rule over Rimmen!\n\nAll that remains is rooting out the shaveskins who stood with Euraxia. We'll find every one of these collaborators, walker. Just wait and see.
Safe transit to Dominion, Covenant, and Pact territories! Climb aboard, watch your step, and tuck your tails!
Come witness the miracle at Sunspire!
Do you hear it? The roar of the First Cat on the wind?
You cannot deny Alkosh forever.
Only a massive cheese-wielding mudcrab can stop you now!
I know you're dead, but you really have to admire this hammer's appetite.
Why did we come here?
It's just a rash! She swears, it's just a rash.

Tava, give me speed! A Dragon approaches!
Justice-RedF/H/Necro
Justice-RedF/H/Dragon
No! There can be no necromancy here!
A beast such as you cannot be here.
Even the strongest sword could not lay that creature low!
No! There can be no necromancy here!
A beast such as you cannot be here.

No! There can be no necromancy here!

Justice-RedM/D/Necro
Justice-RedM/D/Dragon

Justice-RedM/E/Dragon
Necromancy sickens the soul. I weep for you.
Ruptga protect us! There's a beast on the loose!
A Dragon? Eight protect me!
Justice-RedM/G/Necro
Justice-RedM/G/Dragon
Necromancy sickens the soul. I weep for you.
Ruptga protect us! There's a beast on the loose!
A Dragon? Eight protect me!
You dare to face me, morsel?
Obey, blood-thralls!
These bugs are so eager to drink and be made slaves.
This one prefers her thralls to dull-clawed bloodfiends. Too feral.
Get them, darlings!
Took this poison from a Baandari fresh out of Murkmire. Very effective, but spoils the blood.
I have a claw for your heart!
There should be an etiquette. This one is tired of felling prey only to be the last to feed.
Finally, something to do!
Burn, fools!
My claws will strip the flesh from your bones!
Again!
Shield yourself!
Swing with all your might!
A brutal hit!
Here comes another trap!
Good! You have broken free!
Again! Stop this one's attack!
Press your advantage!
A good strike!
A healthy blow!
Grrah! Enough of your games!
Could that be the painted mark we seek?
Show them your power, Devourer!
Drown in blood.
We are not so easily divided!
The blood obeys!
Breathe your last you damn beast!
Your blood tastes of cat piss.
Mojaluz used to be a chef, but realized no money can be made baking treats. Unless those treats have special ingredients.
Sure, Sedarra could help you make a blade so that you annoy your enemies with tiny pokey pokes. Or you could craft a mighty hammer and just smash their skull. Efficiency, yes?
Looking to stock up on some things before facing the next Dragon attack? I've some useful goods.
My selection might not be the prettiest or fanciest you could buy, but I promise my goods will hold up in the harshest of conditions—including Dragon breath.

Hello, fair adventurer! Please partake in our most illustorus … illustery … illustrious, yes that sounds right, illustrious store … ziss, why are there so many big words in this note?\n\nUmmm, please buy something.
I just had a customer in here talking about Dragons. Have you seen any?\n\nOh. I should ask if I can help you.
I have armor fit for a … well, the armor will fit. And protect. Pretty armor with jewels and carvings may look nice, but to survive the swipe of a Dragon, go for solid and sturdy.
I had to go through all sorts of training before I was able to set up shop here in Senchal. If there's one thing the Khajiit take seriously, it's their brews!

I honestly don't know what I was thinking, bringing my vastly superior cooking skills to the slums of Senchal. These Khajiit wouldn't know a refined meal if it jumped off a plate and smacked them square between the eyes!
With Dragons flying about, it's a wonder anyone is traveling these days. I'm happy to see a traveler with coin. You have coin, right?
Why would anyone wish to wear metal pieces? Stiff, awkward. No. Zurso sells nicely worked leather goods. Supple, light. None make clangy noises.
Well, hello! I saw you across the marketplace and was sure you'd come to survey my wares.\n\nI sell useful things.
Looking for something that won't weigh you down in the heat of Southern Elsweyr? Look no further!
Came here with the rest of the Forgotten Legion, all those years ago. I was in charge of the weapons for some of the finest soldiers in Tamriel. Now I ply my trade in the streets of a foreign city.

People think working wood is just chipping and chopping, but you need to handle it to get a feel for its strength. Then, and only then, do you know how to shape it and work it to create a weapon or a shield.
This one has a few items now. Perhaps more later. Who knows? It's in the hands of Jone and Jode.
If you're looking for furnishings for a humble abode or a great manor, I can offer many items for you to purchase. Have a look! Any purchase supports my voice training.
Ah, so you purchase my nice furnishings to motivate yourself to buy a house! Smart! You can settle right in after you buy a home that suits you. And any purchase means more voice lessons for me.
Ah, this one has heard a few things about you. You may do many more great things, and when that happens, Shuva can have many different wares for you.
Shuva has some very fine things for one whose deeds shine so brightly. Take a look.
Shuva can, of course, show you her fine goods, but has to wonder why someone with no house would be interested in purchasing furnishings.
You give us your gold and goods, and we keep it safe and secure. That's why we are named Safe and Secure!
If you're depositing gold or goods, we guarantee to keep it all safe. If you're withdrawing gold and goods, you're on your own.
Hey! Do you like bags? If you do, I have them. I mean, I'm selling them. You should buy one.
Take a deep breath. Smell that? Horses! This one loves that aroma.\n\nThis one loves their noses, too. He must pet them all! They are all so silky and soft.
This one welcomes you to the finest shop in Southern Elsweyr!\n\nHow can Maguzak help you?
Gods, the heat! I didn't really think about that when I agreed to come here. At least the cats know how to brew a decent ale.
Be a guild merchant, they said. See the world, they said! How glamorous! Feh. Senchal is about as glamorous as a wet troll's bottom.\n\nSorry, did you need something?
This look like a store to you? Yeah, same here. Come to find out I'm supposed to call it a kiosk. What in Kyne's feathery-arse is a kiosk?\n\nSorry, just thinking out loud. You need something?
Ah! Greetings sera. If there's anything I can get you, please let me know.\n\nHonestly, I'm keen to make a sale. Locals tend to be a bit wary of Dark Elves. Can't blame them, I guess.
Greetings. As mud is my mother, you will not find a moister array of goods than the ones I have to offer.\n\nWhy did you make that face?
What you want, and what you need, are reliable weapons. This one has some well-crafted arms that can aid you, especially if you are thinking of fighting Dragons.
This one welcomes you! No wait, this one sells wonderful wares of magic! There, that sounds better, no?
I joined the Mages Guild to see more of the world than just Summerset. Senchal has been … interesting, shall we say. Still, business has been good.
Ah Senchal, home of the easy score. Weather is nice too, so long as you do not mind the scent of smoke and blood in the air.\n\nAnyway, let's do business.
Hmm. Those pockets look heavy. Perhaps I can take some things off your hands?
I don't know why I bother bringing such fine goods down here. What doesn't spoil or rust winds up stolen before long.\n\nHelp me out and make a purchase, eh?
Looking for goods? Down here? Ha! Fair enough, take a look!
Gold! Goods! All is safe with Murimdak. Look at this one's face …. Would this face lie to you?
I know that face. Sore, feet, am I right? Climb on board. I'll get you where you need to go.
Can you feel the seed taking root?
Your bags look light, walker. Perhaps Debaasi could interest you in some goods?
Some days, this one thinks we might fully restore Senchal. Other days, this one sees weeds and vines take over another building.
The Shields of Senchal … bah. They're pulling my tail. Imperial brigands, they are, interested only in what they can take. Sure, they play at bringing law and order, but I'm no fool.
If you catch the faint scent of sulfur and ash, it's because this one just came back from hunting Dragons.
Oh. You've found Shavnargo's napping spot. This one is clearly napping. Perhaps leave this one to continue napping, yes?
What brings you to the bottom side of Senchal's tavern? Hiding from Dragons? They are not known for asking for consent, yes? Or perhaps you hide from something less vicious, hmmm?
I am a scholar with no school, a rhyming bard who has no fool. A mage casting without a spell, a dancing cat who has no bell.
I am Urifa, a merchant. How may I help you?
You look tasty, and it's time for my next snack.\n\nI kid, of course. It's not nice to hunt prey in the city.
Purari ate too much food at the inn. So good. They served delicious fish cakes with Topal Bay seasoning. This one ate seven of them. Ah, this one hopes no Dragon attacks. Running is impossible now.

I know, I know. I'm a scribe and yet here I am in the library, reading, on a day off. I love libraries though. The late king was a connoisseur, so he amassed a most impressive collection. Hopefully the Dragons won't demolish it.

I must say, these Khajiit do have a taste for large statues of cats. I would love to see them expand their skills beyond these artistic expressions, but I shouldn't allow my preferences to inhibit their cultural development.
Well met. What brings you to Senchal? Adventure? Trade? A chance to see real Dragons in the sky?

Glad I wasn't here cleaning up after the Knahaten flu wiped out half the city. I heard the royal family locked themselves away in here, and they all died anyway.\n\nProbably pleased Namira, but it must've smelled awful.
Aside from the Dragons, encroaching jungle, crumbling buildings, Imperial bullies, and burnt-out lands nearby, Senchal is a pretty nice place.\n\nNeeds more cats, though.

New to the area? I am. My first and only deckhand experience ended due to a Dragon attack. Fun, huh?\n\nI'm hoping to find some steady work here. But I also want to make a pincushion out of that Dragon's snout.
You aren't one of those altruistic Dragonguard de'nts, are you? Seeking to have me join in on your doomed efforts to rid Tamriel of Dragons?\n\nPlease note that your answer interests me not at all.

I know, I know … a High Elf, in a Mages Guild, studying magic. Everyone goes on about High Elves and magicka, but honestly, I love working magic. Studying it, really. So many interesting twists and turns and theories.

Senchal reminds me of Sentinel, where I grew up. I would have liked to have seen this city in its full glory. I imagine the arrival of Dragons means the chance of restoring the city has decreased, however. A shame.
Southern Elsweyr is warm, but it's a dry heat. I miss the humidity of the swamps.
Eh, what is it? I'm reading a particularly interesting bit of history about the Akaviri Potentate.

I'm not real fond of cities. Yet here I am. When your clan chief asks you to gather information, you do what you need to. \n\nAnd no, I'm not a spy. We heard about Dragons, so I came to see if the rumors are true.
I thought I saw a Dragon fly over Senchal. I screamed and ran. Turns out, it was just a bird. A bird! \n\nIt was a big bird, I'll have you know!
I came here because of Dragons! Now there's a challenge. Figured some group was setting up to deal with them, and I want to be in on that.
Do not wander too far from the village, rhook. This one has seen frightening shadows from the path to the Wall of Life. Spiders, as big as he.\n\nSurely the light plays tricks.
Poor Vijari. This one grew up with him. It is hard for her to imagine taking the path beyond the Wall of Life at the age she is now.
Why do you disturb poor Ghalsu? He carried three jugs of moonshine water from the coast to the colorworks this week and he is paler for it. Let him rest.
This one saw Ka'ishka pack her bags and go. Perhaps this house's sorrows are finally over.
This one heard Vijari made his journey beyond the Wall of Life. Plucked from the vine too soon.
You come to chat with Khina, walker? She would welcome you into her home, but she does not believe you would fit. You may take a seat on her porch if you like.
Matching paints from pigments is an art unto itself. It is not so different from baking. Even the slightest error can result in failure.
Have you ever seen the blessed waters of the southern shores? They shone with moonlight even on the cloudiest night. Truly a gift from Jone and Jode.
Beware those Black Gulls, walker. Nothing but cutthroats and slavers, the lot of them!

You're off to South Guard? Don't expect a warm welcome. The Black Gulls dug into that place like hoarvors—sucking the blood out of anyone who strays too close.\n\nShame. I hear it used to be beautiful.
I can't resist him for long! Hurry!
No, that doesn't seem helpful.
That didn't sound quite right.
One more time!
No! No! Ah!
Clever, but you're making me angry.
The blight has you! Cleanse it quickly!
My dear priestess, I am not finished with you.
Go on and cradle your progeny! They grow up so fast.
You can only fight it for so long.
Doesn't she look ravishing, draped in an azure gown?
I'll make this quick for all of you. Except Carindon.
My blood thirsts!
Yes! That's the taste of victory!
What have you done? I've lost control of Selene!
Oh, you'll make fertile ground!
I accept you offering, but you'll still die.
No more of that now.
Your heart will beat to bursting!
You can't corner me.
You dare hurl your filthy blood at Nisaazda? Grundwulf! Bleed them dry!
Hollowfangs! Feast on these fools!
Ugh. I'd give my left arm for a hot cup of thistle tea.
I heard they're in league with someone else. Someone terrifying.
Blood for the Coven!
Kill them! Kill them!
I break bones good.
Look at them quiver! Cold, are you? Ha!
Ugh, the smell! You're putrid. Putrid!
Why do you hesitate? My servant yearns to make your acquaintance.
You came all this way, only to hesitate now? Pitiful.
Everything dead now, mother.
More feed for the garden ….
Dead? Good. Gather the rats to pick them clean!
Over so soon? How embarrassing.
This island belongs to the Coven. You never had a chance.
Fill those urns, you louts! We're not through yet.
I hear there's something big down here. And I mean big.
Draugrkin, attack!
Quick! Draw your weapons!
I'm right here, runts. Any time you're ready.
<Stone grinding.>
Waiting. Why are you waiting? Why?
What I accomplish here shall never be matched.
Too easy.
More bones. But no answers! No answers!
Dead? Good. Soon, all the world shall fall as well!
I deserve to be free!
Feel the fire consume you, trespasser!
Rrrraaaahhh!
I was already planning on it.
Nisaazda will exact a debt of blood owed for her clan!
You're owed that much.
Wake, children! Wake!
Are you enjoying yourself, Changeling? I am.
Step aside, Skelga. I'll burn them alive!
Your flames are a blight shrew. Go join the rest of your coven.
Damnable fleas!
Offer the Devourer their blood!
Thank you. And apologies for any harm I caused ….
Thanks for freeing me. I need to wash off. Several times.
My knees won't last as long as they used to. Wish I still had a bounce in my step. But enough of that. You were victorious, yeah?
Good fortune, friend. I'll see you soon.
Looking for work? I have more than enough to go around.
Eh, come back tomorrow. The sands and jungles of Elsweyr never stay quiet for long.
Welcome back, my friend! You seem no worse for the wear. I assume things went swimmingly?
