Despite what my sister Gwendis thinks, this one does not crave moon-sugar.\n\nI like moon-sugar, yes. But do I crave it? Adusa would never use that word.
So many monsters, so little time. But Adusa has claws enough for all of them, of that you can be sure!
Come, my brothers and sisters! Devour them!
The darkness, it will consume you!
The Dark Heart, it selects me!
Do not lower your guard. I do not trust this Reach witch.
Destroy the intruders!
Mangy cur! The Gray Host has no room for weaklings.
Another soul for the sacrifice!
Fool! You can't stop this now!
The harrier returns. With good tidings, I hope?
Be careful out there. We need you.
I heard a vateshran's tale that said our ancestors lived in the Reach when the world was young. It's in our very blood to defend it.\n\nReturn later if you seek to aid us.
The Gray Host has learned the Reach will not fall easily. But there is still so much to do. \n\nHave you come to help the Wayward Guardians, harrier?
This is no time to mourn your pet. The Gray Host demands your service.
Vile murderers! My companion's death will be avenged!
Hold these halls. We have our orders.
Damned Dwarven machines! Die already!
Why are we down here? There's nothing to eat!
Those savages will pay for defying the Ashen Lord.
This arrow, I'm saving it for that Reach witch.
I hate Dwarven constructs.
How many more constructs must we dismantle?
After a while, these Dwarven spiders all look the same.
I'm wounded! I need blood!
Why did the Dwarves fashion such horrible machines?
Everything was going according to plan. And then ….
The Reach rebels. This is all their fault.
Was this supposed to happen?
Whose idea was it to set up camp here?
Can you feel the power humming through here?
Think you can best a mage of the True-Sworn?
Did you see the stonework back there?
Simpletons!
No getting through me!
I tried a new shining wax for my shield. Look at the gleam.
Feels strange here. Honestly, I can't even read.
Down on your knees and beg!
You hear that? No. Wait. What's that?
No. No! You must leave now!
You hear the spirits, right? Yes. They crackle and grin.
I guess it's your time!
The portals will help you reach the voidmothers!
Are you the best champion this realm offers?
All this power … wasted.
The void comes for you!
Send me more power!
This realm shatters so easily!
I shall not be extinguished!
Can you take the heat?
Ah, a small one wishes to play.
How am I bested … by a mortal?
Join me in glorious battle!
I shall blaze brighter than before!
My time is not yours to waste!
Aha! Battle is joined!
Your easy death shames us both.
Feel the souls of the vanquished!
Feel power overwhelming!
Let us grow closer together.
I shall drink your vigor!
We shall meet again soon!
Do you trust your eyes?
Boss Trenlor may have gone too far this time.
I can't believe the boss banished Freyleth to the Deep Tombs.
Lothid used to be a more noble clan.
Do you think Kathad is right about Boss Trenlor?
I heard the Ravenwatch is sniffing around.
Guard duty. I hate guard duty.
Counting fleshflies on a bloodfiend … it soothes me.
I heard that the Hillhunter chief's daughter slipped away. She can't have gotten far.
What sort of Briarhearts will these Hillhunters make? They didn't have much fight in them.
We've more briarheart seeds than subjects. We need to find more wilders.
I've heard that we sent runners to the Six-Fords and the Wildspears. Our cages won't be empty for long.
I say we've got all the Briarhearts we need. Where should we strike first?
This is taking too long. The days are growing shorter.
Aye, so far, so good. But what will the Hagravens do when there are no more Hillhunters to turn?
I think it's going well. Don't you?
Something stirs in the depths. I can hear it calling to me.
I wanted to go first, but Nathari said the strong must help the weak see things through.
The light … it pains me …
The price must be paid. Do they not see that?
Our work is only beginning. Do not forget why we are here!
I know Nathari's right. She's been right about everything. But this is harder than I thought it would be.
I don't like these Gray Host cutters standing about and watching. They're not welcome here.
This is our time, our day of victory. We will show them all!
Everything is going according to the Ashen Lord's plan.
Reach blood! Tastes as bad as I expected.
The Gray Host. I love the sound of that.
For blood and glory!
Let the mortals tremble in our wake!
Some of the vampires treat us like dogs. I hate that.
And that's when I ate him.
I'll tear out their hearts! See if I don't!
I prefer my meals … raw.
Remain vigilant. Those who trespassed in the Keep may still be around.
It seems to me this may actually represent an opportunity of sorts. Belain is out of the way.
You call it a battle, I call it a meal!
I've heard the Ashen Lord has been planning this conquest for thousands of years. It'll be magnificent.
I was with Varen's legion before Bal's invasion. Got bitten at one of the Dark Anchors. Heh, now look at me.
Let the mortals struggle, our conquest is close to complete.
I was born near Verkarth, or what remains. A shame I never visited.
I used to be part of the Bangkorai Garrison when I was alive. Ironic, eh?
I hate the taste of these Reachfolk. Gamey.
I don't get why we don't slaughter those Ravenwatch sympathizers. No, no, I'm not questioning our leader.
I just love, love, love all this death! I've never felt so alive!
You will not harm this beast without my blessing.
Attendants! Drain this mortal of my gift!
Your simple attacks mean nothing against me!
I embody life! I cannot be defeated!
You have already lost.
My allies surround me, where are yours?
Your broken flesh fuels the forest, nourishes it.
[low intimidating growl]
It seems he mocks your feeble blows.
I feel that he admires your vigor, but warns you will fail.
You think your Spirit Queen favors you over me?
You dare interrupt my feeding?
The power of the Void is mine!
The darkness will claim you!
You wish to challenge the Hunter's Grove? Very well—begin!
I don't think we're the first to camp here. Lots of fresh tracks.
Get some rest. The gods will watch over us.
Unnatural witch storms? Nothing but Reach stories, mark my words.
Another ritual? Sometimes that feels like all we do!
The Ashen Lord promised. All this and more will be ours!
Blood, blade, and soul as one.
I owe you a cut for every one of my fallen kin.
Lead Rada to me!
Keep your distance!
What to take first? An arm? An eye?
Soon your blood will run as cold as my own.
Argh! Verandis! You dare raise your hand to me?
I still need more souls to summon the soul trap! Keep at it!
That's it! I'll have the soul trap ready in a moment!
Now can you see how far beneath me you are?
Breathe deep and choke on your own weakness!
[aggressive Goblin directing others to attack]
[furtive Goblin whisper like he's sharing a secret]
[prideful Goblin shouting about how she is the best]
[Goblin singing a strange song to herself]
[Goblin gibberish indicating that he's attacking, but not confident about his chances]
[Goblin happily babbling about his pet bear]
[slow growling threat in Goblin babble]
[whispering, gossipy Goblin gibberish]
You there! I challenge you!
Show me the kind of fighter you are!
Too scared you'll lose?
Face me!
Tusking weakling!
My liege! A tribute fit for a king!
Soooie! Soooie!
Dinner time, big fella!
You can't escape the darkness!
I saw a Six-Ford in our territory again. Time to teach them a lesson!
I hear the Thornroots have gone to ground at Briar Rock. Hiding from us, no doubt.
The Nords will pay for what they've done.
You're wondering what goods I have to sell among these righteous rebels, yes? Plenty, I say!
I'm back. Where to now?
To arms!
Victory is cruel. Defeat is worse.
Plenty of room, if you're looking for a place to rest.
Pfft, the Reach is nothing compared to Wrothgar.
What witchcraft is this?
I fear no witch!
Please tell me that's not all you can do.
Tossing you some oil!
Good. Now drip some of that near me.
Behold! The true strength imbued within me!
Feel wrath!
I'll tear you from the face of this realm!
All shall kneel before me!
Mortal! Channel my power and turn them to dust!
See if you can avoid this!
All these slaves and yet no one brings us our meals.
Bring them to me!
Take a look at this new glyph I discovered.
Watch where you step!
Caught you!
Get her away from me!
I can clear these traps!
You can't die on me!
May these bones find the emptiness of the Void.
The signs foretold your death!
Behold the majesty! Such an honor to be in this place.
This suffering shall linger!
All my work, all these years, finally pay off.
I'll look for some more of that oil.
You shall meet our new lord in time!
Mortals betray their own so easily. And for such small rewards.
Hear ye, hear ye! Announcing the arrival of his royal rotundness, King Boar!
One of King Boar's many princes joins the fray!
Prince Boar, your father summons you!
The tusky tyrant is no more! Long live the Champions of the Realm! Help yourself to some apples.
Someday I hope to have my own place, where I can have more than one pot to cook in. More pots, more soup!

Soup has many different uses. It can fill you up or warm your scales on a cold night. It can quench your thirst and take away your troubles. Soup is so much more than simply food. It is perfect!\n\nI would not dedicate my life to anything less.

Jubilee Cake? What about Jubilee Soup? I could make something just as worthy of celebration. Soups are perfect for large parties, as long as you have a big enough ladle.\n\nI really must talk to them about this obvious oversight in the menu.

You are quite the talented cook, friend. But perhaps you have not found your signature dish as yet. Concentrate on a single type of food and make it your own. \n\nBut stay away from soup. That belongs to me.
Your skill with food and drink … is quite impressive. I wonder which of us makes a more complex and flavorful soup?\n\nNo, better we don't find out. I would hate to see you devastated.

I observed a very small mortal—oh, you might call it a child—interacting with a tiny beast. The creature kept licking the child, but its tongue had no barbs or sharp edges.\n\nA rather damp and ineffective form of flagellation, in my opinion.

I admit that, to me, most mortals look more or less the same. Give me a moment. Yes, yes, I recall that odor. The distinct smell of over achievement and quiet desperation.\n\nI do remember you, little mortal! What entertainment you provided me!

Mehrunes Dagon cultists, can you imagine? Why mortals would turn to the Prince of Destruction is beyond even my great capacity to understand. Perhaps you can enlighten me.\n\nDo mortals enjoy natural disasters?

So, just to be clear, I'm a former member of the Order of the Waking Flame. You'd call it a Daedric cult, I suppose, but while we're in the movement, we never use the "c" word.\n\nNow that I'm out, I can say it with impunity—cult, cult, cult!
Would you believe that I joined the Order of the Waking Flame to impress a lover? I know. It sounds foolish now. But they were a great lover!

I spoke with the Master of the Order once. The Supreme Leader. He wore a mask, but his voice sounded very familiar. I think he's somebody famous. Somebody important. But for the life of me, I never could place it.
Is it customary to greet strangers by screaming and fleeing? I seem to encounter that a lot in your world.
I have determined what your world is missing—the satisfying and melodic screams of the damned.\n\nThe absence is rather unsettling, truth be told.
Try again mortal. Get that fluid closer to my magic.
Almost. My cold fire must reach an active power module to disable it.
Prisoners? Free? Impossible!
Can you feel it? All around us. His power grows.
How dare you!
Smell that brimstone? I love it.

I'm glad to have a prankster partner. You understand me, and the Jester's Festival, in a way most don't. \n\nI'll have to think about what fun to set up for tomorrow. Hmm, maybe something with scrib jellies?
Well done. Now dispatch our unwelcome guests.
You have returned. What news do you have for me?
Be careful out there, friend. More than one adventurer has underestimated the dangers of Blackwood.
You look like you can handle yourself. Care to explore a bit of Blackwood and make some gold along the way? I have a job for you.
I doubt I will have anything more for you until I speak with my clients, but I will be sure to let you know when I do.\n\nBe safe out there.
You're back! I confess I was not entirely sure I would see you again. I assume you bring good news?
Never fear, the Chamber of Legates pays its debts. The vaults of Leyawiin are deep, and we have gold to spare for people who can take care of trouble for us.
We only employ those who know what they're doing in a fight. Do you think you have what it takes?\n\nThere's a fine reward waiting in the coffers of the Chamber of Legates if you do.
We don't have any more work for you today. But check back soon!
That liquid on the ground won't move itself.
Watch out! He put down a totem!
Come on, get up! We can do this!
I think you really angered the brute.
Seems there's no shortage of salamanders around here.
Come on! You've got more in you than that!
I should have eaten a larger meal if I knew I'd wait around this long.
Got him right where I want him!
What do you think of these acorns?
Try to dodge these, guar kissers!
There's no dodging this!
You are not the one I seek.
We're about to loose! Lead the enemy to our target!
Wait, big guy, come back! I've got your last meal!
My archers are ready. Give us a target!
In the market for a potion or tincture? Mine are all first rate!\n\nPlease don't take that as a guarantee. All sales are final.
You're familiar with the War of the Singers, yes?\n\nI fold that tale into the metal of every blade I make. What story will your hammer tell?
For a place called Blackwood, you'd be surprised how few reputable carpenters you'll find.\n\nBut here's a bit of good news: you just found one.
I shall find that point where you break.
Find me mortal. Free me.
The Legates think they're in charge here, but I'll tell you a secret that every seamstress knows. \n\nShe who sews the pants rules the world.
Ugh. Really? Try again.
So, if Itade were to trump Hade in this one corner case, we wouldn't ….\n\nAh, sorry. I'm developing a runestone game! But that can wait. Can I help you?
Got plenty of vegetables for sale! Perfect for mashing up with ugly flat teeth!
We're ready! Tell Calia when to strike!
Just imagine … a city like this brought to heel by a mob of half-naked witchmen. Ludicrous.\n\nRemember, the difference between a soldier and a savage is heavy armor.
Gorgeous day for a drink! But then, every day we're alive is a gorgeous day for a drink!\n\nCome see what I've got on tap today.
You are looking for decent food, yes? This one offers the best on this side of the Niben River! \n\nThis is not saying much, but it is true!
Innkeepers are a nosy lot. Not me, though! Long as you mind your manners and spend some gold, I don't much care what your story is.
Ugh. This is going to be a five jasmine tea day.\n\nWhat can I help you with?
Look at what the bog dogs dragged in! No offense, but you look like someone who could use some supplies.\n\nTake a look!
My people favor the sword, it's true. But what is the needle if not a tiny blade?\n\nCome! See this swordsman's art!
I know my way around a weapon both by craft and by battle. Trust me, you won't find better anywhere in Blackwood.
Killing an innocent? That's the sort of thing villains do. I won't abide it.
You realize that, while we're wasting time standing around, the fates are conspiring against us?
You come looking for shields, yes? A fine investment, walker. We are too beautiful to be punched in the face!
Tell me, do you really have enough bookcases? I know I don't. I imagine a hero like you stocks whole shelves with journals of past adventures!\n\nSpeaking of past adventures … have a look.
Watch out!
Well done!
Swords and magic boots are all well and good, but I'd trade every bit of steel I carry for a comfortable chair.\n\nHow about you? Looking for something specific?
Ah, yes, I love this vintage. From my family's vineyard, you know.\n\nBut you're here to bank, yes?
You adventurers are a peculiar sort. I assure you that we keep anything you deposit with us both safe and discreet.
Now here's a sight! What do you make of this?
Kha! That bag is smaller than xaht lizard's throat sac. Xaht lizards are, you know … very small.\n\nLet me help.
You'll see more than horses come through here. And I take care of them all.\n\nOf course, a steed's only as strong as its rider. How're you in the saddle?
This is for my brother!
I cannot emphasize this enough: keep your bowstring waxed. Brawlers value strength—true warriors value precision.
Ugh, if I find another dead cricket among these books, I'm going to place a insect ward on this whole building!\n\nSorry. You're here to purchase, right?
A healthy soul is one well cared for. Find fellowship, good food, quiet walks beneath a star-filled sky, and these gems will serve you well.
This book? Ah, just an old list of grudges. What can I say? I'm sentimental.\n\nYou want something?
I glean with my eyes keen … an object that is brown.
You can't run!
<Taunting Roar>
I wonder if your souls are even worth the effort of tearing open your flesh?
I know my beauty is infinite. But, do not gawk for too long.
<massive triumphant roar>
As expected. Nothing matches the power of destruction.
Yes. Yes! Such delicious morsels!
Adventurer, eh? Yeah, me too. This is … you know, it's a temporary thing. Another dozen sales and it's right back to the arse-kicking for this lady!
Feast your eyes upon these, the rarest treasures of Blackwood! Truly, they belong in a fine, well-furnished shop! As do I!
So beautiful! So glorious! Yes, I mean you, my potential customer! Though this one also has these attributes!
Oh, sera. You look depressed! You know what always makes me feel better? Reckless spending!
Bare feet don't stink! Well, unless you've royally stepped in it. And if you have, I can sell you something that will help. Maybe!
You saw the Temple of Zenithar, I'm sure. Everyone sees it. Then falls in love with it. Then leaves you for it. I mean … oh, never mind.\n\nReady to travel when you are!
You're a clever one aren't you?
Now I've got you!
You're planning to eat that, right?
You cannot win! Drown in fire!
I waited for eternity. I can do so for longer.
Hit it again!
Well done!
Block its strike!
The servants of Mehrunes Dagon are mine to command!
The might of Xalvakka overwhelms you!
Am I too much for you? Would you like more?
Strike hard now!
Watch as your companions burn!
Raw strength, that! Wonderful!
Be ready to break free!
You broke loose!
Again! Halt its attack!
Now, press your advantage!
Powerful strike!
Fear not, featherless one! Your shinies are safe with me. Safe, safe!
Looking for a deal? You came to the right crow! Big trades, small trades, good bargains, bad … wait, forget that last one. All good here!
Stibbo kill!
I'm beaten!
There's something wonderful about wandering a city's streets with no destination.
Can I help you with something?
Bilge grubs! Piping hot bilge grubs for sale!
Psijic portals teach us that sometimes the unseen is not something to be feared.
Looks like the ruin just sunk into the ground here.
More corpses! We need more kindling!
No mortal dares approach me!
My collection of mortal bones shall grow this day.
I need something else to kill.
What shall I call forth today?
I hunger for mortal hearts.
Mortal followers. Why does the master need such creatures?
Mehrunes Dagon bring destruction to this world!
My blade yearns for mortal blood!
The Kyn happily serve Mehrunes Dagon.
Everything burns in the name of Mehrunes Dagon!
Mortal soldiers approach. Get ready.
Stay alert. The master demands it.
Dagon is the destroyer, we are but his tools.
Something watches us. Can't you sense it?
Dagon is the fire, Dagon is the flood!
Think you can fight back? Time to collect our due.
Can you please stop trying to kill me for one moment? I just got kicked through a portal!
Help! This shield is taking a lot of concentration!
That was a hassle. Damn monsters took me by surprise. Thank you for taking care of them.
I owe you a debt of gratitude.
Lord Dagon's reign shall never end.
Some new power stirs in the Deadlands … I can sense it.
I grow bored. Give me something to torment.
Xynaa? Yes, she has my loyalty. For now.
This one never counts gold on an empty stomach. Tummy grumbles lead to stumbles, yes?\n\nFor now, Henadi's belly is full. Lucky you!
Stibbo follow!
Stibbo hate wet!
Stibbo wait!
Swinging swords, selling swords … it's all the same in the end. Sore feet and a full coin purse.\n\nSpeaking of coin, what can I get you?
Another world, another conquest for the master.
I can't believe I'm in another old ruin, doing a favor for Quistley.
Let us wash your anger away. Forever.
You pay what I tell you to pay!
Care to see what you'll soon become?
That helped, but there's still something drawing power from the ritual. Let's keep looking!
You'll water my plants with your blood!
No one escapes!
I shall take your skull as a keepsake!
To battle! For Dagon!
You can't stop the flood with a sword!
Fire and flood take you!
Show me your blood, mortal.
Destruction in Dagon's name!
How can you battle disaster, puny mortal?
Feast upon the weak.
Such shimmer! Such shine!
Got something for me? Especially looking for dolls with real hair.\n\nLook, I don't ask questions. People have weird hobbies.
Only I will remain!
Got any silver in that lot you want to sell? Got a buyer.\n\nThen again, I've got a buyer for just about anything!
You're not here for the rabbit, are you? The rabbit's not for sale.\n\nGot plenty of other goods, though, if you're interested.
Most travelers complain about the marshy smell in Gideon. But I can promise, none of my wares have a trace of it.
I erect the spine of welcome to you. I hope you enjoy your time in Gideon, it is a fine place to be.\n\nHow may I help you today, traveler?

You get asked for help a lot, don't you? Me too. And how'd that work out? Just look around.\n\nMy advice? Demand to see the coin up front, and only take jobs from people you can beat in a fist fight, if it comes to it.
If your mount gets frightened, take a good look around. Many of them, from horses to guar, can sense things that you cannot.
Best make our transaction quick. We never know what dangers will seek us out next.
I don't like all this stone. Too dry. I miss the marsh.
I'd offer you a bed, but as you can see, I seem to be displaced. I can offer goods for trade, though.\n\nAnd don't mind me. Our healer insists I rest even with the potions I took.
Bugs and bogs, I'm tired of standing around.
What are the odds I'd find out I had a sister, only to learn the same day that she'd been captured by slavers?
Soon, we will have all that we need.
No! You will not take this power from me!
These sacrifices are weak. They fear death, they do not crave it.
We must be getting close. The spirit approaches.
Fine, Liam can watch you die before he does.
Come forth abomination!
The time of Xalvakka draws near!
I still can't believe I found my way here. I've joined plenty of cults over the years, but I feel like this is the one that can change my life.
A recruit who doesn't ask questions is a recruit who doesn't need answers. Do these socialites know anything about our doctrines?
I wonder if we're lowering our standards too much. Some of the new recruits can't fight worth a lick.
I dreamed of the Kiss of Sithis last night. I think … I think I am ready.
A recruit who doesn't ask questions is a recruit who doesn't need answers. Do these socialites know anything about our doctrines?
Come here! Xeemhok pick teeth with your bones!
You can't stop it …!
This foothold must be secured so the invasion can succeed!
Xigira lured those fools so easily. A little gold does wonders.
Never lose a bet to a performer. I have to juggle at every light between Leyawiin and Gideon!\n\nNow, how may I help you?
Find the Ambitions!
Foolish mortals.
Argonians? Wood elves? Assassins? Is there no end to this rabble?
Curious. Do these mortals not know the meaning of inevitable?
Bah! For this they summoned me?
A great day!
It has begun! Look, we are in the Master's realm!
Look. The Prince's mortal minion has claimed the first of his prizes.
I don't understand why some mortal deserves the great prize.
Lord Dagon will know our dedication.
This one loves the smell of your blood.
This one honors our lord.
I go to the embrace of the Night Mother.
The Night Mother will avenge me!
Care to check my wares? Every coin goes to support Stonewastes.
Ah, yes, this one has wares to sell, though if you wish to sell your own wares, I might just be interested.
You'll find Argonians, Khajiit, and Imperials wandering around these parts.\n\nAnd, if you need one, a bed or provisions here.
Be ready to dodge out of the way if you're heading into battle! Gear up, too. I can help with the latter.
I can sell you all manner of useful items that'll help you beat those perfidious opposing teams!\n\nAnd if anyone around Leyawiin asks after me, please say you never saw me.
Gah. I keep cutting myself on these furnishings. You like sharp things, don't you? Please, take them off my hands. With care.
Just finished stitching up another banner a bit ago, so everything's in stock. Take your pick!
To eat my food, you must savor each morsel mindfully. If you simply gulp it down, you'll miss out on the piquant and well-balanced flavors. Ingesting my fare is a meditative act.
Do you hear these rats are scurrying under the floor? Bah. Where there are dryskins, there are rats. Fitting, I think.
Take my advice, try not to ever cross a follower of Peryite.\n\nDon't ask … you don't want to know. Damned flies.
If I'm going to play teeba-hatsei at the next game in Gideon, I need to practice more!\n\nAnd maybe learn the rules.
My needs are few. The needs of Leyawiin, however, come in many, many barrels.
People around these parts are up to something. Their comings and goings have changed of late, and some folk are behaving oddly.\n\nKeep your guard up.
People forget that when you can see out of a window, others can often see in.\n\nNothing people do in Leyawiin surprises me anymore.
The shadows grow near. She is close.
I can almost hear her song, her rhythm. Mistress, we grow closer to you!
I will become shadow. I will serve her better than her children ever could.
I will be Her loyal servant always.
I offer everything to my mistress, but it is not enough.
Serve Her, be shadows, be dreams coated in darkness.
She will see our dedication, our love.
Our hearts are bound in sorrows, but we will feel her embrace.
Keep to the shadows.
We will have the connection we seek, it is inevitable.
I will serve Her will or I will serve nothing at all.
Should we kill them quickly, or do we have time to play?
I'll bleed you dry!
What do you think you're doing here?
Sometimes Dezirri catches bits of dead people.\n\nThis one is not thrilled with such results.
Either this cart is cursed or someone's playing pranks on us. Damned thing has broken down five times in as many days.
No one must approach the ojel-bak.
You challenge the Toad-Tongues? We crush you!
We hunt today!
Chaos rules the Sul-Xan.
The mud swirls in unusual directions this day.
The crocodiles are plump this season.
I caught three death-hoppers on the hunt.
I make all my own poisons.
This is Sul-Xan territory.
That's done it! Now, destroy the array!
Let the bog dogs roam where they will.
There is a strange scent in the air this day.
When I first came to Leyawiin, I only planned to stay a few days. But after Sai Sahan took care of those Longhouse skeevers, I decided to stay and help keep the place free of them.
People these days are falling away from the worship of the Eight Divines. Though the temple here in Leyawiin usually has good attendance.
Their blood will water the dirt.
They do not work hard enough. We will need more.
The plant sings. I hear the call.
This work requires many hands. We must have more.
Search everywhere! Leave nothing unturned.
An Orc's work is never done.
We will run them into the ground. They must serve our cause.
Kill the ones that work too slowly.
Do they understand their purpose? They cry and wail, but they should be grateful.
The future is bright and twisting, the chaos bleeds.
Move the dead quickly, we must replace them.
The high priest wants them found!
The leaves burn, snakes of black smoke, chaos singed.
Search everywhere. We know they're here!
I can't wait to witness the sacrifice.
The high priest wants us alert.
Lord Dagon, hear our prayers!
How many more do we have coming? We must increase production.
Let the bodies decompose beneath the soil. They will fertilize the plant.
Lord Dagon, empower your faithful!
Don't let your guard down.
I feel the fire of Dagon burning in my soul!
What an honor to be selected for this duty.
Flames … destruction … chaos. All could be yours to control.\n\nNo, not you. You.
Fire and flood protect us!
Those fools opened the way for us!
Destruction fall upon you!
The disaster spares no one.
Why are there mortals in our fortress?
I serve Lord Dagon.
We serve the twins, the rams.
I want to break mortal bones and rend mortal flesh!
We live to serve.
Are mortals really full of blood?
Be ready. The master expects treachery.
Guard these halls with your very existence.
Mortals are such vile creatures.
You have no concept of our mission here.
I'm done with Leyawiin. But I'm going to get good and properly drunk before I leave. It's the least this place can do for me.
Mortals are such vile creatures. They sicken me!
When does the sacrifice begin? I was promised blood.
Working with mortals is insufferable!
Why does Lord Dagon put up with such pitiful creatures?
Your blood shall feed the Razor!
Rise, children of Dagon! Rise!
Watch for spider-sworn. They could be anywhere.
Enough waiting. I say way push those spiders back to the Skein!
Not one spider touches the machine. Understood?
You can never have too many cats. And yet, Leyawiin seems to be more of a dog town. I'm hoping to change that person by person!
Why don't the heroes in books ever get blisters?
I'm always nervous about taking my horse to Altmer lands. I'd hate for him to meet Elven mounts and pick up bad habits.

I'm fresh from the Three Banners War. I worked as both a blacksmith and warrior as needed, but now I've reforged all my weapons into farming implements. \n\nFarming suits me much better. It tends to make me happier too.
You want the truth? The thing I hate most about cheese is that it does terrible things to my digestion.
For the Prince of Destruction!
More kith for the pyre ….
Go for the eyes … all eight of them.
Mother wants the machine. No excuses.
Cleave to the shadows, brood.
The Kyn taste bitter. Where are the mortals? I want something sweet.
No one should ever underestimate the physical strength of a mage. When you spend most of the day practicing spell gestures, your arms get toned!
For Mephala!
Hmm, this cart might need to be retired. It's seen more days of work than most people around here … even the followers of Z'en.
Can you imagine the power we'll wield once we have the relic?
Fire and flood wash over you.
I don't trust anything made by Elves. Especially Wild Elves.
I was hoping to try out this truth serum, but the High Elf spilled everything without a fuss.

Blackwood's servant-class is the worst. They natter on endlessly when I ask them questions, so I must constantly interrupt them to keep them on task!\n\nHonestly, the world would be so much better if people just did what they were told.
Blackwood has some lovely poisons, if you know where to look.
Those Ivory Brigade fools were no match for the Painted Eye.
Ugh. The heat is unbearable!
First time? Get used to it. The councilor comes here often.
What do you suppose Councilor Vandacia is going to do with the prisoner?

Some people think learning magic will give them control over the world, but it merely gives you a different set of tools. You never truly gain control over anything—even yourself. Who chooses to get sick or get older?
We are True Sworn! We are invincible!
When do they let the guests back here?
Did you see what the Daedra eat? Disgusting.
I'm not sure I trust either the Daedra or the cultists.
Orders are to kill anyone who wanders back here.
I'm the high priest's favorite.
Lord Dagon has blessed our holy mission.
Was this what you imagined when you joined the order?
I owed the Wood Elf and her friends. They killed my brother at the vault.
If you see anyone you don't recognize, kill them.
Welcome to Zenithar's chapel. Take a moment to admire the beauty that Saint Kaladas wrought with his skills.

Some days I regret coming here for work. Everyone is so concerned about their appearance. My current client wants a potion that will remove his wrinkles.\n\nTo me, wrinkles are a sign of a life well lived.

Before you ask, yes, I really am a Dark Elf.\n\nI've had my fill of the Tribunal. The prophet Veloth spoke of sacred toil, fortitude, triumph in the face of hardship. I ask you, who embodies these virtues better than Zenithar? No one!

Ah, hello, my friend! You have sand on your boots and the smell of moon-sugar cakes wafting in your wake. Have you been adventuring in Elsweyr recently? I have a gift for you, courtesy of the Impresario, if so! A suitable reward for your adventures!

Oh, my friend! You have the ruffled look of one who has been on a great adventure, and, I say this with great respect, you smell like you've been dragged through a sewer. You've been visiting strange lands in accordance with our notice, haven't you?
Mortals have no place in the Deadlands.
Hey, no licking toads on watch! Who knows when those brigade losers try making a move.
Soak you in spit!
Crush you like falling boulder!
I'd love to try picking off a few over the wall, but the boss says not to provoke them.
Break you to pieces!
Burn! In! Flames!
Hard to believe there's something of such value under this drab keep.
Hah! What would happen if they actually meet our demands?
I didn't expect this little ruse to work as well as it did. The boss really is a genius.
If you get stopped by an Argonian and an Orc who say they're looking for someone, please tell them to head to Solitude. \n\nThey've been following me for weeks. I only just gave them the slip again.
What have you got against livestock?
You will not escape this place.
I wish I could live somewhere where nothing happens. Just a simple, uneventful town in a boring place, with boring people and no excitement whatsoever.\n\nIs that so much to ask?
Burn the sky! Burn it all!
Chaos take you!
Fools! Your bones will melt!
You can't stop chaos!
Marvelous! Xalvakka sends her reinforcements!
The rest shall fall after you!
No!
You're better off not asking a lot of questions of the people around here. Just a bit of friendly advice. It might save you a few bruises … or fingers.
I can't take much more of this!
You are too late.
You challenge Flame-Herald Bahsei? I happily oblige.
You are no match for the forces of chaos!
Fight my brothers!
You do not belong here.

Leyawiin is a nice enough place. I'm more curious about the architecture of its chapel, though. Some people believe Saint Kaladas performed a miracle when building it.\n\nTo me, it looks like a well-built, non-miraculous structure.
You can't take another hit!
Right here, partner!
Yes? What do you want?
Sure. What do you want to know?
Well, that sounds ominous. Is something bothering you?
I've had some mage training, so I'm pretty handy with a destruction staff. I'm also a decent sword and board man. You know, one-handed weapon and shield?
Discuss? You mean you'll tell me what you want me to do, while I nod in agreement?
What's the plan?
As Lord Silvelle was fond of saying, routine is the enemy of progress.
I'd be very grateful if you let me be.
No one reveres the gods as they should. Not even Lakmargo. We all have much to learn.
Why live in Leyawiin, you ask? Why not, I say! \n\nThe people here might think too highly of themselves, but the food is good, the spirits are excellent, and there's no war here.

The Leyawiin Fighters Guild has many honored traditions. For instance, those who seek to join need to find and kill a certain number of vermin before they can be accepted.\n\nOur definition of vermin is quite broad, thankfully.
What constitutes as mead around here is a vile insult to all Nords. What do they do to their bees? Feed them moon sugar?

If you ever want to brush up on your fighting skills, you'll find plenty of willing participants around Leyawiin. Lots of retired soldiers around here. \n\nDoesn't matter where your loyalties are, long as you have coin to spend.
We form a family of our own here in Leyawiin, composed of people from every alliance and every land.\n\nWhile we do have our differences, the defense and care of our city keeps us together.
Traffic in and out of Leyawiin these days is … interesting. Something's definitely up. I just don't know what.\n\nWatch your back.
I found a strange sphere in the fireplace last week. It stays warm and feels good in my hands. I'm keeping it.\n\nNo, it's not an egg.
The Ivory Brigade is the finest group you'll find in all of Tamriel. Most of them served in the Three Banners War, but a few joined up just by word of mouth.
Some of the noble class here in Leyawiin lack even basic empathy. They are so concerned with their grand feasts and lavish displays of wealth, they forget to show kindness to others.

The secret to my success as a soldier? I keep my gear in order and I train every day.\n\nIf you don't do either of those things, I can assure you that you won't last long enough to set foot in Cyrodiil.

Archery? Eh, just a hobby. I'm a potter by trade.\n\nMost of the time, there's more money in clay than there is in blood. All that business in Cyrodiil, though? Who knows. Maybe I should make a career change after all.

I once served as a guard here in Leyawiin. But my calligraphy skills grew to a point where I eventually was able to pursue a new life.\n\nStill, I sometimes walk the paths I once patrolled in order to clear my mind.
Sometimes you need to hide out in a nice, safe place.\n\nAnd sometimes you need to hide out here.
Darkness lurks in the swamps, walker. Not just slimes and undead. Something from a distant place …. Something that will set our world ablaze.
I've been compiling my research into Argonian culture for almost a decade. Every time I think I'm finished, I learn something new. Hopefully I'll be able to share my work soon.

I actually made the instrument our bard here is playing. I even went to Leyawiin to get the materials blessed before I began my work. \n\nI figure having Saint Kaladas's touch on my creations adds a certain resonance.
I've been fishing all over Tamriel, picking up local customs where I can. Right now, I'm learning spear fishing, which requires a certain amount of stealth. Or so the Argonians tell me.
One of the more dangerous creatures out in the marsh right now are those gigantic frogs, the Death Hoppers.\n\nCan you imagine those things in a vossa-satl? The size it would need to be!
The Ayleid ghosts in my house won't let me sleep. They scratch all night in the walls and refuse to give me even a moments rest!\n\nI wish they'd just go away.
You'll occasionally find the camps of Daedric cultists out in the marsh. I tend to avoid them. I had a run-in with Sheogorath once, and that was more than enough for me.
It's comforting to have the Ebonheart pact war hero in Gideon. Keshu the Black Fin has done a great job here. We're proud to have her.

After serving as a brigade in Leyawiin, Gideon seems … slower and more peaceful in comparison. There's more respect among all the races here.\n\nI think Keshu the Black Fin has a great deal to do with it.
A skillful victory. You have mastered your opponent.
The warrior who has never been defeated is the warrior who has never truly fought.
Dueling never determines who is right, only who is left.
Work with me!
I can suffer fools, dull blades, bland food, and miserable weather. But you … you are testing my patience.
Our tribe of late feels so divided. I hope we can come back together, but I've hoped that for a while now.
We always have more than we need here. Giving it to those who could use it is a simple enough task.
Best if I keep my thoughts to myself right now. I don't want to argue.
I agreed to work with you, not flatter you. If you want false admiration, it will cost extra.
You're affable enough. Just be honest with me and we'll get along fine.
I've always tried to look for the best in people. It's good to find it every now and then.
Until I met you my life was tedious and uneventful. But now I feel the inexplicable need to endanger myself. Isn't that strange?
I have never met someone braver or more true. I'm proud to call you friend.
I respect that, and I completely understand. The last thing I want to do is ruin our friendship.
I … I didn't see this coming. I'm surprised, but very happy!
You'll always be my dear friend. Maybe it was a mistake to turn it into something more.
Apologies, friend, for our current state. Those who took the keep did not have good intentions regarding us.
You broke the spell!
Some say that the Mages Guild is just a fancy book club. A club with some very dangerous books, if you ask me.
Magical places are always so beautiful and inspiring. Well, most of them, anyway.

While I'm starting to miss Leyawiin, I'm not missing the decadence of the nobles there. After that last gathering I was hired on to gatekeep, I never want to see a piece of cheese again.\n\nDamned Sheogorath cultists. Glad they mysteriously vanished.
Regardless of what's going on here, I prefer being out from behind the walls to do my scouting. I was a hunter before I signed on to watch the border here.
Come on then, we fight!
The mortals! Take them down!

Oy, this person won't stop asking me questions. Why do I eat only meat? How do I stomach being around those who eat plants? What am I doing at Borderwatch?\n\nI'd ask her why she's asking me so many questions, but she won't let me actually talk!
The voracious appetite that Imperials have regarding land makes no sense to me.\n\nPerhaps if I understood it better, I could help them see our point of view as well.
I'd have never thought that being sent to Gideon for supplies would end up with us stuck outside our current assignment.\n\nPerhaps I shouldn't have stayed up so late while I was there.
I don't know what the Argonians plant around here, but it's in my nose and eyes, and I hate it.
They come to stop us!
Flames for my fellow Sul-Xan!
Be healed … and avenge me!
You know what I think?
Oh, hello there! What are you?
Can you smell that? Weakness ….
We were summoned to serve, and so we shall.
I sacrifice myself to our victory ….
You are outclassed and outmatched, mortal flea!
You've done better than I expected.
So close, yet ever so far.
Mortals never cease to amaze me.
That device belonged to the master!
I work for Governor Keshu. We're talking to all of the independent Argonian tribes, cataloging them and recording their particular customs and beliefs.\n\nIt's fascinating work!
The dryskin asks a great many questions. I do want to be helpful. So I, in turn, make up a great many answers.
Why hasn't this day ended yet …? Why?
By Azura! By Azura! By Azura! I can't believe this. Is it really you?
There's no hiding from the eye of the inevitable.
Strangers come and go all the time. Why those who have no interest in Sithis approach this shrine, I do not know.\n\nPerhaps they seek to understand chaos, but that is a futile activity.
This shrine welcomes all who seek the wisdom and guidance of Sithis.\n\nJust don't go near the place of old stones. Just don't.
We offer this sacrifice to the tide of chaos!
I won't abandon ever my post, sire … ever.
I heard rumors about this place being haunted or cursed or some such before I came out here.\n\nThat's all nonsense, of course. People get so dramatic when they think they know better than you.
I admit that I'm considering leaving. Perhaps I should have paid heed to my egg-kin when they told me something was out of harmony here.
Mmmrph help! Merrrph.
It was good that you came to help me, I didn't want to be in there any longer than I was.
I came all the way to Leyawiin to compete. I know I didn't have to, but these local teams need to see the majesty of a Nord in action!
Given a choice, Fire Drakes are my team. Because I did have a choice, here I am!\n\nThough I didn't expect to end up so close to the Three Banners War.

Some participants chatter around and talk about how good their team is. I'd rather spend that time practicing, eating, or sleeping.\n\nDedication. Discipline. That's what it takes to be the best Storm Lord member. Now, please excuse me.
Hmmm … the other writers I talked to last year said to avoid the word "moist" in my stories, but that's really all I have left for this passage.\n\nRomantic scenes are so challenging!

How is it that I venture out to embrace being alone in the world, yet someone comes up to talk to me now?\n\nAfter I lost my tribe and Hist Tree, I spent awhile trying to find a place to live, and it was as if I didn't exist.
A wait now for action later. Lord Dagon makes good on his promises.
Dagon strike you down!
Working with others is something I am unaccustomed to.
You dare interfere with our work?
Now, daylight, that's when I should get all the praise. But do I? No! Because no one credits me for any of my work.
Aren't you foolish.
Hmmmph. No sooner does one person tire of my company than another appears.\n\nPerhaps you'll be quieter than the one who talked incessantly about heroics?
No one told me this work would involve so many stairs.
Face my fire, coward!
One of the sacrifices says to me the other day, that he wants to go free because he has a clutch of eggs back in a neighboring tribe. The nerve on that one. Can you imagine?
Chaos take you.
No one understands, but in time they will see.
Be silent!
Our lands are lush with chaos and ripe for the harvest.
Fight on!
How much longer will this take?
Don't save your strength.
It's amazing how you make all those traps in such short time. Pssh. Stupid spineless hatchlings. I make them beforehand.
Finally, prey worthy of my skills.
Can't stay here too long. Need more fletching.
Die!
With this power at my claws, I will bring destruction to any one who stands in my way.
My spine will not bend to you.
Finally, something to burn.
Rocks. Stone. Molten rivers. No difference.
Intruder!
I wanted to be the one to deal with the sacrifices.
I'm looking for a challenge, don't be disappointing.
No complaints here. Waiting around gives me time to make sure my blades are sharpened.
You're out numbered here.
There are vermin everywhere, even here.
Dagon notice my prowess.
The others get to exalt Dagon in the Deadlands, why do I have to remain here?
Give me your life or I'll take it.
Bahsei's plans draw us ever closer to the Lord of Blood and Flames.
Foul stinking creatures, you cannot hide from me.
You'd think the prisoners would give up on mercy already. We've slaughtered enough for that.
My blade thirsts for your blood.
That fool thinks I'll believe that was just a prank. A prank? My tail that was a prank. When I'm through with him ….
I'll cut you down.
I was hoping you'd ask! I think we're a great match.
These mortals keep approaching me and asking for armor. As if their fragile skeletons wouldn't crumble under the weight alone.
I'll grind you to a paste.
These mortals better be right about feeding Xalvakka all those souls, otherwise I'm going to burn them all myself.
You will die choking on the smoke of your own body.
I've seen toothless wamasu with gums sharper than some of those mortal's swords!
No one's landed a blow against me in eons!
You see? Anything is possible with a positive outlook. I never doubted the outcome!
This one has fortunes if you have coin.\n\nAll divinations subject to interpretation, of course.
My tutors liked to tell me that words and stories are a form of magic. If you put them together properly, you can weave entire worlds!
Magic is like strong wine. If you're not used to it, it can make you drunk.
I wouldn't want to live in a world without magic. That would be a world without mystery and a world without faith.
The greatest secrets are always hidden in the most unlikely places.
Killing robbers is a chore that must be done regularly. Like taking out the trash.
What turns someone into a cultist? Is it just the desire to watch the world burn?
I despise cheese. It smells awful. It tastes awful. Do you have any idea where cheese comes from and how it's made?
Violence is a hunger that can never sated. Don't go down that road.
What gives you the right to steal from others?
There's no shame in having once been a thief. The sin is remaining a thief.
I've had enough. You're on your own!
Let me rest a minute. My feet are barking!
I like campfires. They attract interesting people.
I love fine art. It lets you find yourself and lose yourself at the same time.
Rooms without books are like bodies without souls.
There's psijic energy here.
Getting soaked alone is miserable. Getting soaked with a friend is an adventure.
Hello, what's this?
When you stop learning, you stop growing. I don't intend to ever stop learning.
You think that little toy will save you?
Taking risks has consequences. So does not taking risks.
There is no shame in declaring a draw.
I'm not trained to use this, but I do like a challenge!
Now you're just showing off!
The only shame in getting knocked down is in not getting back up!
You need to keep moving!
What sorcery is this?
You lost your pet!
Careful! That one looks dangerous.
That's the kind of beast that scares other monsters!
Underestimating you was their last mistake.
That's how we do things in Daggerfall!
Oh, that's it. Much better!
It's do or die! Use a stamina potion!
You've got no power left! Use a potion!
Never underestimate the power of a group working together!
If we start this, we'd better be prepared to finish it!
What do Dragons want with gold, anyway? They don't need to buy anything.
I like to think fate puts us in dark places because it's our job to be a light there.
This looks ominous.
Practice makes the master.
Ah, this place brings back memories.
I have a gift for you. A keepsake.
This is for you. In token of our shared travels.
I'd like for you to have this.
Let's hit the trail.
Neat trick.
Who's this, now?
There's my little friend!
That's some impressive magic!
Looks like we've got a party!
You seem to be respectable again. I think you got away with it this time.
Now you've done it!
Well, at least you didn't steal it yourself!
That should come in handy.
Nice haul!
Good eye!
Anything useful?
Begone, undead traveler. Let this living host be free of your blight.
Grandmother? Not again. Go back to your grave!
What's on the docket today?
They're coming for us!
Whew, that was a bit of a warm up.
Three alive! Why?
There's stopping to smell the flowers and then there's taking root.
Traveling with you isn't a tour, it's a tale!
Maybe we should hire you into the family business. You've got a knack for this.
If you're hungry we can find a tavern.
The House of Histories! I was told not to miss this! It is the home of the beautiful and priceless mural known as Rithana-di-Renada. In common speech, "The Song of Kingdoms."
Khajiit of the Moons. It's one of the great treasures of Elsweyr. Tragic that it was so badly damaged, but you can tell it was restored with great care.
Ahh! Fetch ….
What do you say we try some of the local fare? I'm famished.
Problem, sera?
This hit list looks more like a pranksters planner than a thief's to-dos. Could be fun though.
Interesting how much clutter people had thousands of years ago, isn't it? Guess some things never change.
Building such an accurate model must have been a huge undertaking. Well, a very small, huge undertaking.
The Vault of Moawita. This is where the Psijic Order keeps the most dangerous of items locked away!
Oh good, you've dutifully murdered another person for your death cult. I'm so happy for you.
That mount of yours can sure move. I might need to new one soon.
I wonder where the rest of the family is right now. We're a bit of a far flung brood. Hopefully they're in good company.
There has got to be a better source for your alchemy practice.
You'll pay for that your rotten fetchers!
I'm losing blood!
Hang in there!
Feeling chatty are we?
What?
What would you like to know?
I hope this is a good talk.
I'm an archer by training, so I try to stay at range. Up close, I'm pretty handy with a dagger, but I prefer my bow.
As street fights go, that one was pretty good!
Did that hurt? It looked like it hurt. You … want a hug?
All right, who did you offend?
Here, let's combine strengths!
I only stopped giving you nasty looks because you've already got one.\n\nLet's do the job and go our separate ways.

Since when have you cared what I think? Seems like you're just going to do what you like anyway, so why bother talking about it.\n\nLet's just get back to work and at least make this arrangement profitable.
You're an effective adventurer, I'll give you that, but let's just keep thing professional. It's better that way.
You're a pretty good adventuring partner, I'd say. Reliable. Agreeable. No complaints.
I trust you. I don't trust many people outside of my immediate family. I hope you'll stick with me, through thick and thin.
Gods, am I that awkward? I know I'm not great at expressing my feelings, but there's no need for doubt. I can't think of anyone I'm closer to, even my family.
Your … weirdness? Seems to be compatible with mine. That's never happened. It scares me a little.
Maybe that's for the best. We are adventuring partners. Romance could make it very messy. Working separately is probably the only reason why my parents lasted this long.
If you really want to try this again, I'm willing. But if you hurt me, it will be the last time.
You're breaking it off? Am I that fetching bad …?\n\nI'm going to need some time to think about this.
That got them off balance!
I'd really love to study those Dolmens, if they'd ever stop getting pulled into Coldharbour.
Sotha Sil built this place and everything in it. Except the people. Well, maybe even a few of them too by the look.
Well, hah, this—this is a first. Hey! No smirking. My family obligations never left me much opportunity for courtship. I expect you to make up for lost time.
Now here's a place I can really get some study done. Or killed. Either really.
I didn't know you were interested in that genre? I'll have to remember that.
My favorite cure for low-spirits!
So Orsinium really got Orcs to care about history? That is impressive.
I can't believe you just waltz up to a god for a bit of conversation like it's nothing. I don't know whether to be impressed or tell the ordinators.
Ugh, Goblins. They eat anything you know? Anything.
I. Hate. Snakes.
Are these all real instruments? There must be a reason you don't hear many of them these days.
Well played, master thief.
Oh, fetch off!
Smoke, ash, and fire. Just like home.
A Daedric pet? I wonder, do Daedra keep pets? And I don't just mean things they've enslaved.
I shouldn't be here. And I definitely don't want to be!
I love learning something new.
Really? You're going to fight them? Right here?
Talk about evenly matched!
So, do I get to practice first, or ….
Flashy may get noticed, but style gets remembered!
Back on your feet!
Try breaking free!
Don't panic! We can do this!
I hope I fare better ….
Maybe we should get some help?
Couldn't leave that walking around wreaking havoc, right?
That one put up a fight, didn't they?
You're like a legend of Vehk!
Thanks! I was feeling that.
You're getting winded!
Quick, drink a magicka potion!
Well, that was intense.
A fetching Dragon? Really?
Dragon slayer does have a nice ring to it.
I hope we find more than trouble here.
There's trouble brewing here. Stay alert!
Mother Morrowind has her eye on you.
This is the spot I've been looking for.
My family deals in collectibles, and this reminded me of you, so—here.
I thought you might like a keepsake. For when we're traveling separate paths.
I know there's no occasion, but I wanted to give you this.
Off we go!
Do that again!
Hello, little one!
There's my favorite! What a sweetheart!
I knew it! This is the way you really look, isn't it?
The coast is clear. Finally.
Just don't expect me to bail you out.
Good eye! I never would have spotted that!
Can never have enough of that.
Looks like you're buying at the next pub, f'lah!
Wow! You don't come by those too often.
Quite a bounty! Glad I don't have to carry it.
Namira notice you! I almost had control. You will pay for this!
You were always my least favorite grandchild. Will you not allow me to enjoy my afterlife?
Where am I? Oh, hmm. I believe I have made an error in joining you on your quest. I'd hoped to leave with someone more daring. Terribly sorry.
All right, calm down! I didn't leave you for that long. Honestly you'd think you lot had forgotten how to forage.
Oh, your sense of style is uniquely eye catching. Would you be willing to assist me?
My love, what do you think?
I do miss Lady Laurent, but this is a welcome respite. Me, a guest? I never imagined!

Lady Laurent can be demanding, but she's a good mistress. In fact, she relies upon me for so many things. Cooking, cleaning, taking notes, handling travel arrangements, carefully investigating cursed objects. The latter? More often than you'd expect.
I could use a strong cup of tea. Maybe with a dash of Daggerfall brandy.\n\nOn second thought, I'm on holiday! Skip the tea. I'll just have the brandy.
Ah, friend! So good to see you again!\n\nIsn't it strange to meet without the penetrating gaze of Lady Laurent watching our every move? Yes, yes. I miss her, too!

Do you remember our adventure atop Sorrow? With the Orcs, and the ice, and the snow? \n\nIt took me months to feel warm and comfortable again. And that was after I finally got out of that block of ice!
Let's not dwell on that time I was an egg. It was so dark and cramped in there!\n\nNow, these accommodations are much more comfortable, but there was a certain peacefulness inside that shell.

Once again, you and Lady Laurent came to my rescue! I'm still finding bits of goo in the most uncomfortable places.\n\nCan you believe that m'lady told me she misses the duplicates? If I thought she was serious, I'd be jealous!
Oh, don't mind me. Just having a look about. Making note of any valuables, number of doors and windows—like Seeks taught me.\n\nJust for practice, honest!
Want to do a little dicing? I need to practice palming the loaded ones between turns.\n\nWhat? I'll let you win some of the time.
Did I ever tell you I found a piece of that Ayleid whatchawhoozit lodged in the seat of my britches after we delivered it? Hope the client didn't need it.
Remember that time we rescued Seeks from Blackrose Prison? I make sure he does every chance I get. I think he's pretending not to hear now.

Ever have a loose hair that's brushing up against your arm or whatever, but you can't find it? That's what it was like after you freed me from Eton Nir. Except they were everywhere.\n\nStill freaks me out whenever I walk into a spider's web.
So many tributes to violence. Did you know Old Orcish has no word for patience? The closest word literally means sedated.
The House of Orsimer Glories? Is it a joke that it's practically empty?
Did you steal all this stuff while I was with you? That really would be impressive.
For a Thieves Guild there isn't much of a treasure trove. Maybe you could steal something to gussy it up.
I can't believe they actually completed a scale model of the entire island. It's so detailed!
What's this? Some kind of exhibit? Looks incomplete.
I know the Vault of Moawita is supposed to be keeping all these cursed objects from doing harm, but is gathering them all here really safe?
I've heard of this place. The Vault of Moawita. But it shouldn't be empty! Something's very wrong.
An ancient mural chronicling the original sixteen united kingdoms of Elsweyr. It's quite remarkable.
This House of Histories seems to be in need of some talented collectors.
I would have loved to see that tapestry when it was new, but the restoration really is beautiful.
Senchal was one of the richest and most historic kingdoms in Tamriel. It's painful to see it reduced to such a state.
Wow, you really can make music from anything.
Always tip bards. They decide who the villains are.
You dare? Merging the realms is delicate work. One mistake and both could be destroyed!
[fast, manic gibbering]
Experience the thaumaturgical prowess of a master!
I offer no mere prestidigitation. \n\nCurated magical sensations for people of all nations for only a modicum of monetary demarcation.
Master, the Nirn invasion has begun.
I smell mortals! Quick, send me into battle.
I wish to fight for my Prince!
Bring this world to its knees!
Destron's power is mine! You will die by his hand!
Rude, rude, rude! Showing up unannounced. But I love a good surprise! Do you?
It's over? Already? Well, that's just disappointing.
The torture here must have been marvelous to watch.
Take care handling the agonymium stones. They thirst for mortal suffering.
Finally! I can burn someone!
Burn for Dagon!
Has the Battlespire stooped to hiring mercenaries, Martus? Or did you run away from there too?
I am reborn! A force that will sunder this world! Bow down and you may yet be spared!
No, no. I can't have you all die on me. Where would be the fun in that?
Why have you offered these pathetic mortals to squander my power on?
They watch! They see every time I look away! Away!
When I move, he moves. What magic is this?
And we're off! Don't worry about me, I can keep up.
Even the newest hatchling knows not to drink that way!
Stand your ground! The storm is coming!
Get ready! Here they come!
To work, comrades.
Hold the line, brigadines, and build a wall with their bodies!
Hello.
Hail!
Hmm?
Please!
I'm desperate.
Spare some gold?
Well?
Yes?
You look like someone I lost.
You scared me!
There is much to be done.
Can I help you?
These are calming waters.
Oh, hello.
Well?
Hello.
Greetings!
Leave me be.
Hmm?
Yes?
Pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Salutations.
So much to do, so little time.
I don't have to explain myself to you.
Are you lost?
Do you need something?
Yes?
On your way.
You look … well supplied.
Be on your guard.
What is it?
Yes?
Not much of a catch today.
Life is amazing, isn't it?
It's too bright out.
Hello.
You're not suspicious at all.
Hello.
Is there something you wanted?
Hmm?
Why are you talking to me?
I haven't warmed up yet!
Fortune smiles on those who are generous.
Yes?
Got better things to do?
Greetings!
Hello.
Fresh faces are a welcome sight.
Hmph.
Pardon me.
My apologies.
I'd like you to leave.
The temple doors are always open.
I have a lot of errands to complete.
I am quite busy.
I beg your pardon.
Is there something you wanted?
Do you need something?
You're a welcome distraction.
Bother someone else.
Oh, hello.
Greetings!
Hello to you too!
Good to meet you.
A thousand apologies.
What do you want?
Salutations.
Yes?
Not now.
What is it?
Hello.
You're an appealing sight.
Are you here to make a report?
You're new.
You better not scare the fish.
Are you here to help me?
What do you want? Have you made up your mind yet? I haven't—er, sorry. I need to remember to be more polite. Customers don't like to be rushed.\n\nI'm afraid I'm new at this.
It's not boasting if you're right.
Press forward, honored beeko. The Winds will carry you.
Voss! See if you can match wits with the great Meer-Ta.
They go no further!
You think yourself some sort of hero?
Many cautioned me when I revealed my love for Xyria. They said she was a demon, incapable of such emotions … that she would use my feelings to manipulate me.
Move, now!
Can you feel it? The palpable dread?
Drown in their fear!
I'll handle the atronach! Kill that damn mage!
Get behind me! I can block that energy!
Drawing out pain and fear? My talents have never been more suited to a task.
Cower before the Waking Flame!
Don't let the Daedra have all the fun!
Don't let the Crimson Oath act like our betters. They are brute killers, nothing more.
For the glory of the clan!
Why does Lord Dagon entrust the construction to these fool mortals?
Kill!
Kill. Flay! Kill!
These Waking Flame have their uses. Submission, for one.
We are the Crimson Oath. We are Dagon's most trusted. Not them.
Submit, creature.
You won't disturb the Lord's ambitions!
I never aim for anything vital. I like to watch them writhe.
Bored, bored, bored. Why couldn't I have been summoned somewhere more interesting?
Oh, I'm going to hurt you so much.
About time we got someone to kill!
I'm looking forward to stomping all over you!
Feel that?
Kiss my boot!
Quit running!
Out of my way!
You'll feel this in your bones!
They're tougher than they look.
Biting off more than you can chew, Eliam? No surprise there.
The light playing tricks on you?
Scintillating, isn't it?
Seeing double, double?
You were deemed worthy bearers of these artifacts. Prove it so!
You have mastered your artifacts well, bearers.
Wait — it's you?\n\nOf all the weavings between Oblivion and Nirn, mortal, there can be none so entwined as my path and yours.
You seem familiar. Have we met before, little mortal? Yes, I think we have.\n\nMust I be burdened with yet another torture in this despicable tower of lies?
Greetings.
There's a discharge labrum there. We need to find and charge some lucents!
There are two other discharge labrums. If we can find another lucent, we might be able to ignite the furnace.
Oh! You're back? Our informants had some great things to say about your performance on that one. Were you able to accomplish your task?

Be careful out there. The Gleaners prioritize items of value, yes, but there's nothing more valuable than an experienced adventurer returning unharmed.\n\nOr, at least not so harmed that they can't bring back the items of value.
Ooh! A capable adventurer looking for work? Hey, do you want to travel the planes and retrieve items of import for the Gleaners? It'll be fun!
Sorry, I'm fresh out of assignments for the day. Stop by tomorrow. I should have something for you then.
You came back? I'm impressed. Or, I will be if you actually did it. So tell me, adventurer, is it finished?
The Saraathu Tong pays for one former adventurer to loiter in the streets talking to strangers. That person is me. Why don't you get on with your job.
The Saraathu Tong only employs those who aren't afraid of some cross planer travel or a little dismemberment. Interested?
The Saraathu Tong isn't giving out any contracts right now. Sate your blood-lust somewhere else while you still can.
Pulverized!
You are skilled to have struck this far into our stronghold, but this is where your limits will be laid bare.
Bear witness to the strength of Oblivion!
Face me, coward!
Observe, the master stroke.
Nowhere is beyond the reach of my blade!
Silver Rose! Press the attack!
You think you control these powers? How quaint.
Allow me to break his shield!
You were barely a test of my strength.
Be careful about what you touch in here. \n\nThe Witchmothers aren't very forthcoming about their possessions. If you're not sure about something, I'd suggest leaving it alone.
This one does not know if the Witchmothers have ever had an Alfiq in their coven. It seems rather unlikely.\n\nIf that is true, Vanima intends to be the first.
You—you won't keep me down long!
We are divided, divided!
Only the Silver Rose have proven worthy of keeping such powerful items in our care.
Of course the peasants were overwhelmed by such power.
Do not fear Oblivion, for it is ours to command.
You will not defy our power.
So loud … in my head!
I'm ready to face anything.
What's on the docket today?
Never thought I'd set up shop in a Breton seaport, clear on the other side of Tamriel from Orsinium. Life can take strange turns.\n\nSo, what can I do for you?
I assume you have accomplished great deeds. I have crafted many impressive feats myself. If you desire furnishings of a darker sort, you're welcome to view my accomplishments.
Greetings, newcomer. Care to step out of the open and buy an elixir?
Protect your puny little vitals with real armor, not any of that stuff your kind makes on Nirn.
I don't miss those mud-caked peasants.
One day, the Silver Rose will possess the strength to claim the Battlespire for ourselves.
The Prior's Divine work gives me chills. Imagine, dethroning the feared Princes of Oblivion!
You won't find me leaping at the chance to deal with the House of Troubles, I can tell you that.
I'm just saying, shouldn't the spoils of a raid go to those who plundered it?
I'd rather be a bearer than a shaper, but I won't complain either way.
Every day these relics grow in power. Thanks to the Prior's wisdom.
Observe the Prior's teachings and you have nothing to fear.
Do not touch these relics unless you are told.
The Prior had entrusted us with this duty. Live up to his expectations.
I have nice weapons. Do you have the coin to pay for them?
Yes yes. I'm sure it'll be a pleasure doing business. Now, how much are you entrusting to me?
Coals on my threshold and coins in my care. Which do you want?
Keep your fingers off my metalwork and we will get along just fine.
I'll make you a deal. If you give me coin, I'll let you purchase one of my brews.
I know your face. Have you bought something from me? Or did I know you when I was corporeal?\n\nNo, that's not it. You're going to buy something soon. A washtub blueprint. I think.
What do we have in here today? A little of this, a little of that!
Let's play pin the tail on—you!
There, back to your usual primitive, animal existence.
I invited some guests myself. Hope you don't mind!
Some weather we're having, eh?
Let me introduce you to a good friend of mine! They'll have you in stitches in no time!
Ooo, I think that one's ham and cheese!
I can see you're ready for an adventure. Care to try one of my recipes?
Look at these garments. Beauties, every one of them. Much better than what your clumsy mortal fingers can make.
I will devour the souls of all your loved ones, Kalmur!
Your service to Lord Dagon is no longer required.
Quench the earth's hunger with your bones!
This mortal power does not sustain! I need more!
Enchantments are my specialty. Guaranteed to hold power for as long as you're alive. Probably could serve your … descendants well too.
It is safer for everyone now that mortals control the food supply here in Fargrave. The things Darzha sells are much safer to ingest. Trust him.
M'aiq once believed that living in a single dwelling would lack variety. But now that he has seen this one, M'aiq thinks that perhaps he was wrong.

Lady Laurent can be demanding, but she's a good mistress. In fact, she relies upon me for so many things. Cooking, cleaning, taking notes, handling travel arrangements, carefully investigating cursed objects. The latter? More often than you'd expect.
I could use a strong cup of tea. Maybe with a dash of Daggerfall brandy.\n\nOn second thought, I'm on holiday! Skip the tea. I'll just have the brandy.

You are a gracious companion, five-claw, who has found M'aiq in all his favorite places. Now allow M'aiq to repay you with the continuous pleasure of his company!\n\nNo need to thank this one. M'aiq likes it here. But you are very welcome!

Do you remember our adventure atop Sorrow? With the Orcs, and the ice, and the snow? \n\nIt took me months to feel warm and comfortable again. And that was after I finally got out of that block of ice!
Let's not dwell on that time I was an egg. It was so dark and cramped in there!\n\nNow, these accommodations are much more comfortable, but there was a certain peacefulness inside that shell.

Once again, you and Lady Laurent came to my rescue! I'm still finding bits of goo in the most uncomfortable places.\n\nCan you believe that m'lady told me she misses the duplicates? If I thought she was serious, I'd be jealous!
Greetings, stork-legged giant! Yes, this nest is a fitting place for me to train. A crucible from which will rise Sir Caw—Gallant Knight of Pinfeathers!

Lady Laurent can be demanding, but she's a good mistress. In fact, she relies upon me for so many things. Cooking, cleaning, taking notes, handling travel arrangements, carefully investigating cursed objects. The latter? More often than you'd expect.
I could use a strong cup of tea. Maybe with a dash of Daggerfall brandy.\n\nOn second thought, I'm on holiday! Skip the tea. I'll just have the brandy.

Your service to the Court is the stuff of legends! One day they will speak my name with such reverence. Squire Caw, the cat-slayer! Squire Caw, the hoard plunderer! Squire Caw, champion of quill and talon! Ha!\n\nCorn-farmers take heed. I am coming!

That Peddler of Prizes! Says I should give up my dream of knighthood and commit to real crow-work. Says I should hoard carrion, hide silver, and harass stray cats. But no. No! I am called to a higher purpose!\n\nVillainous dogs and vile rats, beware!
Let's not dwell on that time I was an egg. It was so dark and cramped in there!\n\nNow, these accommodations are much more comfortable, but there was a certain peacefulness inside that shell.

Once again, you and Lady Laurent came to my rescue! I'm still finding bits of goo in the most uncomfortable places.\n\nCan you believe that m'lady told me she misses the duplicates? If I thought she was serious, I'd be jealous!

I trained with the Battlespire since I was ten years old. I've been on the path toward war for so long I never considered another. It's my duty to fight, because I can. I just need to figure out what I'm really fighting for.
Want to do a little dicing? I need to practice palming the loaded ones between turns.\n\nWhat? I'll let you win some of the time.
I'm haunted by the things we saw in the Dread Cellar. I wasn't present when those atrocities were happening … but Martus was. That's why he had to pay.

It's been quiet since we left the Dread Cellar. Too quiet. I thought the Battlespire would put a bounty on me if nothing else, but that threat has yet to materialize. Surely Martus told them about my desertion.

Ever have a loose hair that's brushing up against your arm or whatever, but you can't find it? That's what it was like after you freed me from Eton Nir. Except they were everywhere.\n\nStill freaks me out whenever I walk into a spider's web.
Ah, yes. Another mortal who wants something. I guess I can set aside what I was doing.

It's good to see a mortal face. A Xivilai just tried to threaten me. To what point, I couldn't say—I'm already dead, after all.\n\nIn any event, my wares are too good to be given away for idle threats. See for yourself.
Something catch your eye? \n\nOh Dagon's blood! I was definitely supposed to wait until you've actually looked at everything before asking that.
When you purchase an item, tell me what you plan on using it for. Some of these objects do not yet make sense to me.
Allow me to let you in on a secret … if you demand more of my time than is reasonable, you won't get through those doors the next time you come here.
Hello? Who's there? Are you here for a mount?
I'm getting out of here, you should too.
Thank you. If you're ever in Fargrave, know the Tong owe you a debt.
I'm not a fighter, otherwise I'd stay and help.
Come, you servants of Mehrunes Dagon! Fight!
I long to serve a Daedric Prince. After all, I have much to offer. I hold a position of high status here and I'm respected for my goods.\n\nSee for yourself.
I won't complain if you paid me extra. And it increases your chances of not being riddled with flesh wounds. Probably.
See anything you like? If not, we're done here.
Whew, shattering that bastard took some doing.
It's not the killing I enjoy most. But I do enjoy it.
He's channeling short pulses!
He's gathered a fair amount of energy. Be ready to dodge!
He's gathered a massive amount of energy!
Is that malice in your eyes, Martus? Have I rekindled your passion for causing pain?
You will perish here!
Taste your destruction!
Foolish mortal!
Tremble in horror at the Prince of Destruction!
Kill them all!
Do you not fear your death?
Shall I take your skull as a trophy?
Enjoy your death, mortal!
You've always had a special place of loathing in my heart, Cyronin.
I need more bone dust for this ritual.
The mortals in for a surprise.
Tougher than you. Tougher than everyone.
Keep your eyes open and knives sharp.
How loud can we make a mortal scream?
Perhaps I can bring the lord's next meal.
A mortal's suffering tastes sweet!
I hear our lord's whispers.
All beings suffer!
My last fight burned down a whole village.
More corpses! We need more kindling!
The Dremnaken fails at its hunt.
Have I shown you my mortal bone collection?
All hail Mehrunes Dagon, he who makes this possible.
All bow before my summons.
Stay sharp! No dawdling!
This is no time to wander off.
When lord Dagon summons, I do as he commands!
You've cut that thing off from its power. Use this to get back to the Cataclyst!
It's drawing power from another stone! Use this portal to reach it before the Daedra recovers.
The energy is dissipating! Take this portal back to the Cataclyst. That thing isn't defeated just yet!
It's reaching out to another of those stones, I can feel it! I think I can get you there! Use this!
Greetings, stork-legged giant! Yes, this nest is a fitting place for me to train. A crucible from which will rise Sir Caw—Gallant Knight of Pinfeathers!

I trained with the Battlespire since I was ten years old. I've been on the path toward war for so long I never considered another. It's my duty to fight, because I can. I just need to figure out what I'm really fighting for.
I'll pull the egonymic from him! Use it against Dagon!
I cannot fall! Not while my comrades still fight!
We fight as one, one!
Damn those cultists and their infernal racket.
I'll be honest, you're doing better than I expected.
While it's technically undead, the Undertaker's living soul has long departed. It's practically a construct.
Why anything needs that many swords, I'll never know.
Unleashing the Purgator.
There's nothing better suited to shuffling souls off this mortal coil than the Undertaker.
Grim Warden. There are unruly prisoners to pacify.
Drive them out!
These tuskers are attacking us?
We're under siege!
The Prior demands your death!
Great, more troubles.
I got first claim to the spoils!
Don't let them near the relics!
You aren't taking a thing from us!
Flames of Oblivion: Consume them!
For the Prior!
Protect the relics!
None shall pass!
I saw it … for a moment … where did it go?
It hurts …! Everything hurts …!
<Speaking in tongues.>

Few others can claim to have visited all of M'aiq's favorite locations. Stand tall, five-claw! You have achieved the unimaginable.\n\nNow, if you are done stalking this one, let's discuss the refreshment options in this establishment.
You mortals insist on a variety of extraordinarily frivolous furnishings. How may I be of service today?

You've come to the right place to spend your coin. I have everything you may need, from potions to repair kits. \n\nPlus, all proceeds go to pay for the ceremonial joining of my house to that of my beloved Unddan.
Come, you servants of Mehrunes Dagon! Fight!
Yes, yes. May the gates of prosperity never close. Now, why have you come here to my renowned stall?
