Don't talk while I ponder the intricacies of the universe. We assume all planes form and function like our own, but that is a fallacy. There could be rectangular realms in Oblivion. \n\nYou're still here? Purchase your magicked item quickly and depart.
Forsooth. Though the time we have may be fleeting, I do but hope we may part both richer. You in potions of vitality and I in both pocket and in company.
Lollygaggers. Malingerers. Bellyachers. Get to work!
Let that be a lesson to you dodgers. We don't tolerate layabouts on our yard!

Right. Don't take too long looking at my wares. Less competent mages may have to ask what each of these items does. But if I have to explain what a cheese grater is to another Daedra, I will be late closing shop.

Another mortal who does not know how to get where they're going? Ri is shocked.\n\nRi speaks facetiously, of course. Ri is not shocked. However, you are fortunate, because Ri is willing to show you where you want to go.
Whoa! That glint in your eye tells me you've vanquished many a foe. Is that why you're here? Finding it hard to carry around foodstuffs and all your rewards?
You looking to purchase one of my creatures? Well, no stealing them. That's non-negotiable.
Seams so fine you will not be able to tell they're there. See for yourself.
Honed these points myself. Good for cutting, maiming, stabbing, murder. You name it. \n\nAll my goods are of this quality. See for yourself.
If I can make it to Wretched Spire, then maybe ….
The Waking Flame are insane! They'll destroy us all!
What do you want? Give me specifics and don't waste my time. I have a staff to shape.
Strike now!
Well? What do you have? It better not have viscera on it.
More beasts incoming!
You're … very fine. I'd be happy to take some things off your hands for you.
Ah yes. A perfectly normal customer. No intentions on harming, maiming, or otherwise making me indisposed to conduct my business? I can see not. Excellent.
My darling, haven't you spent enough time in the House of Whims? As much as I adore your face, do feel free to go and share it with the rest of Fargrave. I insist.
We have arrived at the Pit of Pain! Wait. No we haven't. Argh! Qukikh, get the portal right!
Strange place to come across a fellow wanderer, but I suppose that's fortune for us both.
I've been waiting for you. I think. Do you have a trade to make with me? Or is this one supposed to go the other way, and I trade with you? My memory is willow-branch shaky.
Hurry it up. If I wanted my time and attention taken up by idiots, I wouldn't put myself behind these bars.
Going once. Going twice. Sold to the Daedra in the front!
Oh, are you in need of provisions? Have something to sell? \n\nI only just journeyed from Fargrave myself, so I'm stocked with many useful items. Take a look.
Ah, someone else who's unafraid of some bad weather. You must have as good of a reason as I do for being out here.\n\nI carry an assortment of useful goods. What are you looking for?
Condition met. Trial by combat initiated.
Trial failed. Wardening recommenced.
Condition pending. Preparing to abjure.
Merrunz must be somewhere around here. To think, Zainan is sharing a plane with the Fire-Cat!
Mehrunes Dagon is only one of the Four Corners of the House of Troubles. I-I will remain resolute regardless of his temptations!
My hands are quite full with these hapless mortals. If you wish to visit the most thrilling locations in the Deadlands, convince a different Dremora to be your guide.
Break my guard! I dare you!
If Dydier sent you my way, tell him I'm fine.
Go! You must reach Sombren and stop him!
I don't think we're going in the right direction.
If the mortals can summon us from Oblivion, surely I can summon one of them from Nirn.
Mercy, Lord Dagon … mercy!
Faster! Our Prince, Mehrunes Dagon, demands it!
No one escapes the Blood Pit!
Go ahead, run. I could use the practice.
Work harder, dog!
This one's arms are about to fall off.
Why do you punish us, Lord Dagon?
Please, no!
Mortal bones break so easily.
I say we just kill the lot of them.
Light of the eighth fire, warm my face.
We need more prisoners.
Mortals are useless!
Your chaos is commonplace here mortal!
The number of sick here … boggles the mind.
Once we finish here, Valkynaz Nokvroz will be unstoppable.
The Lord of Destruction rewards our efforts.
Daedrats? No. Why do you ask?
Stay alert. I have a tingle in my horns.
Why do we need so many prisoners?
Intruders? No, I hadn't heard.
Destroy the mortal!
Use my power!
You are bound to me—ah!
I need a moment to gather my power!
Some of your kind find crafting at one of the public workstations here in Fargrave … unsettling. I wonder if you do too. I love unsettled mortals.
Keep this up, mortal, and your debts to the law will exceed your short lifetime.
This is ... adequate. On your way.
You are being childish, Nirnling!
Stay your feet, mortal!
Enjoy freedom while you can.
You seem like you are about to cause me no end of trouble.
It's been a long time since a fool stole here.
Really? Now I have to inform on you!
Idiot! What do you think you're doing murdering here?
I should be disgusted, but I'm impressed.
What a display of futility!
Guard! Look there!
Ooh! A lesson on what criminals shouldn't do.
Where's the--? I could have sworn that I had it this morning.
Trying to steal from me? Your incompetence is adorable!
I won't ask what you're doing when we both know you'd lie.
I would have loved to see the mischief you made. Guards!
I don't want to talk to the likes of you.
You will find no soft hearts here, skrid. Pay the bounty or die.
Don't make me do this again.
A runner? Excellent.
Hold there, skrid!
Keep this discreet, mortal.
I see you there, scampheart. Choose your next move wisely.
Ha! Yes! Claim what's yours, mortal!
Finally, some action! Run, little Nirnling! Run!
Ah! Glorious slaughter!
My, my … look at this one.
No, no, you have to go for the head!
Guard! Kill this one!
How suspicious.
Now, where did I place that …?
Aha! Caught you, skrid!
You don't belong here, Nirnling.
Out, or I'll slit your throat.
Not while the guards are sniffing about.
Why would you behave so recklessly? I insist that you remedy this.
The fearful eyes satisfy more than the gold.
Mortal blood is a treat I have awaited!
You cannot avoid my grasp.
Fly, mortal. I grow bored now.
I have more eyes than you realize. Behave.
This creature steals with such abandon!
We have so few laws, yet you still break them.
This creature destroyed another! Punish them!
End these actions at once or suffer great harm!
The price for that is severe!
Quickly! Before the mortal flees!
You cannot hide. I befriended the shadows.
Where did--? The ritual needed that!
Sneaky creature. I will take that hand!
I don't recall ever wandering through your domain.
Enough of this. Proper authorities will deal with you.
Your reputation threatens anyone near you.
Going somewhere, mortal? Here in Oblivion, it's recompense or death. Choose wisely.
Wise. Now get out of my sight.
It's a blood price, then.
Hold there, scum!
Go, then. But know that we are watching.
Careful, mortal. You wouldn't want to get on my bad side.
Look at that little cutpurse go!
Ah, this criminal might shake things up a bit!
Bloodshed? Finally, some excitement!
Guard! The Nirnborn is here!
Leave some for the rest of us!
Slay it! Slay the Nirnborn!
Mortal shenanigans? How droll.
Zzavfa … where did I put it?
Don't you touch me, skrid!
You've strayed, mortal.
Begone, Nirnborn. Last warning!
You're marked for death. Move along.
Like the daedrat to the Perthan's web, you have run into me. Make atonement or face your doom.
A pity. I had hoped for some entertainment. Be on your way.
You choose death? So be it.
What is this foolishness? Stop!
Bah! You … may go. This time.
What mortal foolishness is this? Be on your way!
Fleeing with your pickings? You will be found.
Time to run, mortal. Your crimes follow you!
A murder? How delightful! But you will die for it, of course.
Flee while you can, mortal! Doom is at your heels.
You bring violence here, mortal?
Torments await you, fool!
Scuttle off, mortal insect. You annoy me.
Curses. Now where did I leave it?
You dare? I will make a necklace of your fingers!
This is no place for one of your kind.
You risk my ire. Begone!
You have made enemies, fool. I want nothing from you.
Feh. I hate wasting my time detaining fools. Get better at this. And pay up!
Too bad you had coin for your bounty.
Thanks for not paying! Now we have fun.
Stop right there!
You must've pleased someone important.
Skrid, watch yourself around me. I can arrest you.
Aha! Now you're in for it, thief!
As much as I respect your transgressions, I've called the guards.
I can't believe you just killed someone. Guards!
No! Get away from me, disgusting mortal! Guards!
Whoa, mortal! Guards!
Get this creature away from me!
That looks like fun. Is it?
Wait. I'm missing something …
Back off, miscreant!
Um, wait. You're not supposed to be here.
Wrong place, wrong time, skrid! Guards!
Better leave. I won't talk to you further.
Mortal, stop there. You will pay your bounty or die.
I did not know your kind had any sense. Surprising.
Such insolence! You will not escape!
Halt, mortal!
Your life is short enough already. Be gone.
Choose your next actions carefully if you value your throat, mortal.
Ha! Such brashness!
Ah, how exciting! How fast can you run, mortal?
Yes, yes! Magnificent!
Well, that was quite impressive.
That blood is so vile. Such a stink!
Enough! Guard!
You should disguise your scent if you wish to sneak about.
Hmm, I don't remember purchasing anything.
How amusing! Did you think that would work?
Are you lost, mortal?
Out, mortal scum!
I am in no mood to deal with the guards. Come back later.
Pay off your bounty. It's the only contribution you're likely to make.
A mortal with honor. Hmm.
No one is above my law!
Stay right there, mortal!
I can always hunt you later.
A mortal shirking the law? This should be good.
I will hunt you in your sleep, thief!
In front of witnesses? Psh. Mortals.
It's about time someone took care of that annoyance.
Your actions do you no favors, Nirnling. Guard!
Your stance is weak!
Guards! This mortal is feral!
That doesn't look like a sanctioned activity.
I could have sworn I didn't forget anything when I set off.
What? Remove your thieving digits from my presence!
You have no possible excuse for being here.
Get out before I treat you like the vermin that you are!
My time is too precious to waste on a known criminal.
Nirnborn are not worth my time.
This is the best vantage point in Fargrave.
Challenge me and you'll be dead in an instant.
I have a lot to do and not much time in the mud.
To walk among so many Daedra is an honor.
Wish I could claim mastery of these orbs. I'm just here since they soothe my tired mind.
My vision may be gone but I see you heathens clearly!
Find your own spot. This one's claimed.
Existence will be little more than combat unless you set your mind to the larger questions.
This bard has diverted my attention. For now.
Ah, you are a tempting morsel, but you should probably keep walking. When I'm finished, nothing much remains of my playthings.
Prosperity on both our doorsteps. If you can manage that, mortal.
A cheat! A cheat and a liar. Naraman you put yourself to shame!
Out of my sight, mortal! I must absorb this tavern's resonance before heading into the Shambles.
I recently misplaced a client. Know someone who needs protection? If so, check back with me. Later. I'm taking a break now.
I trade only at the Bazaar. Or with those who have proven themselves trustworthy.
Please stay healthy.
My neighbors talk far too loudly. I do not wish to be included in their tiresome gossiping.
My companion does not talk much. Her mind remains in Oblivion.
The overgrown child who ordered me here will die for it.
A reminder. Achieve your potential. You clearly haven't yet.
Hewlet Hexos speaks too loudly.
We have no quarrel with you, Kith or Kyn.
You're sort of interrupting our friendly competition here.
Lotuses will flower here in the future.
Oh yeah, look down on the caged Vre. You're above me only in height!
Hurry! To the Bazaar. The little trinkets are back!
May not look it, but there's plenty of work here.
A fascinating specimen. Perhaps for later study.
It's difficult to prize information out of those Daedra. But not impossible.
You have made yourself a personal inconvenience.
The Grasp prohibits putting mortals in these cases.
Tarnished. Rusty. Shoddy work all around.
Governing is not simple. That's why the Grasp is a collective.
I trust the vision of our glorious leader.
Stay vigilant. Our lord demands no less.
No intruder will get past me!
When did we let their kind into the order?
Prince of Destruction, preserve us.
Deadlight is a gift from Mehrunes Dagon.
My swords dance to Prince Dagon's drums.
Our enemies can't reach us here.
Ah, but we call him Merrunz. The Fire-Cat.
Deadlight is a fortress without a door.
Is Mehrunes Dagon displeased?
You're blocking my view.
The view up here is ruined by mortals.
Move on mortal. This is my corner.
Hmm. I need more knives.
Be about your business. I doubt it's here.
It's not boasting if Ux is right.
Glorious flames take you! No, not you, plums. Please don't ignite!
Merchants' voices carry.
Prosperous gates open before you.
The weak mortals will be no match for the Kyn.
Go and claim victory for our lord.
I do believe that this is empty. Wait. Now it is.
How can your kind be any more useless?
These are almost as beautiful as Lentylmo.
I wish to fight for my Prince!
I smell mortals! Quick, send me into battle.
Dahzini believes she is being subtle.
I don't have time to chat.
You would not believe the delightful trifles I have in my possession.
Oh. Isn't Ser just … incredible?
Mortals always need reassurance that my magic is safe.
These formations are hideous. I'll take four.
Do any dare to defy me?
Mmm. This is delicious!
Few mortals have actual business with my liege.
It's a shame this mortal cannot see or hear me, these are some of my best dances.
That strange High Elf over there is talking to fungi.
Slek! This recipe says I need a peddler of rare magics.
Shh! I'm listening to the bard.
Zzavfa! I needed to sell that a while ago.
You're blocking my view.
Have you any tidings of Zynoahz? I am curious about his doings.
Where did I put that hammer?
Stupid mortals, always trying to steal my possessions.
I'm told that if I make my abode comfortable for mortals, they'll seek me out. They are … amusing.
At least warm drinks exist.
I can't believe I'm finally in Fargrave! And so close to a market too!
We've looped back upon ourselves. You'll need to try something else.
The synchroseisia, it's—
Hmm … I lost my favorite knife in the Shambles.
Dremora don't like it when I read their lips. But they're so soft-spoken!
That strange globe I purchased … where is it?
Those at Wretched Spire are indeed wretched. I hope future tasks do not return me there.
Why do mortals always look at me that way?
That shopkeeper is looking down at me ….
You're not worthy to serve Mehrunes Dagon!
M'aiq once believed that living in a single dwelling would lack variety. But now that he has seen this one, M'aiq thinks that perhaps he was wrong.
I wish to fight for my Prince!
Ah, the crisp air of the planes.
Skull scorch it! I wasn't ready.
The end of Nirn is near!
You are worthless!
Ungrateful maggots! All of you!
Heavier on the lash. The recruits must be encouraged!
You poor, poor varlet.
Psh, mortals. They think their screams are impactful.
Prince of Flood and Flame, feed the fire of my hatred.
Be careful when you talk to people who're eating.
An unexpected gift, creature. Here is one in return. There will be more, if you continue to loosen these terrible bonds!
After all this time, a glimmer of my former puissance returns to me. And a portion to you, as gratitude.
My spiracles breathe in the damp once more and it … is glorious. Use this power, and break the final ward!
What you have done here … it pleases me.
So bold! Yes! Test my strength! Feel it bear down upon you like the weight of a thousand seas!
I underestimated you. Noted. Now die!
I have endured too long to meet my end now!
A formidable effort. Alas, you are nothing without the shell of my power.
A boon.
The Fire Cat commands us all to burn!
Do not speak to me, initiate.
Your face does my day no favors.
Even here, others are more fortunate.
To the Spire, we are all small.
Mysissa's ranting. Again.
Those Dagonist skrids grabbed my partner just outside of town. Don't let them catch you off-guard.
Come in! It's a friendly shack.
Does the mortal like what they see? So does Olesella! Go find someplace secluded and wait for me. I'll be along momentarily. I promise!
Why can't anything be built at my level?
I'm going back home as soon as I remember where that is.
This is my boulder. Get your own.
I haven't got all day.
This place stinks something awful. But there is … potential. Opportunities, of a sort.
My scales are dull, but I know my blade is sharp.
Leave this wretch to her low status.
How much are you willing to pay for your safety?
Y'ffre bless your storied life!
Pssst! I'm innocent. Let me out!
Oh, I lost the roving marshrat.
There are stars, even here.
Don't you dare gaze upon Erztiran!
Have you seen the Havocrel who roams the Sever, seeking challengers? Mazorah has. She is not afraid!
You're not on the wanted posters, right?
Turn back. Lest you wander into the Daedric side.
That's a very nice bag you're carrying.
Stuck. Here. Why?
Curses! I've gotten lost again. I can't be back in Wretched Spire … can I?
One wrong move and you're done for.
A fellow traveler. What … fortune.
You are not who I'm looking for.
Seems like everyone asks after Yuhleena's scars, but then they don't want to hear the stories.
Set your eyes to your next target.
I will snuff out your life.
The Unmaker seems hungry. Who do you think we should give it?
Strike them down!
How long do we intend to work with these mortal fools?
I do not understand what use Lord Dagon has for mortal sycophants.
Once our great work is complete, we shall bring ruin upon the mortals.
Soon a great storm of destruction shall break upon Fargrave.
I'll obliterate anything that moves.
Let us build a monument to Mehrunes Dagon with mortal bones.
I swear on my blade. None shall defy Lord Dagon's will.
Mehrunes Dagon demands blood. I will not fail him.
Did you hear something? Besides the wind?
Remind me. Are we working with the mortals or not?
Any word from the Deadlands?
Those Dremora aren't so haughty now, are they?
I hear the Riven Cataclyst is nearly ready.
Soon destruction will reign!
Mehrunes Dagon shall reward us for this!
Remind me. Are we working with the Daedra or not?
I have faith in Sister Celdina's plan.
We're running out of Daedra again.
Ahh—ugh!
Sister Celdina is going to need more prisoners for the device.
That Dremora just looked at me funny.
This is our territory!
Let's find someone to beat on.
What? I'm working here!
No one messes with us.
Do I have to have another look around?
Ugh. I shouldn't have taken that stew from the old lady.
I love making deals here. Guards never notice!
The prey is mine. Find your own.
The Vanquished need no clan!
The spiders need to remember their place.
Skein Row belongs to the Invisible Web.
Don't you just love to play with your food?
Help me break Nokvroz's defenses!
You saw, mortal. Now you must die!
Be ready. The fools attacking us may come this way.
No one can stand against us!
Soon Valkynaz Nokvroz will be invincible.
The Bladebearers attack? Are they mad?
Rynkyus is a fool to attack us head on!
Ardent Hope is the strongest of Mehrunes Dagon's citadels.
I can wait. The battle will come to me.
All will bow before Mehrunes Dagon in the end.
Mehrunes Dagon will reward us for sure!
The Bladebearers? I have an arrow for each of them!
My steel must taste blood this day!
Nokvroz intends to use mortal blood? Disgusting!
I am still uncertain of these Incarnate abominations.
Someone said they saw Arox the Mutilator. Is that possible?
Lord Dagon, smote them!
What do you think happens to us? After all the disasters, I mean?
Stay vigilant. The Dremora and her lackeys could be anywhere.
For the Bladebearer clan!
Take that, and that, and that!
Most impressive Prince Dagon.
You can't control me, Dagon!
I will savor your dying breaths!
Now, Champion! Use the egonymic against Dagon!
Aargh!
I will be free!
There you are! Prepare to be unmade!
Yes! A worthy challenger!
You are wise to seek guidance, beeko. For a pittance, my knowledge can be yours.
New to Fargrave? I have knowledge to spare.

Legends say that the skeletons littering Fargrave were once porters for a great palanquin that traveled the void of Oblivion. They walked, and walked, and walked, until they died. But unlike other Daedra, they did not come back.\n\nNo one knows why.

A Daedric merchant's wealth is not measured in gold, but in favors and debts. Property is a means to power—and power is all they desire.\n\nRemember this when you do business with them, or you will find yourself paddling upstream on trouble river.
Don't kill this one. We need it to serve Dagon.
You think you stand a chance?
You think you can defeat us?
Keep it busy, I need more time.
They found us! Let the fires rise up!
I might fall, but the plan lives on.
Hold on, I need a moment!
Little mortal. How far we have come since we first met.
Great. Some strange mortal seeks to gawk at me with its mooning gaze.\n\nMust I be burdened with yet another torture in this despicable tower of lies?
Little mortal? Well, well, well. A new suite of possibilities just opened up in Coldharbour.
It will take more than this to destroy me!
Cowards!
Why won't you see the truth?
I am free!
They won't find me here … surely ….
Only death-seeking fools serve the Prince of Destruction!
AIOS signal not detected. Transitioning to standard commerce array.\n\nGreetings. How can I help you today?
By the word of Seht, I am bound.\n\nThis partition's storage capacity is sufficient for all deposits.
I won't go back! I won't!
What the—ah!
The Waking Flame? How?
No—no! Don't! Arg!
Do you all feel that?

Do not look shocked. Yes, I am currently a talking daedrat, but once I was so much more. I am Arox the Mutilator, and before this curse felled me, I was mighty! And very large. Huge. Much bigger than you.\n\nWhat? Why do you smirk, mortal?
We should seek out a way to undo this miserable curse of mine, master. Once I possess my proper form, no foe could stand against us!
The story of our victory over Nokvroz spreads like wildfire across the Deadlands, master. It is good to hear my name spoken with dread again!
What? Have you never encountered a free Daedra before? Well, not exactly free, I suppose. I serve Madam Whim of Fargrave. I am here on a secret mission of—no, ignore that. Hezehk has said too much!

Well, well, mortal. Consigning Valkynaz Nokvroz to the depths of Oblivion? Not bad. Now, I have a short list of some other Daedra who Hezehk would also like to see disappear. Perhaps you can tell me how you accomplished that, hmm?

Ah, mortal. You might prove useful to poor Hezehk. Perhaps you could negotiate a reduction in the debt I owe to Madam Whim? She does seem to demonstrate an uncharacteristic fondness for you, though I fail to understand why.

I'm not supposed to talk about this, but I'm so excited! I just completed my studies and I've been promoted to relic-apprentice for the Ritemaster of the Psijic Order!\n\nI just had to share the news, but don't tell anyone, all right?
I actually met Madam Whim when I visited Fargrave. Doesn't her voice just make you melt?
Ritemaster Valsirenn can be a little intimidating, but I think she's impressed with me! I don't think she would have asked me to become her assistant if she wasn't.

Do not look shocked. Yes, I am currently a talking daedrat, but once I was so much more. I am Arox the Mutilator, and before this curse fell me low, I was mighty! And very large. Huge. Much bigger than you.\n\nWhat? Why do you smirk, mortal?
What? Have you never encountered a free Daedra before? Well, not exactly free, I suppose. I serve Madam Whim of Fargrave. I am here on a secret mission of—no, ignore that. Hezehk has said too much!

I'm not supposed to talk about this, but I'm so excited! I just completed my studies and I've been promoted to relic-apprentice for the Ritemaster of the Psijic Order!\n\nI just had to share the news, but don't tell anyone, all right?
No secrets are worth this drudgery.
Dagon's reach is long, mortals. Come and face his wrath!
Ha! You court a grisly death!
I shall cast your heads at Dagon's feet!
I will not fall … to mortals!
Enough of this!
Ha! You really think you have a chance?
Yes! Let us bleed together!
Cowards!
Cowards!
I'm not paid enough for this.
Ha! Flee curs!
I was hoping you'd put up a fight.
That was for Varallion, scum.
I'll gift Varallion your heads and leave the rest to the yaghra.
Leaving a trail of death in your wake.
Got you penned in now.
Catch me if you can!
You'll make a nice pin cushion.
Behind you.
A little pitch for you, coward.
I'll cook you in that shell.
Can you breathe fire yet?
You might still escape, if you flee now. You aren't worth chasing.
You move well, mainlander. You should try bow hunting, if you haven't already. Your quarry would never hear you coming.\n\nSpeaking of bows, check out my wares.
My parents taught me to sew from the time I was old enough to thread a needle. Whether you're out on the sea or exploring the wilds, you'll want my fine stitchwork. Trust me.
You seek my counsel, mortal master? Allow your weakest foe to live so they may spread the tale of your wrath!
The Bladebearers make decent allies, master, but remain vigilant. Dremora are never to be fully trusted.
Trust me, master. I know more about Ardent Hope than you could ever possibly require.
Ah, master, I really did miss this pack!
Ready to try something new, eh? Good. Let's keep those bastards on their toes!
There is nothing I enjoy more than catching vermin. Come, let's play, little rats!
You are smaller than expected. Though it's of little surprise that the magics that kept me imprisoned from reality warped my perception of it.
Let's see if we can find that fancy lute.
The Allwither is the natural end of all things.
<Baaa!>
Glad to see you've returned, and unmaimed too! Well … mostly. How did it go?
No need to worry about your pay. House Dufort always has coin for mercenaries who keep up their end of the deal. And come back alive, of course.

If you're looking for hard work for good pay, you've come to the right place! The tasks I dole out require as many strong arms as you can muster, but you appear capable of gathering a group.\n\nCan I offer you a job?
I'm sure we'll find more threats to the Systres soon. Just not at this very moment.
Back so soon? Can I assume that means that all went well?
Be careful out there. More than one adventurer has underestimated the dangers of our fair archipelago.\n\nReturn to me when the job is complete and your pay will be waiting.
If it isn't my favorite adventurer! Looking for a job you can handle on your own? Then you've come to the right place.\n\nCan I put you to work, my friend?
Unfortunately, all of the jobs I had available have been distributed for the day. Come back later and I'm sure I'll have more work for you.
Ember has a sharp mind. It's her enthusiasm that gets in her way most often.
Rake'em across the Reef!
The fun's come to us!
Care to wager on how long they last?
Admiral Galvendier couldn't best me at sea, so he sends assassins to my doorstep. How pathetic.
Having a twinge of regret about leaping into the serpent's lair?
Undefeated and unbroken.
You come at the queen, you best not miss.
Nothing but bilge scum after all. How disappointing.
Gloves off then, if that's how you want it.
Let's see how they fare.
Your defiance is almost cute.
You dare raise your flag on my island? See, now I'm going to make it painful.
Have at me!
Oh ho, you are brave. I'll enjoy watching that courage fade.
Here, girl! Fresh chum!
Get a load of these bilge rats.
Fillet these bastards!
Blast'em back into the brine!
Time to fry, little fishies.
Many travelers walk around with full pockets. Risky. There are always thieves about, yes?
Shove off!
Back off, stranger. I'd appreciate it if you'd let me be.
They asked the famous Chef Donolon to cater this event, but he turned them down. I was the second pick. Can you believe the nerve? I make a better cake than that hack.
Sweet treats for the sweet! Hello, walker! Can I interest you in a delightful pastry?
I carried my goods all the way from the midst of Morrowind to the tip of the Gold Coast. Repay my labor with gold from your pocket and let my trade carry on.
Whoops! That nearly became a hole in the floor. Again.\n\nWhat can I help you with?
Is the smell as bad down there as it is up here? It is worse, surely!
You only prolong your suffering!
Tell me you're the one the grocer sent over with my hog's head sausages and darkroot ale. I'm starving. I could—oh. You don't have my lunch.\n\nSo, you must be here to buy or sell?

Each of my furnishings has a name and a story! My very own chair is called Dark Ends. Why? An assassin killed its former owner in a grisly fashion, then posed him in … well, let's leave it at that.\n\nCare to take a look around?
The Ascendant are like the tides! Inexorable!
Both the sea and sky are at my command!
You are tethered to the same fate: bound for the bottom of the sea!
I took this job to see what people want to store.\n\nSo, what do you want to store, eh?
Crustaceans. Gross. Gross. Get away!
Rocky no! Don't do this!
Need a good blade, mainlander? Maybe an axe? Never know when you might run into a band of desperate pirates around here. Best to be ready for 'em.

Hmm … no presentation of incomparable beauty is complete without proper attire. It's no use looking gorgeous if you're going to ruin the effect with rags.\n\nPlease note that I don't sell either of those things. Just thinking aloud.
My indriks are without compare, ceruval. Care to take a look?
I'm supposed to sell stuff. That puts me in front of people. I hate being in front of people.\n\nSo, help a fellow out and buy something already.
Here to reclaim something I took? Or bring me more trinkets!
Greycloaks, lend me your claws!
It's been a long time since I crossed swords with someone skilled.
Don't get excited, we're not through yet.
I'll shred you between my claws.
We'll bloody our teeth together!
You'll find no mercy here!
The Ascendant Order will have my blades for as long as I can lift them.
The Ascendant Order has the right of it, I just know it.
I'm tired of waiting here.
The Ascendant Order gave me everything.
When I joined, I didn't know how much of my work would be just waiting.
We must make the Ascendant Champion proud.
My feet are starting to ache.
Have you heard anything from the Ascendant Champion?
The Ascendant Champion will be pleased with our progress.
The Ascendant Order deserves better than this squalor.
The Ascendant Champion's orders are not ours to question.
I'm so tired of waiting around here.
I will prove my dedication to the order through blood and steel!
Why won't you just die?
Look out, it's going to strike!
Strike now, while it's frozen!
Where did all these things come from? Why attack now?
Is this a spawning ground for those things? They just keep coming!
My shield feels light as air, knowing my purpose is right.
I wish to rejoin the others, I grow anxious from waiting.
I will serve in whatever way the Ascendant Champion deems necessary. Even in this muck.
The Order will show us the way.
You want to be here, right?
The Order will free us from all this nonsense.
How does one fight being so small?
The Order must end this.
How does one fight being so big?
No good can come of taking what does not belong to you.
I can sniff out a dawdler no matter where you linger.
Trying to slip off? You'll learn to stick with your crew!
Stubborn arses, I'll drive you like mules then.
Zenithar, Provider of our Ease, I fear your ways are little understood. Help me see that your teachings are known in these lands.
I really need this to work! But what to give? What to give!
Friend! To me! It's about to erupt!
Tribute is it? Very well, I accept your challenge.
Ah, delightful. A customer to distract me from the boredom of just puttering around here. What do you need, you gift of the gods, you?
Is that a deck of Tribute cards I see? It is! Come on and have a seat. I'm dying to play.
They are illusions! Don't be shaken by them!
They all come back to me. You've failed! Give up now!
This one aids any who seek to dispel falsehoods. Lies left unchallenged poison the air we all must breathe, yes?\n\nAh, but you're here for the exchange of wares and coins.
<Moooo!>
The sea's bounty comes back to savory life under my hands. Please, please, take a mere morsel.
You want to share her fate? Be my guest!
Ever lose a needle only to find it later with your foot? That's why you need well-crafted shoes, made with my high-quality supplies!
You've got rubbish. I've got needful goods. How about a swap?
That treasure's mine!
You'll soon join the rest of the flotsam bobbing on the waves.
I'll gut you like a trout.
Surrender to the abyss!
Shh. Let the tide take you.
The current's on my side.
Rise now, seas of Tamriel, wash these pitiful curs away.
Let the brine fill your lungs and die!
Did you believe the Maormer weak and the Dreadsail unworthy of your fear? We have the strength of the sea and the force of waves in our very blood!
Someone strip this lot of whatever they're worth.
Beloved, please … I hate you …! Come back!
You left me! Why did you leave me?
I see we have quite the … traveler … here to do business today.\n\nWell. I am sure you have other places to be, so let us make this brief.
I hate you!
Mara get me home to Lynne ….
It's an order!
The storm! The storm!
…get…
Ly, I believe they've frozen with fright.
The storm never ends!
Swift like a flood-swollen stream, or powerful like the surging tides? Which fighting style is best?\n\nMy gear can help you with either.
Oh! Oh! Treasure! I found treasure!
Island mounts show a different spirit than the steeds of Alik'r. Pay heed, traveler. The difference is subtle, but important.
One, two, three swings low, bring it down blow-by-blow.
You chop up nicely.
An easy kill.
Bah! We're Dreadsails, not salvagers.
No one leaves this place until we find what we came for!
Those lodestones don't seem like much to me.
No, I won't summon a breath of fresh air, greengill.
Heard it was a sea slug's curse that did this place in.
Smells like a dreugh's arse.
I'd rather be plundering a fat merchant's schooner, not these maggoty derelicts.
Not all these floaters are dead as they look.
Give them a Dreadsail welcome!
I'm the rock you're getting dashed against.
Time to drown, wretch!
You've kicked up a storm now!
Time to practice my cuts.
I'll send you to the abyss!
Gut'em for the adders!
You'll make a fine thrall!
My stomach growls and claws at itself. I've not eaten in a long time.
Don't poke at it, we don't even know what it is!
What is this thing, anyway?
I really don't think we should touch it.
Let us deal with these intruders swiftly!
For the Ascendant Lord!
Feeling brave, are we?
Best pick a brew and drink up. Some of my selections are in short supply, and I never know when the next shipment from the mainland is coming in.
Your generosity was your mistake today.
Mercy! I never wanted to do this.
Surely you didn't mean to do that.
The seas around here are nothing like the seas of Skyrim. But trade? Yes, trade is much the same. Want something? Have coin? Then buy it!
Love my luxurious locks, do you? I was marooned once and lost 'em after a year of slowly starving. But if you eat well of my wares, you'll avoid my fate.
Well met! You'll be wanting some quality goods, I trust! Some come straight from the Stonelore Druids. Others … well, they have their own stories.
Hahaha.
Plots and schemes. They fill the minds and mouths of people around here. But let's keep it simple between us. \n\nYou have coin. I have things you can buy.
If you can't manage this, we won't bother getting up.
Used to sail the seas with a fine crew. Merchant ship, we were. Now I do my trading on land, but the goods are better. Take a look!
Seeking wares? I have them here. Just ask me nicely, or I will jeer.
Stepping in from the weather, I see! Welcome, my friend, and well met! How may I help you?
Pockets only get you so far! Add some more bags and packs to your gear so that you can, well, add more gear to your load!
Don't defend this swindler! He's only getting what he's owed.
Thank you. Your saving me is a sign from Zenithar. I'll only work with artisans from now on.
Za'ji rains death from above!
Got one!
Brr. You will pay for all these shivering timbers, fish-Elf!
Craving a seaside retreat, but don't have the furnishings you need to make it feel like home? Well, friend, you've come to the right place!
Had enough of fair weather and sea breezes? I myself find the Systres best taken in small doses.\n\nSo, where are you heading?
Don't mind the rumbling. We get that around here occasionally.\n\nNow, what are you looking for today?
Go for the gills! Za'ji heard once they have gills.
Za'ji can help with these soggy villains!
Had your warm up then?
The words twist inside out and gnaw at my mind. What do they mean? What do they—ah. Sorry, sorry. I am vexed by a puzzle.\n\nNow, what may I help you with?
That was just a taste of what's to come.
Hey there, a word?
Don't mind the dust. Bone or stone, it'll not harm you.\n\nSo, deposit? Withdrawal?
You brought me items? Don't waste my time if you've nothing for me to look at.
What we do here is no joking matter. Without us, goods would remain locked up among the nobility.\n\nSo, with that in mind, I hope you brought me some excellent quality goods to fence.
I'll be taking that gold—off your corpse!
Yrgrid's mark? Pah! I didn't want your gold anyway.
You're a fool and soon you'll be a poor too!
Sure, you can find my goods outside the refuge, but why would you want to?
Here to play Tribute, eh? Good. I need a challenge.
Hail, wayfarer! Can I interest you in a game of Tribute?
Ah, a fellow Tribute player, yes? Fancy a game?
Looking for an easy win? Well, go on. Have a seat.
By the Three, are you going to sit down and play or just stand there gawking?
Ah, walker! You wish to play Tribute, yes? Of course you do!
A worthy opponent. Hist be praised. Shall we play?
Tribute, eh? Grab a drink and a chair, then! Let's get to it!
I don't have customers. I have clients.\n\nSo, client, what can I interest you in today?
I mostly serve off-duty jailers, sailors, and curious nobles, but I'm not above dealing with a friendly prisoner or an adventurer—provided they have some sort of currency to trade.
If you've not visited Gonfalon Bay yet, you should. It doesn't compare to Alinor or other towns from my home of Summerset, but it does well for a Breton settlement.\n\nNow, how may I help you today?
You ever just follow a torchbug to wherever it leads you?\n\nThat's how I ended up out here, selling and buying. Seems to work for me!
Hey, good-looking! Nice place, eh? I will say, it could use some improvements in the security department.\n\nNot that I'm planning anything!
You traveled far to see my goods, I think. Go ahead. Take a look!

Happy to be here. So happy to be here. Selling. To you. Ha! My last job was cursed. Every single person who took it got hounded near to death by some foul spirit.\n\nBut that's a story for another time.
Hello again. The Systres have need of you, if you have the time.
The skies remain clear, at least for the moment. Things are quiet now. But I'll be sure to let you know if I see any more signs of the vents acting up.
Good luck out there! Try not to get too close to the steam coming out of the volcanic vents. I heard it will fry just about anyone's skin off.\n\nYou'll be fine, I'm sure!
Hmm, I don't feel the burn of sulfur in my lungs. You did it, didn't you? You managed to close one of the vents?

Hey, good-looking! Great to see you again! How about these accommodations, eh? Really beats some of the places we've been. Of course, there's something to be said for slimy caves and musty dungeons. They've got character!

There's my favorite partner-in-crime! Say, I was thinking about heading back to Stros M'Kai. For old times' sake, you know? And also to pick up some things. I left my favorite belt in Bhosek's palace. But at least I remembered my pants!

Great seeing you! Say, thanks again for helping me settle that business with Tu'heiba back in Elsweyr. Can you believe we're like best friends now? All right, not best friends, but steady allies. \n\nWell, more like frequent business acquaintances.

What a time we had on High Isle, right? And that Valessea! Now, there's a woman I could see putting a ring on! \n\nWhat? Marriage? Goodness, no! Not that kind of ring! A casual ring. They have those, right?
You have no idea the threat you're facing!
Now, now, patience, my friend. My goods don't spoil, and we can chat about them to your heart's content.\n\nOr we can just get right into business, I guess.
Certainty in times of uncertainty. That's what sturdy house goods provide. Memories, too.\n\nYou'll want those when you face your next competitors here.
<Jester Anglidor stares silently as he traces the shape of an invisible wall.>
Come forth, hounds!
Hounds! Earn your dinner!
Try my iron sparring partner on for size.
Grab that little one there, that'll do.
How do you like my ice sculpture?
Flotsam and jetsam … I'm so sick of flotsam and jetsam.
I'm starting to think this isn't worth the measly pay.
You've got this, but I'm here if you need me.
You think you can fight fire with fire?
Chilling, isn't it?
Undefeated versus Undaunted. This outcome was inevitable.
Now, Turli!
Now, Ly!
Combined might!
We have no equal!
Drown.
Sirens! A dirge for these doomed souls!
The rip tides are eager for your blood!
Dreadsails! Your queen demands a sacrifice!
You look like you could use a hand, brother.
I may be down, but not out!
This should heat the battle up a bit.
You'll regret knocking the wind out of me.
You'll go up like tinder now.
You'll be quick to freeze like that.
Cut a starfish in half and two are born.
The heart of the reef is racing now! Beating like thunder!
Impressive.
Flee now and you might still escape what I unleash.
I long for the water.
This one can't even remember the faces of Jone and Jode.
Oblivion take the Commodore for this. Yeah, I said it!
I'd have welcomed a noose if I'd known this was the alternative.
I ache so bad. What's even left of me to hurt?
My crew never agreed to the Commodore's plan, why should we suffer too!
If I could break the curse, I wouldn't be here. Idiot.
Some immortal scourge we turned out to be. Trapped in a damn cave for all eternity!
The gore will flow.
All glory to the Bloodmage.
One day we will ascend to stand at the master's side.
Blood is the channel that all life flows.
The master's gifts are many.
The master's power is great. It flows through me.
My blade is honed in the master's service.
My blades are for the master.
The master's life is unending. Through him, we will live forever.
No one can stop the master. He will live forever.
I must obey.
My will is not my own.
Yes, as you say.
I will obey your commands.
Yes, master.
We are the blades of the spire.
Death to enemies of the spire!
Death to enemies of the spire!
The spire has given me clarity.
The spire has given me clarity.
The spire is most beautiful at night.
Night is when the spire is most beautiful.
None of those useless louts managed to stop you? Well, I have other means at my disposal.
You again? Begone, we're busy.
Langley says that chopping wood will build up muscle. That way I can wield a broadsword!
Let me take a sniff ….
Oh no! You have me on the run now!
Let's stay on track. The scent doesn't lead that way.
Shake off the drink you laggards! We've got company!
Delay these bastards! It's time I end this.
You shouldn't have taken what wasn't yours.
That power doesn't belong to you!
Hey, good-looking! Nice place, eh? I will say, it could use some improvements in the security department.\n\nNot that I'm planning anything!
