What this place really needs is a good story. Granted, there are plenty of tales about the Legion, but not so many about the ordinary people of Colovia. Give me your name, traveler, and I'll make you a hero of the written page!
Filers don't get rewards. Our work is always satisfactory, and therefore its own reward.

Life is far too short to allow oneself to be overcome by every passing difficulty. When I find myself growing weary of the tasks my employers set for me, I simply remember that they will be dead one day.
Are you done in here? Oh, nearly. That's good then.
Everyone knows the servants hold the secrets of the city. If you ever need information, you'd do worse than to ask a servant.
Don't forget to make your choice before traveling to the next wing of the archive.
This one would give anything to know what the Wood Elves are saying about their king. Just the thought of it sets this one's whiskers twitching.
This one can't help but wonder what the Wood Elves are up to now that their king is dead. Her paws are not so silent as they once were, or she would go investigate herself.
All is well again in West Weald. But this one cannot help but feel she missed something … well! It is no great matter.
What an exciting time to be in the archive. The maligraphies can pop out at any moment!\n\nBe on your guard, mortal. We must not let the enemy catch us unaware.
The Verses and Visions offered throughout the archive are gifts from Hermaeus Mora. Choose the ones you accept strategically. They could determine your chances of survival here.
I didn't file this wing. I mean, look at it.\n\nPick a Verse and take the portal out of here if you want to see something organized to perfection.
It's not every day that we get to stop our work. The whole situation is honestly a little annoying, and also very exciting. \n\nThe next time you see a maligraphy, wallop it for me.
The threads of fate tying you to the Index have been severed. You'll need to give it some time before you go in again.
You look weary, traveler. The grime of the road clings to you. Surely your business is not so urgent that you cannot stop for a meal and a bath.
So much fuss, and for what? The problem has dealt with itself. With the traitorous elf king dead, we can all move on with our lives. Excuse me, wayfarer, I see a coin purse in need of lightening.
Before you ask, yes, I am what you think I am, and no, I will not tell you how I feed. It's a rude question to begin with. Mortals truly have no manners. No matter. Your lifespans are as flies to us.
The harder you train, the harder you hit! That's what I always say. If you don't end the day with fresh bruises, you didn't learn anything.
I'm glad things are quieting down, now. Makes it much easier to do my duty when I don't have to worry about cultists or Daedra or Daedric cultists. Whoever it was, I'm just glad they're gone.
I wonder if the trees of the new forest are good for woodworking. Do they continue to grow even after you cut them down? Truly a conundrum.
This will be your last mistake, Beragon!
Always know your escape route before you start making trouble. Always! No quicker way to a Legion swordpoint than a bad plan and a dead end.
Never thought I'd wind up serving criminals and thugs. This is beneath my station. Maybe I should have joined the Legion after all.
You look new here, traveler. Better find some trouble quick, or it will find you first. Speaking of, you should count your coins if you haven't in a while.
This place is enormous.
Nothing here but old bones.
My work is good, I swear it! I've become much better at remembering things like taking measurements and sewing up the seams of trousers. By the Green, I'm something of an artist at this point.

A smile and a laugh can hide many things, including a dagger to the back. Don't forget that while you visit here, traveler. The Wood Elves seem friendly, but they can be fierce as a wolf on the hunt when they want to be.
Ayleid ruins are a treasure trove of skeletal wonders. The Green reclaimed their flesh long ago, leaving perfectly clean bones behind. Even maggots don't strip the meat so well.

Y'ffre's beard! I've never resented the Green Pact more than right now. Some of the greatest Ayleid ruins are being consumed by this new forest, and no one cares! \n\nI wish I could cut it down. Well, not all of it, obviously. Just a bit.
I always loved woodland creatures. I once let a prairie dog nest inside my tunic for three days because it looked so comfortable. And by once, I mean last week.

Everyone knows the best rotmeth takes time to brew. That's why it's so hard to experiment with new ingredients. One wrong choice could literally waste years of your life. But even so, scamp guts have real potential.

I came here to get away from the Legion, but these Wood Elves have their own way of dealing with outsiders. I don't understand it, and I don't want to. What kind of religion stops you from growing crops? Bah, it's nonsense.

You know, Wood Elf beliefs aren't so different from those in the Empire, once you get past the Green Pact. They worship Mara here too, as I do, just in a different form. It's fascinating to compare my stories with theirs.

Have you been here long, traveler? My study of the Elves has brought me far from the stronghold where I was raised. It may seem strange, but I feel more at home here than I ever did among my own people.
Welcome, traveler. Fancy sharing a story? You look like you've got some good ones. The dust from the road sticks to you like musk on a boar.
We remember! We never forget!
That was the Legion? They're not so tough.
Aren't my beasts magnificent?
Was someone feeding my welwa?
This place could use more trees.
The power of the Green flows through me!
Embrace the power of our ancestors!
Leave the fallen legionaries as a warning to their comrades.
Don't handle the merchandise unless you plan to buy it. I don't want to have to check your pockets.
I can see that you know your steel, traveler. You'll find no better blades west of Windhelm.
By the Green, what's happening?
By Y'ffre, they're everywhere!
The key to perfect alchemy is perfect ingredients. Only by sourcing the best and freshest materials can I produce the finest potions, poultices, and poisons.
Help me! Please!
Help! Someone! Anyone!
I thought I was done for.
Thank you for saving me!
Don't mind me. No one cared when I was alive, and no one cares now that I'm dead.
This bank has no affiliation with any ruler. If something like that Nantharion business happens here, your valuables won't be seized. That's the Kharzurz promise.
I can never tell from the day's rumors whether we're in danger or everything is fine. Either way, I'm glad you stopped by. Hopefully you'll find me trustworthy.
Over the years, I've built a reputation as a trustworthy banker. So, I hope no one finds out I sometimes forget to lock the door.\n\nNo, wait, why did I say that out loud?
Good day, good evening, good morrow, and good season. As is the traditional greeting in some parts of Atmora.
The Prince of Knowledge told me of your approach. You wish to challenge me. To best a master of the game of Tribute.
Construct! To me!
Stop that!
That wine … the smell makes me so hungry.
Scourge take you. What is that?
Keep those blood fiends in line!
Are the servants still off limits?
Getting all these covens and clans together, it's not natural.
This fight just got more interesting.
It's hard to sniff out intruders when that wine is making me hungry.
Watch out!
Too bad Valente couldn't add the elixir to the mead.
I'm a hunter. No blood vassals for me.
When the time comes, I want my pick of the servants.
No one will get past me.
I can't wait to drink someone's blood and try the wine.
Hah. You defeated me, but I had more blood! The Trial continues!
You defeated me, but I had more territory! The trial continues!
Hah. You defeated me, but I had more atronachs! The Trial continues!
Another atronach rises to my ranks!
This is my strategy!
More blood for my count.
I found the perfect spot for a little nap when the officers aren't looking. Now, I just need someone to complete my duties while I sleep.
The officers are all on edge because they think they've forgotten something. I'm positive I have, too. I simply choose not to worry about such things.
Ready for a change in strategy? Excellent. Strive for new growth, just as the Green Pact teaches.
<Tzozabrar eagerly awaits your command.>
You're lucky you caught me. I was thinking of closing up shop and trying my luck in the Gold Coast. What do you need?
I heard adventurers caught the Wood Elf king plotting to smother West Weald in forest. Oh, I wish I'd been a part of all that!
Someone finally dealt with the Recollection. King Nantharion's dead, or so I hear … and I missed it all! Well, how can I help you?
Watch yourself out there. I remember hearing something about Daedra and cultists stirring up trouble, but I can't remember the details. Strange.
The sort of things that just … fall off the back of a wagon might surprise you. Know what I mean?
I deal with shady customers, but I have my limits. Now that Nantharion's exposed as a Recollection sympathizer, maybe things will feel safe for ordinary thieves again.
Sounds like some adventurer finally put a stop to Nantharion and his Wildburn. No complaints here—mass destruction is bad for business.
Watch your step out there. I hear there are some Recollection bandits still skulking around. And some Daedric knights, too. What brought them here, anyway?
(Goblin GIbberish 01)
Just try hurting us now!
I will scorch you where you stand!
That doesn't look right.
Wonder where it went.
There're more enemies now.
Vyla uxun, vyla vesek. Vyla uxun, vyla vesek.
You will regret this interruption.
Witness the power of Mirrormoor!
Mirrormoor bears witness to your demise.
You failed, mortals, and you shall keep failing!
So futile. The kyn will destroy you.
A small victory. You will not fare as well with the others.
Vyla Myrr-Mahr, vyla vesek! Vyla Myrr-Mahr, vyla vesek!
Vyla Myrr-Mahr, vyla vesek! Vyla Myrr-Mahr, vyla vesek!
Vyla Myrr-Mahr, vyla vesek! Vyla Myrr-Mahr, vyla vesek!
Come forth, champion of Mirrormoor!
The circle is ready, champion!
This realm awaits, champion of Mirrormoor!
Traveler, do you think the new forest will cover all of West Weald? That it will never stop growing?
Ugh, the new Legion recruits are imbeciles. Even the God of Arms himself could not help them improve.
My scales grow dry this far from the Black Marsh. Even the hardiest tree needs good soil.
All this nonsense with the Wood Elves would never be permitted on Summerset. High Elves have always had more sense when it comes to the use of magic. I hope their whole forest burns down.
Many people fear wolves, but there is much we can learn from them. They are self-reliant, cunning, and swift. They don't fear the darkness.
Suffer the fury of Mirrormoor!
To the Champion!
Mirrormoor stands against you!
Relish your small victories.
Our power regenerates!
We shall return.
Mirrormoor, strike together!
Together we shall overwhelm you!
Despair, mortals! We are here!
Now the sky shatters!
Submit or be destroyed!
Let the sky rain glass!
Mauloch's toenail, you're good at this.
She sounds so sure of herself. Doesn't she, Tutor?
We failed.
No!
We will return!
This should be exciting!
You'll get her this time!
Suffer!
Run all you want!
Let's see if you can keep up!
The fight is still going?
If we build another arena, I want one of these.
This is just like the Vale of the Surreal!
Impressive army. I'm going to enjoy cutting it back.
Watch the ground!
This fight needed more poison.
I'm going to savor killing you.
Blood, blade, and soul as one.
What to take first? An arm? An eye?
Soon your blood will run as cold as my own.
Take those spiders to the light.
There are pools of water in the battlefield.
Did you see that technique, master?
So you stop … hang on, let me think this through. So you stop the fermentation process with a neutral spirit, and the wine becomes port. And I say any port in a storm, eh?
Arrogant Imperials! I miss the Longhouse Emperors.
Give me a proper lever, I can lift castles. Give me a proper wheel, I can move mountains. Give me the proper tools, and I can work wonders.
I have run this bank for thirty years, and my mother for thirty years before that. And her mother for thirty years before that. Never in all our time have we mislaid a single coin or valuable.
Please, please, take a look at my wares. Buy them. Wear them. Feel comfortable in them!
Felicitations! Are you seeking a restful recumbent position for recovery? Or perhaps a set of serious sundries for your adventuring life?
My uncle set me up with this shop. I'll find no better teacher than experience, he told me. So here I am.
Behold, my traveler! You have stumbled upon the riches of the world, brought to you through great personal peril by the finest adventurers! How can we be of service?
This one knows you can deal with other merchants! Charlatans! Thieves! No, only by dealing with this humble one can you truly find what you are after!
Oh, look. A customer. Just what I was waiting for. I was thinking about how I was bored out of my mind, and who should show up? You. Makes my day!
I have a strange egg-mate in Abah's Landing. She sings loudly to no one in particular, but can never remember the words. Her mind hunts in strange marshes.
When you get to be my age, you know which tomatoes you can squeeze, and which ones you should just leave on the vine.
It's a fine day for shopping, and you won't find a better selection in Skingrad. Just move aside the stuff you don't like.
My travels show me wonders all over Tamriel. But, I feel no greater thrill than finding things a good home.
You want to buy something. I can see it in your eyes. The way you cast them upon my wares. You are one who does not know what you want, but you know you want it.
The key to durable clothing is thread-count. Look at this weave. Look at the fibers we use. You could never count so many threads.
This one has traveled to the far corners of the globe, which is quite an accomplishment when you realize that globes do not have corners.
On the valorous fields of battle, the best and brightest smash each other's faces with heavy implements. I, of course, recognize my own virtues, and prefer to remain on the sidelines.
Once you've faced the perils of hand-to-hand combat and experienced the ultimate excitement of victory, you know there is no other path before you!
Perhaps you need someone to lift a burden from you? Perhaps you need someone to remove something that makes you uncomfortable or wanted by the authorities. Perhaps that someone is me?
What some do not want, others desperately need. I am here to help smooth out such transactions. Come, visit my shop, and see what I can tempt you with.
I have a wide variety of … hang on, what's the word? It's right on the tip of my tongue. Equipment! Yes, that's the word. By Trinimac!\n\nWhat were we talking about again?
Rest your weary bones for a while. And while you are here, feel free to look through my wares.
Keep an eye out for my chisel. I seem to have mislaid it. Hang on, there it is. That's fine, I can pick it up later.
You know, Skingrad is a good place to find work. I've wandered up and down the Gold Road, and this city is by far the best!
I don't like to sleep in. It interferes with my afternoon nap.
My boss said he expected me to work a full day. And I asked, all of it?
When I say I will be there in the morning to start work, I mean any time before midday. Well, midday-ish. Usually by late afternoon, if not sooner.
I can tell by the glint in your eye that you're looking for a bargain or three. Take a peek at my wares and see if there is anything that piques your interest!
I heard that Nantharion and the Recollection were responsible for the Wildburn. To think, I trusted that Elf as my king! Anyway, how can I help you?
Sad to say, Nantharion's gone. We won't see his like again. Now who's going to deal with all these Daedra bouncing about?
I can see at a glance you are a worthy soul. Please, browse through my humble wares. See if I have anything you wish to make your own.
I understand that Nantharion is responsible for the Wildburn. And that a Daedric Prince supports his activities. Imagine that!\n\nNow, how can I help you?
The news from Dawnwood troubles my mind. I hear Nantharion's plans were foiled, but plenty of Daedra still roam the area.\n\nA good thing I have plenty of stock on hand.
Yes, life as a Wood Elf in Skingrad was difficult for a while. But my neighbors have known me for years. They believe I'm trustworthy, as is my merchandise.

Perhaps you came to do some business. Or are you just a spy for Count Calantius? They're all around.\n\nI think that server next door is one of them. Too honest. You can't be that honest in a place like this.

You don't look like one of Nantharion's people. They walk around trying not to look sneaky, but they stand out like a sore thumb.\n\nNot like you. When you're being sneaky, you look like you're being sneaky.

So Nantharion rests with the Ayleids, eh? Thought that would happen. Never trusted any of his lot when they came through here.\n\nNot sure I trust you either, but that's not important. What can I hide for you?
I've heard about you. You're kind of a big deal. Took down Nantharion. Not that that is any skin off my nose, but I know you're a dangerous one. Still, I can deal with you.
Vyla uxun, vyla vesek. Vyla uxun, vyla vesek.
We three, shrouded in glass, summon the forgotten realm.
Pelt and hooves. Attack! Attack!
Grow, reach, entangle!
I left Morrowind with empty pockets and grand ambitions. Look around—you can see how far that took me.
Colovian horses are born swift and sturdy, friend. My own humble talents added little to the fine mounts before you.
I did not make these things you see—they were waiting in the wood when I found them. I merely set them free.
A fine day to you, traveler! Look around. I'm sure you'll find something you like!
These are strange days. I heard a rumor about the Wood Elf king using dark magic to grow their new forest! Thank goodness someone put a stop to that.
I don't know how it happened, but I hear the Recollection is on the run. Someone finally cornered that turncoat king, Nantharion, and put him down. Good!
Good to see things get back to normal! All that's left of the Recollection and their Daedric friends are stragglers, or so I hear. How can I help you?
Kanashurr does not need your pity. He needs your coin. Spare some or leave him be!
Do you wonder at Tethi's nickname? She knows exactly where she is. But it is true she was not a very good archer when she was a cub.
Tethi knew that no true Wood Elf could unleash that awful Wildburn. Now if she could only sink her claws into that skeever Nantharion!
Need help traveling around? No worries, Rakamati was lost many times too. He learned how to travel where he wanted and one day, you will too. \n\nNow, where did you want to go?
Defend the scion!
This path leads to your end, mortal!
Clan Shardborn has returned!
Torvesard is worried about mortals?
Shake the foundations of Apocrypha, my brothers and sisters!
Wrath! Hurt! Leave!
Nature consumes!
What is this strange mosaic?
What a strange design.
Something's coming!
Above us! Look out!
Be on your guard.
Watch for more Daedra.
Search the area for the source of the breach.
Find whatever powers this breach!
Please don't attack!
What's so special about this seed again?
We're really related to these old Wild Elves?
I'm still not comfortable working with Daedra.
We really got the drop on those legionaries!
Those things … they're unnatural.
Keep clear of those tendrils!
Those storms look dangerous.
Such wind! Where's it coming from?
Lightning! Avoid it if you can!
These storms! They're coming from the breach!
We'll all get torn to pieces by those monsters in the green woods one of these days. Might as well drink while you can.
There is powerful energy here.
I remember when the Ayleids were vibrant and alive.
I miss Valenwood.
Look sharp! Imperials could be anywhere!
You hear funny stories in a tavern. I don't much care if they're real or not. A new Daedric Prince? That's a story worth spreading. It'll sell the ale.
That fool Dark Elf played right into our hands.
That fool's notes are barely legible. They're useless!
The Recollection never tempted me. I'm in the business of helping people forget things. Not dragging bad memories back up.
No one stands in the way of the Recollection.
What are we trying to find again?
Stay alert. The Terror expects company and he wants us to be ready.
If I see that Dark Elf, I'm aiming straight for his eyes!
We've been searching forever! Are we sure this is the right place?
How much did we pay for that so-called expert?
Keep vigilant! Enemies are everywhere.
Almost a shame what we did to the town. Almost.

Bandits outside the city. Rumors of Daedra spotted near some ruin or another. Nothing changes. Not even my brews. Those only change when I run out of one. \n\nSo, drink up if you want something different.
I want a name like the Terror. How about the Fang? Too literal?

It's glorious. Magnificent even. The explosion of magic from the Wood Elves had a profound impact on other forms of thaumaturgical manipulation. \n\nIn other words, it is an excellent time to invest in some magical wares.
Do we really need all those bloodfiends?
I'm glad we came back to Sutch. The locals just taste better here. Maybe it's the water.
Balandrus's a genius, using the townsfolk against each other.

I came here from Arenthia just a short time ago. Imagine my surprise when a whole lot of other wood elves settled here too! Obliterated my homesickness, I'll tell you that. \n\nNow, I haven't been here long, but my leather's the best in Skingrad.
We should make the bloodfiends do guard duty.

Folks around here whisper behind their closed doors, like we've never faced tense times before. \n\nBut you aren't here to listen to my ramblings. Your pack's a bit small, right? Some things never change.
A vampire army! Can I be a general?
We are the lake.
I've got everything you need to make the other armies scream like hunted boars. \n\nWhat'll you be buying?
The fighting always rages on. If you need anything to hold off those cultists or their Wood Elf leader, you can get those here too.
I'm glad all that nonsense with the Recollection is over. Means there's more time to focus on winning the next fight!
Uprisings and cults pop up all the time. Don't lose sight of the battles which really matter. Or on the upkeep of your gear, which matters even more.
Psh. Newcomers! So stingy with their purses. I'd much rather see our long-absent legionaries return. At least they send some coin home from their military pay.
I got into this profession to make coin fast. So why do good flavors take so long to develop? \n\nIt still tastes good. Salt solves everything.
This pays better than the Legion ever did.
Guarding a fussy noble is boring.
I saw a quarrier carry a stone bigger than his head!
Keep a look out for the constable and her deputy.
I like being a mercenary. We're our own boss!
Quiet! Did you hear something?
Back on guard duty, you shirkers!
Who knew deserting would be so profitable?
I'm hungry but I'm not sure about the food today.

I gave you the chance to run away. That moment has long passed.

I suppose I can incite my minions to kill you faster.

That lofty Dremora won't get far. Not here.

The energy is changing. Something shifted, can you feel it?

Attack!

Hey, I remember you! Well, if you need help or are looking for something to do, I'm on vacation. Seriously. Not a writ to be had. \n\nAt least, not as far as you know.
Well, look at that. If it isn't Naryu's little hero. And meeting you here, of all places. \n\nHmm. This meeting is a coincidence, right? Forgive my suspicions, but they come with my line of work.

Kill the mortals quickly.

I think I'm getting the hang of training these wasps!
I'm not done with you.

We must move faster. Overwhelm the mortals.

Ignore the chaos and injured. Let's have a bit of normalcy here, shall we?\n\nWhat are you looking to buy?
I have a few goods to trade. Nothing like what you can get in Skingrad, but I'll happily take anything extra you have off your hands.

Let no enemy pass!
Another trophy for my collection.
Sic 'em!
Cut down any who dare breach these walls!

Return to me, my other half!
We should be able to clear these orbs.

The orbs have to be conjured from a ward!
I miss the sun and trees.

Your presence here indicates that you're interested in Storm Lord matters. If that's not the case, then please don't interrupt my post-battle recovery time.
I smoke a pipe in the same way that others meditate. It clears my mind so I can achieve perfect focus. That's why I always win at battle.
The others here offer tips on my technique despite fighting for different teams. I appreciate them.\n\nIf only my experience of the world outside this camp mirrored my experiences here.
Hush now. Let's not talk too loudly. These grapes should be ready for the Lord of Revelry soon. Now we just need those … oh, you're not the person I was expecting. Forget I said anything.
Orbs, watch out!
Can you see a focal point?
Ah is that so little ones? They say you will face great victories, but at the cost of your own death. Wait, deaths. Plural. That's … interesting.
We've been discovered!

We will never forget again!
My echo will outlast me!
We may fall, but our power remains!
Feel my arrows' sting!
Fall before my might!
Rules, rules, rules. I just want to live my life as fully as possible, but rules keep getting in the way.
Hunt, my beasts!
The forest is on our side!
Once we started the ritual, Ostumir never stood a chance.
My tharrikers can deal with anything.
We remember, we rise!
Soon Dawnwood will cover all of West Weald!
We remember, we recall.
We're nearly done. The stockade looks stronger every day.
I still don't understand how Hoperoot fell.
Always remember, never forget!
I can't wait until our forest covers the land!
I love exploring these old ruins.
We're so much better off than we were in Valenwood.

Welcome, friend. Here in Skingrad, we revere the Divines, especially Julianos, who grants us all opportunities to hone our epistemological thinking.\n\nIf you need practice, I recommend reading Lectures on the Theory of Knowledge.
Word choices matter. For example, think well upon whether you wish to categorize something as, say, a mineral. Do you know the definition of mineral? If not, then start there.
Fancy footwork, now. Don't get hit.
This can't be right. Why is this annoying compass bringing me here? All I've seen so far is wisps. My friend is not dead. Did she get turned into a wisp?\n\nNo, surely not. I refuse to believe it.
That did it!

When I set out to study the architectural practices of various Imperial cultures, I never thought I'd be standing here painting a tilted house.\n\nNature seems really angry with this particular structure.

I go away for a few weeks to hunt and I come back to this? This water smells foul. Like when my brother stuck some fish in a basket and forgot about them. But a hundred times that.\n\nNo fish you'd want to eat swim in that water.

Don't mind me. I'm just reading this cookbook I found. It has a maple-glazed bacon recipe that I hope to try after I hunt down another of these boars around here.\n\nI'm salivating just thinking about it.
When you see your usual fishing holes start to play out, it's time to find new ones. Overfishing is good for no one.
You come around the corner. You see old Firandil and you know. You just know I have something good for you today. \n\nLet's see if I'm right! Hah!
The guards around here know their duties, but everyone's fallible. I caught a pickpocket just the other day.\n\nThat one won't be dipping their hands into pockets again for months!
Yes, sleek esraj, you will soon sing to Fahuren.
Not again, Seremina!\n\nSorry about that. She doesn't want to go for a swim, but she must. And she hates being put away while I talk to others.
I advise you to leave the area. My egg-kin are shy. They will not show themselves while you are here.\n\nPlease do not take it personally. They simply do not like strangers.
I live for this time of year. When I'm not stomping grapes, I'm practicing for stomping grapes.\n\nBring on the grapes, I always say! They will be stomped. By me. Bring them all to me!
The wildburn creatures will deal with any survivors.
Let this be a lesson. The forest belongs to us.
We remember. We never forget.
They dared harm a tree!
Search every structure. Leave no survivors.
It's no fun when they die so fast.

It is good to be among clan mates again.
The Recollection will succeed.
Round up any survivors.
These creatures are so fascinating.
My creatures are beautiful … and deadly.
Rejoin me! I command it!
Kill. No survivors.
There must be a way to clear a path. Try looking around for a focal point.
The books in this Mages Guild need to be put in order. I offer to help, but they like them like this.\n\nMaybe I'll organize them while everyone else is sleeping.
I find being a mage much more rewarding than other work I've done. And I've done plenty of work. Life is so much easier with magic.

Boots that squeak can lead to death, no matter your occupation. If you're a hunter, a squeaky boot can alert your prey to your presence.\n\nAnd I've seen a tavern brawl lead to the death of someone who didn't take proper care of their footwear.
I've worked in far worse taverns than this. The kind that only serve cheap ale and unkind stares. I haven't had to break up more than two or three fights a night here!
These Ayleid ruins are significant.
Dawnway this, Green that! Can't we just pick one already?
Why is making friends so difficult?
I find it difficult to pick a favorite wine among those produced in Skingrad. Perhaps another round of tasting is in order.
I learned all about the process for making wine at each vineyard I know of. One thing the best vintners have in common is that they top up the barrels so that the wine doesn't go sour.
We don't need this mortal scum!
Mirrormoor rises, my kyn!
We shall overrun this puny realm!
Mortal weapons are so fragile.
The glory of Mirrormoor returns!
This one watches the artisans and crafters of Skingrad most assiduously, yes. But Khifeh also listens, ears a-twitching, for useful knowledge.\n\nAnd all knowledge is useful, Khifeh believes.
Never join the dance until you know the steps, stranger.\n\nNow, by Dibella's kiss, shift yourself out of my own little dance.
Foolish mortals!
Despair, mortal! You face the Shardborn.
Slay any who dare trespass here.
The Loom will soon be ready!
Our Prince wastes her gifts on mortals.
Our Prince will not be stopped this time!
The shardmarshal demands vigilance.
Enemies are near, I can sense it.
Another wounded soldier to feed.
Lure them over here!
Was something supposed to happen? Maybe check the book again.
Blessed be the name of Stendarr, the God of Mercy. He strengthens and unifies …. \n\nAh, greetings.
A tribute aspirant. Wonderful. I pray to Dibella, to hear her beautiful music as I face this challenge.

A kind face, at last. So very good to see you, my friend. Perhaps your presence will temper Shelaria's threats to kill me.\n\nYour wish to aid in this Draugrkin business is welcome. Shelaria is a competent warrior, but her injures are quite severe.
Your vision has faded. Find another focal point. Each will be in sight of a ward.
You don't need me.
(Popping sounds).
Now we're talking.
I didn't think I could get any better.
Let's make some noise.
Barely broke a sweat.
Such a show off, I love it!
Look at us go!
You're stuck! Move!
Come on, snap out of it!
We've got this. Right?
No one is going to believe this.
I'm starting to see double.
I mean that's just not fair to them.
I'm back in the fight!
You're looking hurt! Bad!
You look winded! Take a breather.
You can't throw a spell without magicka!
All this running around is a workout.
Whoa! They're so much bigger than I thought!
Dibs on the Dragon's Blood!
Let me show you how it's done.
Can we do another? Pretty please?
Ugh. I got sand in my mouth.
Should I be worried if something bit me?
I'm sorry, did we just stop a volcano?
Huh. I was hoping we'd see the big guy.
See, this is why I avoid libraries.
I keep checking myself out in their mirror bits. Is that strange?

Keep an ear out for anything exciting.
I wish I could paint this view.
Here's just a little something from me and the Garland Ring.
Lead the way.

Would you believe my family helped build this city? Everywhere I look. A reminder of the people that abandoned me.
Everyone else looks at that tower with so much pride. Admiration. I look at it and all I can think about is pain. I was tattooed in that tower. I screamed all night. And no one came to help.
After I was ousted, I slept on a lot of sofas here in Skywatch. And a few in Mathiisen. For a while, I was even happy calling this place home.
I can feel so many aches. In some very strange places.
What will we find today?
That could be useful in a pinch.
It's so beautiful. And interesting!
Ahh! Terrifying little boxes!
We're splitting that, right?
Hehehe. Heavy sack.
Now that looks fancy.
Never hurts to learn something new.
Look at you! Better keep you away from Hyacinth, I don't think he could stop himself from taking you apart.
Ahh! I hate that! You look horrible! I suppose that's the point, but no thank you. Ugh. I've got goosebumps. Don't do that!
Companion, player summons vanity pet
You can make cloth from this?
Mining always makes my teeth ache.
Do you ever pretend you're a beaver?
Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty.
Be gentle, I could feel it looking at us.
Now that's pretty.
Look at us, riding in style.
I grow tired of waiting. I'll end this now.
Oh, that's going to leave a mark.
I find the extent of my patience. May you soon find the limit of your misdeeds.
There are so many ways of getting around in this time. We did not ride as often in my day. We trekked across the dunes. Uphill. Both ways.
Where will our roads lead us today?
Tamiit! We are made stronger together.
Get ready!
We emerge victorious.
Var, var, var!
Like twin moons!
Tamiit, move!

Ba'haliin radha'szay!
Sa'pu val'rahd. In the end, we are stronger.
Dhiz maziin! Help me!
Jone's mercy and Khenarthi's swiftness. I am awed.
Bless you, my friend.
Tend to your wounds, tamiit!
By Azurah, you look fatigued.
By Magrus! Use a potion!
Wave after wave. I am glad to see it done, and with such finesse.
Like the Kra'Jun of old!
Beg the Halls of Colossus to take you back.
By the power of the Hidden Moon!
The shackles of Nirni shall not prosper so long as we are there to break them.
Sometimes I wish our adventures were less … damp. Var, var, var.
A vile use of souls. I am glad to have ended it with you, tamiit.
Truly a marvel to see the way these Druids shape and transform nature.
Kss, the stink of Oblivion. I just know it will cling to my fur.
Defending tomes and ancient knowledge is its own reward. But … I am glad it is not its only reward.
One would think creatures as brittle as glass would break more easily. Well done, tamiit.
Yes! Well done, tamiit!
Stay close, tamiit. What lurks here surely intends us no good.
I will stay close to you, tamiit. I do not wish to lose my way.
A place of such beauty eases the ache of being so far from my time.
I found this on our travels, tamiit. A small piece of my past. I wish for you to have it now.
Ahzith rabah.
I see treasure, tamiit. Quick, while no one is looking.
Shall we find someone with whom we can make a trade?
Walls. Conduct. Order. This is not the grassland oasis I knew. But perhaps that is for the best.
The braziers still burn. But they were enchanted to do so. The rest of this place is barren of life.
The comfort of a fire. As true in your time as much as in mine.
Heads. I call heads! … I suppose that counts?
Azurah knows you, tamiit? I always suspected this to be true.
A marvelous illusion! As daunting as the real thing.
Zennrili an Zennji tas jaadi atha'a, raj'kono viti shabar morna.
Ah, treasure. The draw of all adventurers.
A reward for your keen eyes.
An impressive find. Hold on to that, tamiit.
The purpose of tamiiti made manifest. We make each other stronger.
You will need to try harder than that to scare a necromancer, tamiit.
Use caution, tamiit. Taking residence in such a construct cannot be good for the soul.
As this creature seems loyal to you, I will stay my hand. For now.
A very pleasing creature. As loyal to you as Ja'kh is to me.
Spin and weave with Mafala's swiftness.
For something to attack? Or something to protect?
Do not catch a splinter, tamiit.
A potent find, tamiit.
Gah! I always forget what that rune means.
Such delicate fineries you might craft with that.
I am free to take in the sights. Ahzith rabah, tamiit.
I care little for this Tharn and trust him even less. But I admire his drive to investigate, and his desire to end this war. Let us continue, if only for Khamira's sake.
You play with the cleverness of Baan Dar.
May your bones see better use.
The Bent Dance beckons you no more.
You are a slave to your hunger no more.
Khenarthi's blessings upon this find.
S'rendarr's blessings to you, tamiit!
A very diverting game, tamiit. I will keep to myself who I bet in favor of.
I am warmed by your generous spirit.
Oh, I see. You were taking just to take.
Yes, shed the layers of your affliction, tamiit. It gives you power, but at what cost?

I hope this Tharn learns a valuable lesson in the consequences in meddling. If only power and curiosity met more often in ways that do not harm the common folk. We have our work cut out for us, tamiit.
I like this Zahari. She seems a dependable sort. The kind one might see among the Hidden Moon.
This is little better than watching you feed, tamiit. I fear for the state of your soul.
Akha preserve you. I pray for your strength to keep from feeding again.
Is it really a crime if you are never caught?
A precarious oasis in a realm of torment. I shudder to walk its streets.
Please, tamiit. Next time, let such knowledge remain drowned in the tendrils of Hermorah.
If you had seen those you love fall to the Bent Dance, tamiit, I do not think you would find this so amusing.
I thought you stronger than this. To fall prey to Sangiin's indulgence.
Spreading your curse? Why would you ask that I witness this, tamiit?
A life taken, and for what? You are better than this!
Merid-Nunda guides your greedy hands, I see.
What would they do without us?
Ugh. Stuff of nightmares, that one.
Can I count the petals? Please?
She loved me, she loved me not, she loved me ….
Huh. I guess reading can come in handy.
How hard can this be? It's just grapes.
Won't say no to a little help.
Ugh. They're nothing like the pirate novels.
Companion, player summons vanity pet
What's our story if we get caught?
We should do this again sometime!
Hear that? Somewhere, a little heart just broke.
Seriously? What's was the point of that?
Do you consider this honorable behavior?
Sorry, nearly dozed off.
About that potion … nevermind. I'll give you notes later.
Look at you go!
I can feel it humming.
Do you even know where that power comes from?
I have to admit, I was shocked to hear that King Nantharion was behind the Recollection all along. I thought I left that sort of conspiring behind when I left Morrowind.
I expected better from King Nantharion. He thought he fooled everyone, did he? Ha! In Morrowind, we don't let plots come to light before it's too late to do anything about them.\n\nAmateur.
If you think you have anywhere else to go, you're mistaken.
I spend my days looking down, searching for beautiful bones. But maybe I should look up every now and then. I might have seen that King Nantharion wasn't who he said he was.
I can't believe I followed King Nantharion out of Valenwood without suspecting anything. It all sounded so good—a place where no one could tell us what to do. But it was all a lie, wasn't it?
Finally! I hope you fight well.
You fight in my army now.
Die quickly or suffer!

It's impossible. West Weald is full of Ayleid ruins for me to study, but the Recollection hovers around them like senche-tigers guarding a kill! What was King Nantharion thinking, involving himself with those fanatics?
To think that long-lost Miscarcand was right under my feet this whole time! No wonder Nantharion chose this site for our town. If only he hadn't taken up with those cultists and Daedra!
I don't know what to think about King Nantharion and the Recollection. It's beyond me. The forest and the little creatures are the only complexities I need in my life.

Go gently, visitor—this is a difficult time for Vashabar. Half the elves here are appalled at how easily King Nantharion fooled them. And the other half are hoping it all turns out to be a misunderstanding.

You picked an interesting time to visit, traveler. A new Bosmer cultural tradition is taking shape here—the Dawnway. It is a great time to be a scholar! Although the King Nantharion scandal muddies the waters a bit.

I like to think I can smell trouble before I see it, but this business with King Nantharion and the Recollection at Hoperoot caught me completely off-guard. It makes me wonder what else I've missed around here.

King Nantharion fooled me twice. First he hid his dealings with the Recollection. Then he returned to Vashabar with a small army of Daedra after I thought he was gone for good.\n\nBut I guess he won't get a third chance, will he?
It's good to see Vashabar back on its feet. When Nantharion and his Daedric friends seized the old ruins here, I thought the town was finished. But the wind's blowing in a new direction now.
Ksss. You had me worried, tamiit.
You have done a great service to your soul, tamiit. I am overjoyed to see you embrace a mortal life once more.
Huh. For the first time since my wife and I came to Ontus, I'm beginning to think we made the right decision. The constable and the new deputy are making a difference!
I don't feel so well
My stomach hurts.
My head hurts.
I was really breaking rocks, then I just got real tired.
What's wrong with me?
Zeht heard my prayers! My husband finally found work. Now that the constable's new deputy has helped bring some order back to Ontus, no less than three farms near town want to hire him.
If this is fatigue fever, I want it to be over now.
Hard to find opponents these days ….
Goat races are always so unpredictable, but the most fun to watch!
I'm Fennorian of House Ravenwatch. I'm an arcane investigator of sorts. And yes, I'm a vampire. But I'm one of the good ones. Really.

Of all the downsides, the hunger has always been the worst for me. Before, I could ignore my need for food with sufficient distraction. Now, the blood thirst never leaves my mind. My flask has preserved my sanity on more than one occasion.

I'd like to properly thank you for your companionship on our adventures. After a life spent in a laboratory, facing real danger feels invigorating. I'd say it makes me feel alive, but, well ….\n\nAnyway, let's chase some danger together again soon.

As vampires, you and I have a responsibility to the world. We cannot feed on the unwilling or pass on this disease. I understand that hunger you feel. It overrides good sense and morality. But you must stay resolute. Be a force for good, not evil.

Just a quick casting in case I'm indisposed. Knowing myself, I may have wandered into circumstances that far exceed my ability to manage. If this is the case, I formally request your help. Please accept my appreciation of your rescue in advance.
Come back to me. As I did to you.
Besha ahziss tamiit, ja'vijah.
Aww, sorry little guy.

Impress your friends, scribe something new! Bring it with you to your next dungeon, or battleground, or whatever it is you do.
Ancient, stinks like dusty tomes. The Scholarium is my favorite kind of work environment. \n\nWho knows what I'll find, and sell to you?

You're the deputy that helped the constable, aren't you? Thanks for cleaning up Ontus, friend!\n\nI'd give you a discount, but times are tough all around. You understand, right?

If only the Hidden Moon had known of such a place. We would have honed our hadaliit into expert warriors in no time.

I almost wish this place had stayed lost.
Psijic Order? More like Psijic .... Um, forget it.
Ugh. I can feel their eyes studying me.
I would never trust a stray portal.
Hail.
Do you have the capacity to help me once more? If not would you mind leaving? I only have time for warriors with fire and determination.

There are more enemies than you can count in the archive. I hope you are as competent as you look. I would rather you deal my revenge quickly, but I am happy to wait however long it takes for those creatures to suffer.

It takes a long time for the incorporeal to manifest enough energy to collect the necessary items for a reward. So, as much as I'd love to send you back into the archive, I can't just yet.\n\nI won't have you doing unpaid labor to exact my revenge.
You're back. Tell me you killed them!
Do you hate perfect creatures?
Aren't you just perfect and precious!
Let the threads of fate restore your strength.
I hate that briny smell when they die.
At last. The shores are free from this terror you call … mudcrab.
My moonclaw reacts. A great evil shrouds this place, tamiit. Perhaps we can be of aid.
Though this place is holy to the new faith of Elsweyr, corruption from my time is the same in this one. I am glad to see the dro-m'Athra driven from these halls.
Welcome! Let the fear of my power wash over you!

My fingers seek and sense your doubt. Pierce your heart and bleed you out.

Kicking, screaming, meet your fate. Help, I fear, will be too late.

Jack-o'-lantern, upward bound. Cast your blazing eyes to ground!
The Albuses say they have a plan for revenge. Whatever it is, I'm willing to give it a shot.
I heard we're being attacked. I hope it's one of the larger armies.
Kill the invader!

For Cato and Caecilius!

You won't take my son too!
We killed everyone. Why does Orpheon want us to poke around in the sand?

Feel the weight of time!

Dazzle the enemy with your superior skills!

Please don't do anything too risky.

Yes, it's true. I am indeed the one and only Narsis Dren, famed explorer and finder of antiquities. You may know me from such adventures as the Draugr Dilemma and Ancestral Adversity. Both books were quite popular and sold extremely well!

Ah, another devoted admirer! Obviously, you know I'm the world-famous adventurer and author, Narsis Dren! Now, no need to be shy. I'll happily sign whatever you like. I just need a quill. And some ink. And maybe a sweetroll—I'm famished!
Say something?
How can I help you, friend?
Hey! I'm all ears.

It's not that I find books boring, it's more that they were all I had growing up. I wasn't exactly the pride of my family and they thought whatever was wrong with me could be fixed through rigorous study. So no books for me, thanks.
Let's not make things awkward, yeah?
You're not the worst person I've traveled with. Maybe let's leave it at that?
It has its ups and downs, but that's normal, right?
I think we make a pretty good team. Don't you?
I like to think we're rubbing off on each other.
Well. Most of the stories I tell at taverns are about our adventures now. So I say we're doing pretty good.
Honestly, I can't get enough of traveling with you. I'm always learning something new.
What do you want to know?
Yes! I love talking to you!

Ah, it's you! Have you read my latest book? I mention you! Well, not by name. Had to cut a few bits. You know how it goes. But if you need a copy, I can provide one at the friends-and-family rate.\n\nI know. I'm generous to a fault.
Name's Barbas. And yes, I look like a talking dog. That's because I actually am a talking dog!\n\nAs far as you know, anyway.

I'm Barbas. Sure, I may look like a talking dog, but I'm actually … well, I'm a talking dog. I'm Clavicus Vile's faithful hound and servant, though I have a tendency to annoy my Prince. \n\nWhy? I have no idea.
Hello again, mortal. Surprised to see me here? I am, too. But I'm exactly where my master wants me to be. And yes, that should concern you.

Not only was my mother a skilled mage, but she was a celebrated architect. I used to fawn over her worktable trying to decipher her drawings. Was it a palatial dome or an arcane circle? She'd never say. Just said one day I'd learn.

The Garland Ring has hideouts all over the Aldmeri Dominion. Caves, churches, basements. One was in a haunted Ayleid ruin! We had a member named Marigold whose whole job was to help those ghosts move on.
Something's been bugging me. If the Gardener is the Proxy Queen's uncle and Queen Ayrenn is the Proxy Queen's cousin, you don't think …? No. There's no way.
Fajh'na tah! This home is impressive.
It is always the harder thing to persuade an enemy into an ally. As in the case of Viti.\n\nI am not known for my sage advice. But when such doors open to you, tamiit, always try to take them.

Krin'ze and Viti write me often. They mean to record what I know. To salvage the history of the Hidden Moon.\n\nIt gives me hope that one day, my order may yet live again. Moons, let us hope this is so.
Eh?
Yes?
What is on your mind, tamiit?
Despite how much it has changed, I consider it my purpose to protect my homeland. Be it dragon slaying or creeping through caves, if you set out in defense of Elsweyr, please bring me along.
Azurah is infinite in her forgiveness. With you, I discover the limits of mine.
In the interest of honesty, I do not think us suited for each other's company.
Some partnerships require more effort than others. I am reminded of this lesson when I follow you.
You are my tamiit. We are partners, friends. And we guide each other through the world.
We bring light wherever we travel, tamiit.
Azurah saw fit to put me in your path, tamiit. I endeavor every day to deserve it.
Have I not exalted you in blessings recently, tamiit? Besha ahnz'ii. You are the best part of this turn on Nirni. And the one before, too.
Certainly.
Such words would make my heart light.
Think you can fight one more?
You're going to ruin everything!
Pain is my specialty.
These disruptors are more trouble than they're worth.
You will pay for that!
There's nowhere to run here.
Guards! To me!
There will be no trial.
So, Naryu. Are you two close? Think maybe you could introduce us? Just curious. Always looking to make a friend.
I could never be a detective like Mizzik. All the details, the lies? The second I get frustrated I just start throwing punches.
This Raz guy is operating on a whole other level. Disguising yourself as Queen Ayrenn? Brilliant. You think I could get his signature?
That was beautiful. Figuring out who you are. Finally feeling comfortable in your own skin.
The Veiled Heritance are all too familiar. The lengths my people will go to for power.
Being born different shouldn't make you an outcast. Manacar's made it work for himself, but how many others suffer in silence?
I understand where Cres is coming from. They just want to fit in. Be accepted. They made mistakes, but is that so wrong?
This is what happens when you let stuffy nobles run the show. People suffer, and for what? Better margins? Despicable.
You made a real difference here, I hope you know that. This tale will inspire so many others beyond these walls.
That should come in handy.
You've got a fine eye for details.
What are you going to do with that one?
Come on, let's go test it!
A useful find.
We will make better use of these stolen treasures.
Ksss … I feel eyes on us, tamiit. Be more careful, next time.
Time sees your infractions forgotten.
Fairly done, tamiit.
Really? Azurah forbid you might feel the weight of your actions.
Fascinating to see the way these scholars think.
A second life for such an old thing. Heh. Like me.
Clothing yourself in the Bent Dance? I feel as though you do not take me seriously, tamiit.
This Cadwell puts on a cheerful front, but … I do not trust him, tamiit. You should not, either.
Necromancy, here? You forget yourself, tamiit!
What use could one have for such a thing?
Vastarie illuminates a chapter of the Hidden Moon that I did not live to see. Let us discover what awaits us next, tamiit.
My tamiit, holding the Moonlight Blade. I am awed, and yet I have no doubt of you deserving such an honor. Let us continue to aid Shando-ri.
It fills my heart with sorrow, learning at last the fate of my order. But to see two souls made whole depart for the Crossing together … I am glad we could see it done, tamiit.
The ascension of a new mane. I never thought I would see such a thing in my lifetime. It was an unfair choice to put on you, but I think you made the right one, tamiit.
Khamira, made queen of Anequina. How different this world is from my time. But then or now, it would be clear to me she will make a great leader.
My thoughts are with Abnur Tharn, tamiit. I had not expected a sacrifice from one such as him. May his soul know peace, wherever he is now.

The wall of life … restored. I am moved by our work here, tamiit. I pray for Dak'radhi now. That Vijari's soul might find his on the roads to the Crossing. That they both find peace in Azurah's embrace.
I grasp for words, tamiit. The false prophet himself. A choice to doom one of the sisters to a dark fate. The injustice of it wounds me. But we must keep going.
My tamiit, Moon Hallowed. As if there was ever any doubt in my heart. With all your practice guiding me, I think you will make a fine guide for Khali and Shazah.
They couldn't set up camp somewhere less damp?
What's our next move? I'm tired of waiting.
It's a simple process. A child of five could do it. Unfortunately, we don't have a child of five, so I'll be forced to walk you through it.
Go to your room, Abnur.
I think I understand, Sai. You need to put aside your duty, just this once, and focus on what you want.
I have never been content to remain in one place for too long. It is not my nature. Eventually I am overcome by the need to endanger myself. Between comfort and adventure, I always choose adventure.
Have you seen the Prime Sorcerer cast? I thought I was powerful.
My Lord's son was so young when he died.
Eliminate them!
Meddlers!
Enough! To me, my steed!
You will suffer like no other!
Kill them already!
Bring the spiders to the storm!
No one can stop us. You stand no chance!
Don't underestimate me, Vandorallen.
You're not worth my effort.
Isn't it time you fought your own battles?
You still haven't learned to conserve your energy. Martus must be disappointed.
Your spiders don't scare me. Not anymore.
Kss! You try my patience.
I'm lost. It's so dark here.
I shall cleanse this scourge!
This has happened before!

I need a moment!
See clearly!
For the honor of the Dominion. Stay vigilant.

I am pretty sure Hyacinth has a stack of those at his greenhouse.
Face me, tamiiti!
It's good to get a break from the forges.\n\nIf you have unwanted items, I have an eye for materials. Care to deal?

And such perseverance deserves my greatest reward. Keep it up, champion. Strive for victory in every match, no matter who your opponent may be.
Any victory should be marked with a reward, no matter its size. Keep it up, champion. Strive for victory in every match, no matter who your opponent may be.

Our skill is rewarded!
Perhaps a challenge, next time?
An ideal outcome!

A sun-blessed day!

We did it!
Y'ffre's smiling today!

Easier than target practice!
Excellent teamwork!
I knew we could do it!

Glory to Akatosh!

We are victorious!

Enjoy this win!
Victory for the sharp claws!

A toast to our win!
We'll feast later!

We won, by Mauloch!
Cower before your victors!

Well played!

The honor is ours!

We'll steal the win back next round!

We'll do more next time!

Let's rally! I'm ready for a win!
Next time we'll send them back to the ancestors!
May the Three have mercy! We'll take them!

They can't win forever!
A bitter loss! Forget it and move on!

My pride is wounded, but not my spirit!
Lick your wounds and return to the game!
Skeeving horkers! I crave victory!

We'll take them next time!
They won't be laughing when we come for them!
We won't lose again!
We'll have vengeance!

For Jone and Jode!

Forward to victory!

Claws out, ready for battle. Don't let them win!

Greetings, walker! Know that you are in the presence of Za'ji, proud captain of the Perfect Pounce, the finest vessel to sail the Topal Bay! No need to bow. Just throw a few coins, yes?

Walker, it is good to see you again! Have you had as many adventures as Za'ji had since we last sailed together? \n\nNo, do not say! Za'ji does not want to yearn for your exploits. Not while he is sober.
Another Khajiit! This is a fortunate day. Za'ji might know where to find some fine wine and moon-sugar cakes. A good way to pass the time, yes?

Every now and then I wonder if I could enchant an entire castle. If I could turn Haven into an ensorcelled fortress, imagine the possibilities!\n\nBut enough dreaming! Do you have any enchanting needs?
Last night, dreamers, Vaermina sent an Omen of Mortal Foreboding to me! It ordained a death among us, I sense a prisoner will soon die.

From what I heard, there was functionally no risk of the invaders breaching our vault. I cannot stress enough how secure this structure is—I'd even say as secure as law.\n\nOf course, it took some time for us to be informed of the safety outside.

If you've anything you need to keep safe for a while, please, let us assist you. It is the least we could do for you, as without you we may have been hiding in the vault for a very long time.\n\nAnd there are only so many books in there.
Even with its troubles, Summerset Isle is peaceful compared to what we've suffered here.\n\nIf you hunger or need rest, my home is yours.

Thankfully, you routed the easterners before they could discover the meaning of stairs. We'd have been destitute without you!\n\nShould you need anything to drink, you need but ask. We are friends, after all.
My nightmares are growing darker.
I could really use a drink.
For the Empire.
What can I help you with, my friend?
In time I'm sure I'll be able to offer you more, but for now,  I have only what remains to me after the raiders were cleared out.\n\nFeel free to have a look. I'd have much less without you here.
I must admit, I appreciate your efforts in this city. Haven has been my home for quite a while.
Ah, it is you! Our own local hero. Without your five claws, our hall would stink of the dead.\n\nPlease, stay as long as you like.
Please don't interrupt. I must monitor my pupils. Thank you for saving the city, and all that.
Leave this place! You are not welcome!

It certainly seems like we've got some impostors calling themselves fighters around here. They were inside the hall! Inside of it!\n\nThis guild needs some cold water down the codpiece. I do hope you're the one to pour it.
I tell you, be glad the Jackdaws lacked any real fighting style. I'd call it "Silt Striders Rutting at Dawn"—a lot of awkward flailing, but still dangerous if you get too close.
Ah, the five-claws who conquers those who conquer Haven. If Bad Swimmer can be of any assistance to you, he will do so, happily.
One of the great things about fishing is there's always fish in the sea, even when pirates storm on by.
I'll kill the intruders and bring you their heads, my love!
I firmly believe one must be armored, but mobile. Too much steel deprives you of this, fatigues you.
Saving an entire city must be difficult work. Easier if you were clad in my fine wares!
A well-oiled blade can be the difference between a confident person and a corpse.
What good were walls for this city? You want real defenses, put your guards in the trees. Nothing like a rain of arrows to greet invaders.
Your friend always had the opportunity to free himself. All he needs to do is reveal the location of the Amulet of Kings, and you can all be on your merry way.

Rakkhiza sees you, walker, and saw your five claws bared in quelling the raiders of Haven. She assures you, if interested in any of this one's fine brews, you will see a far better price than Rakkhiza offers any other walker!\n\nSo please, enjoy!
The Jackdaws are fragrant in the worst ways.
The whole plaza smells like ash. Do the undead smell like that normally? Was this special, somehow?
Wayrest will burn!
I wonder if we can expand Haven's walls. Maybe into the sea? We need to ensure nothing like this can ever happen again.
I don't know what the Altmer and Khajiit do with their dead. I guess that's their business.
Did they think they could simply sail away with our riches? We showed them a thing or two!
Panisa asks you, is it the Argonians? Do they swim here, eating all the fish?
Greetings, warrior. How can I help you?
My equipment is only for the heroes of the Pact!
The best equipment for the Covenant's finest warriors, right here!
I was just thinking of you. We need your services once again.

One of the worst things about fishing is there's always a storm on the horizon. We didn't see this one coming, though.\n\nSeems like I'm the only fisher willing to barter, too. Times are rough, but if you've got to, you've got to.
Pack overflowing? I can help.
Please listen to me.
We put the magic in magic-user!
Wading into enemies with an axe in each hand? You'll need armor!
Soft fabrics for the discerning mage. No chafing!
Real armor isn't stitched with thread. It's forged in fire.
"In the shadow of <<1>>," you said. "Perfectly safe," you said. Ha!
No, no, no …. What did he ever do to you?
You doggies don't… eat people, right?

I, Jacmund Cine, bring my wares to all the people I meet! Whether they need them, well, that's up to them.\n\nRegardless, I usually stroll by some infrequently-visited communities. I reach out to them, in these troubled times.
If you're looking for some of my stock, let's make it quick, all right?\n\nI have a schedule to keep.
Everywhere I go, lately, there is some new disaster. It would bring me such joy to bring my wares to a place untouched by all of this strife.
Where do all these cultists even come from?
Mezha-dro wishes there were a person like you for every Daedra worshiper in the world.
Over here!
No scouts here, just my neighbor. Although, this is certainly an … interesting arrangement.
Just what I wanted!
I'll give you the blood eagle before I'm done!
Greetings. I have another urgent mission for you.
Excellent timing. We urgently need you on another mission. Ready?
How can I help you?
Greetings, walker. You are here to purchase my wares, yes?
You honor me with your presence, warrior. Peruse my wares?
You can look, but my equipment's only for battlefield warriors.
I sell only the best equipment, and only to the best warriors!
If you have proven yourself on the battlefields, perhaps my stock would interest you?
I'm trying to make the best of this situation, but I miss having a proper roof above my head.
I think I might move away from Rivenspire. I hear Glenumbra is nice this time of year.
I'm dying, killed by a reachman… Father always said it'd end this way…
Where… Where is Sir Etienne?
Tell my wife I love her very much…
Those animals were going to kill us!
That's the one who made us fight!
So this is life in cities free of the ash. The air is so clean here.
I have a cousin in the city of Lord Vivec. I've not heard from him in some time… I wonder if they are seeing as many immigrants as we are?
I have family working the mines near Gnisis. I wonder how things are back home?
We've been lied to!
There must be more to see.
I would give anything to have died in their place.
Destroying the totems is the first step to restoring the natural order.
You must end a great injustice.
You're the champion who scared the Wood Orcs away from Bramblebreach!
Is it true you saw the Wilderking?
A friend of mine was killed by vampires in the moors near Longhaven. Thank you for clearing those monsters out.
Just when we think we're done with them, the Veiled Heritance turn up again. It's a good thing you were there to stop them.
Is it true Vicereeve Pelidil was leading the Maormer attack?
I heard what you did at Moonhenge! How did you escape in time?
You're the one who stopped the Daedric invasion at Moonhenge.
The hero who defeated the lich prince! The Dominion is truly in your debt!
Hungry … so hungry ….
More from the south! Let's get them!
More in the ruins! This one needs help!
There's a group coming in from the east!
Ngh!
So much death…

All this fighting between the nobles … it makes no difference to us common folk. I don't care a cup of bitter wine who ends up ruling Rivenspire.\n\nSpeaking of wine, I may have a bottle or two. If you're interested.
Here's to this dunghill of a city! And to every one of the nasty fools who still live here!
Has anyone seen my wife? This is important! \n\nI think she might be dead. Actually, I know she's dead. I need another drink.

Now, Shornhelm used to be a fine place to live. A fine place. But lately Shornhelm has become downright terrible.\n\nI swear I saw an old friend of mine skulking around the other night. And she's been dead for more than a year!
Anyway, that was the second time I caught collywobbles. You'd think I'd learn, eh?
Silver's getting more expensive. It's going to get hard for me to keep up.
Sometimes I feel that my succulent morsels are wasted on this clientele. Perhaps the High King and his court will let me cook for them while they're in town.
My cart carries only the best. Only the best. I guarantee it.\n\nFeel free to take a look and let me know if you want to purchase anything.
What a glorious place. I am going to kill a lot of people here.
How do I keep making losing bets? How? Am I… cursed?
This town is broken. Flee while you can!
What will my wife think? Perhaps… I might fight, myself. I could recoup my losses that way.
Bloodsport. May it never die.

Kurshara-daro is a firm believer in sampling one's wares, you see? The problem is, with a wager, one owns not the fighter they back.\n\nIt is a concern. Kurshara-daro is no slaver, but she feels strange not having the experience.
How could I lose so much? Rigged, the fights have to be rigged!
And if I fight, do you suppose I would be matched with others like myself? I would not be fighting any mammoths, no?
Some other Bosmer grapple with the concept of "money." It's so easy to get! You just place a bet on the fighter you'd sooner eat.
How could we ever recover from this?
Trust me, everything's going to be just fine.
I suppose eventually something like this happens everywhere, right?
I don't think I was affected, but could I really be sure of that?
Sacred Arbiter, take pity upon your humble servants.
However this disaster befell Southpoint, I pray the Eight guide us toward health and stability in its aftermath.
Heroes don't kill.
You are sick.
So this is Falinesti. Hardly what I expected.
The Psijic Order could have hidden Falinesti. They have their fingers in all sorts of pies.\n\nEven pies in Oblivion.
Be cautious. Frost trolls await the unwary within the site.
Where is Falinesti, you ask? Another realm, I believe. Consider if the Walking City spearheaded the Dominion invasion of faraway Akavir!\n\nSuch things do happen, you know.
What mysteries will Falinesti hold for us upon its return?
I believe it's possible Falinesti walked into the sea. What if our Sea Elf cousins stole it to their island home? Makes sense, if you think about it.
Was it the people who walked, or the trees themselves? What a conundrum.
Falinesti was clearly taken from this realm by Y'ffre. But to where? What realm does Y'ffre call home?\n\nI must write my colleague in Artaeum. He may have some thoughts on the matter.
My pack serves me, even in death!
Such tenacity! Such ambition! Such bravery! Such a pity we're going to skin you alive and feast on your intestines!
I'll make you listen, like all the rest of them!
You aren't worthy of its power!
For … obvious reasons the port's been blocked for a time. I've still got a few casks and kegs of reasonable quality for my best customers.\n\nFancy a drink?
Smash it in the head. Keep it away from me!
Madgod's breath upon your soul. Endless light shall make you whole!
Doing my job.
I'm doing my job. My job is horse things.
It's good knowing the city is safe, isn't it? I hope we can keep it that way.
I am disappointed, Centurion Longtail. Look alive!
If the key's in the house, how is the door locked? I just don't understand.
It takes a lot of planning to get a job done right.\n\nSo, that is exactly what I'm doing. Planning.
We must find another fang! Let none stand in our way!
None can stand against the might of the goddess!
Why don't you stop this, Nerien'eth? What purpose does this serve?
Make this stop, Nerieneth. I've done nothing!
Emerge the victor, and my knowledge is yours.
Camoran filth!
It does not matter where the mortals are when the Dragon Breaks. Only that they remember.
Blasted sneak-thief!
Come along.
You aren't one of us!
Eh?
Krin Ren-dro invites you to come visit the beautiful town of Pa'alat! All are welcome beneath his roof!
Hear and learn! Pa'alat controlled by Dominion troops! Ayrenn orders execution of Ren-dro's collaborators!
Spikeball races at all hours of the day and night! Come, race, bet, win! Only at Hadran's Caravan!
Tired of the old, boring troll fights? New management at Hadran's Caravan has pulled out all the stops!
Stop, you can't go in there!
Why must he continue to suffer, Nerien'eth?  Stop!
All the secrets of Apocrypha shall be mine!
We need a trebuchet, or ten.
Whatever you do, don't trip on your sabatons in the middle of a battle! \n\nTrust me, it's awful.
Please—release me from this wretched body.
When will it rain for us?\n\nHey, miracle worker. Why don't you tackle that next?
I, for one, am very glad to see the backs of those insufferable lutes. Louts.
Shh! The guards will kill us all if we stop working.
Few people recognize the power inherent in a fine mount.\n\nHorses are powerful, majestic creatures. And upon one's back, so too shall you seem!
Virtually anything is poisonous in the right amount, did you know that?\n\nEven water. It is hard to imagine, having so much water it kills you… But it is a thing that can happen!
Welcome to the Magical Ring! You want enchantments, is it not so?
Keep fighting like that and you can kiss your ears goodbye!
I wonder what you'll sound like … talking without a head!
Do you think it'll be like last time? With all the blood?
If everything is fine in Alik'r, I will return to the Queen's side.
If the Falinesti Faithful didn't need us to wet nurse them, we'd be fighting alongside the rest of the Jade Dragoons.
Don't worry about me, I'm fine. Do whatever you're here to do.
I get this feeling we need more pitch. I can't explain how or why, I just feel that we need it.
I have many fine brews!\n\nMost from right here, but there are many, regardless!
Whatever hungers you may have, this one can satisfy them!
Seek succour with the most succulent of foods you will ever find!
It is factually impossible for you to find finer brews than mine.\n\nI have special brews, you see … for they are mine.

The potentialities of alchemy, though vast, are by nature finite. The secret is: You can brew potions from nearly anything.\n\nThe limit is: 'Anything' is a known quantity at any time. You only have so much of anything. Acquiring more is the trick.
What are you afraid of? Words?
I've spent a great deal of my life contemplating and studying enchantment and the soul.\n\nAnd I don't care any more. If you'd like to buy my materials or findings, good luck.

The Code of Malacath does not rely upon the finest of weapons. It's actually better to prove your strength with sticks and stones.\n\nThat's why I do all my smithing with a big rock. Hammers are for toothless weaklings.

This one is sometimes concerned. Much killing is done with this one's trade, yes? So then, is that blood on her hands?\n\nSomething of a conundrum. Sashawi is thinking, perhaps, many who die invite their own deaths, yes? They choose to eat steel.
I hate clutter, mess, and chaos.\n\nThat's why I make and sell bags! So handy to keep things in.
You have anything for Nagaddu?\n\nOr you need anything Nagaddu has to sell? Either way, he is here.
A fine staff is like a spell. But, you hold it in your hand!\n\nI can't think of any easier way to get a grip on spellcraft.
<<1>> is dangerous for couriers who don't stick to the roads. I used to lose one every week until I started advertising for capable adventurers.
The finest of weapons cut and pierce. A sword or dagger? These do both.
Bandits use this pass more often than anyone else, for it circumvents the main route via the garrison.
Many of the beams which support this place were salvaged from an ancient ship.
Get out of here or jump in the stew, the choice is yours, skeever tail!
A sword of quality should be capable of shearing through your enemies' armor, as well as your enemies.\n\nIf it cannot do so then it's hardly quality, is it?
I wonder if we would have ended up thusly if not for your aid.
Do you see any discarded notes, journals or … well, that is a concern for another time.
You'll like the way you're dressed! I can guarantee that, I think.
Wear nothing unbefitting one of your station; that is my rule.
Looking to save your skin? Well, wear some more skin over it. It really is that simple.
Armor that does not hinder you from jumping and skulking about, yes? Marnub has this and more.\n\nTrust in Marnub. He does you no wrong.
There's an old Orcish saying about shields.\n\nI don't remember what it is, I'm just saying. There's an old Orcish saying. Buy a shield.
I can find a way to get you nearly anything. I can also find a buyer for nearly anything you might have.
Once you ask us to store an item of yours, our guarantee is that nobody will ever touch it again.\n\nExcept for you. Usually.

Satuhaz wagers, if one were to bring a pack of armored trolls to break into our vault, our trolls would be the victors in that scenario.\n\nWhy, you might ask? This one has the answer: Our trolls are vampires.
Things are never safer than with us, here.
What are our vaults made of? I'm not sure. Probably solid ebony, two feet thick.\n\nAnd inlaid with Dragon's bones. Studded with glass and graven in runes of impermeability.
It has to be here. It must be here!
Take it from me—your goods are safe here.\n\nEspecially safe from me. They don't let me handle anything. I have to pass it all to a trusted intermediary.
Never ignore what occurs in your homeland. This is how I lost sight of the corruption in my own men.
Whatever wall stands, there exists such a force as to knock it down.\n\nThe delivery of that force is my specialty; it is what I live for.

I don't really like… working with siege engines. The size of team needed to work with one is probably not worth the effort.\n\nIf we could replace every siege engine with a master of destruction magic, we'd probably be better off for it.
Khunzum cautions the unwary: Cyrodiil is not nearly so stable as our Aldmeri territories.\n\nHe is putting this lightly, Khunzum should say.
I serve defenders of Aldmeri interests. Proven defenders, that is.
Need a bed for the night?
This one can sell you a bag to store anything.
Since we've had more High Elves and Khajiit around, the food has gotten much more varied in Elden Root.
I really can't stand flin, but it's fairly popular. I'm not sure why. Maybe it's all the whisking?
Hello. How may I be of service?

In learning to fight better, I've broken every bone in my body. Every single one. Including the bones in my ears.\n\nI've also broken every bone I could find to break in others. You know how much force it takes to break a vampire's fang? A lot!
This one acknowledges the limitations of placing the guildhall in this great tree. It is hard to reach.\n\nTrekking supplies in could be more difficult, this one supposes … but not by much!

There is an intriguing connection between the sugar and translocation. It makes this one keenly able to move goods between guildhalls, yes? The feeling is difficult to describe.\n\nMight Lamaia help you?

When studying magic, one must simply accept that certain factors of magicka will elude one perpetually.\n\nFortunately, for those times there are individuals like myself—willing and able to guide others toward understanding.
Where's our embassy?
You can't just pave the Grahtwood!
How can you ignore your allies like this?
Once I have my body back, the mortals will suffer! I'll make them all suffer ….
Hold fast to your family, wayfarer. You never know when they might be taken from you.
This one wonders … are they building our embassy in our style of construction but of stone? It would be perhaps cold, yes.
I have things I must do. I cannot wait forever.
Has anyone seen the king yet? Anyone?
Come get some more, you skeeving horkers!
Please, don't hurt me! I have nothing to give!
You think to steal from me? Have at you!
Who are you? Why do you bother one who has no interest in you? Go on with your business, and leave me to mine.
See the world, he said … what a joke.
Everyone spits on me and takes my things. Those are my things! Mine!\n\nYou can't have them. I've been to Oblivion and back, all to get these things. These things which are mine. So just back off!
I don't have anything for you to take. Please don't hurt me.
I wish I could fight. If I could, I'd clear the trash out of the Middens. All the trash that people let pile up in here.\n\nYou know the type. Trash that fights back.
I may be blind, but I can still sense what occurs around me.\n\nAnd if you touch my candle, Auri-El grant me the ability to stay my destructive hands ….
The new Arena Champion! Cheers!
Champ, do you have another match soon?
This is our food, friend. Ours. Fair and square.

Do you not see the truth of things? The creatures that have invaded this place—they're as warped by Oblivion as I am. As you are.\n\nFlown too close to Aetherius, our wings burned off, crystallized, fell away ….
I wonder sometimes if I'm really here. Not here, as in the physical location.\n\nThe question is more … do I really exist? Do you? Does anyone?
The smell down here … it is so rancid. <<1>> does not know how much longer she can bear it.
This one studied fighting in a temple of the Two-Moons Dance.\n\nBut this does not mean <<1>> is able to use that to bring us back to our feet. Fighting alone is not enough, yes?
This one wonders … if he is to eat these flowers, how sick will they make him?
Is that you? No … you're not my son.\n\nIf you see him, tell him to come visit me. And to bring my rug.
First … I eat. Then … I muddle out how I even got here.
I've seen betty netch with more energy than you!
You must be full of blood! You keep losing so much!
What are you even trying to do, little Elf? You call this fighting?
My babies are starving! Please!
One thing is sure—if the Reachmen attack, they will spare no one!
I think this band would sound better if it was made of hoarvors.
Stop … just stop it!
You will burn!
Hey, you. Got any spare coin?
Hey, walker. You give this one directions to Redfur, yes?
Tirdas is even worse than Morndas. I'm already tired and I still have too much to do.
Relax, sit down, have a drink!
Put your weapons down and unwind. All that … whatever it is you do, it's got to be a big source of stress.
If a bird greets you, sing to it in reply. Your song will be the echo of an echo of an echo of Y'ffre's own, and thus holier for it.
They're dead. My friends are dead. A thousand curses upon the Worms!

The living moment is encapsulated within the song of every living creature, metered out by the pulse of its heart.\n\nYour heart is your life's drum, the beat to which you always move and think. The Now is your life in any moment as you see it.
