Pacrooti tries to keep things simple. What he will never understand is why others insist on making them so complicated. Also women. Pacrooti will never understand women.
Ahhh! Hmmm!
This one did not get in trouble for his recent mischief. The guard was not even sure which Khajiit to blame. The Magister does not hire them for their brains, it seems.
So many things to learn here! I'm sure of it. No, positive of it! Definitely positive.
The pay is good, but if I have to listen to Gilyan complain about digging one more time ….
Slavers? I don't know anything about slavers. If you need to get from here to there, then we can talk. But slavers? You want to talk to my brother about that.
All aboard who's going aboard! Next stop, Vvardenfell!
This ship sets sail for Dark Elf lands. Are you sure you want to make such a journey?
The lands of the Dark Elves aren't for the casual traveler, but yes, I can take you to Vvardenfell.
Pirates? Not on this journey! They know better than to sail anywhere near my ship!
Have you sailed on a ship before? If you're prone to sea-sickness, tell me up front and I'll stock an extra bucket.
My passengers don't need to worry about a thing. Not a thing. We take care of everything. And in the most delicate manner possible. Now, would you like to join us?
Did you look at the book? A true dungeon delver would have gotten it right on the first try.
I cannot wait to see his face when he finds out.
I don't like the way the mountain rumbles these days. Makes me glad we're about to set sail and leave all this disaster behind us.
I demand you make way and let me see Lord Vivec!
Lord Vivec, protect us!
Red Mountain! It's erupting!
There's the thief! Give me back my pig!
Anyone seen a suspicious character with a pig? No, not me!
Did I lend Vardette's Kwama treatise to someone?
Ah, a fellow adept! I trust your search for knowledge goes well despite all the turmoil in this distant land?
The Fighters Guild is always ready for battle. It's what we live for!
It is my great pleasure to tend to all visitors. How may I help you today?
Can I help you? Speak up. We won't live forever, you know!
Do not listen to the gloomy portent of the mountain. Business has never been better. Come! Do your trading here.
I don't think this will work.
Do not worry, friend, all of these goods were obtained most legally. The Telvanni here would have it no other way.
Speak of your desires. I am certain the Telvanni can help you.
Greetings from the Telvanni, the kindest slave-owners in all of Vvardenfell. How can I be of assistance?
The Telvanni are too busy spitting in each others' soups to focus on true magecraft. Join the Mages Guild, see what real magic can be like.
I pity these Telvanni tricksters. So proud of their fungal towers. Guild wizards could grow a mushroom twice the size in half the time!
Need a change of scenery, friend? The Fighters Guild is looking for recruits. We'll send you places you've never dreamed of!
Sadrith Mora is so isolated, I'm surprised to see another member of the guild out here. Be sure to find me anytime you're in need of companionship.
They burned everything we had—but at least we're alive! Thank you!
What kind of vines throb and bleed?
For the Hunt-Father!
Stand, slave! Don't you have more to say?
The machines will reinforce!
We are the chosen! The Dreadhorn will rule this land!
The Forge is my heart!
Don't you recognize Telvanni excellence?
House Redoran?
Greetings, Hlaalu!
Hlaalu, friend?
Hlaalu? Most certainly!
May your pouches overflow with gold!
Redoran, friend?
Redoran! Is there any other?
May your sword never lose its edge.
Telvanni?
House Telvanni, the best of them all!
Let me summon the portal.
No matter the threat, the Scarlet Judge will protect us.
Catch any bad ones today? Oh, what am I saying! Of course you have!
You honor us, Scarlet Judge. Be safe!
Ah, the Scarlet Judge again. Suran never ceases to entertain.
There's that noise again.
And here we … no.
Do not worry about Red Mountain. Vivec always protects us and our homes. Truly, your purchase will not be regretted.
Yes, feast your eyes upon these splendors. All could be yours! If only you had a place to live and put them.
I can only deal with clients possessing either fame or notoriety. Guild rules and all that. I suppose you qualify, though.
Fame spreads like weeds in a garden. But fame is like the good weeds. Not the strangling, kill all the plants weeds. Um, can I show you my wares?
The rich and the famous intimidate me, so you must realize how flustered someone of your status makes me feel. Please, have a look at my wares for your home.
No home? I'm not sure why you would need these things, but I will sell to you if you wish.
I'm sure your royal abode is already filled with lovely furniture, but there's always room for more!
Tales of your deeds travel far and wide. Is there anything you need for your homestead?
Not every battle can be won, but a well-furnished home to return to makes the loss a little less bitter. Why not take a look for yourself?
It's an honor to have your exalted personage visit my humble shop. I'm sure your home receives many esteemed callers. Perhaps my wares can remind them of your great accomplishments?
Tales of your deeds travel far and wide. But how will you let others know of your accomplishments? Perhaps some choice furniture pieces in your home would do the trick.
News travels fast in these parts. It says that my furniture is the best around. Take a look and see for yourself.
Papa always tells me that I'm the best shop girl he's got, but I'm the only one he's got! Compliments are nice and all, but only when deserved.\n\nSo, well, hello. What do you need?
It's hard not to think about Baar Dau, but I'm sure shopping will help. It'll at least take the edge off! I know a lighter coin purse always makes me feel better. Take a look at my wares.
Use my levitation sigils!
Red Mountain's bubbling and boiling like an overstuffed pot of fermented meat juice! I sure hope it settles down before something terrible happens.
Curse this confounded island! And this blasted map!
Every time we get close, that murderer Omellian slips away!
Every time we get close, Omellian slips away! What connections does he have?
Welcome to the wild frontier of combat, Emperor. It will be interesting to see how well you do in these old Daedric ruins.
These old Daedric ruins can overpower a rookie, but someone like you might actually make it. Not that I'd put any gold on your survival. Just saying.
Watch your step in there, outlander. The fighting in Ularra is faster than anything you've ever seen on the battlefields of Cyrodiil.
I never expected to see the famed Cyrodiil Emperor join something as barbaric as the battlegrounds ….\n\nWell, to each their own.
These Dwarven ruins might not kill a veteran of the battlefield like you, but they'll certainly try. Only fools abandon caution.
I've seen many eagerly set foot into Ald Carac for the games. And I've also seen many exit, eager to leave. Watch yourself in there.

It must have taken Vivec himself to get someone of your stature to come harass me about the quarry. I know. I know. They need the stone to finish building the city, but the fighting! It's just too much for someone like me. I'm no warrior.
Praise the Tribunal! You look like someone strong enough to knock some sense into the fools fighting over the quarry. Well, don't stand around dawdling. Go on. Fight!
Are you looking to get yourself killed? Go ahead. Step into the battles of Foyada Quarry. It seems like every other fool on Nirn is in there.
Vermin infestation in transport circuit. <<1>> required for extermination.
Maintenance order submitted for <<1>>. Current backlog of maintenance requests: 2,308,547.
Quarantine failure. Infestation counter-measures deployed.
The Pit Daemons are going to take the field and tear all those Fire Drakes to bits. Just wait and see!
Pit Daemons think they can rule Deathmatch? Ha! As if! Fire Drakes have that locked down.
Next Domination match, Storm Lords are going to take all the capture points. I'm personally going after the Pit Daemon ones. I still owe them for the loss last week.
This one fights among many in the Battleground. As such, she might have to battle you one day. So perhaps it is best not to speak to her, yes?
Sure, the games can be a tad risky. But where's the fun without at least a little chance of decapitation?
Last week, this crazy lady jumped down and tried to kill me. She landed wrong and nearly broke her leg. Funniest thing I've seen in months.
If my team is all Dark Elves again, I think I'll throw myself into Red Mountain.
Word of advice? If you don't want to be put to work, avoid Foreman Mevel. It's much more fun to fight inside the quarry than gather stone all day.
What's keeping Mevel? Doesn't he know I need that stone? What's going on at Foyada Quarry? I'm about to go down there myself and give the fetcher a piece of my mind!
I can't shield all of you, get off the platform!
The secondary terminals are attempting to compensate! Give them a whack!
Heat accumulation approaching threshhold. Pressure release valves opened.
Rosy! I have some treats for you!
Did you find some yummy bugs?
What could be keeping that crew? We need to get that stone to Vivec City!
Savarak really seems to care about Vos. He's always in town. I never saw Mistress Dratha outside her tower unless she absolutely needed to leave.
Nothing around here ever changes. Maybe I should go to Eastmarch.
Mistress Dratha would have dealt with the Black Snails by now. I hope the new magistrate does something soon.
Vos is such a nice place these days. I'm glad I don't have to work so hard anymore.
I haven't seen Lord Vivec in days. Do you think we've disappointed him? We're all trying our best, I swear it by the Three!
As soon as I finish this, I'm collecting my pay and leaving. Baar Dau isn't going to kill me!
Don't worry about Baar Dau, Lord Vivec has it all under control again. In fact, I was never frightened at all!
Ugh! These cantons will never be finished with freed laborers. Perhaps if I complained to Lord Vivec, he could make an exception for us. These delays really can't be tolerated.
Why, Vivec! Why! The moonlet will destroy us all!
Perhaps one day there will be slaves in the city again, and everything will be as it should. Until then, I need to keep my eye on these so-called wage-workers.

This city becomes more beautiful with every passing day. It inspires even the greatest warrior to put down their sword and pick up a quill, just like our Lord Vivec.\n\nI've never been particularly good with my letters, though, so I'll hang onto mine.
How can this be happening? This glorious city can't be destroyed!
I wonder what all the excitement was about? Was Lord Vivec testing us? Maybe it was a lesson of some sort?\n\nI expect we'll hear all about it at the next sermon.
Another fine day in the service of Lord Vivec! I think I might even compose a song today!
What's wrong with you? Don't you realize the sky is falling? Get to safety until Lord Vivec gets everything under control.

Now that the city is safe, I feel like singing the praises of Lord Vivec from the tallest canton!\n\nActually, I really do feel like that. If you'll excuse me, I have to go and figure out which canton is the highest.
Building a city is hard work, but now that I am a free wage-worker, I gladly perform the labors they ask of me.
The land rumbles and shakes! The sky falls from above! What's next? No, don't tell me! I'd rather not know.
Now that the city is safe again, I hope they decide to build more cantons. Job security is a wonderful thing for a wage-worker.
While fools charge into battle, the wise prepare first. Which are you?
I sell only the finest things for the finest combatants.
It's keeping me alive to pry open the rift!
This land, it takes a lot to get used to. I don't know how the Dark Elves can stand it.\n\nIf it wasn't for the decent benefits and generous pay, I'd go back to Daggerfall in a heartbeat.
Hortator and Incarnate … must rise. I have to prepare. I have to ….
I don't remember groveling that much when I was a wretch.
Quiet. It can hear us.
You take. You take.
Mine? Mine!
Has anyone fed that thing lately?
I tricked that Armiger! You saw that, right?
Hungry One looked at me!
Me think that one's alive.
We can always use hardy wanderers like you. Interested in a job?
Why not take a load off? I've seen more than one adventurer work themselves to death. And I do mean that literally.
Don't ask me, I don't have any more information on the matter.
Though I am loathe to admit it, our resources are stretched during these troubling times. Are you in need of work?
You've done excellent work today. Rest. Reflect. There will be more battles to fight on the morrow.
Our requests often require an amount of finesse. Remember, you represent the Temple as you set forth on this task.
Up for another challenge?
Keep practicing for your future victories.
The Circle of Champions is always proud to reward those who show talent in our games.
I've already heard tales of your cunning in the battle field.
Besieged by garbage. A new low.
I knew it. The hunt is in your blood!\n\nVery well, outlander. Are you ready for a new quarry?
Their circuit is active again.
Careful, it's gone haywire!
That's it, now push them over the brink!
Eager? I could see the love of the hunt in your eyes when first we met. But a hunter must practice patience.\n\nReturn later and we can discuss another quarry.
Track down the beast and slay it, but bring me something to show that the creature has been dispatched.
Welcome back, outlander. Was your hunt successful? Have you brought proof of your kill?
The Ahemmusa guar are the best in the land. Just keep your distance, outlander.
Beware of Manaad, outlander. He watches over the cairn of the First Ashkhan of the Erabenimsun and will not take kindly to those who disturb his prayers.
I hope the magister appreciates all I do for him. It's not easy getting all these goods through his front door.
Tread lightly. The slavemaster is always looking for fresh hands.
Magister Therana tossed the last outlander who displeased her off the top of her tower. I hope you don't plan on paying her a visit.
What brings you all the way out here? Magister Therana doesn't usually accept visitors. She's an exceedingly private individual, as I'm sure you've heard.
Magister Therana doesn't make life easy for an honest trader. Perhaps I should try sailing somewhere with friendlier clientele—like Stonefalls.

I didn't expect the waterfront to be so fragrant. Like home, but different. I'm told that is not usually the case, but all the dreugh activity has befouled the water.\n\nHas anyone made a study of dreugh migration? The spine of curiosity quivers ….
I love the feeling of tearing into a roast leg still on the bone. Makes me feel positively primal! Maybe I should try it raw?
It matters not who sits in the tower. The work is the same.
One of my duties as temple priest is to serve and protect the poor and weak. But I know you, outlander. You are neither poor nor weak. Praise the Tribunal for that!
This place is never quiet.  That's good, I can't stand the quiet. I might hear it again.
Work is going well on the cantons, and thanks to those new Blessing Stones we should be finished ahead of schedule.
Red Mountain erupting caused major setbacks. Between the lost workers and the damaged stone, it will be years before everything is done.
Is the foreman looking for me again? I'll be right out, I swear.
I never realized there was so much for an archcanon to do. I really must study!
What kind of example do I set? Lolling about this canton. I've read every book in the place and paced every corridor a hundred times. It's not what the Warrior-Poet would do.
Keba isn't too fond of Red Mountain. She didn't like Ash Mountain much either. I think she just has something against volcanoes. Or mountains.

Welcome to the center of culture in all of Vvardenfell! You must visit our library. Bradyn is working on the most wonderful project there.\n\nYou do know how to read, don't you? Oh, what am I saying! You can always learn.

I served in House Guard before I decided I needed a new challenge. Now I battle Daedra with the exceptional men and women of the Fighters Guild.\n\nI heartily recommend the organization, in case you're interested.
How many push-ups has that been today? Ah well, one can never be too fit.
Ah, yes, Magister Gothren's favorite kind of visitors. He's always asking when the next outlander will brighten his doorstep. I'm sure seeing you will put him in such a kind mood.

Warriors coming together, battling it out, bonding with allies and respecting their foes. That's what the Pact is all about! You'll find no better example of our alliance than the comradery of the battlegrounds.
If I have to hear one more quip about being an Orc that cleans ….\n\nWant a few fingers removed? Would that be Orc enough for you?
I hope you haven't bothered yourself with talking to any of our slaves. You'll quickly find they aren't much for conversation. And if they are, please let me know. I'd love to have a chat with them.
I've come here for fine food and quality entertainment. You, my friend, provide me with neither.
I can't wait to go home and tell everyone I've met you! I won't bother you for a signature, of course. I'm sure you're far too busy.
I'm not here to entertain the likes of you.
Commencing scan ….
The automatons are still up here and still a problem!
There. Now try again. Successfully, this time.
Unfortunately, Lord Vivec has nothing in his palace worth stealing. This one has looked… extensively.
House Hlaalu couldn't care less about this backwater egg-mine. It's up to us lesser Dark Elves to watch out for each other, so far from the big city.\n\nI'm sure you can't wait to leave. Where to?
Old Risa doesn't take kindly to n'wah riders. Keep still and keep quiet, and you may get to your destination alive.\n\nWould you like a ride?

Only Dark Elves can truly appreciate the majesty of the silt strider. Other races are always complaining to me. Oh, it's too high! Oh, it's so ugly! I don't know why I even let them ride!\n\nSo, where can I get you to?
Yes, I know a Silt Strider is a giant bug. Doesn't make it any less reliable then your fancy horses or guar. \n\nYou want to go somewhere quick, you learn to make your peace with it.
Good to see a Dark Elf face. I feel like I've only been dealing with Nords and Lizards all day. It gets very tiring, very fast.\n\nHow can I help you today?
Good n'wahs sit down, shut their mouth, and listen properly to instructions. Bad n'wahs end up dead before they reach their destination.\n\nNow, where can I take you?

Some of us Dark Elves can't seem to stand other races. It's s'wit this, and n'wah that! But we could truly learn so much from them and their experiences.\n\nLook at me, talking your ear off! Where would you like to go today?

It's hard not to believe in your gods when one is a silt strider ride away. I don't know how your lot does it. I don't know if I could keep the faith.\n\nBut, more importantly, how can I be of service?

If it were up to me, Vivec City would only be for the Dark Elves. Oh, I suppose we could have a few servants to sweep the streets, but that would be it! Well, who am I to question the word of our god?\n\nHow can I help you, friend?
Get on or get moving. I don't have all day.\n\nWhere are you going?

The Dark Elves in this town are a suspicious lot. Always talking about this Scarlet Judge of theirs. Honestly, I wouldn't know this figure if they asked me for a ride.\n\nAre you interested in traveling today?
There's much preparation to do for a silt strider journey, but we're just about ready to leave. \n\nWould you care to join us?

Suran has a man dressed in blue running around. The fetcher keeps helping thieves and capturing travelers. Calls himself the Cobalt Crusader.\n\nOr wait, was it—was it blue? Well, never mind. Can I take you somewhere?

All them fancy families in Vvardenfell are always talking to the dead. I tell you, it's all smoke and mirrors! Just trying to put on airs to make themselves look better than the rest of us.\n\nWell, enough of that. Where can I take you to?
Do you know who I am? High Ordinator of the Order of War? Does that ring a bell? Sigh.\n\nWhy we allow outlanders into Vivec City at all is beyond me.
Sometimes I just want to chuck it all and return to Wrothgar. Then I remember how the stronghold Orcs treat their women and I say tusk that! I'll stay right here, if you please!
Nothing here for tuskless runts. Only those who can walk with Malacath can buy my wares.

For Falkreath!
Ours for the taking!
Our home! Then and now!
Only your greatest labors will please Lord Seht. And as His Tourbillon says, great labors require peerless components. Come and look at my wares.
Don't look back! They're coming!
Divines have mercy! The dead come for us!
Burn it all! Leave nothing!
By the Stars, one whisper of the name Artaeum and the initiates can talk of nothing else. Have we no studies to attend to? Research to compile?
Need something else? My mayor-like duties have me pretty busy.
I don't got nothing for you right now, but check back, you hear?
Things keep going this well and we'll have enough stockpiled to keep us good for years. Still willing to help?
Strike there!
Kill them all!
Did you finish the request? Your reward has been burning a hole in my pocket.
Get up and fight or I'll kill you myself!
No one can save this hold now!
Death is waiting!
We won't be safe while there are bodies for these spirits!
I embrace the flame!
There's no retreat from here! Fight!
Let it all burn!
Earth and fire obey!
The Horned Lord protects.
The world is my ally.
Stars, my lord? I don't wish to overstep, but the practical application of such a form ….
They're living nightmares, Magus. We must destroy them.
Don't you want to be like the Brave Little Scrib? He would never cry over such a silly thing.
Your guidance and wisdom has been invaluable to me. Where would I be without you?
I can't be with you like this. We're not equals. We never have been.
Animus geodes are far more powerful than common soul gems, but their uses still remain limited.
Yes, I've heard quite a few refer to you by your new title. I think it should be obvious that I shall abstain from doing so.
You're a bore, Sil. You've just forgotten because everyone else is too scared to tell you.
No one will even realize we're missing. Besides, what's the worst Mother can do? A scolding?
The Celestiodrome will need to have rotating girders for proper topography to be formed.
You wish me to go to this location, Lord Sotha Sil? I would be happy to! It should only take a few years to walk there.
Our soldiers are useless against the sheer volume of Kagrenac's machines. We're sending those mer out for slaughter.
My friend, what have I become?
You did it, didn't you? Huh. Well done! Now go collect your reward.
With you on the job, this situation should be resolved before the next turn of the gear.

I may be simply a novice, but I heard about your exploits since you arrived in the Clockwork City. If you have the inclination, Adjunct Daro and the Clockwork Apostles could use your help.\n\nWe'll pay, of course.
No combat contracts have been requested. Please see the nearest Clockwork Apostle representative for more details.
Chew on this, construct!
Come for more information about your task, then? Not surprised. Water regulation is a complex field.
Come to report your success?
Together we'll keep this city's water cycle running!
I am able to give you further information if needed.
Dangerous presence no longer detected.
I have a contract available for citizens with combat experience.
Imperfect presence no longer detected.
Really, you'd think they'd just leave us alone.
The stars already in the constellation have found their place. Try to think of the spots where the light is missing.
They're quite the collection, aren't they?
Captive spirits, I release you! Lend us your aid!
We must release the spirits from his control before we're overwhelmed!
The forgotten dead are eager to taste life.
I can stifle Orryn's conjurations if you destroy the crystal!
I'll enjoy this.
These bones know something about rot.
My barriers will stop the rot!
This lair serves my every whim.
His control is too strong now! I can't stop his minions!
It'd be a shame to die alone.
Go away! Go! Go!
Terari? Are you there … ? Is anyone? It's so empty here.
Is it over …?
Integrity compromised. Initiating emergency defense protocols.
Combat sequences recalculating. Reflecting.
Life ain't easy and life ain't fair. But who ever said it was? Not our good god, that's for sure.
What is the lesson in this torment? What are we to learn besides the depths of cruelty?
Almsivi, where are your voices? We need you now more than ever.
We are immortal generals to all powerful gods! What good are we locked away?
Redemption is a lie! There is only torment for you here.
I am no longer of Almsivi, only the Void!
Yes! This is what I'm meant for!
Order is restored.
Have faith.
No fear of death … makes you sloppy.
The pipes are managed by an automated system, but under what regulations? And who's controlling it?

Did you hear? The apprentices have taken charge of the Everwound Wellspring! I hope that means there's more fresh greens in my future. I could really use the ruffage!\n\nCan I sell you something today?
I'm sure they'll be enough from the harvest to go around. But just in case, why don't you take a look at what I'm selling today.
Careful where you step. A blade of grass is not a figure of speech in the Radius. Perhaps I can interest you in one for grooming?
Definitely Breton in style, but composed of the miasma of Oblivion instead of fire-baked clay.
The decrepit structural condition and lack of roof indicates that maintenance in this pocket realm is sorely lacking.
Perception receptors indicate dark magic at work. Caution is advised.

There's so much to learn, and I'm making sure to write everything down! Well, engrave everything down I suppose. These sequence plaques may be wondrous, but they're not the easiest to take notes with.
Come, come! Pull the switch!
Fight! Win! For the Knight!
The Clockwork Apostles are as obsessed with magic as the Telvanni were. But as long as they're not as keen on slavery? Well, that makes quite the difference.
I suppose I should be grateful. After all, Seht was the one who made this wasteland we all get to enjoy living in.
May our hearts be ever oiled and calibrated, just like our great Lord.
Do you think the Wellspring will ever have another harvest? Without Lector Naril, how can they possibly grow more plants? Just thinking about it has made me a nervous wreck!
I may not be one of the Clockwork Apostles, but I still find harvest day to be an exciting time.\n\nAnd the chance to taste some real food? Just thinking about it makes my mouth water!
I guess I was lucky enough to get here before the big crowd. The rumors I've heard about those struggling to find a sponsor … well, I'd rather not discuss it.
To join our sacred order takes not only skill, but also a dedication to innovation and discovery. It is not enough to simply learn what is, but to imagine what could be.
So, what did you find inside the Wellspring? Were the carrots as tall as mountains? Were the gorapples as big as bull netches?\n\nYou can tell me. Harkskar knows how to keep a secret!
Ah, another hopeful for the Wellspring. May the gears rotate in your favor, especially if you've got a gold piece to spare!
Something you wanted to talk about? Afraid I've got my hands full at the moment. Perhaps another time.
What could you possibly wish to speak of? I assure you, I have nothing worth talking about. Well, nothing that you would understand, in any case.
I'm lucky to have made friends so quickly since joining the order. I know Saelin and Vilasti aren't the easiest to get along with sometimes, but they're actually very kind once you get to know them.
I will find a way out of this wasteland, with or without the help of those Clockwork Apostles.
Finding your place here within our city is to become a gear within a glorious machine. Greatness lies within us all, should we find the will to merge our fractured selves.
Can you believe it? Such terrible events taking place inside the Wellspring.\n\nI wonder if that means there won't be any more harvest days? Oh, that would make me really sad.
Drink up! It's harvest day! You know, the day when they harvest the apprentice and select the best plants from the Apostles.\n\nOr is it the other way around?
Got plenty to eat around here, so don't concern yourself about that. Just grab some slop and you're good to go. Not the best tasting, but it gets the job done.
We must look out for each other, yes? A cruel land calls for kind friends.
I grew up with tales of the Hist, but have I never seen it. It does not concern me, though. How can I regret the loss of that which I have never known?
No one quite knows how Barilzar left the Clockwork City, but it's a rare and powerful ability to be able to do so.
I know factotums can run a shop well enough, I've seen it. Perhaps you just can't teach an old machine new tricks.
Do you need assistance leaving the premises?
Shh… Quiet now. Quiet, quiet.
Sotha Sil really didn't have company in mind when he made this place.
You should move along. I fed the last troublemaker who came this way to a fabricant. And trust me, those things are always hungry.
The gruel here is a perfect medium! It holds color so well. So vibrantly!
Your dedication to finding me was impressive, I'll give you that.
Maybe I should learn some spells.
We should all seek a well-oiled soul.
Yet another research paper to write.
Whatever happened to regulation?
Lord Seht, guide me on this test.
I'll never make my appointment.
Sotha Sil give me patience ….
If the Apostles keep this up ….
Are the air filters repaired yet?
This one could go for some moon-sugar ….
If only it would work properly ….
By the word of Seht, I am bound.
I always find the best way to grease your gears is with a new purchase.
Opportunity flows within this city like its oil slick waters. One must only be quick enough to seize it.
Here you salvage what scrap you can, or you end up with nothing. It's tough, but its life.
Sorry, but I have nothing for sale right now. Dealing in the salvage trade can mean some pretty irregular shipments.
Doesn't take much to end up in Slag Town. Trust me, if I could have avoided living like this? I would have.
Slag Town has enough hardship. We do not need newcomers to worsen our burdens.
I didn't travel all the way to this mechanical bemusement simply to see the sights. I have a mission to perform!\n\nIf you'll excuse me, I'm much too busy to talk to you.
Items for sale in this establishment!
Meals for sale in this establishment!
Our items are oiled and calibrated!
Carved up like fat Nords!
What are we but the leavings of the Divines?
Why, I never!
So this is how it ends.
What a great day to serve!
Fetch it! It's multiplying!
Get these creatures away from the Shadow!
Am I missing a screw …? Ah, no, just loose.
Please be more careful in the future!
Activation mode initiating.
Resident, please cease all violent activity.
Resident deceased. Cause: homicide.
Theft observed. Reporting to local authorities.
Warning: personal misconduct will result in fines or execution.
Items stored have been unwillingly taken.
Impact detected. Please discontinue this assault, resident.
Discontinue your unlawful behavior, resident.
Your presence is unauthorized. Please depart.
Lifeforms detected.
Engaging threat.
Activating kinetic barrier.
Additional targets deployed.
Entering heavy combat mode.
Divide … by … zero.
Do something useful with those featherless appendages of yours and fetch me a tribute, you wingless peasant!
A tribute saved is a tribute earned. Which reminds me, can the Blackfeather Court count on a tribute from you today?

Oh, crow-friend, the Court flaps happily amid the tributes you brought us! We couldn't possibly accept any more at this time.\n\nBut do return later. The Court is fickle and in constant need of new baubles.
The time has come, crow-friend! There are tributes to collect!\n\nCan we count on you to help the Blackfeather Court and get the job done?
How the shadows always dance with mortals, and so often go unnoticed.
The blackness of Oblivion calls to me.
We will weep when no other mourns your loss, but the tears will be of joy.
Lens rotation in progress.
Apologies, but I am currently engaged in a task.
Surveying area …. Result: no intruders detected.
I am designed to serve.
I am numb to the suffering of the flesh.
Flame is merciful before the end.
Sniveling Gascone. He can't hide from us.
Sadly, you have no more crates. But you can always purchase more!
You already had that, so you got gems instead. Very nice!
Greetings, my good friend!
Pacrooti tries to keep things simple. What he will never understand is why others insist on making them so complicated. Also women. Pacrooti will never understand women.
Which crate do you choose?
Ah, you've come to the right place for fun and excitement! But you need to purchase a crate first.
This one wishes you great luck!
This one is impressed!
Hmmm.
Well done.
Here we go!
The capture point moved!
The capture point's moved!
By Stendarr! The capture point has moved!
The point has moved!
By Sithis! The point has moved!
The point's moved!
There goes the capture point!
To the new capture point!
To the new point!
We must capture the new point!
By Auriel! On to the new point!
We need to capture the new point!
By The Eight! The capture point moved!
Come on, come on! The point's moved!
Grab the new capture point!
Move it! To the new point!
Move on to the new point!
On to the new capture point!
By Vivec! The capture point's moved!
On to the new point!
By Magrus! On to the new capture point!
Rally to the new capture point!
That new point won't capture itself!
The capture point has moved!
The capture point moved!
The capture point's moved!
By Ysgramor! To the new point!
The point has moved!
By Mauloch! The point's moved!
The point's moved!
There goes the capture point!
To the new capture point!
To the new point!
We must capture the new point!
By Onsi! To the new capture point!
We need to capture the new point!
Oh, how you marvel. I'm flattered.
Magnificent!
An unparalleled reward!
Once more, my good friend?
The crystal! It's powering the summoning circle. We have to destroy it.
If you seek membership in the Fighters Guild, you are talking to the wrong cat! Go see the Hall Steward for all the particulars.

You'd think I'd resent the way most of those High Elves treat those of us they consider to be inferiors. Well, maybe I do. Let's just say they ought to check the straps on their saddles, if you catch my meaning.\n\nWhat can I help you with?
You honor my humble stable with your exalted presence, auspicious one! Allow me to show you a mount worthy of your greatness.
Perfect. Now to reunite you with your dear Scalecaller.
Haha. I should have abandoned my flesh long ago.
Pacrooti is jealous of your good fortune!
How did we get separated? I was just behind you!
Is that you?
I swear I was walking in the opposite direction. Well, let's carry on!
Oh no, not again!
We can't let this crazy forest beat us. Follow me!
You got these for free? You're a sly one, aren't you?
Don't be long!
The dead are tireless. Are you?
Leave me to this empty existence!
They say the north wind cuts right through you. Let's find out.
A flash of pain and the creeping dread of poison in your veins.
Consume the fire or be consumed by it.
The snap of lightning's jaws sinks deep.
By the time you feel the creeping vines, it's too late.
The grating scrape of chains is all I know now.
Death won't end your pain.
Your fate is sealed.
Died like a snow-back.
You want a victory? Earn it!
Like old times, eh Sabina?
No. Nothing like old times.
Make the most of a bad situation.
You can't escape this fate. None of us can!
I'll not die alone … again.
Dawnbreaker is ready! Just give the command!
Very well, I'll do this myself. Dawnbreaker, go forth!

Check whatever bizarre customs you follow at the door. This is a High Elf establishment and you'll conduct yourself appropriately if you expect our hospitality.\n\nNow that that's done, what is it you want?

Ah, fivefold venerations to you and yours, friend! Let this humble establishment cater to your every need. Whether you require a moment's respite or provisions for the long road, I'm sure I can oblige.
This one feels honored to have so cultured and prestigious a visitor walk into her humble shop.\n\nMay I show you my selections, your eminence?
This one wishes she never came to this land of pretension and overbearing ordinances. Who knew there could be so many rules!\n\nMakes me want to drink my stock dry, but then what would Riharai sell?

I suppose the Divine Prosecution helped you settle into our fair city. Or maybe it was monks at the monastery? I never remember who's dealing with these sorts of things.\n\nYour gold is good here. Just don't expect a seat at a table. Or a glass.

Our poor city is overrun with immigrants! Isn't the Divine Prosecution supposed to keep that from happening? Or is it the monks? I can never remember.\n\nIf this keeps up, I might just go and give the Kinlady a piece of my mind.

I sympathize with the many immigrants flooding to these shores, but the Mages Guild must maintain its air of neutrality and objectivity.\n\nWe make it a habit to refrain from becoming entangled in politics, no matter how distasteful they may be.

Rumors that agents of the Psijic Order have been spotted here on Summerset make me extremely curious. What could they want after vanishing from the world all those years ago?\n\nYou can rest assured that the Mages Guild shall investigate these reports!
A reckoning is upon us!

Another newcomer! Welcome, welcome! Both me and my pouch of gold are happy to see you!\n\nI'm sure you're collecting all kinds of souvenirs from your travels. How about a new pack to carry them all in?

If you get a chance, you really ought to catch a performance of the House of Reveries. The whole thing with the masks is kind of creepy, but they really do know how to put on a show!\n\nSay, are you interested in a new pack to carry your things in?

This one is not a newcomer, so do not try to take advantage. Marakar knows how to navigate turbulent waters.\n\nWhich reminds this one, you look rather fresh. Buy something and we will keep the cheating to a minimum, yes?

This one has lived in Alinor his entire life. Marakar isn't a newcomer or an immigrant! But all you new arrivals have made life difficult for me. So unfair of you, sharp-claw!\n\nYou could make it up to Marakar if you buy something, though.

Damn High Elf saplings, causing trouble and harassing honest merchants just because we're different from them! I have a mind to turn the lot of them into torchbugs!\n\nBut you didn't come all this way to hear an old lizard complain. How can I help you?

I extend the spine of greeting, egg-sibling! There are so few of the Hist's children on this island paradise, which makes you a welcome sight for these old eyes.\n\nI tell you, the next High Elf that insults me gets turned into a torchbug!

The Mages started here on Summerset. Did you know that? Our illustrious founder, Vanus Galerion, was born and raised here. Remarkable High Elf. Kind of an arse, but remarkable nonetheless.\n\nHow can I help you, friend?

Why Summerset? Hey, I saw the brass ring and I grabbed it. Once the locals taste my brew, they'll never want to drink anything else. And as for the rest of the arrivers, well, if they're thirsty enough, they'll drink anything!

With all the newcomers filling the streets, I'm glad to see an Altmer grace my establishment. Can I tempt you with a High Elf delicacy?\n\nOne of those Nords had the nerve to say that my century soup had spoiled. It's supposed to taste that way!

Before you get too comfortable, I don't serve any of that strange, foreign food here. Nothing but traditional Altmer fare prepared in the traditional Altmer fashion.\n\nIf that suits your needs, then we can do business.
This is for Cartorrel!

Another visitor? How exciting! Not to be rude, but you all have such fascinating turns of phrase. I absolutely love your voice, by the way. I could listen to you for hours.\n\nI have so many questions! Perhaps later, at the inn? Over a bottle of aurum?
Harmonious salutations, friend High Elf! May coins fall into your pockets like rain on a stormy day!

So many Divine Prosecution bailiffs roaming the streets. You'd think laws were being broken left and right! Come to think of it, with all the newcomers, there are bound to be a few slip ups, I suppose.\n\nBut you popped in for a different matter, yes?

So much consternation over the Queen's decree. You'd think she sold the island to the Orcs or the Argonians, what with the way everyone is complaining.\n\nI say let the visitors come. The more the merrier! What's the harm, right?

Surprised to see an Orc working in the High Elf capital? Imagine how I feel! Now, not everyone thinks this is a good idea, but as I understand it, the High Elf queen asked for me personally. So here I am.\n\nWhat can I do for you, hmm?

No matter how hard I try, I can't keep this area clean. It seems like all I ever do is sweep, sweep, sweep.\n\nWhat do you say? Want to take a turn with my trusty broom? No? That's what I figured. So what do you want, by the way?

I'm a simple woodworker, my dear patron. There's absolutely nothing nefarious going on around here, you have my word on that. The Divine Prosecution didn't send you around, by any chance? Oh, no reason. Just asking.\n\nNeed something else?

I may or may not have connections in Black Marsh. And I may or may not know someone who knows someone in the court of the Skald King. Does that make me a spy? Of course not! I'm just well-connected.\n\nBut if you hear anything interesting ….

It isn't ready yet, but I'll save you some of my next batch of Rotmeth. Just don't let the Divine Prosecution catch you with it. One whiff and they'll toss you into a deep, dark cell. It's a law or something.\n\nMay Y'ffre guide your path.

I'll match my wares against anything else you can buy on Summerset—even what those fancy High Elf grocers sell. And my items are probably less expensive.\n\nI don't know that for a fact, but I'm guessing, what with the snob tax and all.

Another High Elf? Why are there so many of you in this moons-forsaken city? Oh, right. It is your city. How could Nuzon forget when you make that abundantly clear.\n\nForgive this one. It has been a long day. Now then, do you actually want something?

You know what that word means? The one the High Elves call us? "Nebarra." It means "unwelcome." Clawless bastards! This one loves our nation and this beautiful land. It's the High Elf arseholes Nuzon can't stomach.\n\nSorry, sorry. How can I help you?
I rule over this mountain! And you shall feel my wrath.
Kneel or be crushed!
Nothing but ash will remain!
May the flames take you!
Frost and blight hold you!
My Lord! Lend me your aid!
Stay back! You are unworthy of Spellbreaker's might!

Another research subject? Lovely, lovely!
Revel in our blessing!
Tamriel will be purged. Cleansed!
Scalecaller rises! We obey!
You'll laugh at us no more!
Become diseased! Become blessed!
That snow storm is generating freezing winds!
Use the ogre's freezing attacks to shield yourself from tremors!
Those ice pillars are dangerous, but they may prove useful!
Make sure to find cover when the ogre summons those ice shards!
The ogre's pestilence is strengthening, the closer they are!
The ogre is calling up skeevers! Quick, disrupt him!
You need to free any teammate who becomes petrified!
Your petrified friend requires aid!
Destroy the stone orb that's freed itself!
Primary functions operational.
Integrity compromised. Ceasing all functions.
Engaging threat.
I'll protect you!
Are you ready for a contract? I'm sure a newcomer such as yourself has plenty of time to spare for a worthy endeavor.
I could never imagine the newcomers would be this helpful to the Divine Prosecution's efforts! It's simply astonishing.
The Divine Prosecution doesn't pay until the contract is complete. So get back to it!
Oh. Oh, yes. I shall bless you all. I will, I will.
I do so appreciate when one of my deputies returns with all their limbs still attached. Tell me, were you successful in your investigation?
This antidote should help you!
I need beetle juice for an antidote!
Too quick! Lets slow you all down.
Feel my blessing! Let it spread!
Do you feel your magic weaken?
Imp guts! Just what I require!
I need stranglers' sap to create an antidote!
Where are my guards? Get in here!
This is better than exhuming duty, I guess ….
Wasting away in the dark. Just like my darlings.
Ah, there's a nice chill.
Father wielded a blade. I wield life and death!
Hack and stitch, hack and stitch. When did I become a butcher and a tailor?
To face death, and wield it like a blade. How invigorating!
I wager some of these bones could sail with some good fletching.
Bet I could take the skull off one of those skeletons below.
Do you feel that? I think the geyser's about to go off!
Watch out! You won't survive the Matriarch's swing!
I wonder what we'll make from you.
Don't mar their hair! I want it!
Let's hear your soul wail!
You'll never reach the Far Shores.
Now I chop you up!
My blade has a soul. You will join it!
I'll plant the seed of death in your heart!
Swift or lingering death? Choose quickly!
The Divine Prosecution lacks numbers, but that doesn't mean the law isn't served. Add your skills to ours and once again become an implement of justice.
I must admit, the newcomers who we've contracted have been pulling their weight. Surprising, to say the least.
This threat to Summerset must be dealt with, newcomer. I urge you to complete your assignment as quickly as possible.
My superiors continue to be dubious of this contract solution to law enforcement. Every success makes our efforts more tenable. So tell me, was your hunt fruitful?
Stop fiddling with my ingredients! Nasty, nasty!
Gorag gar!
I can't wait until the master unveils his latest work.
How did Lizabet let intruders get this far? The master will be needing a new favorite soon.
I hope the master lets me keep one of you.
You'll regret crossing us. Forever.
Yorag gara!
A few more off to the Void! Who's keeping tally?
I could have wound up like them if not for you.
Wretched things. Begone!
I also bring the blessing of fire's end! Ha!
Some medicine for my lovely guards. Oh yes!
More abyssal geysers have sprung up across the island. We need to utilize the information Cainar and Miriya acquired and destroy them before they damage the island.
My scouts indicate that there's no end to these abyssal geysers that have been spotted. Unfortunate, but unsurprising.
There's nothing else to discuss until those abyssal geysers have been destroyed. Get to it and may the stars guide you in this task.
It's just been one disaster after another today. What say you, newcomer? Has the abyssal geyser threat been averted?
These seas may be treacherous, but fear not. Even the ocean winds quail at the sight of Captain Wereshark!
It found me! Save yourselves!
The Prince of Bargains just wants to talk.
Keep searching! The master demands success!
I'm sorry, but I have a note here for you from Master Rolis. It says you should 'start making waves' if you wish to be a client.
Welcome, friend. Please feel free to browse! If you don't see anything you like, I would appreciate it if you, at least, pretend to be interested.
My dear friend. Please, pick over our goods. Do let me know if you see anything you'd like.
I'll wait for you here.
Idiots! Apprentices are all idiots!
Z'Maja will enjoy the gift of your bloody corpses!
I'll kill you all, in Z'Maja's name!
Death to all who defy Z'Maja!
You'll feel the fury of my flames!
I was … defeated?
Your deaths shall please my mistress greatly.
You challenge me? Very well. Let us fight!
Z'Maja will … crush you.
How could I lose … to such fools.
You think yourself worthy of my blade? Fools!
Your defeat was inevitable.
The world will drown in Z'Maja's shadow.
The shadows answer to me now.
New shadows for my army! Excellent.
The Welkynars could not defeat me! And neither will you.
I may have fallen … but so too have the Welkynars.
Have no fear, my goods are of excellent quality! I'd only serve the best to Lillandril's citizens.
I may not have much clout in this city, but I always have an open ear if you have trouble fitting in. Y'ffre knows I need one somedays!\n\nNow, what can I do for you?
My girl Holi is the sweetest little Wood Elf you ever did meet. Make sure to treat her with respect, you hear? I'll have no disrespect in my inn.
I know some of us here in Summerset have been true de'nts about this open border situation, but just know that we don't all feel that way. For me, you're all most welcomed.
I don't mind selling around Ebon Stadmont, but don't think me foolish enough to head inside the forest. Auri-El knows where I'd end up.
The work of our High Elven forge-masters is without peer. You, my friend, deserve nothing less.
These Island-Elves don't know a damned thing about working leather. Too busy stringing their lutes and writing bad poetry. You, though—you know quality.\n\nTake a look. You'll like what you see.
I see that glint in your eye, cerum. You're looking to make a purchase!
You know, I always wanted to be an artist. But, as you can plainly see, the Stars had other plans for me. Such as helping you.
What can I get for you today, Kor-um?
So many of these Elves walk by my shop without so much as a glance. My items are of high quality! Please, see for yourself.
Perhaps it's a Daedra? One of the nebarra could have summoned it.

At least my rank as Hall Steward garners some respect. Or perhaps it's my blade which keeps the High Elves in line.\n\nWhy not join the Fighters Guild? Learn to invoke fear. It's better than contempt.
Whatever could this creature be …?

At least my rank as Hall Steward garners some respect. Or perhaps it's my blade which keeps the High Elves in line.\n\nFeel free to tell these mer what guild you belong to. Invoke some fear. It's better than contempt.
We've killed one of these creatures, but there's no telling if anymore are nearby. Keep on your guard.
I thought I've seen every danger Summerset had to offer, but this … I'm not sure what creature this could be. Daedric, perhaps?
I doubt you can even lift the shields I offer, but the guild has requested I stop refusing customers.
I expected more from you, even if you are a novice. What did I sponsor you for?
Oh sure, blame us! When you're the reason we're in this mess.
They sent her to the hedge maze yesterday. She … didn't make it.
They wouldn't kick me out, would they? I'd be hunted. Killed!
Now I have to deal with intruders? Just great!
I must protect the pack! It's all I have left!
No one leaves this prison. At least, no one leaves alive.
Be thankful I'm your executioner. Vykosa is far less quick!
I'll make sure to properly document this battle. After your defeat, of course.
Always the hunted, always the hated. Until this one chose to fight back.
You all should have stayed in your cells.
Pitiful. At least you'll make a fine dinner.
You shall invade this keep no longer!
If only you had seen reason. This one would have let you join us.
For the glory of the hunt!
Hunt them all down!
You shouldn't have chased it. You should have turned back.
Scared? Ha! You should be.
Are you all right? Please, please get up!
And so your hunt has ended.
And now to collect your pathetic hearts.
I wager I'll count more indriks between these pages than you'll find all day.
Is the plan to mask your scent with grapes before taking a welwa?
Are you trying to lull the gryphons into a false sense of security with all the breaks you've been taking?
Are you trying to marinade before the giant salamander roasts you?
We can regale the court with tales of how Paredan bravely wrestled seven volumes to the ground. He'll have the paper cuts to prove it!
Nothing like a good pledge to get your blood pumping!
Ah, the smell of blood and guts. Or is that scorched flesh? Whatever it is, it's welcomed!
Look at Paredan with his nose in that book when he has such fine company right here. I'll bet it's full of that nebarra smut they call romance.
My brother! He read somewhere that weapons and drinking don't mix. Does he know nothing about being a noble?
I heard Paredan's family had fallen on tough times, but this swill isn't fit for my butler's table.
Don't you think you're taking things a little personally? Let's just go about our own business.
I am a Kinlady of Summerset, and you dare address me as though I were one of you common rabble!
I don't understand why you're being so obstinate. Just observe the proper protocol and we can both go about our business.
To be honest, I thought your kind only ate horse. So did my mare, apparently.
I had just enough time to make it to Lillandril and now this happens. There goes my bonus.
These Elves act like their smallclothes are seven sizes too small. Any little thing sends them over the edge!
Still your tongue! I am the middle of dealing with this insolent Orc and nothing will keep me from it.
I need to begin the search for my horse immediately. Can this be kept brief?
If you haven't come to fetch my horse, I have no use for you. Mind your own affairs.
I call forth Ruella Many-Claws to shock the mortals into submission.
Mortals fear the dark. Now let them fear Churug!
Drown in Sheefar's cold embrace!
Girawell, emerge from my shadows!
Muustikar hungers for more than waves today.
Reefhammer, smash these mortals upon your shell!
From out of the sea, I give you Darkstorm the Alluring!
Let Eejoba lead you into my darkness, mortals.
Now Tidewrack crashes down upon you.
Nothing can stand against the power of Vsskalvor!
K'Tora sees the fear inside you.
Feel the power of eternal darkness!
You resist? How annoying!
You may have ended this geyser, but more are set to burst!
You stopped this geyser, but what about the others that are set to burst?
Those who've seen the face of darkness do not survive long.
<<Heavy coughing, hacking.>>
<<Heavy coughing, hacking.>>
Another ephem, well. Isn't that just what Lillandril needs right now.
I always knew Queen Ayrenn didn't have her head on straight, but opening Summerset's borders? That's just lunacy.
You'll often find artists along the docks. In my opinion, ocean paintings tend to be a tad … trite. But then again, what do I know?
To me, my shadow warriors!
I'll tear you apart, limb by limb!
My mistress requests your death. And so I answer.
Why do you still fight? You're nothing against Z'Maja.
Burn them all, Silaeda!
Belanaril! Show them lightning's wrath!
Falarielle! Unleash your icy ruin!
So you're the ones helping this wretch? I'll put a stop to your meddling, once and for all!
Sunhold is ours, by blood and fire!
We've already won! Why do you still fight?
My liege. I've been … defeated.
The Mages Guild makes their wares available to all, no matter race or creed.
The Mages Guild appreciates those who question our methods. Only through critique can we better ourselves. Whereas the Sapiarchs … do not agree, on that front.
You know, I was quite the juggler in my younger days. Use to help pass the time. Do you think the House of Reveries could use another juggler?
Wait a moment … where's Paredan going?
Can't a man enjoy a drink in peace?
Siblings, join me in the hunt!
Not many can ignore the call of the sea. Looking to travel?
Remember! Divide and conquer. Take those shadow replicas out one at a time.
Do you all have a death wish? Is that it?
Finally, a chance to defeat this resistance, once and for all!
The depravity of Daedric worship is running rampant through our lands! Look around! Anyone gathered here could truly be a Daedric-loving fiend!
We have welcomed the tainted Dark Elves and their perverted Tribunal creed! The wretched spawn of Trinimac, the shape-taker! We give them free rein in our hallowed homeland!
Shall we permit our great land, our divine provenance, to be desecrated? No! We must steel our hearts against the seductive and corrupting whispers of Daedric worship!
Though we face a spiritual assault, brothers and sisters, we can take strength in knowing that our ancestors watch over us. Auri-El sees your toil, your forthrightness!
To the Auri-El I bear my soul, and offer myself as a humble servant. Direct me in my crusade for purity, and give me the strength to save my people!
The prisoners are useless to us now! Kill them!
Darkness shall consume you all …. Soon. So, so, soon.
It's a thing of terrible beauty, isn't it?
These potions really stink. Wonder what's in 'em.
Glad we finally got organized. Maybe now we'll get something done.
I've been land-bound too long.
Get one of the marines to do it.
Touch my plunder, you lose your hand.
For the Sorcerer-King!
The smell of mortal blood is intoxicating.
Warm blood approaches.
Let's give them reason to be afraid of the dark.
I smell something delicious. Something awfully close.
If I infused their bile with imp stool then—no, that would never work.
If any of those creatures interfere with my experiments ….
Another fine addition to the Royal Menagerie.
Gryphons would make better neighbors than Wood Elves. Let's consider this spot.
As you say, my lady.
Get this creature out of my sight!
I'll make quick work of it.
These High Elves have had my ship under inspection for weeks. They live so damn long they forgot what a hurry is?
In my father's time, this winery was a place of notable repute. The Queen's decree has put an end to those days, it seems.
Don't tell me my clothes aren't fancy enough for this place. I'm one of the richest merchants in Solitude! \n\nI just like to be comfy, is all.
Those insolent servants served me a vintage Umber Press in a wooden mug! So what if I've broken a few glasses? Now I resemble a common Nord!
Wait a moment … I started drinking in Russafeld. How did I end up here?
The Divine Prosecution will ensure that peace is kept in Alinor. I would advise that you do not give us reason to invoke our authority.
Even the Proxy Queen buys my horses. She's got a fine eye, I can tell you that much.
Some strange happenings going on at Cey-Tarn Keep, if my contacts are telling the truth. Grisly business.
I came to see how the newcomers are faring with our hospitality. I have not been disappointed by the circus. It's so droll.
Smallclothes on the bannister, food on the sheets, discarded bottles in the halls. Who taught any of you manners?
I was hoping the Queen's decree would solve my labor problems, but now I have five times as many orders and still only two workers.\n\nI'm getting tired just looking at them.
Have you seen any Divine Prosecution around? I'm supposed to be keeping a lookout.
With all the nebarra in Alinor, it's no wonder the hunting has gotten worse. All my favorite spots have been picked over.
If Alinor is around in a hundred years, it will be because I had the good sense to cut back these plants before they cracked the stone.
I was rather hoping that all the newcomers would induce Anginil to update his menu. Alas, no luck. I'll just have to make do with his old standbys.
What's the point of going into battle if you don't look good? My weapons are works of art.

They say that we must be welcoming to these newcomers, but I don't see any nobles in the upper city opening their doors.
Last week was sunny as anything. I really should invest in a hat to help keep my poor scalp from getting burned!
Trade's picked up since the decree. Not that I'm complaining.
These sundries are the finest in Alinor.
No need for pleasantries. If you're going to buy, buy.
I hope my shirt looks all right. Wouldn't want to embarrass my fine employers.
Here to see what the buzz about Huzz is all about?
So many come to the city. My peers see opportunities for spiritual guidance. I see threats to our moral purity.
If newcomers are to come to our land, they must learn to respect our religious practices. And that means proper donations upon every visit!
"In humble work there is true honesty. It is the bastion of the pure-hearted."
This tree reminds me of Summerset. Beautiful. Proud. Strong. And just like our wonderful island, I shall honor it all my life.
Some of my customers haven't been very polite since the borders were opened, despite the fact that I'm Alinor born and raised.
I may have lost my home, but my pride remains. Be gone with you!
Hail to thee, Emperor. Your large armies will be no use to you in the Battlegrounds. I am intrigued to see how you adapt your skills to match these challenges.
The Battlereeve insists that you are a worthy fighter. I will determine that for myself if ever I see you in the Battlegrounds.
I do not mean to cause offense, but your time would be better spent honing your skills for the Battlegrounds than speaking to me.
A simple drum and song may seem harmless, but they could be the seeds of civil unrest and moral decay. Be wary!
A merchant told me that Cloudrest has a toad infestation. Can't imagine anything more horrible. Those slimy creatures give me the shivers!
I take pride in the quality of my wares. Only the finest for my customers!
I think a little competition for the Sapiarchs is a good thing. The Mages Guild may be just the thing to propel advancement forward around here.
Take a moment to center yourself, and maybe you will hear this music as this one does. The tones echo through the stone as though the entire city resonates. Miraculous, Khajiit thinks.
Wait … there was a pile over there. Or did I dump that already? Gods, I don't know where it ends.
That Orc knows her way around stone, I'll give her that. We might finish this restoration well ahead of schedule!
I've missed my homeland while fighting for the Queen. There's nothing like Alinor in all of Tamriel.
I don't recommend taking notes on this bridge. The crosswinds are robust ….

Raynilie the Stormhand, at your service. Don't let the name disquiet you. I'm not one for conflict … generally.

Not a lot of trade on this road, but I'm the only one walking it. Soon enough, I'll be able to open my own shop!

Ah, newcomer! Exploring the wonders of our spectacular isle? I have supplies for sale, should you have a need.

Give the Divine Prosecution a wide berth if you can. They're not inhospitable, but they seem to prefer to be left alone.
Mother always said I should visit the homeland someday. I expect she was hoping it would be as a debut into high society. Not with a sword on my back.
By the Stars, one whisper of the name Artaeum and the initiates can talk of nothing else. Have we no studies to attend to? Research to compile?

It's funny. Most of these books have supposedly never left the shores of Summerset. But I've seen a few unsanctioned copies of them back in High Rock.
Take a look at what I have for sale. You never can tell when you'll need something!

Every adventurer from Hammerfell to Shadowfen will be coming through this port. And they'll all need resupplying.
Take a look around. Queen Ayrenn's decree was supposed to open Summerset to others, but the High Elves don't so much as look at us half the time.
The High Elves have some decent vineyards here. Russafeld and Alinor both have fine selections. Though of course, I prefer the dry reds from Anvil.
I took a few days just to wander the city, and I can say the High Elves know a thing or two about beauty. The way the stone plays with the water … it reminds me of Solitude.
Don't bother asking the dockhands anything. They're far too busy for a quick chat. Trust me, I've tried.
I wouldn't recommend going into the city's underground. Such a place tends to attract the lowest factors of Summerset's society.
If you get in a spot of trouble, you should head to the city's underground. It's a bit of a maze, but most guards don't like heading down there.
Shimmerene has always boasted the largest population of newcomers, given its location as a port city. But ever since the borders opened, that population has grown exponentially.
I have no logical opposition to Queen Ayrenn's decree. I just wish the Aldarch had better prepared the city for the influx of arrivals.
Almost got in trouble with the guard over this fishing spot. Said I needed some sort of permit to fish within the city. Have you ever heard of something so ridiculous?
While I love working in Shimmerene, it lacks a certain place where we can avoid the law. I hear there's a refuge in Alinor, though.
Not only must the Divine Prosecution contend with new arrivals, we must be wary of those who would take advantage of this time of confusion.
My husband and I waited months to arrange passage and come to Summerset. Once he's done with whatever he's doing within the Monastery, we can begin our new lives!
We have been delivered unto a trying time. New people come to our land, with new faiths. But our order will rise above.
All the beasts you see on this dock are due to be taken to Sil-Var-Woad, the island's royal menagerie.
Farniri found gray fur on her pillow this morning. She hangs her head in shame.
The Divine Prosecution doesn't seem to enjoy an armed organization like ours in their midst. But someone's got to bring the fight to the Daedra.\n\nYou look like you can hold your own. Why not join?

Maghumo kolektos!

Chisel and I started as carpenters in Alinor. Came to Rellenthil on a whim, and simply fell in love. We both auditioned to join the troupe as soon as we could!
I came to the House of Reveries quite some time ago. I was hesitant at first, but my wife was simply determined to join. Turned out to be the best decision of my life.
I've always found the attendants here to be quite … attentive. If you tip well enough, of course. Though I spare no expense for those who treat me well.

I strongly suggest that you purchase some supplies. You will need them before long—trust me.
You don't have any beavers wandering around in here, do you? You know how I feel about beavers.
Have to keep a close watch on the weaponry these days. The last thing we need is a killer snatching them up.
Before you ask, yes, it is odd for a Psijic mage to open a shop. But everyone has to have a hobby.
Didn't I see you with the Divine Prosecution? How can I be of service?
Do not wander the keep alone. You will only wind up dead or a suspect in the recent killings.

Raising pigs may not seem like a typical Psijic hobby, but I just find them so cute. And affectionate too! I always tend to have a few trailing behind me.
We've collected all sorts of source material in order to best research these cursed relics. Poetry, journals, even plays.\n\nJust read the plaques on the display cases if you want to learn more.
Killer's gone, so back to the usual sneers, I guess.
Quit bothering me you damn yell—oh. Sorry. What do you want?

I never realized how tough being on edge is on your neck. Give me a siege over a Daedric killer any day.
This one has not had to clean up after one of these killings, for which he is grateful. Though he has heard there is not much to clean up, so perhaps not.
This one is afraid he cannot talk. The Elven eyes are back upon his every move.
Please give the Captain some space. She has to organize a search of the premises. Something about secret floors or some such. It's very important, I'm sure.
The Captain isn't to be disturbed. She has many duty rosters to update thanks to the, um, staffing difficulties.
Welcome to Artaeum, cerum. Our tower is yours to explore … within reason, of course.
As in all things, repetition begets confidence, and confidence begets excellence. Do not grow lax in your studies, cerum.
I see you looking over my hoard of treasures, tuskless. I'll part with them … if the gold is right.
Why did you keep chasing it?
I sincerely hope whatever happened here never happens again. I would make an atrocious pirate. But I digress. How can I help you today?
A harmonious home is key to happiness. My goods can help you achieve such a goal.

I only deal with clients possessing either fame or notoriety. Luckily, you do qualify. Though only just.
