I know I've been a fool about this whole cult business, but if you ever heard the Master speak … well, it was like he was talking directly to me. Like he cared about me. Later, he scared the gorapple out of my pie, but before that, it was sublime.

Curios and furnishings. Consider how some other mortal spent a portion of its sad, finite existence to fashion them for another's benefit? How did they convince that creature to give up some of its life for such a materialistic endeavor?
Your world has … possibilities. Mortals create new things. It is the one attribute of yours that my kind envy. I see why so many of the Daedric Princes wish to claim your world for their own.
The range of my magic is limited. Track that fluid closer to me.
My cold fire needs a little more help to reach an active power module.
Taste our lord's power!
A delicate veil separates us. Soon, torn asunder.
They found us!
Just don't make eye contact and they won't hurt you.

Now, what to do for next time? How about replacing someone's paint bucket with milk? The city's cats would rush over to lick the side of a house!\n\nHmm, maybe too expensive. And we wouldn't want the cats to get splinters.
Our progress seems to have attracted friends.
It is good to see you again, my friend. Were you successful in the task I gave to you?
I look forward to your safe return. Please, speak to me as soon as you complete your task.
I could use your help, if you have the time. Your talents might be perfect for a job I need done.
I do not have any other work that needs doing at the moment, but I am sure I will need your services again. Seek me out later.
You've returned. What of your task?
You've got what you need to get going. The sooner started, the sooner done.
Want to prove yourself? Put your skills to good use in the service of Blackwood. You'll be well rewarded from Leyawiin's vaults if you come back victorious.
The Chamber of Legates appreciates your help. We'll have more work for you soon.
Use the fluid that Drathas provided.
It's not over! Just need to stay strong!
A challenge, huh? I knew I liked you!
You've got salamander company!
Our adventure just started. We try again!
I know that mass of muscle looks mean, but I bet you've faced tougher.
Ha! I bet this one chafes the knickers!
Eat arrows, you rotters!
My arrows never miss their mark!
Check out this move!
All this effort for naught.
Arrows away!
I've got another batch …! I always miss the big finale.
Give the order and we'll release a volley!
You wouldn't happen to know what would cause a healing potion to explode, would you? No? Never mind. I'll figure it out.\n\nSo … looking for healing potions?
Imperial, Khajiit, and Argonian smiths work shoulder-to-shoulder here, sharing tales and techniques.\n\nWhat will you teach us, I wonder?
To be honest, I prefer whittling keepsakes and furnishings. But weapons of war have a certain beauty too, I suppose.\n\nCome, show me your passion!
Let us see what challenge you offer me.
I shall watch how you use my power.
Leyawiin's nice, sure. But it's like my auntie always said: Never trust a city where most plants are shorter than you are.\n\nBut I digress. What can I do for you?
How embarrassing.
Enchantment's a game. A serious one, yes, but a game nonetheless.\n\nHow fine a player are you, I wonder?
Hungry, eh? Well, look no farther!\n\nCan't speak for the fruit, but I'm told it's divine.
Calia will attack Vandacia when you give the word.
Have you ever seen a death hopper, sera? They're frightful beasts, it's true. But I've never met a frog who could swallow a suit of iron.
Ever been in a spot where your gut's so clenched with guilt and sorrow that you can't bring yourself to drink?\n\nI mean … I haven't. Just wondering about you.
Authentic Blackwood cuisine … feh! If Azurah wanted us to eat mushrooms and tubers she would have made us pigs!
Get all kinds in Leyawiin. Less Khajiit than I'd like, though. I tell you, those Elsweyr cats spend like the gold's burning holes in their purse!
Sturdier than cloth and more subtle than steel! Is there any armor as fine as leather? I think not!\n\nCome! Have a look!
Leyawiin seems safe enough, sure. But, the wilds of Blackwood? About as safe as the inside of a crocodile's mouth.\n\nYou'll need what I carry!
Pay no heed to these fools in metal armor. Speed and maneuverability best lumbering protection every time.\n\nDon't believe me? Have a look.
Everyone's always belly-aching about death hoppers eating their livestock. You know what can't eat livestock? Dead death hoppers.\n\nBuy a weapon and see for yourself.
There are many things worth living for, and a few things worth dying for. Nothing is worth murder.
Time can be invested, spent, or wasted, but however you use it, you never get it back.
The Argonians have a saying: wood is stronger than steel because steel cannot grow.\n\nThis one's wares do not grow, but they are strong nonetheless!
I'm no stranger to adventure. Sure, I look meek and bookish, but you should see my hall of trophies!\n\nAs a matter of fact, I might have something you can add to your own collection.
Keep it away!
That must have hurt!
A home's not a home until you fill it with tasteful and expensive furnishings … oh, and laughter too, I guess. Whatever.
Tragic what the Three Banners War has done to Nibenay. But as I always say, where there is finance, there is hope!
Wood Elves accuse me of snobbery because I shirk some of our customs. Ridiculous.\n\nEver met a banker with filed teeth? Yeah, me neither.
The Divines were in a good mood when they made this place.
How did you fit all that gear in such a tiny bag? A warrior like you deserves a proper rucksack.
You know, the crest of Leyawiin is a rampant steed. Puts a lot of pressure on a stablemaster like me! But I think I'm doing all right.
You wanted our power? Here!
A sword without oil and whetstone is little more than a heavy club. Preparation begets victory.\n\nSpeaking of preparation, let's look over my wares, shall we?
Storing books in Hammerfell was so much easier. Everything here is so confoundedly … damp.\n\nBut enough of my grousing. What do you need?
You come seeking soul gems, yes? Remember: to master the power of souls, one must first find peace for the soul within.
Mauloch as my witness, I'm done with holding grudges. Beating people senseless is just too much work!\n\nSales, friend! That's where I find my bliss!
Wish they would let some of the prisoners run loose, give my arrows the excitement of the hunt.
Fight well or die swiftly!
<Rapid Angry snorts>
Waiting only hastens Xalvakka's arrival!
Every moment you delay, I drink more souls and grow stronger.
<deep, sharp barks>
Ha. Merely ashes in the wind.
They all fall before the might of Xalvakka!
Don't forget to take care of those feet! Blackwood's murder on the boots. Just a little advice, one adventurer to another.\n\nNow. Business!
Potent! Mysterious! Competitively priced! Come, friend! See all the grandest goods and scarcest stock Leyawiin has to offer!
A sleek and sturdy customer like you must have quality goods. Luckily, this one has quality goods in great supply!
Greetings, sera! Here to make a purchase? Why not two? You'll be twice as happy!
Despite my lack of footwear, I might have some for sale. Emphasis on might! Stock changes by the hour round here. Best move quick!
Anxious to weigh anchor and find solace for a broken heart out on the open sea? I know I am!\n\nWhere to, my friend?
I guess I'll do this myself.
Thought you had me, didn't you?
Stop it. That's cruel and wasteful!
The flames of Mehrunes Dagon consume you!
You summoned me and now you must fight.
Well done! Now faster!
Impressive!
Keep up the defense!
Give it everything you've got!
That's the way! Well done!
Again, make ready!
Ha! You're unstoppable!
Interrupt now! Before it strikes!
Excellent! Now, lay it on!
Expertly done!
Deposit or withdrawal, hmm? Remember, your shinies are extremely valuable. Do not squander them!
Approach, featherless! You will not regret it. But if you do, take your complaints elsewhere. Elsewhere!
Stibbo make hurt now!
I need help!
Cities are as alive, fickle, and uncertain as people. Some are good; some are bad. Some give you gifts; others rob you blind.
What's on your mind?
Got some fresh bilge grubs for sale! Get them while they're molting!
Now that's a neat trick!
Quistley really got himself into it this time, the idiot.
The flames consume mortal flesh too quickly for my taste.
I need no blade to deal with measly mortals.
I tire of this. When can the slaying begin?
What can I ravage today?
These blood sacks shall burst before me.
Devastation comes to Nirn this day!
I hear the air doesn't ignite upon Nirn.
All hail the Prince of Destruction!
The master unleashed a river of fire. It was glorious!
Mortals have no reason to exist.
Destroy anything that isn't one of us.
Quiet, churls. I heard something.
Dagon grants us strength!
I died a thousand deaths in service to Mehrunes Dagon!
I long for a true challenge, not these pathetic annoyances.
Dagon laughs and the world shakes!
We took everything else. Time to take your lives!
Why couldn't you try to kill someone else?
I'm not trying to be a bother, but I could really use some assistance here!
I love being kicked into another dimension.
That was much too close for comfort!
I have great hopes for this incarnation.
The Prince's plan is coming to fruition.
Does the weather reflect Lord Dagon's mood, I wonder?
I have been told that Lord Dagon has taken note of my service.
You can trust Henadi to keep your goods safe and sound. Unless they look particularly delicious.\n\nHa! Just yanking your tail, walker!
Here comes Stibbo!
No! No water!
Stibbo stay here!
You know, I once commanded forces to lay seize to … bah. I've been told I reminisce too much instead of selling.\n\nSo, what'll you have?
Destruction is just a new beginning.
This had better be worth it, or I'm knocking him out again.
Embrace us. Let us drown you in love.
Teach them a lesson about paying their tithes!
Your bones look strong. I can't wait to make use of them.
This focal point is finished, but it wasn't the only one by the look of it.
The plants, they hunger!
Now you suffer!
Fire consume you!
Mortals have a stench about them.
Your frailty betrays you, mortal.
All will fall before me!
The Lord of Devastation sends his regards.
Come and find your end, mortal.
Like fire from the sky!
Your patience is rewarded.
Who is that sleek crow I spy?
People in Leyawiin are so damned careless. Just seems like they lose things all the time!
Wither and die!
Didn't bring any heat with you, did you? Last thing we need is brigadines nosing around down here.\n\nAll right, let's deal.
Don't, uh … don't look directly at the rabbit. Just trust me on this.\n\nI've got plenty of goods to look at instead!
Watch what you eat at the Egg and Hammer Inn. My last meal doesn't know whether it wishes to stay or leave.\n\nLet's talk goods … quickly.
There's no better place than Gideon! We have the best potions, too. Try some of mine! Er … the ones I'm selling, that is!
I've got one rule: only do good if you're getting paid like someone who does bad. Leave the charity work for priests and simpletons.
I treat my mounts well. You should do the same, or you may find your life shortened by a great deal.
The safety I once knew is now only a dream. I erect the spine of welcome regardless. How may I help you?
I wonder how long the village's supplies can hold out?
Were this a different day, I'd erect the spine of hospitality. Instead, I have potions and sundries for sale.\n\nPerhaps once the healer lets me go, I can see about more.
Those villagers are complete cowards!
If these slavers have harmed a hair on Clairene's head, none of them are walking out of here. I swear it!
Yes, more, more!
Chaos will rule! You cannot stop this!
Chaos is pure! There is no order in our paradise!
They scream for they do not understand the peace which chaos brings.
Oh, Mirri, the struggle only makes this more fun.
The power of my lord brings forth abominations!
I bring forth an unstoppable army!
You'd think that a few more personal comforts could be arranged. Do you know how much gold I've tithed to the Unmaker?
I grow weary of teaching these newcomers how to properly conduct a human sacrifice. The last one I supervised made an awful mess of it.
Why does Lalais insist we guard every chamber? Is she expecting unwelcome guests?
I've spoken with my cousin about the Unmaker. I think he might be ready to join us.
I grow weary of teaching these newcomers how to properly conduct a human sacrifice. The last one I supervised made an awful mess of it.
Puny weakling! Xeemhok feast on your flesh!
This realm will be ours …!
Soon our master will reclaim what is his!
We can make use of this place again. Xigira will make it so.
Though you'll see mostly Imperials, Argonians, and Khajiit around here, we have Nords and some Reachfolk show up.\n\nLet's get to business, shall we?
Our triumph is at hand.
Is there no foe here worthy of my blade?
Lord Vandacia promised a great reward to the one who delivers him the Ambitions.
Search every corner, every chamber! They must be here.
Check the bodies of the slain! The Ambitions may be feigning death.
Come, my comrades. Our work is not done.
Do you smell that? Our triumph is at hand!
This business is too important to leave in a mortal's hands.
What was that?
The lord of bloodshed will rule over all existence!
For Dagon!
The Dark Brotherhood is nothing compared to Dagon's might!
Fools! The Dark Brotherhood does not forgive!
Cowards!
The roads here may look peaceful, but they hide dangers. Stay wary, traveler, and be prepared. I have some goods you might find helpful, or I can take extra burdens off your back.
Be careful of the frogs in the marshes near here. Or are they toads? Ah, the unending conundrum of frog and toad: same or different?\n\nEnough of that, though. Let us get to business, yes?
The Three Banners War is fierce. Taking a break makes you appreciate the war more when you head back in.\n\nSpeaking of breaks, I've got some beds for rent right here.
When someone snags you while battling, don't stand there and take it. Break free! Then return the favor. Or just take them out with one of my weapons.
Is that High Elf watching me? Oh, never mind. Let's talk about my amazingly wondrous goods instead.
Let me answer what I'm sure is your most pressing question. Why, yes, I do have a crown for sale amid my offerings. Take a look!
Eh, you don't need to wipe off any blood from your last match before browsing my goods. Blood's a good addition to any of my wares.

I craft each of my dishes with a specific beverage in mind. Right now, I'm trying to figure out what to pair with a wine that's become popular recently. \n\nIt's called … Leyawine. Clever, yes? Or perhaps too clever.
In Gideon, we would serve these rats for morning meal. Here in Leyawiin? Bah. We waste more than we eat.
Come to Leyawiin, they said. It'll be glorious, they said. \n\nNow look at me. Hopes dashed, no coin to my name, surrounded by flies and dripping with snot.
One of the Argonians here is afraid of my ball. Every time I wander by, he ducks into a building or runs off. \n\nI wonder why.
The Niben River is beautiful, yes, but you would be surprised how many bodies float through here. Troubles up river, you see.\n\nI don't think that Three Banners War will ever end.

I don't trust those who use their money to control people in Leyawiin. It's a corrupt system. And they don't exactly like when I call attention to it.\n\nI'm glad my life partners are an ex-assassin and a battlemage. They have my back.
Gods, my back.\n\nLook, don't get me wrong, I'm happy for the work. But would it kill these people to ship in something a little lighter? Where's Leyawiin's thriving pillow industry?
Foolish birds, they take Her love for granted.
Rustling feathers, foolish darkness, all they do is talk.
What does she think of me? Does she think of me at all?
The shadows will hold me, the darkness will lick my bones.
Mortals cannot know the depths of this pain.
Squabbling, cackling, dark eyes, beady eyes.
They whisper to me. Do you hear it?
For every end, a new beginning. A fool's words.
Every dusk, a loving embrace. Every dawn, a knife in the back.
The shadows are friends, they chase away the light.
We follow the will of our mistress.
Good, I was beginning to grow bored.
I'll put a stop to your meddling!
Are you lost?
Smugglers once hid goods in barrels and left them in the waterways around Leyawiin, tied to a stone. They stopped when Dezirri started harvesting them all.

Before this damned cart broke down, I was using it to bring merchandise to Gideon. You ever been there? That place feels strange to me. Like … hair-raising strange.\n\nI told my betrothed and he said I'm just imagining things.
Chaos surround you.
Kill! Kill! Kill all the intruders, my pets!
When is the next sacrifice, egg-brother?
I pity the lesser tribes.
I heard we captured some travelers. Good.
I suspect a storm is approaching.
Destruction comes to us all, egg-sister.
If they are not Sul-Xan, they are not worthy.
Soon, all of Blackwood will be ours.
I think that's all of them. Now the array!
A scout saw intruders. Be on your guard.
The bog dogs seem particularly agitated for some reason.
Have you seen the chapel yet? The calm in there might make your teeth itch after awhile, but it's nice enough. Honestly, I think they make it that way on purpose so you get back to work.

Take a long, hard look at yourself now and again. You might not like what you see. Or perhaps you will. \n\nIf it's the former, do something about it. If it's the latter, you're better off than most folk.
The roots have taken, the sacrifices toil.
It thrives in the dirt. Chaos, it takes form.
Their hands bleed, and they cry. They do not see the gift chaos brings.
Grind the bones of the dead, sprinkle them in the soil.
Once we find the Ambitions, nothing will stop us.
So much to do, so little time.
Soon, we will have all we desire.
Can you feel it? The roots cling to your scales.
It is potent. Good.
Mind the leaves, they will show the first signs of death.
The potency is acceptable. Continue.
Glory to fire of Dagon!
Do they know the gift they have been given?
Pathetic. Hardly any guards or defenses.
Did anyone explain what's going to happen?
Glory to Lord Dagon!
I wonder what we're actually going to find in here.
Do not breathe in the fumes. It will burn the throat.
They will do the work, or they will die.
Is the high priest here? Who's commanding our forces?
These Ambitions, why are they so important?
Be on your guard. The high priest expects trouble.
The Deadlands are so … red.
Burn the butterflies. They watch everything. They mustn't.\n\nKill all the spiders. They seek power. They shouldn't.
The culmination of decades of planning is upon us!
They broke the wards and our portals did the rest.
For the glory of Lord Dagon!
Lord Dagon, grant us strength!
The mortals think to order us around?
The master's cult found an Ambition.
Destron and Calia are in our care.
Lord Dagon is the fire flowing through my veins!
Has the time finally arrived to let the rams free?
Keep looking.
Do we have to suffer the presence of those mortal fools?
No one comes through until the high priest gives the word.
That stench? That's mortal stink, isn't it?
As Lord Dagon commands, so shall it be!

Sure, Zenithar, talk all you want about gainful work and trade or whatever it is you go on about, but how is anyone supposed to succeed when the system is stacked against them? Leyawiin and its corrupt god can kiss my arse.
I hear Nirn is overrun with the foul creatures!
I smell an intruder!
The mortal priest considers himself special. I want to rip out his heart.
I expect a battle to break out before too long.
All belongs to Dagon!
We are legion!
This vault is ours. Not even Mephala can wrench it from our grasp.
Wait. I smell something.
Dagon scorch the lot of them!

You ever live through one of those years where it seems like everything's on fire?\n\nI feel like that's happening around us right now. I plan to sleep for ages once things settle down. If things settle down.
I've never liked running. If the Divines meant for people to run, they wouldn't have given us horses.
Lord Silvelle taught me that a good horse is smarter than his rider, but under no circumstances should the horse be allowed to know this.
While the soil around here hasn't seen as much blood recently, there's plenty soaked in from past battles.\n\nDon't think about it too much. You'll likely be eating food grown around here.
The good we do today will likely be forgotten tomorrow, but let's do it anyway.
You smell disgusting, mortal flesh!
We'll be rid of these spiders soon enough.
Flame-father, bear witness! I kill in your name.
Our task is simple, and the Kyn are weak.
Leave only silk and husks!
We stay until the machine is ours.
Seems like in this town, if you've got enough coin, you get what you want. Pah.
Come, fire-whelps! Taste my bite!
Have you been to a party here yet? People in Leyawiin really know how to celebrate … and eat.
I hope we'll all see the relic, but she'll probably keep it for herself.
Who goes there?
This occupation was easy, thanks to my illusions.
Should we poison the wells when we go?

Ugh. Just clearing my nose of the stench of incompetence. My house reeks of it! I'd hire new servants, but I've grown to accept the fact that nobody does anything right. Ever. I have to constantly correct them. Constantly!\n\nIt's exhausting!
The giant toads aren't usually poisonous, though their gasses are flammable.
Do these hostages seem worth so much to you?
Why do Daedra look at us like we're lunch?
For Vandacia!
I serve Councilor Vandacia.

I find it shameful that battlemages sought so much Imperial power. That served to attract others to that type of magic—folk who have absolutely no empathy—which harms everyone, ultimately. Ambition is a self-serving trait.
A sacrifice? That seems … excessive.
Don't slouch. If Councilor Vandacia sees you, you'll be the next one on the altar.
Ever want to see if you could beat a Dremora?
Did you know Councilor Vandacia was a high priest? I didn't know that.
Did you see all those fancy outfits? Prancing peacocks, the lot of them.
I hope someone does try to sneak back here.
Dagon's fires light our way.
So, what happens after all the death and destruction?
I look forward to taking part in the ceremony.
The order is my home.

If you seek blessings on matters of wealth, trade, labor, or communication, feel free to pray to Zenithar while you are here.\n\nHe might not provide you with the Mace of the Crusader, as he did Pelinal Whitestrake, but he may answer in other ways.
The Argonians around here make me smile. Their tales of Keshu make me want to take up my sword again.

This edifice is the work of Saint Kaladas. By all accounts, he was an unusual man—even by First Era standards.\n\nAccording to legend, he dreamed of the mad Elf-slayer, Pelinal, every night—and those dreams drove him to build this chapel!
I can't wait until our lord claims the mortal realm.
I've signed with a lot of outfits, but this one's got the sharpest tusks.
Ha ha! Spit melt you away!
You cannot run! Too slow!
Don't worry. If any hostages make a run for it I can skewer a knee at a hundred paces.
Crush outsiders!
Share the fire with you!
Where do you suppose we'll go once we have the relic?
Taking hostages is cowardly, but it sure is effective.
We should keep a hostage up on the walls to make an example, if the brigade tries anything.

Can you believe that some Nibenese make a hobby out of arranging marriages? You heard me correctly. A hobby, not a paid profession.\n\nThe only thing worse is planning weddings! Who would volunteer for that?
That was somebody's pet, or their dinner. Why would you be so mean?
Kill them!

I believe we should all institute the afternoon nap as a tradition. I would have started already, but my wife disagrees. Vehemently. She says something about Zenithar finding it an affront.\n\nNow she stomps around the house whenever I try to doze off.
Let the burning fires consume you!
No!
Burn!
Chaos claim you!
Xalvakka favors me with gifts!
Such insignificant creatures.
You'll be avenged!
Don't linger around here unless you're ready to deal with the consequences. Some don't appreciate strangers poking around their business … and they'll let you know it.
Can anyone spare a healing potion?
You cannot halt the wave of chaos here.
You dare enrage a superior combatant? So be it.
Your blood will feed the harrada!
Fine, I will kill them myself!
You have chosen death. Chaos will consume you.
I've read some accounts that the windows of the Chapel of Zenithar were made with Ayleid stones. \n\nUtter nonsense.
Find some cover!
Something on your mind?
What's wrong now?
Of course. Anything in particular?
Couldn't be better. Is there a problem?

I'll take a life if I must, but I take no joy in it. Assassins and thieves who wrap their deeds in fancy oaths and guild trappings have no honor. Murder is murder, and taking things you've no right to is wrong in my view.
Let me guess. I should rush our enemies and you'll be right behind me?
New strategy, eh?
I strive to make a habit of trying new things.
Be about your business, please.
The secret to success in this life is to properly acknowledge all deities. All suffering in life can be explained by our failure to do so.

Leyawiin is a nice place, but be careful who you trust. In this city especially, appearances can deceive. \n\nEveryone wants to look like they're well off and important. Some will even ruin themselves trying to appear wealthy.
The annual Fighters Guild celebration requires one to have a high tolerance for drink. Consider this fair warning if you find yourself in attendance.
I came here to sample Leyawiin's libations. Unfortunately, it seems that only the priests are allowed to drink it in this temple. \n\nWhat a waste.
I was never a fan of my homeland's dust and sand. The air here is better. It refreshes you.
If you plan to go hunting out in the marshes, watch out for the gigantic frogs. They're lethal.\n\nAnd don't even think about trying to tame one. They'll eat you in your sleep.

I heard the Fighters Guild took out a group of smugglers hiding out in a cellar a few weeks back.\n\nThey filled in the cellar afterward. Shame. Lots of good wine and other valuables in there. Glad the smugglers are gone, though.
When I joined the guild, everyone called themselves Skatum for a few days.\n\nIt was very strange. There was much confusion.
Most of the nobles here don't do much. They leave the politics to others. Most of the work that gets done around Leyawiin is done by the Chamber of Legates.

I feel that the spirit of this town stems from self-reliance and an understanding that life is short.\n\nToo much of that is dangerous, of course, but in moderation, it can yield moments of contentedness.
Some people enjoy traversing the lands currently torn apart by the Three Banners War.\n\nThat, to me, exhibits a strong dedication to exploration. Or looting, I suppose.
If my archery impresses you, you should see my pottery! Little less exciting, sure. But you can't drink wine out of an arrow!
I swear we have chipmunks in this city, but I never quite see them. It's always just movement out of the corner of my eye … maybe a trick of the light?

Ha! Brigadines are turning the city upside down looking for me! I'd tell you what I stole, but you wouldn't believe it.\n\nSeriously, don't try to get it out of me. My lips are sealed! You'll never …. Y'ffre's bones, aren't you even going to guess?
These hidden places will not be enough to protect us from what's coming. The fire-cat is waking. I see it in my dreams, walker. Beware!
Did you know Gideon stands on what was once an ancient Ayleid settlement? Fascinating! And the Kothringi once occupied this town! There's so much history here, I want to learn it all.
I love experimenting with new stringed instruments. Adjusting the depth of the sound hole, the material of the body … even the length of the neck can lead to miraculously different results.
I keep finding burnt fish in the waters around here. It's very odd. Either someone's playing an elaborate joke on me, or there's something very wrong going on in Gideon.
I respect the local Argonians, especially those who follow Keshu. She's done great work in Gideon. Because of her, this tends to be a vibrant, welcoming place.
I'm not so sure about this Keshu … does her being in charge mean we're under Argonian rule? How can we be sure she'll keep us safe?

We get the occasional fortune hunter out this way. They're usually poking around for Kothringi treasures.\n\nI think it's bad luck to collect things from people that died of the Knahaten Flu. I don't know, maybe I'm just superstitious.
I think some of the dryskins are nervous about Keshu being in charge around here. You can see it in their eyes.
There's a lot of history here in Gideon. The Imperial invasion of Argonian lands was successfully launched from this spot. Of course, that was all a long time ago.
Humility. Always humility. The only victories that matter in life are those you win against yourself.
Defeat is a hard teacher. Remember the lesson.
Is this a game that you really want to play?
Use my power!
This is a business arrangement, nothing more.  I said I'd work with you. I didn't say I liked you.
Sometimes, at night, the glow of the stars here shifts slightly. Or perhaps that's just my sorrow at the plight of our people.
I'm positive all will get better for our tribe. It has to.
I'm worried about the sort of choices you seem to make. I'm not sure we're after the same things.
Will you be quiet? You're driving me to drink!
I like that you're a listener. So many people like to hear themselves talk.
You're good company. I feel like we see things the same way.
I count myself lucky that Tenarei Vels knocked me out and left me tied up outside Deepscorn Hollow. I've had no truer friend in my life.
Life was made for good friends and great adventures.
I hope you're not offended. Physical relationships aren't something I take lightly.
I didn't expect you to have a change of heart. I … yes, of course!
I … I am disappointed, of course. But I will respect your wishes.
Please, while our hospitality is less than what we'd care to present, you are welcome to speak to what little we have remaining.
Keep them on the defensive!
It occurs to me that love and magic have a lot in common. They both delight your heart and enrich your soul. And both can be dangerous to beginners.
The Divines were in a good mood when they made this place!
I ended up out here because my vision is extremely good. You need that if you're patrolling borders.\n\nYou especially need that if you're watching to see if Dragons come this way.
We sometimes get Baandari out this way. They told me about Dragons showing up in Elsweyr.\n\nAs if we didn't have enough to worry about with this Three Banners War.
Such small, weak cattle.
I will cut out your heart and eat it raw!
You know, I'll tell you this for nothing: Don't ever be a Wood Elf in a militia filled with Imperials. I come out here to do a job, and all I get is grief.
Prowlers are dangerous adversaries. Better to live with them than to make them enemies.\n\nThe puzzle there involves figuring out how to live with them.
I wonder if the supply caravan I set up will get here at a bad time.\n\nWell, at least we'll have supplies if we can't return to our posts.
I'm Leyawiin born and bred, so I was around when Sai Sahan cut a bloody swath through town.\n\nThat was some day, let me tell you. The smell after was terrible. But worth it for the freedom.
Kill the trespassers!
Let the flames of my death protect you!
Chaos gathers me in. My life is yours!
I've been thinking.
Your teeth are big and scary, but you're so cute. Yes, you are. Yes, you are!
A warrior stands ready to fight for the Prince.
I test all my weapons on banekin.
Melt me, Chaos! Dissolve my flesh!
You dare challenge our Lord of Fire and Flood?
But you won't last much longer.
How can you stand against this onslaught?
Still going? I'm almost impressed.
Don't gloat just yet. We have many more of these devices.
I'm not sure what's been going on here, but it has something to do with that old xanmeer.\n\nThe local Argonians refuse to talk about the place of old stones, as they refer to it, though.
I am not sure why so many scholars visit us. We are but a simple tribe, living in harmony with the land.
Leave me alone. Just leave me alone!
The champion has arrived!
The eye of death falls upon you.
Nothing is permanent. Everything changes. Too bad dryskins cannot understand a truth as simple as that.

A merchant recently visited, seeking unusual items to purchase. I offered her some water. She looked confused.\n\nI told her the water here is unusual to those who live elsewhere. I don't think she took me seriously after that.
Oh, chaos, hear our call!
Something's wrong. I shouldn't be here.
I used to live around Leyawiin. Bunch of lazy arseholes there, let me tell you. Hard work didn't mean a thing. They hated it, and I had no patience for them for hating it.

I once traveled the seas as a deckhand, seeking to learn all the songs sung on the seas.\n\nI now perhaps use too much alliteration in my own speech after memorizing many songs to share with my egg-kin at home.
Anyone? Mmmffff it ate mmmmmmm!
Ugh, I smell like old socks that have been left in a bog. Thanks for the help, I'm going to wash up.
The mead might not be good here, but the competition is. My blood is pumping just thinking about facing off against the Fire Drakes and Storm Lords again!
I chose to pass through Gideon to explore the artistry of the people there. Some supply goods to the vendors here.\n\nI should have a lute with Fire Drake colors soon, thanks to an artisan in Gideon!

I haven't seen Leyawiin. I didn't see Gideon. I've heard of some of these places, but they're just places I pass through on my way to the next competition. Places don't feed my ambition to win.\n\nAnd Storm Lords should always win.
Sometimes you just have to get away from your life to write your stories. New scenery. No people constantly interrupting you.\n\nYou do begin talking to yourself a bit more ….

I admire Keshu the Black Fin. She once stood alone, as her name states, but now she doesn't.\n\nCurrently, I stand alone. Will I find a purpose that will draw others to me, as she did? Though, I am finding standing alone curiously freeing now.
Each rustle in the weeds is only some vermin too small to be worth my arrow. This time is not any different.
No need for an alarm, you die now!
When chaos reigns and the world is right, I wonder if I'll miss the endless hours of waiting by a wall.
I will cut you where you stand.
Everyone thinks stealth is all sneaking and timing, but it's really a lot of waiting in bushes or behind trees and knowing not to talk to yourself until you're sure you're alone.
Found my next kill!
The Hist sent me out to spearfish in every puddle of water between Lilmoth and Leyawiin.\n\nI am unsure of the purpose of this, but I am attached to no outcome.
So many arsonists in one place, how are there still trees?
I will cut you to ribbons.
I'm not saying we should kill them all and be done with it, but would gagging them hurt?
Let me add a scar to your face.
Calm yourself and listen to the ground.
Burn like the others.
Mark your fruitless eyes, when this ritual is done our lord will know what we've achieved and will praise us.
You let this hapless fool injure you?
I'm not sure how large our lord is. He's said to be tall, but, the sky goes on forever in the Deadlands. He'd never have to stop growing.
Strike the newcomer down.
The trick is to remember not to eat after handling poison. Or rub your scales.
The beast will enjoy feasting on you.
Promised me a hunt. No hunt here.
You will feel my arrows in your back.
Just a few more souls and then death and destruction will reign.
Burn in my fires.
Your journey ends here.
I like it when the sacrifices scream.
Give up.
Our work shouldn't take too much longer now.
Ha. You think you can beat me?
Look, all I'm saying is that the beast won't care if the sacrifices have all their toes attached to them.
I'll cut you to ribbons and feed you to the fire.
Planning to take over the world is hard work. Once this is over and Dagon rules everything, I'm going to sleep for a fortnight.
Give your life for my cause.
I can't wait for my turn to tear the souls from those cowering clawed bodies.
You made a fatal error coming here.
Another unprepared tribe attempted to overthrow our plans a few days ago, Prince of Disaster took them all in his glorious blaze.
Come to provide some entertainment?
Hope Xalvakka doesn't mind taking the crazy ones. I swear we've broken more minds then we started with.
Die with dignity.
I can work with that Assassin, don't worry, but will I ever think of him fondly? Don't make me laugh.
Block this you coward.
Really? I'm flattered … flustered … but I'm definitely interested.
Once the Harvester is full, it'll be time to end this interminable break and strike the mortals down where they stand.
My lord Dagon doesn't want someone as puny as you.
Mortals think they know all about how to torture one another. Pssh. They're too focused on limbs to recognize it even if I boiled the bile in their stomachs.
End this farce and I will take less pleasure in watching you burn.
Guar dung! The best thing these mortals can do for our lord is give their souls to the Harvesters.
What makes you think you're worthy of my time?
It's never a mistake to help others. One of the most important things you can do in this life is to let other people know they're not alone.
Have you ever wondered what awaits you in the coming days?\n\nWonder no more! For a small fee, your fate and fortune will be revealed. Accuracy guaranteed up to five days.
I adore books. They're like magical keys that open up worlds and change perspectives.
Some say gold can't buy happiness. It seems to me they just don't know where to shop!
I don't believe that magic, in itself, can be evil. It's simply how you choose to use it.
Your intuition is remarkable. Can you teach me that?
A hard life and a violent death. Such is the fate of a bandit.
I saw all the cultists I cared to in Deepscorn Hollow. Yet here we are, dealing with cultists again.
Why are people so offended when you say you don't like cheese? I don't judge them for their dislikes. Do I?
Cruelty is never justified.
I saw you pick that pocket.
We're not punished for our sins, but by them. Remember that.
I can't stand it anymore!
Why do people who work sitting down get paid more than those who work standing up?
Reachmen say that fires are only dangerous when they get bored. That's why we tell them stories and let them lick our food.
Art isn't what you see, but what the artist makes you see.
Books are the wisest counselors, the most patient teachers, and the most faithful friends.
Can you sense that? A psijic portal!
Is it true that it rains toads in the Shivering Isles?
Look here! A stranger's loss might be our gain.
I don't know where I'm going, but I'm well on my way!
I won't allow you to escape that easily.
Careful, now. For a duelist, death can be a professional hazard.
Keep going! You're wearing them down!
I've no skill with this, but I'm willing to learn.
Do you think that might have been excessive?
Heroes don't give up; they get up!
Are you stuck or choosing to remain still?
Clear your mind and break the spell!
Your guardian was defeated!
That one's trouble!
If it bleeds it can be killed.
Every villain is the hero of their own story. Funny, that.
You mess with the swordsman, you'll get the point!
I'm not dead yet!
You're exhausted. Pace yourself!
If you can't rely on magic, change your strategy!
Those who insist on working alone will have rivals instead of allies.
You do know that's a Dragon, don't you? Are you sure about this?
You must be out of your mind. No sane person picks a fight with a Dragon.
I can't resist a passageway that leads to the unknown.
This is a place of evil.
You're never content to rest on your laurels. I admire that.
This place is special to me.
Let's ride!
Very clever.
Well, hello there.
This one's my favorite!
Something's different. New hairstyle?
The more, the merrier!
Just because you didn't get caught doesn't mean you didn't deserve to.
This is going to come back to haunt you. Mark my words!
I thought you gave up thieving.
What do you think you'll make with that?
Let's keep our eyes open for a tavern where we can spend that!
That might be useful.
Find anything?
I cast you from this form, spirit. May Azura's light guide you home.
Grandmother! You should be resting, not wandering about in the minds of others.
Ready when you are.
Get back you fetcher!
Maybe I should have joined the Buoyant Armigers?
That blade is pure evil. It doesn't just take lives, it takes souls!
Are we waiting for someone? Some thing? Just because?
What a sight! I can't wait to write home about this.
Dealing with Ashlanders is dangerous, but they really are a great source for my Daedra research.
Why in Vehk's name are you butchering livestock?
Help! I'm … help!
Some people don't like the bustle of cities, but I come from a big family, so it reminds me of home.
Something you need to discuss?
Well this seems a lot less deadly than delving. Why did mom never suggest this to me?
So the corpse-wife of an all-consuming-death-god whispers to her favorite murder-child who all her other murder-children should be killing. Do you have any idea how insane that sounds?
My butt will be numb if we ride much longer.
I have gotten used to a great deal of unusual things since we started traveling together. Not a complaint, just odd to think about.
If you're going to kill bugs, at least kill fetcher flies.
Hey! Get up! Hey!
I could use some help!
Maybe we should retreat?
If you want to take a break, I won't complain.
If you're planning to boss me around. Forget it. I'm neither your servant, nor your friend.
Discuss away.
If you've got something on your mind, you can just come out with it.
My dad's an antiquarian. He gave me an appreciation of cultural artifacts. Mom showed me how to find them. I prefer to treat such things with the respect they deserve.
Have you sufficiently asserted your dominance? Can we get back to business now?
Forget that fetcher. Bet they were cheating anyway.
Well, that escalated quickly.
Ready for some teamwork?
Don't fetching pretend your interested in being my friend. The only reason I'm still here is you have some redeeming qualities far outside your personality.\n\nWe done?

If you were one of my siblings I'd bop you on the skull. A lot. I'm trying to be professional though. If you could manage your behavior better things would be better for the both of us.\n\nCan you do that?
So you've noticed my complaining? Well, good. If you want us to get along, maybe try not to piss me off so often. I'm trying to work with you here. Help me out.

I don't regret throwing my lot in with you, if that's what you're asking. There aren't many adventurers I'm willing to partner up with again and again, but you keep proving yourself useful.\n\nAnd pretty nice.
I … never had too many friends. I like to think I can count you among them. Quality over quantity.
Now you've got me worried. Traveling with you has been the highlight of my life. I hope you feel the same. Or, at least don't mind too much.
I've never felt so vulnerable. I've exposed all of myself to you. You haven't run away screaming, so I guess that's a good sign.
Well, that was the most awkward conversation of my life. Let's do our best to forget it. I think I still have some wine in my pack.
What would Lord Vehk do in this situation? Kiss you? Kill you? Both? You're lucky I'm not fully orthodox.\n\nWe can try again.
Vehk help me! I knew it was dumb to fall for you. I really don't want to cut you off, but this is going to be fetching awkward.
Staggered them!
All these Daedra appearing would be great for my studies if we didn't always have to be killing them.
I wonder how the Tribunal Temple feels about the Clockwork Apostles? Actually, I wonder if they even know they exist. We're in a whole other world.
We already trust our lives to one another. Our hearts should be easy … right? Just, please, don't hurt me.
If you brought me here because you knew I'd like it. Well done.
Bringing a book for travel is well worth the pack space. Shame they're so heavy.
You are going to let me try that, right?
I don't know if they call Lord Seht the Father of Mysteries because of his skill at unraveling them or because no one can figure him out.
Spawn of Malak's putrid feces.
As far as I'm concerned, all snakes are poisonous!
I saw nothing.
I'm leaving. Come to me when you're ready to stop being a s'wit.
I don't suppose we have anything to cook?
I wasn't aware you could tame Daedric creatures. Not without sorcery anyway.
If you're trying to introduce me to your family, I have no interest in your siblings!
Dare I say, I think you're being a good influence on me.
I don't have to officiate or anything, do I?
Come on, now. Finish them!
This should be interesting. I haven't had any training for this.
I think you got their attention.
Don't let them throw you around like that!
Roll! Roll if you can!
It's all in your head! Keep fighting!
Poor thing's dead.
Please don't fetching get me killed.
The world could do with a few less of those. Sheesh.
Do you want to brag about that, or should I?
That's a slaughter Dagon would envy.
That's much better!
Use a stamina draught!
Easy! Let your magicka recover!
That was truly vile.
Why did it have to be a Dragon?
Bet mom would love a Dragon skin rug.
This looks ripe for adventure. Maybe a tad overripe.
Something's not right here. Be ready for a fight.
Vehk's in for some competition.
I've been wanting to visit here. Spare a moment?
Was tired of walking anyway.
Where did you get that?
I had a pony guar when I was little. Pon pon. She was adorable.
Don't tell the other pets, but I like you the best!
Hello there, gorgeous!
We got away, this time.
Hey, warn me before you're going to be a fetching s'wit!
That's why I use a bank.
Nice haul!
Finders keepers, as they say.
That should fetch a fair fetching price!
Lucky fetcher. I only ever seem to find musty grain and spuds.
Oh slip on entrails mortal! I'll return and when I do, I will be seeing to you first.
Just getting some fresh air, dear. You know it gets stuffy and cramped in my grave.
Seht's beard! You lot are more innovative than anticipated. Mark my words, next time I won't be so easy to detect!
Juniper! Did you take that from your sister? Drop it! You've already had your share.
I have never seen someone dressed in your manner before! Those color choices are truly inspiring. Please, I require some knowledgeable advice.
I have chosen the perfect compliment to your overwhelming beauty, dear. Come see!
I'm not used to being a man of leisure. M'lady gets so flustered when I'm away. I left her in very capable hands but I worry about her so.
Sometimes I think I should do something different with my hair, but Lady Laurent isn't fond of change.
I was telling the maids and fellow manservants the other day how much I appreciate the clear directions and stern punishments that Lady Laurent hands out. I would be lost without her guidance.
Good friend, may we discuss something other than our past adventures together? I've been away from m'lady for too long, and such memories will turn my bleak mood ever darker. I hope you understand.

Cold. Ever since that time atop Sorrow, I've been troubled by the slightest chill in the air.\n\nI guess that's to be expected, given how long Lady Laurent left me in that damnable block of ice! I wonder how she'd like it if I let her tea get cold?

Since that incident in Murkmire, I've taken a different view of the simple egg. It is more than the basis of a souffle or a hearty breakfast. The egg is a sacred vessel. Why, I vow never to cook them again!\n\nThough I do adore a good scramble ….

Do you recall that incident in Blackwood? At the xanmeer? Well, you'll think me mad but I must tell someone!\n\nI think there are still duplicates, following me. Why, I awoke this morning and thought I was a duplicate! Checked for goo and everything.
I haven't heard from Seeks since I got here. He said he'd come get me when I was needed, but it feels like I've been waiting forever!\n\nI'm beginning to feel unwanted.
Wonder why they call moving stolen goods fencing and laundering? That's too pedestrian for Lady Twilight. She should liquidate and polish … maybe.
Wonder whatever happened to Teldundindo of Sunhold? Don't think I ever saw him after he ran off in the sewer under Borderwatch.\n\nMaybe he's still down there, listening to the echo of his own voice.
Those Blackguards were a nasty bunch. And I don't just mean they were mean. They all smelled like soggy armpits and netch farts. No wonder Seeks left.
Why is it that Mephala is always depicted as some seductive woman? I've seen what her kids look like and it ain't that.
You know that Dark Elves and Orcs are both cursed races? Dunmer just don't dwell on it constantly.
Say, would you call this a literal "rogue's gallery"?
I can't get over how meticulous all this is. I'd never have the patience for it. I suppose that's what makes it all the more impressive.
You can't avoid your fates, Ambitions!
[Goblin babble calling out for allies]
Magic! Fascinations to beguile your very imaginations!

I, myself, am no mere magician like those you'll find in the House of Revelry. I wield magic. I imbue it. Shape it to my own delights and those of the people I favor. \n\nFor some coin, I could favor you with a display of whatever your heart desires.
The weak mortals will be no match for the Kyn.
I serve the will of the Lord of Flood and Fire!
Why does this mortal realm give us problems?
Go and claim victory for our lord.
My triumph is inevitable.
I wasn't prepared for a contest today. I'll just have to improvise! That's when the magic happens.
Well, that was a fun diversion! But who's going to clean up?
I'm itching to light someone on fire.
Gathering this energy is vital to Lord Dagon's plans. Don't take it lightly.
Take some alive. I want to torture them!
Keep them away from the stones!
Is that a potential with you? She still has a sparkle of innocence in her eyes. I love watching it die.
I have feasted on fear to bursting, but I am not yet sated!
I expected more, Martus. But I suppose I always was superior in the application of pain.
In Dagon's name, they are broken!
So mysterious, so shiny. What is this magic?
How lovely, how grand!
I'll be right by your side.
Worry not about the floor if you grow sick.
If death finds me, let me meet it with a sword in my hand.
Victory or death! There is no defeat today!
Is this the best Dagon can throw at us?
This is our ground and If they want it, they can pay for it with their blood!
There's much to document, my journals are filling fast.
Be about your business.
Can I help you?
Spare some gold?
If you have nothing to give, move along.
I'm still a few coins short of a warm meal.
Yasha's got her cousin in from out of town and only just told me!
The gardens are my favorite place to think.
Not now, please.
Every snapping twig sets my heart racing.
Even with an open mind, you'll be surprised.
I'm still waiting on my last supply order.
Patience is the essence of all things.
I'm not big on conversation.
I have dreams about Gideon's streets flooding.
If you'd like a turn, step in at any time.
It can be difficult, but I do enjoy the work.
Does this look easy to you?
The days feel like they're speeding by.
My apologies, newcomers are not as welcome as they have been.
Forgive me, there is a lot on my mind.
There are brilliant minds in Gideon and for that, I am grateful.
My hands won't stop shaking.
I'll mind my own business if you mind yours.
I didn't become a soldier to do nothing all day.
Care to report anything?
Do you need something?
Distract someone else.
Thieves? In Gideon? That's just a rumor.
Enjoy your time off when you get it.
A delicate touch is useful for many professions.
I think I'll take a walk outside the city today.
Sometimes I lack the patience to wait for a bite.
If I wasn't busy all the time, who knows what I'd get into.
I'm going for a drink the moment this is done.
Surely no one can read all the books in a noble's library.
If you're here to rob me, know that I don't have much.
If I finish my chores quickly, I'll be able to get seconds at dinner!
Nothing exciting ever happens here.
There something I can do?
Fantastic, something blocking my view.
Asked her name and had to set Chrysanthemum to music. Never again.
Things could be worse, I could be begging in the wilderness.
Gideon's walls take some getting used to.
Times were, we couldn't plow the fields for all the rocks.
It can be difficult, but I do enjoy the work.
If the bridge collapses, I'm not rebuilding it.
Pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Are you talking to me? Without a proper introduction?
I'm dealing with a personal matter and would like not to be disturbed.
Welcome to Gideon!
You're not the most obvious person here, but it's a close call.
Pray for what you seek and the gods may grant it.
Serving a new family is not as difficult as I expected.
Watch where you walk!
There's so much to do and so little time.
Don't hesitate to report any suspicious activity.
Be on your guard.
Meeting you made my day better.
I don't have time for an inane conversation.
In weather like this, Shugarra is lucky if her fur lies flat.
Begging your pardon, but you're in the way.
There is work to do until the sun goes down, but such is life.
The wildflowers are in bloom once again.
The promise of a new day brings the promise of answers.
This one should go back to bed.
Is there such a thing as useless information?
Must all the interesting things in the world be unknown?
I have the most amazing soup bubbling away. Just hope nothing boils over.
There's a full skin of water waiting for me.
Took my beloved to watch the sunset the other night. Highly recommend it.
Adventurers are always welcome to talk to me.
Be diligent, especially around the market.
The faces in the rock are watching me, I just know it!
Yes! Another good haul!
I can't stand getting muck between my toes.
You ever try a new thing? And discover that you're not very good at it? I'd much rather fill orders than handle customers' coin, but here I am.\n\nOh, never mind. Please just buy something.
I use only the finest ingredients in my dishes.
Our enemies may think they control the field. But every shadow you see is mine.
Now is not the moment that I am finally bested.
So many have fallen! Many more left!
This pathetic world will burn in the fires of Oblivion.
Though she is a Dremora, Xyria is different. Exiled from her clan, alone and hunted, simply because she is unique.
Dodge quickly! To the side!
The terror wells up in this place. It wells up in you.
Cower and beg for release!
I can manage this pile of overexcited rubble myself!
Use this barrier!
I would have loved to work in the Dread Cellar before it was closed down.
We'll add your fear to the fire!
Die for Dagon's glory!
Those designs will make you crazy if you look at them long enough.
Mortal blood to spill!
One of us should be chosen next. We've earned Lord Dagon's favor!
Die! Die! Die! Die! Die!
Rend. T-tear! Kill.
Mortals desire direction. Obedience. Not so different from banekin, really.
Let the mortals slave away. It's their lot.
You'll make an interesting pet.
Who let these vermin in here?
No, no. That paralytic poison numbs the pain!
Watch your step out there. Saw something in the swamp swallow a Scamp whole.
Will they try to flee? I love it when they try to flee!
Try not to die too quickly.
I can see you trembling. Or is it the boots?
Dodge this!
I'll stomp you to mush!
You can't get away from me!
I'll stomp you like grapes!
Down you go!
A little help out here?
How much more power must we lend you?
Careful where you step.
Follow the light!
Twin blades, blades!
Avenge your fellows! Defend the honor of the Silver Rose!
Well fought, my knights, you wield Oblivion's power skillfully.
It's good to see you!
Oh! Didn't hear you approach. Are you getting sneakier? \n\nNever mind. Was your endeavor successful?
Oh! You get to head out on an assignment. Have a good time, all right?
Looking for work? I have a job that I think you'd be absolutely perfect for!
Zzavfa! You're looking for work, but I have nothing to offer. Next time, for sure.
I see you're still in one piece. That's better than I managed. Do you have good news for the Saraathu Tong?
The Saraathu Tong does not pay for time spent on a job. Dragging your feet will get you no favors.
Coin purse empty? The Saraathu Tong is looking to give out some work to those who are willing and able. As long as you can stomach working for mages that is.
Keep moving hireling. There's no more work from the Tong today and my scars are being irritable. I have nothing kind to say to you.
Ooo, I felt that.
Falter now and I will cut your coward hides to the ground as you flee.
I have mastered Oblivion, now I will master you!
Get back here!
This light will strike true.
I can pierce through space, time, and you!
Knights! Flanking maneuvers!
Your delusions of grandeur could make the Mad God jealous, little mortal.
We have artifacts of our own, little mortal!
The order's honor is avenged.

What do you think of my outfit? I tried to get as close to the Witchmothers' aesthetic as I could.\n\nThey probably don't fixate as much on their appearance, but I enjoyed the challenge. It makes me feel like I'm part of the coven.
Hmph! All the dirt and mold in here makes it difficult for this one to keep the books clean!
You'll … pay for this slight!
Our strength fails, fails!
Not a peasant to be found. We should take prisoners in the next raid.
To be so close to such powers but not possess them is torturous.
These relics are conduits to power. Embrace what they offer.
You defy the will of the gods.
Dark … Cold ….
Let's go find someone to help.
Miss me?
I make jesses and hoods for falconry, but I'm out of those for the moment. Might I interest you in some comfortable leather armor instead?
You mortals and your small desperate struggles.\n\nPurchase something. My wares are Daedric and more costly than most mortal works but they are fairly priced. I guarantee it.
Stock up on everything while you can. Fargrave's an odd city and who knows when I'll next be able to make the potions you'll need.
I cannot believe I'm stooping so low as to armor another mortal. So be it. What do you want?
Can't wait to be chosen as an artifact bearer.
All the forces of Mundus and Oblivion will cower before us, mark my word.
Keep faith. It's our convictions that allow us to claim mastery over the forces of Oblivion.
If I wanted to dabble with otherworldly powers, I'd have taken up magic. I prefer to keep my enemies far afield.
If the Three taught me anything, it's that power comes to those who seize it.
It'd be my honor to be chosen, just hope it happens soon.
Harnessing this power is just a matter of will. Show no weakness.
Remember: do not deal with Daedra, command them.
Only the worthy are permitted to handle artifacts. Only the Prior decides who is worthy. Understood?
We have always been the stewards of these relics. We've simply adopted new methods of doing so.
Profits for all. Mercy for none. Well-armed customers all around.
Another mortal attempted to defraud me out of the interest I was owed. You won't make the same mistake.
I would say that it is a pleasure doing into business with you, but we'll see how it goes.
I price my armor and materials the way I see fit. You have a problem with that, then you shouldn't have bothered coming all the way out here.
How far did you travel to get here? It doesn't matter. You look like you could use a drink.
You want a chair and twenty-three wooden beams. No, that's the next customer. \n\nI can't remember what you want. You're going to have to take a look and tell me.
Well, what in Oblivion have we got here? Something for everyone!
Duck, duck—goat! Haha hee ha ho ho!
Better? I can't tell. You all look like livestock to me anyway.
Let's see who wants to join us. More the merrier, I say!
I'd say it's coming down like cats and dogs, but it's not!
Come on out you big slab of meat and whack them with your ugly stick!
A little gift from Uncle Sheo!
I've always wanted to get my hands on a sulfurous succulent. Apparently, you can do fascinating things with their roots. \n\nOh well, I still have a lot of traditional meals to sell.
Here to ogle at what real skill with a needle and cloth can accomplish?
You cannot stop my hunger, mortal!
You are not worthy of the position you hold!
This is but a taste of the scorching Deadlands.
More pain! More fear! More despair!
I hope you can afford my glyphs. I would hate to have to ask you to leave.
These provisions nearly didn't make it. You're in luck, friend. We had to ask for assistance from the Mages Guild. But everything's here now and undamaged.
Strange, is it not, how often one must travel alone? Rather than meet a friend at some distant destination, M'aiq would prefer to journey together and enjoy the company.
Sometimes I think I should do something different with my hair, but Lady Laurent isn't fond of change.
I was telling the maids and fellow manservants the other day how much I appreciate the clear directions and stern punishments that Lady Laurent hands out. I would be lost without her guidance.
Ah, what a pleasure to see you again, five-claw! M'aiq enjoys your stories almost as much as he enjoys his own.

Cold. Ever since that time atop Sorrow, I've been troubled by the slightest chill in the air.\n\nI guess that's to be expected, given how long Lady Laurent left me in that damnable block of ice! I wonder how she'd like it if I let her tea get cold?

Since that incident in Murkmire, I've taken a different view of the simple egg. It is more than the basis of a souffle or a hearty breakfast. The egg is a sacred vessel. Why, I vow never to cook them again!\n\nThough I do adore a good scramble ….

Do you recall that incident in Blackwood? At the xanmeer? Well, you'll think me mad but I must tell someone!\n\nI think there are still duplicates, following me. Why, I awoke this morning and thought I was a duplicate! Checked for goo and everything.
Our exalted Duke of Crows would judge this place … adequate. It needs more that glistens and gleams, featherless. Much more!
Sometimes I think I should do something different with my hair, but Lady Laurent isn't fond of change.
I was telling the maids and fellow manservants the other day how much I appreciate the clear directions and stern punishments that Lady Laurent hands out. I would be lost without her guidance.

Don't tell anyone I told you, but some members of the Blackfeather Court scheme to install you as our new ruler! Nothing will come of it, of course. Our Duke is far too clever!\n\nEven so … don't get any ideas.

When you see Baron Jangleplume, tell him I want my tea saucer back. And my marble collection. He promises to keep things safe. Feh! Safe in his hoard of other people's treasures!\n\nHe's pecking my marbles, featherless. I just know it!

Since that incident in Murkmire, I've taken a different view of the simple egg. It is more than the basis of a souffle or a hearty breakfast. The egg is a sacred vessel. Why, I vow never to cook them again!\n\nThough I do adore a good scramble ….

Do you recall that incident in Blackwood? At the xanmeer? Well, you'll think me mad but I must tell someone!\n\nI think there are still duplicates, following me. Why, I awoke this morning and thought I was a duplicate! Checked for goo and everything.

I've spent my life preparing to be a battlemage, but I've never been on the field of battle. Once fully commissioned, I'd be called upon to rain down fire and lightning on the enemy. Wipe out regiments in an instant. A scary responsibility to have.
Wonder why they call moving stolen goods fencing and laundering? That's too pedestrian for Lady Twilight. She should liquidate and polish … maybe.
I still think about Martus's final moments. They hang over me. Affects me more than he deserved.\n\nHis death was justified, but sometimes I regret taking it upon myself to deliver it.

I'll admit, I'm feeling a bit aimless since renouncing my position in the Battlespire. Wandering adventurer suits well enough for laying low, but my only goal is survival. I need a meaningful cause to support. \n\nFinding one is harder than I expected.
Why is it that Mephala is always depicted as some seductive woman? I've seen what her kids look like and it ain't that.

Mortals, selling to you is like exchanging goods with an infant. It's insulting and irresponsible. \n\nI've been informed that I cannot refuse you access to my goods, though. Take a look and be out of my sight quickly.
Daedra keep odd hours and so do I. My shop is open all the time for my customers.
We deal in mortal goods from this plane and others—Nirn included. Some complain that our prices are too steep. They're not the ones who have to import the items from a separate plane of existence!
Yes. Yes. Continue with your shopping. I refuse to stop you.
Mortals, Dremora, even Scamps. I've made up rooms for them all. You'd be surprised at the sort of beings who stop here.
The mounts, they keep me calm. If they start to spook, then I know there's something worth worrying about. \n\nThey don't seem to mind you, so neither do I.
Thank Vehk! I don't know who you are, but I hope you make it out of here too.
If I was less shaky right now, I'd make the Waking Flame pay for this.
They left us to get eaten by that … that thing!
The legions of Lord Dagon will overwhelm you!
Living and trading here is often tedious. But then a newcomer appears to introduce some excitement into the routine. \n\nYou won't try to fight me for my wares, will you?

Do not attempt to convince me that a rock is the favored currency where you come from. I have traveled throughout Nirn and I do not take kindly to liars.\n\nIf you have valid currency, then feel free to take a look.
These are my goods. Handle them with respect.
Atronach's down!
Guess I've not lost my touch for battle after all.
Be ready to jouk quickly!
Stay light on your feet, he's about to make you dance.
Be ready to run these waves are going to be intense!
Your potential didn't know the depths you were leading her down. Maybe I'll show her how deep they go.
For Lord Dagon!
The Prince will bathe in your blood, mortal!
The weak shall be devoured!
You were fools to come here!
You are brave to face us, mortal!
Taste the bile of terror as it rises in your throat!
What courage! What fun!
Your fight is useless!
Our concern for how low you've sunk ends when we bury you.
Service bring victory.
Needs a touch more sulfur.
Quiet, churls. Someone watches us.
Duty to the Kyn, duty to Mehrunes Dagon.
This waiting makes us soft.
Take them apart, piece by piece.
Gather the forces! Something's near.
Mortals have such a stench about them.
The warriors are almost ready.
A scream sounds delicious.
Wait. Did you hear that?
All those books would make fine kindling.
I tire of this. When do we march?
The prisoner supply runs low.
These blood sacks shall burst before long.
We have bones to break and blood to drink.
Such a reward to watch over this tower.
I am the strongest in all of Ardent Hope!
Good work! Back to the frontline!
I've located the source it's tapped into. Take this portal and deal with it!
That ought to keep the Daedra on its backfoot. Let me get you a way out of there.
Hold on, I can sense where it's drawing its power from! Take this portal and stop it!
Our exalted Duke of Crows would judge this place … adequate. It needs more that glistens and gleams, featherless. Much more!

I've spent my life preparing to be a battlemage, but I've never been on the field of battle. Once fully commissioned, I'd be called upon to rain down fire and lightning on the enemy. Wipe out regiments in an instant. A scary responsibility to have.
I'll draw the egonymic out! Aim it at Dagon!
I won't die so easily. The Opal Charm's power preserves us.
Our steps are in sync, sync.
Perhaps if I shock the crystal matrix ….
The Purgator won't stop until it's killed you all, so fight with all you've got!
I would highly discourage letting that thing kill you. You won't like the results.
Ignore the moaning, it's for psychological effect.
I hope it incinerates a good many of those cultists.
I assure you this creature lost its humanity long before it lost its life.
This is certain to make an unholy racket, if nothing else.
You dare attack the Silver Rose?
Glory to the Silver Rose!
I'll burn out this infestation.
The slaves of Oblivion come for us!
Who'd be fool enough to attack us?
Oh look, a commendation is coming my way.
They've breached the keep!
It'll be my honor to kill you tuskers!
We are the masters here!
Stand firm against these heathens!
Guard these items with your lives!
In the name of the Silver Rose!
Take it back … please take it back ….
I hear it! It's in me! I hear it inside me …!
Hehehe … hehe … ahahahaha ….

You, again? This is the nineteenth time you have found me. No. The twentieth. Congratulations.\n\nIf you were a hunter and M'aiq was the prey, this one would already be in your cook pot. Good thing M'aiq is stringy and has no meat on his bones, yes?

I'd very much like to speak to the creature who created your mortal resting platforms. I have many inquiries. \n\nStill, you seem to be more rugged than that individual. I have finely crafted items of mortal comfort. What would you like?

I have baits if you want those. The sort for fishing, not for enticing people like I enticed my betrothed. He is quite the catch, if you get my meaning.\n\nSorry! My manners flew away the moment we started planning the wedding.
The legions of Lord Dagon will overwhelm you!
Ah, a mortal bearing coin and economic prosperity. You bring still air to my lava flow.
You dare interrupt me from matters that your feeble mind could not even comprehend? \n\nFine, if you must peruse my staves and rings, do it … quickly.
Wherefore find you life? In truth your answer matters not. Though I am told that a pinch of talk before a sale leads to congeniality.\n\nWhich—from this expanse of vitals and tools—willst thou?
There's a war on, laggards! You can work or you can join it!
I don't need a whip to tame you lot.
A customer's friendly face helps to keep the more suspicious Daedra from taking up my time. It's not my fault they don't understand Soul Gems.
Ri thinks you should know. In another four hundred years or so, all the rivers of fire are going to change their flows. Any maps you make of this place will be useless then.\n\nNow, where to?
Are you an adventurer? In my experience, all adventurers could do with a larger pack. Loot and trinkets take up so much more space than you expect.
My mounts get the best care in all Fargrave. Respect them, and we won't have a problem.
Tears repaired and holes mended.\n\nNew garments available too if you have need.
Buy from me and you'll get weapons as good as those the Daedra use around the corner there. I guarantee it.
I lost them? I lost them! Thank Dag—oh, uh … hmm.
Divines protect me, I've made a terrible mistake!
There are mortals who will tell you that perfection comes at the cost of speed. My work is proof that they're wrong. It only takes me an hour to shape a bow.
Go! Attack now!
The Grasp think their Stricture laws are so encompassing, but they never come to the Shambles. So, be a good little supplier and we won't have problems.
Be ready!
I prefer to do business with individuals who are a little more … deathless, but I'll make an exception for you. What do you have for me?
Welcome to our humble hideaway. Even the outcasts of society require steady income. Buy my kits and help me make mine?
Back again? I'm beginning to think you have ulterior motives, dear one.
Well, at least there's ground this time. Qukikh, I'll send you back to Coldharbour if you don't get the portal right!
Come here if you're cold, wanderer! You seem kindly and I could use the company.
The Drain carries it all away. Internals. Externals. There are only material goods of the now, and memories of the future. \n\nLook at both but don't lose yourself.
I do have sums to finish and you're going to muddle my perfect system. Thank you for that.
Going once. Going twice. Sold to the portly Ogrim there. Thank you, sir!
It's not often I see a mortal around here. My usual clients are Dremora and Daedra. I probably have some edible provisions around here somewhere. \n\nNow, what are you looking for?
My wares are heavy. Some would say it's dangerous to be hauling them around the way I do under a sky like this. Care to lighten my load?
Inhibitor wards lifted. Activating final seal.
Final seal reinforced. Refreshing wards.
Inhibitors breached. Black sea contingency commenced.
The Fire-Cat's domain! Finally, this one's dream has come true. Its fiery fury does not disappoint. This one nearly singed her fur three times today!
May the Tribunal watch over you. As I hope—know!—as I know they watch over me.

Ah, a convenient mortal. Which sounds more horrifying to you? A visit to the Crumbling Cliffs or to the Pits of Pity? \n\nRight. I'll take these two to the Crumbling Cliffs. Your eyes kind of went wide at the mention of that one.
Come on! Hit me!
Sometimes, you get exactly what you want. And then some idiot comes into your life and gives you more.
What are you waiting for? You must defeat Sombren!
We should go back, I think the wisp went the other way.
Aha! I found it! A gateway! I just need to open it.
Great Destroyer, forgive me.
No malingering! Back to work!
Your imprisonment lasts forever, cur!
I might loose an arrow at someone just for fun.
Sometimes it feels like we're prisoners, too.
This one can't go on like this.
No rest, never rest ….
Spare me, I beg of you!
Weak! You're all weak!
Why must we watch the prisoners? They never do anything interesting.
You should have seen the size of the Daedrat I chased out of my rooms.
Valkynaz Nokvroz always looks so angry.
We should make the old blind seer work, too!
They break my heart, the Drained. Poor minds trying to cope with Fargrave.
If the valkynaz destroys an overseer, can I take their place?
Valkynaz Nokvroz could arrive at any moment.
I wonder what happened to Arox the Mutilator? I hated him so much.
Guarding prisoners is beneath my station.
Where did they send the Daedric prisoners?
I want to smash something!
Cut them down!
I'm ready. Call on my power!
Something's coming? Ack!
Soon, my power will be ready to use!
Fargrave promises good fortune for all. Let's test yours. I will watch your efforts at creation. Closely.
You might've gotten away with this if it were up to me, but my superiors are not that merciful.
You've robbed me of fun mortal. Leave.
Running will only make your sentence worse!
Stand and face me.
Tell anyone about this and you die.
You should know that this will cost you.
Theft? Ha! This Nirnling has nerve.
Petty crime? My day couldn't get worse.
Your time is limited. Do not waste mine.
Your impertinence will not stand!
Hit harder next time!
Call the guards, you idiots!
Doing something criminal?
I will advance when they see the glory of my--wait. It's gone. Again!
I'll crush your bones beneath my heel for this!
It's been so long since a mortal tried to sneak in here!
Get out! Or the guards will make you!
Kindly run into a spear, criminal.
You made me run, Nirnling. Now, I'll make you pay.
Smart move. Now, off with you!
You'll pay for this defiance.
Not another step!
Know there will not be a next time.
You think I can't see you slinking about? Pathetic.
No one steals from the Daedra!
Enjoy freedom while you can, criminal!
Don't stop there! Kill some more!
Is there any law you won't break?
Just don't get any blood on my property.
Don't let that skrid get away!
Planning something, little Nirnling?
I must have dropped it. Zzavfa!
Think you can steal from me?
You've come to the wrong place.
Out! Get out!
Should have worked cleaner. Come back later.
Motion of yours will cease. Now, atone for your deeds. And quickly.
My eyes will watch you from the dark.
A mortal's freedom and you chose death?
End your movements, mortal!
My master summons me. Go free.
You believe yourself invisible to us?
No! The master needed that! Oh no, no, no!
Would you behave this way on Nirn?
Such actions require vicious consequences!
No! How could you do this? Impossible!
Blood flows! Bring others!
I beg someone to stop this!
I appreciate the effort, but I see you.
Which plane could I have left it on?
You'll find nothing but worms, friend.
Creatures like you don't belong here.
Consequences. Ah yes, they will find you soon.
Straighten your affairs. Then we talk.
You think yourself cleverer than the Daedra? Pay up. Then contemplate the depth of your naivete.
Go. And know your place.
You will never escape Oblivion!
Halt, mortal!
It seems I must set you free. For now.
The eyes of Oblivion are upon you, Nirnling.
They'll have your hands for that.
The guards will flense you for that!
Murdered? Hmph. Why do mortals have all the fun?
Crime! Havoc! Chaos! Yes!
The guard's coming. Finish them off!
Make it bleed!
Yes, I see you there. We all do.
Where--? That Varlet must have taken it!
Ugh! It touched me!
Lost? Linger and you'll lose your head.
This place is mine. Get out!
No. I can't have the guards snooping about.
Little nixad, you have supped carelessly. The only way to avoid the clannfear's claws is to pay your fine. Now.
Your compliance is noted. Now, begone.
You shall wish for the torments of the pit before you die!
Stop! Flight is futile!
All is in order. Be on your way.
Do you think that I do not see you?
Theft. Exactly what I expect of your kind.
Your penance will not be easy, mortal.
Murder? The mortal shows promise.
Now comes your penance, mortal.
I have summoned the guards, fool!
Scourge the mortal! Punish them!
Lord Dagon's eye is upon you, Nirnling.
Bah! Not again! Someone has robbed me!
Shall I hold still while you paw at me? Point to my valuables, perhaps?
A delicious morsel! Flies do not often seek out the spiderweb.
Away with you! Back to Nirn, or whatever plane you come from.
A fly buzzing in my ear? It should go, before someone swats it.
Not much of a challenge, are you? You're under arrest. Now, pay your bounty.
See how easy it is to pay up?
You'll not get away today.
Don't move!
Oho! Got good friends, eh?
Stop what you're doing right now or I'll detain you.
You thought a mortal could steal without consequences?
Foolish skrid! Guards! Detain this scoundrel!
Kill elsewhere. Never here. Now face the law.
Skrid! I'll have the guards on you!
Ease off there. Hey, guards.
Guards! Slay this skrid!
You! What are you doing?
Gah! I must have a hole in my purse!
Fool! Move away from me now.
You'd best leave. Now.
How dare you trespass! The guards will handle you.
Don't even start talking to me right now.
Do not make this difficult, scum of Nirn.
Acceptable. Now get out of my sight.
Ah, I love when they run.
Be still!
Seems fortune favors you. For now.
I could smell you well before I saw you.
A pilfering mortal. How surprising.
A criminal! Hilarious!
Ah, the smell of fresh blood. How lovely.
Guards! This mortal thinks themselves invulnerable!
Oh, that looks fun! Can I help?
Guard! Punish that Nirnling!
Be quick about whatever it is you're doing, mortal.
Argh, I can never keep ahold of anything.
Mortal greed never fails to astound.
You clearly do not belong here.
Be gone, or your death will be agonizing.
