Slay all who oppose our Prince!
Show them the power of the Shardborn!
At last! We shall not be forgotten again!
These mortals dare oppose the forces of Mirrormoor?
Yield, mortals!
This lake is ours! Defend!
We are many. We are powerful!
This place has an unsettling air.
This place feels … wrong.
Look! Up there!
It's another incursion!
We must hold them here!
Damn these Mirrormoor bastards!
Look for whatever anchors this breach!
Spread out and find the source of the breach!
I'm a friend, remember?
I better not catch anyone sneaking around down here.
When do we get to fight somebody?
When will we be ready to strike?
As hiding spots go, this place isn't half bad.
Where's that chanting coming from?
Do you hear chanting?
Something's coming. Something bad.
A storm! Brace yourselves!
Listen. There are voices on the wind!
We can't survive much more of this!
Wood Elves and Imperials …. \n\nIt's a surprise I haven't found a way to bottle all the trouble they're brewing.
These spirits cannot defy their fates.
I thought we dealt with these meddling necromancers?
There has to something worthwhile here.
These ancient Elves loved their stonework, eh?
This business with the Recollection really angers people. If I see a Wood Elf brave enough to face the world right now, I make sure to fill their tankard up.
The relic must be here somewhere.
Narsis Dren? Never heard of him.
That Wood Elf King is dead. We all die, there's nothing special about it. Still, I'll drink to a death. What about you?
That Dark Elf was insufferable.
Stay alert. These ruins are covered in traps.
Did you hear? We're going to be an army!
I hope I find the relic.
Don't let anyone else enter the ruins.
We should have killed that fool Dark Elf when we had the chance.
We claim this ruin in the name of the Recollection!
Where's the latest group of townsfolk? I'm hungry!
You missed some fool spouting off about how we were all safe thanks to the Legion. I had to cut him off for drinking too much. Thinking things are safe is a sign you've had too much.
Open your eyes! Balandrus expects trouble.

To what do I owe the honor of your patronage? Interest in magical assistance? The looming threat of conflict? Curiosity? \n\nRegardless, I welcome it and you. Please, let me know what you'd like to purchase.
Once the army is ready, where should we go next? Skingrad? Kvatch?
I think I liked it better when we were just bandits.
Hey, I don't remember a jungle to the south the last time we were here. How did I miss it?

This season's my favorite. The air just makes moving the leathers so much easier and they take to shaping so nicely. Oh, and they don't dry out either. Supple and soft, the best combination for a good fit. \n\nTake a look. You'll see what I mean!
Blood tastes so much better when the source is scared witless.
Yes, the weather's a bit strange this season. Yes, my packs are watertight. Yes, I will sell them. Let's get to the part where you pick one.
Just because we conquered simple townsfolk doesn't make us an army.
Wake! Wake and defend!
No matter who I sell to, it's all high-quality stock. Sure, I'll support my team, but that can't interfere with the reputation of my business.
I heard there's a new Daedric Prince wandering around. Not some one I'd like to run afoul of. \n\nTake my advice and get stocked up while you can. The best warriors are prepared for anything.

A few of those Recollection tried to join up here to hide from their problems. I chased those gangly boars back to the forest where they belong. We only have time for the real warriors, not some cultists with memory issues.
Some fools think they can change the world. I know the only thing that changes is who controls the battlefield.\n\nNow, how can I help you make the change you wish to see?
If I have what you need, who cares what the price is? You need it. And in these troubled times, who knows if I'll have it the next time you stop by?
I carefully learned what flavors the Imperials like, and now the Wood Elves want the same treatment? It's a good thing they don't all stick to meat. That would get boring after a few seasons.
Make sure you don't eat the special food.
We don't like those ranch rowdies, right?
What were we hired to do again?
Not sure I like taking orders from a prissy noble.
When do we get to fight something?
I ate some of the lamb stew. Is that a problem?
Did the noble order you to chop stone, too?
Dark Company, stay alert!
Baron Carvain says we need to double production. Again.
The baron said to watch for intruders.
Anyone want to play cards at the Stonechip tonight?
Remember, no one's allowed on the ranch.
I heard those quarriers were up to no good.
I prefer this work to regular ranching.
You think they'll grow big enough to ride? That'd be pretty neat.
The next crystaljack that stings me gets a sword up its arse!
I've never worked on a ranch quite like this before.
The boss told us to be ready for a fight.
Wood Elves and Reachfolk are both quite skilled in the healing arts. Imagine what we could learn from each other!
Serving as one of Ard Caddach's few ambassadors is a true honor. He leapt at the chance to send someone to this fledgling kingdom. I was fortunate to win the post.
You need a dose of my wonderful elixir!
First you, then this whole damn town!
Finally. I haven't hurt anything all day.
My blade is better than all of yours!
Footwork won't save you from me.
What's this? Your forge holding you back?
I'll challenge your expectations.
You're no match for me!
The forge's heat is inescapable!
They're gone? Praise Y'ffre, they're gone!
It's over? I can't believe I survived!
This post is an endless bore.
Can't wait to get back to the mortal realm for more bloodshed.
Death comes for you!
It's slaughtering time!
They cannot hear you. That doesn't mean you cannot kill them.
The knot belongs to me. You can't have it.
Oh, how you marvel. I'm flattered.
Well done. We killed them.
Nothing stands in my way now!
Oh, how you marvel. I'm flattered.
Shh. Never interrupt your enemy when they're making a mistake.
And so it begins!
You're far beneath me.
You mortals think you're so talented. Very well, I'll make sure to test you.
I bring forth an unstoppable army!
This place makes me itch.
Keep them from the light!
I am basking. Do not interrupt.
Your trespass ends here!
Rise now and accept my will!
My army is unstoppable!
None of you have any conversation skills.
Do my bidding!
This won't take long.
Do we even have a plan? One that will work?
Look lively!
The knot is mine by right. I deserve it.
Fresh blood to spill!
The only bad part about this plan is that I'm standing here doing nothing.
Where'd they come from?
This time we will see victory. Right?
We need more skeletons. Raise any corpses you find.
The wraiths are restless. I don't like it.
I hate fighting Goblins!
Anyone tried to raise a minotaur yet?
Stay alert. Those Goblins are tricky.
I'm having no luck creating Goblin zombies. How about you?
Minotaurs make for formidable foes. I like that.
These ruins reek of death.

All this unoccupied space is intentionally left empty. Now, I can create memorials to the Barons I lose in the future and to those who I do not even remember forgetting now. \n\nThis area is satisfactory. I wouldn't complain about more traps though!

My master enjoys looking at all the islands floating around the Hall of Barons. I still have designs for an arena challenge set on one. Fa-Nuit-Hen wanted to see challengers dangle from the cliffs and fight to the death.
Skingrad was starting to look a little sparse. Good to see new residents putting the hustle back in our bustle.
Now witness what our ritual has wrought!
Prepare to be destroyed, mortals!
The champion of Mirrormoor strides forth!
Destroy all who oppose Mirrormoor!
Purge this realm of mortal filth!
Transform this realm to crystal!
Serving as one of Ard Caddach's few ambassadors is a true honor. He leapt at the chance to send someone to this fledgling kingdom. I was fortunate to win the post.
Approach, mortal! My wares are as boundless as the ink-dark sea.
Anyone have any extra arrows to spare?
Once word gets around, the Dark Company will be famous!
This fort has certainly seen better days.
One of those recruits called me a deserter. We're mercenaries now, damn it!
I'd rather die for myself than for the Ebonheart Pact.
Those recruits didn't stand a chance against experienced soldiers from Cyrodiil.
Once we secure this fort, let's go after an estate or a vineyard!
I could go for some fried thunderbug legs right about now.
I hope a real Legion cohort shows up. I could use a real challenge!
Sure, I deserted. Who wouldn't? But if you say another word about the Covenant, you'll get my boot in your arse!
What's next on our list? Maybe some raids into Hammerfell?
Dark Company. Whoever came up with that name deserves an extra share of the next haul.
This one wishes this place didn't have so many vermin.
The soldiers here were like kittens without any claws.
Shor's bones, how do any of you stand this weather?
Let the Legion come! Those milk drinkers will never retake this fortress!
<Eri wiggles in place, ready to run your goods to safety.>
This is no where near as bad as a Tharriker.
More gold for me!
What is a Goblin good for anyway?
Why don't we just smash the totems?
Forget what you've heard! The Aldmeri Dominion is the future!

As a servant of Dibella, I embrace different parts of myself to help others. I can be a doting mother or a ravenous lover. I can be a stern friend or a passive listener. Each supplicant has different needs.
Stay alert! The Legion could send a real cohort at any time.
This realm will be ours!
Put these foolish mortals in their place.
We must guard the ancient one!
Why do we even bother with mortals?
These ruins. I remember the mortals who lived here. What happened to them?
Follow our orders to the letter!
Keep watch for fate's lackeys.
No one must approach the ancient one.
Look how the realm changes!
Let no aid reach the Prince of Fate!
Torvesard really is the best of us.
Too many books fill this place.
Soon the shards of Mirrormoor will be everywhere!
Avoid the Black Books. They aren't what they seem.
I appreciate having a roof over my head and a place of relative safety to rest when I'm dealing with a writ, but I'm not big on questions. Let's just say I have a job to do and leave it at that.
I'm surprised we get along so well. I usually find a way to get on people's bad sides. Women especially find me exasperating. Irresistible, but exasperating. \n\nWhat can I say? It's a gift.

If it isn't the hero who befriended the Morag Tong in the past! How good to see you! \n\nSo, enough with the pleasantries. Tell me why you're following me and make it good. I'd hate for us to get into some sort of unnecessary conflict.
That business with Naryu and Veya was certainly … intense. More family drama than I'm used to dealing with, that's for sure. I don't know how you stand it.
After the wildburn passes, the entire Weald will be ours!
A lot of preparation goes into the ritual.
You dare attack a servant of Prince Ithelia?
Make Mora's minions suffer!
Stay alert. The keepers expect trouble.
A change is coming. What was lost will be restored.
Keep your eyes open. Unbelievers are everywhere.
Soon all of West Weald will be ours!
Arkay protect us!
The wildburn destroys the old and gives birth to the new.
Remain watchful and report anything suspicious!
Who but King Nantharion could accomplish all this?
With the Prince's help, the Ayleid Empire will be reborn!
The rest of Vashabar will see. They'll come crawling back to us.
West Weald has no idea what's about to happen.
I hear that traitor Beragon is helping our enemies. If I ever see him ….
Allying with Dremora? I hope King Nantharion knows what he's doing.
Remember, we're not supposed to let anyone get by us.
This land is ours, and the wildburn will prove it!
Careful!
Do that again!

Word of advice, stranger. When you accept a job that requires you to watch a location for a while, make sure you bring provisions.\n\nNow, please remove yourself. You're distracting me from my work watching that cave.
You will never defeat me!
Nothing can stop me!
Share this pain!
These mirrors will be your doom.
You can't even hurt the real me!
Those crystals are part of the barrier.
The knot! It is in pieces!
Animating Crux split 2
Stop them!
That creature looks powerful.
Keep your hope!
The knot is dangerous out here.
Honor and service.
Please spare me!
Such tiny creatures. I cannot wait until they crush you.
The mirrors are the source!
Lead it to an orb!
See, this is why I didn't bother to fight you.
Did you miss how outclassed you are in size, weight, and combat skill? But by all means, wave your banner.
Your fate is sealed.
Don't toy with them! Kill the mortals!
It is time! Destroy them!
That was a lucky hit. Nothing more.
Enjoying the fight? It looks like you're tiring.
Feed the wasps, they said. They don't sting, they said. Liars.
So, can I open one of those bottles of wine now?
Someone grab that damn dog!
All this for some wine? I hope it's worth it.
You are no match for me.
Mortal homes always smell awful.
I'm ready to sink my blade into mortal guts.
Not to sound ungrateful, but can you please untie me?
Tragedies bring travel companions closer, but coin does endear them to me more.
I thought coming out here would expose me to adventure and more thrills than my stall in the marketplace.\n\nPlease, if you help me get rid of my stock I can go back to Fargrave!
Is it bad that I'd rather not do business with the ranch hands or quarriers right now? That fatigue fever scares me witless!\n\nOh, but if you want to trade, I suppose you look healthy enough.
None shall reach our Prince.
Hounds! Attack.
Defend the shrine at all costs!
We fight for the Prince of Fate!
Return, my twin!
Something around here has to dispel these orbs.
The ultimate test.
Those legionaries never had a chance.
Find the ward, dispel it!
I don't like fighting under all this rock.
The Legion's no match for the Recollection!

Why battle for the Storm Lords? If you're shallow, I'd say because of our beautiful purple heraldry.\n\nBut I hope you're not shallow. Take up our mantle and fully experience the righteousness that comes with fighting for the right team.

No matter where I go, something terrible seems to happen. I help as I can, of course, but it's never enough.\n\nThat's what draws me into fighting for the Pit Daemons. It's something I do well. Plus I can walk away when I want.
The vineyards interest me. I would volunteer to help stomp grapes, but my focus must remain on supporting my team.\n\nPerhaps once I fight better, I can stomp grapes.
A few roses would cheer me up right now. Especially the thorns.
Heads up, we've got some orbs!
Quick, chimera's gone. Can you get to a focal point?
Oh, I see. The wisps bear grim tidings. A darkness stalks you, and no matter how far and how fast you run, it will overtake you. Better to face it.
Kill the intruders!
If you aren't making full use of everything you trap, you need to do better.\n\nAt least make sure whatever's left over is available to vultures, ants, and other scavengers.
I know this place is sacred, but it's also kind of creepy.
Almost time to feed the tharrikers.
Who ate all the jerky?
We remember, we overcome!
When do we launch the attack?
Have faith. King Nantharion knows what he's doing.
We should rebuild Hoperoot.
I'm proud to be a part of the Recollection.
What are we looking for here again? A stein?
Look what our ancestors created here!
King Nantharion is a great leader!

Ah, you represent the break I needed from pondering thought. Focusing too long provides diminishing returns.\n\nIndeed, a fellow priest of Julianos spilled tea on me yesterday, which helped me reach an important conclusion on the role of mistakes.
If you're considering becoming a priest of Julianos, be ready to argue every nuance of your attempts at logical discourse.\n\nAnd never take setbacks personally. Practice makes better. Not perfect.
Just keep moving, we need to hold out a bit longer.
Keep your eyes open, friend. This place is overrun with wisps and worse.\n\nAnd no sign of my missing friend. Z'en's price, I hate this place.
Great work!

Don't make the mistake of thinking this scholarly artist isn't prepared for whatever the wilds throw his way. The armor I wear isn't for show.\n\nMy companions here left some fool of a bandit for the vultures a few days ago, in fact.
Something happened after I left Skingrad to go on my usual hunting expedition. I'm glad I had plenty of provisions for the return trip because it's dangerous to forage off this land.

I once adapted a recipe from a Telvanni alchemy primer to use pork as its base meat. The mushroom sauce was creamy and delicious.\n\nOdd to find such a thing in an alchemy book, but I won't judge a horker by its tusks!
My usual spots around the Strid River needed a break from fishing, so here I am! So far, so good.\n\nIt's good to make changes and push yourself from time to time.
Apologies for my poor demeanor today. Sometimes the mystical properties of the Scholarium result in … well. My hair looks terrible right now! \n\nNot your problem, of course. How can I help you?

Some folks around here expect me to turn down wine because of the Green Pact. But if the wine has the Surilie Reserves label, I'll drink it and then some. It's when the grapes are forcibly plucked from the vines that I have issues.
This esraj is the best thing Fahuren has ever stolen.
No more arguing, Seremina. I need to talk to this stranger.\n\nSorry about that. She does go on.

I'm told this area contains spirits who kill those with evil intentions. But I believe killing someone who has evil intentions is also an act born of an evil intention. So should these spirits not kill themselves?\n\nThis question keeps me up at night.

If you're going to stomp grapes, you need a song. A rousing song. A song that lets you scream your love for stomping these grapes into the best damned wine you'll ever drink.\n\nI haven't yet found my song, but with enough stomping, I will! I swear it.
These loggers deserved worse.
Nature will not be denied.
Cut down a tree, we cut down a score of you.
Let the animals and the forest have this place.
The mortals are somewhat useful.
This area will make a perfect camp for the legions of Mirrormoor.
Mirrormoor's victory is assured.
This mortal town is ours!
The ritual must be completed.
No one can defeat the Recollection!
This trading post is ours now.
Hunt as you will, my creatures!
Return! Give me your strength!
Come forth, my other self!
Do you see a focal point? I bet that's the key.

Skingrad may not be the post I wanted, but I will research everything about this area before my next posting.\n\nToday I learned that the horseman statue is that of Rislav Larich, who helped keep this town independent from a theocratic hegemony.
Skingrad grows on you. Not enough for me to stick around if my work here goes, shall we say, badly?\n\nI'll miss the wine awfully if I have to leave, though.
The merchants who brave the wilderness have my respect. They may traverse safer paths, but that doesn't wholly negate the dangers they face on a daily basis.

You get to see it all in my line of work. The richest of the rich and the poorest of the poor. Knaves and nobles bump shoulders while the tavern wench watches. Sometimes she sees too much. That's when It's time to move on.
Even wild growth needs tending.
New forest? Looks like old Valenwood to me.
No one to talk to in Black Marsh and no one to talk to here.
Some around here seek to protect their own safety at the expense of another's freedoms. I hope they learn that uncertainty is a part of life before their fears stifle the rest of us.

I visit the traders here each day. Some have new wares. Some have standard stock, but like to share things they've learned from visitors.\n\nErgo, I recommend you visit the traders not only for goods, but also for information that can keep you alive.
Keep the portal open!
I want to crush the mortal city!
Prepare the weapons for the next arrivals.
I grow bored with all this waiting.
We may have to work with these mortals, but I don't have to like it.

Khifeh finds joy in the learning of new things. Perhaps this one should become a scholar, yes? Leave behind the life of a Skingrad servant?\n\nYet this one is paid well for serving, and coin leads to comfort. Decisions are hard.
In a city filled with wine, those with heavy purses and profligate ways may find themselves stalked by those with light purses and lighter fingers.\n\nBear that in mind as you walk these streets.
Prepare to be destroyed!
Die well, mortal!
Remain vigilant, Shardborn!
The glory of Mirrormoor returns!
Mortals are not worthy of the Many Paths.
The hordes of Apocrypha? Let them come!
I remember more and more all the time!
We failed in our duty before. Not this time.
Remember to donate coins for the wounded.
Follow my lead!
I'd check that book again. I bet that's the key to this puzzle.
I study true the Covenants, Akatosh, that I may one day ….\n\nHmm. How can I help you?
Do you seek a Tribute battle? Stendarr willing, I may prove a worthy adversary.
Proxy, use Abolisher to seal the portal!
Behold! Not even the mighty minotaurs could stop me!
Change the mirrors!
(Goblin GIbberish 02)
Wipe out the Daedra before they break through!
Irnak Myrr-mahr, suni zagh. Irnak Myrr-mahr, suni zagh.
Irnak Myrr-mahr, suni zagh. Irnak Myrr-mahr, suni zagh.
From our three fonts we remake this world.
From our three fonts we remake this world.
Your vision has faded once more. Find another focal point. Peer through the lens and break the wards to find the key fragment.
I'm getting a drink.

You ever wonder what your flower name would be? I've thought about it a lot. I've narrowed it down to three. Aster if you're leaning towards spellslinging. Thistle if you're feeling brawny. Or Foxglove if you like sneaking around.
Hey! Let's get a move on.
Nothing will hold me back!
Let's show them what we've got.
Was that it?
Ooh, fancy!
Teamwork!
Get yourself free, quick!
Now's really not a good time!
What could go wrong?
And the crowd goes wild!
Is the room spinning? Or just me?
Worthy of a bard song!
I've got my sparkle back!
Bandage that wound. Quick!
Bit of fatigue there friend. Careful!
You're tapped out. Grab some magicka!
These get easier, right?
Do you think I could ride it? Sorry, just a passing thought.
I was this close to getting crushed!
Want to see something really fun?
I just love the sound they make. Bwah!
Is it just me craving seafood right now? No?
Ugh. I think I inhaled some vampire.
I need to cool down, that got a bit too hot for me.
Let's get some fresh air after that.
Is this ink ever going to wash out?
We are going to get bad luck from this. I just know it.
Beautiful leg work!
Worthy of a bard song!
We're agreed, then. We're here to cause some trouble?
Bet there's a great tavern around here.
Could we just sit and enjoy the view?
Giddy up!
Look at that. Finders keepers, right?
Ah, Alinor. Not every memory I have here is a bad one. Good people, a rare few that chose to help me even after I was ousted. Even when it threated their livelihoods.
I was told that if I worked hard enough, applied myself, I'd get to spend my life studying in that tower. Good riddance. That was never the life I wanted.
Keep an eye on the guards. They may not be smart, but .... Nope, you know what? That's all I've got. They're not smart.
I should stay moving, I might doze off.
What are we gonna find?
Oh, Hyacinth would love to see this!
Be sure to check for hidden compartments.
Someone's definitely going to miss that.
That could fetch a nice price.
You just keep growing.
This is where clothes come from?
Tough work. Better you than me.
Sorry tree, we needed your flesh chunk.
What's a little dirt under the nails?
Where do runestones even come from?
I should tell Chirrabi about this.
Who's a pretty mount? You are!
Your resistance is impressive. But it will not save you.
You've got more than that in you, I know it.
May I have forgiveness in my heart when next we meet.
People dress so strangely in this time. I try to hold my tongue, but sometimes … Kss. I suppose you would say the same if you could see how they dressed in my time.
I am with you.
Jo'zhet! A new level of strength and understanding.
Azurah, give us strength!
Until you rise again.
Show them who you are, tamiit!
Tamiiti cannot be stopped!
Free yourself, tamiit!
Focus on my voice! Break free!
So, it comes to this?
We are victorious, by the strength of Alkosh.
Tamiit … my wounds ….
Ahzith rabah, tamiit.
S'rendarr! You are wounded, tamiit!
You have exhausted your strength, tamiit!
Recover your magic, tamiit!
Foes in such numbers! This era should be thankful that we fight them together.
Hahl fajh'na, a dragon? Show no mercy, tamiit!
Until you rise again, demon.
Azurah, witness my devotion!
As with the Lattice, so with Nirni. Tally your failures, Molagh.
The Court of Bedlam is behind these things, I hear? Hrrm. Aptly named.
This harrowcraft is harrowing indeed. May we never see its spread beyond the borders of Skyrim.
Spirits of earth and water. The land here is truly alive in ways the desert is not.
Crossing planes is not new to me. But the Deadlands? They live up to their name.
No small task. Let us depart before curiosity gets the better of us in this realm.
I am glad to see it done. Now, to pick these shards out of my fur ….
Fajh'na tah! Well struck!
I have sought trouble in worse places. I am with you.
Hrrm. Fewer people staring at me than I anticipated. What a strange time you live in.
Ah! The sights here … words fail me.
We ride.
Treasure there, tamiit. Yours to take.
A trading post. The oldest reminder of home.
The aqueducts here existed in my time, but often ran dry. Here, they run abundant, and feed farmland. Nothing short of miraculous.
Ashen Scar. Once home to the Hidden Moon. The shadows here are as long as I remember.
Ahh. Warm like the desert sands.
A very deserving find.
Ja'kh must like you, tamiit. In life, he never did anything like this for me.
Fragrant! … As they say in this time. Ahem.
Traj radhin vabazeri. Strength becomes you.
Kss! I do not like the way it stares. Though I suppose we have the same eyes.
I wonder if Ja'kh will play nicely with your pet there. But I think he may be as shy in death as he was in life.
Fine threads make for strong cord. Yes!
Such potential from the veins of Nirni.
For a furnishing, perhaps?
A blessed bounty for potion-making.
An inspired find, tamiit.
Jo'zhet. Useful not only for its luster.
All the better that you lead.
I cannot help but hear the tales told in each game you play. It is quite diverting.
Cease your rattling.
The heart of Lorkhaj sees you redeemed.
Your soul is bound for Coldharbour.
The swish of fresh water—it soothes me.
Jone's mercy! That was close.
Hahl fajh'na! You just never know the way these games will go.
Give as freely as you take, I say. Well done, tamiit.
Merid-Nunda eyes your greed, tamiit.
Free your soul from the bondage of hunger. Find strength in my company instead.
We tip the scales in favor of my homeland. I thank you, tamiit.
A vile concoction with vile results. You are adrift from your true self, tamiit.
You were paler than two moons a moment ago. Now, you seem more yourself.
Such trifles will not be missed.
Reclaiming this place from Molagh can only serve to inspire his wrath.
You learn to craft the vestments of my adversaries? Why?
Ksss. The skin of a Bent Cat? Do you think I would not feel your soul bending before Namiira held you in her clutches?
It sickens me, seeing you gorge yourself on another's vitality.
I have no words for what you've just done. Azurah guide me, that I may redeem my tamiit for this dark deed.
Killing as you want is no way to live, tamiit.
Think better of taking such things, tamiit.
Don't all clap at once.
Hope you enjoyed your stay!
It might regrow if you leave the roots.
Let's make good use of it.
Taste doesn't matter when you chug it.
Hey, if it gives us an edge.
Does this count as swashbuckling?
Can we look through their things?
Woo! What a rush! Let's do that again.
How can you sleep at night?
C'mon friend. You're better than that.
I prefer to look my enemies in the eyes.
I guess we can stop to read.
Sometimes you've got to get creative with potions.
Honestly, inspiring.
What's it feel like, all that magicka?
Wait until the hangover hits.
Quite a few Wood Elves in Vashabar are very unhappy with Nantharion and his supporters today. There are scores to settle. A promising development for someone in my line of work.

Vashabar seemed like a nice quiet place to drop out of sight for a time. I never imagined the ex-king and his Recollection fanatics planned to upend it all with Ayleid magic!\n\nGood thing they're dead.
Don't worry about getting out of the sunken ruins, you won't be leaving.
I can't believe it. King Nantharion, in league with the Recollection? What else have I missed while I've been rummaging through the roots for skulls and such?
I actually admired Nantharion. He said we didn't have to let a king in Elden Root tell us how to live. Yet all he wanted was a throne of his own.\n\nI'm a fool for listening to him.
Let's see how long you last.
You never stood a chance.
Don't underestimate me!

My faith in the Dawnway is shaken. I've been fascinated by my Ayleid heritage my whole life, but I'm embarrassed to admit it now. I have nothing to do with the Recollection—or that fugitive king of ours.
King Nantharion made terrible mistakes, yet I am saddened by his death. Embracing our Ayleid heritage—parts of it, at least—was a lofty goal. But nothing good grows in soil watered by lies.
I hear King Nantharion was allied with the Recollection, but I never noticed. The flowers and the forest creatures told me nothing of these troubles. And I was happier for it.

I'm glad to see a hero here. King Nantharion's disappearance leaves Vashabar with a hole in its heart. These elves must decide who they are without him.\n\nSomeone like you could be an inspiration to them.
I've been looking for a chance to cross blades with some of those Recollection fanatics, and it turns out Hoperoot was full of them. If only I had known it sooner!
I'm glad someone put an end to Nantharion's mischief. I can't tell you how much it galled me to learn he was behind everything our Colovian neighbors feared about us. Some king he turned out to be!
The sun is shining bright and the air smells sweet, yet I have a feeling something terrible just missed us. Call it a soldier's hunch.\n\nThe funny thing is, I have no idea what it was.
I am sure it seems easy in the moment to follow such urges in exchange for power. But you acted in greater service of your soul. I am glad to see it done, tamiit.
It cannot be easy to forsake such alluring gifts. Do not worry, tamiit. You and I will make each other stronger.

For months, I've been telling my wife everything will be all right. I'll find work, our neighbors will warm up to us, someone will address the violence in town. Never imagined it would actually turn out that way!
I'm tired.
I hope this isn't the fever.
Got to keep digging ….
I felt great, got so much done. Now I feel like horse dung.
This is the fever, I just know it.
I hear the threat of fatigue fever is finally over. Even so, I think I'll continue to avoid crowds for now.
I'm going to die, aren't I?
I once won eight games in a row!
I've got seven gold to wager, and nine games I want to bet on! Hmm ….

People often ask what formal training I needed to become an arcane investigator. I had none, aside from a brief alchemy apprenticeship. No, all one needs is immense curiosity and determination.\n\nOh, yes, and a wild disregard for personal safety.

I see Count Ravenwatch as more than a father figure. My birth father was quite cruel, whereas Verandis showed me compassion from the moment he found me. Here's the truth. If not for him I may have descended to become a bloodfiend. How shameful of me.

Adusa-daro expressed skepticism when she heard about our adventures. She seemed to think you did more of the work than I let on. Maybe we should carefully document my contributions the next time you and I go into the field. I always bring a notebook.

No doubt you've heard stories about the origins of our condition. I wouldn't let them worry you overmuch. We cannot be held responsible for actions beyond our control. All that matters is how we behave in the here and the now.

Hello, I'm not available due to unforeseen circumstances. As I don't know the nature of the reasons for my absence, which will happen later, I cannot fully explain. I hope that makes sense. So, I apologize for my future disappearance in your present.
Moon Mother, return my tamiit to me!
Was that necessary, tamiit?
Really went splat, huh?
Something's lingering here.
Never met a guard I didn't hate.
We can have some fun with that.
And you get to keep all this?
Don't all the lines just blur together?

You know, I once acted as a Chronicler for Vanus Galerion himself! A very important service role at a limited-time event with incredibly prestigious patrons.\n\nNot important right now. How can I help you today?
You'd be amazed at the wonders I've found within these walls. One thing I've learned so far? Everything is connected to that altar. Everything.\n\nIncluding my wares.
Ooh, this one makes me itchy!
This is kind of cozy.
I'm so glad the threat of fatigue fever is behind us. Now we can get back to business!\n\nSo, what can I sell you today?
I didn't even hear it click!
That fight was quite the gamble. Thrilling! Let us see if we can face another threat of this measure.
Well fought, Inkslayer.
Those beings lack conscious thought and move only to kill. We should hold no qualms in ending them.
Great. More stuffy mages.
Huh. Not exactly humble, are they?
If a mage touches me, I'm punching them.
You just stuck your hand in that?
I could teach you a thing or two.

You don't know what it's like to be dead and unable to avenge yourself. It's maddening! I was a famed warrior. A hero in Summerset. There were songs praising me and I was killed by some books that I can't even tear to shreds!

Are you ready to seek my revenge? You don't want to lose threads of fate just because you weren't prepared for what awaits you in the archive.\n\nThat is not what happened to me. Those creatures just got lucky.

I still want revenge, but it's going to have to be set aside for now. Your skill and your services deserve payment, which is something I cannot give you. \n\nCome back when you're well rested and hungry for a fight.
You return. With good news, I hope.
That gryphon was more scared of you, you know.
I wish I could put you in my pocket!
The currents of fate shall revitalize you.
Spiders with armor. Nasty little things.
I thought that was a rock. Bravely done, tamiit.
Drums of the Bent Dance. Dro-m'Athra trespass in this heaven-reaching temple. My fur stands on end.

The Ghost Moon made easy prey of those that survived here. If these Doubting Monks had followed the old ways, this would not have happened. I am glad you were here to stop the spread of darkness, tamiit.
Nothing tastes so sweet as the fear from a broken hero!
Your weakness grants me strength!
Crouch! You must stay hidden for now!
I can smell your fear!
There you are!
A mere practice round. Do you feel overconfident?
Let's see if we can't break you now.
Cowardice suits you so well. Embrace it!
It would be awful to fail now, having come so far.
Pumpkins seed, and thorns will bloom. From there my patch wraith pets will loom.
Let my fingers find your fear. They will stab you, I will cheer!
I'll pick your bones, I'll blind your eyes, I'll sap your strength, let scarecrows rise!
Kick and scream, it doesn't matter. All your dreams I will now shatter.
Just to you this shall appear. The sum and total of your fears!
Let my Jack-o'-lantern fly! Now unleash their blazing eyes!
I volunteered for this. The way the master died…. Shameful.
Anyone got a deck of cards? Dice?
Stop them!
Time for some fun.
You weren't on my docket. But I can make room.
Cato Albus lost so much, but he will never suffer my loss.
It looks like it's waiting for us to attack. There's no need to be impulsive.
Barely broke a sweat.
How you defeated Jerensi is beyond me.
Cato Albus, you have taken enough lives!
Defend the Albuses!
You see Jerensi? She sure knows how to handle that big blade.
Surround them!
I do this in the memory of Lady Maya.
Feel our pain!
Want to trade guard rotations? I keep hearing voices at night.
This ends one way.
Fight for what you believe in. Nothing else matters.
Oh, you're arrogant. That won't serve you well here.
These soldiers had to die. And so do you!
You seek to rattle me, but I will not be rattled!
You go no further!
You're that confident you can defeat this Atronach at its worst?
I'll break the ward as fast as I can.
Pray to your gods while you can.
My skills bring naught but suffering.
Accept your fate.
Your decisions are your own. You chose this violence.
Innocents should die peacefully. The combative should die violently.
Fight! It's all you know!
Your condolences mean nothing!
I'm so sorry, my boy.
You don't belong here!
Did you see all that treasure? That's more than I saw in Cyrodiil!
Why do these Redguards get to live in peace and luxury?
For the true emperor!
To arms!
Orpheon's the rightful emperor. If you don't believe that, then you won't live to see his reign.
Come closer. My gryphons will love tearing you apart.
The Three Banners War will end with me on the throne.
Surrender, Moth Priest. Or I'll kill your friend, too.
Who's a good gryphon? Is it you? Is it?
That's how you planned to defeat me?
Send them to the far shores!
They've been on this island the whole time? How did we not know?
Long live Orpheon's reign!
What do the monks need all this wealth for?
Fools! I faced hundreds of banners in Cyrodiil. I won't lose to yours!
You want a swift death? I'm more than happy to oblige.
Let's see what you can do.
Gryphons, attend me!
That will be the last threat you make.
I need that scroll.
This treasure will finance Orpheon's next campaign.
I saw better technique from the worst Dominion soldier.
Orpheon's army is undefeated!
Well? Are we going to fight?
Too easy.
You fool! You think you can touch this?
If you want Orpheon, you'll have to go through me.
Now no one stands in Orpheon's way!
Orpheon won't see you today.
Why'd you go and do that?
They smell as beautiful as I'd imagined.
Tamiit, it pains me to see your soul in bondage so. Reverse this, I beg you. It is not too late.
Become unmoored from now!
Over here!
Fall, Scourge!
Yes! Slosh through the battlefield!
It doesn't even look like you're struggling.
Your fight better not disrupt the ecosystem here. It's very volatile.
You'd do well to avoid taking unnecessary damage here. It is rather hostile.
Ready yourself. They charge once more!
I thought these enemies were supposed to be difficult.
The Index will save you, but I don't think you'll need it.
I hate to be right, but I don't think the maligraphies are done.
Goodbye now.
Boo.
<The scamp points to small hand-written sign nearby. Caal: Assistant Chronicler, Familiar to Firandil, Merchant.>

Look, I'm not as experienced as Filer Tezurs or Ool when it comes to selling the items you are looking for. So, I will not engage in haggling. \n\nI don't think the others haggle either. No haggling in the archive!
Winter serves Yandir!
So beautiful. I loved feeding indriks as a kid.
You would make a great spy.
Ah yes, trapping souls is a normal practice in this time. Ksss.
See, always nice having a few gems handy.
Mizzik … is all right.
Our blessing will kill them all. Slowly.
Our blessing will kill them all. Slowly.
<<Heavy coughing, hacking.>>
<<Heavy coughing, hacking.>>
Our blessing will kill them all. Slowly.
Our blessing will kill them all. Slowly.
<<Heavy coughing, hacking.>>
<<Heavy coughing, hacking.>>
I can manage this pile of rubble myself!
Atronach down!
Can you say: Tan-lor-in?

Ah, it's good to have a place where I can relax away from my adoring admirers. Fame's not all it's cracked up to be. It's terribly hard work! I get hand cramps just thinking about all the books, scrolls, and babies I've had to sign.

Yes, it's true. I am indeed the one and only Narsis Dren, famed explorer and finder of antiquities. You may know me from such adventures as the Draugr Dilemma and Ancestral Adversity. Both books were quite popular and sold extremely well!
What do you need?
Yes?
Something bugging you?
I love picking locks! All that treasure! And the only thing between me and the coins are these tiny little mechanisms? Look, it's the closest I'll get to enjoying puzzles.
Sometimes I wonder if I would've been better off stuck in that ice trap. Does that answer your question?
I thought we had more in common, but I'm struggling to remember what.
I've definitely got some notes, but maybe we see how things go for a while?
You're not getting tired of me are you? I think things are going well!
I think we're really starting to hit our stride, don't you?
You make me feel seen. Does that make sense? Things are a little bit brighter thanks to you.
All my life I knew something was missing. I would've never guessed it'd be you. Hope that's not too mushy?
Sure thing!
Anything for you.

I remember you. That time with the lever, right? Or was it that incident with the buttons? No matter. You always were my favorite apprentice. Good old whatever your name is again! I never forget a competent assistant!

Oh, oh, oh! Are you my new master? Ha ha! Just kidding! \n\nThat would turn out badly for both of us. I already have a master, and he's of the Daedric persuasion. And he's a Prince of a guy, if you know what I mean.

People are always asking me, hey Barbas, introduce me to your master! Everyone thinks making a bargain with a Daedric Prince is the fastest way to get ahead in the world. Happy to oblige, but they have no idea what they're in for.\n\nNo idea.
Look, it's my very favorite mortal! Oh, won't we have some fun now! Let's play fetch! \n\nQuick, go fetch me a platter of sausages and a bowl of mead!
A friend of mine, Hyacinth, once described for me in excruciating detail how lopsided my gait was. So, I started glueing thin bits of leather to one of his boots. Took him months to realize it.
Not sure if you'll ever get a chance to meet Yarrow, but he's an amazing healer. Says it's on the account of his family helping treat the Thrassian Plague. From scrapes to boils, he's your guy.

I went back and visited the city where Wisteria grew up. Shimmerene. Gorgeous, of course. You'd be hard pressed to find a dull view anywhere in Summerset. Spent the whole night exploring, wondering which window little Wisteria used to dream out of.
I do not mind the interruption. A distraction from one's prayers can just as easily be interpreted as those prayers being answered.

I am not the only one from my time that walks this world again. Talbira's spirit remains passenger in Krin'ze. Sometimes, I catch her playful turns of phrase in the letters she writes. I am grateful she gets to live and guide again.
Speak.
I am listening.
Speak, tamiit. I am listening.

We did not have this Tales of Tribute game back in my time. It is quite diverting.\n\nI would not mind a chance to watch you play. Do not worry, I will bet in your favor. So all the better if you happen to win.
You have shown through your actions that you do not care for my thoughts or friendship. So, I wonder, why waste breath in asking?
The Order of the Hidden Moon focuses in forgiveness and redemption. When I spend time with you, I feel truly tested in the tenets of my faith.
I find silence to be your greatest virtue.
You are my guide in this strange new world. There is much we might learn from each other.
Tsin radhin vabazeri. We make each other stronger. Of that, I have no doubt.
You are part of my greater purpose here, in this time. I know it.
You led me to the path of forgiveness, tamiit. I would follow you anywhere in this world or any other.
As you wish.
By all means, tamiit.
Our cause is just!
For the dream!
I will make you suffer.
Give in and give up!
You are doomed, interloper!
No one escapes justice!
It's time we were rid of you.
You're barely worth the effort.
Look at you, being resourceful.
That's nice. And I know craftsmanship.
That could come in handy.
Now that looks fun.
Material full of potential.
Rajhin smiles upon us.
You were spotted. Noctra turns her gaze from you in shame.
All things fade, even the infamy of our actions.
And with swift enough fingers, you might take that coin back.
And what lesson do you get from this action, I wonder?
To hold history in your hands … nothing compares to such a feeling.
You take such care in restoring old relics, heh heh. Very fortunate for an old relic like myself.
Fashioning your belongings in the style of dark spirits? To what end? For what purpose?
I do not know this Cadwell, but stories of his name leave a foul taste on my tongue. Please, speak not to him again while I am present.
Kss! Please. Keep such abilities to the shadows!
I had not thought you a poisoner, my friend.
You have your orders. Follow them and keep quiet.
Just imagine the feast they'll throw in our honor.

Oh, please. We're adults, aren't we? The day I start considering people's feelings before speaking my mind is the day my efficacy as a politician comes to an end. When that day comes, just kill me outright, I beg of you.
You really are starting to annoy me.
Take all the time you need. I'll keep watch. If there's anything I can do, just name it.
I've been far too busy. Fighting has left little time to socialize.
Some people get all the luck.
The war took so much from so many.
You breathed your last!
You won't succeed!
I'll trample any who stand in my way!
Let pain descend!
Useless. Dispose of them!
This storm will stop those spiders!
You care so much about justice, why are you trying to stop us?
I thought you were smart enough to know this isn't justice.
Give up? When I'm winning? Is that what they taught you in the Battlespire after I left?
Put your staff away, Vandorallen. This has gone on long enough.
What will my spiders do when your magic fails? I'm excited to find out.
You could have been a great Sorcerer. But your talents are lost on Cato Albus.
Ka'iir!
Father? Where are you father?
I've trained my whole life for this!
This will happen again!
Boo.
Mephala! Lend me your power!
Hold on!
Ha! See the unseen.
I'll take a ship at sea any day over these humid caves.
It's been ages since I last slept. I think I'm hearing things.
They couldn't spring for some thicker lining? I'm freezing.
Anything left besides that stale hardtack? I'd like to keep my teeth.
Dig a little deeper next time.
That droning gives me a headache.
Senchal today is not so different from how it was in my day. Whether that is a compliment or not is up to you.
