Bah! Our supply of webs is endless!
By the scales of the queen!
You won't last long!
Stand and fight me!
I shall not be denied a good death!
You are my opponent?
Don't deny me a good death!
Every tale they tell of you is a lie!
I've had enough of your insolence!
Fool! What else could you expect?
There could be no other end.
With my power, the Reach will attain the Ruby Throne once more!
Thank you, blessed mothers, for the gifts you give me!
The city is simply beautiful. It seems the king will leave a lasting legacy after all.
Should I be quiet? Don't want to disturb your tracking. I'll be quiet.
Disgraceful.
Alas, this one has no coats to sell—but there are other ways to keep warm, yes?
Somebody get me a stiff drink and a crutch before I start cracking skulls!
Are you headed back to the city? I need to see a healer. I'm in real pain here.
I'd planned to set up shop in Alcaire Castle, but a soldier there accused me of conspiring with the Winterborn invaders. Idiot.
Don't think too hard about how it's made. Just eat.
You won't find better drinks, unless you locate the Clockwork City.
Wrothgar is too cold, and Alik'r is too hot. This one spends time in both—it is the only way to find balance.
This one prefers gold to green baubles or blue stones. To crowns, to silver, platinum, and all other things. Gold is all that matters.
For a short time only! Priceless treasures could be yours!
When the world was young and Y'ffre taught creatures their ways, did he also teach them where he hid his gold?
The Orsimer have so long been trod upon by others, beaten down to rise again. Why not show them all — with your riches?
This will help the people of Orsinium.
The Orcs aren't all that excited about a Nord-run business inside the city walls, so they pushed us to the outskirts. Just as well. My customers like the quiet.
Way I hear it, the king's got a real taste for salmon. 'Course there's not much the king doesn't have a taste for, am I right?
Look for a baby with a bat in its mouth! That's mine ….
It's a good thing I arrived when I did. These monks are in very poor shape.\n\nYou look a bit bedraggled as well. Can I help you find anything?
My father buried his treasure far away from Abah's Landing.
My cousin, <<1>>? We are quite close, the two of us, quite close. Find me a good red wine and I'll put in a word on your behalf.

It is hard to watch, yes? We have given the monks moon-sugar tonic and offered prayers in their name, but the rest …? The rest is up to them.\n\nTurap'su hopes that she will not have to bloody her sword.
What can Teifi get you? This one's stock is meager, but the Cantors have blessed every piece.
Stay away from the pointy bits!
Shalaraj—feer jassa!

I haven't seen too many of the old gang yet. I suppose it will take awhile for word of our return to spread.\n\nIn the meantime, I'll do what I can to get the guild up and running again. Who knows? I might even plan a heist while I'm waiting.
I know, I know. You thought I was the queen of the Dominion for a moment there, didn't you? Sorry. I'm just practicing for my next assignment. Have to keep my skills honed, after all!
My sword is sharp and my eyes are keen. When the guild needs my strength, I will be ready.

Walks-Softly says we're safe down here, but I can't help looking around and thinking that I jumped out of the sinking boat and into the jaws of the slaughterfish.\n\nDo those kind of thoughts make me a bad person?

I don't care who takes over the guild, as long as they supply me with components and let me build things that go boom.\n\nI've been working on a mechanical bird with an explosive inside. Impractical? Probably. Dramatic and flashy? Most definitely!

While illicit genius sounds pretentious, it barely describes the talents I bring to the guild. I hope the higher-ups realize how lucky they are to have me.\n\nBut sometimes it's hard for those without quick wits to notice such things.
Souls for the darkness! Meat for the beasts!

I've handled the accounts of House Hlaalu and the at-Addin Syndicate. How do you think I grew so rich?\n\nBesides, being in the right place at the right time allowed me to pass along information that the guild used to plan some of its biggest heists.
Drag them to the Darks!
Behold, the power of the void.
Your souls are ours to shape—ours to destroy.
Glad to see <<1>> has been keeping the guild on track. I'm still worried about the Iron Wheel, but we can weather that storm if we keep our heads low for just a little while.

Yes, yes, I hid from the Iron Wheel. Everyone in a position of power did exactly the same thing. But I'm back now, aren't I?\n\nI am an expert in the subtle application of alchemy. My contributions work best when no one knows I've provided them.

Zeira's a miracle worker, bringing the guild back from the brink of death. I suppose I can stick around for one more big score. And maybe for one more after that. It's not like I have anywhere else I need to be.

I'll let you in on a little secret. Terror can be a stronger motivational force than either admiration or respect. That's why I foster this grim, dark attitude.\n\nDeep down, though? I'm a lovable mudcrab!

During the crisis, I worked behind the scenes to keep Abah's Landing from falling apart in the guild's absence. Oh, I wanted to be here to help, but I had responsibilities.\n\nLook at everything Zeira has accomplished! She certainly did a great job!
Behold the wrath of Lorkhaj!
Forward, child of darkness!
Rejoice, children. The void approaches!
Claws out, friends! Rakkhat's servants have returned!
Haste, friends! Lorkhaj is nearly upon us!
Always the hard way with this one.
The void relents—for now. Hurry back, walker!
You persist? Very well.
Late again. He'll pay for that.
Look on me, fools, and see the end of all things!
Rise, Jone! Rise, Jode! Grant us sanctuary!
If I don't do a good job, I'll never be able to pay them back.
Wither and die!
You will fall!
There you are!
Despair!

Ever do something so stupid it made you feel as dumb as poor old Prince Hew? Well, what I did wasn't on the level of Hew's biggest follies, but it comes rather close.\n\nMaybe I'll just try to avoid Thazahrr Cartel agents for a while. Just to be safe.

You look like a decent enough person and I'm feeling generous, so I'm not going to rob you today. No, don't thank me. And don't look so disappointed. I'm sure we'll meet again in some other dark alley.\n\nYou can give me your gold purse next time.

Welcome to Abah's Landing!\n\nWhere else can you drink with a pirate, chase a thieving pickpocket, and roll in the hay with one of the Winsome Welwa's well-endowed beauties all in the same day? Nowhere, my friend, nowhere!
Good to see you! Come to deliver?
You've been busy, my friend. Rest and reap your bounty.
One cannot step light with such burdens. Let them take their leave.
My wares are mostly legal. A boast for any merchant in Abah's Landing.
I'll take a peaceful oasis to the bustle of the city any day.
I think I may move on soon. Best to buy now.
You would face me again? Fools!
Have you seen any cats around here? Not the ones that sit in your lap and have fleas. No, the other kind. The big, smelly ones that think that they're people. Seen any of them lately?
How dare you darken these sacred halls with your foul presence!
I wouldn't go in there if I were you. Those pirates are a mean and ornery bunch.
One cannot step light with such burdens. Let them take their leave.
Any more would attract too much attention. My apologies.
Gold for a miserable wrack. No, that's wrong. Wreck? Wretch?\n\nOh I give up! Why do I even bother? I'm the worst beggar ever to walk the streets of Abah's Landing! Whatever shall I do?
Blast these fools to pieces!
I have lightning on a leash!
Kortu thought he saw something by the river, but it turned out to be nothing.
If the next door doesn't open on the first knock, it's getting my boot!
Bringing justice to this cesspool, it's what I live for!
Half a shift before bed. Can't come soon enough.
Cooperation will spare you the rod!
The Chief Inspector is more patient with these thieves than I would be.
Tomb robbers. There is no lower form of thief.
Maybe we'll get lucky and some stupid thief will wander by.
If we fail the Magnifica this time, heads will roll!
As the Iron Wheel turns, justice prevails.
Oh, Prince Hew, how far you have fallen.
Stay vigilant. Transporting the prisoners is our priority.
Nothing leaves this place alive!
Destroy these foolish intruders!
Remember yourself! Remember who you are!

At least this foul city produces one good thing—"The Adventures of Pirate Empress Thusa ap Lagud!" Have you read the latest installment? I can't wait to see how she gets out of this one!\n\nAnd just between us, I enjoy the bawdy bits immensely.
I recently had the privilege of visiting Abah's Landing. Charming little village. I particularly enjoyed the hospitality at the Winsome Welwa.\n\nBest night's sleep I've had in an Elf's age!

A time existed when murders occurred in the shadows, behind closed doors. But did you hear what happened in Kvatch? A man killed by an unknown assailant and left on display in the street?\n\nI tell you, it's enough to scare the tentacles off a netch!

At dinner with the Provincial Governor, I said, "Fortunata, you need to rein in your pirates." And do you know what she said to me? She said, "But Magus, my pirates are upstanding citizens of our fair city. Whatever do you mean?"\n\nWitch.

A little light reading always relaxes me after a long day of study. I just need to decide what to read next.\n\nShould I dive into the latest Narsis Dren travelog? Or perhaps I'll cuddle up with the new Inspector Vale mystery? Choices, choices ….
Who knew "The Brave Little Scribb" was such a torrid tale! The Naughty Nereids really brought his struggle to life.\n\nI can't wait to see what those performers present to us next!
Not that I mean to complain about the Pirate Queen—excuse me, the Provincial Governor—but this one thinks we'd be better off if the Count of Kvatch was in charge.

Welcome to the friendliest inn on the Gold Coast! We are so much classier than that pirate's den in Anvil. And cleaner, too, truth to tell. No one ever gets sick when they eat or drink in my establishment!

As a merchant with a valuable stock, I depend on the common courtesy of my clients and the Kvatch Guard to keep my interests safe and secure. Lately, however, both the Guard and the Order worry me. They scare me when they're around.
"Herein lie the countless damned, their worth measured only by the weight of the gold that condemned them. Select your meal and devour it whole."
Over here!
Come on, this way!
Little busy, I'm trying to track down two gold pieces that came up short in this morning's count.
How may I serve?
Greetings! Let's do some business.
Walking these halls reminds me of the story they used to tell to scare the initiates. The tale of the Wrath of Sithis.
In the old stories, the Wrath of Sithis appeared to carry away the souls of traitors. If that's true, I wonder why purification was even necessary?
<Most employment opportunities appear on Anvil's bounty board. There's no shortage of postings tacked here.>
Don't mind the dried blood on the merchandise. Gives it character.
The Matron only allows me to keep the bare essentials in stock. My cupboards are bare to the bone.
Don't mind Grazda. She can be a bit abrasive, but we're open for business if you have gold or goods to sell.
They are toothless Dragons! Powerless, frightened.
Hear me, faithful of Akatosh! I speak of the foul followers of Sithis!
Perhaps the Speaker or Elam have something for you. It's entirely possible.
But Akatosh and his Primate will guide us through these troubling times.
But they'll never silence her voice! Her sermons will live on!

Welcome to the family, Initiate! Once you figure out your place here, I'm sure you'll do fine.\n\nJust don't try to encroach on Mirabelle's area of expertise. We don't need more than one spy and infiltrator in our Sanctuary, understand?
The Gold Coast welcomes you, reluctantly. My buccaneers and I are the law here now, and you'll respect it or be thrown in a ditch.
Smash the rats! Smash!
The rats are weak! Xal-Nur is strongest!
And again.
Spare some gold—please!
Do I look like a bank?
Watch where you step. I haven't finished mopping.
What junk have you brought me? Doesn't seem like you have an eye for quality.
Xal-Nur kill stupid lizard!
You die, slave-scum!
Xal-Nur break ground! Ground break you!
Xal-Nur make you spit blood!
A wamasu is off its chain! Kill it!
Xal-Nur will spit again! You'll see!
I was to be forgotten! Why must they always come?
You want to get in on a fight card, just hop in the pit. I don't give billing to walk-ins.
Purge!
No escape!
<Any bounties not suitable for the Kvatch Warders to undertake invariably winds up afixed to this notice board.>
Nothing is beyond my control in this place. Not man, nor beast. Obey!
Your flesh is nothing compared to my power, beast. Use it!
From my slumber, your doom will rise.
So much whining over a few dead Brotherhood members. It's quite simple: they failed. Why mourn the loss of weakness?
I'm happy for you, Silencer, but I miss our lost Brothers and Sisters. Durisa, Van, Cimbar, Mirabelle, Green-Venom-Tongue. Dread Father must have needed them at his side.

Look at you, a Silencer! The Speaker must be so proud! He brought you to us, after all.\n\nIf it's not beneath your new station, I'd love to go hunting with you again sometime. And by hunting, I mean sending some deserving souls to Sithis.

If Green-Venom-Tongue were still here, he'd be writing this all down in that journal of his, preserving the moment for all eternity.\n\nWell, he's not here, so thank the Dread Father we won't have to remember a thing!
It seems like you're here more now that you're a Silencer than when you were my Assassin. It's good to see you, my friend.
Akatosh may show mercy, I will not!
I'll butcher you like an animal!
The arena is my hearth and home. Enjoy the hospitality!
Keep a brave face, before I shatter it.
Oh, they don't bite. I jest, of course.

This hostel has been in our family for generations, but it requires an awful lot of work to keep it running. I plan to sell it after mother dies and move to Daggerfall.\n\nOh! Please don't tell her I said that! She'd get terribly angry with me.
Have you come to hear the will of our Night Mother?
Assassin, come. Speak with me.
The hunger of your blade is a blessing for which we remain grateful.
Do not dally. A throat awaits your blade's sharp kiss.
Have you dispatched your victim, Initiate?
We both have duties to attend to.
What news have you brought to me this time?
You have my attention, Silencer.
Sow fear, Silencer.
Here, boy.
Here, boy.
The key component to fetch, pup, is that you have something to bring me.\n\nFinish a contract, then you get your pat on the head.
There are plenty of contracts that could use your talents, Assassin.
Something you needed, Silencer?
Got a contract? Good. Now off with you.
There are plenty more jobs waiting, so finish your current contract.
Go on, Silencer. If the Initiates see you chatting me up they'll start doing it too.
You're alive. I hope someone else isn't.
What can I do for you, Assassin?
Have you brought me something, Silencer? You know I love gifts.
I refuse to stay overnight in Anvil. Inns are probably full of land pirates, waiting to steal my supplies.
This chapel would make a right fine tavern. Just gotta clean out those rot-tusk priests.
You seen the stone mermaid yet? It's a fine sculpture—just don't go swimming there. The locals don't take kindly to people scaring off the fish. I've got the welts to prove it.
Think you're sneaky, huh? Well, Ghaturn wrote the book on sneaky! You probably never read it because it's so hard to find! Cause it's, you know, sneaky.\n\nNever mind.

You been to the Chapel of Dibella yet? The priests seem a little more … reserved than the Dibella worshipers I've met before. More's the pity. Wouldn't mind hoisting my sails on a different mast, if you catch my meaning.
Hoisting crab-pots isn't as glamorous as hoisting the black flag, but honestly, what is?
Fine view of the sea from up here, huh? And no drunken buccaneers to muck it up. Damned Red Sails. To Oblivion with the lot of them!

Don't even bother with that chapel! Nothing but faithless hypocrites in there.\n\nBack in my day, a silken shawl over a single breast was considered modest! Now? Feh. Wooden pews and sky-high collars. It's a disgrace!
I don't know why those Sermonizers wear white. Gonna be hard to wash out those blood stains when I thump'em in the nose. Yffre's bones—anything to stop them hassling me!
The Order of the Hour has no time for pleasantries. If your business is not urgent I suggest you move on.
Greetings! Oh, don't mind Gristle—he's gentle as a lamb. Unless you've got food. Or you look him in the eye. Or you move too quickly. Or you smell like a horse … he hates horses.\n\nEasy, boy.
Let the Dragon God guide my hand!
Let the Dragon God guide my hand!
Plautus, you fool …. What have you gotten yourself into?
Classic Alexia …. Couldn't find her way out of a room with no walls.
Rotten fruit for sale! Perfect for throwing at criminals in the Kvatch arena!
Protect the stones! Kill the invaders!
This city will be your grave!
We will bury you!
Calm yourself, Chudan, or pay the price!
Your minds are weak!
Plant the seed and reap the harvest!
Did you hear what happened at Anvil Castle? That's another scandal for this disaster of a town.
<Nods knowingly.>
No matter the value of your goods, I shall guard them with my life.
Let's see the goods.
No matter the value of your goods, I shall guard them with my life.
Let's see the goods.
We've brought out the worst of the worst to come pay their penance in the pit!
What bloodshed! Thieves and murderers certainly know how it's done!
Lie with the worms!
She desires your suffering!
Welcome the all consuming darkness!
Time to sweep you away.
Nowhere to run, nowhere to hide.
Don't keep our lady waiting.
Did you really think you could kill me?
I think we need some time apart ….
Aw, did you miss me?
Where are you?
Shh. It'll be over soon.
The shadows claim you!
There is no escape from the web.
Fools. Friendship is poison.
Your secrets are mine!
Dead? Such a disappointment.
I'll tenderize you yet!
So … hungry!
Mmm—I'm all aquiver!
I'll just take a slice!
Let's have a taste!
Ah ah—leave that one alone!
Time for the main course!
Mmm … I couldn't eat another bite.
I see you lurking up there!
Soon your powers will belong to the Serpent. He will use you to bring about his glorious reign.
Just one moment.
Let's hope we're not too late.
Continue on, little ones. You will not escape my wrath!

I came out of an egg! Did you know that? Not everyone does. Come out of an egg, I mean. Wood Elves pop out of acorns. That's why they're so small. \n\nWait. That can't be right. I guess I don't know where Wood Elves come from. Do you?
After this, no more mining and shoveling for Sahalu. This one will get a new job as a chef … or maybe an acrobat. There's a lot of gold in the flippy tumbling business, yes?
Granosh crun! Granosh crun!
This one cares nothing for snakes or corrupt caravan guards. Shurami is only interested in the art of the deal.\n\nCome, fragrant one. Let us talk.
Want to know my secret for scrumptious gorapple pie? Come closer. This isn't for everyone's ears.\n\nIt's the crust! I use genuine crust from the inside of a kwama's shell!
Sometimes I miss the sights and sounds of Morrowind. But a few stiff drinks take care of that lickity-split!\n\nYou know, you look like you can use a stiff drink yourself, my friend.

You've come to me at the right time, friend. The last wagons to arrive before all this trouble began filled my bins with goods, and much of it is still fresh!\n\nI'm sure I've got something you'll like.
Don't you walk away from me. Yes, I'm drunk. I'm very drunk. I even threw up over there in the corner.\n\nBut that doesn't make you better than me. Nobody's better than me. I'm a perfect drunk!
Why that strange High Elf is so eager to purchase red brittle is beyond me. But I'm sure you have more important business to discuss with me.

This Iron Orc nonsense, it's all just an elaborate trick. It's the Dragonstar Caravan Company. Figure if they scare us, we'll be more willing to put up with their outrageous demands.\n\nWell, Tall Papa never paid gold for dung, and neither will I.
I can't stop shaking. It should pass in a moment, though. Then I can get back to work.
Sometimes I wonder why I left behind all the comforts of Rivenspire. Then I remember. It was the vampires. I never could abide such creatures.
I once spent five days drinking mead with Thane Jeggi at a fishing hole in Eastmarch. We had a fabulous time!\n\nBut never try to match Jeggi mead for mead. The man drinks like a thirsty mammoth!
Forced to work in intolerable conditions and this is what happens. This poor woman is more ill than she lets on.
A traveling bard once told me to write what I know. But who would want to read a story about sifting dirt and digging rocks?\n\nThere's nothing so dry as advice that contains no water.

Stupid, clawless, incompetent fools! Someone cracked another slab of red brittle trying to extract the foul metal.\n\nIf this one gets the shakes, someone can expect a gigantic hairball in their evening stew.
Keep walking, you infidel dog! The Blood-Feathers care nothing for pleasantries—only for the banter delivered by the blades of our swords.
You don't think there are trolls in the Arena, do you? I hate trolls. And ogres. And ducks. I really hate ducks.\n\nI guess I hate all the things.
Why the sour look, friend? Come. Dance and make merry! Nothing like the threat of a gruesome death to make you feel truly alive!
Have you ever tried Voljar's mead? Better than that swill I hear they serve in Sovngarde! Better than anything!\n\nI wish I had some Voljar's mead.
If you're Stone-Fish material, then I'm the king of Shornhelm. Move along and don't look back, sour tart!
Want to see what I have for sale? Of course you do!
The Captain really thinks we can bring Imperial Law to this backwards region? That'll be the day! When pigs fly, I say.
Regulations, this! Rules, that! What nonsense!\n\nI will drink whenever it pleases me. It's medicinal. And besides, what will Lucina do? Flog me? I'm their damn healer and they need to keep me happy.

Just look at those skeeving Imperial diamond-backs. So clean and proud in their fancy armor. \n\nOne of these nights, I'm going to give them a proper deep-woods welcome. Cut them ear-to-ear with a deer antler. Just my way of saying hello.
Grab a bowl and find a spot. You won't be able to conquer the Arena on an empty stomach.
Another morsel for the Arena? Better hurry, little morsel. When the Five Claws are finished in there, nothing else will remain to fight!
Have you ever been to a swamp? Dreadful places, but this one has heard that such knowledge will aid you inside the Arena.
This one wonders why all these so-called warriors don't just pack up and go home. Now that the Five Claws have arrived, none of them stand a chance in Oblivion of winning.
Sometimes I think we should pack up and move out. Offer to help deal with the Iron Orcs and the Scaled Court.\n\nBut then I think, no. Not today. Today, I want to become champion of the Arena!
I don't have time for this. I have a competition to plan for!
This is Ear-Carver's fire, walker. Ear-Carver's and the Five Claws.\n\nWhat makes you fragrant enough to share its warmth?
Glorious, simply glorious. Those ruins will make excellent subject matter for my next painting.
Got something to sell? Well, we put the "profit" in "profiteer!"
A newcomer! Marvelous! Come in and tell me your story.
I could be a writer. It doesn't look that hard to me. But spelling? I hate spelling. I'll get someone to handle that for me.
You're not here to take me back to my cohort, are you? I'm not going back. Not a chance.
You never saw me, understand? I won't go back to my cohort. Not for all the gold in Wayrest!
Everyone is welcome at the Crossroads! Just leave your hostility on the road and keep your gold handy.
The Crossroads is open for business, but I'll be keeping an eye on you.
Well done, soldiers! We held our ground and persevered!
Such fine craft. Do you sell your work? One day, I should like one of these for myself.
It is truly humbling to be the guardian of such beautiful gifts, if only for a short time.
We've brought out the worst of the worst to come pay their penance in the pit!
What bloodshed! Thieves and murderers certainly know how it's done!
Don't you know it's rude to keep your hostess waiting?
Wrap up these gifts for your mother, children.
For the Lady!
The Lady's will be done.
Kindly die now.

I tamed a Scamp once. Made it fetch me my morning breads before I woke up. Scrubbed the floors of my house when I was gone to keep it clean.\n\nThen I realized how despicable of a creature it was. So I ate it.
Serve the Xit-Xaht, or die!
Fools! We're Mephala's chosen!
Mephala craves your death!
Souls for the Spinner!
Welcome, blood bags.
Pacrooti really enjoys those small flatbreads baked by the High Elves. They are like tiny, edible plates.
Make a selection to reveal your rewards!
Heart of Mara, a bonus reward!
Fortune favor you, my friend!
Bright moons! Pacrooti welcomes you and prays that the Divines grant you luck and great fortune!
It has been Pacrooti's pleasure, as always, my good and faithful friend!
Time for a repeat performance?
Perfectly respectable.
That's a good one!
Most fragrant!
A lovely sweetmeat!
Just outstanding!
You'll not find better!
Burn, you worthless toads! Burn!
Every relic you recover defies Sheogorath's plans. We're not certain how. Yet.\n\nPerhaps the newly discovered relic can shed light.
<Evilest Laugh>
Need to find the Worm Cult and root them out at the source.

I'm not sure I'll ever get used to that huge rock floating over our heads. No wonder the Dark Elves act so crazy all the time. This land of theirs—it's like Oblivion, except with slightly better refreshments.

This is the Fighters Guild, damn it! Not some high and fancy guildhall for grandiose mages! Why do they keep insisting on sending us ewers of metheglin and flasks of old epiphany? We're not some High Elf drinking society!

If you've come to join the most prestigious, most eminent guild in all the land, then you've come to the right place.\n\nTell me, do you really think you have what it takes to distinguish yourself in the Mages Guild?
The Mages Guild has always treated me well. So I ask you, why in the world did they decide to send me to this bizarre land of bugs and mushrooms?

I've been reading a most fascinating account of the travels of Kireth and Raynor. Dark Elf explorers. Have you heard of them?\n\nI think I met them in Mournhold. They wanted to join the Mages Guild. I wonder how that turned out?

These little Dark Elves, so proud of their Living Gods. No offense intended, but the Tribunal can't hold a candle to the Eight. Now, Kyne—that's a God to put your faith in!\n\nWould you care to browse my wares?

Bugs and mushrooms as big as houses and guaranteed to scare the stripes off a kitten! This one doesn't know what in the name of Jone and Jode the Dark Elves were thinking when they decided to live in this bizarre land.\n\nBy the way, do you need a bag?
The Red Mountain? Oh, that's just noise and smoke. Nothing to be concerned about. I'm almost certain it won't erupt during our lifetime. Lord Vivec and the Tribunal would never allow such a thing!
Peace of mind. That's not something you can put a price on. Our vaults provide that and so much more. I'm certain you agree.
My forge may sputter and spit like Red Mountain, but it gets the job done. Feel free to try it yourself, if you're so inclined.
If you're looking for something to put a sparkle in your eye, try some of my choice stock. Just don't drink it too close to an open flame.

As an Orc living in Dark Elf territory, life isn't a bowl of dried tubers, but it isn't too terrible. At least, no one's tried to bind me in chains or kill me yet. There's always tomorrow, though, so who knows?
You look too skinny. You need to eat something. Here, try some of this. Isn't it delicious?
They say clothing makes the man. Or the woman. But it's the people who make their own clothing that really stand out, as far as I'm concerned.

Lord Vivec visited my shop just the other day. Charming fellow. Very polite. Even asked how I liked his fair city. But did he spend any gold? No, not even a few pieces for a hunk of bread or a block of cheese.\n\nI do hope you're better than that.
Well, that's done! Now, what can I get for a weary traveler?
Troubling times make for uncertain encounters. I can't be too careful, you know. I have my regular customers to think about.\n\nI suppose you're all right, though. What can I do for you?
Welcome to my humble shop. If you'd be so kind as to make a purchase, I'd be eternally grateful!
Robbery and murder! It happens to people more often than you think. That's why I limit the amount of gold I keep on hand.\n\nNow, have you come to buy something or steal something today?

My, aren't you a full flask of flin! You know what would make you even more desirable, if I may be so bold? A new suit of armor!\n\nIf you have the time, I'm sure I can get you fitted and geared up faster than the flick of a nix-hound's antenna.

Not even the wood speaks to me on a day as slow and listless as this. Even the boards bore me!\n\nAh, a potential customer enters my quiet shop. Will you excite me or do you just tease Old Amarz with your bulging gold purse?
My clientele is interesting, to say the least. Don't worry though, I'll make sure no mud or blood gets on your items.
The fire's warm and the roof doesn't leak, so come on in and make yourself comfortable!
I use only the finest water when I make a brew, drawn straight out of the Odai River itself! The lava run-off gives it a charred taste that I'm particularly fond of.

You know, I was born and raised in Eastmarch. Moved to Vvardenfell after the formation of the Pact. But as soon as I raise enough gold, I'm heading for Orsinium.\n\nAn entire city of Orcs! Can you imagine?
The Beautiful Darkness walks in the shadows between the moons, but she prefers to ride a dire wolf when the opportunity presents itself.\n\nMake sure the Sharp Arrow knows.
Heard a rumor about some crazed Dark Elf running about in red night clothes. Can you imagine? Long as they don't steal my potions, that's fine with me.
I run the finest establishment in all of Suran! Ask anyone here. Well, perhaps just anyone who's already smiling.
I'm not taking writs of credit or other such nonsense. This is a gold-only shop, understand?
Honor to you and your house, exalted guest. Please, feel free to browse.
You look hungry. Just don't try the special. We make that special just for the masters.
Don't ever get into a drinking contest with a Telvanni. You're liable to wind up getting turned into a five-eyed nix-hound before the bottle is empty.

The Telvanni do not notice a missing trinket or two. Why should Short-Leash let them know they are performing such acts of charity? With one hand he cleans what is dull, and with the other he takes what is shiny.\n\nSuch is the life of a slave.
You are most welcome, friend! What can I do for you?
You won't find better arcane merchandise … certainly not around here.
The glass mine might be closed, but that just means we get to start drinking earlier in the day.\n\nNot that work ever stopped me before, know what I'm saying?
I'm sorry that there were problems at the mine, but I'm certain everything will get back to normal soon.
My recipes appear as a ray of sunshine on a cloudy day in this dismal land of giant insects and disagreeable Dark Elves. It's a well-known fact that I'm the best cook east of Summerset. Ask anyone.
Trouble or no, I'm not going to let it affect my profits. So, welcome to my inn and damn happy to meet you. Show me your gold and we'll get along just fine.

All this talk of cults lately. I've heard rumors, sure. Everybody has. But it's not like they come in every day to buy bait or anything.\n\nAt least, I don't think they do. I guess you never can tell who might be a cultist.
Ah, a customer! Glad to see that Savarak hasn't scared everyone off yet. How can I help you today?
You missed it. Three Undaunted just had an arm-wrestling contest, all at once. They called it a draw when they each dislocated a shoulder.
For those of us from the north, diving naked into the Sea of Ghosts is a rite of passage. It really separates the reckless from the meek.\n\nStill not sure where you fall.
House Redoran controls the west and House Telvanni holds sway over the east. Me, I'm the master of this cooking pot. Oh, what a sorry life this is!
You're an adventurer, aren't you? I knew it! What an exciting life you must lead. You absolutely need to tell me all about it. Are you free later? I can meet you after the shop closes for the day.

Red Mountain rouses from its slumber. I fear that can only mean one thing. Vvardenfell will soon need the services of the Fighters Guild. Of that I'm certain. Every rumble and plume of smoke practically calls out our name.
Life in the ash can be deadly for outlanders. You will need what I sell if you hope to survive.

Do you sense it, adept? That feeling of doom and despair that hangs in the air of Vvardenfell like a dense fog? Something isn't right in this fair land.\n\nI wonder if the Mages Guild can do anything to help?
Do you have the relic? Your face is … hard to read.
Always good to see a reliable face. Care for some work?
Hungry, free-scale? I'm sure we don't have anything that will please your oh-so-delicate palate.
It is good to see a free Argonian, but you must be cautious. The Telvanni will clap you in chains without hesitation. Buy something and go.

I heard that the Ashlander tribes were stirring up trouble to the north. Things have quieted down, but you never know what danger waits around the next bend.\n\nThat's why you need the best armor gold can buy—my armor! Can I put you in a suit today?
You are in a hurry, aren't you, my friend?

Hammer and steel! Now that the end of the world isn't quite so imminent, I'm busier than a bull-netch surrounded by a herd of excited betties!\n\nStill, if there's something you need, just speak up and I'll get to you in a moment.
Greetings, friend. I've got plenty of fine goods if you wish to browse. You won't find better in Vos.
I've many fine goods to sell, if you have the gold. Take a look.
Return the relic and we'll let you live!
I don't cavort with delicate flowers. Take the pledge.
Trying to count me among your day's conquests? I am not won over so easily.\n\nTomorrow … that might be another story.
I can feel time passing us by. We will never see this moment again. Claim your reward.
Take a few too many knocks on the head? Don't you want your reward?
Why me? Why not the others?
The High King will hear of this!
What is wrong with you?
This one recommends you buy a home while the costs remain reasonable.
No home? There are deals to be made if you know where to look.
You could be the Skald King himself, but without a home you're just a worthless vagabond. No offense.
No home as yet? Do you like standing exposed in the rain on stormy nights? Actually, so do I, but I still have a place of my own.
Without a home, you have no door to lock. And without a lock, well, that's just inviting thieves to rob you.
In Black Marsh, every leaf covers your head like a roof and the very swamp serves as a carpet for your feet. Unlike you, I prefer an actual house, but I'm a lizard of discriminating taste.
Life is hard and sometimes it tusks you where the sun never shines, but don't worry. Tomorrow will be worse.
You must be persnickety if you haven't been able to find a house yet. I guess beggars can be choosers, hmm?
You don't have a house, do you? I can tell. You have that air of vagrant about you.
Never trust anyone who doesn't have a home of their own, I always say.\n\nStill, trust is overrated. How can I help you?
Every home requires a personal touch. And this one has personally touched everything in the inventory.
Have you been to Morrowind? I haven't, but I hear the Dark Elves live inside bugs, of all things!
Have you been to High Rock? They say everyone in High Rock lives in a castle, if you can believe such tales.
I have no reason to harm you, mortal. As long as you buy something, I'm sure we'll get along fine.
They say you can't take it with you, so I say spend it and live like a king! I have just the piece your home has been craving.
Now, you're not as famous as Narsis Dren or Investigator Vale, mind you, but I'd be happy to do business with you.
Ah, the hero of the Dominion! I have something special I just know you can't do without!
What an honor! Let me show you my special stock. It will look amazing in your home.
A little fame can be dangerous, but at least we can do business.
Take your pick of a remaining crate.
Select the crate to try your luck!
Do not be sad, my friend. There are always additional crates available for purchase!
We are being attacked! You may want to stop and fight, my friend!
Ah, the hero of the Pact graces my shop. This one is unworthy, but let me show you what I selected especially for your home.
I've been saving a few items for that special someone, and you certainly qualify. Let me show you what I have today.
Think you're tough? I've dealt with dozens that are tougher. It's my business to provide for people like you. So, are we ready to do business?
Ah, the hero of the Covenant! Let me be the first to congratulate you on your well-earned fame and fortune! And to sell you something expensive ….
It pains me to say it, but I think I'm about to lose one of my prized possessions. I know it will look great in your home, though, champion.
Now, I usually only deal with heroes of a higher stature, but I like you. So this time I'll make an exception.
Ah, hero, you grace me with your exalted presence! Would you like me to heap praises upon you first or would you like to get right down to business?
I've been saving a few items for that special someone, and there isn't anyone more special than you. Want to take a look?
That thing with the what's-it-called? That was you? Well, if you say so. Go ahead. Feel free to take a look.
Ah, the hero of the moment has come to call on this humble servant. I'd kiss your feet, but I hurt my back and can't bend right now. So let's talk business, shall we?
Something special for someone extraordinary? You've come to the right place, champion.
Flames of Oblivion, devour them!
Exceptional rewards!
Amazing! How do you do it, my friend?
Most crates contain four rewards, but sometimes you will get a special fifth reward!
Select your crate and we can begin. Most crates contain four rewards, but sometimes you will get a special fifth reward!
These precious gems can be traded for valuable rewards!
You are today's top player, my friend! You should feel very fortunate!
Pacrooti has never seen such a magnificent display of good fortune! You have set a new record!
About time. Got what I need?
Looks like it's time for a hand-off.
I'll make sure this goes where it needs to. Here's your fee.
Is it supposed to smell like that? I hope the client doesn't notice.
Form and function, where do you stand? Oh, never mind. Just hand it over.
Looks uncomfortable, but I understand that's the style. The client will love it.
Never got the hang of enchanting myself, but I'll get this to the client.
All this food? For a single client? Whatever. Here you go.
Quite a rarified piece. Very intricate. Smells like wood. I'm sure the client will love it.
All right, that was just mean!
We can find room, depending on your destination.
The manifest is full, but I'll find room.
It's not a good day to travel, but travel we must.
Smoke instead of light? Not the reaction I was hoping for.
Local traditions are essential to the New Life. Sometimes they change, year to year!
Happy to see the ancestors aren't materializing. I find ghosts to be rather boorish.
Those spores may help me devise a treatment for other infections of tower fungus. At least something good could come of this.
Vivec City, home of the best and brightest, they told me. Well it doesn't look very bright to me, not under a layer of grime.\n\nDespite the dust, do you care to look at my wares?
You will not believe how close this stand has gotten to blowing up. Perhaps fools are soon parted from their gold, but I would rather they avoid my shop altogether.\n\nWhat can I help you with today?
Some of the greatest wizards of the age have handled my instruments. You can handle them too, if you wish.
Here to do a bit of alchemy? Well, try not to crush the instruments with those sausage fingers of yours.
Sister, your confusion just confirms my claim.
Pacrooti envies your glistening gems!
<cough>
Hmm, ha ha!
Ha haaaa!
<humming 3>
Mm hmm!
Pacrooti really enjoys those small flatbreads baked by the High Elves. They are like tiny, edible plates.
Hmm, ha ha!
The magister in the giant mushroom tower is not a nice man. He should try moon-sugar. Perhaps it would sweeten his personality, yes?
There's nothing like discovery to really get your heart pumping. The unknown is more appealing to me than any feast you could place before me.
Nothing ever good has come from messing around with magic. But I'll stay as long as they keep paying me in gold.
You're not with the House Guard, are you? The Ordinators? The Armigers? No? \n\nWell, then, how can my vessel and I be of service to you on this fine and glorious day?
Plenty of room if you're looking to go to Vvardenfell. Climb aboard and we'll set sail before you know it.
Vvardenfell isn't for the faint of heart. But if that's where you want to go, I can probably accommodate you.
I'm extremely busy getting our ship set to sail. If you desire transportation to Vvardenfell, I suppose we can make a little room for you.\n\nIf we must.
Need to travel around the Vvardenfell coast? Then you're in luck, because I'm the best captain with the fastest ship and the bravest crew.
In a hurry to leave? There might be faster methods of travel, but few are as comfortable and stately as my proud vessel.\n\nAnd we plugged most of the leaks!
Circumspection is the watch word of the day. And my crew and I are nothing if not circumspect. Would you like to hop aboard?
You really are turning out to be a disappointment.
Should I offer him the land at a ridiculous price?
By the Three, I've never seen the mountain so active. And Baar Dau! I swear, the moonlet looks like it's about to fall from the sky! I can't wait to set sail and put dry ground behind me.
Stand aside. Lord Vivec is expecting me!
I don't like the looks of that sky.
The moonlet! It's raining fire from the sky!
Stop running! I just got her fattened up!
Pig on the loose! Be on the lookout for a pig on the loose!
Damn, I still need to send a letter to Gothren, that pompous ass.
All manner of goods for sale! Buy before the sky crashes down!\n\nWhat can I get you?
Trade will continue no matter how many times the mountain rumbles. What can I get you, my friend?
No, that's not correct.
Come! Buy some of these fine wares.
Buying! Selling! Trades of all kinds.
My arcane wares are the best in all of Sadrith Mora. Which has absolutely nothing to do with the fact that they're the only arcane wares in Sadrith Mora. Take a look.
The Telvanni are held back by their mistrust and bigotry. If you wish to learn the craft, come to the Mages Guild. We turn none away who truly wish to learn.

All these Telvanni mages can do is boast and brag. I'd bet hard gold that if they had to face off against one of our fellow Guild members ….\n\nSuffice it to say, there's more to the craft than mere bravado.
The warriors in Sadrith Mora are nothing compared to my companions in the Fighters Guild! Join us if you want to earn true honor.
Finally, another member of the guild! It's good to see I'm not the only one in town.
Who's safe from these Reach-dogs? Only Falkreath's walls, surely. We'll go there.
That thundering hammer. It never rests! I just want it to stop!
The clan will drink your blood!
Back to work, or the rest of you will get the same!
You will submit!
Telvanni, of course.
Redoran, friend?
House Hlaalu, perchance?
May all your deals prove profitable!
Walk in honor, my kin.
Telvanni or …?
I think you'll appreciate the view from my tower.
I erect the spine of gratitude, Scarlet Judge. Thank you for bringing Marshal Hlaren to justice.
It warms my heart to see the Judge patrolling our streets.
I fear no evil while the Scarlet Judge walks our streets.
My, do you really walk around in that all day? Don't you get hot?
Is someone there?
Again? These instructions are terrible!
It is always a good time to upgrade your decorations. Come, see my selections.
No home? This one knows that there are deals to be made if you know where to look.
A little fame can be dangerous, but at least we can do business.
Ah, a true hero graces my shop. This one is unworthy, but let me show you what I have selected especially for your home.
I've been saving a few items for that special someone, and you certainly qualify. Let me show you what I have today for your household.
I never understood how one could go so long without a home, but then, I never understood how the kwama could go without the sun. Different lives for different types, I suppose.
A warrior such as yourself deserves more than an empty home. Here, let me help you fill it.
Can I help you with something? Some new furniture perhaps?
When allies enter your house, you want them to know of your great deeds in the Battlegrounds. That's something my shop can help you do.
You've proven yourself on the Battlegrounds, and now it's time to remind others of your great deeds.
Is there something I can shop you for today? No, wait. Is there something you're looking to help? No, drat!\n\nUm, care to look at my wares?
Try not to think about the rumblings from Red Mountain. It's much better to think about all the goods that just arrived. Take a look at these splendors!
The levitation sigils are cast!

I only recently arrived and I'm still getting used to this strange land. Did you know they mine insect eggs for food here? Or what about those murderers that get to kill people just so long as they have an official piece of paper? It's crazy!
Oh, hello. We seem to be, ah, adrift.
I won't rest until I avenge Sergeant Delms.
I won't rest until I avenge Seyda Neen's honor.  Sergeant Garil can handle the governor's duties until then.
You look pretty tough. For an outlander, that is. Maybe you can give these other warriors a run for their gold.
You outlanders keep pouring into Ularra. It's fun to see how many of you end up with your guts pouring out.
I see you've grown accustomed to the battlefield, so I won't even try to convince you of the scientific importance of these ruins. A brute like you will probably just roll your eyes at me.
Ald Carac is a Dwarven ruin, and as such it should be put to better uses. Like research. Specifically, my research. Which I was in the middle of doing before this lot showed up.
Look, do me a favor. Defeat every last one of those s'wits. Make them so ashamed they'll give up battling for good and finally leave my quarry alone!
Quarries are for gathering stone, not corpses! I have deadlines. I have a quota! This is just insane.
Organic detritus accumulating in transport circuit. <<1>>, commence scouring.
Critical fault detected in sweep sequence. <<1>> proceed to restoration alcove for analysis.
Unauthorized access of service corridor. Security measures initialized.
Pit Daemons losing to the Fire Drakes last week was just a fluke. We'll get them next time!
Fire Drakes losing at Domination? Never thought I'd live to see that. Must have been a stroke of bad luck.\n\nYou know, these socks feel unlucky. I think I'll go burn them.
Just listen to those Fire Drakes boast. Once they face down the Storm Lords they'll break apart, like a rowboat in a hurricane.
The Pit Daemons, the Fire Drakes, the Storm Lords, they are nothing but hot air. This one will speak to them when she is cold, if only to warm her paws.
Last week, I sprained my ankle fighting in Domination. I may not be able to run for awhile, but my arrows still fly true.
If Foreman Mevel thinks he can put me back to work in the quarry, he has another thing coming. I'm here to fight! It's my new calling.
"Where's the stone?" they ask me. "Where's the stone?"\n\nI don't know! I don't know where the fetching stone is!
Another discharge incoming. Get down.
It's bypassing my alterations! Disrupt the secondary terminals now!
Power-plant overtaxed. Cooling initiated.
Where could she have floated off to?
We'll have some fish when we get home.
Maybe I'll just retire. There's nothing else for me to do if the quarry can't be worked.
I don't know why Lord Vivec ever agreed to this. No slaves? In a Dark Elf city? Who ever heard of something so outlandish!

You want something done fast? You want something done right? You get slaves to do it! You have to watch them like hawks and beat them every now and again, but they're much more reliable than these wage-workers.
I love this city! I love the cantons. I love the waterfalls and ocean view. I even love the rock that hangs in the sky above!\n\nDid I happen to mention I love this city?
I love this city. Almost losing it makes me appreciate what we have so much more. I think I'll use my sword to protect Vivec and its people. It's the right thing to do.
The blisters that cover my scales remain the same, but now I can nurse them in the comfort of my own home. No more crowded slave pens for me.
I don't think I would have cared about the moonlet falling on my head when I was still a slave.\n\nNow that I'm free, I find that life is ever so much more precious.
Everyone needs something to keep them kicking in the field. And I have the wares to help you do just that.
You want to hear the crowds cheering? For your name to be sung? For victory after victory to be gained by your hand? \n\nMy shop can help you accomplish it all.
The rift will grow if that Daedra isn't slain!

It's nice to take a break from building the cantons. The overseer can be a real taskmaster, and I miss the pleasing shape of proper castles.\n\nAt least they don't have us trying to build those weird mushroom towers, though.
The Sharmat … lurking. Waiting. Curses beneath the mountain …. Hear me, Incarnate! Hear me.
You should have seen the look on his face when I left him there.
We're definitely going to need some more wretches.
Trick worked!
Claw out eyes! Claw out eyes!
Such work is below my station.
The Master personally selected me for this mission.
When will dead mortals reform?
Urn broke! He did it!
People hand in jobs, I hand them out. It's as easy as that.
A little overeager there, aren't we? Get some rest before you take on another job.
I may be an expert in many things, but for this particular case I've told you all I can. Go to the person who sent in the request if you want more information.
Major events overshadow the lesser, but even small troubles can be of great importance. Do you wish to help?
You've helped us in all our current endeavors. Come back later and we should have more requests.
Your payment will be given by the one who made the request. We often find a quickly completed task is met with generosity.
There is no challenge without the challenger.
Take some time to rest before your next challenge.
I'm excited to hear of your victories.
How fare you in today's battles?
The junkyard is stirring. Be wary!
Still as eager as ever to return to the hunt? Hm! Good! I have just the beast to challenge you with.
You mustn't allow them to cooperate!
It's channeling tremendous amounts of energy.
That's all of them. Now trigger a surge!
You hunt like a born Ashlander, but even the most skilled hunter requires time to rest.\n\nCome back later and we'll find you another quarry.
Now comes the hard part, outlander. The hunt. The dance. The kill.\n\nSurvival isn't proof of success, however. I demand a trophy, taken from the dead beast's body.
When the hunter returns, the tribe gives thanks.\n\nBut tell me, outlander. Do we have something to be thankful for?
I should not be seen talking to you. Others have been punished for far less.
I gather herbs and such for Magister Therana. She pays a fair price if you meet her expectations. Tribunal save those who don't.
Magister Therana really doesn't like to be bothered. Unless you have legitimate business with her, I suggest that you leave.
I don't take passengers if that's what you're about to ask. I deal with enough s'wits once I come ashore, so I certainly don't need any crowding up my holds.
I heard that nomadic Ashlanders travel nearby, but when I expressed interest in observing their movements, the captain of the Buoyant Armigers nearly tethered me to a post.\n\nVery vexing.
Oh, just a little ditty I heard. Kind of catchy, isn't it?
I don't think I'll ever really get used to being the archcanon.
I'm going to go mad if I have to spend another day holding down this canton. Problems abound and my orders are to stand around. That's no way to emulate the Warrior-Poet!

We have many customs I suppose will seem odd to you. Never fear. You seem odd to us, too.\n\nPlease bear in mind, we don't eat with our hands or appreciate inappropriate displays of public nudity. Or burping. We consider that to be particularly rude.
A kwama-wrangler must remain lean and fit. Those tunnels can be narrow, you know!
Airdeoza is not one to try to rise above her station. No, no, let her be safe among the unseen, the forgotten. That is where it's safe.
Got another comment about my cleaning skills? This broom can be used for more than sweeping. Just keep that in mind.
You'll find that we treat our workers with the utmost care. Our punishments? Completely harmless, I assure you. Though accidents do occur from time to time.
Do I look like someone you can speak to? This fan cost me more than your entire outfit.
I have you to thank for my life! I'll sing your praises to all who will listen.
I have better things to be doing than talking to an outlander, I'll have you know.
Assessing threat ….
Did you not hear me? I need you up here!
Fortunate that there was enough of you left to translocate.
All this talk of Red Mountain exploding makes Serabhi yearn for the knife-happy guards of Abah's Landing.
Normally I'd give you all sorts of warnings and instructions, but I know you'll keep your head about you. It's those other races I don't quite trust.\n\nWhere do you wish to go?
A word of advice? Don't look down. The last Khajiit who rode Old Risa decided not to heed that warning. And despite the saying, no, he did not land on his feet.\n\nNow where can I get you to?

Argonians in particular can't seem to hold their lunch when they ride these beauties. Never actually thought those lizards could actually turn any greener!\n\nI'm sure you'll have no problem though. Where would you like to go?
If I hear anymore insults about my silt strider, I'm refusing service! Us Dark Elves have a sense of decorum in these situations. Learn some manners.\n\nNow, where would you like to go?
Lovely to see you! Please, tell your Dark Elf friends to stop by more often. I need a break from the rabble every once in awhile.\n\nWhere would you like to travel to?
Another outlander in need of a ride? I swear, you're all just trying to annoy me at this point. \n\nAll right, yes, where would you like to go?

Most Dark Elf outlanders I meet are shocked by our faith in the Tribunal here in Vvardenfell. But heck, Vivec's in our own backyard! Hard not to stay devoted.\n\nSorry, not here to debate religion. Were you looking for a ride?

So many different cultures come through this part of Vvardenfell. I just can't seem to stop asking questions. It's frustrated more than one customer.\n\nSo, before I let my curiosity get the better of me, where would you like to go?
I really had to work my arse off to get a position in Vivec City. Just in time for a Red Mountain to burn it to the ground. Lucky me.\n\nDo you need a ride somewhere?
Are you waiting for an invitation? This is a caravaner station, so I'm assuming you're in need of a ride.\n\nCome now, where do you need to get to?

Many depend on our services for travel. We're far more reliable than your typical caravan, that's for sure. Not many creatures wish to face off against a silt strider.\n\nWould you like to journey with us?

There's no need to be frightened. Silt striders are very calm creatures, and generations of Dark Elves have used them for travel. Why, I'm the fifth in a line of proud caravaners.\n\nWhere can I take you today?
Heard those mushroom towers are great for your health. All that fungus in the air helps clean out the lungs. Wish my home was made of that stuff.\n\nNow, do you need a ride?
Heard about an egg-mine with singing kwama in it. They're so good the miners can't even work! They just keep clapping! Imagine that.\n\nDo you need something?
Outlanders! Who else but the ignorant savages from other lands would barge into my office and expect to be able to just speak to someone of my stature? Incredible.\n\nNo offense intended, of course.

You look like you've had enough of that heavy, bulky armor. My leathers breathe! They have give! And they look great, especially on someone with your physique.\n\nSo, want me to help you get into some leathers?
Good fighters need good gear. I've got good gear. Want any?
These wares can make all your dreams come true. As long as your dreams include the battlegrounds and victory. Otherwise? You're out of luck.
You want to make great victories on the battlefield, no? That's what this one is here for. He has just the thing for you.
I'm sure a rugged individual such as yourself has no problem taking care of themselves, but perhaps my goods can be of some help?
It's good to see a friendly face. Sometimes I walk for days with nothing but my guar for company. Now, what can I help you with?
A life of travel means a light pack and a lighter soul. Still, I have goods for purchase.
I run a cleaning service of sorts. Most merchants don't like buying dirty goods.
Most merchants are picky about what you bring them. Me? Just trying to make some gold, like the rest of the folks down here.
I try my best to sell quality wares. Sure, expectations aren't very high, but we sell an enormous amount of product. And most of my customers don't take kindly to faulty goods.
A lot of these runts won't even think about joining the Battlegrounds. But me? I'm taking the chance to get out while I can.
Oh no, the Battlegrounds is stopping us from collecting stone. Whatever shall we do?

Did you notice that I haven't moved Baar Dau back to its original position. It's in no danger of falling, thanks to you, but as I wrote in the Ballad of Red Mountain, "All actions have consequences and pose some risk."\n\nBest to leave it alone.
The switches aren't going to pull themselves.
That's not right. Try another scroll.
For the Jarl! For Falkreath!
You are getting closer!
A Sweet roll! Delicious!
Think it's hot here? The Forge will consume you!
The Hunt-Father must be pleased. A feast is coming!
I beckon, the land answers!
No escape from the earth's fire!
Animals! You're all animals!
Hungry roots hear me crow! They do! They do!
Bows they bend and bones they break, these branches of mine!
Mashed and mauled in rocky teeth!
Vengeance for my children!
Feast on our prey!
<Huffs.>
My teeth are sharp, little lambs.
You'll repay that blood with your own!
Even fire hungers! I welcome it!
"Proselytize," the act of advocating or promoting a course of action. May I proselytize you to buy some of my wares today?
They say there's nothing more appealing than a mysterious man. Only stands to reason that the Father of Mysteries be a cut above the rest.
I run a good, honest business. Not that the businesses here aren't good! Or honest! Or anything really. Oh, I don't know.
All prices have been calculated with current market trends.
I suppose I have to be grateful I've found a guild to hire me. At least that counts as something in this fetching wasteland.
Nothing worse than sand in your armor. You would think Alik'r would have prepared me, but the surrounding wasteland here seems endless.
I have packs that hold things. That's it. Nothing fancy. You want to enchant it? Be my guest.
Currency and personal goods can be stored within our bank.
Please know that we use gold here in Clockwork City. Trading your coin-purse for a handful of gears in a dark alley somewhere is not advised.
I have several teas that are good for what ails you. My last cup should be kicking in any minute now. Any minute ….
If you seek to cut down one of Sotha Sil's trees, you will need many axes. And lots of patience.\n\nAlas, Jobai has no axes to sell, but he has many other spotless items! Take a look.
My meals have been created to be edible.
Mages are the absolute worst with their clothing. The burn marks, the oil smudges, the stains of unknown origins. It's a crying shame.
A group of Tarnished brats came sniffling around my stall the other day, begging for scraps. Of course I had my guards turn them away. Do I look like I'm running a charity here?
We're all provided clean water through the Halls of Regulation. The drinks I serve are as gleaming as can be!
Mother always hoped I'd have a knack with machines, but I'd much rather stock my inventory and balance my books.
I can't sleep a wink at night, what with all the cawing. Isn't anyone going to handle this crow menace?
Honestly, I don't know what's wrong with the people in this city. If it doesn't have gears, they just aren't interested.
There hasn't been a new fashion trend in this city for a hundred years! I need to make something bold, something with style!
These goods were made by honest mer hands. When a factotum can carve wood as good as me, that's when I know it's time to quit.
Worried about your gold? Don't be. My good neighbors are convinced I'll hex anyone who so much as thinks about stealing from me. And who am I to dissuade them?
My items are of good quality. Anyone who's told you otherwise is a fetching liar.
Come to make some alchemical discoveries? Good! No playing it safe though, all right?
You don't want guests to come over to an empty house, do you? My shop can help you avoid looking like a squatter in your own home.
Come to see my stock? My wares are only for those of great accomplishments. Let's see what I have available for one such as yourself.
I feel that you've gone through many trials. My stock can remind you of victories won.
Everyone within the Brass Fortress seems to have your name on their lips. A champion of such renown deserves only the finest furniture for their home.
I've only just arrived and I'm already set! I've got this lovely shop to take care of, and the most interesting customers to keep me company.
Don't like my prices? Too bad. You're free to leave.
I think my leather will suit you just fine. Then again, I'm sure you'd look great in most things.
I'm willing to buy most scrap, but spare me the details. The less I know, the better. I'm sure you understand.
A lot of my elders tell me to be a proper Argonian, but I ain't ever seen a Hist in my life! Besides, customers always appreciate a friendly smile, even the type of customers I get.
My claim here cannot be broken so easily.
Oath-bound, rise!
Flee our lands! Tell all Skyrim the that the Dreadhorn clan is coming!
You're scared. We can feel it.
Will you put up some fight or be slaughtered like these Nord pigs?
I will cover this land in ice and blood.
Beg and I may spare your kin.
If I knew my way around a gear or two I might have been one of the lucky ones, but I'm happy enough to have inherited this shop.
Keep holding! Don't give them anything!
Offer your throat to the Hunt-Father!
All your halls will crumble!
No craftsman can keep pace with Sotha Sil's divine genius. Even so, we must try. If you come with well-oiled intentions, I have goods to sell.
Divines have mercy!
We're trapped! We'll all be living dead soon!
Leave some! For the Forge!
Hand the supplies to me when you're done, and don't go doing something stupid to get them!
Soon as something comes in, I'll let you know. Take a breather for now.
I've got good honest work for good honest pay. Helping out Slag Town is just the gravy on the gruel.
Drive them out!
Full volley!
Please tell me you have our supplies. I can't take anymore bad news today.
Goad the beast! It wins or it dies!
I'll spare you the sight of Falkreath burning!
Grovel!
Please! I don't want to die at my ancestors' hands! Cleanse the dead down there!
Wreathed in fire! I reign!
No beast sets foot in the Jarl's hall!
This hall will be your pyre!
No escape from me.
My line is unbroken.
This land knows its master.
The Planisphere should be fully operational within the week, my Lord. Have you thought more on who will maintain it?
What purpose could these creatures hold for the good of Nirn?
There we go. All better. No more need for tears, my little lord.
I'll stand beside you, my friend. Till the end.
I don't wish to say goodbye, but I fear I must. We're worlds apart, you and I.
Let us not think of what it is, but what could be. A more efficient energy source that could power the most complex machines.
Why change yourself, Sil? Why degrade yourself to this cursed appearance? After all, you are one of the few who can resist Azura's curse.
Curse them? Why, we've given them the gift of divine protection.
You're overthinking this. We sneak out, we sneak back in, and no one will ever be the wiser.
Factotums will need a voice. Something consistent but easily replicable. Perhaps something comforting.
Are you content, Lord Sotha Sil? Is there anything I can retrieve for you? A book, perhaps? Something to eat?
You want me to do the impossible, Vivec? I may have power, but even I cannot overcome whatever Dumac has found.
We've cursed them all. They'll be cast out. Disgraced.
Finished already? Hm. That was fast. Well, go on and claim your reward. Then find me later if you want to tackle another assignment.

There hasn't been this much trouble in the Clockwork City since—well, since any time I can remember. That's why I'm grateful you agreed to help.\n\nNow if you could get on with it, I'd feel even better.

The Clockwork Apostles have need of someone with your skills, if you could spare the time. We'll pay you for your efforts. A good rate, if I do say so myself.\n\nAnd Adjunct Daro has spoken highly of you.
I have no task to give you. If you are in need of employment, please seek opportunities elsewhere.
There's more where that came from, you mechanical monstrosity!
Information is the key to success in these tasks! The more knowledge you have, the better off you are.
Here for your well-earned reward?
The Clockwork Apostles have taught me a great deal already! Though I could do without all the sermons ….\n\nDon't tell them I said that though.
More information about your task is available.
I can no longer detect a danger to Clockwork City.
Combat ready individuals are needed to complete an important task.
I detect the Imperfect is no longer functional.
Here we go again.
The corrupted stars aren't currently in the constellation, so the spaces where they should be are dark. Those are the points we need to guide them.
I have hundreds, just like them. All so very eager to meet you.
Your bonds are broken. Make Orryn pay for what he's done!
It's the crystals that bind them to this place!
These reanimations are trivial. Can you keep up?
These crystals are potent, help me break them!
I'll try not to break you too much.
Shed your flesh and the agony will end.
I will purify the corruption!
They seem so tiny now. Insignificant. Like you.
Aren't you going to help your fallen friend?
I'm still here! I won't go!
I can't stop. It never stops. I'm so tired. I can't sleep.
Functions compromised. Reflecting … reflecting ….
By the word of Seht, I am bound to defend these halls.
Always on the lookout for a bit of paper. Once found me a whole journal out in the Radius. Worth its weight in gold, it is. At least to me.
This is no test. Seht has forsaken us.
These hollow shapes cannot love you as we once did. Forgive us, have mercy.
The world is ours for the taking! Why do we languish here?
Brassie—or, well, my brassilisk is doing just fine. I've got him all set up and working again, ready for another adventure in the pipes!

You were in there, weren't you? The Wellspring? Is it as beautiful as they say? All green and lush and vibrant? Maybe someday they'll let me in for a little look around. That would be exciting!\n\nUntil then, I've got wares to sell. Take a look!
If you walk on by, not only will you miss out on an exciting encounter with a buxom young merchant, but you won't get to take advantage of my overly generous nature.
I hope to never come across a glittering Hist in this place. These trees are dead and lifeless … no, more soulless.\n\nTheir bark would make a fetching necklace though, if only I had a prybar.
This gate may serve as a sort of fulcrum for Daedric magic. Data stored for later analysis.
Perception receptors indicate a primitive book of paper and ink somewhere within the confines of the wrecked cottage.
Blood soaked into the ruined stonework marks this as a place of vile worship and sacrifice.
Information here is not only accessible, it's encouraged to be learned! Not hoarded away in musty libraries where only a privileged few can read it.
Quickly, Featherless. The lights! Pull the switch!
Direct hit! Slay the abomination!
Hears-the-Winding is a kind soul, and far too good for those dark elf siblings she spends her days with.
Sotha Sil cares nothing for us. All his wisdom is given to his Apostles. All his concerns are for his machines. Why follow a god who thinks nothing of you?
It is within the Omni-Axle that the fractured creation of Nirn is made whole, for only Sotha Sil knows its shape.
They say Sherizar has taken control of the Wellspring, but how can that be? Before the harvest, she wasn't even an apprentice yet!
I hope Lector Naril selects Sherizar as his new apprentice. She's been working so hard to get him to notice her.
Proctor Teryon is a pretty good sponsor. He teaches me all sorts of things. I mean, I only understand about every other word, but I appreciate the sentiment.
As a lector, it is my responsibility to guide young apostles towards a greater understanding. Not only in a field of their choosing, but also within themselves.

I heard that something terrible happened in the Wellspring? Does that mean the harvest will be delayed? Please, tell me they'll be fresh fruit and vegetables!\n\nIf I have to eat another bowl of flavorless paste, I might just scream!
Is it harvest day? I think it is! Fresh vegetables instead of flavorless paste! Hopefully, this season someone will share their portion of the Wellspring's bounty with old Harkskar.\n\nHopefully ….
Oh, I'd love to chat about whatever it is you want to talk about. But I'm afraid I just don't have time at the moment.
You'd best not give me some strange disease, auxiliary. Who knows what parts of Tamriel you've been rolling around in.
I am still deciding upon a field of study, for there is much to discover in Lord Seht's dominion.
I'm sure House Hlaalu is spending all available resources trying to find my whereabouts. Why, I wouldn't be surprised if a rescue party showed up any day now. Any day ….
Do you seek guidance? Or merely an ear to vent your frustrations? Either way, I have little answers. Silence gives birth to the intrepid mind, after all.
The things I've heard about what happened in the Wellspring, makes the points of my ears curl!\n\nIf even half of it is true, then the Apostles have a lot of explaining to do. A lot of explaining.
I'm a little drunk, so what? It's a special day at the Wellspring, so fetch off!
Anyone mess with you in Slag Town, you just send them my way. I'll sort them out.
First an Outsider, now a Tarnished. Perhaps there will come a day when this one will be merely a Misanir.
We are tarnished, cast away and forgotten. But still, we must get by.
This laboratory once belong to Barilzar, a powerful mage who helped Lord Sotha Sil with his divine experiments. I traveled through the Radius just so I could find out more about that very research.
This useless pile of brass used to be a guard of some sort. Its harmless now, though. Well, mostly harmless.
I will not harm you, citizen.
Too loud! You're being too loud! We need quiet, yes.
I'd offer you food, but we're struggling to get by as it is. I'm sure you can understand that.
Vivi and I are getting by just fine by ourselves, so it's best if you just keep walking.
The colors in Clockwork City are inspiring. Such browns! Such brasses! Such yellows! Quickly, I must get to work before my inspiration is gone!
Don't you have something more important to be doing than gawking?
I wonder how Ma's doing back home ….
May our hearts be calibrated.
Now where did I put my pen ….
By the gears ….
Is this tonight's assignment?
Of all the rude women I've met.
Another one who can't find their place.
Steel and brass, I'm tired!
We'll need to fix that leaking pipe quickly.
May Bright Moons light this one's path.
Shor's bones ….
Brighten your brass with a gleaming new item?
Apostles, Tarnished, it is all the same to this one. Each has something they want, and something they are willing to trade to get it.
I'll never be dealing with that cranked Khajiit again, that's for sure. From here out I'll be trading my salvage to more respectable merchants.
I deal in salvage from all across the Clockwork City. All out of stock at the moment though, I'm afraid.
The Slag Town mayor is better to his people than the high and mighty Clockwork Apostles.
Go buff your brass somewhere else. Zaiba is not impressed.
Sotha Sil once sojourned among the adepts of the Psijic Order. I hope to find some link between this mechanical monstrosity and the island of Psijic monks. I'm certain there's a connection!
Merchandise can be bought for currency!
Edible items can be bought here!
Come purchase our goods, water-tight and everlasting!
Feasts and victories are the reward of clever cutting.
Get away! You aren't wanted! None of us are wanted!
I'm not configured for combat!
Goodbye, apostle.
How can I serve you today, apostle?
More of them! Take heed!
Quickly! Pull them away!
Perhaps I should learn to cook. Now, where's the nutriment dispenser …?
Well, hopefully you've got that out of your system.
Repair protocols successful.
Please discontinue your assault, resident.
Unauthorized execution observed.
Minor larceny perceived.
Alert! Unlawful actions observed.
Larceny has been committed on storage compartment.
Functions compromised. Cease your actions, resident.
You are in violation of Clockwork City law.
You possess insufficient access credentials. Please leave.
Primary functions operational.
Combat sequence operational.
Initiating shields sequence.
Ally sequence activated.
Combat sequence set to full capability.
Testing data acquired. Discontinuing combat.
Hmm, fingers attached to hands, hands attached to arms. No feathers to speak of. Yes, yes, an idea hatches from the egg of ingenuity.\n\nCome back later and perhaps I'll have a task for you.
Murder! Murder, I say!\n\nSorry, sorry. I like to keep the featherless curs guessing. But how goes your search for tributes for the Court?
Back again? So soon? That just won't do!\n\nThe Court has more tributes than it knows what to do with at this point in time. Come back later when our hoard isn't quite as full.

I must confess that the Blackfeather Court's hoard has been depleted of late. Tributes have been few and far between. \n\nWhat do you say, my featherless squire? Care to aid our murder in its time of need?
Who will share in my emptiness?
Gentle night, show me your darkness.
That emptiness felt in your hollow lungs. It is us.
Zero threats registered. Idling.
May Lord Seht bless your labors.
Defense protocols initializing. Reflecting.
May you never malfunction.
I am bound by a god's hand. Yours will not set me free.
Can you feel Red Mountain's judgment? I cannot.
Do not be sad, my friend. There are always additional crates available for purchase!
Ooo.
Fortune favor you, my friend!
Pacrooti really enjoys those small flatbreads baked by the High Elves. They are like tiny, edible plates.
Take your pick of a remaining crate.
Pacrooti is excited you're here! But you're missing the most important thing - a crate! You can purchase them in the store.  Go ahead… Pacrooti will wait.
Hoooo.
This should please you!
Ooo.
Terrific!
Cross your fingers!
You were in such a hurry to get here. Now you hesitate. Pitiful.
Just outstanding!
You'll not find better!
Shall we try again?

The people of Summerset have some strange opinions, but who is this one to complain? As long as they let us do our job, they can hold their noses in the air and imagine their nethers smell sweet. That's what Vahazi thinks about that!

The High Elves aren't so bad. At least, not most of them, anyway. I came to this land with the shirt on my back and a dream of running a profitable stable. Now I have two shirts and a busy stable.\n\nAm I profitable? Depends on you, I suppose.
Pacrooti wishes he had such a treasure!
By Auri-El, how did I end up here?
This way! I'm over here!
Huh. At least we're back together. Come on, this forest has to end somewhere.
There must be some sort of trick to this!
Perhaps we can tie ourselves together? No, that won't do.
Pacrooti enjoys getting free things too.  Maybe you'll give him tomorrow's crate?
Return soon!
Struggle all you like, death gets its way in the end.
See what I have been reduced to?
Bodies caught in the Throat of the World never rot.
Will you hear the scrape of their scales before they strike?
The shalk leaves only cinders and bones in its wake.
The lizard's roar is the cracking of the sky.
The lurcher embraces death every fall and rises anew. It will be no different for you.
These are our chains now.
Helplessness and hopelessness are all we have now.
Release their soul!
No glory in your death.
I won't fall to the likes of you!
Come on, make me feel it!
You still feel?
I definitely still feel boredom.
Watch as hope dies.
You gave a good run!
Command me and I'll use the sword's power!

Listen, nebarra, and listen well. I run an upscale establishment. Even the Proxy Queen graces these halls on occasion. I won't turn you away, but you need to be on your best behavior.\n\nIf you can handle that, then you are welcome here.
Welcome, traveler! It's so good to see a member of the proper progeny grace these halls. We've had so many … others … since the queen's decree.

Riharai came to this land at good Queen Ayrenn's request and has fallen in love with the sky and the sea! Your people have been so kind and accepting, for the most part. Well, a few, at least. Not that this one is complaining.\n\nCare for a sample?

Queen Ayrenn promised we'd fall in love with the sky and the sea! She said that her people would be kind and accepting! This one hasn't heard that many lies since she watched a performance by the House of Reveries!\n\nSorry, sorry. Just feeling down.

You know, some of my best friends are your sort of people. There's what's his name … and the brewer I recently hired. Best friends, one and all.\n\nIs there something in particular I can do for you? Otherwise, my regular customers are waiting.
