I had my fill of Reachman blood when we drove them out of the Empire.
Let these idiots squabble over rocks and dirt. The Ashen Lord has grander plans.
Have you seen the Ashen Lord do battle? We are mere shadows by comparison.
I can still hardly believe the Ashen Lord is a sword-saint. I thought the Ansei were the fanciful legends of my ancestors.
I don't pretend to understand the Ashen Lord's plans, I just trust he knows what he's doing.
Do you ever miss being alive? Hah, me neither.
The sun's not so bad. Reminds me of taking a really hot bath. I used to love those.
Always terrorize your prey before you sink your fangs in, it gives the blood an exquisite taste.
This mortal has my blessing, remove it!
My defense is eternal!
This new host serves me better!
Undisciplined! Ill-restrained!
Creatures of the hunt! To my aid!
All life must die.
[a taunting moo]
He stands defiant against your strikes.
He may have suggested jumping to your death would hurt less.
The Nighthollow shall rise again!
The darkness is mine, you worm!
I'm not done with you yet!
You face the full might of the hunt!
The skies are full of dark clouds lately. I don't like it.
More prayer and less complaints would do all of us some good.
What's all these scratches in the dirt? Some sort of ritual?
The werewolves aren't so bad, but I'm not sure about the vampires.
Sometimes I dream about witch pikes and harrowstorms. Does that mean anything?
You aren't fit to die by this blade.
This is the best you could muster, Verandis?
Rada will be vulnerable here!
Stay away from that magic!
Can you feel Coldharbour clutching at your heart?
Ugh! How? How can you turn the Dark Heart against me?
A few more should do the trick! Don't let up!
I am about to summon the soul trap! Get ready!
Hahaha! Sometimes this power almost feels worth the price I paid.
Your death will bring me great pleasure.
[annoyed Goblin groaning that he has to fight]
[appreciative Goblin submissively thanking someone]
[mad laughing Goblin attacking player]
[Goblin gibberish bragging about the size of her sword]
[Goblin shouting to allies to get behind him]
[pitiful Goblin whining about how he's sick]
[wail of Goblin anger at being interrupted by attacking player]
[haughty Goblin taunting the player before an attack]
You! Stand and fight!
Think you can grant me a good death, worm?
Will you not stand and fight?
Do not deny me a good death!
Maybe I was wrong about you!
Such abundance, such decadence, such … aroma!
Oof! Stinky, stinky! Just like you like it!
Another banquet for King Boar!
You won't get away that easily!
I've seen neither hide nor hair of the ard's Stonehands for weeks now. Cowards.
Today we hunt. Tonight we feast!
Let the clans march together, I say. Just like in the Black Drake's day.
The folk out here are tougher than any hiding in a stone city, for certain. I help as I can to raise coin for them.
What did I miss?
No remorse!
The day is ours!
A little gloom is nothing to fear, but I'll pray for a bit of sunshine all the same.
I'd welcome trouble right about now. Tusking bored out of my gourd here.
Ah! Such foul magic!
Not another step closer witch!
Get up and start being productive!
Here! I found some conductive oil!
My flames will light that up if you can plod over by me.
Take my power so you may stand against him!
Flies come to get swatted!
The initiates require much more training.
All things must end!
Both a beginning and an end that we bring about.
Scatter, bugs!
Ha! Wrong move!
Too close for comfort!
Let me fix this!
No! We have too far to go!
All that is created must eventually be destroyed and then renewed. The cycle is unbroken.
Who comes now for pain?
I wish we could just get this over with already.
Come! Show me your best!
I love how the screams echo through these caves.
You forfeit your lives for nothing!
The crying truly grows tiresome, don't you agree?
Doooo doo doo doo dootidoodoo DOOOOOO! His Hamminess, King Boar!
Go get'em Prince! For the King!
Announcing the arrival of the lord's lardiest lad, Prince Boar!
Alas, who will dispose of all the kingdom's refuse now? You, heroes, your mushy spoils.
Some ask me why I do not make slurry, or pies, or haggis. My name is not Makes-Many-Pies, is it? Soups come in many different flavors, and none of them are boring.

If you find a bone in a bowl of soup, consider yourself lucky. It is better to find it in the bowl than lodged deep inside your throat.\n\nBones add flavor, but I usually fish them out before serving. Usually.

Celebrations like the Anniversary Jubilee inspire me. Seeing others enjoy food makes me happy, but they should be eating soup! I have already created six new recipes. Would you like to hear me list all the ingredients?\n\nHmm. Another time perhaps.

The secret to being an expert provisioner and cook? Never let your cooking burn. Most other mistakes can be corrected, but a scalded soup just tastes bad.\n\nNot that I've ever burned a soup. Never happened.
You cook with a golden spoon, don't you, provisioner? You use only the freshest ingredients, the finest cuts of meat, the most delicate spices. But have you ever cooked with snail slime?\n\nNo? Pity.

I've been reading about your so-called Emperor Reman and his ambition to conquer the world. A very admirable trait in a mortal, and highly unusual.\n\nCould you introduce us? You mortals all do know each other, correct?

Ah, little mortal, so good to see you again!\n\nYou have helped me in the past, however insignificantly, and despite your lowly status as a creature of flesh and blood, I more or less appreciate your efforts.

Secrets. We seem destined to drown in enigmas and mysteries! The Daedric Princes have a fondness for them, as do so many of your fellow mortals. But the secrets of Emperor Leovic, they vex me. I will unravel them.\n\nYou may help too, I suppose.

I joined the Order of the Waking Flame because I wanted to be a revolutionary. With the Empire falling apart, what's the harm in trying something new?\n\nDon't worry. I quit the cult and am looking for something else now. Maybe the Dark Brotherhood!

Have you read Caecilius Bursio? Great truths are written in the stars, he says. I was born under the sign of the Steed, and everything he writes about such people describes me precisely!\n\nExcept impatience. I have no time for that sort of nonsense.

I'm afraid for my safety. The Order of the Waking Flame doesn't tolerate apostates. They have a very special ritual they reserve specifically for so-called backsliders. It's called … the Dagon Slap.\n\nBelieve me, it's a lot worse than it sounds.

Tell me about this thing called sleep. Do you really spend a part of every day unconscious and performing absolutely no useful function whatsoever? It sounds so inefficient and boring.\n\nWhy does your overseer permit such lackadaisical behavior?

I might have need of you in about four hundred and thirty-three of your years. It's a minor scheme that I have been working on, but you would be perfect for it, and of course I would reward you. Do you think you could avoid dying until then?
Not close enough. Go again. Faster.
This will only work if you can lead my cold fire to an active power module.
You shall not interrupt our work!
These potions take forever to blend. But they pack a punch.
Look who wandered in.
Never could I dream of such gifts as these.

Snake? No … frog! Sorry. I was just coming up with another prank idea. The perfect prank should be disruptive and shocking, but not terrifying, or damaging. Even better if it's tailored to the person.\n\nIt's a delicate balance, you know.
Excellent. Looks like that got their attention.
I hoped to see you again soon and here you are. I assume you completed your task successfully?
I wish I could offer you some guidance on the task at hand, but aside from what I have already told you, I know little else. Good luck to you!
There are many people in Leyawiin who need help. I have a job for you, if you are interested.
I apologize, I do not have anything new for you. I will speak to my friends around Leyawiin and have more work for you soon, I promise.
How did you fare?
You've got a job. Go on, get out there.

We seek brave, skilled warriors. Does that describe you, or should we keep looking? \n\nLeyawiin's Chamber of Legates authorized me to reward those who prove their worth, if that influences your answer.
I love your enthusiasm, but I don't have anything else for you at this moment. Never fear—something will come up soon.
I'm looking right at the fluid you need to pick up. Go for it!
Not time for a nap, friend!
I'll need more arrows for this!
Another spicy salamander!
Get up and dust that one off!
Oh, he's not so big! I mean, yes, he is big. Huge. But you can take him!
No one could see this shot coming!
This might sting a bit!
I hate wasting expensive arrows on the likes of you!
Going to turn it into a pin cushion!
Not what I wished for, mortals.
Aww, I lugged all this garbage here for nothing!
Beautiful town, Leyawiin. Not nearly as exquisite as Alinor, but far less … breakable.\n\nAhem. Anyway, care to see what I have in stock?
I sometimes miss the heat of Hammerfell. It's just one of the reasons I treasure the warmth of the forge.\n\nYou cherish it too, don't you? Come, show me.
I served my time in the Three Banners War, but one can only make so many catapults, you know?\n\nHere in Leyawiin, we can carve whatever we choose!
A test of your limits to determine your worth.
Could you be my freedom?
You know, I once lived in an abandoned Hagraven's cave … till I realized it wasn't abandoned. Ha!\n\nSay what you want about them, but those feathers have style!
Amateurs.
Fancy a game of Nine Shells? No, no, you're much too busy.\n\nIt's runes you're after, isn't it? Well, take a look.
You like fruits and vegetables, right? Yeah, who doesn't love just … you know, taking a big bite out of a radish? Mmm! Scrumptious.
We can drain Vandacia's power. Just give the order.
Armor's met the business end of more than a few swords, eh? Here, let's find you a replacement.
Don't let anyone fool you into thinking my attempts at sweet roll mead have gone too far.\n\nI'll get it right some day. Just watch!
You are hungry, yes? This is no surprise to Ra'dru! This one would rather eat chalk than the mush these people call food.\n\nCome, see what I have for you!
Here to listen to Audania sing? Best get to it while you can. She's going places, that one.\n\nHow about you? Going or staying?
Did you know that Sai Sahan himself liberated this town from the Longhouse loyalists? What a hero. What a beard!\n\nIf you're trying to live up to his legend, perhaps my armor might help.
Have a care where you step. We're still housetraining Scritches, here.\n\nBut, hey, after you check your boots, have a look at my wares!
Fine fabrics, tight seams, and precise measurements … these are the tools of a true artist.\n\nIf you mean to stay light on your feet, you'll need what I provide.
If you're in the market for a new weapon, you're talking to the right Orc.\n\nThis city could use a few well-armed wanderers. Trust me.
Cold blooded murder doesn't take courage. It's the act of a coward.
We don't need to be confident to get started. We need to get started to be confident.
Trees grow slowly in Blackwood, but we are richly rewarded for our patience.\n\nLook at this one's fine wares! The best woodwork in all of Cyrodiil!
Been in Leyawiin long? I wouldn't stay too long. That Three Banners business will land on our doorstep any day now.\n\nBut enough of that. What can I do for you?
Why are they attacking us?
You're unstoppable!
Take it from me, oak is so five-seventies. Once I learned that High King Emeric favors cherrywood furniture … hand to the Divines, I never looked back.
Axes and armor may earn you a fortune, but without prudent investments, you'll spend it all in a day! \n\nPlace your goods and coin in our capable hands.
Let me apologize for my besotted colleague. Tasting is not the same as drinking!\n\nNow. How can I help you?
I like places where things have happened, even if they were sad things.
The Argonian way is to do more with less. Believe me when I say that bag is … very Argonian.\n\nWhy not stretch a little?
The trick to cinches is to tighten, then wait a bit. Ha! I'm full of tips like that.\n\nYou looking for a lesson, or just here to inspect the horseflesh?
We're not going to die for Mehrunes Dagon!
Leyawiin needs what the Guild provides, and there's gold enough for all of us.\n\nNeed suggestions on what to do with that coin? Take a look.
You're here for arcane goods, right? I've many to spare for the well-read warrior.\n\nBehold!
Joy is the seed of great deeds, walker.\n\nHow may I bring some to your day? Some shiny soul gems, perhaps?
You looking for great goods at a fair price? Well, I'm looking for discerning but wealthy customers. It's like it's meant to be!
Shame they wouldn't let me have a go at picking off more of those feckless shell-scales. I was just starting to enjoy myself.
Oh? A challenge!
<low rumbling growl>
Xalvakka is only the first. Soon our lord's power shall cover the land!
There is nowhere to run, small mortals. Face your death with courage.
<long satisfied grunt>
Feed, great Xalvakka! Drink deep!
My forces shall enter your world and wipe out all you know.
Got plenty of items for today's adventurer! Trust me, I know what I'm talking about.\n\nReally, I do!
Gaze upon my wares, weary traveler! All the riches of Cyrodiil and beyond rest in this … luxurious cart!
This one is not a mind-reader, but she is a keen observer of Tamriel's people.\n\nYou mean to make a purchase, yes? Ha! You see? I knew it!
You know the best thing about Leyawiin—other than that shapely countess, I mean? Its streets are packed with discerning customers like you!
My employer says no loafing. Loafing! Can you believe that? This isn't loafing. This is low-pressure sales. Relaxing, right?
Leyawiin's quite beautiful, isn't it? Stable, lasting, steadfast and true. Unlike certain capricious bards I know!\n\nEnough of that. Where to, my friend?
You can't evade my traps forever.
Do you place so little value on life?
Drown beneath the flames!
Is now the time? Will you be the ones?
Attack!
Top marks!
Protect yourself!
Use your heaviest attack!
You're a natural!
Prepare yourself!
Swiftly, now! Interrupt it!
Strike hard now!
That was quite a blow!
Your gold looks better in our vaults than traded for some frilly foot-coverings. Bear in mind, the greatest treasure of all is frugality!
Deals and bargains! Bargains and deals! No better trades anywhere, I guarantee it!
Now Stibbo serves the tea.
I need healing!
I love cities—the rude people, the noise, the chaos. Is it strange that I find it comfortable?
Did you need something?
I got them, you want them! Fresh bilge grubs for sale!
Who says you can't get something for nothing?
I wonder what this place was. It doesn't look Dwarven.
We earned what we have here!
Fantastic. Another life-threatening experience. Just my luck.
Someone, help me please! I only know defensive spells!
Why can't I be ambushed by competent creatures? That'd be so much less embarrassing.
Well, that was more excitement then I planned on having today.
The safest vault is the one you cannot find, yes? Unless you are soft-headed and forgetful.\n\nHenadi is neither! Promise!
Stibbo am coming!
Stibbo no like water.
Stibbo no follow.
You know, the life of a merchant can be pretty adventuresome too! Just yesterday, I got a parchment cut the size of a …. Oh never mind.
How can mortals hope to stand against us?
Did I ever tell you that I once found Quistley in a brothel, with his leg manacled to a bed? I didn't enjoy explaining that one to his parents.
I always get my cut.
It's stopped feeding on their soul. Let's do the same to the rest.
Your death will be slow and agonizing!
Eat your fill.
Better not be any blood on these. The laundering thing is a metaphor, all right?\n\nCome on. Let's see what you've got.
Kneel, worm!
Plenty of scheming going on down here, friend. We're up to our eyeballs in schemes!\n\nSpeaking of schemes, let's see the fruits of yours, eh?
If you're looking for arms and armor, you'll have to go topside. The rabbit, uh … the rabbit won't let me sell those anymore.
Looking to trade? I have a good selection. Gideon sees a good deal of commerce from day to day.
Have you heard the vossa-satl player? She buys my potions sometimes. Thirsty work, that music stuff.
The Ivory Brigade? Pfft. Nothing but a pack of gulls in peacock feathers.\n\nI'm from Summerset. Believe me, I know the type. First sign of trouble, they'll scatter like roaches. Just watch.
All sorts of mounts come through Gideon. I stable even the most unique, and I sell a few of the more common ones, if you're interested.
Now I know dangers threaten even the safest clutches, so I am determined to stay here and serve.\n\nPerhaps I can help you today?
I'm tired of moving around. We should stay here for a while.

It feels odd not to have a place to offer you if you need rest. But then, much is odd about Stonewastes right now. My own potions saved my hide.\n\nI have more for sale. Hopefully the funds can help us rebuild.
What do you think they'll cook up for us tonight?
I'm anxious to find Clairene, but I'm also terribly anxious about meeting her. Maybe that's normal when you learn you have surviving family all of a sudden.
Once the rituals are complete, the darkness can flood through.
Destruction will cleanse them.
Flesh and bone, muscle and sinew! Fight for me!
I will feed your souls to Xalvakka myself!
I don't feel so good. Whatever they're putting in our food, it isn't sitting well with my stomach.
Our last supply run, bungled. Yesterday's dark ritual, bungled. If I didn't love what I do, I'd just kill everyone in their sleep and leave.
I wish the nightblades wouldn't brew poisons in the same kitchen where the cooks prepare our meals.
Sometimes I hear whispers when no one is there. I think Sithis is speaking to me, telling me to forget the cares of this world.
Our last supply run, bungled. Yesterday's dark ritual, bungled. If I didn't love what I do, I'd just kill everyone in their sleep and leave.
You trophy soon! Xeemhok swears it!
I once saw a rather large rabbit being chased by an even larger frog. Stone cold sober, I was, too.\n\nStill am. You have to be if you're selling wares on the road.
Today is the day the Master foresaw!
I have sworn to take nine lives this day …
This is more resistance than I expected.
Some mortal got his blood on my robes.
For my prince and lord! For Mehrunes Dagon!
Damn. I'm completely turned around here.
Long have I looked forward to this day.
Be vigilant! Two of the Ambitions remain free.
The Prince knows his true servants. You will see.
We will kill them all!
Fall, lesser beings! There is no place for you in the new world!
A new dawn breaks! Die!
I am baptized in blood and fear! You cannot kill us all!
The Dark Brotherhood will make you answer for this!
I pick up my wares in Gideon and sell them before returning home to Stonewastes. Care to look?
The Nibenese and Argonians might claim these lands, but by the blessings of the Moons, only the Khajiit can truly live upon this soil.\n\nAnd with those same blessings, shall we haggle over prices?
You'd think you'd see more Baandari out this way, but they seem to be avoiding something for now.\n\nNow, what'll it be? Buying or selling? Or do you need a room?
Prepare yourself fully before entering battle, combatant. You want every advantage you can take before facing other teams. My gear might also help.
Have you ever tried this field brew? I've been up for three days straight. Astounding stuff. I'm selling it. Come give it a try!
Need to lighten your load before your next competition? I'll help out with that. Pretty sure I'll find buyers over in Leyawiin—they usually have more coin than they know what to do with.
Go show those softies over in Leyawiin that you're tough. Stick a standard or tapestry up in your combat trophies exhibit. You have one of those, yeah? If not, start today!

I'm told that I shouldn't let Daedric Princes inspire my food creations, but the possibilities are too tempting! Mehrunes Dagon and spice go hand in hand!\n\nHmm, I wonder if I should char the meat or serve it as bloody as possible.
Unless you are a rat catcher or wealthy merchant here to sweep me off my feet, we have nothing to talk about.
Maybe I should start robbing fresh graves … I'm already surrounded by flies.\n\nThough, with the luck I'm having, I'll probably end up getting chased by a draugr.
On nights when I sleep with the ball near my head, I dream of unsettling things I can't quite remember. But if I don't sleep with it, I'm extremely clumsy the next day!
Soon, it will be time for a swim, I think. Just a few barrels more.

Sai Sahan liberated Leyawiin years ago. It's such a magnificent story, though it varies depending on who you ask.\n\nMost here will tell you it was a glorious thing … just one man cutting his way through two armies.

One of the women in that house there is writing a history of the Longhouse Emperors. She likes to read parts of it aloud every morning with her windows open.\n\nNot much of a reader myself, but that Leovic character sounds like a real horse's arse.
It's time to put an end to your meddling!
Are you ready to die?
You'll suffer for disrupting our plans!
This one came from Elsweyr recently. The stories of Dragons seem fanciful, yet Dezirri is assured they are true.

Leyawiin's a fine place to live if you don't mind a bit of palm-greasing. If you do, just expect things to take a bit longer to accomplish.\n\nI've learned a lot about patience in the past few decades.
Destruction is the natural order.
Take their heads! Eat their tongues!
I've seen some come back from the Three Banners War victorious. But some don't come back at all. May the latter feast well in Sovngarde.

The locals are always so concerned with status and appearances. \n\nI heard them talking about an unmarried older gentleman, saying how odd it was. The man is a friend, and I happen to know he's simply not interested in a partner. Nothing odd about it.
Sample the concoction, let the chaos sing within you.
Slow, too slow!
My blood is aflame. Death, fire, chaos.
The plant sings in red.
I've little time for talk.
Their fragile hands bleed.
Spineless fools.
They will not eat until they finish the work.
There are six more at our disposal. Let us put them to work.
They broke their arms in the struggle. We will need replacements.
I enjoy listening to their screams. The plants love the sound.
I disposed of three bodies. They were unfit to tend to our needs.
Harvest the most recent growths. It is time.
Hope is an illusion. Grace never existed. Ideals never come to pass.\n\nWe exist only to further another's plans.
Pain is both a gift and a promise.
Call forth the fires, summon the floods!
Did the emperor send you? It has been so long.
We were sent here for a purpose. Stay alert.
We serve the emperor and have never wavered in our duty.
First one to the prize gets the glory!
I will find what the master seeks.
Nothing burns brighter than the master's flames.

I'm not moving from this room until I'm too drunk to speak or someone offers me honest work.\n\nAnd while I can drink most anyone under the table, I bet I end up insensible before work lands in my lap.
I will crush you like those spiders!
Attack, churls! Attack!

I'm looking into how Zenithar ended up having a chapel here, and it involves the Mace of the Crusader and a master builder named Kaladas, whom we now call Saint Kaladas.\n\nIt didn't involve eternal unpaid toil, though some priests might tell you that.
Tell me, are we running to something, or from something?
I reckon I can handle anything that comes at me on the road with good manners, common sense, and a full wineskin.

I've had no fewer than three wives and four husbands. Most were lost in the Three Banners War, but my late wife died trying to rescue some foolish scholar.\n\nFarming might not be glorious work, but it's safer, for certain.
What's the green stuff between a Dragon's toes? Slow Goblins.
I am a flood, drowning you in blood and pain!
The Nibenese might be a hedonistic lot, but they do know how to make a person feel welcome.
You should head over to the inn and listen to the bard there. Her voice … it's so delightful. And her fingers caress her instrument with a tenderness that feels lacking in our harsh world.
Some insufferable colleagues tell me that my punctilious nature makes me unapproachable. Unapproachable! Me!  Can you believe that?\n\nDon't bother answering. We both know it's absurd.

This inn is my favorite spot in Leyawiin. Not only can I enjoy a tasty beverage or two, but I can listen to others and seek to understand their viewpoints.\n\nIf only more Nibenese chose to listen instead of demand.
Some come here looking for news of work. I unfortunately have nothing to offer, but others around Leyawiin just might. Keep your ears open and your hands ready.
I'm told that my skills would be of great use in the Three Banners War, but I don't care to contribute. I lost a sister to that war, and it would kill my father to lose another child to it so soon.

One day I'll return to Morrowind to bring my kinsmen Zenithar's good news.\n\nWhile I rest here in the Divines' embrace, my brothers and sisters quarrel under the watchful eyes of Daedra and selfish living gods. They must see there's a better way!
Destruction is inevitable and so is our victory.
Chase you down, small ones!

I'm sure there are many who wish to wield the Mace of the Crusader, but I could care less about the responsibility attached to such an honor. \n\nI'd rather live my carefree life here in Leyawiin, and pay others to handle things.
What are you doing? Have you no decency?
My haj mota will tear you apart!

Have you seen Legate Tbeza-ko? She's so kind, and powerful … and beautiful. I keep trying to come up with some reason to speak with her but every time I try to approach her, I panic. \n\nIt's just as well. She's too good for me.
Succumb to my lord's burning flame!
You will die for that. I will make your last moments agony.
Be cleansed by the fire!
Die, intruder!
Arrivals from the other side! Attack!
You were doomed from the start.
Rest in peace, brave friend.
Don't mind me. I'm just loitering, like you. Funny that.
I'm wounded! I need some help!
Your body will feed the Harrada.
I see. So you desire to die in agony?
Spawn of chaos, destroy them!
Out of my way!
Your blood will make rivers.

I often wonder how notes end up in strange places like Dwemer ruins, or infested caves. Who leaves a shopping list in a Daedric shrine, for instance? \n\nI keep my journal tightly bound to my person to prevent losing them.
You need healing!
I'm with you. What do you need?
All right, all right. What is it?
Is everything all right?
I think it's going well. Don't you?
I love the life of an adventurer, but I also find joy in simple things. Playing my flute. Reading a good book. I'm fascinated by history and magecraft. But I also love a good tale, well spun.
Haven't you given me enough bad advice to ignore?
Always good to change things up from time to time.
I never walk away from a challenge.
This is a completely normal stroll through the streets.
Is your every thought dedicated to a god? It should be! Everyone's should be!
If you need anything, the Ivory Brigade will be able to help. They're quite busy, but they genuinely care about the citizens of Leyawiin.

The Fighter's Guild found a nest of smugglers in a hidden cellar a while back. We've since filled in that cellar, which I understand some people aren't happy about. \n\nBut places like that tend to attract criminal activity. It's better this way.
I find it interesting that the priests dedicated to Zenithar can drink the others under the table. That's true dedication! They've earned my respect.
I wouldn't boast any reverence for the Daedric Princes here. People here still remember the Longhouse loyalists, and how they suffered beneath their rule.

The Fighters Guild here likes to prank newcomers. They got me when they sent me out to gather spittle from a creature that doesn't exist.\n\nOf course, I did not know that. I spent the better part of two days waist deep in the swamp for my foolishness.

Keep an eye on the Mages Guild. They research some odd things. Personally, I think they look too deeply into matters that would be better left alone.\n\nDon't get roped into their excitement. It might not end well for you.
The food in Leyawiin would be better if they served it with maggots. There is too little substance in the fare here.
A haunting melody whispers to me through my dreams. I feel as if something is trying to warn me … there's trouble on the horizon.

I've visited other cities where people seem to worship at the altar of busy, as I call it. People there seem unhappy and tired all the time.\n\nPerhaps, thanks to the influence of Zenithar, we have a healthy balance of work and play here in Leyawiin.

My father was a builder. He spent the better part of a year on a bridge, only to watch soldiers tear it down before it could even be used.\n\nIt broke his heart, but also taught him a valuable lesson … nothing is permanent.
I wish I'd been around during Sai Sahan's liberation of the city. Skewering these straw targets is all well and good, but piercing the eye of some Reach savage? Now that's a real thrill!
Sometimes even the most hardened of warriors needs to spend time catching butterflies.\n\nMyself included.
Someone stole my favorite belt. Can you believe that? Seems to me the people around here should learn a lesson in good citizenship!
Disaster stands upon our threshold, walker. The others do not see it. But I do.

I can't overstate the importance of curiosity. The world around us is constantly changing, and not always for the better. Hope can get you through some bad spots, but asking yourself what comes next vanquishes fear.

Before I begin working on any instrument, I spend time meditating and asking for Dibella's blessing. I feel strongly connected to her here in Gideon. \n\nAnd the Argonians here always seem interested in my work, so that's encouraging.

Take it from me, you don't want to mess around with slaughterfish. If you happen to snag one while fishing, that's one thing, but don't go out of your way to catch one. Unless you're not precious about your fingers.
I might disagree with someone, but that doesn't mean I stop treating them with basic decency and respect.\n\nNow, if they come at me with the intent to kill, I'll respond in kind. Don't forget that.
The remnants of the Kothringi around here unsettle me. They died so quickly from that flu … perhaps that's why their spirits linger in Gideon.
Have you noticed Gideon's walls? This place was once a fortress city. Hard to believe. We wouldn't withstand a siege these days.
Have you lost a boot in the marshes yet? It's more common than you might think.

I tend to try and guess at people's intentions when I'm in a new place. It's useful to determine whether or not someone's trustworthy. You get a sense for these things when you work for the Ivory Brigade … but now I'm here. Things are different.
Together now!
You know, a few years ago I would have stormed off and left you to look after your own messes. I guess I've grown.
A merchant came through with a cat who birthed kittens not long ago.\n\nI wove a special basket just for them. I felt joy doing so.

Some Baandari came through a few months ago. I helped fix their wagon wheel, using up parts we had around. We asked for nothing in return.\n\nThose nights they stayed, they gifted each of us with a tale. That was a wondrous time.
Let's make a deal. Don't ignore my concerns, and I won't badger you about your decisions. Agreed?
The less we say to each other right now, the better.
I trust you. There aren't many people I would say that about.
You don't often find a traveling companion you can trust your life to. I'm glad we met.
We make a great team, and I trust you with my life. What more is there to say?
I'm glad we met. Together, there's no challenge we can't overcome and no foe we can't defeat.
Be wary of the large frogs around here, beeko. They, too, are not doing well given recent events, and their temperament leads them to attack any not of their kind.
Good! Remember how you did that!
One of the greatest laws of magic is sympathy. The greater the sympathetic link between two objects, the more they influence each other. I find that … comforting.
I never thought to lay eyes on this place. In truth, I wasn't even sure it existed!
For some people, coin is everything. I personally find that abhorrent. I've seen the impact of coin-hungry folk on those with no power.\n\nIt's appalling.

I vastly prefer the discipline of the military over the hedonism of the rich.\n\nGiven my experiences with both, I find that even the most decorated soldier possesses more empathy in their little toe than the most empathetic wealthy person.
Try to run! Just try!
Fall! Fall! You all will go down!
I'd leave to go eat with my friend over there, but this lady would just follow me. She's worse than a burrowing burr!\n\nI just can't do that to any of my friends.
After living in Gideon for a few months, I find it refreshing to be back home. I do not understand the proclivity of others to trap themselves in stone structures.
We noticed that the animals in this area were moving toward Hutan-Tzel. That's not normal.\n\nAs a result, our guard is up and then some.
Gideon feels more and more like an artist commune to me, which I quite like. Waking up to mist drifting amid ruins and hearing strains of stray music makes for quite a haunting memory.
Now! We need to complete the ritual!
My flames will shield you, brothers.
With my death … be healed!
Hey, partner?
Oh wow, look at you! You're so big!
First we take this region, then we march north.
My preference is when they scream.
Trespassers! My blood will rot your flesh.
The very air of this realm will destroy you!
Impressive. For a sack of mortal meat.
Why don't you just die already?
Oh, don't give up now. I want to crush you personally.
You survived? And you destroyed our device? Inconceivable!
Intruders …. Intruders everywhere!
I knew that if I waited here long enough, I'd find you!
Gaze into my eye and welcome the end.

One traveler asked many questions. I answered them as best I could, but he grew frustrated. Claimed I was being purposefully ambiguous.\n\nI told him I was being truthful. It is not my issue if he feels uncomfortable with ambiguity.
Death and chaos, we bow to your power!
Protect the castle! No one gets through!
Even people around here seem to like to chat regularly.\n\nI have no time for that nonsense. Too much work to do. I plan to make this one of the most successful farms within weeks of here.
The performers nearby remind me of my travels. The urge to learn any songs they know is strong still, yet I fulfilled my duty to the Hist in that regard years ago.
FFFFfphhhhlech. So gross!
Definitely should have seen that coming. Thanks for the rescue. No idea how I woulda gotten out of there.
The mix of Imperial, Khajiit, and Argonian I found when I arrived in this area made me think I'd have easy enough competition out here, but instead I'm finding teams worthy of my skills.
The wines of Leyawiin are worthy to use as toasts to the victories of my team.\n\nGo, Fire Drakes!
I hear some of the wild celebrations happening over in Leyawiin proper.\n\nThose folk are extremely dedicated to their festivities. I can respect that.
I might have too many lusty scenes in this current story. I'm worried about the pacing.\n\nEh, I'll let my copy reader decide. It's easy enough to cut out the one with the three warriors.

Perhaps I was too attached to my tribe. To my Hist. I cannot describe the loss I felt at first when I lost them all.\n\nMaybe my current purpose is to learn to be myself, alone? Or maybe being attached to a purpose is also problematic.
Put the best archer on sentry duty? Psssh. Our leadership is fit to be worm food.
Come to volunteer?
I don't see why the sacrifices always complain. We all die eventually, at least their ends serve a purpose.
If you behave, I'll make sure your end comes quickly.
I don't care what happens when our lord makes his appearance, I just want him to be here.
Aww look at you, a fierce adventurer come to stop us!

When you spend this much time fishing, you pick up a few things. The rhythm of the sounds around you warns you of impending danger if you pay attention.\n\nThat is how I knew to avoid a group of Nocturnal cultists recently.
If they didn't serve a purpose, I would crush all those weaklings under my heel and dance in the sound of their screams.
Burn in the fires of the Deadlands!
Neiweet asked me about when I was gonna settle down, again. She's never going to get it.
Do you think you're brave coming here?
The world is in motion, move with it.
You do not frighten me.
The witless creeping crawling beasts bow their spines to our whims.
Crush 'em!
They follow Bahsei's orders so well, but will they drink the tea I make for them?
Dagon deliver us.
The next fool to bother me will be used for target practice.
I'll riddle your armor with holes.
Bahsei is the one with plans. I just want to watch the fires.
This is my kill.
The sacrifices should save their sniveling for someone who cares, Lord Dagon shows no mercy and neither do we.
A sacrifice with strength and will? Xalvakka will enjoy you.
I don't know how you got passed everyone else, but you won't get passed me.
Stay here. Wait. Wait for what? Scales to fall off?
Been waiting for a good fight.
Nothing is sure, which is why our lord will rise. He cannot be stopped and neither will my bloodlust. I just wish he would get on with it already. All this planning is making my scales chafe.
I'll tear you to pieces.
This place would be a lot more interesting if we all didn't have the same goal.
Weren't you taught not to meddle in the affairs of others?
The next sacrifice I see will get descaled like a fish, always wanted to see what that'd look like.
Oh, did that hurt?
Muck and slate, ugh. My claws long to dig scratches into scorching rock.
Ha. You think you can stop Dagon?
I've felt his might myself. When the earth shook and Dagon spoke to me …  I'd never felt anything like it before. It was pure power. True power. The power of a Prince.
I'll spare you the sight of what will come next.
Hope someone has planned something else for us to eat. If it's overcooked meat again tonight I will not be responsible for my actions.
This kill is mine.
Bahsei's plans have never let us down. She's the commander we never knew we were lacking for all those years.
How many blows can you stand?
If that Harvester takes any more time with those souls, I am going to start adding the scaled insects to the feast. Maybe that'll speed this up.
Your chances of survival are as small as you.
Hope these mortals like the view of the Deadlands. It's the only view they'll ever see.
Attack me in my own homeland? Can you be less of an idiot?
Psh. Mortals. Predictable as always.
Nothing feels better than restoring a stranger's faith in the goodness of others.
Zahsbi sees you have questions.\n\nWho will be your true love? What will be your demise? Will those questions have the same answer? This one could tell you. For some coin, of course.
The worth of a book is measured by what you carry away from it.
Unfamiliar magic is like drinking strange wine. Eventually there will be a price to pay.
Love and imagination are the only magical powers that everyone possesses. If you can cultivate those, consider yourself a magician.
Do you sense something?
Bandits should play to their strengths and go into politics. They'd live longer.
Daedric-worshiping murderers really make my blood boil. Is there no end to their wickedness?
People boast about how good stinky cheese is. Why would you want to eat something that turns your stomach at the first whiff?
Bullies are cowards who can only feel better about themselves by making others feel worse.
You're nothing but a common thief!
We're free to make our own choices, but we aren't free from their consequences.
Enough is enough!
Care for a tune?
Why is it my hands always seem to be cold?
I've always wanted to be an artist. I guess you have to draw the line somewhere.
Life's too short to read books you don't love.
I smell magic!
I wonder how long this rain will last?
Even an old sack might have treasure inside.
Hard work pays off. Nobody ever drowned in sweat.
Did you think I would just let you save him without a fight?
There's something admirable about refusing to give up!
Learning a new weapon is a trial by fire. But it takes fire to make steel, doesn't it?
That's it, partner! Give them everything you've got!
They've got you!
Come on! Get out of there!
Pull yourself together!
Your pet didn't make it!
We've faced worse than you, monster!
That was a fight for the ages.
Life isn't a fairy tale. But sometimes villains get what they deserve anyway.
You're a lifesaver.
It's good to work with others from time to time.
I don't fear dark places so much as the things that lurk in them.
The gates of Oblivion stand open!
There's always something new to learn.
Right behind you, partner.
You're full of surprises.
You can judge someone's true character by the way they treat their pets.
This little fellow makes me smile.
That's a good look for you.
All right! Where are we going?
This is a great area for harvesting.
You've got a knack for stumbling across those things.
Your time on this plane has ended, spirit. The Far Shores call you. Go from this place and never return.
Grandmother? How did you get out here? You should be in your grave!
You called?
I don't want to hurt you, but now I'm going to!
You know, I like to think I'm agreeable.
Nobody deserves to die like that!
It we're just going to wait around, let's play a game or something.
I bet this place is full of interesting history. I should try looking it up later.
I won't tell the Ordinators if you won't.
So fetching petty. And cruel!
Don't leave me behind!
I can't wait to take a load off at the inn.
Change of plans?
Another find? I hope it's something interesting!
I bet the stable masters love taking care of that one.
I do love seeing so much of Tamriel. I wish less of it was trying to kill me, but at least it makes life interesting.
Help! Someone help us!
I can't hold out much longer!
Potion! Don't forget your health potions!
Found something interesting to share?
Yes, s'wit?
All right, sure.
So that's what the pensive look was about. Nothing serious I hope.
I can't stand Goblins. Or snakes. Or boats. They all make me want to retch, for different reasons. The less we deal with any of them, the better.
Work with me here!
If you're afraid I'm going to let you die. I've thought about it. But unlike you, I'm not a rotten s'wit, so don't worry and don't bother me.

I agreed to tag along on your adventures, but I wish you'd leave me out of some of the stuff you get up to. My mom doesn't like me associating with the wrong crowd and you're looking more and more like it.
My family taught me a lot of patience. You're starting to test it.\n\nI do want this arrangement to work out. There are just some things you keep doing that get under my skin.
We've already been through more together than most people I've known. Feels like I've known you forever. Not tired of you yet though.
You make me laugh, you make me think, and I miss you when you're not around. If that's not friendship, what is?
You're the best companion a girl could ask for. With as much time as we spend together I'm surprised you're not sick of me. Glad too. Life wasn't half as fun before I met you.
You're more than just an adventuring partner. You're my best friend. I'm so happy I met you, even if the circumstances were awful.
Keep them on the backfoot!
Another day, another dolmen, eh?
I wonder why Lord Seht made so many creations that imitate life? Because he could? To better understand them? You'd probably just walk up and ask.
See, if I'd taken up trade like my little sister, the most interesting places I'd visit would be banks.
I like reading too, you know. If you ever need an excuse to get me something.
Well, what did he say? Some inscrutable wisdom beyond mortal comprehension?
Gods, the smell! I'd rather fight bog blights.
You'll take anything that isn't tied down, won't you?
That's it! I'm done. You can finish this yourself.
I miss roasting pupal scribs over a fire. So sweet and airy, with a hint of crunch.
There are literally skeletons walking around! Why would you want to live here!
Maybe we can add that to the list of things I can beat you at?
I've never used one of these, but I have wanted to try.
Bet they never saw that coming!
Where'd you go?
You can make it! Keep moving!
Hey! Stick with me!
We lost your pet!
Take this one seriously.
Even Vehk will want to hear about that one.
I wasn't worried. Were you worried?
Don't suppose you'll work this knot out of my shoulder while you're at it?
We drove them back!
Let's not get separated. I'd rather not be alone in this place.
Careful! We're headed into troublesome territory!
Seht likes a quick study.
Let's ride!
I love it!
Where in Tamriel did you get that one?
This one make me laugh. That's a very desirable trait!
Are there any side-effects to this that I should know about?
Nothing wrong with a little opportunistic harvesting.
A nice little present from Vehk, eh?
Worms find you before your grave! I will pluck out your eyes for this.
Why must you ruin my fun?
You lot are more excited over some castaways than my husband was when we got married.
I must know where you got that outfit! No, no that would be foolish in these circumstances as I am pressed for time. Perhaps you can offer me some advice instead?
Darling, how does this outfit look? I think we will make an adorable portrait!
What is a manservant without a lady to serve? I suppose I should relax, but I really want to make someone a nice cup of tea.

As a man of leisure, I'm unsure what to do with myself. Lady Laurent usually provides me with a to-do list at the beginning of every day. Without such a list, I am adrift without a sail. A pot without a spoon to stir. A … what were we discussing?

Never interrupt a mage when she's in the middle of casting a spell. Not even for something important. Such as, would you like butter or jam on your crumpet?\n\nBelieve me, I learned that lesson the hard way!

My friend! Lady Laurent will be disappointed that she missed this encounter. She always had nothing but good things to say about our adventures together. Well, mostly good things.\n\nActually, she rarely talks about you. Sorry.
Mind if I try picking your pocket? Seeks says I shouldn't ask that, but I'm four for five and that last one said I was sweet but she was married.
Oooooh, good stretch!\n\nCreeping around is real murder on the back and knees. I thought going on all fours was easier, but Seeks hit me with a rolled up handbill until I stopped.
You know, when Seeks first told me he was going to spy on the Painted Eyes, I thought he was talking about a trip to the bordello.\n\nI was a little disappointed. He could stand to loosen up a bit.

After watching you fight through that gauntlet in Murkmire, I thought Lady Twilight should take up the rapier.\n\nI bought one, but Seeks took it away. Now I practice jabbing things with my lockpicks.

Remember how Seeks joked about my itching? That it meant my skin was going to start sloughing off after that rescue from the spider ladies? Turns out, that does happen. But with the right antidote, it's just really refreshing for the complexion.
I grow tired of this game. You cannot stand against Mehrunes Dagon's power!
[confused Goblin gibbering as though caught unawares by an enemy]
Challenge what you know, if you're courageous enough. All things are possible.

Peddlers will tell you about the strength of their craft, but words are nothing to an intelligent person such as yourself. Which is why I show you proof of my abilities. \n\nFor a fee, I could lend my magical might towards whichever end you seek.
This place is pathetic. It will crumble before the might of Mehrunes Dagon.
Who can I kill for the Prince of Destruction?
Send me now! I want to eviscerate them all!
Spread like fire in a dry forest, minions of Dagon!
You will regret defying me!
I can't wait to see what my bag of tricks has in store for you.
I've worked up an appetite. Why couldn't they have turned into something tastier?
You can feel the fell energies all around us.
Keep the Scorions away from the stones until they are full.
I'll roast you alive!
Keep them out of the prison!
You know, Martus, I might have offered a place here to an old comrade, but I have no need for a man who's lost his resolve.
Flee, and foretell the coming of this realm's true master! Mehrunes Dagon shall reign!
A little fresh agony for the Scorions to lap up.
Prepare to march! I wish to trample upon the worms of this realm.
I'll follow right along behind you.
Your eyes shout out your strength! Try again!
Strike now! We will not get another chance!
Rally around me, brigadines!
I hate working for free.
We won't last forever out here! You need to keep moving!
Just when I think I have learned all there is, a new subject piques my interest!
Stand tall and walk with confidence, you have nothing to fear.
There's a new set of tools I've been eyeing, but they're expensive!
Psh. Generosity is hard to come by in this city.
I'm trying to keep four children fed the only way I know how. Have a heart!
Your purse looks like it could stand to be a little lighter.
I heard the Bursio child has a broken leg. Probably tried to climb that damned tree again.
I never know where my feet are taking me until I get there.
My egg-brother invited me for dinner. It'll be a relief not to cook tonight.
When I was younger, I wanted to explore every ruin. Now I don't venture out too far.
The floods remind us of what is important.
Never did I think that my business would flourish like it is.
When bored, I close my eyes and name all the scents in the air. This can be a mistake.
Please don't scare the fish.
My day began too early, but tonight I'll get some rest.
With so much to rebuild, even my claws are tired.
If I have to climb any more steps, my legs will give out.
I am not a patient mountain. Step aside.
When I'm done with this, I'm going for a drink.
With so much uncertainty shaking the branches, I welcome routine work.
Surely there are more pressing matters that demand your attention.
Do you happen to know where we are? I've gotten lost in more than just my thoughts.
Last time I tried to make a good impression, it went badly. Now I'm just hoping no one notices me.
If my master comes looking, say you haven't seen me.
I was trained for combat, not running after thieves!
This damnable weather makes my bones ache.
Bother someone else, please.
I don't have time to talk.
Happy to look the other way as long as there's something nice for me too.
Can you sleep through the night? Not me.
Keep an eye on your purse and you won't see anything else.
Leyawiin is so beautiful when the leaves change, it's my favorite time of year!
I wonder if fish like eating bait. Can they even taste things?
I'm thankful to have a job.
Should've bought more of those tonics that High Elf was selling.
I hear there's going to be a recitation at the tavern tonight.
You look like trouble.
I should pick some flowers before I head home.
I am so bored!
I'm on duty.
That was the worst sneaking ever, I heard you from down the road.
Oh, life was hard for the city bard, a man who … no that's terrible.
I got an apple. It's bruised and someone bit into it. But still, delicious!
You ever walk outside the city just to admire the view?
Make more work for us and I'll introduce you to my sharpest tool.
There's always work for those who are willing and able.
Work, work, work. Seems that's all I ever do.
My family's lived in Leyawiin for generations.
Are you following me? Do I need to scream?
I wish I could help, but I'm quite busy at the moment.
I have nothing to spare today.
Do I look like trouble to you?
The gods help those who make offerings in the temple.
Too busy. Can't chat.
Mind your own business!
They didn't like how I tucked in the bedsheet. Really, how many ways can there be?
I'm off duty. Bother someone else.
Mind your valuables!
If I see you at the tavern, I'll buy you a drink.
Have something to report?
This one wishes to travel, but hasn't the courage to take the first step.
New people add life to the city.
Which do you think would fetch a better price? The livestock or the crops?
Does this one know you?
Questions gnaw at Buzan, but he will not lay them on the shoulders of strangers.
So many books, so little time.
The last traveler to come through here brought a needed supply of new books. You have not.
I have learned so much, but there is always more.
If my assistant doesn't return soon, he'll be peeling potatoes for weeks!
Lived here my whole life and the heat still gets to me.
I wanted to be a poet, but turns out I'm better with a hammer.
If I thought you'd let me, I'd pick your pockets in a heartbeat.
If I have to break up one more tavern brawl, I may start drinking myself.
Life is better without someone looking over your shoulder.
My family will feast tonight!
Lend a hand or leave me to it.
My usual assistant—who would normally take care of our customers—decided she wanted to be a sailor instead. She's out at sea somewhere.\n\nSo, now I deal with customers. And fill orders too.
One taste and you'll never want to eat anything else!
My blades have not tasted blood in too long!
Continue onward. Leave these mindless dolts to me.
Here I come!
Come, hero. Come and face your doom.
I know I can protect Xyria as long as I am by her side, just like she once protected me.
Get out of the way now! Counter and kill!
Do you know what it's like to beg for death? I'll show you.
Clear your minds of all but pain and fear!
Let me handle the big rock, you worry about him!
We can withstand his spell from here!
The master used to call this place home, you know?
We have no shortage of cells for you.
Save one for the master to torture!
Don't get in the way of the Scorions. They're all but mindless and set to their task.
Victory for the Crimson Oath!
I don't care if they annoy you. Don't kill the Scorions once they've fed! You'll waste all that delicious misery.
Bleed! Suffer! Die!
B-bite. Claw. Gore!
I didn't expect to find somewhere this comfortable in the mortal world.
Lord Dagon entrusted us with his greatest plans. Be honored.
You'll look good in chains.
Feed them to the machine.
Who knew mortals had such an appreciation for pain?
This prison would be perfect if it had some living souls around to torture.
How many arrows to kill you, I wonder?
I've been wanting to try out these new barbs.
I've been waiting to break in these boots. Though most of the breaking will be happening to you.
Boom!
Goodbye to your teeth!
Allez hop!
Coming through!
Let's shake things up!
Jump in anytime!
Sloppy, Eliam. You're going to get us all killed!
Shrink before Meridian light!
Piercing rays!
We'll split you in two, too.
You subjugate the very powers of Oblivion, they cannot defeat you.
Be prepared for such attacks, bearers, as more take notice of our power.
Hello there.
You're quickly becoming my favorite employee. Come, tell me. I assume the news is good?

Vaveli over there tends to be stern with her hirelings, but I try to be more understanding. Just don't forget that you took on a job for the Gleaners, all right?\n\nI try to be understanding, but I still expect results.
I have a job for you. \n\nIf dangerous missions into the unknown corners of the planes interests you, that is.
You want to work and I want to pay you, but my cupboard is bare … so to speak. Return on the morrow and I'm sure we can come to terms. See you then!
Hmm. You don't look all that worse for wear. I take it the job went well?
I already told you about the work that's available. Well? The Saraathu Tong pay for results, not chit-chat.
If you take on a job and have the skill to come back in one piece, the Saraathu Tong will gladly give you another.
The Saraathu Tong doesn't have work for you right now. You're an adventurer who can still work. Go spend some money. Relax. Enjoy the fact that your injuries aren't enough to keep you from a fight.
Boot to the head!
Daedra smell fear, you know? And now, so do I.
I wield powers beyond your reckoning.
You won't escape!
Now, I run you through.
The Silver Rose has its thorns!
Rally to me, Silver Rose!
My, aren't you impressive with all your borrowed power.
You are still mortal, little knight!
You culled our ranks, but the Silver Rose is stronger for it.
Are you working with the Witchmothers? If you are, put in a good word for me, would you? I'm hoping to get in their good graces … if such a thing is even possible.
You'll excuse me if this one is not the most affable. The Witchmothers are creatures of great power and control.\n\nVanima does not know if you belong among them.
Ugh! That hurt, you curs!
Our guard is broken, broken!
I heard you will become a bearer soon. Pray you are ready.
Discipline. Discipline is the key to becoming a bearer.
Trust in the Prior. Through him you will transcend your mortal limitations.
We are beyond your reach, heathens.
Can't look away … can't look away ….
What's new?
Are we waiting for someone? Some thing? Just because?

Fantastic accomplishments should get their just reward. I'm sure yours is coming soon. But with such a short lifetime, why wait in discomfort? Take a look at my wares. They're made by Daedric hands, so they will outlive you.
I just restocked, which means that you're in luck. The alchemists here do wonderfully potent things with ponchu root!
Overstay your welcome in front of me and I'll show you why you want to be wearing my armor. The demonstration will only be free of charge in some regards.
I heard Volendrung was found in Cyrodiil. Now that'd be a prize for one of Malacath's own.
Have you ever held a Daedric artifact? Pure power. There is no feeling like it.
Is it hubris to wield the Daedra's power against them? I say it is hubris to believe we can best them without it.
Special training? I'll stick with my bow, thanks.
Why shouldn't the power of the Daedra be ours? To the victors go the spoils, as they say.
The Prior should let me try taming an artifact of Malacath. It's only natural.
If you feel an artifact calling to you, inform the Prior immediately.
The Divines give us power over Daedra. We must use it.
Touch nothing! Or would you like to wind up like those peasants?
Even bearers must observe protocol. So says the Prior.
Don't have to be a man of many words, just have to make my goods … good.
Your life's savings are safe with me. \n\nIf you're here for a loan …. As long as you pay the due in a reasonable amount of time, your life will be safe too.
Before you inquire, I am not planning on cheating you out of your money. \n\nWe Daedra have more self-respect than you mortals.

The good thing about having you Nirnlings here is that there are more warriors for my real customers to fight. \n\nDon't die too soon, though. I'm sure I'll make a few things in the future you are going to want.
Some use their strength to crush foes, I use mine to crush hops.

I must warn you, I'm not sure where or how I became so good at my craft. My skills grew overnight. \n\nThe fastenings on some of the cabinets sometimes look like they've been done by an apprentice, though.
You're not even going to try your indescribable horrors? Such ingratitude!
Hey, goat! Quit kidding around! Hee hee!
You are completely restored. I think. Mortal anatomy isn't an interest of mine.
I just like poking holes in reality, if I'm honest.
Those froggos know how to stick a landing, I'll give'em that. Where'd you suppose they learned to fly?
Think this one's starting to go off a bit, if I'm honest. Little vinegar should cover the smell!
Which has more holes? You or the cheese? Haha!
No new recipes, I'm afraid. The Grasp won't let me sell my creations until I can prove they won't kill anyone. \n\nPlenty of traditional foods available though!

My seamstresses and I make the finest garments in all of Fargrave. \n\nWhat? Of course I have aides. They may not outlive their apprenticeships, but the quality of work is still worth the upkeep. See for yourself.
Why do you struggle? Accept your fate.
Lord Dagon does not abide failures!
The stone bleeds Lord Dagon's fire!
I will drink this well of agony dry!
Coming to speak to me was a good decision on your part. You look like you could use some enchantments.
Freshest food in all of Fargrave. This one guarantees it.
No one ever seemed to visit wayshrines until adventurers found a way to use them for travel. What were they built for in the first place, M'aiq wonders?

As a man of leisure, I'm unsure what to do with myself. Lady Laurent usually provides me with a to-do list at the beginning of every day. Without such a list, I am adrift without a sail. A pot without a spoon to stir. A … what were we discussing?

Never interrupt a mage when she's in the middle of casting a spell. Not even for something important. Such as, would you like butter or jam on your crumpet?\n\nBelieve me, I learned that lesson the hard way!
M'aiq knows you. You followed this one all over Tamriel and found me even in my best hiding places. Now M'aiq must know.\n\nAre you stalking this one?
Wingless knights are clanky and slow. Slow! Knights of the Blackfeather Court are clever, strong, and swift! And also very hungry.\n\nShow me your fresh meats and tender cheeses, featherless!

As a man of leisure, I'm unsure what to do with myself. Lady Laurent usually provides me with a to-do list at the beginning of every day. Without such a list, I am adrift without a sail. A pot without a spoon to stir. A … what were we discussing?

Never interrupt a mage when she's in the middle of casting a spell. Not even for something important. Such as, would you like butter or jam on your crumpet?\n\nBelieve me, I learned that lesson the hard way!

The Knave of Rooks mentioned that you're a vassal of our great and powerful Duke of Crows. Splendid! As a trusted servant of the Duke, you could put a good word in for me, right? Help get me knighted?\n\nDo it, featherless, or I'll peck out your eyes!

Baron Jangleplume and the Peddler of Prizes tell me I need to practice more.\n\nScratch! Parry! Flap! Thrust! Ha! No one performs their martial exercises like I do. Have a care with those fingers, featherless. My blood is up and I'm ready to peck!

I always saw the Empire as a force for good. I was raised to believe it, even before I joined the Battlespire. I know now that's far too idealistic a viewpoint, but I still believe a united Empire is better than this endless civil war.
Oooooh, good stretch!\n\nCreeping around is real murder on the back and knees. I thought going on all fours was easier, but Seeks hit me with a rolled up handbill until I stopped.
No one has come after me for killing Martus and deserting my post. Have they just not caught up to me, or aren't they even looking? It would be sad to be that insignificant. Sadder for Martus.

A letter arrived. Didn't say who it was from, but the only person who would even try to reach me is Martus.\n\nI burned the letter without reading it. I may have resisted killing him in the heat of the moment, but he's dead to me all the same.

Remember how Seeks joked about my itching? That it meant my skin was going to start sloughing off after that rescue from the spider ladies? Turns out, that does happen. But with the right antidote, it's just really refreshing for the complexion.
Are you going to try to steal something from me? Take a good look at what's on offer. Make my day interesting. Please.
Can you keep a secret? The Saraathu Tong don't know about some of the goods I have in stock. Promise not to tell them and we can do business.
I shouldn't be saying this, but we have some pretty special items in stock for our exclusive customers. Take a look around and let me know what you think!
You want to converse before finalizing a purchase? How very odd.\n\nI will not talk to you except to exchange goods. Tell me what you would like.
This place used to be a wreck. You should have seen the state the floorboards were in! \n\nBut I fixed it up properly and now look at it. It's the best inn in Wretched Spire. Only inn, too.
Dance in this destruction, children of the Deadlands!
Wretched Spire is … enjoyable. Maintaining a stock of goods in a place such as this presents an intriguing set of challenges.\n\nI take it you're here to talk about the wares as well?

Allow me to explain my rules to you, mortal.\n\nAt the end of this, we give each other what we're owed and then you go on your way. Before that time, we do not speak. So? Take a look at my inventory. Silently.
You don't seem very good at haggling. Luckily, I don't haggle with mortals. \n\nThe prices you see are what I require. Take it or leave it, Nirnling.
It's down! We can win this!
It won't be near so quick or so gentle for you, Martus.
Sidestep quickly, until he's exhausted his reserves!
Keep strafing and you'll be fine!
Dive if you have to, but try not to overextend yourself!
Why so glum, Martus? Aren't you pleased to know I turned all that pointless suffering into something greater?
I do take some satisfaction knowing you've damned your soul to Oblivion.
Bring me a report on Ardent Hope's defenses.

Only the proudest champions of the Blackfeather Court rise to knighthood. What I need is a quest. Yes! A grand adventure! What should I seek? An ogre's eye? A Hagraven's mole-hair? No, no, those won't do.\n\nWait! I have it! A pewter spoon! Yes!

I always saw the Empire as a force for good. I was raised to believe it, even before I joined the Battlespire. I know now that's far too idealistic a viewpoint, but I still believe a united Empire is better than this endless civil war.
We bearers are united as one! We cannot be divided or conquered!
The battle is not yet decided, decided!
Cursed bindings will be the death of me. Again.
The behemoth is a product of conjuration, have no concerns about destroying it.
That monster deserves no pity. Break every bone in its body!
No one has defeated the Grim Warden, but I'm sure you'll do fine!
The Purgator is yours to command.
Rise, Undertaker. It's time to resume your grim work.
The Grim Warden suppressed many riots in the Dread Cellar with ruthless efficiency. I'm sure it'll do the same now.
Kill the interlopers!
You picked the wrong fort to raid!
You sully our great bastion!
Die you vile thralls!
How'd you get in here?
This ought to get the Prior's attention.
Hold the line!
Think you can just waltz through our stronghold?
The minions of Oblivion are among us!
We are prepared for the likes of you!
You will not lay a hand on these prized relics!
We will not be bested by filthy looters!
Is someone there …? Won't someone end this …?
I just want to go home … Divines just let me go home ….
Pell … mell … well … cell … fell ….
You and M'aiq share a common pastime. We both go out of our way to collect obscure achievements by any means necessary.\n\nM'aiq likes that about you.
If you don't see what you want here, don't ask me to make it to your specifications. Custom furnishings cost more than you are able to part with.
We have some fascinating accoutrements in, if you have a mind to take a look. Lockpicks, tools, medicinal drams. \n\nHmm. Accoutrements, learned that word from my fiance.
Dance in this destruction, children of the Deadlands!
The finer points of your rudimentary mortal tongue delude me. \n\nStill, I'm sure we can embark on this exchange within the broad paddles of conversation. Correct?
I know what you're here for. My magic weapons and jewelry are the most potent available in this area. Let's get this transaction sorted quickly. There are matters I must attend to.
Good morrow to you my excellently esteemed customer. What drams or materials take you your pleasure in today?
You aren't paid by the hour. Get hauling or starve.
You've earned fifty lashes to go with your black eye.
Ah, finally, someone who isn't a Daedra. I hope you won't be rude either. I could not stand to sell another magical item to a rude creature.
Given how unreliable a mortal's sense of direction is, Ri finds himself surprised that you located him.\n\nHmm. Ri now wonders whether you meant to find him at all. Where do you wish to go?
No discounts for heroes I'm afraid—or villains. Whatever your ethical leaning is, no discounts. I send the money I earn from selling packs home to my mother. You understand.
How a person treats their mount says a lot about them. Wonder what I'll learn about you.
Willing to fix mortal work. Jerkin and jacket alterations a specialty.

We can help each other. You buy from me exclusively, and I supply you with excellent weapons for your journeys. Then maybe the pact factions will take notice of my shop. \n\nYeah, that's bound to work.
There has to be some way back to Nirn! There has to be!
If you're another mortal coming here to get a chair instead of the bows, staffs, and shields I clearly specialize in, I'm going to break every law in Fargrave and be done with you.
Sell your goods or don't. I don't care. Take what isn't yours here and you'll pay for it with your life.
Don't assume your good looks will get you a better deal from me. My rates are fixed.
Let's both agree not to stab each other at the end of this conversation. That has happened far too often as of late and my healing drams are quite expensive.
Ah, mortal, the things I imagine doing when I can get you alone. And disregard any warning Lyranth may have given you. I have nothing but the best intentions in mind.
Ah. A portal to absolutely nowhere. I suppose you think this is funny, Qukikh?
Feel free to join me by my fire. The Deadlands are dark without the light of friendship.
Sales are the root of business. Lifetimes are not. They all just float away on the tides of time. Swoosh. And then they're gone.
Another worm interrupts my bookkeeping time. Well? Tell me about your finances. I don't have all year.
Going once. Going twice. Sold to the Skaafin in the middle! Ha! Do be careful with that item, sir!
You must be brave, wandering around here in the wilderness. \n\nWord of advice? Stock up while you can and keep your wits about you.
Two travelers like ourselves meeting out here? Fortune must be smiling on us. \n\nHere, rest awhile and take a look at what I've got.
Supplicants detected. Commencing evaluation.
Supplicants insufficient. Restoring ward integrity.
Analysis at two thirds efficiency. Exhuming protocols.
Furious heat! Unbridled chaos! The Ja'Khajiit does not disappoint.
Whatever this Daedra shows me, I'll prove to Lord Vivec himself that I am faithful. I just hope the sites we visit aren't too horrific.
These two never stop yammering. It's all insistent questions and gasps of awe.\n\nI thought Quathynax overreacted when he stuck blades in his ears, but I'm beginning to see the appeal.
Your claws are as dull as your wits!
Best thing about Fargrave? I can be who I want to be. In the form I want to be in. Whenever.
Prevent Sombren from transferring his power! Go!
We should use the wisp to guide us.
Soon, I'll be able to move freely to the mortal realm! Then no one will stop me! Hahaha!
Namira's guts! This loot will get me nowhere with the Gleaners.
If you aren't protected by a pact, make one. I don't want to see your face among the Drained.
Disaster take you, mortal!
Blind them with my power!
Unexpected. Well, I'll—oh no!
Think you have the skill to create something worthy of my interest? I'd love to see you try. Please begin.
Pay the fee or end up underground, where you mortals belong!
Don't run from me!
I need to speak to you.
Psh, amateur. Be less suspicious!
You dare steal to publicly? Idiot.
You won't get away unpunished!
I have no patience for this mess.
You dare commit that act here? Guards!
You shame all martial crafts!
Where in Oblivion is the guard?
I would never stoop so low.
Why do I keep losing things? If they hear about this, I'm done for!
I'll crush your bones beneath my heel for this!
You made it this far without being caught? Well done!
Your footfalls distract me from my work. Leave!
I'd dip my tongue in lava over speaking to you.
Bold move breaking the law of Oblivion. But every transgression has its cost.
Poor choice, Nirnborn.
Freeze, scum!
Enough skulking, Nirnborn. Be off.
Guard! We've got a greedy Nirnling here!
You broke our laws. Now, the guards will break you.
Try that on me and I'll cut out your tongue.
Laws are childish illusions. Keep breaking them!
Is a guard coming? Oh, I can't wait!
Guards! Look here!
A bit of skulduggery, eh? Princes guide you.
It's lost! That Kynmarcher's going to skin me!
Nice try, mortal.
You need a compass or something?
Leave, or I'll send you to Namira!
I don't need this kind of heat. Jog on.
The mortal used eyes and fingers. Appease me with compensation or I take the eyes and fingers.
Then your meat shall bleed!
The chase ends here!
I have eternity to catch you, mortal.
A poor show of treachery. I'd do better.
Come! See! This mortal acts foolishly!
Bold little creature. Now, you must flee!
That will be your final mistake, little one.
Keep going! More, more!
Bring the knives! Sharpened!
You make more noise than you realize.
I asked for better pockets!
No! I need all my objects!
How did something like you get in here?
You were told! Your suffering is earned.
Perhaps when the rumors are kinder to you.
There is nowhere you can run that is beyond our sight. Make your atonement offering. Now.
You wish to die? I'll indulge you.
Don't take another step.
You're not fooling anyone, skrid. Least of all me.
A Theft? Praise Nocturnal!
Think you'll get away with that? You're dumber than you look.
Dead? Guess I should have murdered them sooner.
The guards will have your skin for parchment!
What a mess!
Guards! The Nirnling pleads for death!
And what are you up to, little Nirnling?
It was right here ….
You've fingers like an Ogrim!
This is no place for Nirnborn.
Enough snooping, skrid! Out!
Return when things have settled down.
Foolish of you to place yourself in my power. Our law is iron: Make restitution, or meet your doom.
This is not the required behavior.
Halt, curse you!
I do not like the look of you, mortal. Take yourself out of my sight.
Fool. Is that bauble worth your life?
You seek consequences for your actions? They are coming.
The game of death. This may be interesting.
A pity. Your career of mayhem ends here.
Stop! We do not stand for this!
Here! A fool begs for death!
You bore me with your skulking about.
Foolish, foolish …. Where did it go?
Why, the insolence! The impertinence!
What is your business here, mortal?
Do you seek the torments of the pit? I can send you there!
You are … interesting. But I do not care to share your troubles.
You're terrible at breaking laws. Now? You're mine. Hand over your bounty.
You think you'll escape me? Funny.
Be still, mortal!
Oh, Nirnborn, don't toy with guards like me.
How much more can you pilfer before the guard arrives?
I'd kill you myself, but I want to see what the guards do.
Why'd you murder them? Feh. The guards'll find you.
You'd best skitter off before the law finds you.
Stop it at once! Guards!
Back, Nirnling! Back!
I don't like what I'm seeing, mortal.
Why do I keep losing things?
Fool! Move away from me now.
Pretty sure you don't belong here.
Leave now or the guards will have you.
I've no time for those wanted by the guard.
Your kind always gets into trouble, don't they? Pay up now.
Mortal impudence! You will regret this!
You will answer to me!
That's enough. Scurry off now.
Do they not flay thieves in Nirn?
The guards here will not be as gentle as the ones you are used to.
How brave! A mortal with a craving for death!
There is no law that is not worth breaking, is there? Keep going!
There's no need for that!
Guard! Lend a hand here!
Oh? Brave indeed.
I bet it was that Dark Seducer.
Try that again and I'll devour your hand.
Poor mortals, always so hopelessly lost. You are lost, aren't you?
Get out of here!
Not while you've got a target on your back, mortal.
Taking money from mortals like you is the best part of my job.
Feckless Nirnling, do as you're told!
You! Don't try to run.
A mortal? Breaking the law?
Aww! That was an adorable attempt!
My clan would never let me see light if I did that.
There! Proof that your kind is flawed.
A mortal? Committing crimes again? This will definitely shock the guards.
Mortal, this is unbecoming!
Guards! Remove this Nirnling.
Mortals get to do everything interesting.
Ugh! Why am I always losing things?
You're going to have to try harder than that to steal from me, worm.
I know there's no way that you're allowed to be here.
You! Get out before someone sees I haven't made you leave!
I can't trust you to behave and you can't trust me not to tear your skin off.
There was a time when I would have killed for the honor of having a stall in the Bazaar. And then mortals sullied that.
I come here to think in the quiet. You're ruining that.
Everyone believes they are beyond the reach of my bow. That's their downfall.
My scales long for a cool cloth. But work comes first. As it always does.
Stay out of the Shambles. Those Daedric lords are justifiably unwelcoming to us lowly mortals.
Can't compete with Daedric craftsmanship, like these orbs. They do me a world of good.
Look to the future and know that it resides in the flames and chaos of Mehrunes Dagon!
Shyn got herself trussed away over there. Serves her right too, going on like she was.
For a collection of races with mortality issues, it's a surprise that Nirn isn't barren.
I'll not say much. But this music is … tolerable.

Now aren't you an interesting sight! Most mortals would never dare get this close to me.\n\nDo you enjoy getting close to dangerous things, mortal? Like the moth circling the flame? Do you want to get burned? Can you handle my heat? I think not.
There is nothing so lawless as a city with mortals. But I wonder what would have come of our city had we not let you in.
Naraman thinks his tactics clever. He is wrong.
Mortals. You try so hard to accomplish so little in your short lifespans. It's tragic, really.
Fargrave is safe enough, but outside these walls you're going to need protection.
Vares Dredayn developed a new medicine. Hopefully, it won't turn patients into poultry. Again.
You've gained admittance here and now what? You want to roam the markets too?
I attempted to ingest food many years ago. Meat was delightful but foliage left much to be desired.
I am above you. If you will not afford me the respect I am owed, then I will not speak with you.
Many mortals don't live long enough to contribute even one meaningful idea to society.
Mortality is a blight on the streets of Fargrave. And we allow Scamps here.
We form no pacts. You cannot convince us otherwise. It is our rule.
Enlizanev plays this game really well. I can't let them win!
The Lady looks on all and finds them deserving of love. I know you'll see the same in yourself.
Zzavfa! Does no one in this insipid city take Vre's bribes?
There's a Dremora who sells these little pillows. No idea what they're for, but I must have one.
I wanted adventure, and now look at me! Working in a city on another plane.
Leading expert on Nirn. In Fargrave and out. New title. Earned through study. Yes.
There is no better place to study then here, under the stars. Yes?
Fargrave is a feat of magical acumen that has yet to be matched. No matter how hard the Saraathu Tong tries.
These are quite ugly specimens.
