Bother me with questions and I may just risk disgrace to deal with you.
I've seen mortals fight. You are not always undeserving of respect.
Some Gleaners enjoy taking from mortals. But I can't think of what you could have that I'd want to steal.
The mortal asked if I was skilled. Psh. I've labored for the lifetimes of several mortals.
I may be far from my original post, but that does not permit me to be derelict in my duties.
All existence is forfeit to the Lord of Destruction. Fargrave's fall is nigh. Buy some fruit?
An Ogrim just stepped on me. The nerve of some creatures!
Too much drink? Nonsense, I have yet to experience the intoxicants.
Stupid Nirnbound. Existence was better when we didn't have to tolerate them.
Who can I kill for the Prince of Destruction?
Norwetil exemplifies mortals who are too lofty for their stations.
Can anyone take this creature away from me? I'm practicing.
None can match my power!
The family I serve are good to me. And the others they pay.
This is the most enjoyment I have had in a while.
Dagon's Blood! This thaumaturgic problem refuses to make sense.
The fungus over there … it watches me.
Come closer and you'll taste my steel.
Never challenge a Daedra. You don't stand a chance.
Fargrave used to be something. Perhaps I can help restore its glory days ….
Fargrave was a place of wonder. And then the mortals arrived.
I need more skulls around here.
Which armor to wear today?
I appreciate trial and error methodologies, but I'd really rather not test our luck with the Eleventh Force. Proceed carefully, please.
Oh, I feel out of—
Fargrave needs more useful soil and fewer watchers. Their eyes are unsettling.
I don't feel like running a stall today. Yet, I must at some point.
Eyes. Too many eyes. I need to lie down.
I need something new. Something interesting. Something … intriguing.
Insolent worms. You deign to walk by me? I'll remember your faces, I'll remember all of your faces!
No one ever seemed to visit wayshrines until adventurers found a way to use them for travel. What were they built for in the first place, M'aiq wonders?
Send me now! I want to eviscerate them all!
Chirrrai misses the city when she is gone. There's no better place to find odds and ends.
No! Roll again. We'll play another.
Thought the people in the Shambles would flock to serve chaos. Look at them. They're not worthy!
You cheat! How could you roll that when I already stole your die?
Stop your whining and be subservient!
Mortals. They defy the order of things, even in a realm that is not theirs.
It may not be safe here, but that just means it's more fun.
Such exquisite relief, to think again. I owe you a boon, creature. Take this. I promise much more for my freedom.
Such a formidable creature. Perhaps you have no need for my gifts, but I offer them all the same.
Ah, creature. If you only knew how long I have waited for this moment. Yet there is one final shackle upon me. Break it, and bathe in my gratitude!
In another time, we might have been allies. But this prison requires a prisoner, and I have served my time.
I never expected you to go without a fight. Good! Let us see who is stronger!
Such steel, land-thing. I was right to choose you … but you have reached beyond your grasp!
Hragh! I won't die to the likes of you, creature!
Inevitable.
Use it well.
Open your purse and aid me. One has lost more than just one's place.
We need more cats.
If you're a friend, can you give me a drink? If you're not a friend … do you wanna be?
Come, mortal, I require satisfaction. I have very particular needs and you probably won't survive the experience, but I assure you, it will be memorable!
Time passes differently for immortals, but an eternity is still a long time.
Who would work with mortals? They are inferior in every way.
Go elsewhere? Not when there are so many lesser beings right here.
Those who created us demand that we stay strong.
You're not better than me. You have your own chains!
One of the planes is the home of a rare Jackbeetle. But it's never the one I'm in.
I need quiet to think. There must be a way to atone.
One simple mistake led to much misery. Erztiran had power!
Sorry. I can either look where I'm going or think about my studies. And I like my studies.
Zyzazzil says that mortals who know loss hold onto what remains more carefully. I doubt it.
Where did my underling go?
You approach me? Most would say that it's a sign of ill fortune to come across me in the Deadlands.
Fargrave is easy to find after you have been there. Unfortunately for me, I have yet to visit.
I examine a patch of whimsical fire flower one time. And Oox, Scourge of the Night, wanders off!
Corrupt moons smile on me.
When all else fails, pursue what others are too cowardly to do.
How can you battle disaster, puny mortal?
There's a foul stench in the air. A mortal is near.
A mortals tried to swear fealty to me. I have no need of a pet.
We could us a good battle. My blade longs to draw blood.
Why have the mortals come to Skein Row?
If the Dremora seek battle, the Web will comply.
Only my power can hurt Nokvroz!
You're mortal! Good. My indignity can die with you!
Sister Celdina is filled with the power of Mehrunes Dagon!
Have you stood before Lord Dagon yet? He's very … big.
Is that all you've got?
Is this all the Prince of Destruction can do?
This ends here!
Feel my fury!
The egonymic can hurt Dagon! Use it now!
You will pay for that!
You dare?
You do not know what you reap!
I cannot die!
Let this be your first lesson: nothing in Fargrave is free.
Fargrave is a tangle of biting briars. Let me guide you.

The Nereid in the southwest fountain fell in love with a Dremora and followed him here through a river of memories that flows from Nirn to realms beyond. When she arrived, she found herself trapped.\n\nNow, the Dremora will not let her go.
If you really want to offend a Daedra, ask them what time it is.
Let the flames consume you!
Try not to die before I can summon more pools of energy.
A good fight makes victory sweeter!
I will not chase the likes of you.
This is the only way! You must understand!
Now you die!
I just need to get out of the Deadlands … that's all.
Is there no escape from this molten pit!
Dreaming …. Flowers. Overturned basket.\n\nI am now prepared to exchange objects for gold. Begin trade when ready.
Dreaming …. Seasoned saltrice. Laughter.\n\nI am prepared to accept all goods and gold. Storage period: unlimited.
No! Leave me alone!

I ventured outside today and was set upon by a savage beast with claws and fangs. A cat, I think the mortals called it. To my shame, I was forced to flee at its unprovoked onslaught.\n\nNext time, though, next time ….
Carry me into battle, master. I will gladly sink my fangs into your enemy's throats … if you could but hold me high enough to reach them.

For centuries uncounted, I gave my loyalty to Mehrunes Dagon. In return, he allowed that lickspittle Nokvroz to curse and supplant me. Prince or no, he will answer for that. Vengeance shall be ours! Tomorrow.\n\nToday I would like a wheel of cheese.

If anyone comes around and asks if you've seen Hezehk, just say no. I'm hoping to make this break in my duties last as long as possible. Thank you. Now if you don't mind, I want to get back to my book. That Investigator Vale is an intriguing mortal.

Now you've done it, mortal. I hear Mehrunes Dagon got a good look at you in Ardent Hope, and he's not likely to forget your face. He will have vengeance. Hezehk knows it! A pity, too—I disliked you less than most.

So, you met the Anchorite, did you? There's a story behind that one, I'm certain of it. My guess is that she committed some gruesome crime and feigns ignorance to escape punishment. Or she's horribly scarred beneath that mask.\n\nOne of the two.
I'm not looking forward to slowing down after my studies. I hope the Psijic Order can keep me busy.
The Psijic Order took quite an interest in your battle against Mehrunes Dagon. I only wish I'd been there to take notes! You must tell me all about it!
I wonder if Ritemaster Valsirenn will read my thesis on Daedric gambling? Perhaps I should replace some of the more … colorful language.

I find myself puzzled by the notion of currency. Do not the strong simply take from the weak? Do not the weak attempt to steal from the strong?\n\nWhy complicate matters with this strange barter system?

If anyone comes around and asks if you've seen Hezehk, just say no. I'm hoping to make this break in my duties last as long as possible. Thank you. Now if you don't mind, I want to get back to my book. That Investigator Vale is an intriguing mortal.
I'm not looking forward to slowing down after my studies. I hope the Psijic Order can keep me busy.
Come out, mortals! I have a bloody task to perform.
Face me, trespassers, and know Lord Dagon's fury!
Foes! At long last!
The Dremnaken will feast on your corpses!
Enough sport. Time to die!
No! Not in the sight of Dagon!
You think me weakened? Foolish!
Only cowards will mourn you!
I will not give chase to the likes of you.
I will not give chase to the likes of you.
Bah. I have better things to do.
Run if you wish. You'll meet Dagon's fury soon enough!
I'm going to wipe the floor with you lot.
That lot's dealt with. Now get out there and find what they did with Jakarn!
A new era is upon us. You can't fight it.
You're just leaving more for your friends to step on.
I have you now.
You make the yaghra look swift.
I'll riddle you with knives.
Over here!
Hope the yaghra like you crispy.
Hot as forge nails.
Phew. Look at them burn.
You should have stayed out of Altmeri lands. You don't belong here.
Practicing your archery within the city walls is not advised, in case you're wondering. We've had a few … accidents … of late.\n\nNow, how can I help you?
I ripped a hole in your pack, master. So I can survey our surroundings. It is a small hole, do not worry.
Annihilarch's Summit. Such memories I have of that place! How I loved perching on the jagged peaks!
Your pack has been soiled, master. Er, it must have been some mysterious interloper. I will find and punish them!
There used to be a half-eaten sweetroll at the bottom of your pack. Not anymore ….
Hmm. You're favoring that right arm. If I see it, your enemies will too. Let's mix things up a little, eh?
Did you think we'd leave this one unguarded? You are more the fool than he is!
I am free once more. You have my thanks, creature—champion—and all the riches I can muster. Sparse, though they may be.
Can you imagine not believing in ghosts? A friend once told me that you can't swing a stick in Glenumbra without it passing through some lost spirit.
We will spread beyond the grove. All the land shall wither and die.
<Baa.>
I trust you bring good news? Or at least not-disastrous news?
Well, you look ready, and this job won't finish itself. Otherwise why would I be in need of adventurers?
Care to take on a job that requires a group of like-minded individuals such as yourself? It could be dangerous, but it pays well.\n\nCan I tell you about the task, my friend?
I'm afraid I don't have anything else for you at this moment. But check back with me later!
Adventurer! What news do you bring me? Has the job been completed?
I have no other information regarding the job, but I'm sure you'll have no trouble completing it. Well, not too much trouble, at any rate.\n\nCome back here when you're done and I'll have your pay.
An adventurer after my own heart! You like to work on your own, and I have tasks suited to just such a person.\n\nCare to take on a job today?
Deepest apologies, but there is no more work available today. But here in the archipelago, the winds change quickly. Come back later and we shall see what we can do.
If Ember wishes to take up more formal training in the future, she knows where I am.
Think we've gone and scared them, Turli.
I won't forgive you for besting my arena champions without my witnessing the spectacle. You'll make it up to me here.
Clouds gather, tides rise, and your precious flotilla will be dashed against the rocks like children's toys.
We're really scraping the bottom of the barrel for talent today.
Bow before the queen!
All dead? Damn, I needed a new latrine slave.
Finally, challengers with some guts!
Let's see some blood down there!
Let's see how good you really are.
When I'm done here, let's see how you like having your carcasses raked over every barnacle on this island.
I'll fly your hides from the yardarms.
You little sand fleas are beginning to irritate me.
This one's well acquainted with the priests and their lectures. Hard work? Returning lost valuables to those who want them is hard work, yes?
Get away from me.
Leave me be! I'm minding my own business. Maybe you should too!
Find everything to your liking? There's some sauce bottles down the road if you need to add some flavor. Don't mix up the one with the two moons label on it unless you like yours really sweet.
What a wonderful festival! Even a storm couldn't dampen this day's joy. What can I get you?
My wares are unparalleled. They are of a high quality make. \n\nSo, what has your Zenithar demanded of you, sera? A fine trinket from sunken Thras? A woven kelp dress from Pyandonea?
That looks much more exciting than digging through pulpy papers. Poor Za'ji almost envies you. Truly.
I am Count Damard! I am the Ascendant Magus!
Smugglers collect odd things in their sea caves. Why, just yesterday I sold a lantern with colorful glass to a lady of discerning taste.\n\nSo, what can I help you with?
We'll wash away all their foolish plans. And you with them!
Unity will only ever lead to destruction! See for yourselves!
Once someone tried to deposit a goat with us. I still have it around here somewhere. I think. Maybe it's on the roof.\n\nYou don't have a goat to deposit, do you?
Get these awful creatures away from me!
No! What are you doing? Stop!

Keep an eye on the wharf rats. Half of 'em are pirates between ships. They're always looking for a chance to stick a knife in someone for some easy coin.\n\nSpeaking of coin, are you buying or selling?

Some sailors tried to convince me they'd found a new type of mudcrab—one bigger than a Dragon! Of course, you know sailors. Always exaggerating.\n\nNow, I'm no sailor. When I say my goods can do a thing, they do.

The Impresario entrusted me with the care and breeding of her valuable indriks, and I take my work very seriously. While you browse the markets here, please let me know if any of the current stock catches your eye.
Watch the spines!
Attack! Attack!
I have my eye on you. I'm always watching.
I see you straggler! Get back with the rest!
Move, or you can work the plagueyards instead!
I can't hold this for long! Help!
You wish to play Tribute. Very well. I relish a challenge.
You're not one of those loonies who obsess over your Roister's Club rank, are you? I'm just here for a good time!
Airalar learned long ago that lies tangle the tongue and complicate one's life. Now he deals in nothing that is not true … but let us speak of nicer things.\n\nSuch as buying and selling.
<Mooo!>
The poorest sailors and wealthiest nobles alike seek out my culinary delights. Try one, and you'll see why. In fact, you'll be begging for more!
There's really no such thing as junk. It's all just treasure in need of a good whack or two! Save yourself the trouble, eh? I've got the broken down bits right here!
Back off. This treasure's mine!
The lodestones were ours the moment we agreed to the bargain.
Orgnum's serpents take your soul!
Hmph. Bottom-feeders.
That's it, cease your struggles.
Like a shark chasing horkers.
Hah, spewed into the drink like the swill you are!
Soon you'll be nothing but mouldering filth for the harbor rats!
You thrash and gasp like fish dumped onto the decks, soon to be snuffed out without ceremony or respect.
The secret's safe now.
You should have left me to the plague! At least I'd waste away surrounded by family.
You wouldn't even notice if I was gone!
It's too late!
My bones are humming! There's a tingle in my spine! Akatosh have mercy!
It should have been you!
Gaaaah!
…safe…
If memory serves me, there's typically more fighting involved when defending against an invasion, correct?
Every Breton I meet seems to harbor just a little magic, even if they do not know it themselves. It is puzzling.\n\nAh, but you wish to see my wares?
I found this? Fortune really does smile on us these days!
The mount is never unlucky. The rider, on the other hand, can be.\n\nHow can I help you, mainlander?
Hack off each branch and limb, it's time for the axeman's trim.
Unskilled and soft.
Don't bother getting up.
I'll have to take my share in soap before this is done.
Tell me you found something!
Wonder how this place became so haunted.
One good storm could wash this whole place away.
Wouldn't trust those planks if I was you.
Who made you captain?
Don't see what's so special about these ships.
I wouldn't eat anything that came from these waters.
We needed a new deck swabber.
Look at these mud-heels!
I'll blast you into chum!
Face the sea's wrath!
Death's brought us a bounty!
Bet you're a sinker.
Let's collar this lot!
Come at me, landlubber.
As sure as beetles crawl on the ground, one of the blessed ones must have sent you!
My hidden friends, make yourselves known.
That's the spirit! Let's make this a grand melee!
My friend, I have many wares! Whether you're buying to meet a need or seeking to forget your woes by treating yourself to a trinket, I'm here for you.

I'm just another bit of flotsam. Storm washed me up on the prison isle—you'll hear of it soon enough if you stay. Food was terrible! Anyway, I've been in the Systres ever since.\n\nNow, how about some fresh produce?
Uncertainty is uncomfortable, but we live with it every day of our lives. For example, what you see for sale here today may not be available tomorrow, so buy it while you can!
You'll hurt your … oh no, I sound like my mother.
Make good use of this warm up. You'll need it.
High Isle's safe enough, but steer clear of Amenos. No honest traveler goes there! And speaking of honest, I have some honest, high-quality wares to show you.
The sea is calm. The sky is clear. You're standing there. Now buy from here!
Whether you're chasing gold, seeking knowledge, or simply looking for a comfortable bed, we have you covered.\n\nSo, friend, what's your pleasure?
Hah! You won't catch Za'ji like that!
That one won't trouble you!
Do not let any sharpened teeth or scales deter you! A Sea Elf is still just an Elf!
I spent years crafting furnishings of my own in Sentinel. Living in Gonfalon Bay is definitely an experience—one filled with far less sand!\n\nNow, how can I help you?
Quite the traveler, are we? I hope you experienced all the wonders of these isles. It doesn't do to leave behind something only partially enjoyed.\n\nSo, where to?

If you plan to make Gonfalon Bay your home, be careful to secure fragile items on shelves. They sometimes fall off when the ground shivers.\n\nIf you forget, I might have replacements for certain things.
Hah! All his boasts are full of tepid sea water! You can handle this soggy Elf!
Don't you worry about these drowned deaders! Za'ji is on it! Well, maybe still worry about them, but Za'ji can help!
I'll call first round.
I'll take the first round, Ly.
Spare a moment?
We have a special vault for weapons and armor. Very special indeed. No, no details for you other than that we keep everything safe. So very safe.
Gifts from the sea. Items dropped by people passing you by. Things left forgotten in dusty chests. I'm interested in all of them and more. So, show me what you've got.
Even the merchants around here have too many items to keep track of. Help them, please, by lessening their items … and their headaches.\n\nThen, of course, bring them to me!
My advice for when the earth rumbles around here? Stand under a sturdy stone structure. Saved my life a few times already.\n\nNow, what do you need?
You here to play Tribute, or chew the fat? I'll tell you right now, I'm not a conversationalist.
Do you seek a Tribute opponent? I stand ready to oblige.
I really should be going …. Oh, to Oblivion with that. Let's play!
Fancy a game of Tribute? I promise, you won't find a player more eager to play and more likely to lose.
You want to play Tribute, eh? Very well. I can always use the practice.
You carry Tribute cards, yes? Come! This one's whiskers twitch with anticipation!
I still have much to learn about Tales of Tribute. Come, let us learn together.
Fancy cards you've got there. It's not the cards that count, though. It's the will to win!
Information is a product I do not sell. For that, please talk to some of those supremely loose-lipped folk in the bay proper.\n\nNo, let us talk goods instead.
Amenos Station is safe enough and a nice place to visit, but I'd avoid the jungle if I were you.
While few escape the prison isle of Amenos, bards tell of daring tales of some rare escapes. It's why I keep my wits about me in the wilds here.\n\nYour gear? Does it need some repairs, perhaps?
Druids and strange lights. That's what I saw the other night. Not sure what came of it.\n\nAh, well, we're talking exchange of goods and coins, yes?

You know what I hate? Buried treasure. Honestly, who buries a treasure? All the sailing, and the digging, and the backstabbing. Who has the time?\n\nHere's a life tip—if you need an old map to remember where you hid something, pick a better spot.
I once saw a Gonfalon sailor try their hand at the combat here. They happily went back to their ship afterward.\n\nYou are made of stronger stuff, though. Just like my goods!

People tell me I'm a bit obsessed with my last job. That I talk about it all the time. Trust me, if you'd survived what I did, it'd be on your mind a lot, too.\n\nBut, please. Distract me! Look at my wares!
The air smells of ash and sulfur. Can you feel it in your chest?\n\nWe could use your help, if you're available.
We're not done with those volcanic vents just yet. The threat will come again, just as surely as the sun rises. I'll be sure to call on you again when the time comes.

Not that I don't love standing around and chatting with you, but did I mention there's a possibility of volcanic eruption if we don't get this dealt with? I don't mean to rush you but … all right, I am rushing you! Get going!
I don't see smoke on the horizon. Everything better with that volcanic vent?

Feels nice to take a load off, eh? After the things we've been through, we deserve a little relaxation. But not too much! We have to stay sharp. Lazy folks make perfect marks, and if someone stole from me? Well, I've got a reputation to protect!
Come! Test your might against the Ascendant Champion!
You've come to the right place if you want the sorts of things I sell. Oh, please, take a look!\n\nDon't mind me. I'm cooling down from my own recent bouts. Thrilling stuff, these battlegrounds, yes?
Dancing your way through battles, eh? Or maybe stealth is more your way?\n\nRegardless, your victories have earned you great rewards.
<Jester Anglidor has nothing to say while he pulls on a rope only he can see.>
Hounds! Join the show!
A few more hounds should spice up this fight.
My iron friend always puts on a good show.
Ah, there's a quick critter now! Catch it, would you?
Can you conquer this mountain of ice?
I'll watch your back! Go get them!
Trying to borrow my power won't bring you victory.
You're not prepared to wield my power.
Shame there wasn't an audience for this victory.
It's time, brother!
In perfect concert!
A duet of death!
Is it that time again?
Into the drink with you!
Try not to get swept out to sea.
Where's my crew? Show them who rules the seas!
One good spark should set you off.
Don't think I won't exploit such an obvious weakness.
Forming these guardians is trivial. Killing them? Not so much.
Cower and hide while the sky comes crashing down and the reef surges!
A reprieve, for your victory.
If you think you're ready to face my full power, by all means, give chase.
How long must this go on?
I'd trade you all for just one more whiff of skooma.
Just kill me again. Maybe it'll take this time.
Ever visit your old bones now and again? No one else is going to come mourn them.
Never should have meddled with deep druid magic.
Oh, what's he going to do? Kill me?
The only good thing about this is not having to feel the damp of this damn cave.
Wonder if my stash is still safe out there? I'd like to think it's been buried longer than I have.
The spire will never fall!
The spire will never fall!
The master's strength is our strength.
Our brotherhood must remain pure.
It has been too long since my blade drank the life of another.
I would die for the master.
The master's word is our bond. All praise to the Bloodmage.
The master will soon ask us to ride again. Be ready.
Power surges through me! The power of the Crimson Spire!
We control the very power of life. The master's power is our strength.
As the master wills it.
My sword for the spire.
I will obey.
My skill is for the spire.
We must build our ranks. All must serve.
We must build our ranks. All must serve.
My life for the spire!
I live in service to the spire.
I live to serve.
I am the spire's blade.
The spire is my life.
Those that don the crimson are my flesh and blood.
I suppose only the Fleet Queen can give you a proper Dreadsail welcome. Say hello.
I'm not boasting. It's just a fact. \n\nThree different artists have used me as the model for manly knighthood.
Sir Langley sure eats a lot. More than half our gear is food!
What have we got here?
Welcome to my parlor. Enjoy the hospitality!
This isn't the right way.
Anyone falls here, I'll string you up for the harpies to nip at!
Look alive! The battle's come to us!
So, what's your status these days, eh? Single? Hitched? Little of both? You know what, forget I asked. No offense, but the last thing I need is another well-armed, battle-tested ex!
<Jester Anglidor has nothing to say while he pulls on a rope only he can see.>
Bunch of sorry land urchins coming, Sorti! You want <<1>> to stuff them down the scupper?
If they came past the twins, it won't be me that stands in their way.
Keep your weapons to yourselves. Or don't. <<1>>'s always ready for a bout.
I don't mind kowtowing to the Dreadsails if it means having their protection while raiding the Systres.
You'd do well to show fealty to the Fleet Queen. Taleria will take over the Systres soon.
This one has not seen you at any other dives among the Systres. You must have sailed far to deal with Fleet Queen Taleria.
Ugh.
<<1>>. Did he squeal before the end?\n\nHe was a meaty one. Think I'd get in trouble for taking a bite before he gets cold?
I don't know how Taleria started sailing circles around the Dufort fleet, but whatever her trick is, it's working.
Suppose your arrival has something to do with all the commotion outside. Keep the fighting out of here. I hate scrubbing blood off the bar.
Then flies into a rage ….
So run, my sweet lad ….
It's your blood that you'll spill ….
The Roister's Club rewards those who take risks. I assure you—you'll take a great risk by challenging me.
Looking for an opponent worthy of your skill? Well, you've found one.
You've just volunteered to be our sacrifice!
Bretons have a natural aptitude for card games. Don't believe me? Well, have a seat then, and I'll show you!
Victory's just a matter of preparation, my friend, and I've been assembling this deck for months. Think you're ready for it?
You're not one of these "play for the fun of it" folks, are you? For me, fun is optional. Winning is mandatory.
I'm on a winning streak that's hotter than Mauloch's anvil! Come on! Shuffle those cards!
You seem confident. I, too, am certain of victory. Deal your cards so we will see who is right.
I have waited long for an opponent of your skill. Consider this my formal challenge.
I'm bound for Roister's Club glory. And you, darling, are bound for defeat. Let's get to it!
At last! A true challenge. Let's see those cards, darling.
Well, I'm better at Tribute than I used to be, but that's not saying much. Have a seat, and let's see what happens.
Look, I don't know how I made it to this rank, but I want to keep it. So, go easy on me, eh?
Proud of your rank, aren't you? Well it's not about where you are—it's about where you're going. And you're bound for defeat.
The Three smile on me, sera! I've already won three matches today. I'll be a game-baron by weeks end! Come on! Let's play.
The moons always shine on this one in games of chance. Lucky for you, Tribute requires skill also. Let us see which wins out!
The pride of Gonfalon Bay, yes? This one is truly blessed. Come, have a seat!
Tribute, yes? I warn you—I have more tricks than a wamasu has scales. Do you still want to face me?
We both rest in Tribute's highest branches. Let us see who can climb higher still.
I used to spend my spare time brawling, but now I play Tribute instead. It's just as fun, and you lose less teeth!
I could beat any man here with this deck! Would take more time than beating them with an axe or a shovel, but I'm tenacious!
Well, I'd really hoped to speak with High King Emeric today, but I'll settle for partaking of this exquisite banquet. Duchess Elea knows how to entertain.
Word of advice: Leave an old lion to his drink. I've got no pleasant banter in me today.
So many fine people and such a lovely setting. Yet Nadari-dra must ask the question: Where are Queen Ayrenn, High King Emeric, and Prince Irnskar? Has some misfortune befallen them?

I must say, I don't like what I've heard about this Ascendant Order. Bands of lawless knights roaming High Isle's countryside at will. How uncivilized!\n\nI suppose we are safe enough within the castle walls.
How dare you disturb us!
I am one with Satakal.
Good. The runic prisons need fresh volunteers!
Do you feel the strength, sister?
One way or another, you'll serve the Order!
Do you smell that, brother? The stink of fear.
Through death, their lives have purpose.
Ever seen the Fleet Queen conjure a storm? Makes my magic look like a gentle mist.
Throwing ships into the Shipwreck Shoals is the most fun I've had in ages.
Demolishing the wrecks around here is kind of fun.
I'm so sick of mudcrab stew. How do you figure hadolids taste?
Gonfalon Bay must be ripe pickings right now. Hope the fleet finally mounts a raid there soon.
I'm tired of picking over wrecks for bloody parchments in the shoals. When's the real plunder coming?
Does fresh water make your scales itch? Don't know how those tree-lickers stand it.
I hate coming ashore. Can never find my legs.
I'm tired of killing all these half-blood bastards. I want to add a few more Altmer ears to my collection.
Slaughterfish are the worst eating. All teeth.
The spirits call me to drive off the defilers.
The earth speaks to me. It thanks us for our work.
The Draoife are fools. How could some choose peace?
The ritual is tomorrow night, isn't it?
Who defends this land, if not the Eldertide Circle?
Mount Firesong stirs. A change is coming.
Praise to Y'ffre, I befriended an ornaug. A wonderful companion!
We will feed the earth with the invaders' bones and blood.
Why won't the Draoife act? Now is the time!
The Systres are sacred. They must be preserved.
How many invaders must we slaughter before they leave us in peace?
I am ready. I feel Y'ffre's strength inside me!
I'm bored. Anyone want to smash some barrels?
Hope I don't get stuck cleaning the ornaug pens again.
I saw some outsiders wandering around with the boss earlier…
Apparently our prisoner is a very important prince. Who cares?
Nobody better touch my stuff or they'll lose some fingers!
I'm so tired of eating fish all the time.
I said stay back. I don't want to arouse suspicion.
I could go for some crab about now…
Someone tried to steal my rations yesterday. I slit his throat!
This smells like sea water. How close are we to the ocean?
Are you just going to stand there and admire? Come now, you look more like the type to take action, not sit around while it passes you by.

I nearly cut off my own finger doing work on the docks. One of my tavern buddies sent me to see a druid elder for a root to help heal the wound. He was strange, but friendly enough! And I've still got all my fingers!
What are you looking at? I don't have any work, if that's what you're wondering. I operate on my own and if you were smart, you'd do the same.
You hear talk about how this place is a paradise of sorts, but it's just like any other place. People come, people go, everyone has their own problems.
Can't be sure, but I think the ground started shaking when I took work from a second lady. I've doomed us all.

I think if I was to become a knight, I would want to be of the Oaken Order. Slim chance of that, though. My sister was a rare case because a noble decided to sponsor her. No one would be foolish enough to sponsor someone like me. Still, I can dream.
A storm has delayed my ship? I'll drink to that!
When I was younger, I watched the druids sing to the fishes. Now the druid's songs are quiet. I miss them.
The Ancient Anchor's ale is good, but their food is even better. Bit pricey, though.
Forgetting your prayers will cost you in the end.
When I get enough coin, I'm going to get out of here and go back home where I can't smell dead fish and saltwater at every moment of the day.

Did you know that talking to plants sometimes helps them grow? I don't think it matters much what you say. Personally, I like to tell them about my dreams and secrets. I like to think they keep them safe.
I've tried to show many druids the way of the Eight Divines. Most are unreceptive. \n\nPerhaps I'm fighting a losing battle.
I'll take a glass of wine, thank you.\n\nOh, my mistake. At first glance I thought you to be one of the servants. Deepest apologies.

The wonders of our natural world, contained within my goods, and blessed by Y'ffre's followers.\n\nAnd I give each item a bit of an extra buff and shine to remove the marks of the earthier of the hands that touch them.
These puny creatures aren't worth my time.
This place echos something terrible.
My only wish is that the druids of the deep suffered a fate worse than ours.
With those lodestones and the Fleet Queen's magic, we're untouchable.
Seems like you're already on bad terms with the Fleet Queen. You wouldn't mind crossing her a little more then, for the right price?
Well done, the runes must not have been as difficult to locate as I feared.\n\nSince you're here, why not take the opportunity to try the device for yourself?
Such opinionated companions. Mathluz thinks he has a better chance of getting off this island on his own. They are amusing though, yes?

I thought the chaotic fluctuations were the result of the runes, but now I'm reevaluating that theory. The output is much more intense as I'm sure you can tell.\n\nI'll have to recruit some more volunteers and see if there's an underlying pattern.
Die and die and die again! It's all we're good for!
The stone that holds us prisoner will one day crumble, but we're eternal. Then our patience will be rewarded!
If I'd have known this is how it would end I wouldn't have feared mutiny.
The deep will free us, it just needs more! I know just what to give it.
Big mistake!
Ooh, that one was satisfying!
Take that, you overgrown lizard! We're Dragon slayers!
This cat needs a nap after that!
Finally, a real challenge.
It's huge! Let's take it down!
We're the best!
I'm not bleeding so much anymore! Thanks!
I'm not going to make it much longer!
Break free!
They're messing with your head!
You have to rally!
You stopped them just in time!
Hey! I need you in this fight! Don't give up!
Magicka! Now!
You can do this! You need a second wind!
I love it when you do that!
Get a load of this!
Come on, let's do this together!
Easy to get lost in a place like this. I think that's one of my favorite parts about cities.
This place gives me the creeps.
Look at us! Off on an adventure!
Let's ride!

I was thinking about trying out a new spell. I want to animate my hair and make it into a weapon. Sure, there are some risks associated. Like, what if my hair chokes me instead of my enemies? Actually, that's a fairly big risk. Maybe I'll hold off.
That bag either has something valuable, something useless, or a body part inside it.
I never knew Tamriel could look like this.
Every day I feel like I understand more about magic than I did before.
What did you find? Let me see!
You're brave, reaching in there like that.
Ooh, shiny.
Adventuring with you really keeps a girl on her toes. You're getting stronger all the time!
You like to talk, don't you? I don't mind, I guess, but I'm not really one for deep, meaningful chats.
Hey, you. Everything all right?
I'm right here if you need anything.
I'm not a fan of dogs. They smell and drool too much. Werewolves are even worse because they're the same, only bigger and chattier.
Things are good! You put up with me, which is more than I can say for most.
You've got adventure in your blood, there's no one else I'd rather be around.
You've made my life way more exciting. I hope I can return the favor!
You changed my life for the better. I don't know how I can ever repay that.
Did I miss anything good?
You're so annoying! Don't come looking for me.
Die, mongrel! Oh, that feels good.
I love killing werewolves. Can we do this more often?
I wonder if I'd cut it in the Thieves Guild. Something for the future, maybe.
I never get sick of that! The Thieves Guild is the best!
You're welcome, High Isle!
Magic is great until you make it all official and structured. Where's the fun?
Steal anything good?
Stinks to be them today.
Not a very good guard, if you ask me.
You should steal from pompous mages more often. It tickles my heart.
Good stuff in there?
Bet they're going to miss that!
Smells like trouble in here. I love it.
What a deal!
This is my favorite part!
Eat our dust, dung-for-brains!
You're going to have to teach me how to do that.
Magister Irin never let me watch him do this, it's so interesting!
Games like this bring people together. You can have nothing in common with someone and still have fun.
You got some good stuff out of that, didn't you?
That's a lot of coin!
You've got to be kidding. We're better than this!
Aw, come on!
I love eating fish but catching them has always been way too much work for me.
I'm trying not to experiment too much with my spells here. It's a nice place, probably nicer if it's not infested with magicked toads. Though, that would be funny.
This is the only thing between me and freedom.
My family will pay when I get off this forsaken rock!
This vacation's not what I expected. Said there'd be taverns here. Where'd they go? It's a shame.
Do you know my traveling companion used to be a charming man? Yes, I'm struggling to believe it myself.
We're in this together!
Hey Stendarr? Thanks for keeping us safe.
Dame Isobel the Dragon Slayer. The other knights will be so jealous.
There was a moment in there where I was worried. But just a moment!
This one looks tough. Get your guard up!
Dame Isobel and the Dragon! Here we go!
Stow your weapons, my friend. We've won.
I'm not dead! Thanks!
I need healing!
Move, get out of there!
I'm right here, stay focused!
You won't take them! Not on my watch!
Now, press your attack!
Stendarr save you, you're wounded!
Recover your magicka, if you can!
You look tired, be on guard!
A battle to remember!
<Strained shouting.>
Let's do this together!

Ships from the Veloise Mercantile make call here in Wayrest every single day. My parents are here almost as often as they're home at Gonfalon Bay. I wonder if they're here now? Probably hip-deep in some deal, no doubt.

Have you ever had an Orsinium dessert? Say what you will about Snegh as a knight-in-training, but he brought back the most delicious dishes to share from his clanmatron. Orc moms do not skimp on the sugar.
A city of Daedra, I can't imagine a worse place to be. My blade is ready.
Stendarr keep me safe. And my coins in my purse!
Now this is why I joined you. This place is great!
You've got the reins.
Here we go.

I don't know why, but our adventures today remind me of Aurelia. You know when we get into battle, that comradeship we've developed? I haven't had that with anyone but Aurelia before. Of course, Aurelia and I never waded into battle together, so ….
There's a supply sack just there.
Riding with you is quite the journey. Look around us!
Your guidance has made me a better knight. Thank you.
Looking forward to see what you make with that.
What did you find in there?
Wonder what price that lot might fetch.
Draigh! You're paying next time we stop for a meal.
Like every good story, your tale just grows in the telling.
My honor as a knight is the only thing keeping me here.
My blade is yours.
Let's get into it. Side by side.

The Daedra fill me with … loathing isn't the right word. Fury. Their darkness threatens everyone and everything on Nirn. \n\nStendarr gives me the strength to fight them, and I swear to do so at every turn.
Stendarr willing, our adventures have only just begun!
I offered you my blade hardly knowing anything about you. You've been so kind to me ever since.
I'm still so grateful you took me into your service. The adventures we've had, the sights we've seen … they mean the world to me.
Anyone who's put up with my nattering on about stories and sweets as long as you have has to be my best friend.
I'm right beside you. Let's get out there.
I can't help you right now. I'm sorry your decisions have led to this.
And never return, fiend!
You were spectacular. Stendarr's might flowed through you, I could almost see it!
What do you think Bolgrul does when he's not at the Enclave? Do you think he has any hobbies?
Home sweet home. Always makes me proud when we can help the people of High Isle.
You've got this! Lay on, my friend!
Ooh, that really woke me up. A bracing combat.
We may not remember them in a few day's time, but they will remember your actions forever.
All of these beasts are so interesting. Before I left home I'd never seen anything like them!
I learn a little more from you every time you're at the anvil.
You have to teach me how to make that. It smells so good!
Ahh, excellent repairs. Good technique.
I know you can make better choices.
I don't know why you consider these actions just. They are not.
Please, you're better than this. Look within you, fight the abomination!
I'm going to keep a tight hold of my coin purse until we're well clear of this place.
The Brotherhood's work here tips the scales of power. But the cost ....
You may forget this choice in moments, but they will not.
Have you seen my copy of. Um. The Maiden's Tight Hold? I haven't had a chance to finish it yet and I just got to the best part.
How did you find me?
I saw one of the folks cheering me on get hauled off by the guards a bit ago. Wonder if they're heading to Amenos Station. Eh, well, not my problem, right?

Some of the druids have strange stories. One talks about how she walked around Dufort Shipyards covered in snails and nobody there said a word.\n\nWish I knew how she got the snails all over her. That could have come in useful in my last match.
Damn.
You probably saw this coming.
If you venture into town, look for the cats. At least one of them really likes to get a good cuddle in.\n\nNo, I'll not tell you which. Part of the fun is in the seeking.
You've got to be kidding.
Just what I was waiting for ….
Mauloch's jawbone!
I earned that one.
The cards favor you.
A stroke of luck!
I'll get out of this … somehow.
I won't waste this opportunity.
You can't do that! Wait, yes you can. Damn.
Even I can't screw this up!
Oh, for Ayem's sake ….
There we are!
Fate has her claws out, I see.
Sleek strategy, yes?
As mud is my mother ….
Seizo!
Oh, come on!
This'll shake things up!
Just a little more limbering up, then we can spar.
The worst part about Gonfalon? Fish. What self-respecting lady wants be surrounded by reeking peasant food.
Someone order all the rum in Gonfalon? Ought to tap one of these kegs myself.
Remember those less fortunate in these troubling times!
There's something brewing in the Systres right now. Seems a good time to find a new port.
What sloppy signaling. I'll need to complain to the watch captain.
D-don't trust the sea! It'll betray you f-for the Fleet Queen and you'll end up like m-me!
Weather's growing unpredictable. The port's going to be in a tangle.
You shoot a sea bird just after it's snatched a fish you can get two meals at once.
Only a fool sets sail without making an offering to the Divines.
Am I to the left? Or perhaps to the right?
You're doing great! Just a bit longer!
You must kill it! Hurry!
Look out! Atronachs! Kill them before they reach the vents!
Another vent sealed!
The small vents are sealed. I'll close off the main one.
<Stern Faun grunting>
<Assertive Faun bleating>
<Weary Faun grunting>
<Soft Faun trilling>
Saved at last! I owe you my life, stranger.

Once Rigurt was forced to eat paws-on-a-stick. Very strange Wood Elf food. I could not get tiny Wood Elf to tell me where paws came from, but it tasted … not terrible.\n\nDid have a claw stuck between teeth for a week though.
Rigurt has met many people. Visited many places. \n\nAlinor is nice, but the tall, skinny Elves have so many rules. Rigurt could barely keep them all straight!

So good to be here with bestest cultural assistant in all of Tamriel! Rigurt would be lost without you, my friend.\n\nActually, Rigurt is sort of lost. Where in Oblivion are we? Rigurt might have had one too many casks of mead last night.
My house in Stonelore Grove serves as a place where people know they can find me. When I wish to be alone, I go into the wilderness.
Learn something and teach something every day, and you will make the world a better place.
The great nobles of the Systres Archipelago distrust druids, but they have nothing to fear from the Stonelore Circle. We are content to outwait them. We know that rock endures.
The anger of Mount Firesong left many scars across High Isle. When I return home, I will do what I can to heal them.

Been trying to think of an alternate means to earn income. I finally think I've got something. You ready? Street performer! Oh yes!\n\nFigure I'll start small—like, a living statue. I already stand around all day. Why not get paid for it?

Want to work your way up the Tribute rankings? Just don't forget your old pal Brahgas when you get to the top!\n\nIt can get lonely up there. Or so I hear. My relationship with the top is more, you know … conceptual.

Thanks again for taking care of Sorinne. If we'd lost her … gods. It would be like getting our hearts cut out. And not carefully extracted after we're dead. I'm taking about really getting in there. Like, with a flint knife and a soup spoon.
If you're looking for company, you'll need to buy me another drink. I'm not drunk enough for any of that foolishness quite yet.
You got it!
Voices of root. Voices of many!
All this killing is giving me an appetite.
This is how they follow Y'ffre?
You won't stand in our way!
Aww. Aren't you a hero.
They're hurting the Spirit of Stone!
Insects in the Deeproot. Burrowing. Eating at us.
The Spirit of Air is mine. The seed is mine. You're outmatched.
The seed will be found. Not by us. Not by us.
That's it? That's who you thought would defeat me?
Leave one for me!
<<Sniffling, runny nose.>>
Your corpse will feed the dirt.
Stone is cold and dead. No wonder their defenses failed.
You won't see another day.
I can never seem to get that flashy move right.
Look, more come to slaughter.
Dirt everywhere! No lava. No magma. Just boring dirt!
Get ready, here it comes!
We grow stronger. Strong enough to deal with you!
Lose your voice to the Rootspeak!
You challenge me? My fangs will gnaw on your bones!
I'll toss you from this cliff!
Don't be afraid. You'll hardly feel the tide of your blood leaving you.
Your blood is delicious!
I can feel your veins. I can taste them!
Do not stand there! Dance under the sea with me!
Poor mortal of weak mind.
We retreat into the dirt.
Hooves defend our grove. Defend!
Hmm. I'll need more of this soothing balm.
They see what can no longer hurt them. Is that right?
Everyone here is suffering the same things. Jergerd's not alone.
Here looking for the patients? This one doubts you'll find who you seek. No one ever does.
Friends, behind you.
Don't talk to me. I'm not in the mood.
Never thought I'd share a room with a Dark Elf, but the healers made me.
Can't take it. Not real!
The view here is strange. It all feels so far away.
Die, lapdog!

Another day, another challenge, yes? This one hopes you have been practicing, because the competition is heating up!\n\nOr maybe just Kishka is heating up. No more of Marunji's fire-dumplings for Kishka!
Nothing beats a full belly … aside from this challenge!\n\nMarunji jests, of course. No challenge is better than a tummy full of sweet-blossom truffles!
Make em' pay for my crew!

You have quick fingers, and while your skill is admirable, it's also … ugh. I always feel like such a stick in the mud. Aurelia used to joke that I was worse than the guard. \n\nLook, please don't steal things in front of me? Thank you, my friend.
Soon we'll be able to fix everything.
How will you deal with this?
An imperfect design.
A small sip of life.
I made another barrier, take cover!
Very entertaining.
I can create mountains from nothing!
Even a little magic can give pain.
Spirits of wolves past, deal with them.
I will bring you down!
You can't run from me!
Cower at my strength!
I'll snap your neck with my paw!
I'll let my magic deal with you.
The longer you wait, the hungrier I become.
Watching you struggle was such fun.
The ground quakes with power. Our goal is close.
The bears will protect our ways.
Archdruid Michiel has things well in hand. The spirit will be ours.
I spit at mainlander boldness.
Make sure the bears are prepared.
The Firesong will burn its enemies into oblivion!
It's a pity I can't make this kind of money as an ingredients hireling instead. Even if I could, it'd be such a disappointment to my parents.
This crew should feel lucky to have my magic.
With a crew this big, there's nothing and no one we can't conquer.
I bet I could out drink any of those Gilded frauds.
Can't wait to get back out onto the sea.
Curses, is that a crack in my staff? Damned salt water.
The Dreadsails have gotten so big these days.
The tips of my ears are going to dull if we keep this up.
My adders look hungry ….
Down with the nobles and the false kings!
The winds are calm, but another storm brews.
Swift and silent. That's the best type of kill.
It's an honor to wear this armor!
It takes talent to casts spells powerful enough to slay your enemies.
The Ascendant Lord is the only one I will follow!
I do not trust Sea Elves. Pirates and slavers, all of them.
Is it true? The sacred seeds of the Dream have been found?
The Stonelore have lost their way. We are meant to be as one.
A simple vine across a path is an effective snare.
Quell an eruption, and you only make the next one stronger.
A forest spirit … can it really be?
Fire clears the way for new growth. It is a cycle.
Ash and cinders! These gloves are singed.
I was promised a place in the temple. Instead, I am here.
Mount Firesong senses it too. Times are changing.
Not even a good try. But fun to watch you sizzle.
<Weary Faun grunting>
<Soft Faun trilling>
<Assertive Faun bleating>
<Stern Faun grunting>
Screw Orgnum, he can take his loyalty and stuff it.
Eugh, those spriggans give me the chills.
Do you mind? I'm trying to work.
My neighbor is much bigger than me, and very muscular! He'd make a much better ghost servant!
I trust those Sea Elves no farther than I could throw one.
Mainlanders are overrunning Galen. We should do something.
Let Mornard's knights come. We'll broil them in their armor.
Have you noticed shalks and vulk'esh leave each other alone?
I'll feed you when we find treasure! Treasure! Squawk!
The rain is not enough to cleanse this island.
He doesn't stop. Please make him stop.
You'll take this ship over my corpse!
The pain needs to stop. It's endless. Make it stop.
Get your hands off my treasure!
Bretons look at me and think, oh a wispy High Elf. They don't think I can haul more in one hand than they can in two.
Sometimes I hear strange things in the darkest hours of the night. Surely just lingering nightmares.
I'm drinking for dust. One sip for every spec.
Hush now Cornflower. Concentrate on the melody.
Do you see how dusty the floor is? Sign of well priced-drinks that is.
Too many new faces around these days.
Last time I studied here, some drunkard threw shells all over my book.
Mind your leathery bits by the stables. Those beasts might be lovely, but some of them like to chew on sweaty leather armor on account of the salt.
So many visitors come to this fountain and wish I had a pint. Well, I don't know if that was their wish, but it's what happens when I fish out their coin.
The rushing water from the stream below can be quite calming. Though, it has led to my falling asleep while reading from time to time.
Did someone put up wards in case this place floods again?
I didn't enjoy the musky, earthy smell at first, but it's grown on me. So has a little bit of lichen, but nothing a helpful hand can't fix.
I don't know, I think I'd rather do kitchen work.
Nothing more sad than a plant not reaching its full potential. That's why I like spending so much time helping them along.
Clean walls hide spoiled foundations. Mark my words!
The key is to spear near the tide pools. The big fish enjoy snacking on all the little fish that make their homes in the rocks.
My ears know a good tune when they hear one.
I wish the newcomers would stop tossing refuse into the bushes.
All right you baseless fools, this is what a real thief looks like.
Who took my mace? It was right here.
I think it was my grandfather who redid some of the tile work in this room. Wonder if he'd be proud of me and how far I've come. Ah well, best not to dwell.
Two moons, what a day it has been.
When was the last time we had a festival here? The Divines are angry.
If that parchment comes in with water damage again, I don't know what I'm going to do.
Where is that drink I ordered?
Vastyr is such a beautiful city, but I still want to improve it.
Nearly out of bait. That's no good.
After a long day I like to let my feet cool off in the water and watch the boats sail by.
Why will no one tell me how the stone and cup game works!
Next catastrophe in Galen? Roll the dice and see!
The work and craftsmanship that goes into building a galleon is a sight to behold. Truly marvelous.
The great thing about a port like Vastyr's is access to some really wonderful imported paints. Hard to find a good cerulean in the archipelago, let me tell you.
I bide my time until I find the Far Shores by chronicling what I witness here.
Just a little more … there. Perfect.
There is a strange stench here. I'll find it.
Let me see those feathers. Are you molting?
Smell of fish always makes me hungry. Even bad fish.
I once made a noble cry at the sight of my pottery. Kind fellow. Bought out my entire stand that day.
I do try to practice my meditation from time to time. Helps keep scary thoughts of missing manifests and empty crates at bay.
Anytime they tell me to sweep out here, there're important discussions going on inside. I suppose I'm not trusted enough to do my job.
The sea creatures are leaping today. Good fortune for me and my nets!
Why'd I have to even go and open my dumb mouth?
This one just loves the smell of inn tables. So many past meals, so many jokes and lively conversations. It's joyous, yes?
You're back! I did, as they say, cross my fingers for you.
Don't return empty-handed. Failing that, at least return with a story to tell. And if you can't do that … at least make it back alive.
What phenomenal timing! Something new just came in. Any interest?

Magic isn't so different from the sea. Tu'whacca will knock you on your arse quick as you please if you underestimate one or the other. But take the time to study them? Respect them? Ah, then you'll rejoice in the true spoils of each.

There was a craven lad on my ship in the early days, but he wasn't cut out for the sea. Liked the gold well enough, but hated the pirating. He got run through with a blade on his second voyage. Too bad he couldn't take his gold to the grave.
If you attempt to pet this one or make silly noises at her, Clan Mother Tadali will teach you something about Khajiiti claw-dancing.
Keep your paws to yourself, walker. Never seek to pat an Alfiq without asking permission first.
When you see that lazy excuse for Tadali's son, Za'ji, tell him to write his mother. This one misses her cub.

I'm Captain Isara Davaux of the King's Jest. Sailed straight from Wayrest to High Isle to get upgraded for battle. My fine vessel was among the first fourteen ships to pledge our sails and anchors to Olo's vision. We're going to make those slugs pay!

What's the All Flags Navy? Have you been hiding under a rock? It's only the largest naval force ever assembled in Tamrielic history! We should all thank Baron-Admiral Bendu Olo for bringing us together. His bold vision will ensure our victory!

You know, I forgot all about Captain Renwic and the Pristine Halberd. Fine ship and captain both. Not sure what you did, but I'm glad to have them both back in the forefront of my mind. And it will be good to have them with us when we sail to Thras!
Now that's the smell of a job completed, if I've ever … er, never mind. How'd you make out?
Look at you! All enthusiastic. Wish I had something to give you, but you'll just have to come back tomorrow.
Fowl or fish? Both are on the menu today.
What sounds better? The Great Galen Tour or Gallivanting Across Galen? Oh, apologies, you're probably here for work.
I wonder if Glurdekh wants to go for a drink later.
I wonder if the druids hid any treasures in these tunnels when the Bretons took over Vastyr.
The stone and the tide can defeat the fire. Only together. Not apart.
Hmm … this book is about rouge, not rogues. Nice to know some dyes are made from crushed beetle shells, though.\n\nI should really consider a career in proofreading.
It's comfortable down here, but that hermit crab is … unsettling.
It is too hot for chores or work.
Think on the sound of water, the smell on the breeze. These things will anchor your magic.
Sometimes the fish refuse to be caught.
This book says druids eat worms. Blight and rot, we only do that on special occasions!
My mind burns with thoughts of vengeance.
I know your wounds hurt, little one. Nearly done with the poultice.
We're Eldertide. We shouldn't need the help of the Stonelore.
I thought all Stonelore were spineless fish, but did you see that druid slap Clemence?
Bloom in peace, little one. You're safe here.
So many flowers. The Stonelore must really be pleasing Y'ffre.
They leave their pottery exposed? No wonder it cracks.
That … really hurts.
Listen. The flowers will tell you when they've had their fill.
The earth spirits whisper like shifting sands.
That heron's been overfishing. Only got minnows left here.
So once I master this, you'll teach me to make vines grow?
Severed at the roots, hmm? That can't be good.
I ought to write House Mornard for more supplies.
I need a snack that's easy to eat while playing Tribute. Maybe Chef Rhazeez has some ideas.
Wonder if Marwig sorted out that spell yet.
If I fall in and drown, I guess that's on me.
Just as the tide goes out, so too goes any more work I might offer. But come back tomorrow, and something else is sure to wash up!
All these trials prove the rightness of our cause.
Let us drive the nobles and their knights into the sea!
We should send someone to hunt for food.
We should train again tomorrow.
Interlopers!
I sharpened my blade for you.
I trained my entire life for your return.
Delay if you wish. I have all the time.
The prophecy is fulfilled.
Toss those bodies into the pits.
Alert the guards!
Have them bring another laborer.
Invaders in our home!
Bring him to me.
This will go quickly.
<long sigh>
What do you think of the Matriarch?
I do not fear your threats, Scourge!
I've waited years for this moment.
You wish to die screaming to the sky?
Die, creatures!
Such miserable attempts at escape. And for what?
Weak. You never stood a chance.
Oh, this is rich. What are you doing here?
But I was chosen.
Absurd what these sailors are charging for passage to Y'ffelon. One of these days, though, I'll make the trip to see the volcano up close. One of these days.
A friend once suggested I write my smithing techniques down in a journal. But who has time for that? Hah!\n\nHow can I help you today?
We'll make sure things are put to rights. Probably with your help. Heh.\n\nWhat are you looking for?
I once worked with metal that whispered in the flames. A mage later told me that I'd broken some curse or other.\n\nHah, never you worry though. These wares are guaranteed curse-free!
More trouble in Galen … you interested in helping out again? There's good coin in it for you.
The threat of the vents will rear its ugly head once more, don't you worry. Be ready. I'll be sure to call on you when it does.
Please hurry. Galen is relying on you to prevent utter catastrophe.
I've been hearing whispers that the vent has been sealed. Is it true?
After everything that's happened, I'm thinking of getting a pet. Perhaps a feline of some sort.\n\nI wonder if Varisse likes pets. I shall ask her after work.
I wonder what life is like as a druid. Being so close to the earth, the sky.\n\nMakes me yearn for the comfort of my old nests. A warm fire should suffice.
Don't you ever wish you were just sitting at home, warming your scales by the fire?\n\nWorking here is great though. Not sure how else I'd meet people.
Now, I don't know the first thing about Sea Elves or Dreadsails or what have you.\n\nWhat I do know is how to kick back and enjoy a brew. You should try it.
You know what is a great distraction? Playing with recipes and coming up with new brews.\n\nYou know what is an even better distraction? Drinking them.
There's nothing like drinking a fresh brew and letting the sea breeze through your hair.\n\nGive it a try, the weather is great.
I once had a mentor who advised licking the wood before you worked it. Swore he could taste the shape it would take.\n\nI for one won't be risking the splinters.
A beautiful thing a piece of wood. Imagine having your whole history written inside of you.\n\nAll it takes is some care and attention to reveal what's hidden inside.
Don't be afraid to run your hand along my wares. There's not a stray splinter or sharp edge in sight.\n\nLuck and clear roads to you, wayfarer.
As a young apprentice, I once asked my master who would be foolish enough to think that there was nothing finer than a plank of sanded hickory. \n\nTo which he of course replied, yew wood.

Yes, the ale has mites in it. They're a special additive that some of our druid patrons pay extra for.\n\nIt's not to my taste, but druid gold spends the same as anyone else's. Now, how can I help you?
The cathedral will be the talk of the town for months, I'm sure. If you've got any good news to share, mind that you don't keep it to yourself!
If you're seeking something to commemorate your adventures, you've come to the right place. A piece that sparks conversation can always pull a room together.
Plenty of customers forgo helmets when buying a set of armor. It's all the same to me. No use in protecting your head if you're not even using it.
Too many people prioritize the look of their armor over actual protection. The only benefit I can see is that it makes it easy to identify your corpse.
The land turns on you quick outside Vastyr. Most of what might find you in the wilds won't be friendly, so make sure you can fend for yourself.
If you're looking for some sort of pleasure cruise, look elsewhere. We're about the destination on this ship, not the journey. \n\nWhere are you headed?
"Stowaway" doesn't seem like it should be such a hateful term, right? It's not as if a crate's much different than a cabin, anyway. It's all just a matter of how you decide to dress it up!
Supply in the Systres isn't the problem. It's transport. Mornard, Dufort, who cares! I'll throw in my loyalty with whoever takes care of those damn Sea Elves.
I don't want to hear any complaints about my prices. If I were genuinely trying to rob you, I'd save us both time and tell you to your face.
Many new faces in Vastyr these days. It certainly gives me a feeling. I'm sure you feel it too.
My mounts are hardy enough to traverse Galen, which means they'll do just fine anywhere else you might venture in Tamriel.
I've got mounts that'll get you to where you need to go. You need them to do it faster, or with a heavier load, well, I can help with that too.

Folks come in all the time to withdraw gold, then turn around and lose it all betting on a game of Tribute. Some big names, too! People you wouldn't believe.\n\nBut I shouldn't say any more. What can I do for you?
I once had a thane from Morthal propose marriage to me. He was everything I wanted in a man, but I just couldn't imagine living in Skyrim, of all places.\n\nAnyway, what can I do for you?
I'm a druid! A steward of nature! Not a damn waiter! Why doesn't she understand that?
My last husband hated the Systres. It's part of the reason I came here in the first place. That and, well, there's always something interesting to talk about.\n\nHow might I be of assistance?
I may set the cost, but the sentiment of a piece is entirely up to the buyer. What a treasure it is to see how different people prize different things.

Something so relaxing about preparing a meal. If it weren't for the aches in my wrists I'd never notice working the day away. \n\nYou would have to stick a lantern in my face and holler my name otherwise.
I won't pretend like I sell the best food here in Vastyr, but I'll make sure you're well fed and taken care of and that's a whole lot more than most would do for a traveler like yourself.

Between the aches in my bones and the chips in this cleaver I would say I've worked ten times what was ever expected of me, but that is just the way we are in Vastyr.\n\nWe rise to the occasion, no matter the odds.
New leadership in Vastyr, eh? Don't know how that's going to affect our usual routes out of the Systres. But we'll do our best to get you where you're headed.
Druid circles can quarrel all they want. Noble houses can wage war for centuries. But it's the birds who truly rule these islands, you hear me?
One of the Stonelore Druids offered to mediate this hostility between me and the gulls. Can you believe that? \n\n… Would something so stupid even work?
If I don't have what you need, I probably know someone who does. Just a little benefit of being the only inn in town.
Never much liked crowds. Suppose I came to Galen to get away from it all. \n\nTrouble is, so did everybody else.
Folk here don't give up ground easily. Y'ffelon could smother the island in lava, and you can bet you'd see folks from Vastyr burning their feet to try and claim the land before it cooled.
I offer guild rates on jewelry and staves. The opinions I offer come free of charge.
Heard people say that we Orcs have complicated relationships with magic. \n\nAnyone who has a simple relationship either already got killed by it, or is going to get killed by it. End of story.
Careful where you point all your sharp bits and hard edges. Everything in here is very delicate. Well, everything save for myself.
If you are thinking of haggling remember that at any given moment an enchanter has a small satchel of runestones to hit you upside the head with.
Nothing sells enchantments faster than a party. Everyone is always trying to impress someone. Why not add a little spark or glitter to an evening gown. Want to try?
I love a good pair of gloves, no, wait, a belt! Yes, a good belt, or perhaps boots? Yes, big, thick boots. No, no. Belt. That's my final answer.
When I married my wife I made the most comfortable bed spread out of, what I thought was, her dowry. It was actually, in fact, her pet cow. I mean, who has a pet cow?
Sometimes, chewing on a piece of leather helps me think. There's a good chance I've chewed on every item here at least once, in fact!
In the market for a new bag? Nothing better than that new bag smell. Fresh leather and endless possibilities.
Someone came in earlier asking for a bag for their bags? The wonder and imagination of youth is an inspiring thing.
Some pack merchant friends of mine have spoken at great length about the benefits of fish leather. I may just have to give it a try.
It is always a pleasure having such a well-traveled visitor. These eyes are always in need of inspiration and your garments are doing just the trick, Wayfarer.
All I can do is keep focused on every stitch, every seam, but if it isn't my hands shaking it's the blasted ground.
I have considered using coral from the backs of local crabs as adornments, but those pincers are far too intimidating for me. I just wait for someone in the market to sell them.
Every item in here is an authentic, handmade replica of the finest quality. And if you do not believe me, check the stitching. It does not lie.
Some folks dream about settling down, having a few kids, but me? No way. I will not be happy until I have found the perfect sconces to have in my bedroom.
If you decide to stay in Vastyr, be sure to remember me. We've got the finest furniture this side of Galen.
I have a little bit of everything, which is quite impressive considering we're on an island.
I often buy pelts and other goods from the local druids. Strange to see them at each other's throats like this. Makes me uneasy.
You know what I say? You can never have enough stuff. And when folks around here want stuff, they come to me.
While I am curious about their ways, I rarely bother making the journey to observe the druids and their magics.
I'll spend some time communing with the stars tonight to honor Count Mornard. Even magic needs to process grief.
Training in the mystic arts is well worth your time, Wayfarer. The Mage's Guild is always available to help guide you along your journey.
There is nothing more relaxing than the sweet smell of the sea breeze. Stop awhile and take a deep breath.
It wasn't an easy victory, but we showed those pirates and Sea Elves what for. Hope they think twice before trying something like this again.
I had never considered exploring the more wild parts of this island. After everything that's happened, seems a shame to leave its beauty unseen.
This one smells something sweet on the air. A delicious treat? Or, perhaps coin looking to be spent?
I am pleased to find your perusing my wares. What can Arzalaya do for you, traveler?
This one finds the clinking of coins to be a pleasing sound alongside that of sea spray and bubbling stew.
My grandfather used to say that druids spoke through the breeze and lightning. Makes me wonder what these quakes are trying to say.
I do miss the fjords of Skyrim, but that's not to say leaving these sandy beaches would be easy.
If you're in search of fine arms and rare goods, then look no further. I have everything a warrior could need right here.
What's this? We'll teach you to steal our kill!
I will have vengeance for the harm you've caused.
Kick the thing into the lava and we can avoid a fight.
All right, it's time to let go now. This is beginning to hurt.
Ha! Take that!
I'll take care of this one.
Come here, wandering friend. I have an experience you don't want to miss out on.
He's ready for me. Just help pry him out of there.
Squawk! Do you know how long I've been looking for you? Squawk!
It's tapping into the distortion's power!
Quickly now, it's about to release!
To the light! Quickly!
Disable that orb!
Agh, it's slimy in here!
What threat could you pose to the Firesong?
Frog, man, or mer. None will stop me!
Why are you behaving like this?
Concentrate on your job!
I prefer the beach. Those caves smell musty.
Just another day taking orders from Sea Witches.
I'll be honest—I hate the sea.
The sound of the ocean relaxes me.
She always rejected me before now.
Why aren't the others helping me?
By the way—where's Quen? Probably should have asked earlier. I can't believe she's vanished like this.\n\nSince you're here instead, please search for anything on the relic.
We're going too far.
I will send you and your ship to the bottom!
Maybe I'll strike a bargain with that chef. Hunt her fresh meat in exchange for free meals.
Maybe I should go find out what things I can gather and sell here in Necrom until I can find companions we feel safe traveling home with. What do you think, my little friend?
I thought I saw a candle go out, that never happens.
There's nothing to do with the Stormwing quarantined.
A good spot … until a guard comes along and asks to see a permit. Then what?
The water here always ripples. I know. I've watched it.
They speak tough words, but their spines are willow branches.
The comings and goings of people in this dry-stone city puzzle me. Perhaps I shall stay for a while. But I must find somewhere to wallow.
Hear me, ancestors of the Dark Elves.
Someone here's got too much coin and bad luck with cards. I just need to meet him.
Perhaps I should ask the Hist for my next set of dice. I've had abysmal luck.
He didn't leave me. I left him! And went straight to the tap to celebrate.
If we're careful with the saw, I think we can make more than we planned!
I heard House Telvanni is getting ornery again.
Something has to happen around here. Anything.
There. That should do … if I can get some customers.
I'll never be able to master these mortuary processes.
Half of my job here is making amends with the dead.
The pigments I bought from that Khajiit sparkle more than I expected. Almost a ghostly afterimage … I hope they weren't acquired from a tomb elsewhere.
We're supposed to be neutral here, but it's just as cutthroat as everywhere else.
I was once mighty. Look at me and weep.
Where is she? Well. A pleasant place to wait, at least.
Father, I model my life after yours. You modeled yours after the saints, as is proper. I remain grateful for your teachings. May the Tribunal watch over us all.
Not bad at all. Expensive, but what else am I going to spend my coin on?
Please stop yelling at me.
I'm starting to think no one wants to join my cult.
May the Three watch over him and guide him!
Lots of little otos today. Not a bad catch, I guess.
Seasons pass and her spirit is still angry with me.
It's so difficult, letting go of her like this.
The crunch of the bloodtooth may soften your teeth, but boil it in oil and share tasty treats.
Why must there be all this talk and unrest, it makes the dead jittery.
Maybe someday I'll go to Eldenroot. Someday.
Oh, I blunted the edge on a troll's skull. They've got some hard heads, ha!
The dark corners of Necrom exist only for thieves and the dead. Get out of here.
Think you can keep up?
Is the dust here bone dust? It tastes a bit like bone dust. Why do I know that?
Cities may change, but the smell of a harbor is the same across Tamriel.
Nice thing about Necrom? There are no nice things about Necrom.
Some of the best alchemical ingredients can be found under rocks. Slimy lichen, darting lizards, even the most mundane of skittering bugs have within them the building blocks of a powerful potion.
I'm bringing you Necrom's finest armors! All for your perusal!\n\nCare to take a gander?
This city's bustling. If you pass on something you like, I can't guarantee I'll have it the next time you come by.
Trying to decide which bank to use? You could go with the Nord, yes. But, this is not Solitude. You're in Necrom, and Dark Elves have more experience running businesses in this city.
You'll be pleased to know we are exceptionally incurious about what you leave with us. A good practice when dealing with Telvanni.\n\nWhat can we do for you?
You have the look of someone who has traveled very far. Stay a while and share stories of your travels with a fellow, albeit retired, adventurer.
You've got a fine eye for craftmanship, I can tell.\n\nSee anything you like?
I got one of those Dark Elves to say my food was decent. \n\nA compliment from a Dark Elf. That's how you know my cooking's good!
All the other merchants here are so talented. I hope my clothes meet your expectations.
Runes and glyphs, freshly dusted by my little friend here! Guaranteed to enhance the effects of all your enchanting.\n\nWhat can I get you today?
Just passing through? I pray you stay a while, the funerary rites of Necrom are a wonder to behold. As fine a city as any merchant could ask for.
I see more than you think. Everyone in Necrom has secrets. Even you, I suspect.\n\nSo, you have business with me?
It might be difficult to tell which vendor you need to talk to in order to get what you need, but I'd say you're at the right stall.
Many strange and marvelous things find their way to Necrom. Falani has collected a few of the finest to offer her customers.\n\nPlease, see for yourself!
No one sources furniture like Murkholg. There is no line I won't cross. Envious of the furniture in someone else's home? Just give me their address.
Sorry, just finishing up my break. Be right with you.\n\nWhat brings you here?
Every time someone makes fun of my accent, I think about shaving weak patches in their armor. But I'd never sabotage my work like that. It's more important than their words.
There's so much magic in these lands, can't you feel it in the air? If you can't, maybe you'll find something here that will help you.
You look like you've seen your share of trouble. Well, I've got what you need for the next time you find yourself in a scrape.\n\nHere, have a look at my wares.
You look like you're in need of a ship. You can charter mine, just name your destination.
How do I make a profit? Easy! I deal in … volume! Hah!\n\nWhat do you need?
Take a careful look before you sign for one of my beasts. They're incredible mounts, for sure, but they're not for the faint-hearted.
Come here! Look at all this one has to offer. He promises it will not disappoint.
Seems like half the blades I make wind up gathering dust as decorations for some ancestor's shrine. But I have a feeling you'd put my work to better use.
How can the Keepers of the Dead place their charges above the needs of the living? Is our life not more important to maintain and cultivate? It bothers me.
This city smells like a crypt. I need to take some time outside the walls and feel the sun on my scales again.
The fishing is pretty poor here, but it is close to home.

Forgive me. I grieve the passing of a former business associate. Lloros Telen died in debt. In fact, one might say he died of his debts. Or the moneylenders' efforts to collect on them.\n\nA lesson for us all, yes?
Sometimes I think about sailing far away from this place. But I have no guarantees I'll ever return. Only the Dark Elves have that assurance.

Nothing warms up these old scales more than throwing dice when the stakes are really high. When the only thing standing between you and a pile of gold is the perfect roll. Those moments make me feel young again.
With enough time, I might even make something that rivals the great artisans!
Not enough hours in the day to do everything, is there?
Don't mind me. I like to take my meals in the abbey square. It's a good spot for people-watching. Always something going on down here.
I'm hoping one of the curates will let me visit the upper floors of these towers.
I once saw a ghost ship pull into port. I swear it. Thankfully, there was no undead crew in sight. And it was gone before I could raise an alarm. I still get the shivers thinking about it.
That Khajiit just coughed up a fur ball.
Have we been properly introduced?
