Ah. I was just explaining to Ragbara here about how we visit the ancestors and bring them presents so they know we haven't forgotten about them. I suppose our ways are strange to folk of other lands.
I apologize if I've disturbed your mourning, but you're currently disturbing my rant. If you'd so kindly step aside and let me unleash my fury, I'd be much obliged.
I may have misplaced my notes regarding a particularly nasty insect alteration spell. If you find it I'd ask that you don't read it out loud. I have yet to fully work out the kinks.
I do my best to keep this space clean, but … some of the urns leak.
Can you feel it? There is magic in the air.

Such a strange assortment of people find their way to Necrom these days. The result of the Tribunal's alliance with the Nords and the Argonians, I suppose. Just remember there is no war in Telvanni lands, serjo.
Have you heard any skittering around here? Perhaps a snickering, or clicking? I hope I'm imagining it. I'd hate to have to deal with a kwama infestation. Or, worse, skeevers.
My legs don't like the land much anyway, but they don't mind sitting.
I wonder how they can sell these pumpkins so cheaply?
New in town? I haven't seen you in here before. Make yourself comfortable, and someone will be around to wait on you soon. I've got to finish tidying up here, or Elvel will have my head.
Just like my father before me, I spend the quiet hours of the day designing my funerary urn. I pray one day my own child crafts my urn to its specifications the same way I crafted my father's.
It's my duty to protect this city, I will not speak ill of it.

I admit, I thought I'd find better opportunities to sell my axe here in the middle of Telvanni lands. But Necrom's a bit too quiet and the Telvanni mages don't think much of simple soldiers. Might need to move on.
If you don't appreciate and learn from the dead, how will you ever live your life?
I haven't hunted in a long time, stranger. Nowadays, I much prefer to bury my nose in a pint. I've lost too many friends to your line of work.
Munsora has lived here most of her life, and there are still corners she hasn't discovered before.\n\nShe hopes you have time to explore too.
I've finally found it! I've spent weeks searching every marker and memorial in Necrom for this tomb. The missing branch of the Lathdar family ended up here. My genealogical research is complete!
Come, and meet death!
Thank you!
I'm grateful you came along!
The prophecy of the new Druid King will be fulfilled!
Crush them, my pets! Burn them!
I am afraid your help comes too late, mainlander. Our village is in ruins, and the sealord took our sister Niraya.\n\nStill, I am alive and these Dreadsail pirates are dead. For that, I am grateful.
Mount Firesong, obey your king!
You can't defeat me!
Flames of Firesong, to me!
Hold up. I swear I heard something behind us.
Just a little jumpy, I guess. Let's report to the boss.
At least we're above ground. I heard the Mages are hiding out in some tunnels. Their door's just a front.
Sometimes I think about hopping on one of these ships and sailing off to find my fortunes. But I can't just go off and leave all my commissions behind.
My friends are the only thing keeping me in the Systres. I can paint scenes anywhere, friends make a home.
Chirrdibazi likes standing in the shade. That is not illegal, yes?
Do not worry about that worker. Chirrdibazi keeps her eyes out since the trouble began. Let's her friend work in peace.
All we eat comes out of a shell. I long for boar!
Grandvache's pulling in some big score, but even my ears haven't heard anything about it.
I keep waiting for someone to pay me enough to target Grandvache. The day's coming soon. I can taste it.
I know you're there. Step forward. Don't be a coward.
Her brood will tear your skin from your bones.
Close your eyes and observe no more.
No one is a match for my power.
The Lord of Secrets knows my power, and so shall you.
Foolish heroes to follow an old fool. How fitting.
I see. So you desire to die in agony?
Lamikhai won't need my help, but I want to see you burn.
Heard what happened up there? Sit down and waste some time here among friends then.
I don't look into Yves's business and he keeps his cronies away from mine. That's how he secured my patronage.
There are some Eldertide visiting, so if you're an outsider I'd suggest you steer clear of them. Though they promised that non-druids wouldn't be harmed while they're here.

Raz believes we have an operation coming up somewhere in Black Marsh. It's been some time since this one got to make friends with an Argonian. Scales and fur make such a lovely compliment, don't you think?
Bright moons! Pacrooti welcomes you and prays that the Divines grant you luck and great fortune!
That's a good one!
How sleek! How delightful!
Your crates are gone, my friend. But there are always additional crates available for purchase!
Most crates contain four rewards, but sometimes you will get a special fifth reward!
Select your crate and we can begin. Most crates contain four rewards, but sometimes you will get a special fifth reward!
We are here to play, yes? Let us see what the cards may bring.
Ahh, sweet gems!
I'm too old to deal with irritants like this. Come back when you're ready to play a real game.
You did it, cardsharp. You found me! Druid Braigh, the Ivy Savant. Hope it was worth the trip, hah!
I love being a druid, but why can't we kneel on rugs instead of hard stone all the time?
Sea breeze has me wanting to be out in the water. Maybe I'll take a dip later.
Think I could buy myself one of those nice mage robes if I asked nicely?
The Firesong strayed so far …. Does the True Way even exist at all?
Once got pinched by a mudcrab. Nasty little thing. Haven't seen him in a while though.
Nothing better than a bright sun and a cold pint. Well, maybe there's room for a sweetroll in there somewhere.
I didn't even know there was an attack until a bookcase fell on me. That's how invested I am in my studies.
Careful not to slam any doors. Shakes the dust off the walls and onto all my books.
Knights keep blocking the streets. They should keep their foolishness to themselves.
Have you been to the Vine District? I sometimes sell my fish there. The druids there are nice, I've made a few friends. One of them even taught me a trick about the kind of bait I was using!
I don't always take kindly to the tracks they leave, but few things are as exciting as seeing a new little pet scamper around.
My mother had a saying about idle hands and wandering thoughts. Well, I can't quite remember them, but nowadays I—I think taking a break isn't all that bad.
I'm glad those damned reavers are gone. I know Sir Stefan will see us through this. Count Stefan, sorry. I think it'll take some time for everyone to adjust.
The guards point and laugh, but their tone will change once they've been stung. It's like being branded by a hot iron.
It's all in the wrist. You get the right flick into your cast and you'll send your hook out into the deeper waters of the bay.
I've always considered myself a lifelong learner, traveling from one piece of knowledge to the next, and never before has something captured my imagination like druidic magics and culture.
I've gotten into my fair share of scraps here and there. I'd say my blood and sweat has probably touched every dusty corner of Vastyr.
I wonder if someone at the Mages Guild could teach me to conjure a mace? I should stop over there and ask.
Spare a coin for another drink? I swear, I'll pay you both back.
Bet the Dreadsails have some good strong grog on those ships of theirs. \n\nOr, had some good strong grog, I guess.
Sometimes the sunrise over the water makes me believe I've seen Tava's red feathers splayed out across the very sky.
Vastyr did not fall, but the hearts of its people have. We will recover in time but these wounds must heal first.
I was thinking about taking a nap before starting work. This spot right here might be perfect.
It's easy to lose time by this stream. The sun could rise and fall and I'd be none the wiser.
My father didn't love that I became a hunter, but I brought home enough wild game to shut him up.
When making your choices, look to consider every possible outcome.
Trinkets from your realm are in high demand in the Shambles. I can take whatever you're willing to spare.
The faces of this stone remind us to respect all possible outcomes and reactions. I think. Whoever left offerings at the face of anger must really be in trouble.
The glow of the magma … it's hypnotizing, isn't it?
I can't explain it. There's just something special about communing with earth spirits by a stream.
Some people are more attuned to the True Way than others.
Had to sit down. The ground's all wobbly beneath me. Damn volcano!

Once upon a time, I cared about way too much. Now I probably care about way too little, but I wake up feeling well-rested each morning.\n\nSo, what can I do to help you wake up feeling well-rested? Got some goods for me to look at?

A priest of Tu'whacca sought me out one day after I sneezed in Vastyr, but I had no clear evil to point out to him. Perhaps that is your role here?\n\nAh, even if not, I can help relieve you of burdensome goods.
My best sales come from those gamblers who've chosen to run games here in the refuge.\n\nOh, maybe I shouldn't talk about them? Hmmm … well, anyway, looking to buy something?

Did you know that even the Mad God appreciates my selection? It's random, it often has many pointy things, and each item has a tale of blood and even madness behind its acquisition.\n\nNot that the Mad God has been here. Recently.

Druids wander down here sometimes, asking all sorts of questions. I don't have a problem with druids. I do have a problem with people asking all sorts of questions.\n\nNow, with that out of the way, how may I help you today?
So much pain and suffering this season. And Mount Firesong rumbles like an angry ursauk. But let us talk of more pleasant things. Would you like to make a trade?
Curiosity and resilience go hand in hand, I've discovered. Right now, in fact, I'm curious as to what I, a merchant, can do to help you, and what you, a customer, can do to help me in return.
The problem with being a traveling merchant? I have way too much time to think. Sometimes my own thoughts are so loud it makes me want to scream!\n\nBut you're a customer. How can I help you?

I trained hard to be a knight, perhaps too hard at times. I remember evenings when I could hardly lift a spoon to my mouth to eat after a day of working my sword arm. I slept better in those days than I've slept in all my years since, I think.

I was just thinking about Archdruid Rahval. He never tried to be a father to me, it just happened. I remember one day he got cross with me for something foolish I'd done, as boys do, and I felt the kind of bone-deep shame that only a son can feel.
Sea Elves! Doing a bit of raiding and pirating, I can accept that. It's in their nature. But a full-scale invasion of the island? That's just not something House Mornard can allow to go unanswered.

I have a unique perspective, having been raised as both a noble and a druid. You could say I embody both sides of the Breton legacy. I'm not sure how, but I plan to use that to better govern Galen and its people. You have my word on that, friend.
Be ready for a storm and rejoice when the sun comes out. That's my motto.
Privateers and pirates can be dangerous, and feuds between ships can get rough. But if anyone hurts someone under my command … well, then I hurt them right back.

Sometimes I wonder if it's all worth it. The fighting, the intrigue, the privateering. Then I think about all we accomplished together. The good we've done. Makes me kind of weepy. \n\nIf I were prone to that sort of thing. Which I'm not.
I am an outsider, a wanderer. A vampire hunter. I will gladly make use of any opportunity to rest, to ready my spirit for the battle ahead.\n\nAnd trust me, there is always another battle.
What do you require? Does the blood moon rise? Do the fanged lords threaten our very souls? Speak before the trail grows cold!
Ah, you poor creature. I can sense the bloodthirst within you. If you have need, I will gladly put you out of your misery. Just say the word.

Ah, hunter. A pleasure, as always. I am attempting a new type of meditative exploration. As you've seen, my combat skills are usually up to the task. But a keen mind is as critical as a sharp blade in my line of work.
They could be around here.
Did you hear that?
Down you go!
My blade is pure!
Save that bread for later.
My staff feels bent.
Have you ever seen anything like this?
Give them everything you have!
I'm tired of studying.
I could use an ale.
Is this all you are?
Turn them to ash!
Do you think we should leave?
The boils itch.
Surround them!
Now's the time!
<<Sniffling, runny nose.>>
Our research is going too slowly.
<<Sniffling, runny nose.>>
Our research is going too slowly.
Over here. See if that scroll Leramil gave you actually works.
This portal isn't easy to keep open. Can we go, please?
Fast as light!
Do you feel adrift?
Covered in glory!
I can't contain all the shards!
Don't underestimate these Daedra worshipers.
Free!
Wait for your turn, beast.
When the Dusksabers come for you, you're time is done.
I'm not afraid of a big eye, but tentacles unsettle me.
Keep those death hounds contained! No need for a total slaughter.
That cultist had the audacity to put up a fight!
I could use something stronger than the blood in these cowards.
Ruins. Why do I always get these assignments?
You don't think we'll have to face any actual Daedra, do you?
Cultists. They're more trouble than they're worth.
I might do a little hunting after this.
I'm just saying, stealing from Daedra never works out well.
Blood tastes best hot and full of fear!
Many of us have sung for your arrival. Stories passed to us of your first scourge of Bal Sunnar. Our salvation will not go unremembered.
Many of us have lived here since hatching. They have not known the cool muds of Black Marsh. They will never forget you.
With our captors dead, we can feel the warm sun on our scales once again. I will sing your deeds to all that can hear.
We keep these prizes until such time as a rift to Apocrypha opens. Then we'll empty the vault and collect anew.
Wait. Do I hear …. Are those keys jangling in your purse?
A Cartoklept? Stop her before she scampers off.
You ever try drop-kicking a banekin? They fly a lot further than you think. \n\nI'd show you, but there's not enough room in here.
I'll batter your bones with hardcovers.
Taste the anger of these leaflets.
Knowledge, give me strength.
Let's test your mettle.
I'm faster than you.
Defeating you is almost an insult to my abilities.
No! That is thirty years of knowledge you burnt.
Lamikhai? You've gone too far.
You are nothing more than ash.
Insolence! Why won't you stay put?
Fear my flames.
Let's be done with this. I have important tasks to see to.
How are you still alive?
Something doesn't feel right … I smell blood.
I've got the eyes of a bat! Er … the ears.
We need to finish up here. I've got scores to settle in Cyrodiil.
I've got a purse full of coin. And nothing to spend it on here.
Blood is best served warm.
Handling books requires a delicate touch.
Every malpracticer will share Twelvane's fate.
Vanton will join this one. We will crush anyone who opposes us.
What is the mind of one mage? I created wars and puppeted kings. This is nothing to me.
There is no place for your filth in this world.
There is too much weakness here.
Vaermina will have her mage after all.
Oh, I see. You're arrogant as well as foolish.
You think you can stop me?
You're foolish to fight this one.
Do you know who you're dealing with?
I'm at my strongest here. And you are weak.
Not one to back down? I'll enjoy boiling your brain in your skull.
<Zilipif hisses urgently.>
Hmm, now where did I bury those components?
This must be the place. Take a look.
By the Mother, the Poet, and the Magician. You returned triumphant?
You walk into the maw of danger itself, in service to the Three. You are to be commended, but you must put your shoulder to the wheel.
We Ordinators seek out the ambitious and brave. You seem to fit that description. Do you have time to help the Temple, and make some extra coin in doing so?
Well, that's the last of my duties done. Come back later and I may have new orders. \n\nFor now, let us silently offer our thanks to the Living Gods.
The Eye that Watches is blind.
Why don't we unleash more Mind Terrors against Mora's servants?
I do not trust that clanless fool. Torvesard forgets his place.
Leave no door unopened. What is Vaermina's must be recovered!
Do not let this place unnerve you. We serve the maker of nightmares.
Does no one here fear the Dark Lady? I shall correct that!
Hermaeus Mora has many eyes. Surely he watches us?
Patience. Even Hermaeus Mora must dream from time to time.
*Enraged Gibberish*
*Enraged Gibberish*
I will have nightmares of skeevers after this. Yet another sacrifice for the Weaver of Dreams.
I never saw myself working alongside servants of another prince.
You're safe to walk here.
A whole new realm is but ink and parchment away!
Lurkers are strange, but they have their purpose.
Tomeshells! Damned pests!
Philosophy is the path so rarely taken.
The power of words is greater than that of armor and weapons.
Throw another Watchling on the fire!
Ah! You appear to still be in one piece! How did you fare?
I have other business to attend to. You should attend to your tasks as well.
We seek brave, skilled warriors who are looking to make a little coin. Does that describe you?
You're quite eager to help, but we don't have any other work for you at the moment. That will change, though, soon enough.
Drown in the inky seas, interloper.
Control the power? There's no controlling it.
Drown in the water of knowledge.
The shadows are growing. Watch for the tide. It's coming.
All this for some stupid staff?
The Magnastylus keeps saying these rifts are dangerous. But nothing's happened yet.
You won't interfere!
Look lively, we have some newcomers to welcome.
You're not welcome here.
I put down my copy of Timeless Antecedents for this?
Something doesn't feel right. I smell blood.
Let's see how well you fight.
We're overdo for a rift to Apocrypha.
I used to torture the mortal fools, now I stand guard in a cave. Those scribes will pay for their nonsense.
Slash at the legs first, they always dance after that.
You think you pose a challenge?
Can't you wait your turn little mortal?
Mehrunes Dagon must think these scribes are some sort of threat. Why else would we be stationed here?
You won't last long.
Your brood will never amount to anything. You bred them to be lazy fools.
I will teach you what it is to suffer.
Valinna thinks she has some stake here. I can't wait for the webs to fall from under her.
I wonder which will be better? Your bones or your blood.
Defend the hall!
I missed the hall's smell and quiet.
The Magnastylus says we can fight. So let's fight!
I don't think the maps of the Deadlands are accurate, but the Riftmaster won't let me go check.
Aim for something soft!
Keep laughing. My descendants will perfect my spell, but you won't be around to see them.
They're everywhere!
Is that the best you can do? Have at me!
Haha! Nice shot!
The battle is not yet won!
Careful! Do not disturb the atronachs!
I believe Aedra are far superior to Daedra.
I could use a few of these books for my own library.
It's a bit blustery in here.
Meridia bring light to this place!
Let me tell you the history of Umaril the Unfeathered.
Get away from me! I'll kill you all! Kill!
The others were weak. But I can hold on. I can … I can't. I can't!
I think that's it! Let's get this book back together!
Bring her here!
Don't let her get away!
A sleeping wamasu! This is such good fortune. I must jot down some research notes.
I wish I had some Sujamma right about now.
Shut your flat head, I heard something.
Feels good to be back in Morrowind. I can't stand the cold.
Those n'wahs need to watch their tongues or they'll lose them.
That stew tasted like bittergreen.
Don't get too friendly, f'lah. Or you'll join the trolls.
Can you people go one afternoon without getting bitten or stabbed?
You're Camonna Tong! Act like it.
You lost my coin in a torchbug race? Who even races torchbugs?
I hope a troll beats your thick skull in.
I should've been a merchant in Mournhold. That's where the real money is.
Don't spit in my cup and call it greef!
Ancestors, what did I do to deserve this line of work?
Don't test me, or it'll be the last thing you do.
I've never seen Infernium do this before.
Sheogorath wishes for your destruction.
You will not make it out a live!
Boot to mouth!
No way out mortal!
Tremble in fear!
Eat shield mortal!
March, my soldiers, and win the battle!
Make quick work of them, my soldiers!
Clear the way mortal!
Burn mortal!
You're done mortal!
You will make a fine sacrifice!
Here's some respite.
This oven again? Akkhiri cleaned it just last week.
Next time Eluzzur accepts free passage to anywhere, Eluzzur will ask where anywhere is. A Dark Elf city of the dead is not where this one wants to be right now.
This cough won't leave. Please, help me see better days?
One thing about Necrom - it is an industrious place.
This is ridiculous, out of spending gold already?
Look at this place, how did they manage to build it?
Now what? Overland to Firewatch? Or wait for Stormwing to sail?
Never again. Never ever again. Mushroom mead? No. Just no. Nothing is worth drinking that awful swill. I wouldn't give it to my pigs.
If you walk by, at least look at those who can do nothing but crawl.
Don't attract attention. Don't attract attention. Just be subtle.
I heard so much about Dark Elf assassins, but I haven't seen any.
The Waiting Door is such a strange concept. Who is waiting exactly? The living awaiting death? The dead waiting to be summoned by later generations? I should ask one of the priests here.
Tu'whacca knows I've had practice enough. Time to settle some scores.
I wonder when Vevia's family will arrive. She deserves to have them all here for her funeral.
Magic is a tool that misbehaves if it's not used.

You must forgive Shuzashi, walker. Today is a day of grief for her. She must commit a good comrade to the fires, as his people often do. It is not the way of Shuzashi's people, but she does this for her fallen friend.
Not only did I lose my boat in a game of dice, but the guy I lost it to already gambled it away himself. My boat will have been owned by half of Necrom by the time I win it back.
I break my back for a handful of coins a day. And I still have to sleep under a dock and look for scraps to fill my belly. Necrom's not a city you want to be poor in, stranger.
This city is a lot more colorful than I gave it credit for. \n\nYou hear city of the dead and you think grey stones and dusty floors, but look at all this!
I wish I could read the keeper's ledgers, but their handwriting looks like poorly defined squiggles to me.
Be still, stranger. Listen. If I can learn to hear the dead of Necrom whispering to me, then perhaps I can teach my fellow priests in Skyrim how to hear our own dead.
I took time away from work to explore Necrom, but I'm afraid I didn't give myself enough time. I'd stay for the rest of the season if I could.
I have wandered far from the Alik'r Desert. Many are troubles I left behind me. But here, in this city of tombs, I have finally found … peace.

I came here almost half a lifetime ago to study the effects of the dead on the living and I can't believe that my observations are ongoing. Everyone experiences this phenomenon differently. It's amazing!
Bone dust might be the best option for that third process.
Apocrypha might do my work for me. But then how do I prove he's dead?
Spare your time and read me a passage?
They look rickety, but the walkways are stable.
Feh. Where's that wagon? I'm starving!
I still can't believe I'm here!
I tend not to look directly into the sky.
It can't be a crime to take just one book, right?
I will read every tome in this accursed plane.
I wonder if I made the right choice when I accepted the invitation.
Cipher's Midden is safe, but beyond its borders, watch out!
What's keeping those rocks from falling?
This one needs to gather more samples.
Be careful with fire spells. These stacks are flammable!
Mind where you step. Some of these ink pools are deeper than they seem.
There are eyes everywhere. Doesn't anyone else see them?
Yes, yes. But where can I get some wolfsbane around here?
You really can't judge a book by its cover.
We who serve the Great Eye come from many lands. But once we don a cipher's robes, what we were before no longer matters. Whoever you are, whatever you have done, you have a place here.
Be careful what you read in this place, stranger. Some things cannot be unseen. I cast away my eyes to atone for what I'd learned, and it was not enough. No. Not enough.
From here, the mortals look small … as they should.
Ah, these ciphers delight me. They think themselves wise as they study their tomes. But while ciphers sift through secrets, I have been appointed to sift through them. And my work is just beginning.
I do miss my family's cooking. I'm ghastly in the kitchen, but my relatives? All of them are highly sought-after chefs.\n\nBut I won't go back until I've fulfilled my purpose here.
Funny thing. I used to make fun of these starry-eyed scholars for getting caught up in their books and forgetting to eat. You can't live on books, I'd say. But I think some of them actually do.
Easiest way to survive here is not to look inside anything tied down or locked ….\n\nBut the folks who stay here aren't the sort to abide by that rule!
My egg-kin know nothing of my true whereabouts. I miss their insights, of course, but my journey here must remain a solitary one.
These piles may look slapdash, but they're very carefully organized. I know exactly where every one is. So don't move anything or straighten the stacks.
Cipher's Midden, where book lovers come to roost.

This is a tale the Spinners don't tell in Valenwood. An old rift that divided my people in the earliest days. I came to Apocrypha to learn the truth about such things. But here it must stay, for the good of all.
Before we make judgments about anything, including books, we should make a strong effort to learn all we can.\n\nIf you do this yourself, you'll broaden your mind.
Kelp growing on land? Now this one has seen it all. What will be next? A tree growing with its roots in the air?
The Lord of Apocrypha keeps his own council. He could destroy this entire place without explaining himself to anyone.
Other Dark Elves in my profession fear this place. Dark Brotherhood, Morag Tong, they haven't made their peace with the spirits they send here. \n\nI have. They cannot harm me.

Be careful who you waylay, stranger. My brothers and I ambushed a Telvanni lord in a gilded carriage. He turned out to be a mage. Transmuted my brothers into little hairy guars, and set a price on my head.
Curses! If the guards caught her, who knows where she'll be sent? Now what?
I still can't find that listening spot that drunk told me about. Hmmm … maybe I shouldn't listen to drunks. She just seemed so earnest.
There's no Orchard in Necrom.
Can't you calm down?
Enter the focus point!
Apply my ghost sight to attack with precision!
Mortal! Let me aid you!
That was a satisfying smack!
Let fate renew your vigor, proxy!
Stand close and let me shield you!
<The air shimmers with the glacial aura surrounding Hoarfrost.>
<The air shimmers with the fierce flames surrounding Pyroclast.>
It is too dark a time to be wandering unprotected. But they are beyond caring now.
To think Martina has been studying fate from within the Underweave all this time. I wonder what advances she's made since we parted ways?
Here's a sailing tip. Always make note of where they store the good rope. Never know when you might need to tie up a mutineer or secure a loose-fitting pair of pants.
Howler likes to act tough, but the little guy is prone to nightmares. Not your usual Daedric horrors or swamp beasts, no. Nightmares about losing a game of Tribute.\n\nYup, he's an odd little monkey.
You ever just forget something? Like, you had a rollicking good story to tell around the campfire, but suddenly it's just not there?\n\nAh, never mind. Need any repairs?
The best merchants are those who understand that the customer wants to be right, but sometimes isn't.\n\nYou do want to trade, don't you?
I confess, I wasn't sure I would see you again. The Gardener of Men chooses his tools with care, but he has fearsome enemies.\n\nSo. What happened in Bastion Nymic?

I do miss our little games of dress up. We should find time to don disguises again. There must be some stronghold that needs pilfering.\n\nIt's not weird that I like to change my garments and fool people into thinking I'm someone else, is it?

J'baanluk considers his nose to be as powerful a tool as his sword or shield. For instance, this one can tell where you've been by the smell of dried mud on your boots and the flecks of pollen stuck to your gloves.
The fiery breath of a Dragon almost compares to the scorching sands of Elsweyr. Almost.

You did good removing the usurper queen from Rimmen. J'baanluk shudders to think what life in Northern Elsweyr would be like if she were still on the throne. This one will never forget that, adventurer.
Stop me if this is too personal, five-claw, but as a Khajiit, how do you handle the itch? You know the spot, right above your tail. This one can never reach it while fully armored.
Why does everyone take a step back when I show up? It's not like I'm contagious or any—oh, wait. Yes I am.

Our society needs tenets or some sort of creed or doctrine. All the most popular faiths have them! I've taken it upon myself to collect the words of Peryite and write them down for posterity, but I need a better opening than "Hi, my name is Filbert."
Still some scrib guts wrapped around the axle. Can't go anywhere 'til that's taken care of.
All this walking is supposed to be good for me? I can't possibly see how.
No point in working. I'll just have to wait.
I heard the kagouti keep nests nearby. How exciting! Must be dangerous to wander.
I'll give him a little longer. But we need to keep the roads clear.
Who would even read this nonsense? Besides me, I mean.
I don't miss the cold of Eastmarch. I get plenty of it from the Elves here.
Even if Hild isn't really praying when she wanders up here, it's nice to look over and see her beside me.
My egg-kin don't like me coming back here. As if it's more dangerous here than anywhere else this side of Cyrodiil.
If you're just standing there—bring me another cup, will you? And another bottle, while you're at it.
Two-thirds of work is just looking busy. It's not easy! But you have to do it, otherwise they'll find something for you to do.
Writing was just a way to calm my mind! I didn't think anyone would actually read what I wrote!\n\nWhat if they hate it? By Tall Papa, what if they like it?

Remind me. Did we meet in Summerset or Orcrest? No matter, I remember you well.\n\nYou listened to my discourse on the wonders of Peryite. I appreciated that. So, you'll get the first copy of our new pamphlet as soon as it's back from the printer!
Is this all that remains? An arbitrary clump of ground? A weathered headstone? Is this my fate?
Come on, <<1>>. Let's get going!
See Ma'nna? Your favorite flower. Just as you were mine.
I know the perfect place to display this treasure. Yes.
A terrible memory!
You're not welcome here.
Stop her. Please!
This isn't right. You're twisting my mind. Stop it!
I will break Vanton. But for now, let's see if I can break you.
You're not wanted here.
I don't feel right.
It's time.
I can't give you a discount for your bravery, but if respect could buy you what you need ….\n\nJust make it out of there, all right?
Get what you need and then stop Ansuul. Before she tears a hole in the Mundus.
Appease me and you may yet avoid your doom!
Winds of the North, Twelvane calls you in the gryphon's sight.
Burn in the lion's wrath.
Wamasu! Lend your power.
You tamed the gryphon. It's vulnerable.
You beat the house of the lion?
The wamasu's power can turn against the chimera!
Quiet, pet. They won't wake you again.
Stars bow to Twelvane's power.
This one will never be cowed by idiots.
Passing time is inevitable. As is your failure.
You got it! Now please make Twelvane stop.
You're too hot-tempered.
You can't run from justice.
Footsteps. Stay calm. <<1>> is here. It's fine.
You dare interrupt?
Can you keep up?
You really are foolish.
Tear them apart!

Some competitors in our exercises here seek out relics, including those of my people. I myself have no issues with that, but you may find others who think differently.\n\nPerhaps you'll purchase something to reward my indifference?
Pay no mind to Pirrunira's injured wrist. A minor sprain, earned by a moment of clumsiness in the ring. Her goods, however, are worthy of your attention!
I was going to organize my inventory, but any distraction is a welcome one. What can I do for you, great warrior?
Before a job, I like to go to my ancestors for advice. A few of them helped build Necrom after all. They know about passageways that even the spiders have forgotten.
Only those who seek us only truly find us.\n\nHow may we be of service?
Given the nature of this … place, I deal in some fairly strange things. Maybe we can surprise each other.
Best get what you want and then scamper off. It's not always safe to stay in an obvious spot for too long here. Unless you can handle yourself, of course.
Greetings! So many interesting people find their way to Necrom, each with a story to tell. Which often involves hiding things they don't want to carry around.\n\nWhat do you need?
I can always spot a mortal who has come face to face with the Prince of Knowledge. He leaves a mark on you, not unlike an ink stain. I hope your pact was worth it. Now, care to trade?
Fire Drakes are weak and Storm Lords spend more time over-analyzing their strategy than they do working on their skills. Pit Daemons is the only respectable choice.

Oh, hello! Don't mind me. I've been having some trouble with spellcasters in my matches of late. I thought it might be a good idea to learn an arcane trick or two of my own. But this tome is just impossible!
No one else was around to take it, but books don't wander off on their own.
You better not be smudging that text. Rotten thing.
City of the dead? The dead should be stuck under heavy stone slabs and left to their rest.\n\nAt the very least no one should live with them!
We'll find every last one of you. Rid the city of your filth.
I think I killed the last one too quickly. I won't make the same mistake.
Yaseyla said to kill them all.
You think you can stop us?
Did you hear that one beg?
There's so many of them. All lined up for the slaughter.
Do you think you can stop me?
Think you're a match for me?
So weak. He's so useless and simple.
He couldn't even save Twelvane. They used to be friends, you know.
You don't belong here.
You won't save Vanton.
I'll feed the next one to a paranoxia!
They keep screaming when I break their fingers.
You won't get any farther.
I'll cut your tongue out.
I'll enjoy killing every last one of these powerless maggots.
What do you think, ears or eyes next?
You'll fall before our superiority.
You'd defend these weaklings?
You're an embarrassment to the guild, Vanton. What has your research amounted to?
Remember how small Vanton felt giving that lecture? He can't do it without Ansuul's help.
You don't care about Vanton.
You think you're a hero?
I've only been in Apocrypha for a few days, and I have to say you meet the most interesting people here! I know it's not very safe to just wander around, but I keep finding such interesting things.
Ah, do you admire the skeletal remains? This whole region of Apocrypha is littered with the things. That is why they are called the Writhing Wastes. But of course these great beasts writhe no longer.

I'll never waste ink like that again if it means I can avoid counting all these damned books for the Lord of Secrets.\n\nI love these damned books. I just don't want to count them. Again. Learn from me, wanderer. Don't waste ink.
This one had a conversation with Leramil the Wise once. She's an odd one to have Hermorah's favor, but the scope of her knowledge? It impresses even Sinjari.
There's a chill in the air. It dries my scales.

If you're heading for Necrom, good luck, wanderer. Just remember that our practices are sacred. So try not to disturb anything while you're there.\n\nDon't feel special. I remind everyone I meet about this as part of my duties.

I've heard that the spores of this fungus can be distilled into an elixir that causes madness. Prized by those who seek to test their strength of mind, and perhaps win Sheogorath's favor.\n\nOr so I've heard.
This tilework is much friendlier to my poor knees than the dirt roads I'm used to.
I'm working on a guide to salt water fishing for every corner of Tamriel! Oh, I know most anglers rarely get the chance to travel outside their homelands. But sometimes it's fun to daydream, eh?
You're as worthless as you look!
Isn't ghost sight wonderful? You'll find a cache here.
Pox and plague upon you!
She said she'd help, but this isn't helping me! I want out!
Keep your eyes open. Witches Festival or not, you gutless fools have a job to do.
Who drew this map? A child?
Oof!
How do you like that?
I'm sorry! Stop! Please!
You have to kill that nest!
I can't believe I forgot your favorite food.
Go on. Pick which one you think he'll like.
Traveler, you come at an inauspicious time. I am currently attempting a rhyme with "shrieking orange." \n\nMy mood is not receptive to idle conversation.
Hah, my reputation is such that prey are drawn to me.\n\nPrepare yourself, traveler.
Get these things off me. Please!
Something's wrong ….
Without your help, I'd be a skeever's snack. Thank you, friend.
I seriously need a bath ….
Hermaeus Mora is no fool. We must work quickly.
I never saw myself working with another prince's servants.
His Pestilence has outdone himself with this newest blight.
Let's see how the servants of the Great Eye like our lord's blessings.
Our foes will thank me for sharing our master's blessings.
Strange to see Hermaeus Mora's servants act in such a way.
<Entreating unintelligible gibberish.>
The guard advances.
The rain hardens!
Burn in Yokuda's remaining light.
If we retrace our steps, set things right, we'll be released?
Why didn't we have a plan?
Our leader will find us a way out.
I just don't understand it.
Why were we brought here? What have we done wrong?
Have we tried the overlook? How far of a fall can it be?
Got your back.
There's something worth bragging about.
Well, that's over. Let's find another one and do it again!
And just like that, it's over.
It's over for you.
Let's skin this big lizard!
That'll teach them not to cross us.
Heh. Second wind!
I'm hurt.
Get out of there!
Shake it off!
NO!
Show them what you're made of!
You need a potion, quick.
You packed a potion for this, right?
Don't give out on me now!
Go wild!
(battle roar)

Wood elves are mad for plenty of things, but I think they got it right when they started building cities out of trees. Why use stones and backbreaking labor to do what nature does a thousand times better?
The locals really just talk about anything here, don't they? Don't care who might be listening. Hmm. What a funny place.
I read somewhere that Stormhold was used in the slave trade to Morrowind. Not too long ago, in fact. Guess that's something Stormhold and I have in common.
Ah. People. Great.
Might get rough in here. I've got your back.
Here we go.
Let's ride.

You ever looked at a guar? I mean, really looked at a guar? They've got those clawed little hands tucked up there … You think I'd get bit if I just grabbed one of those little clawed hands? Probably what I'd do if someone grabbed my hand.
See that? Probably something useful in there.
You know? I don't hate it.
Picking up a lot from you, lately. It's paying off.
Good to get stocked up.
You gonna share? Just kidding. I wouldn't either.
Can't believe someone just left this here.
That's gotta be worth some good coin.
You earned it.
What now?
What do you need?
I'm listening.

Fishing is the closest I get to relaxing. And it always seems like I get better bites when sharing a fishing spot with someone else. \n\nSo if you ever want to cast some lines together, I can think of worse ways to spend our time.
We make a good team. Anyone can see that.
Friendship is a strong word. \n\nBut not inaccurate.
I'm not good with feelings. You know that. I like you. I like what we get up to together.
Trust always seemed like something I'd never find with another person.\n\nBut like most good things in my life, I found it with you.
Let's get it done.
I'm going.
Found the off switch.
This world's done with you.
When we get paid for something we're good at, it's like we're not even working.
Straightforward, respectable work. Can't ask for much more than that.
Straightforward, respectable work. Can't ask for much more than that.
I don't have a mind or mouth for poetry, but there is something about being near Hist trees. It's like I want to … sing? Not going to, for your sake. It's just strange.
You know what that's good for? Eh, you'll figure it out.
You're more generous than me.
I always find myself in a better mood after a meal.
Good looking out, recharging that.
Find a soul gem for that weapon of yours.
Staying on top of repairs. I like it.
Good loot, there. Hold on to that.
Can't think of anyone more deserving.
Couldn't have landed that better myself.
You trying to get run through? Fix that gear of yours!
Got a repair kit? You're looking a little worse for wear.
If you were just going to do that, why pick it up in the first place?
We could've outrun them.
Come on, really? They're just trying to get by.
If you're going through the trouble, why not pick the pocket of someone who deserves it?
Didn't realize you meant this kind of fishing. Hmph.
If someone's set on killing you, no outfit is going to change that.

I used to respect House Telvanni for refusing the Ebonheart Pact. Thought it was smart, staying out of a war.\n\nNow I know: just because you agree with someone, it doesn't mean you're on the same side.
I'm with you, cohort.
From legendary scourge to pile of meat. Hmph!
Ah good, we cling to corporality. Excellent.
Loathsome!
Zounds, that's a big lizard!
Any more? I need some tea.
Ah, my vigor returns!
I'm wounded, and not a young man!
Traverse that impediment!
Heed your surroundings!
Tell Arkay to take a hike. Don't die!
Splendid form!
You're losing vitae!
There's a void of magicka inside you!
You seem quite fatigued!
Breathtaking!
(unleashed power shout)
I wonder if they ever scrubbed out the scorch marks where my first lab used to be? Meh.
Zeht's tears, I hope we don't see Telenger while we're here. That man is insufferable.
Martina and I worked closely together here in our early, experimental days. Fond memories.
Perhaps we can complete a writ or two on our down time. Hmm?
Inwards and downwards!
Ah. This is kind of nice, actually.
We can't take a portal?

I became an arcanist when my tome 'bit' me. It's true! I was running my hand along a shelf in a secondhand shop in Sentinel when the damned thing nipped my finger. Good thing it did, too. I would have made a lousy guild apprentice.
Can you use that in your craft?
Ah, newfound understanding! And with it: power.
Someday you'll make something surprising with that.
Any coinage of unusual make? Worth examining later.
A prosperous discovery.
The value of that … hah!
I'm taking notes on your progress, just so you're aware. Galvanizing!
Your coin keeps me here, nothing more.
Hmm? Yes?
New research awaits! Let's ruminate.
I have a new interest! Ayleid wells and Mundus stones. They draw together arcanum in unexpected, anfractuous, even devious ways. I require more hands-on study and I require it now.
I've had many collaborators over the years. And you are one of them.
To this point, I have had no reason to regret our collaboration.
You are peerless, cohort. I feel privileged to be your companion.
The fact that you've endured my presence this long means you're stuck with me. You have my deepest apologies.
A fated arrival.
Leave me be, you confounded clod.
Vermin extermination. Hah!
It died like it lived. In feathers and foulness. Yech.
Malodorous! Appalling! Nauseating!
That was quite compelling. I'll need time to organize my research.
I sometimes wonder what becomes of our enchantment efforts. Hmm.
Someday I'd like to do a research paper on the mercantile ecosystem of cities like this. Where do the goods come from? And where do they go?
Look up, cohort. Most researchers believe meteoric iron wells emit mystic power back to the sky. Purely for religious purposes? Or is that energy … I don't know … going somewhere?

The magecrafter's trick of lining a piece of armor with sapphires would be humorous folly, if it wasn't so demonstrably effective. Why sapphires? What is it about that gem that focuses the aetheric zephyrs?
Zounds, a new lead! Let's get after it, cohort!
Dagon's realm is unpleasant in the extreme. But this was an excellent opportunity for empiric research.
To think a scholar from Kozanset was able to see this here today. An opportunity beyond compare!
Ahh, what a novel approach. Enthralling to get a peek inside your mind.
Hmph. Derivative.
Let it sit with you. Novel erudition always makes me heady.
We'll make good use of these resources! Far better than those asinine Artaeum archmages.
Palatable. Delicious? Perhaps scrumptious.
Your scholarship in the realm of enchantment is second to none. We are true colleagues.
What was your intent with the flavor profile there? Hmm, may have room for improvement.
After a cursory assessment, I'm most intrigued!
These mages are all the same. Vainglorious and sophomoric. Spell artisans of the lowest order.
My inclination is to be more watchful.
I'm not sure that was wise.
As a scholar of fate, I can assure you our time could be better spent than playing some card game.
Distasteful.
Yes, much better than a nice herbal blend. Surely.
I can taste the beanwater at the back of my throat.

I'm considering an unorthodox theory about Ayleid Wells. What if the power they reroute back towards the heavens is being collected somewhere … by someone? \n\nThe scholars all agree no mortal beings live on Akatosh or Arkay. But what if?
I'll give you notes later, cohort.
What a novel setting. Might want to come back here, some day.
I found you, prince of knowing. I promise.
You there! Are you really there? If you are, you'll want to see this. I'm sure it's there.
Shh! Don't disturb him! Admire, worship, serve him! Hermaeus Mora, he's here!
I was wrong last time. And the other time. But not this one. Watch.
How could the Elves let a place like this fall to ruin?
My lord, this mortal doesn't believe in your greatness. Smite them!
Rot!
Hermaeus Mora sees much. His followers might know we're coming.
Are we finished here? The real battle is still to come.
How dare you enter my sanctum!
Now face arcane mastery unleashed!
You would be wise to leave.
Chaos cannot be defeated…
I will rain chaos down upon you, intruder!

I find the funerary rituals of the Dark Elves fascinating. Before I started my route, I spent some time in Necrom, learning about their traditions. I saw no spirits, but perhaps that's because I have no kin here.
How would you describe that bouquet? Clean? Bright? Zesty? Use your words.
Heh. Spicy.
Take care of that enchantment. Don't let it get to that point next time.
Looking for insights from a wizened old magister? Well, let me know when you find one!
Your fear is like sweet wine on my lips!
My ghost sight grows more powerful with each nightmare you destroy.
I will regain what fate took from me!
I can grant your dreams or feed your nightmares!
This isn't the right sector.
One of the best ways to let your time in Necrom settle firmly in your mind and emotions is to ride Trinni, my silt strider. Pause, reflect, and breathe while riding in style to Ald Isra.
You remind me of my minions.
I saw you giving Bittersweet here a good once-over. She's a remarkable silt strider, isn't she? Probably the best I've worked with.\n\nAnd she'll get you to Necrom safely, I promise.
Not one of these tomes will escape my grasp.
This knowledge shields me from your feeble attacks.
You aren't worth a footnote.
End your trespass and do not open that which is locked.
Join the Dreamcarvers in death.
This doesn't seem right. Let's go back.
I'm going to die out here ….
Show me.
I will rain chaos down upon you, intruder!
Another interloper? Let me twist your dreams.
Fools! You face the Valkynaz of the Dreamcarvers!
I will twist your mind for challenging me!
No! No one defeats the Dreamcarvers!
Disease lord … give strength!

At sunset, when shadows first begin to creep up Hammerfell's mountains, I swear I can hear singing. Just at the edge of my perception. A scholar once explained that it's simply sand running along the mountain top, but where's the poetry in that?

The sword swallowers of the House of Reveries often find themselves afflicted by a nasty ailment. One characterized by a coarseness of speech and breath. I've since perfected a cure. \n\nI call it—Alchemy's Golden Tonic for Sword Throats.

Dreamer asks about you. The kind adventurer who spared them from the Endless Library. They still struggle with letting go of their past. The young ones often do, but I empathize. After all, so many find the Reveries while searching for a home.
I used to think of myself as a sailor from Sentinel. But my true home is whatever deck I happen to be standing on.
I wish the Khajiit and the Wood Elves would steer clear of Summerset's politics. I've got too many friends fighting on the side of the Aldmeri Dominion for my liking.
I miss the Spearhead. A captain never really stops loving her first ship, after all. But I have to say I like the way Nereid's Song handles a fickle wind.
I suppose this is as good a place as any to stare into the Void and contemplate the end of existence.
I thought about going outside today, but the whole idea was just too exhausting.

Oh, there you are. Hermaeus Mora tells me he's not yet done with you, mortal. Fate's chosen, and all that. \n\nTell you more? And risk the very fabric of space and time? Hmm. No, no. That would be wrong. Forget I mentioned anything.
Flames of Firesong, to me!
Once had a new angler ask me the best time to fish. Easy answer, I said. It's right now.
Insolent trash.
Bother the Void.
That's it. Now you die.
I am endless.
You cannot stop me.
Did you think this was going to be straight-forward?
Mantikoras grow within the spawning pools.
By fiery tooth, sharpened talon, and scaled wing.
Overcome this, little reflection.
I want to savor this fight.
Let us test your perseverance.
You beat my atronach.
Ah, reflection. You think you succeeded?
I'll just create a stronger Dragon.
Don't forget, I am plentiful!
I am one of many. You are but one.
Your constructed order falls.
I am the margins. You are a footnote.
I have no end. Can you say the same?
You survived far too long.
Initiating shields sequence.
Ally sequence activated.
You trophy soon! Xeemhok swears it!
Shagrath consume you!
This wasn't in any of the books.
This place isn't real either?
Boiling ink. Not ideal.
You'll never leave here alive!
You'll never leave here alive!

More pages are missing. I'd go find them myself, but you know how the archive is. I could be impaled, bitten, skewered, or charred alive by magic. I'm a translator! I can't just go around getting attacked.\n\nBut you … you did this before. You can.
Uh, sorry. No. I don't let anyone hang around while I'm working. You're going to have to wait out there for the next translation.
I hope your quest is successful, friend.\n\nIf you run into any Daedroths out there, show them no mercy. They like to eat my quill nibs.
Good to see you well and not dismembered, adventurer. Were you successful? Do you have them?
Your deaths here were meaningless. I hope you're pleased with yourself. Your bodies will serve me, now.
Kill them!
Now Lord Bal shall ascend to both Thrones!
By choking air and purging fire—your kind will end.
Bask in the full spectrum of pain.
By her will, we stand united!
The cold will leech your insolence until you are frozen in eternal supplication.
Her light will strip you of all your failings.
You will burn in her radiance!
Lightning is the whip she will use to break you!
Supplicants, you will serve for all time.
You may live to serve, or die a pointless death.
Warriors of Light! Join me!
I walk the shadows!
My shadows will tear your life away!
Run, mortal!
Dark light take you!
Shalaraj—feer jassa!
No one survives the butcher!
Stay away from my sweetrolls.
Blood!
You're going to make me work for my kill? Good!
A test of your limits to determine your worth.
An eternity of disappointment.
A place of Tho'at Replicanum's power.
Would you mind moving forward? I'm not very practiced when it comes to nymics.
Heed me, Tho'at Replicanum. Heed and return!
You wrecked my beautiful castle on your way to me. You deserve more than such a simple death.
I opened a portal to another Verse hidden in the archive. Be careful. I don't know what you'll face in there.
Such delicious power.
Don't move around so much. You never know what lies in the dark.
Let me feast on your terror!
See what I have been reduced to?
Want to buy something from the archive? Need to buy with something from the archive. Only way! Infinite Archive has knowledge. Value. Nothing else suits. \n\nYou have what I need for a sale, yes?
Bodies caught in the Throat of the World never rot.
Will you hear the scrape of their scales before they strike?
The shalk leaves only cinders and bones in its wake.
The lizard's roar is the cracking of the sky.
A lurcher's soul has a crushing grip on life. Can you feel how desperately it wants to take root?
The guiding light burns everyone who reaches too closely.
I wield powers beyond your reckoning.
You culled our ranks, but the Silver Rose is stronger for it.
Turn and fight!
That was hard won and well fought. I look forward to our next duel.
I wasn't always a doll, you know. Take my advice and avoid Dragon cults or you could end up like me.
This place is nice. You know what would make it nicer? If I wasn't trapped in the body of this doll!
Good to see you. I am stuck in this obnoxiously cute form again, but at least I can move around this time. I'll figure out how to change back. Eventually. But for now, I am content.
Mizzik's mother read him Investigator Vale books when he was small. Reading them since, he realizes she left out so much blood and violence! And … other things, too.
Some may turn their nose up at gossip and rumors. For Mizzik, they may offer important leads!\n\nAnd when he is not conducting an investigation, they provide a fine source of amusement.
After our adventure in Riverhold, Mizzik has been trying hard not to make hasty assumptions and waste time chasing down false clues.\n\nIt is difficult. Mizzik finds conclusions very easy to jump to.

My Aunt Murog once offered her famous pie recipe as a wedding present to any Northpoint woman who would consent to marry me. Can you imagine? Putting up with me for life?\n\nAnyway, I got so many offers I had to leave town for a while.
Look, I like Tales of Tribute as much as anyone. But all those masters and rankings and whatnot? I don't know. Why can't we just have fun and play the damn game?

Seems like nearly every time you and I cross paths, I'm tied up or pinned down in some way or another.\n\nFigures that when I'm finally in shape to show off, we're somewhere that I probably shouldn't go breaking the furniture.
Ooh! Killed one!
Did all those books teach you nothing?

I have enough to pay you now. And the copies of Tho'at Replicanum are plentiful enough to keep you occupied for as long as you want. \n\nAre you ready to go back into the Infinite Archive and fight their inky ilk?
A strong battle. We should do this again.
Ready yourself. The duel's begun!
We should get another nymic fragment from this maligraphy.
Well fought and well met. I'll remember you for sure. And I hope you'll remember me long after the bruises I gave you fade. \n\nWe taught each other much in that duel. I hope we can fight again.

I … I lost. There's no way around it. And I refuse to sully my integrity alongside my record and deny it. Should anyone ask, I will regale them with the truthful outcome of our battle.\n\nJust know that I will face you again. And I will win.
Oh good. We won. Thank the Cephaliarch that's over.
I'm going to go record all this in my journal for posterity.
You can join me if you want, but there are other maligraphies and Replicanum still in the archive.
The Black-Glove will be dead soon. You want to join him?
Axeborn Khurga is dying over here. You don't want to come get her?
The heart of the pit has to be quite the sight for you, Orc. Are you glad that it's the last thing you'll see?
Even the Black-Glove lasted longer than that.
Oathsworn or not, I'm still undefeated.
Well, that was an exciting diversion.
Our work isn't done.
Orcs are so proud of these homes. But the rock is as dead as they are.
Are you volunteering?
The Green is strong here. Short. But, very strong.
You had your chance to join us.
There's no way we lost to followers of Malacath.
Stand down or die.
Anyone know if we found that thing Aradros wanted?
That's just presumptive. All right, I'll give you the fight you want.
We'll tear you to pieces!
Oh, you're looking for a real challenge? All right.
You're going to fight me for this Orc?
Let's see whose flame burns brighter.
Nothing will remain but your ashes!
Few Oathsworn falter before a battle, but you're not Oathsworn, are you?
The Trial of Blood is arduous and painful. Still, you were not a match.
Spill the most blood to pass.
You're living, you require time to breathe and recuperate.
Oh, you're dead. That's one way to lose the battle.
Kills do not ensure victory. Controlling the battlefield does.
It's been so long since someone challenged me. I forgot how glorious it is!
I could have gone easier on you, but you took the trial.
Amass a larger army to ensure your victory!
It appears that we are out of time.
The ghost lights. I can't exist without them.
Ah! My lights! I need them.
Ugh. Now I have to start all over.
I feel funnier than I did before. It makes my fins shake.
I thought the frog would stop this from happening!
Be quicker next time!
The lights. Bring them here. I need them.
Well, this makes digging for treasure more difficult.
Looks like I won't even be a mage in death.
I can't keep myself together for much longer.
I thought I could practice here alone.
We are very upset with you!
Go faster! Time's running out.
It's rude to sneak up on us when we're playing!
Another mercenary back from the field. Give me the news, soldier.

I remember when the Legion was beyond number, when we had no need of adventurers-for-hire. Alas, those days are gone.\n\nStill, I expect you to bear in mind that Skingrad and Count Calantius are funding your efforts. Conduct yourself accordingly.

Perhaps you've heard. Imperial City is engulfed in war and a good portion of the Imperial Legion is off, trying to keep it contained. So, I have been authorized to hire adventurers and mercenaries to deal with more local issues. Care to hear more?
No more assignments are available, adventurer. Come back later. Some new threat or danger is sure to appear eventually. It always does.
There you are, thank Julianos! I thought I might need to send a search party. The logistics of such an endeavor would have been difficult, to say the least.
Return to me when your task is done. In the meantime, my superiors seem to think I need more duties to fill my day. If this keeps up, I'll be buried in paperwork until next season's grape harvest!
The Legion may be short on time, resources, and soldiers, but there is one thing I can offer you. Gold.\n\nSo, how many items can you help me strike off my list today?
Julianos smiles at me today! All of my tasks are complete and I have no jobs for hire! Enjoy the respite and come back tomorrow.
If you're looking for more work, Onsi knows I have plenty to share. The West Weald Legion is trying to keep up, but we're outnumbered. Perhaps even overmatched.
I wish I could send you straight out to deal with another Mirromoor incursion, but I can't offer you more work right now. Check back soon, though—I have a feeling the Daedra aren't done with us yet.

We've learned that you must defeat a powerful Mirrormoor champion to repel an incursion. Be warned: You can't overcome the champion until you kill the Shardborn valkynazes shielding it.\n\nReport back after you stop an incursion. And good luck!
It is said that Onsi sets a light in the face and a spring in the stride of a victorious warrior. If I am not mistaken, that is what I see now.\n\nHow did you fare, hero?
Thanks for helping us. We don't like being ghost lights.
Walking will hold you back.
You're too good at being a Watcher. Get your prize and take your body back.
I thought making you like me would solve this problem. I was wrong.
Get rid of the tomeshells. I don't care how.
Watch your step!
I can assist you!
I'll carve you up.
Leave the sweetrolls alone!
With her dead, there's more for me.
You beasts. How dare you!
No one steals my pastries.
Does that tree look right to you?
Anyone! Please help! It's horrible!
By the Green, I thought I was done for. Thank you, friend.
Flee, fool, or behold my wrath!
Not my children! You will suffer for this!
Malacath's mandible! Look at that!
Can you withstand the heat?
Don't you want to know what's in there?
I will bring about your downfall!
Be right back. Need to water my fish!
Destruction! You will fall to me!
The Weald will succumb to my illusions!
Get lost in the illusions I spin!
Feel the roots entangle you!
Fodder for the soil!
No! You resisted my illusions!
Such a captivating melody .…
The song … so beautiful ….
This was my wing to file. I'm glad to see it's largely undisturbed.
Don't mind me. I'll just look elsewhere for the spoils of war.
I saw you in the Index. You move quicker than I thought.
You did your work well mortal, now it's time for mine.
The fire burns all around us.
Maligraphies remain? So will I.
That Malkhest fellow said you'd be here.
I came to see what you were going to do in here.
Over there's where I had to stop working.
Please resist all temptations for destruction.
I like my tomes with a bit of life to them.
Try not to get ink everywhere. This is an archive.
How do you understand depth without three eyes?
My illusions can't be broken so easily!
Mortals are similar to filers. We have different specialties and so do you. \n\nYou're a strife mortal. Malkhest is a meditative mortal. This makes much sense.
Filer Myx won't let me file my sections into barricades. This is combat! Battlements and defenses are a requirement.
Let me know how you like the archives. I'm quite proud of the work I did in there.
I hope you're exploring the Index Chamber on your own. I don't want to have to point out everything of note.
The Lady's will be done.
Hope you've practiced your guard.
One less to worry about.
Don't show me your back!
Stop talking! I'm trying to listen.
The Blind sent us here to follow our path. So stop lollygagging!
The mean to stop us!
Don't let the interloper through!
Are you going to fight the Atronach from up here? Then what are you waiting for?
What's behind the Darkshard? Is that a Maxus clone? I'm intrigued.
Master, are you sure these are the right mortals?
Do you think they'll try this again, Tutor?
Did you think I wasn't strong enough for this? That I wasn't prepared?
You will not stop us!
I am surrounded by mindless fools! There's no one else qualified to be in charge of this group.
You! Stop!
Stay strong, don't let this place get to you.
The Blind will find what she seeks!
This is a place of honor for us, don't complain about being included.
We have an army, you won't beat us.
Stay on the path and you'll never be lost.
Are you underestimating your opponent? We'll see.
This is exactly the mentality I like to see before a fight!
Fight well!
This is sure to be spectacular!
You want to put on a show for our host?
No one gets between me and my goal.
There you are!
Wither and die!
You will fall!
Behold the wrath of Lorkhaj!
Look on me, fools, and see the end of all things!
I can withstand the flame.
Primary functions operational.
Combat sequence operational.
Testing data acquired. Discontinuing combat.
Hammer wants blood!
I never expected you to go without a fight. Good! Let us see who is stronger!
Inevitable.
I think we killed the Orcs too quickly.
After all that fighting, I'm going to sleep well tonight.
More? I thought we were done.
Your journey ends here.
I'm the most devoted one here. I should be by Aradros's side.
How long do we have to stay here? I miss Valenwood.
You don't stand a chance.
This won't last long.
Did you hear the noise that one made when I burned her?
Those Oathsworn didn't stand a chance. They've never been in a real fight.
You'll die with the other Oathsworn.
The Oathsworn are ash. And so are you.
How do you think the Orcs work in the pit? It's so hot.
You see that statue? One day, I want them to make a statue that size of me.
Don't make this too quick.
For Aradros and the Recollection!
I had to use magic to carry everything over here. Which wasn't too difficult, but it still required effort. \n\nAll I'm saying is it'd be rude of you not to purchase something.
Let Azimurr take a good look at you. Hmm, this one sees the problem. Come. Take a look at the sturdy armor Azimurr has to offer. And it's reasonably priced.
Trust me, my weapon prices are a steal. Get it? Because they're made of steel! Hmm, except the items that aren't. This joke may need some work.
I may seem young, but I'm good with numbers and handling gold. Nothing's ever gone missing from my coffers. I swear by Mauloch!

My friend Peek-Ereel once wrote that I wanted to make as little a mark on the world as possible as I passed through it. \n\nI was young then. We both were. Now I know better. I could sooner walk through mud and leave no footprints.
My loyalty will always belong to the Ebonheart Pact. But my heart belongs to Gideon. And my soul? That will always live in the roots of Seekhat-Xol.

Despite nightmares and visions of doom, young Eveli still devours every book she finds. She has a resilient spirit. And, for better or worse, a true love of books. \n\nAdmirable. I have heard others swear off reading entirely for far less.
A day in the Dark Brotherhood is a lot like anyone else's. Wake up, eat breakfast, get to work.\n\nSure, not everyone slays in service to our Dread Father, but otherwise it's about the same.

A lot of Nords try their hand at music or poetry. It's an honored tradition, but I can't carry a tune. Doesn't stop me, though! My friend Mirabelle complained that the sound of my voice was killing her. I took that as a compliment.

Such skill and strength you demonstrated when you dealt with Primate Artorius! Signs of a true hunter. You proved yourself worthy of the Silencer title. The Night Mother made the right choice when you were invited into the family.
Of course Hildegard is here with me! We're inseparable! Well, except for those times when she goes full on werewolf.\n\nHer fangs are very sharp and she likes to bite, so I leave her to her business.

I am a werewolf and I can be upfront about it here, right? No judgmental types around? I can usually feel the change coming upon me, just as Kor knows a storm is imminent when his big toe starts to ache.

Kor says I am too young to have regrets. I've hurt people, lost my family. Even lost myself for a while. Sometimes I wish I could take it all back.\n\nBut without that, I wouldn't have my brother and the path I'm on now. That is worth the struggle.

From Initiate to Silencer in such a brief time. You're an inspiration, my friend! I hope to please our Dread Father and Night Mother in the same way. And I think I can, once I gain a little more control over the wolf inside me.

On our way here, I felt a transformation coming. I leapt off the cart and ran into the woods. When Kor found me, he said the driver feared that I left because the horses smelled so bad.\n\nIt was quite funny, but we had to walk the rest of the way.
I've come to retrieve the nymic fragment. Carry on!
We're doing very important research back at the Index. I volunteered to come retrieve this.
Master Malkhest needs this fragment and you need a portal. Mortals always need something.
Retrieving these fragments is important, but keeping the maligraphies from destroying everything is important too.
Over here, mortal. With the rewards. I do hope you'll choose something interesting.
Make your choice while Master Malkhest prepares the portal for you.
No more maligraphies? Excellent. I was concerned that they'd still be here.
Almost no one in the archive has martial skills. It's a good thing you came along.
I and the rest of the filers are ready to carry on your good work should you fall.\n\nThe enemy awaits! Make your way to the portal and to glory!

Have you noticed that some wings of the archive look similar? The Infinite Archive used to be one continuous landmass, but that's obviously not the case anymore.\n\nThis doesn't matter to me as I can fly. You, on the other hand, must rely on portals.
Watching you fight, I almost understand Filer Eru's enthusiasm for violence. Almost.\n\nThe rewards for your efforts are there. Make your selection and move to the next battle.
Take all the advantages you can get. I think Tho'at Replicanum is noticing your abilities and creating stronger maligraphies.
You took a real beating in there. Give the Index time to reconnect you to the archive before you go back in.
Torvesard warned us we'd have company!
Check over there.
Ugh, I hate wasps.
The finest wares in all Tamriel, collected here for your convenience and pleasure! Now a show of gratitude would be nice.
Ah. You seem like the kind of warrior who appreciates perfection. Not everyone is worthy of my wares!
I come from a line of alchemists. We would never adulterate our work with fillers like chalk, mushroom dust, or day-old bread. Only the best produces the best!
A suboptimal moment to disturb my reflections. Luckily, the Inevitable Knower warned me we would speak today.
The Prince of Fate knows all, sees all. It was the merest flick of a tentacle to understand your approach. To advise of your challenge in the game of Tribute.
Together we scour the pit of weakness.
Not this time.
We're not done yet. Keep going.
I just want to kill you more.
Get ready!
Count your blood army, you've lost. The trial continues!
Killing your enemy isn't everything, you need to control the battlefield.
How did you forget? You only win when you have the largest atronach army.
Rise and fight with me!
Conquer for me!
I rarely lose!
Tooth, claw, and bone. The Green provides all the tools we need to prepare for war.
<The jewel that is Tzozabrar's eye fixates on you, ready to listen to your command.>
Business is good here, but things are just a little too quiet for me. I'm ready for some real action! Now, how can I help you?
(Goblin GIbberish 03)
Ha! Your attacks are useless!
No one will find your charred corpses!
That might have been incorrect.
It moves so quickly!
Tutor, take note of which enemy they prioritize.
Well played, but you haven't won yet!
I'm not here to stop you. I'm here to see how badly you fail.
Two great combatants meet at last!
Try not to make the same mistakes!
Curse you all!
There's nowhere to run.
I need more power!
This fight seems fair.
It's been inspired by my arenas!
Is this really Maxus, or one of his copies?
No more Atronachs. This space isn't big enough for a real army.
How will our warriors deal with this?
I always loved watching this big guy fight!
You possess all the skill of a child.
You aren't fit to die by this blade.
Can you feel Coldharbour clutching at your heart?
You're being chased by spiders, find the light.
Cleansing water probably sounds appealing to you.
This creature shows promise too.
My family came to Cyrodiil from Hammerfell centuries ago, and we have met with nothing but success. This shows what can happen when you don't shy away from hard work.
I just got a shipment in from High Isle. I mean, if you like High Isle. I hope you do.
Count Calantius is the one of the craftiest leaders in the Empire. He keeps the streets swept, the wars far from our walls, and the coffers full of coin!
There's nothing like a good book, my uncle always said. But I assume someone as well-read and well-traveled as yourself has seen all of these volumes before.
Our wares have seen the heat of battle and survived. The stories they could tell! Yes, they might be a bit scuffed, but that buffs out with a little elbow grease.
This one should have a better spot to sell such fine wares. But no, this one lacks the influence among the Imperials for such favors. Bah!
You see something you want? Great. Purchase it and move on. Let's make this transaction as painless as possible.
I can tell at a glance if someone is serious about their carpentry purchases. Convince me of your intent.
Settle down with a grocer, my friend. Then you will never lack a decent meal.
Yes, the goods I sell have seen the inside of an adventurer's pack. But they still have that newly-forged smell to them.
I've lived through a couple rulers, and Count Calantius is probably the best one, as far as merchants are concerned. He protects us, and then steps out of the way to let us do our jobs.
I am proud of my stock. Why hunt like a hoarvor through the litter of other shops? Come to me and I will provide you with all the finery your home deserves.
Look at the durability of my wares. This is material that can stand up to fighting hard and sleeping rough! It's not just armor, it's an investment!
Dazhiir offers solid merchandise at a fair price. Think of fair as if it is a carnival of value. Minus the clowns, of course.
I once showed off my talents on the battlefield. After I healed up from that experience, I decided to become a merchant. I never regretted that decision.
I have fought on the battlefields, and never did I live so much as when I risked death. I quake even at the memory of it!
Think of us as Skingrad's lost and found. You find it, and we help you lose it again. Works out well for both of us, eh?
Commerce such as mine relies on trust from both the sellers and the purchaser. Even here, honesty is the best policy.
I have the perfect thing for you! I put it somewhere. I had it in my hand just moments ago. No, maybe I don't have it. But please, feel free to browse.
It is good to see a friendly face out here in the hinterlands. How are you this fine day? Can I help you with anything?
And forge a throne from the shards that survive.
Danger! Protect us!
Split at the stem.
Draughts? Philters? Lockpicks? The coin you spend today is just a small investment to secure the trove you'll find tomorrow!
We cannot teach horses to run faster or farther. But take good care of them, and they figure it out on their own.
I see you're interested in my work. Each piece I shape upon the lathe shapes me in turn. The things we make, make us as well.
Welcome, traveler! I bet you've got an interesting story or two … but I can see you're here to shop. How can I help you?
You may ask, what does a Khajiit know of these lands? Rakamati will tell you. He walked the Gold Road with old Imperials. They taught his feet and eyes the way. You can trust Rakamati.
Drown in our lake!
Attacked? Us?
You're scared, but you don't have to attack!
Things aren't going to improve around here. Well, they might for me. Hard times are always good for brewers.
The power of these ruins is ours for the taking.
Unlike the Ayleids, Mirrormoor endures.

The nobility is adamant that we have little to worry about. The growing tensions will ease at some point.\n\nAll the same, there is no harm in shoring up your stores of healing drafts and protections.
I wonder if I'll ever get a nickname. Like Quickawl, or Strongthread. Something that shows my mastery, you know?\n\nAnyway, what are you looking for?
Another adventurer. We seem to get a lot of your kind around here. \n\nWell? Don't take your time with my inventory. I don't want a line to form.
Protect us!
What do you need? I have it in stock. Don't believe me? Take a look for yourself, but I know I'm right.
How large is your purse? I ask only because I have a great deal to sell you. Knowing how much you can spare will make our dealings much easier.

Everyone always has some recipe or dish in mind when they come to me. Well, too bad! I make delicious food. It's incredible. I slaved over this cook fire. I made sure it didn't boil over or burn.\n\nYou will buy my food, and you will enjoy it!
Thank you all for attending! I plan to offer an exchange of culinary culture soon. I have a hearty coney stew recipe.
I thought I'd miss the rocks and crags of the Reach, but the Dawnwood is growing on me. It's growing on everything for that matter.
Once you're dead, the elixir goes in the water!
We get rid of you and the evidence at the same time!
See what a real blade master can do.
Embrace the dance of death!
Struggling will only burn you more.
I'll crush you for Aradros!
The Oathsworn weren't nimble, are you?
Orcs say this fire is transformative. Wonder what it'll make of you.
Only good mortal is a dead one.
How long have I been doing this? Seems like forever.
Fresh blood to spill!
I needed some action!
No, they're not here for architecture. They are here to die.
You're hesitating. Do you finally understand how futile this is?
You were in such a hurry to get here. Now you hesitate. Pitiful.
They all look delicious. Who to devour first?
You should have died earlier and saved us both some time.
You were in such a hurry to get here. Now you hesitate. Pitiful.
I heard about these banners. They're an insult! Do we not look challenging enough?
We will feast on your pain!
I won't waste my time on you.
Are you so confident, or do you just want to die quickly?
I will feed your souls to Xalvakka myself!
We haven't fought anyone in ages!
Some mortals to practice on!
Remember your oaths. Hold this chamber and let no one pass.
This is as far as you go!
Most bones are too brittle. These bones are eternal!
Rip them to shreds!
I suppose I raised you for combat and not entertainment.
Crush them. Kill them!
Die by my hands!
Wait, how many eyes did it have?
Your lives end now!
I'm going to expire from boredom alone. How does anyone stand this?
Let's test your strength.
Keep up that yammering and I'll split you in two.
Our guards are useless!
There's no way this plan backfires. It's better than the last one.

Can you feel that? That's the swell of potential just waiting to be converted into something useful. It's an excellent feeling!\n\nSometimes I stare out at the limitless possibilities of Maelstrom and revel in its power.

The goal of this hall is to help my master remember their Barons. Once remembered, they can be re-corporated. \n\nI don't think my master will ever surrender the dream of storming the Aurbis in glorious combat.
I thought I'd miss the rocks and crags of the Reach, but the Dawnwood is growing on me. It's growing on everything for that matter.
I could hear the clink of your coin from across the realms. Truly tantalizing.
<You get a doggy grin before Eri remember he's on the job and gets focused.>
