Goblins are a blight.
Nearly slipped on a rock.
I thought this would be more interesting.
There better be a tavern around here.
Ready for exciting, fulfilling work? Join the Aldmeri Dominion!
These mortals do not deserve Mirrormoor's blessings.
Mirrormoor will triumph!

Names Ashur, I don't normally offer that to just anybody. Can't be too careful with such things in my line of work. And just so we're clear, I'm an assassin with the Morag Tong. Keep that to yourself and we won't have any issues.
My family has a long tradition with the Morag Tong. My grandfather was a revered operative, for example. One of the reasons I became an assassin.\n\nThat, and I like executing writs.

Well met, adventurer! I didn't expect to see any familiar faces here, so this is a surprise. Just to be clear, I am not here to carry out a writ. No bloodshed or mayhem this time around for me. \n\nReally. Wink, wink.

Last time I saw Naryu, she had finished a writ and was looking for a bottle of wine and some company. I almost volunteered, but then I remembered something very important.\n\nNaryu tends to stick daggers in her playthings when she's done with them.
Mirrormoor will not be denied!
Argh, the cursed light!
Arkay's wrath will find you!
Get ready!
You are stronger. You can win!

My employer claims her beloved and her best friend are trysting in that moldering hole in the earth. Yet my nose tells me a thrice-blasted troll frequents the area.\n\nPerhaps I should bring some of its dung to my employer as proof?
I deserve this, not you!
No one will underestimate me.
I don't even have to aim!
Yes! They obey me!
Fools! All of you!
Look to the crystals!
Your friend is still alive.
Animating Crux split 3
You cannot let them succeed!
Find a way to bring this crystal down!
The exit is close. We can make it.
Return to the null arca!
I wish I was off adventuring.
No! I surrender!
You think you're so clever and powerful. Just wait.
Focus on the mirrors. Get it to stop!
Make it hit one of those orbs!
The arcane knot is mine. As it always would be. Pathetic.
One extra banner isn't going to keep you from dying like the insects you are.
I'm going to enjoy this.
Crush them! End them! Destroy them!
Obliterate the mortals! Leave nothing behind!
That actually hurt!
Still alive? Well, I doubt that will last.
I will destroy you this time!
We're certain to make this battle a short one.
I thought these legionaries would be more trouble.
I think the Khajiit knew that we'd experience some trouble here. He told me to stock up before we left Fargrave.\n\nSee for yourself.
This isn't the expedition Keshargo promised. He never said we'd be attacked. \n\nAre you here to help us? Please, buy whatever you need!
Mirrormoor shall not fall this day.
For Mirrormoor! For our Prince!
Clear a path for the Great Eye!
My twin, come back!
Prove your worth.
If local events dragged you into a morass of endless responsibility, clear your mind with physical activity that requires your full attention? Join us in battle.
If we ever face each other here, I hope we learn from each other. Knowledge gained while facing a Pit Daemon like me is knowledge you can use through life.
With a team name like Fire Drake, you may expect us to breathe gouts of flame on you.\n\nI assure you that I have no such intention at the moment.
I see. I see. Very well. The wisps see a golden path laid before you, and that you have the strength to walk it. I see good fortune ahead for you.

If I can't find my friend soon, I'm going to get my coin back from the mage who enchanted this compass. Unless … hmm. Maybe people can change into wisps. I should ask about that first.\n\nBe careful, friend, just in case.

Another traveler informed me that the Wood Elves may have something to do with this house's condition. That's for later consideration, though.\n\nRight now, I want to lean at the same angle as the house, which doesn't help my painting technique.
Looks like I'll have to find a new favorite wine. Even the grapes that look safe in this vineyard could give a Peryite-blessed skeever the runs.\n\nDon't ask me how I know that.

I hope to find a good wine in Skingrad to pair with my new Wood Elf pork recipe. Trouble is that I got distracted by the once-plentiful boars here.\n\nMaybe Biryth was right and I need to cut back on my boar hunting. But they taste so good!
On my way here, I ran into some folk muttering about outsiders. I can't decide if they were talking about me or someone else.\n\nWell, that's on them, not me. I like meeting folks who are new to me!

As a veteran of the guild with a penchant for the identification and illumination of ancient secrets, a little advice. The cute little coffers carved with inscrutable runes? Never worth the next-day headaches.\n\nSorry. You came to shop. Take a look.
This one should give up banditry and become a musician.
Where did you learn that foul language?\n\nOh, not you, stranger. My companion Seremina. We were just talking about what happens after I … no. Best not to discuss that with anyone.

Impure egg-kin and ojel sleep more soundly than I do. It seems unfair that they can dream of their next abhorrent act while I struggle to remain awake.\n\nPerhaps I can make their dreams less pleasant to them. Eventually.
They should have left when they had the chance.
Saws and axes? Heathens!
To me! At once!
Now, we kill the mortal.
For Mirrormoor! For glory!
For Mirrormoor! For our Prince!
The Prince must not be interrupted.
We will never forget again!
Everything lost shall be restored!
Our day of reckoning is at hand.
To have purpose again, invigorating!
Any orders from the shardmarshal?
Watch your step!
The truth is the wisdom is the law, oh father of equations.\n\nHave you come for truth, pilgrim?
A challenger. I pray to feel Mara's love, that it might carry me to victory.
Yes, I can already feel the power of the well coursing through me! All will tremble!
The mirrors are important!

And forge a throne from the shards that survive.
And forge a throne from the shards that survive.
I've got better places to be.

Silence is nice. I definitely respect silence. It's calming, right? That's what people say? I've never found it calming. I sort of dread it. Not that we can't sit silently. We can absolutely sit silently. Just like this. Silent. Totally. Silent.
I missed that twinkle in your eye.
I'm learning a lot from you.
Time to knock some heads.
Almost dozed off there.
Now we're talking!
Look at us go!
You're trapped! Look out!
Need me to knock some sense into you?
Let's give it all we've got.
They really made us work for it.
I don't think I'm going to make it.
Refreshing! Thanks!
You can't keep fighting if you pass out!
You're exhausted! Careful, don't keel over.
Drink a bottle of the blue stuff!
Always worth it for the loot.
Mind the chompy end, yeah?
It's hard to hear after all those shouts!
I hope this works!
Wow, the big guy sure loves the sound of his own voice.
Aren't beaches supposed to be relaxing?
This is why I never date witches.
These druids don't mess around.
I feel like all the spikes and flames are a bit much.
Ow. I got so many papercuts.
Watch your step. There's glass everywhere.
That rattled them!
Let's find something to punch.
Would be nice to get a drink or two.
I wouldn't have seen this without you.
Race you there?
If I spot treasure, do I get a finder's fee?
My first kiss, right over there. The son of an artisan my mother knew. He was soft. Sweet. For a moment, I think I convinced myself I could be normal, like everyone else. I'm glad I grew out of it.
I could go a lifetime never seeing that tower again. Some wounds never really heal, you know?
I used to be a gardener for Skywatch Manor. I am judging this shrubbery work so hard right now.
Come on, show us something good!
Does it … maybe then it … oh, that's clever.
Good thing it wasn't a trap.
Someone just left this lying around?
Bet we could get some use out of that.
How do you do it?
Don't forget to check for bugs.
Look at you, collecting your special rocks.
Think something big knocked this over?
Don't skimp on the creepy crawlies.
Old magicka has a curious feel about it.
A work out just for some dust?
Hey. Maybe next time you let me steer?
I know you've got a second wind in you!
I take my leave. Farewell.
So many books in this era. More and more made with every turn of the seasons. Azurah will have to send me back from the Crossing for a third life just to read them all.
Let us travel like twin moons.
Strength of the exiled Boethra. It finds me, even now.
Watch yourself!
May your bones serve better.
Ji'zho tsin'radhi!
Like twin moons!
You are trapped. Move!
Ra'ham! Find your center!
A battle fit for moon-singer stories!
Boethra's path leads us to victory.
I have a second life, but I can still lose it.
You show me Jone's mercy.
Tamiit! Stay with me!
You fade like the dawn, tamiit! Careful!
You are drained of your spells, tamiit!
Sharp claws on all who see such a swift end!
Demon! Feel the wrath of the Hidden Moon!
Siich'dei, mighty one. You are beaten.
Dusk and dawn, ignite within me!
After how many failed incursions should this Lord of Domination seek to change his name?
What a rush! Of water. Among other things.
Well, at least I can feel my claws again. There must be easier ways to warm oneself in this climate.
Balance restored. Already, the earth cools beneath our feet. Well done, tamiit.
As chaotic as the tales of Merrunz said. I am glad to see the portal closed to this barren plane.
Hahl fajh'na. Quite the ordeal. But we are made stronger for it. Ahzith rabah, Hermora.
The light from these strange Daedra dazzles my eyes. At last, we see them gone.
A splendid strike! Do it again!
Jone and Jode, guide our steps in this troubled place.
I think I read about this place! In a book from my time. It is quite different from what I recall. … Perhaps I misremember. Pay me no mind.
There is a majesty here that surely moves the hands of poets.
With Khenarthi's swiftness!
Something of value left there. Only fair that it become yours.
Many glad sights in a vibrant market such as this.
Rim'kha. How strange that a place may seem both foreign and familiar. Like a friend changed after so many years apart.
Ruins of structures I know, and ruins of structures I never lived to see. The feeling is … murrzalgi. Sweet and bitter at once.
What use is treasure if it stays sealed away?
Jo'zhet! How useful. Ahzith rabah.
Seven shadows, what a find!
Alkosh smiles upon you.
Imagine the fine attire you might make with that.
A fine ore, tamiit.
A sturdy find indeed.
The potential for health or harm.
Potency, aspect, or essence? Hrrm. Good find.
Fair potential for fine adornments.
If I fall off, just leave me. I shall use my moonclaw to catch up.
A fitting reward for such well-played victories. Let us see it done again soon.
Stay buried next time.
May your heart be made clean.
Our weapons are but one cure for your kind.
You do not know what a blessing water is until you have gone long without it.
Savior and protector. That is the tamiit I follow.
So tempting to play … but if I do, you will never pry me away. Better that I watch. For now.
If only everyone so willingly parted with their gold. There would be no need for beggars.
Are you ashamed of these things you so skillfully stole?
I am glad we spent our time on that, tamiit. This defense force needs all the help it can get.
Take and give with the same hand, I say.
I sense Merid-Nunda's hand here. Greed and domination never play well together.
Normally, I admire your curious nature. But learning such a thing as this cannot bode well.
You bend to a design that neither you nor your victim were made for.
No! I beg you, tamiit. Do not inflict this curse upon another.
Have you abandoned your conscience? Stop this!
Petty thievery I admire. Stealing such as this feels malicious.
A fine enough reward.
Back to Oblivion!
Flowers make me so nostalgic.
That's a nice boost.
Mmm. Reminds me of home.
You came prepared.
Aargh or whatever!
Pocket what you can.
I remember guards being quicker?
There a lot of gold in stealing kid's toys?
Ugh. I want no part in that.
I don't need to be here for this.
Can we get moving?
Come on, sneak a little sip.
Nothing can stop you.
It's so beautiful.
Try not to stare directly into it.
I suppose my undead army could use more soldiers.
You don't stand a chance.
Xoryn will get what he wants.
I will not be defeated!
Not much for the match wagers, myself. I prefer cards, stones, or chits, you know? I bet on myself.
What else is there to do when you're not working at the quarry or ranch?

Arcane investigations happen more often in a library than in a haunted graveyard.\n\nFinding a severed tongue scarred with ancient runes can be exhilarating. But spending days hunched over dusty tomes to translate those runes? That's the real fun.

Gwendis behaves just as any true sister—she teases me endlessly. She calls me bookworm due to my love of libraries and my passion for books. I haven't yet thought of a nickname for her. I really must do some research.\n\nAh, blast. I am a bookworm.

In many ways, I'm quite fortunate. Despite the various trials and pains I've experienced, I managed to stumble into a life filled with purpose. Count Verandis gave me shelter and a family. And now I count you as an excellent friend. How lucky am I?

The topic of a cure comes up often among our kind. I don't know if you've considered, but I have. Even researched the process, which seems very rare and difficult.\n\nIn the end, I decided against taking the cure. This is who I am and I accept that.
Tamiit! No!
You ever wonder where these came from?
Why stop there? Let's find another.
I won't lie, that's pretty useful.
Where can we get more?
I didn't realize you were an artisan!

I've just come back from another expedition searching for scripts, seeking out secrets. I am quite frankly exhausted.\n\nAnd yet somehow I am still here. Ready and willing to sell you these precious materials.
If you're looking for something and don't see it, just be patient. If you please. What I have available changes with the whims of the adepts. Whims, I say! \n\nIn the meantime, here's what I do have.
Hmm, why do I taste mint?
Who keeps this many baskets around?
Delicate and dashing!
Hah! Such battles make me feel young again. Shall we seek to fight another?
To see copies of one's self defeated for all eternity … I nearly pity her.
What luck to face a Marauder like that! Perhaps the worldly and wandering spirits wish to hear our weapons sing.
This place makes my tattoos itch.
You think they're compensating for anything?
Let's loot the place and leave.
At least wash your hands after.
No sudden moves now.
I can't tell you how long I've been stuck here waiting for someone with skills and guts. No one else would go after my enemies. But, you're brave. You can help.
Stay on your guard in there and don't underestimate anything. All the enemies you defeat will only lure you into a false sense of confidence. That's when they get you.

These blasted filers, they know that I need rewards to pay you warriors with, but they keep moving them! I want to tear the tentacles from their sides!\n\nCome back later, after I've had some time to find refiled rewards.
How was it? Did they bleed? Did you win?
My heart can't bear it!
If anyone hurts you, I'll kill them.
Let fate renew your vigor, proxy!
Crouch! He must not hear or see you!
Worry, scurry, hurry.
Here I come!
The Albuses care about us. Not like the alliance generals. We're fodder to them.
The wind blows through here like it's got a mind of it's own.
Do your worst!
Fight for our cause!
I don't have to guess where your loyalties lie.
I am the one Cato trusts. I am the one who will avenge Caecilius.
Ready whenever you are.
Ready the next prisoner!
Lucilla, you thought they could defeat me?
You weren't supposed to die!
You fight for the alliances!
Good thing the Albuses stepped up, otherwise this accursed war would never stop.
Enemies of Albus!
The alliances think they can get away with so much.
You will not threaten Cato!
My boots haven't dried out in days.
Time to fight.
We all answer to someone. Least I know who that is.
You brought a flag as your witness? Adorable!
For Caecilius!
I was happy to just kill you, but I will make you suffer first!
No one obstructs the Albus family.
I hope you know what you're doing.
Divines favor us!
I still feel duty's pull.
I tried protecting you from yourself.
I will not fail this time!
The war does not have to continue. But it continues.
More students who never followed my teachings.
You never think!
I don't want your pity!
No more interruptions.
You're not hearing me!
Can't wait to see Orpheon back on the Ruby Throne.
This assault didn't last very long. Orpheon's living up to his title.
Look here. A training dummy!
This is your last fight.
So, some ungrateful rats did survive my boulders. I can remedy that.
Did you like my Alcunar's entrance? He's very graceful. And hungry.
Think you're the first to oppose me? You don't stand a chance.
Pact recruits put up more of a fight than you.
Oh good boy Alcunar! Yes!
How sweet is this revenge, eh Alcunar?
Tu'whacca take 'em!
We could have ended the war! But those uppity alliances will never stop.
More for the slaughter!
Garvin's going stir crazy down here with nothing to track.
The Undaunted banner? All right, I'll show you my best.
My gryphons do not understand the begging of losers. But you're still welcome to try.
Do your worst!
Bold choice, warriors.
Prideful and arrogant. I will show you your errors.
No one stands in my way and lives.
Ugh! I stepped in blood.
I'll leave you in the sand!
So, you can aim. That doesn't mean you can fight.
Yes! Let's go!
Do you like the fire? It's very drying.
Awww. They're dead.
Oh! A fight!
We shouldn't hurt beautiful things!
I just know it understands what love is.
Do you feel adrift?
Fast as light!
The prophecy is fulfilled.
An archival wing that fights back? I'm thrilled!
The change in temperature shouldn't affect you.
Step carefully. No one wants to fight with damaged shoes.
Before you ask, I did not file this wing. I would have moved the tomes somewhere safe.
Onward, soldier. Brace for the fight.
That fight went better than expected.
Are they all dead? I can't watch.
I must admit, you are killing them quickly.
Don't keep our lady waiting.
Nowhere to run, nowhere to hide.
<Caal eyes your coinpurse, muttering something in incomprehensible Daedric to herself.>

Ah! A customer. You surprised me. I didn't think anyone would be here so quickly. I haven't even adjusted all my prices to cover value differences across the Aurbis. \n\nNo matter, you are a customer. All prices are final!
Foam and frost, to me!
Is that all that silver tongue can do?
Your reliance on this practice of soul gems is troubling.
You ever shake the soul gem to hear if they scream?
Mizzik needs to stop doing that.
Our research is going too slowly.
Our research is going too slowly.

<<Sniffling, runny nose.>>

It's down. We still have a chance!

Good assistants are so hard to find! So many of them complain about the long hours, lack of adequate compensation, and dangerous working conditions. It's as if getting the chance to learn from the great Narsis Dren isn't recompense enough!

Have you been inside many sarcophagi before? They're remarkably comfortable. Snug, yes, but good for a nap. Just be sure the lid doesn't lock behind you. Unless you like a challenge. Nothing like being trapped in a tomb to get the blood pumping!
What's that?
I'm listening.
I'm here for whatever you need.

I try to avoid most magical institutions. I just don't think they have our best interests in mind, you know? I've had my fair share of curious mages try to solve ... well. Me. Like I'm a puzzle, not a person.

Don't make me come in!

You'll make your family proud. I know it!

I need <<1>>!

I would be proud to bare steel alongside you, warrior. Continue your efforts for the Covenant!
I don't think I can take much more of this. I can't sleep. I can't think. And the food tastes terrible.
I'm so tired. But I can't go to sleep. I heard if you fall asleep in Coldharbour, you never wake up.

Now, I know some of you are wondering why I ban Necromancy in my classroom. Trust me. The smell alone is worth steering clear.

The Guild requests your help!
By Stendarr's blade will we settle the score!
The discoveries I'll make here will rewrite the laws of magic!
Breath that in, wayfarer. Smell the waters and life of Eyevea.
Magnus keep and watch over you, adept.
Fight well, adept, and uphold the Guild's honor on the battlefield!
Mara's heart, this place is lovely. Might have to bring my sweetie here someday.

Bright Moons, adept. This one is glad to see you enjoying the air of Eyevea.
Stars above, adept. Your work with Valaste is the talk of the guild!
My only real complaint about Eyevea? Not enough meat in the beer.
Suhr's inside, if you need help!
Get me some more tar, will you?
Those damned Sea Vipers still watching us? 'Course they are.
More wood for the cookfires, captain!
Sorry, adept. Trying to calculate pricing for a particularly intricate spell matrix.
Go well along the river, adept. May it guide you well.
Perhaps the gold is in another coffin. Curses!
Death will not stop us!
Such foul creatures in my forest will not be tolerated!
Weapons ready.
Is it just me, or do those illusions stare into your soul?
Good luck out there.
I drank too much.
I think this has gone on long enough. Time for you to die now!
Not gonna fall down today. Just not gonna.
Marvel at its slavering maw!
O'ver the seas and far away!
Do you see, Grubnose? Everything will be all right.
Whoa there, no entry.
This lodge is off limits!
If I ever get a good night's sleep, I'd love to write a paper about these things.
Why … what did we do that for? It looked so friendly!
The buzzing is louder and louder and louder! Stopped. Stopped, it's all right now.
So tired of the fighting. Why can't we all just talk?
The poison's burn wanes. I am in your debt.
No access to non-Covenant personnel.
Come on, I don't want to move. This pole is comfortable.
Invite only!
Don't go to sleep. Bad dreams. Bad, bad dreams.
Oh, why did we even come to this awful place? What were we thinking?
Did you know the Mane is here? I would have thought he'd oppose the occupation.
You've no idea how grateful I am that you came along.
Good day, Centurion.
I can see the fear in your eyes, you spineless worm!
Trade caravan coming in from Mistral!
Two hours until watch change. Stay alert.

Next time, throw yourself in the fire!
Come forth! Crystal moonlight, come forth!
Balance, balance! Do not overextend!
… rise up from below!

Hope no more get into the camp.

The Master's Will be done!
Balras should have been here by now.
Curse those cultists. I should never have made this deal.
Upon my honor, Eyevea certainly is grand!
I know it's just my imagination, but I swear the Elves leave a stink behind. You know?
This place is wonderful. Don't tell anyone, but I think even Sovngarde might pale next to Eyevea!
Go with Almalexia, adept. May she guide your research well.
Stars above, it's you adept! Do give Shalidor my best, yes?
I saw an Argonian earlier today! Can you imagine?
This one is most impressed. You survived the trials of Sheggorath, and still have your wits about you!
May you find your way to Mara's Bosom, adept.
Is that a lung?
From what Merric tells us, Aelif will guide you true.
Good luck.

Merric has been reasonable so far. Perhaps he should have been the interim rather than Sees-All-Colors. I've always held a great respect for the Redguard.

I pray you'll return with the answers we need.
There's no law against me standing here.
What have my babies done? Those poor miners!
Have you watched the General's projection? Really watched it? Her eyes kind of… follow you.
The Clan Mother demands we be kind to our Colovian prisoners. If we must…
Clan Mother Kazirra demands we be kind to our Colovian prisoners. If we must.
Keep your lizard well in hand or I will step on it!
Can we ever trust the Mane again? Is the darkness within him truly gone?
Aaaaah!
Aaaaah!
It's a good thing you arrived. I'm not sure how much longer we could hold the undead back.
Break those rocks! Dig those ditches! Why? Because I want you to!
Those who cover up the truth are accomplices in the crime! You know who you are!
Your torment is ended.
Veloth guide my hand!
This one knows that Senalana was once a home to the Ayleids. Perhaps that is why the Colovians are so intent on taking it.

When I was young, I always dreamed of getting married. Can't say the idea appeals to me any more.
Excellent. More meat sacks for the ogres!

I can't wait to have more space for beekeeping. Cities as far away as Skywatch are importing it, and we just don't have the space to keep up.
I want to dance! Do you want to dance? I want to spin around and around! Let's dance!

I can make this last as long as I need.
Selene will make you pay!

Just one more bet. I'll be out of the hole with just one more!
I feel so sheltered as an Altmer. We must understand the other people of Tamriel if we stand a chance of ruling the continent.
I love this place. It's the smell of desperation. Such a bestial stench. It makes betting so much more pleasurable.
The Withered Hand comes with Satakal's blessing.
I'll make <<1>> proud.
No more!
I'd ask if you were interested in browsing, but I can tell from that look in your eye that you're here for business… not pleasure.
I need more time. Don't let those creatures get past you!
What wasted potential.
A couple more hours, then I'm done!
I don't have an unlimited amount of power at my disposal, so you'll need to deal with these brutes.
Lizard run, under the sun! Fortune favored, victories savored! Lizard run, lizard run!
We have the fastest lizards, here in Alik'r!
I read about a lizard called a guar… I wonder if it has the passion to race as our lizards do?
We're missing sales every minute we're closed!
Lizard run, under the sun! Fortune favored, victories savored! Lizard run, lizard run!
Bet on the restless ones!
There has to be something out here. Where in Y'ffre's name is that sound coming from?
Work, you lazy skeevers! Work!
Do you get in trouble for being so "knotty"?
Fancy words and stern indignation won't sway my decision.
The Altmer girl?
Those mercenaries will get what's coming to them!
That ash is worth far more than your life to me.

Fishy, fishy, in the sea,
Jump onto this rock for me,
Fishy, fishy, in the sea,
What color fish will you be?

…Dagon take you, I'm hungry!
Great!
An Altmer called me 'half-elf' yesterday. I think he was insulting my height.
I'd like to travel to Summerset one day.

Before you ask, no, I've never eaten man or mer. I left Valenwood for Auridon some time ago to study magic.

To begin with, being a practicing cannibal in the Summerset Isles would make establishing a social life difficult.

Now, how may I help you?
If ever a dark storm appears before you, and from it a great anchor falls ….\n\nYou rush in and kill everything you can find. And then, come tell me about it.
We won't be made fools of in front of Molag Bal!
Lost at sea in the service of the Emperor. I wonder what my family must think.
You look like a sturdy one! Should I treat you to my whip or my riding crop?
Lin, can we go soon?
Silence, please, during our worship time.
Better not stay long. They'll try to make you join the order if you do.
Your corpse will join the rest of the dead!
Beg for mercy. The captain may hear you out.
Hurry up! We have treasure to load.

Razum-dar is a tough, but fair spymaster. Our last boss, Krin Ren-dro, would sacrifice us like pawns, all for some "greater cause." I never trusted the man.
Fools thought betraying the captain would pay off.
The Planemeld will go on as planned. You cannot stop it!
We do sometimes admire our prey and secretly applaud when it cheats our snares.
That's good, keep them off our backs. Buy the captain some time!
We don't know death like this in the Wilderking's realm.
We should leave soon, before the Orcs return to finish us off.
Your efforts are futile. The Planemeld is nearly complete.
While the prey was distracted, the predator prepared to strike.
Have you tasted the wine? I recommend you do not.
Her parents did right to come to me. Only I can help the poor thing.
Prince Naemon told the most hilarious joke the other day. Something about a Bosmer and a Khajiit ….
Take a Breather Allene.
You really can't do anything yourself.
Dogs! Filth! You anger a powerful enemy.
You've proven your strength. Again.
Protect the Barrowbough!
For the glory of the Ra Gada!
Stendarr's wrath, that fire is hot. Just a moment, comrade. I'll prepare the core.
<<1>> and the Dominion: together, we'll achieve unity.
Don't be long, dearie. I'll wait for you up here.
Good to see that you're well, dearie.
The presence of unbelievers clouds our dreams and nightmares, cutting us off from Vaermina. Convert all you meet, slay those who refuse!
Come to me if your limbs ache or your stomach rumbles. Phynaster's Stride has many beds, and plenty of room for you.
I hear your steps, Vestige.
What news from the world at large?
Spit it out, we haven't got all eternity.
I've seen that look. I've worn that look!
Now they've gone and spoiled the mood!
Die and be damned!

I'm sure everything will be fine. Why would anyone bother us here?

Get out of my head!
If Mother Almalexia is the Anticipation of Boethiah… where are the arenas? Where is the strife here? It's all so strange.

Unacceptable!

Eeyai!

No mother should have to bury her children.

We sing and spin tales here in Valenwood in honor of you, Y'ffre, for the lessons you have taught us ….

Hircine—no! I just wish to commune with you!

The Thalmor commands!

Sahalu is full of big ideas! \n\nInstead of digging through the rock, we should dig underneath! No one listens to Sahalu, though. "We'll get crushed," they say. Feh. Ziss on them. I dig my hole anyway.

Purge the non-believers!

I wish I had more time to study this unusual place, but I expect they'll call us into battle at any moment.
My partner wants to explore and take notes. As usual.\n\nI swear, if she isn't here when the Battlemaster calls us to compete, I might just set her on fire.

I didn't really want to fight in the Arena, anyway. Stupid horkers! Oh, why did they leave me?\n\nI lied! I want to fight in the Arena so badly, I can taste it! And it tastes like Voljar's spiced mead!
It's a shame everyone who doesn't want to fight just can't get up and leave the field of battle. Imagine how much better wars would be if the only participants actually wanted to be there.
Valkyn Skoria will not suffer this! Slay the mortals!
Did you get your helm caved in? Don't you want your cut?
Feel free to examine the craftsmanship. All of my armor is of the finest quality, I guarantee it.
Outsiders are often surprised by the quality of Orcish leatherwork. I have no idea why. We're not savages, you know.
Have you visited the museum yet? Fascinating place. Who knew the Orcs had such a rich history?\n\nDo buy something before you go, though!
Down-on-their-luck adventurers and second-rate merchants. I'm so proud to be counted among them.\n\nAnd what can I do for you this fine day?
The ritual site is our only priority.
I'll never get used to outsiders pawing at my masterwork weapons, but the king's wishes must be obeyed.
Embrace the new day—and burn.
Do I need to explain the concept of a bank to you, or are you familiar with our list of services?
The Fire Maw will purify you.
Writhe in fire!
Prepare yourselves for the end!
These mortals are not to touch the Valkyn. We stop them here.
Be grateful for the cleansing fire.
For the Valkyn, my fire will claim you.
Valkyn Skoria rules this keep!
Nowhere to run.
You will burn.
A new day dawns amidst earth and fire!
You should visit the House of Orsimer Glories. It's our museum in the Crafting District. A real treat, trust me.
I never expected the Orcs to build something as grand as Orsinium. But all these stone walls are kind of oppressive, don't you think?
Outsiders are good for business, sure. But seeing all these tuskless faces walking around like they own the place makes me nervous.
Such a lovely city, yes? It's almost a shame to waste it on the Orcs. They seem to prefer more humble accommodations, yes?
You do understand these components are used in alchemy, not baking, right? Good.
Some people love the sound of hammers and anvils. Just sounds like noise to me. Ugh.
So I prefer that everything be put in its proper place. Does that make me too genteel for Orc society? I think not!
You should have seen this place before the king started rebuilding it. More like a disaster area than a proper city.
The Fighters Guild ignores political boundaries and alliances. We go where we are needed.\n\nAnd Wrothgar? Wrothgar definitely needs our help.

The king was quite adamant that the guilds should have a place in the reborn Orsinium. He wants every service and convenience available in any other city, including the Mages Guild.\n\nThat's why we're here.

The locals have little trust in magic and even less tolerance of outsiders. Especially outsiders of my particular pedigree.\n\nHow the king hopes to establish a proper kingdom with subjects such as these is beyond my comprehension.
My brews pack a wallop like you wouldn't believe! Think you're tough enough to handle them?
Good to see you!
Cooking is usually women's work, but what can I say? I've always favored a fork and spoon over a hammer and anvil.
What a fine day! But they're all fine days here in Orsinium, don't you agree?
Going to have to shift all these if more supplies come in.
These will be very useful in Cyrodiil!
I wonder if I might buy one of these off you sometime.
Turn this place to ash! Leave nothing alive!
Too many packages. I'll never sort these orders in time.
Come, sit by the fire with <<1>>. Let us talk of things this one has that you need!
Could you put your delivery on the cart? No, never mind, I should do it.
This one knows how you die.
This one shall not warn you again!
With each delivery of goods, our struggle seems less futile.
Your bodies will feed the light of the Deadlands.
Death is a new beginning.
Come! Do your trading here!
I've got just what you need.
Greetings! Let's do some business.
Selling! Buying! Trading! Right here!
Come! Do your trading here!
This one has what you need.
We like it out here. It's quiet, peaceful.\n\nExcept for the draugr, but no place is perfect.

One thing I'll say about the city, they pay well and they're willing to buy every fish I catch.\n\nI'm just glad you were able to deal with the trouble at the barrow. I'd hate to have to move all our stuff again.
Come, father. Let's clean the fish and make some lunch.\n\nHello. I'd ask you to join us, but company makes my father nervous.
I've got good Orcish weapons. The finest craftsmanship in all Tamriel.
Joining the king's army was the smartest thing I ever did.
I wouldn't want the stone that builds Orsinium to come from any other quarry.
If I were in charge, we would have sent word to Orsinium right away. But the chief always has to do everything himself, Malacath help us.
Come! Do your trading here!
Ready when you are.
I complain a lot, but at least I'm not out there fighting. I wouldn't last a Wayrest minute in those tunnels.
As the only king in this dank place, you'd think I'd get to burn one of those saplings. But no, I suppose I have servants to do such things.
If we don't wind up beating them, I plan to market my goods to the Winterborn. Gold is gold, am I right?
It's nice to see a friendly face, but please leave. I don't want to attract those creatures' attention.
I wouldn't go down to the quarry if I was you.
I still think Chief Ramash is a stubborn fool for not seeking help sooner. But that's chiefs for you.
Nearly every able-bodied Orc was in the quarry when it happened. We've been working day and night to provide the stone for Orsinium.
Bless you, warrior. When next you visit the Temple, come see me. We may have need of your services once again.
I'm free! I'm free!
I'm free? Praise the Eight!
If you see General Nedras, please do not tell him you have seen this one.
If we don't wind up getting through this, my only hope is that someone will avenge our suffering from Molag Bal's machinations. If the gods are just, he will suffer.
There will be few who miss Maximinus. Perhaps I'm the only one.

I don't know if you have any loved ones back home, but if you're heading out into the city, you might want to write up a final farewell letter.\n\nDon't try to give it to me, though. I couldn't care less for your sentimental garbage.
The spiders—I can feel them all over me!
Finally I'm free!
I didn't get this far because I have thin skin. Let them taunt me. I can take it.
Who are you to ensnare the Lord Warden of Coldharbour?
I pray the Ehlnofey will forgive me. I tried to go with the soldiers to help heal the wounded in the sewers, but I … lost my nerve. I have never seen such carnage.
The papers you found were reports on conditions up in the City. Not much news gets back to us down here, so they were very welcome.
The sewers are dark and dingy. Not the kind of place this one prefers to spend his time.\n\nBut General Nedras orders Tapak to guard this door, so that is what he will do.
This one is still here, as you see. No fresh air for Tapak.\n\nNot that the air of Imperial City is too fresh anyways ….
I never thought I'd miss my time in Cyrodiil. But now? I'd give all the wealth of House Telvanni for an hour outside these walls.\n\nBut never mind me. We've got a war to win!
Like fighting Daedra? Good news! You'll find no shortage of them here.
Buying or selling?
If I may be of service?

You know, most people would hate being stuck down here, never even seeing the sun, but not me. I like the dark … if you know what I mean.\n\nThere are a couple of passages back there … no one's around. I'm just saying … maybe later.
Hide! For all the good it will do!
Drink up!
I don't want to die!
What made that sound?
With Canuldil gone, there's nothing to keep me here any longer, aside from the certainty of instant death if I leave the house.
The Calidia family will not stand for this dawdling. When my father gets here, he will set things right.
Make sure you're not seen entering or leaving here. This is our only base in the Nobles District and we can't afford to lose it.
Intruders! Crush them!
You dare face me again, worm?
You will fall to my storm!
You are foolish to return to this place. Why tempt fate twice?
Time to play again, little fool?
Oblivion take you, fool!
By the Lord of Domination, you will be destroyed!
Thralls of Varen will die!
You interrupt me once again, wretch?
This time you shall taste the soil of a freshly-dug grave!
Wicked, wicked. You shall atone!
Awaken, and fight for your Lord Warden!
Your bones will become our spears, your flesh will power our spells.
Mortal flesh has so many uses. Yours will not go to waste.
With your death will come many others.
Die, mortal, die!
Out of the mist I call you!
Come to me and bask in the glory of the Empire!
My special ones will protect me!
They mean to escape! Slay them!
Oh, my pretty! Come to the Lady!

I'll let you in on a little secret. If you ask, the general and the sergeant will give you a slew of orders. \n\nIf you want to make some gold though, grab some friends and head into the sewers. Lots of creatures down here with a price on their heads.
Attend me, banekin!
Just because there's a little war going on, that's no reason to let our standards slip!
Death to mortals!
General Aklash spends all day looking at those maps, but she still doesn't know her way around the city.\n\nBetween you and me, I think she's faking it. I don't even think she can read.
Don't bother asking for rat poison. I'm all out. If you're in the market for dead rats, however, you won't be disappointed!
We'll return these valuables to the vault someday … I hope.

As the mud is my mother, I promise, my prices are fair. I may be the last vendor left in the city, so I could set whatever price I please, but I wouldn't do that. \n\nWell, prices might have edged up a little.
Ah, you look like someone with fine taste and many fine possessions. Do not risk them falling from your pocket in the city.\n\nLeave them with Shamaea for safekeeping, yes?
I should warn you, if the city gets pulled up into Coldharbour, my prices will go through the roof.\n\nYou should buy now, if you're smart.
No loans here. I find soldiers in war zones to be poor risks.
We both thought the other dead, and it took a complete stranger to reunite us. Who said no good remains in the City?
Happy as Aishah is to see you again, there is no more work right now. Perhaps later, my eager friend.
I am certain that my father's soul rests more peacefully now that you returned our family crest. We will always be in your debt.
I have nothing more for you right now, friend. Check back next time you're in the area.
This place isn't much, but it's better than living with Holia.
Who does that Gryna think she is? Well, she'll never sweep floors in this city again, I promise you!
I've eaten some pretty vile stuff in the last few weeks, including raw clannfear. But military food takes the cake.\n\nOh, why did I have to think about cake?
Mortals burn so quickly—too quickly. They should suffer much longer!
Imperial City is ours. The mortal fools just don't know it yet.
An Ayleid summoner once thought he could control me. I gutted him.
Why don't we make a new garden … out of Elven corpses!
Molag Bal rules here, as in Coldharbour.
Scamps! I need more Scamps!
Abnur Tharn will die, when next I see him.
When do we feast upon mortal flesh once more?
The master favors his Xivkyn. Can't you see that?
No Khajiit. Cat-flesh is too gamey.
There is no greater pleasure than corrupting an Aedric shrine.
The insects live under rocks and plot our doom. Find them.
Quiet, churls. I heard something.
Scouts warned of mortal soldiers approaching. Be wary.
I prefer disemboweling my foes. Shocking them is too subtle.
I have guard duty when I could be studying under Gati.
What happened in the Magisterium cannot be repeated.
Praise be our master. This campaign is a success.
The sewers are beneath me. I did not come here to swim.
We should just flay their skin off and be done with it.
Young clannfear need food to grow. Luckily, there are plenty of mortals around.
Legion Zero belongs to us. We should kill them and raise them.
We've got scouts posted all over the Arboretum. Not many of us left, but we're making these traitors pay out the nose, trust me.
Succumb to flame and shadow!
How can you wander around in plain sight like that? The Daedra will throw you into the arena with the rest if you're not careful.
I will be at the right hand of a Daedric Prince one day, either Molag Bal or someone else.
I used to love coming here when I was off duty—watching the bouts and such. Now I can't wait to get away. Damn shame.
Don't believe everything you hear in the city, soldier. I've even heard people say that Clivia Tharn is back in the Tower. Fat chance that the Tharns will ever return.
I'd keep that weapon in hand if I were you. As soon as you step into the sewers, you'll need it. \n\nWe have made very little progress in making the sewers more secure.
Go away! They'll grab us and drag us into the Prison. Once the Lord Warden gets ahold of you, you're never seen again!
You hear about how cruel and evil Daedra are, but you never really believe it until you see them in action.
I wonder how Captain Caudex is holding up. Said he was headed to the Arboretum to "take care of something." That probably means a lot of traitors are going to wind up dead.
Do not let that oaf Pollius order you to your death. You should leave this place. I know I am.
I never should have left Deshaan ….
Anything Molag Bal's creatures do to the city can be undone, given time.
I've seen some disturbing things. You provincials aren't raising your banners over Imperial buildings, are you? You're here as allies, not conquerors. Remember that.
These blue-eyed bastards are going to pay for what they've done to our temple. I'll see to it myself.
Ugh. I'm sick of breathing in this smoke and filth, but I can't go back out there. I just can't!
Beware the catacombs, stranger. There are things far more dangerous than Legion Zero soldiers down there.
Major Fidenas set up this observation post, left a dozen of us here. Just me and Tactitus left now. Haven't seen Fidenas in a couple of weeks either.
That civilian's going to get us killed if she doesn't keep her head down and her mouth shut. Never could stand rich people, not even dead ones.
I do not know what waits below, but it does not wait peacefully. I am reconsidering my determination to reach the very bottom.
Anitir! Tsabinna! Come back, don't leave me here! Noooo!
I hope you bold warriors appreciate the effort it takes to keep your bellies full!
If it weren't for you bringing supplies in, I might have lost my job. So … y'know … do that more often.
Smash those rifts or be overwhelmed!
You're a stranger to the City, I can tell.
I've already heard. Maximinus was always hard to collect money from. I bet he died just so he wouldn't have to repay me.
I will remember Otholug as the bold Orc he was, not the monster whose existence you ended.
White-Gold Tower is now the gravestone of the Empire!
The eternal night of Coldharbour will consume all that you know!
Little mortal comes a-calling. Comes to goggle at my devices.
Do what you will with my devices, wretch. These halls are filled with those who call me "Master."
Where have all the weaklings gone? We can't have killed them all.
Ready yourself! Daedra are coming through!
You turned the tide! We push on!
The Planemeld obverse—it begins!
This is the end for you!
Let me see ... so that is the crime you committed? I was hoping for someone a little more notorious.
You pay the bounty, you go free. You do not, I kill you. Simple.
You know what you did, you scoundrel! Right? So, um ... pay up, for whatever it was.
I am certain you regret your actions. But you must pay a bounty so we all know you are certain.
They always send me to collect the bounties because I'm so pleasant! Unless you don't pay that is ....
Foul blackguard! You're brought to heel. Will you answer for your crimes?
I assume you cannot afford your bounty, you vile delinquent. Am I wrong?
There seems to be a bounty hanging over your head, my unlawful friend.
I almost walked right by you. Then I remembered your bounty.
You want to pay your bounty with what, a guilty expression? The law only takes gold, you fool!
Have you learned your lesson, felon? Crime is expensive!
I do not mean to bother you, but I am a duly appointed officer of the law and you owe a bounty.
I can make these charges disappear ... for a price.
We all make mistakes. Some of us do not get caught. Unfortunately, you did.
I prefer to handle this in a civilized fashion, but I can get loud if you prefer that approach.
You are caught. Pay your bounty and I'll let you go back to whatever gutter you crawled out of.
Time to pay the fine. Are you going to need help counting it? Basic arithmetic--a criminal's bane.
I don't make the fines. I just collect the bounty. Now pay up or I'll get rough with you.
Crime is a dank cloud of noxious vapor. Pay your bounty and let the winds of justice prevail.
The fruit of crime is tough and bitter, mud-mouth. It is also costly. Pay your bounty or die.
Look, I'm  new at this, so why don't you help me out and just pay the bounty?
I've got a great epitaph for your tombstone. 'Did not pay bounty.' Has a nice ring to it.
I don't have a problem, you have a problem! You know what your problem is? You committed a crime!
My mind is a cloudy bog today. Still, there's no reason we can't settle your bounty peacefully.
Take care, or collecting your bounty won't be an option. Bleeding on the ground? That's always an option.
Good friend, it seems you forgot to take care of the bounty hanging over you.
Will you honor your debt to society and make remunerations for your bounty?
Here's the deal. You make a sizeable donation to the 'orphanage' and I'll forget this ever happened.
What did you do? No, don't tell me, I'd rather not know. Just pay your bounty and be on your way.
Captain says you're a bad person. Pay the bounty or else.
Know what we do with criminals around here? Pay your bounty, and you won't have to find out.
Such beauty--why must it be so savage? You must pay for your criminal transgressions.
All right, I'm warning you! Pay off your bounty or ... or I'm going to .... Just pay your bounty, all right?
I've got you now, criminal. Lucky for you, I'm easily distracted by shiny things.
Please, please ... refuse to pay. I haven't smashed a felon in a tree's age.
As a lawbreaker, you truly are without peer or equal. I almost hate to request your bounty.
Everyone plans to get away clean. Then their plan meets reality. Today, I'm reality.
In the end, we all pay for our misdeeds. You're lucky to pay for your crimes with gold.
Have you seen a criminal around here? I'm supposed to collect a bounty. Oh, it's your bounty!
No excuses. I've heard them all. Pay your bounty.
I'm sure you're innocent. Everybody is. But I still need to collect your bounty. Sorry!
You are the most exciting thing to happen to me in weeks. Now, be good and pay the fine.
According to my records, you owe a bounty for alleged criminal activities. Will you pay?
Y'ffre knows, I have the patience of a tree. Well? Just pay your bounty!
Halt, law-breaker! Don't look at me like that, they make us say it. Look, just pay the bounty, all right?
How foolish you are, to think you could get away with a crime! Do you also think to avoid the bounty?
I don't like collecting bounties, but it's my job. So how about you pay and we can all relax.
I'll never understand criminals. You all get caught, eventually.
How depressing. You have a bounty on your head. If you pay it and clear your name, I'll still be sad.
The fine assessed for your crime is perfectly reasonable. Will you pay?
You look like someone I want to get to know better. A lot better. But I need to collect your bounty first.
Look. You know what you did and I do too. It's simple--you pay in gold or you pay in blood.
A criminal act starts a dark ripple that spreads across the sea of order. You must make amends.
I'm just doing my job. It's nothing personal. But you're on my list and I have to collect your fine.
It's an honor to meet you! I'm hardly worthy to demand your bounty. But here I am.
As you pay your bounty, I will make a full and accurate record of the transaction.
You want to break the law, you deal with me. Pay the bounty.
If the hand offends us, I say cut it off! Or I accept gold in lieu of body parts.
I don't like this any more than you do, but I-I have to do it. Can you just pay your bounty?
I hate to be a bother, but I'd appreciate it if you paid your bounty now.
I'm prepared to forget this whole thing if you pay your bounty. No harm done, right?
You've reached the crossroads of fate, my friend. Pay in gold or pay in blood.
We both know how this works. Try anything and I'll take the bounty out of your hide.
You pulled me away from a nice mug of …. Never you mind, just pay your bounty so I can get back.
Going to give me a sour look, ay? Well the cost just went up. Cough it up, s'wit!
I've met a lot of criminals, but you don't have the look. I have no idea why your name is on my list.
Your debt to society must be paid, rapscallion. Will you comply?
You pay your bounty, or we find out what kind of pattern your blood makes when it hits the ground.
If it were up to me, we'd dispense with this bounty business and kill the lot of you.
No need to bow. We don't have to stand on ceremony. Let's just settle your bounty, shall we?
You are free to go, as soon as you pay your bounty.
You're caught, so it's time to behave yourself. Let's keep this civil.
One day I'll meet an outlaw who pays a bounty without complaint. Will this be the day?
Bah! All criminals are craven cowards and you're no different! Will you pay in gold or blood?
Oh, Dumac take you! I can't tell you how this grates on my patience. Pay your bounty and begone!
Stop in the name of the law! What? We have to say that. It's in the regulations.
The bounty is an opportunity for you to set yourself right with me and with the gods.
Look, I'm only asking because my captain will kill me if I don't. Can I collect your bounty please?
I think we should execute criminals on sight, but my captain won't allow it.  He wants your bounty.
You need to clear your record and I need to pay my rent, so turn over your bounty, if you please.
The criminal's dilemma is easily resolved. Pay the bounty and live to defy the law another day.
Guilty? Innocent? This one couldn't care less. I'm just here to collect your bounty.
I am the law in this place and you will pay the bounty for your crimes.
Evil deeds always come back to haunt you. This bounty is the least of your worries.
Lucky for you, this one likes to toy with her prey. After I collect your bounty, of course.
You think you're clever, hm? Not clever enough to avoid getting caught. Looks like you owe a bounty.
You were caught with your hand in the moon-sugar jar again, weren't you?
This one detests being a hagraven, but you do have a bounty hanging over your head. Will you pay?
This one smells fear. Oh, wait. That is me. Well, at least one of us has the proper attitude.
This one will stand very close and breathe on you until you pay your bounty.
Dark moons and dull claws! This one is so tired of confronting criminals! Pay your gold and go away.
A bounty has been placed on your person in accordance with local law. This one is here to demand payment.
This one loves justice. And gold. Lucky me, I will claim both!
You have two options: pay the bounty or face a beating. This one knows which he would choose.
I'm not responsible for accidents that happen to those who won't pay their bounty.
Stop and pay the bounty.
Some guards might try to squeeze extra gold out of you, but all I ask is that you pay what you owe.
I like you, thief. Give me your gold and you'll be free and clear.
Didn't your mother teach you right from wrong?
Come, wrongdoer, pay up and be quick about it.
Your compensation, now!
Crime never pays, sweetheart. That's why I got into law enforcement. Now, let's talk bounties, shall we?
Hi! I'm here for your bounty. Come on, pay up! You certainly look like you can afford it.
There is no clemency for criminals here. You must pay your bounty, or I will use force.
If you don't pay your bounty, I'll make you sing drinking songs with me.
My patience wears thin and my pockets are empty. Will you pay your bounty now?
It's nothing to be proud of, but it isn't the end of the world, either. Just pay your bounty.
All right, lawbreaker, time to pay for your crimes. You are going to pay, right?
Don't give me a reason to hurt you. Just pay your bounty and be on your way.
The bad news is that you have to pay a fine. The good news is I'm going to get a promotion!
I'd pay the bounty for you if I could, but such favors are frowned upon by my superiors.
There's a reason I approached you ... Oh! I remember. You're a bad person. You need to pay a fine!
Look. If the captain weren't riding my arse, I wouldn't care, but I have to ask for your bounty.
You know what? You're such a good sort that I think I'll pay your bounty for you. That was a joke.
Fun time's over, you Goblin-kissing bastard! Pay the bounty or this law-dog is going to chew you up!
Thought you were gonna get away, eh? You're dumber than I am!
Trust me, I enjoy this even less than you do. Pay the fine.
Great! Another criminal who hasn't paid the bounty! This is your chance to settle up, troll-breath!
The sword of justice cuts clean and true. Pay your bounty or bleed, criminal.
Watch yourself. I'm faster after a couple drinks. If you're smart, you'll just pay the bounty.
You're too beautiful to be a criminal. I could help you make amends, if you're interested in such things.
Pay your bounty or die. There are no other options open to you.
Another day, another low-life. Just pay up. I've got better things to do than waste time with you.
Pay up, scum.  Don't worry--I guarantee that at least some will make it to your victims.
You were naughty. Now you owe a bounty. Says so right here.
It doesn't matter if you run. I'm not alone ... we'll all chase you down.
Every guard in the region wants to meet you, and I'm the lucky one to catch you first! Now, about your bounty ....
Oh boo hoo! Tell me another sob story, you spineless goat! I want your bounty and I want it yesterday!
Tell your excuses to someone who cares. I only want your bounty.
You face the same predicament as every other criminal. But it all goes away if you pay your bounty.
They will sing of your crimes and the spectacular way you died, provided you do not pay me.
Pay or die, criminal. You have no other options.
There's no need for us to be enemies. I'm sure you had your reasons. But I must collect the bounty.
Don't think of running. It's time to pay.
Stay calm, my friend. I only ask that you pay your bounty and you can be on your way.
I'm just going to keep taunting you until you pay your fine.
Pay the fine or I'll have your skin for a cloak.
I'm sorry, but what you did was against the law, and now I need to collect a bounty.
Your crime spree is through. I'll have your bounty now.
You are found in violation of the criminal statutes of this fair land. You must pay a bounty.
Deep down you're a good person--I can tell. Here's your chance to prove it.
Blood and blades! I am so tired of confronting criminals! Pay your gold and go away.
Rejoice, criminal, for I have come to clear your name! Make recompense for your bounty, please.
There are always options. Pay your bounty or face a beating. Which will you choose?
I have to believe that more of our brothers and sisters found refuge out there. If only we could make contact! We may have the numbers to turn the tide.
Failure will not be accepted!
Make them believe that they have won, and they will never attack.
May a thousand thousand more of these animals fall to my blades.
I pity the Dremora. They cannot comprehend the majesty of the Xivkyn.
Do what you want.
There's a nice bounty on you. Guard!
Get out of here, lawbreaker.
You're a cold-blooded killer!
Not in the face!
I'm not part of this.
You're not planning something illegal, are you?
Call the guard, there's a thief in our midst.
Even the stars turn a blind eye from time to time.
Xarxes knows your deeds, monster.
Auri-El's armored scales, another petty criminal.
Stendarr have mercy on us! Someone call the Guard!
Auri-El protect me!
Please, there's no need to get violent.
I'll call the Guard if you try anything, by Stendarr.
You stole that? You won't get away with it. Guard!
I've no time for this.
You won't get away with this!
Guard! Apprehend that fool!
How ghastly!
Back! Back I say!
I assure you, my lips are sealed.
What in Y'ffre's name are you doing?
Guard! There's a thief here!
Honestly? Out of my way.
What were you thinking?
Someone fetch a guard!
Lorkhan take you, murderer!
Not another step!
I was just leaving.
Getting into trouble, eh?
Stop, thief!
Do what you want.
There's a nice bounty on you. Guard!
Get out of here, lawbreaker.
You're a cold-blooded killer!

Your death will be quick, if you'd stand still!
Mother!
By mother's blood, I will burn you all!
Have you noticed? I think this place is full of criminals.
Ahh! Never sneak up on a person doing business!
Profit sounds like music to my ears. Come, let's dance!
Our stolen goods are well-hidden. Where are they, again? No? Just asking.
"Armed only with his fists and the blessing of Trinimac, Usunok charged forward to deliver a single blow."
Next, I'll learn how to do it with ice! Don't think I'm ready for lightning yet.
I'm not sure how long I can keep working if someone doesn't take care of the food shortage.
If you're so worried about it, why don't you go out and hunt for more food?
Not everyone fully grasps the intricacies of solving puzzles. But go ahead and give it another try.
<<1>>'s cooking is the talk of Orsinium!
Maybe I should have some.
If we keep eating here, how will we fit into our armor?
How long have we been working on this dolmen?
What a trophy you'll be!
Gar yarag go!
Aga yara yor!
Give up! My flames will devour you!
Come closer, sweet thing!
Feel my burning rage!
My axe will make quick work of you.
You lose. Such is your fate.
You shall know pain!
This one's spells are supreme!
I'll scorch the skin from your bones!
Fire and steel are my brethren!
Think that light can protect you? Not for long!
At the queen's command! Kill!
Mortals—I hate them!
I'll slaughter you!
You have no love for my kind. I have none for yours. Come, let us complete the ritual.
Behold my devotion, as I become the Guardian of the Reach!
Idiot.
Feel free to examine my goods. Yes, take a nice, long look.
Here to buy, to spend freely, or merely to talk? Talking without trade is vexing to some, you know.
Come, raise your gold, your money! Raise your riches!
These will be very useful in Cyrodiil!
Quite a view, eh? Alas, there's no time to enjoy it. A merchant's work is never done.\n\nSpeaking of which, what can I do for you?
I don't know much about this <<1>> fellow. My cousin, <<2>>? She has every prerogative to throw her dowry away.
Teifi has traded in the shadow of many temples. This one is the spookiest.
Are we running? No? All right, then!
All is ruin! All is sorrow! Die!
Your fate is sealed.
Vazh. Hissirna kassaad.
You have no power here!
Shadows, take shape. Slaughter them!
Doom stands upon your threshold.
Moons protect us—they are calling the void!
The breach will not hold much longer—you must act now!
Well, he hasn't skipped town … yet.
This place poisons the soul. You must hurry—back to Nirni!
Treasure this small victory. It will be your last.
Everybody pays. Sooner or later.
I can't focus … why can't I focus? I'll lose everything!
Your mortal husks will burn!
You look like you've been in a right scrap. If you've lost any teeth I can always post a bill!
Come, your pockets look full, but they do not jingle. Let us remedy this terrible affliction.
Someone's treasure is this one's trade.
You cannot defeat me!
I see the Black Dragon failed me.
Someone's treasure is this one's trade.
You'll have to hang on to what you have. I cannot move anymore so soon.
Keelcutter! Full Barrage!
Come forth, my loyal protectors!

Have you seen the Naughty Nereids perform? Their rendition of Investigator Vale was just as this one imagined it, and this one has read all the stories.\n\nTilwen was perfect as Vale. She can investigate me whenever she wants to!
"Herein lie the countless damned, their worth measured only by the weight of the gold that condemned them. Find your favorite and drive home the point—preferably with the tip of your blade."
I know a secret route!
Get your arse over here!
Ugh, there's blood in this purse. We work in a cistern—how much is it to ask to keep things clean?
Come! Do your trading here!
Speak with me a moment.
Another set of remains. I hope this is the last.
She completed the purification of her own Sanctuary. I can't even imagine what that must have done to her.

Do not fear the Dark Brotherhood! They are children compared to Akatosh!
The Dark Brotherhood! Cowards and skeever lovers, the lot of them!
Astara was looking for Kor, have you seen him? Something about cleaning up after Hildegard.
We just have to have faith, my friends. And maybe a little wine ….
Just, perhaps, with a little less zeal until some of this blows over.
You not escape! You die!
That doesn't make sense.
I'm so hungry! Please help!
Bah! Off with you, fish-breath!
I refuse to see an alchemist. You want to meet a real outlaw? Look at what they charge for tonics!
You want to succeed in this business, you learn which dogs to feed and which to beat.
Xal-Nur crush puny wamasu!
Xal-Nur will crush your heads!
You weak! Xal-Nur strong!
Xal-Nur make you flat!
Xuth! One of the beasts broke free!
You all wet! Xal-Nur hates wet rats!
The memories are all I have left. You will not rob me of them!

We are legion!

Give yourself over to me, become my will made manifest!
Do not take them. I will find you ….
Look, no offense, but I don't exactly fall into the whole "family" thing. I'm here to work. Unless my job is to kill you, I don't see what we have to talk about.
Fall before the Order of the Hour!
Divine punishment is at hand!
Become ashes and dust!
I'm afraid the chill can't numb shame.
Come, my lovelies! It's dinner time.
Quiet!
Quiet!
Don't venture beyond Varen's Wall. Not until someone can remain Emperor for longer than a fortnight.
Kvatch used to be the Colovian crown jewel. Now? It's gone to Oblivion in an ore cart. Disgraceful. Varen Aquilarios must be rolling in his grave.
Rise up, lighting! Rise!
Build or die!
Invaders! Bare your fangs, Xit-Xaht!

Fall before the night!

Who will be the weak link?
You won't suffer too long.
Who's outnumbered now?
