Not your lucky day.
No one escapes the web!
Come here, little morsel! Come to Velidreth!
Watch your step—I dropped something.
No, no, that one's mine!
Come here, sweetmeat! Come to Velidreth!
Finished! Now who's dessert?
Even now, there are those who dare to challenge me. Those who would set you free. Do not believe their lies. Theirs is a false freedom. The only true freedom lies in service to the Serpent!
Let me concentrate. This isn't as easy as it looks.
I came to Craglorn to get away from dire end of the world situations.
We are ensnared in the same web, you and I. But you cannot even see your bonds!
Want to see a party trick? I don't want to ruin the surprise, but in involves a bottle of wine and a clothes iron. And … and probably some towels. It tends to be messy.

Sahalu is full of big ideas! \n\nInstead of digging through the rock, we should dig underneath! No one listens to Sahalu, though. "We'll get crushed," they say. Feh. Ziss on them. I dig my hole anyway.
I have heard rumors of this Scaled Court. But Dragonstar has its own snake cultist. Have you met Safa? She is a very good customer—for a cult leader.

I don't think all of the Serpent's followers are evil. Why, we had Regent Cassipia and her friend Little Leaf in here for dinner just the other night. A delightful couple!\n\nWould you care to try the dish they raved about?
Of course I enjoy paying the Caravan Company guards to protect me. Who wouldn't?\n\nNow what can I get you? I really need to sell some drinks today.
Please behave yourself around the Caravan Company guards. They're more ornery than usual, what with all the Iron Orc trouble and everything.
This town was barely a hole in the ground before the Dragonstar Caravan Company put it on the map. We'll be bigger than Belkarth sooner than you'd imagine.\n\nOh, and feel free to use the equipment.
I'd let you request a song, but I only play what I want. If you don't like it, we can settle it in the Arena.
Do me a favor and don't ask where my goods come from. I'm a terrible liar.

That's it! I'm done waiting! I'm going to march in there and demand they let us compete. We're the Diamond's Daughters, for Akatosh's sake!\n\nImperial Legionaries don't wait in line for a battle. It's just not done!

The Captain cut off the wine rations. Said she wants us clear-headed when we enter the Arena.\n\nWell, pinch that! As a healer, I know for a fact that a few cups of wine help settle the nerves. And I have a key to the wine locker!
You're looking at one of Dorzogg's Dozen, the best warriors north of Belkarth! Get in our way and we'll cut you down—but not like a tree. I would never hurt a tree.
Another champion in the making, eh? Better eat up if you want to do your best.
We are fragrant! We are sleek! We are the Five Claws and we can't be beat!\n\nIt still needs work, but this one likes the sound of that.
We had to fight our way through a gang of Iron Orcs to get here. A decent enough exercise, but I hope the Arena offers a bit more of a challenge for warriors of our skill level.
What? Is it time to enter the Arena? Wait a moment. You're not the Battlemaster. You're nobody!
Now, where did I put that spare canvas? It must be around here somewhere.
You know the great thing about used armor? It's pre-ventilated!
It's a shame everyone who doesn't want to fight just can't get up and leave the field of battle. Imagine how much better wars would be if the only participants actually wanted to be there.
I'm innocent! Innocent, I say! Besides, that cur had it coming. I was morally obligated to end his miserable life.
The Celestials caught us by surprise, so every gift helps.
We must see that some of these items reach Dragonstar.
Are you hungry for blood? The Kvatch Arena's next event is about to begin!
Pardons well earned! Let's clean them up and make them presentable for freedom!
Oh, look at all of you. Tonight will be a feast!
Such a tangled mess we've made.
My kin cry out for your blood.
Death is my domain. I won't be bested at it.
This should be refreshing!

You ever been hit with a clanfear tail before? I have. Hit me square in the chest. Lucky for me, I'd been working the docks, lifting lots of crate that year. Stomach was rock solid.\n\nThe tail broke right off. Made a whip out of it after that.
The Silken Ring will be your noose!
Oh, you've wandered poorly, fools.
No escape, only suffering!
Ripe for the picking.
This one wonders, could there be anyone more lazy than the person who named the fireplace?
Are you ready to reveal your rewards?
Jone and Jode, a bonus reward!
Well met, and good fortune to you!
Pacrooti would like to remind you that tips are appreciated. It is far easier for a mammoth to pass through the eye of a needle, if it is slightly greased, yeah?
This one hopes you will visit him again soon. Until then, may good fortune go with you!
Pacrooti admires your persistence!
This will do!
This one is impressed!
A marvelous reward.
Wonderful!
A blessing from the Divines!
This one is impressed!
Quickly, minions! Light a fire in your flesh!
The Order located another relic. Can we count on your assistance in recovering it?
<Diabolical Laugh>
Staging catapults near the Dark Anchors is too risky. Or is it?
You look a bit lost. This is the Vivec City depository, the finest bank and loan in all of Vvardenfell. Would you like me to show you to a vault?

What does security mean to you? If it means confidence and certainty in these troubled times, then you've come to the right place. Our vaults provide a level of protection unparalleled in other institutions.

I don't mean to be forward, but you're the eighty-seventh customer to walk through that door—and the last eighty-six didn't buy a thing.\n\nPlease, good customer, change that pattern and we'll both be wealthier for it!
Once worked in a proper bank you know, in a proper location. And then someone's son needed a position, and I suddenly found myself thrown out the door. But that's how it goes sometimes.
I swap recipes and ingredients with Tilenra all the time. She's a true master of the craft, she is.

You need it? I got it! \n\nActually, no, that's bit of a misnomer. My goods are limited to my current stock only. Sorry for getting your hopes up. But what I do have for sale is of the finest quality!
Don't you dare question my goods. They're the finest quality, and that's the truth.
Spiked the shein with some Telvanni brews once. Won't ever do that again. It took a week to scrape the tentacles out of the cask!
The overseers, they say, "We are always watching." But we both know that is not always true, yes?\n\nThis one finds that if you are always watching them, you can get away with a great many things.
Anyone ever dare you to eat a live slaughterfish? Remember to knock its teeth out first.\n\nOther than that, I have no regrets.
You're back. Rumor was you'd be too timid to return.\n\nBest to disprove rumors through action, don't you think?
Do you wish to do business with the Velothi people? Pay the proper respects and we can trade.
The relic must be in your possession. Mustn't it?
Priority contract just came in. You interested?
Very well. Let's flip them all!
This mine belongs to us now!
If you want to compare scars, I want to see new ones. Take the pledge.
Glirion's heart is a fortress. Epics will be sung about the one to crack it.\n\nCome back tomorrow. Tonight I have a siege to lay.
On reflection, your animate carcass is a welcome sight in the camp. Would you like your reward now?
Got some nerve walking off in the middle of our conversation. Guess you didn't want your reward after all.
These talks should have been scheduled after the festival.
Must you? Really, must you?
I despise this local custom.
Where do you live? In the wild, like some sort of animal? That won't do.
You could be the Covenant's next great hero, but you're nothing without a place to stow your gear.
You need a home. They're warm and comfortable and they make for a better investment than stuffing gold in your spare boot.
A rampaging dregoth destroyed my first home. The second one was swallowed in an earthquake and the third was ravaged by fire.\n\nWhat's your excuse for not having a place to live?
Destitute and homeless? My heart weeps for you. Perhaps there's something in my inventory that will brighten your day. Take a look!
A person without a roof over their head gets wet when it rains. Don't be that person.
When ill circumstances toss snapping mudcrabs into your bath water, sometimes you just have to make chowder. Or find a place to live. Whatever.
No house? However do you get by? I can't imagine sleeping in the altogether without four sturdy walls around me!
I appreciate the nomadic lifestyle as much as the next person, but I think you're missing out by not owning your own home.
No home to hang your hat in? Then where do you suppose you'll put my highly sought-after goods?
A home without clutter is like Jone without Jode. And this one has clutter up to his whiskers, yes?
Not everyone likes shopping for their home. I get it, really I do. Just pick something so we can both get on with our day.
You could buy from someone else, but I wouldn't advise it.
It's just not a home until you decorate the torture chamber, am I right?
I detest linen sheets, don't you? Silk or nothing, I always say.
Fame is fleeting, but a home is forever. So if I were you, I'd stock up now while you still have the chance.
Your reputation in Dominion lands grows by leaps and bounds. Good for you!
The champion of the Dominion! What an honor! I have something extraordinary that will be perfect for your home.
You're the one who did the thing that everyone is talking about? Yes, I think I've heard of you.
Do any of these crates smell lucky to you?
Shall we get started? First you must select your crate and open it!
Pacrooti can see a lucky aura around you today.  He is sure you will get something good! And all you need is a crate. You can purchase one from the store, and then we can begin.
Your reputation in Pact lands multiplies like torchbugs in the moonlight. Soon you'll be as famous as the great Narsis Dren, if I may be so bold.
The champion of the Pact! What an honor! Would you like to see something exclusive I selected just for your home?
You have a home and a reputation? Splendid! Then let's make a deal!

Your reputation in Covenant lands increases with every passing day. Soon your name will be as famous as Lady Laurent or King Kurog! And do you know who furnishes their palatial estates? You're looking at him!
The champion of the Covenant! What an honor! I have something rare and significant that would look great in your home. Take a look.
Starting to make a name for yourself? I like that. Let me show you something that will enhance your reputation and decorate your home at the same time.
Your reputation proceeds you, hero! Let's share a drink and see if anything in my private stock speaks to you today.
I so look forward to your visits, champion. It makes me want to slash my prices to make certain you'll take something home with you.
Hmm, yes, yes. I've heard of you. I think. I suppose we can talk.
Hmm, yes, yes. Your reputation proceeds you. You're the hero of this great thing and that grand accomplishment. I have something special, if you'd like to see it.
Whenever you visit, I'm left practically speechless. So I'll just let my furnishings speak for themselves.
I'll burn you to cinders!
Very lucky indeed!
Pacrooti is truly impressed!
There are many wonderful rewards that a crate could contain.  In the gem store, you can see this magnificent selection and even buy rewards with the gems you collect.
Uncover your rewards to collect them. Some rewards are better than others, and some are so valuable they make Pacrooti's claws tingle!
An auspicious day! You have surpassed every other player! Congratulations!
Pacrooti has seen many lucky players, but none have done so well as you, my friend!
The artisan arrives. How's work?
What've you got?
This will do. Yes, this will do nicely.
Ouch! Try pushing the correct button this time!
No, no, no. Reset the mechanism and try again!
You are curious about New Life traditions, aren't you?
Oh well done! Perhaps I should charge for my tutelage?
My store may be the only enchanting thing about this city. And you can tell any of those Dark Elves in charge I said so.\n\nNow, what can I get you today?
If you're looking for suggestions, then look elsewhere. I sell to those who know what they need, when they need it. Alchemy is not a trade for the indecisive.\n\nWhat will you be purchasing today?
Have you come to make a purchase, or is this a purely social call? Either way, you have my undivided attention.
I have everything that the aspiring alchemist might desire. Even large-sized instruments for the more heavy-handed among us. Have a look.
Must we continue to tolerate this travesty?
Wondrous gems! So sparkly!
Ahhh.
Ah! Ooooh!
Ha haa!
<yawn>
Ha ha ha!
This one wonders, could there be anyone more lazy than the person who named the fireplace?
Ah! Ooooh!
This one does not even like mushrooms in his stew. Why fate has brought him to live in one, he will never know.
Puzzles not a strong suit, hmm?
Where did I leave that quill?
Lord Vivec needs to do something! Look at that sky!
Red Mountain's particularly active today.
Lord Vivec, don't let us die!
Sneaky s'wit! She's my sow!
Where did they go? Pigs can't really fly, can they?
I can't wait to see the yearly yield totals. Should make everyone jealous.
Keep your eyes on the skies. If there isn't ash overhead, there's one of those silt striders passing by.\n\nWhat can I get you?
Red Mountain may shake, but my resolve to bring you the best wares around will never waver. What can I get you?
It is most pleasant to see you. Can this one interest you in some of these most distinguished goods?
Browse the best wares the Telvanni have to offer!
Looking to do a bit of magic? Why not discuss it with one of the Telvanni mages? Trust me, they'd be happy to talk about what they know. And talk, and talk, and talk ….
They meant to turn us to cattle. First we get the yoke, then we get the cleaver!
They don't even have hearts, just this cursed red rock where it should be!
The horned-ones will break your bones!
How are your working conditions now?
Dwemer, do not fail me!
Telvanni, the greatest of the great houses!
Ah, Redoran, most noble of the Great Houses!
Ah, Hlaalu, most shrewd of the Great Houses!
House Telvanni, by the stars above!
Strange, I thought I heard something.
All right, I'm definitely reading something wrong.
Need something for your home? This one can surely provide it.
Even the great Vivec needs a place to rest. You should consider purchasing a home of your own.
Ah, yes, I think I've heard of you. My memory is hazy, but my deals are clear as spring water.
Your reputation in Vvardenfell multiplies like torchbugs in the moonlight. Soon you'll be as famous as the great Narsis Dren, if I may be so bold.
A champion stands before me! What an honor! Would you like to see something exclusive I selected just for your home?
A person without a roof over their head gets wet when it rains. Don't be that person.
We don't handle delivery, but I'm sure a rugged individual such as yourself would have no problem transporting my wares.
A victory party needs to be set in the right locale. My goods can make sure your home fits the bill.
You don't understand how hard it is, greeting customers every day, one after another! It's not as easy as it looks.\n\nAnd I'm still not doing a very good job at it, am I? Oh, um, can I help you?
The wonders of Vvardenfell are unending. Much like my selection of wares. Want to see?
Get up here, before they destabilize the rift entirely!
How big is this island? And why can't they draw a proper map of it?
We'll walk the length and breadth of Vvardenfell to find Omellian if we have to. Delms would have done the same for us.
We'll walk the length and breadth of Vvardenfell to find Omellian if we have to.
Sure, maybe you can swing a sword or cast a spell or two. But Ularra is a whole different playing field. You need actual skill to dominate these games.

I've started keeping tallies in my spare time. Broken bones, missing limbs, decapitations, that sort of thing. I would show you my statistics, but this is one of the few cases where I agree that ignorance is bliss.
Now all that my workers want to do is watch the games. Or, Vivec forbid, join them! I've already lost three of my best diggers to this madness.
Blockage detected in transport circuit. <<1>>, vaporization protocols authorized.
Pit Daemons dominate Deathmatch every week! Don't believe what those Storm Lords say.
Sure, the Storm Lords talk a big game. But once they're on the field they never seem to deliver. Come on, give us Fire Drakes a real challenge!
I hope the Dark Elves aren't in a hurry to finish building this city. I love how the stones lie in Foyada Quarry. I'll be fighting there as long as I can.
Gravity is not the force you should fear right now. Jump!
Thermal control at capacity. Emergency venting required.
Rosy! Want a nice fish?
You're looking a little gassy. Are you feeling all right?

It's almost funny how many people call me their lucky charm. They buy something from me and their chances to win seem to increase like magic!\n\nIt's just the wares, of course. Gladiators are a suspicious lot.
All of the Battleground games involve combat. My wares can set you apart from your competitors.
Kill this peddler of lies before it destroys us all!
Little one, you thought to best me in a bargain?
To me, wretch.
Your kill? No, my kill!
Me hear something.
Keep away from the urns, wretch!
Dead mortals disgust me almost as much as live ones.
You distract. Me take.
Hungry One powerful creature, powerful!
The type of work I have is not for the faint of heart. You think you can handle it?
I'd give you a job if we had one, but we don't. Wait it out for a bit and something should become available.
If you're here to ask about your reward, don't bother. I just hand out the requests.
Many come to us for aid, and the Temple cannot turn them away. That is why we look for outside help.
Your generosity has been well noted, but I have no other task for you at this time. Give the Temple time to find another.
Ah, now that I think of it, I do have something else to tell you. Quick feet make for strong spirits. I believe that's self explanatory.
Back for more? I always have a challenge ready.
Come back later to see if I have more challenges for you.
Time for battle! Take no prisoners!
Greatness stands before me!
The fabricants are getting up again. Durable, if nothing else.
The thrill has taken hold of your spirit, hasn't it, my friend? Very well. Let's get you something new to hunt.
Keep that circuit broken!
They're dangerous in that amplified state.
Discharge that energy! Direct it against them!
Every kill adds to your growing legend, outlander. Save some creatures for the rest of us, or my hunters will lose their edge.\n\nReturn later and we'll see about finding you another quarry.
I envy you, outlander. About to partake in another hunt. May your ancestors guide your hand!\n\nRemember to bring back a trophy to prove that your kill was true and clean.
The hunter returns. Was your hunt successful and your aim true? Better yet, show me what you have brought me.
The next Dark Elf that tells me I missed a spot is going to regret it.
The Telvanni only want what's best for the citizens of Sadrith Mora. Some may find their policies a bit taxing, but I assure you it's all for the greater good.
Adjusting tactics ….
I cannot stabilize this rift with these machines interfering!
These Vvardenfell Dark Elves distrust outlanders, but they seem to keep a particularly careful eye on Khajiit. Well, not like it's much different than anywhere else in Tamriel.
I meet the most interesting people during my travels. And the most attractive, of course. Now, what would you like to buy?
A city merchant may have more wares, sure, but I get by with my meager collection. You're free to look if you'd like.
I must be ready to move at a moment's notice, so I always make sure to travel light. What little I do have is yours to buy.
I'm not picky about what you bring me, or where you happened to pick it up. A sale is a sale to me.
I can buy your goods, or I can make sure other merchants don't kick up a fuss about them. Your choice.
I don't deal in stolen goods, despite how this area appears. I don't much care where your gold comes from, though.

I thought you might be Archcanon Llevule. He's been very busy since we last spoke.\n\nI'm afraid Barbas's impersonation of poor Tarvus did not extend to keeping the temple books in order. Our records are in shambles!
You'll get no slaves from this hold!
You will soon be there!
Sweet, Sweet Roll!
The bulls are hungry. I'm hungry. Work.
The villages are too easy. I want to thin a real herd of Nord pigs!
We give the stone life!
The flames hunger!
We'll drive you like cattle into a lake of fire!
Bare your throat for thirsty thorns!
Reap what they sow. Yes, they will.
Rumble rubble, crash and tumble!
I am the Dreadhorn clan!
Fruits of the slaughter, sustain us!
<Growls.>
Dangerous prey quickens the blood!
You know, Slag Town isn't all bad. Apart from the occasional threat or two. But you know, that's how it goes sometimes!
I haven't seen Sotha Sil once since I've arrived in Clockwork. You would think he'd show his face in the city he created.
You look like an honest sort. The kind who can appreciate a good, simple pack. Doesn't talk to you or anything, but honestly? Why would it need to?
Would you like help today? I am able to perform a variety of tasks related to banking.
I can't imagine the regulations of other banks. Here everything has its place, and our storage facilities are processed using the latest advancements.
I have several fine vintages for you to try. Sampled them myself just recently. Perhaps too recently. Ugh, my head.
Be careful, walker. Pine splinters can poke the paw, but metal splinters cut to the bone!
All food I offer is free of contamination and poisons.
I find that sewing helps regulate the mind. The few apostles I've convinced to take up the craft have told me it's done wonders for their concentration.
You newcomers will never understand the luxury of a hot meal. Try living off of gruel for a few years, then you'll know true appreciation.
I think the hardest thing for newcomers to get use to is the gruel. We here in the Brass Fortress grew up with it, but I'm sure it's not easy to adjust to.
Perhaps being a shopkeeper wasn't what my family was hoping for, but I try to make them proud in my own way.
There's a lot you can do with crows. They're very versatile creatures. Crow stew, crow pie, crow-quettes ….
The newcomers have been great inspirations for me. Feel free to share any tips you may have picked up!
I don't trust none of these fancy factotums running around the city. Make sure to stock up on my wares, get yourself some protection. Who knows when you're going to need it.
I'd watch your gold down here, if I was you. You never know when someone might get desperate. Well, more desperate than this lot already is.
Before you even start, no, I'm not having an enchanting evening. You can't believe how many times I've heard that one.
If you're looking for alchemical reagents, you've come to the right place. Just promise me you won't use them to make something boring.
A house and furniture go together like Sotha Sil and Mysteries.
Come by my shop any time you'd like. I'm always happy to show my customers some attention. Especially when it's a customer like you.
You'll find quite a few easy targets up in the Brass Fortress. Most of the apostles have a loose gear or two.
My sister has a knack for magic, got swooped up real quick. Me? I'm content making a life out here in Slag Town, living by my own rules.
I will keep your bones as a trophy.
Our compact is eternal.
Don't keep your ancestors waiting.
I'm just not spring-loaded enough to move out of Slag Town. You have to have a certain kind of smarts to escape this pile of scrap.
All is lost! Fall back!
Bleat like the sheep you are!
The Hunting Grounds call!
Sotha Sil favors you, Auxiliary. You have the eyes of a truth-maker. My anvil is yours. Can I assist you further?
I won't die like a coward! I won't!
Smell their fear! Make them weep!
Don't go killing yourself, you hear? Who else would I get to run around Clockwork for us?
I'm glad you want to help, but don't work yourself sick. Take a break.
No one in Clockwork is gonna miss the scrap I'm requesting. But to us? These supplies are worth their weight in gold.
On my mark!
Leave nothing standing!
I've got a lot of people asking about those supplies. Give me some good news.
Let fire kindle its rage!

Hurry with those bodies! I don't want to be here if they disturb old Bjarfrud the Bloody!
Come! Dance in flame!
Only ash will remain!
Come and be trampled.
I wield the earth and sky. This land is mine!
Let the elements decide.
I was not manufactured for pleasantries. Please check later for another task.
Make sure you're well prepared for the task on hand before heading out.
Do I have good news to tell the other apostles?
I'm quite proud to be the resident expert on water regulation.
Do you wish to learn more about your current task?
I no longer sense a Daedric presence in Clockwork City.
Rewards will be offered for the completion of contracts. Are you interested?
I can no longer sense the Imperfect's functions.
You're enjoying this, aren't you?
I'm beginning to think you don't appreciate my work.
Slaves to Orryn. Now is your time!
I can't summon aid while these souls are bound to his crystals!
The clatter and scrape of old bones is music to my ears.
Destruction spells aren't my specialty. Give this crystal a whack, would you?
Hmph, putrid meat.
Don't let its corruption touch you!
I think I'll mash your bones together just like this.

I want to go home! I just want to go home!
We used to dance. Terari! I can't find the steps …!
You best not cause any trouble in Slag Town, you hear? My sense of justice ain't as noble as the factotums topside.
This is not just! This is not right!
Change was in our nature, but where you rose to the heavens, we fell to the depths of Oblivion.
This wasn't what you promised Seht! This wasn't my destiny!
Brassilisks don't usually have much purpose beyond a gaudy toy. Of course I've functioned Brassie to be useful as well as adorable.
In Black Marsh, we waste nothing. No part of the land is without its uses. It is not so different here. Except for the things marked "waste." You should definitely leave those alone.
The Clockwork Apostles may not appear friendly at first, but after showing enough intellectual curiosity they open right up about their work.
Hears-the-Winding is different from the other apostles. She's even offered to teach me how to read. My egg-sister must have gone through much hardship to have grown such kindness.
To follow a god you cannot see, now that has reason. But to follow a god who refuses to show himself? Who hides away and ignores your pleas? Well, that's just crazy.
The Clockwork Apostles walk the path of the Sublime Piston, which sunders the Named pursuits of those trapped upon the Line-motion.
Please leave the sequence plaques where they are. I've just started organizing them, and I don't want you mucking about and undoing my hard work.
Isn't this place supposed to be something special? All I'm seeing is a lot of metal, a lot of dirt, and a lot of things that want to kill you.
I saw a Breton girl walk by here a few days ago, looking for something called the Halls of Regulation. I hope she made it there all right.
My companion over there keeps eating my masterpieces. Still, it only drives me to create more! To create better! Soon they'll be so beautiful no one would dare gobble them up.
Spring-load your day with some purchases?
I have become the butcher's blade.
Can your lives be mended?
Do cease and desist!

Our accounts are severely lacking in the way of new tributes today. What to do, what to do?\n\nYou, there! Can't you see I have much too much work to do to engage in idle chit-chat. Return another time or find someone else to bother.
Tribute? Something shiny, something tasty? Or both? Shiny and tasty? Oh, stop keeping me in suspense! Either give me the tribute or get back out there and find one!
The Court demands something shiny. Or maybe something tasty. We demand a tribute!\n\nPlease, crow-friend, flap your nonexistent wings and fly to our aid. Our hoard won't fill itself, you know.
Why must light chase away the shadows?
I feel its desire to smother the light.
Sleep now.

Accessing general greeting array. Hello, resident.
Dreaming …. Glowing embers. Wool blanket.
Greetings, resident. Please obey all Clockwork City laws.
My only pulse is lightning. How it burns!
How much will you endure to see justice done?
This one recommends that you purchase a crate from the store.
Ooooh.
Well met, and good fortune to you!
This one wonders, could there be anyone more lazy than the person who named the fireplace?
Do any of these crates smell lucky to you?
Pacrooti can see a lucky aura around you today.  He is sure you will get something good! And all you need is a crate. You can purchase one from the store, and then we can begin.
Reveal your rewards, my friend.
This looks valuable.
Ooooh.
Excellent!
Good luck!
Take your time. I'm just considering where to mount you.
A blessing from the Divines!
Your luck amazes Pacrooti! Perhaps he needs to shuffle better.
Your next crate awaits!
Wait! What was that reward? … Unbelievable! Pacrooti wanted one of those for himself!
Pacrooti wonders what you will get next time. See you tomorrow!
Pacrooti will be right here!
How much longer do you intend to keep this up?
Feel how the mammoth's cold heart still seeks to gore.
These serpents will swallow your soul.
I will boil the marrow in your bones.
A wamasu kills simply by existing.
A lurcher's soul has a crushing grip on life. Can you feel how desperately it wants to take root?
Don't struggle, it only draws out the suffering.
Soon you'll know.
Orryn demands this.
You're his now.
Once, I was worshiped. Now I shall be feared!
Thurvokun's gift endures! Feel my flames!
Feel how the fire burns!
I'll freeze you where you stand!
Peryite's wrath will bring your ruin!
No, no! Stay away from Spellbreaker!

No, no—no, you're ruining our samples!

You're nothing against Scalecaller's might!
Join us in Scalecaller's blessing!
Our research will continue! You can't stop us!
We will be revered! Honored!
Testing protocol initiated.
My friend, behind my shield!
The labors of the Divine Prosecution mount, but our ranks remain annoyingly low. That's why we need the help of deputized newcomers such as yourself.\n\nAre you ready for a contract?
I do believe you'll need to leave the area if you actually want to complete the contract I gave you.
It oozes and pulses along your skin. Can you feel it spreading?
It's good to see you back, deputy. Dare I hope you bring news of your success?
Such robust guests. I'll put an end to that!
It spreads within you! Pulsing! Yes!
Do you feel it? Your magic draining! Failing!
Guards! Our guests need some extra care.
Fang Lair might make a decent stronghold, with cleaning up.
My skin clings so tight. Maybe I should cut it loose?
This place is dead, even for a Dwemer ruin.
What fools, my superstitious kin.
Hope the Scalecaller attacks soon. I'm ready to reap some souls.
Perhaps I should practice my technique on a skeleton?
Watching something bleed out with an arrow in its guts is so calming.
We can raise legions of the dead in this place.
The geyser is going to blow soon! Be careful!
As a current resident of Summerset, you must do your part to protect our beloved island. Do you have time to take on another assignment?
The Divine Prosecution has granted you the honor of helping us during these dark times. See that your duty is done.
Our appointed agent returns. Your report, quickly! Was your hunt successful?
No, leave my guests be! They belong with us now!
Gar yarag go!
Enslaving a lich … think I'll cling to life a little longer.
Eat something, before you're mistaken for a corpse.
Aga yara yor!
It's kind of fun, the way they pop.
Sending souls to the afterlife is a specialty of mine.
Stay back, they hunger for life.
Ah, nothing like the smell of charred flesh!
Drink up, my lovely guards. Get nice and strong!
Come out, sister. We won't hurt you.
We know your future, Oracle-witch!
Leaving already?
You best make this fight worth my while!
You're nothing against Z'Maja's might!
Let's get this over with, shall we?
Only fools would fight against Z'Maja's will!
Soon, my shadows shall spread to all of Summerset!
You all shall make excellent additions to my shadow army.
Fools! You shall join the Welkynars in defeat!
To kill your own order … your own companions …. How does it feel, Olorime?
Am I worthy yet? I don't want to go back to the hedge maze.
The hunters are gone, right? They're dead? Of course they are!
Of all the cursed luck! How did hunters get in the keep?
No! I won't be hunted! Not again!
I'm sure Vykosa wouldn't mind if I killed just a few of you, eh?
Moon Hunter Keep is ours by blood right!
You must be quite powerful to have made it this far. Pity I must kill you.
You could join us. Freedom, power. Strength. It could be yours.
Don't worry. I'll make sure your corpses don't go to waste.
You were destined for death the moment you stepped into this keep.
You'll be but a footnote in my pack's glorious victory!
Vykosa would have happily let you join her pack. If only you had asked.
It's tired of running, hunter. It's tired of being chased.
I hope you enjoy the Hunting Grounds, because you're about to spend eternity here.
We've come so far! This can't be the end.
Join us within the Hunting Grounds. Forever.
And now to be rewarded the power I deserve.
I can't help but envy such a great pledge. Makes me want to go out and knock a few heads myself! \n\nAnd afterward maybe knock a few knees, if you catch my drift.
You've got the eyes of someone back from a fresh kill. \n\nAnd not in a bad way, mind you! In the very heroic, definitely good way.
Summerset will soon be back beneath the waves!
Summerset falls, and then the Crystal Tower.
Surrender and perhaps I'll let you live.
Embrace your futility, worms. Summerset will be ours!
This island, this world, it shall all be ours!
The night protects me, mortal.

To me, my shadow warriors! To me!
Ah, the wretch's little resistance. So glad you could join us!
Did you truly think you could stop the mighty Maormer?
Sunhold is ours! There's no taking it back!
My victory … was so … close.
Rojai has become somewhat of a symbol of the Guild. Foreign, fierce, and not particularly liked by our current neighbors. Still, he shall endure, just as the Guild does.
The Guild always has a steady supply of magical wares. Care to take a look?

Ma always said I had a voice like a bird. Maybe that's what I'll audition with. A song. \n\nI'll have to ask Daring to give me some recommendations. Something that will really get the House of Reveries fired up!
I don't know you, and I am not interested in knowing you. Leave me alone.
We must stop Z'Maja, before her darkness spreads!
There's no one left to rescue you! Sunhold is ours!
Even with all this power … still, I fall? Pathetic.
Thought we was after the Sapiarch. Not sure I signed up for this.
All this work will be worth it someday… I hope.
Quickly. Grab what you can before we sail.
Who's responsible for this weather?
Quiet! I heard someone nearby.
Altmer magic, bah! Nothing but spittle compared to my storm!
A little fear can win our battles before they begin.
The plot we've weaved is catching prey.
Do not flee. I shall cover you in the finest silks.
My brood shall pick your bones clean!
Is there no end to these damned sea spawn?
Hmm. Perhaps if I first drain the corpse of blood, and then apply the imp stool ….
It has been said that you have some skill with sword, or was it spell? It matters not. The Battlegrounds are unlike any other playing field. You need actual skill to dominate these games.

Inga lukzi embrach!

Do you smell something? Something smells … yellow. Not hiding any ducklings around here are you? Duck feet are hideous, mate. Hideous!
It demands your death. I must obey!
Oh, good. I was just starting to feel peckish!
My pack shall feast upon your corpses!
A valiant effort, though useless nonetheless.
Vykosa will put an end to your intrusion!
You shall join us in our eternal hunt!
You'll all fall soon.
This one does not mind getting her claws bloody.
Show yourself, you curs! We must defend this keep!
Rip that one apart first!
I'll rend your flesh and feast upon the meat!
Let us finally feast!
It is time to face your execution!
Let's give our prisoners a feast!
Here, you weak fool! Grow stronger with this!
The power of lightning courses through me!
You are feeling tired, no? Why not give in to Vykosa's might?
Feel the crushing weight of my magic!
Feeling a little … frightened?
This spell shall put an end to you all!
Now then … which should I choose?
Gaze upon true power! Gaze upon your deaths!
You must escape those roots! Before it's too late!
You must avoid those thorns!
The Guardian will use those spriggans to heal! Kill them first!
Don't allow those spriggans to keep healing the Guardian!
We should crush those Silver Dawn pests, once and for all!
<Wolfish heavy breathing.>
I'm so hungry! When's the next hunt?

What a delicious scent!

You dare threaten my pack? I'll strike you down!

Stay low! The fog will hide you while our wisp finds the indrik!
A light touch will help the wisp keep searching.
Finally, we've found the beast!
Welcome to Lilmoth, beeko. There is no finer place to bask, wallow, and store your treasures.
In Murkmire, all oaths are kept. So believe me when I say your treasures will be safe with us!
The Fighters Guild tried recruiting some members of the Dead-Water tribe, but we weren't particularly well-received. A shame. Many claim they are the greatest warriors in this swamp.
Simple, practical, logical magic, that's what I do. None of this nonsense with listening to wind chimes and taking orders from a tree.
My packs can carry most anything. Toxic plants, blades, a toad or two …. They're very durable.
Feel free to use my tools. But if a Saxhleel in black armor approaches, step aside. It's not wise to make a Shadowscale wait.
Hot days, warm nights. Not a shiver to be found! Sure, it gets a tad humid, but there's nowhere else I'd rather be selling my armor.
Never did imagine myself selling swords in some backwater swamp town. Still, you can be sure the weapons I sell are of the highest quality.
My egg-sister and I discovered the secret to perfect snail-gin. Now we just need to discover the secret of how to make it not kill you when you drink it.
Want some advice? Watch the local woodworkers at their trade. Their bows could make an Elven barkweaver jealous. Trust me.
I feel bad for all these tourists, chewing on their imported boiled potatoes and cured meats. Argonian fare might be weird looking, but it's the best in Tamriel!
Can I interest you in something?
You're welcome to use my tools, friend. Just remember to knock the mud off your boots when you come in. I'm running a business here, not a pigsty!
The wind sings a song of foul weather. You should prepare, beeko.
Bland palate? No wish to dine upon our native eel-pears? Disgusted by the thought of local cuisine? My shop has just what you need!
My inn is my hearth, and you are welcome. When the winds change, another may take my place. That is the way the river flows in Murkmire.
Most of my orders come through the Bright-Throat tribe. Not sure what they need with my leathers, though. There aren't many warriors among them.
The Mages Guild sent me to Murkmire as an interpreter of sorts. Even when speaking Tamrielic, very few truly understand Argonian speech.
Hasty stitching makes for broken threads. Patience in all things, but in sewing most of all.
My workshop is old and full of nightmares. Your hammer must learn the old tree's wisdom to harness that power.
I've made some good deals lately with the Bright-Throat tribe. Though I'm not sure what they need weapons for, given how peace-loving they're said to be.
Look out!
Keep your head down and let the fog cover you!
Make sure to give Hircine a good show now!
Those spriggan saplings seem up to something!
Guard yourself against that spriggan's elemental spell!
Why are we hunted? Leave us alone, we just want to be alone!

Purge the impure!

Remember the name of Cyrodilic Collections! We're going to return Argonian history to Murkmire. You have my promise on that.\n\nIn the meantime, could you help Jee-Lar? He's having some issues equipping our next expedition.
That's not good! Quickly! The skeevatons!
It seems the Argonians about here are content with furniture made of mud and sticks. Of course, my shop holds our wares to a higher standard.
I've always said that I'd mount anything at least once. Ah … that is to say, I'll mount any steed. Perhaps I should think of a way to reword that.
Murkmire having no Daedra is a good thing, yes, but it does make for idle hours. Perhaps I will convince Hitari to hunt down some wamasus with me. I've heard they can be quite the challenge!

The way some of these Argonian mages talk about their magic is … frustrating, to say the least. "A smidgen of this root, a pinch of that. Feel the wind! Let the earth move you!"\n\nReally, how can one practice under such uncontrolled conditions?
Not from around here I see. Don't know why you'd come to this hole, but I'm guessing you're looking for an opportunity. Might have one. You up for it?
I wouldn't be here if it weren't for you. Not that being in Lilmoth is anything to celebrate. Steady work though.\n\nFor you too, if you're interested.
Don't make a habit of these visits. Routine is a death by many cuts.
No other jobs right now, but I'm not going anywhere. I'll yell if I need you.
Keep watching, you kuudas! You might just learn something.
Time to face your final opponent!
The challengers have triumphed!
Keep on your toes, challengers!
And the challengers return for another bout!
That's it, challengers! Put up a fight!
Blackrose Prison is no place for mercy! Strike quick and true!
No tasks for you. Come back later.
That way. Your task awaits, outsider.
Is that the best you can do, Blackguards?
Show them what the Blackguards are made of!
Blackguards! Get back up and strike back!
A nix-hound has more common sense than these challengers ….
Ka-ha-ha! These spineless weaklings will never win.
Was that a hit? I could barely tell.
My, my. Such marvelous brutality today.
A lovely blow! How exciting.
Oh. That certainly looked like it smarts.
When the hunt ends, the celebration begins. Is a celebration in order, friend of the Naga-Kur?
We need relic hunters and we're paying well! Come! Let's talk!
I say sincerely. What I offer will no doubt lead to your death, but the battle will be glorious!\n\nWill you accept a challenge from the Naga-Kur tribe?
Feel my power!
Just looking at these scales makes me itch. Please let it be my imagination.
I am relieved to see you in good health, Rootmender. Were you able to complete your task?
I had no doubt you would accept this task, Rootmender. Still, I wish to thank you all the same.
The Root-Whisper tribe continues to grow, but our resources do not. Will you lend your aid once more, Rootmender?
When you speak to Argonians, they truly wish to listen. When you speak to Khajiit, they are simply waiting for the moment when it is their turn to talk.\n\nI am no exception to this, of course.

I don't buy Sulahkeesh's sweet granny act for one second. Once a Shadowscale, always a Shadowscale. That's why I pay my respects when I see her.\n\nYou'd best do so too, unless you want to end up face down in the swamp with a slit throat.
The Root-Whisper Village has only just started its long journey to prosperity.
Poor Tsaesh is being bothered by that Lukiul again. Bah. Does he not realize she's as mute as a stone?
The Blackguards swarm around Murkmire like flies over a corpse. If you meet one on the road? Do not hesitate. Strike them down before they have a chance to draw their weapon.
That place behind me? Nothing special about it. Just a trap door inside an abandoned building. What's strange about that?
Isn't Lilmoth just beautiful? A true tropical get away!\n\nI'd also love to visit the Bright-Throat Village if I could, but traversing the swamps is a … challenge, to say the least.

I would raise the spine of aggression at these contemptuous hatchlings, but I do not want to frighten them. They would run into the swamp and sink into the mud or get eaten by a predator.\n\nThey are as fragile as the shells that spawned them.

I grimace with consternation. The hackwings. They are a plague upon the land!\n\nI go out to hunt them, slaughter a dozen or more, and the next day there are twice as many! Where do they all come from, I wonder?

I am supposed to be training with the other novices, but I am not in a rush to walk the Path of the Lily.\n\nSome Naga believe war and battle demonstrate the height of courage. Me? I prefer a quiet spot and a warm bowl of worm and marsh moss stew.
You may enter our village, outsider, but have no doubt that we will be watching you.

The Xinchei-Konu is known to our people as the ku-vastei. It helps to create the needed change of our people. Not directly, of course, but through a spark.\n\nHmm. Many apologies, but I am not the best at explaining such things.
Danger hides even in the most serene locations. Never forget that, outsider.
The tribes of Murkmire all have different traditions. It makes me curious … what will the traditions of Root-Whisper be?

Xukas will open the Root-Whisper tribe to outsiders. He intends to share our culture and history, and create allies where so many see enemies.\n\nStill, he also wishes to honor Jaxsik-Orrn by strengthening our defenses and military might.
My skills in spear fishing are unrivaled. It is an honor to teach this skill to my new tribe, so that we may one day prosper under a blessed sun.
Ha! I can't believe that worked!
We have many hardships ahead of us. Farms to grow, warriors to train. Families to build. The tribe of Root-Whisper will know little peace for many generations to come.
The void will take you! As it takes us all!
Chaos, death, destruction! All are mine to control!
Joy. Anger. Misery. They will come, and they will pass. As all things must one day pass. Know that truth, and you shall know Sithis.
Your kindness will be your undoing!
I can't be the only one confused right now. This is supposed to be … music? What in Trinimac's name ….
Can I help you?
That should do the trick!
Haven't you done this before? I thought you were an expert!
Do I need to take over?
Lilmoth is known as the festering jewel of Murkmire. And we, beeko? We're the decay.
I've never felt more at home than within this refuge. Soon as I've earned enough gold, I'll quit this job for good!\n\nNow, how can I help you?
The tree takes in its nourishment, no matter the source it comes from. So too do I accept that which you have acquired.
Do you have any goods you need handled? I am said to have quite the touch.
Sure, I could probably get a job banking up top, but I actually prefer it down here. A lot less stress, a lot less expectations. Now if only there were a few less stabbings ….
One day, I will be a nisswo with an apprentice of my own. And when that happens, you can be certain that I will not put them in life-threatening situations!
Exotic, enchanted goods! Guaranteed to lift your spirits!
Magical spoils from distant realms!
The merchants have doubled the Lilmoth guards again.
The ship will be easy pickings, I guarantee it!
You play hip-and-tail ball like a one-legged guar!
Send more supply caches to the Echoing Hollow.

This one's pets are stirring. There's prey about.
Sometimes this one thinks she should have been born a senche.
Death by a thousand fangs!
Dro'zakar is on the prowl. Woe unto the prey he stalks.
Worse than a Kotu Gava bite, yes?
It's the sugar that this one misses most.
Fighting only makes the poison flow faster!
Bahlokdaan needs no wings to crush you!
Off with your playthings!
Our power felled a Dragon. How could you compare?
This is the true strength of blood!
Sanguine spirit, take form and feast!
I'll deal with you soon enough, Sahrotnax!
I'll never quench this thirst on you vermin!
Listen, Mojaluz understands that better herbalists might work within Senchal, but at least this one's goods are legal. The Shields buy them often!
Come indulge in my store so that you may forge whatever you desire. Perhaps giant hammers. Other stuff too, maybe. But trust this one, giant hammers are the best.
I know my stock isn't the best, but smugglers are the only ones doing trading around here these days. Not about to involve myself in that game.
You ever try walking through a desert with a full suit of plate on? Not a good idea. My stuff will get you wherever you need to go.
Are you feeling disenchanted with your life? If so, this one has good news for you. Our products can enhance anything. Weapons. Armors. Lovers. You name it.
Have you noticed how the eyes of the statues follow you in Senchal? Do you think Sheogorath watches through them?\n\nOh, I'm sorry, how can I help you?
Business here in Senchal comes and goes. Mostly pirates and smugglers needing something. The Shields rarely come to me to buy or repair.
I trained for years under Master Tasheer up in Rimmen. It was a hard apprenticeship, but by the Eight did I learn how to make a fine Khajiiti brew. Feel free to try one out for yourself!
I used to prepare meals for nobles, you know. Summerset nobles! But I suppose cooking for cats is better than a visit from the Divine Prosecution ….
Perhaps Zurso can get some Dragon hide to work with and maybe make a chest piece that resists fire. Assuming the hide came from one of the fire-breathing Dragons, of course.
Someone told me that I'm wasted in this old marketplace. But I enjoy selling nice wares and talking to people. Each day is a little different.
My past experiences with Imperials were not … good, so I set up a business here with some trepidation. The Shields are more respectful, thankfully.
I've still got my tools from my time in the Thirteenth Legion. Every weapon in my shop was sharpened with an Imperial grade whetstone and cleaned with Imperial grade oil. I guarantee it.
I'm blessed in that I have now worked with wood local to Senchal and Elsweyr, so I know more than I did before arriving here.

Have you seen the Pahmer? The really, really big Khajiit? I just want to jump in their arms! They are so big and furry. I love them!\n\nI have yet to talk to one, though. They're a little … intimidating.
This one thought that when he joined the Mages Guild, he would get fancier robes to wear. But you did not come here to hear Kargik complain. Come! Take a look at Kargik's magical items.
Some guild members don't care for the duty of selling items, but I don't really mind. Better than going out and killing Dragons. Speaking of items, would you like to see my wares?
Ah, it's taking root within you now.
Debaasi has only been robbed four times today! That is much better than the fourteen times yesterday!\n\nNow, please, help Debaasi out and buy something, yes?

Wondering why I'm here in Senchal instead of frolicking about in Grahtwood? Let's just say it involved a spriggan, an albino hyena, a lot of rotmeth, and … nope. Not saying any more than that right now.
I'm not free of the blight yet. We have to kill him!
There must be something useful up there.
You did this? You did this to me!
No one has fun at my expense!
His stench is unmistakable. Wash it away!
I never said you could cut in to this dance of ours.
You're so slow you actually took root!
Ah, I forgot to bury you. You'll sprout yet, my flower.
You do realize that I planned all this, don't you? Though I didn't expect you to deliver Selene to me so readily.
Thank you for freeing me. I'll return the favor.
Feast on these curs!
Ah. Nisaazda's final gift. It tastes divine.
Ah! My control has been severed!
You dropped something. Let me get that for you.
Your blood has no power over me.
Blood is too precious for you to waste.
Feel your pulse quicken … and stop!
I'll seep into your veins.
Gah! Keep them away from Khajiit's ritual!
Show the Clan Mother your worth!
Hammer crush skulls flat ….
If your flames scorch my children, Hiti, I'll gouge out your eyes!
We'll make you clean. Naught but bones and ashes!
Do take your time. This anticipation … it's exhilarating!
Look, dears. They linger on our threshold like babes in a basket. Adorable, aren't they?
Well done, beast! Now, we boil the bones! Make them clean!
Honestly, sisters, was that so hard?
That settles that. Honestly, dears, was that really so hard?
You're right on time, runts. The lads here are starving!
How long have you been standing there? How long have I been standing here?
Death can only be delayed for so long ….
Least you died in a graveyard, eh? Convenient.
Ha! Now you're stuck here too. But at least we're all together! We're all dead together!
Death comes for us all eventually. Today, it came for you.
The warlock sends you to your death!
Your transgressions fuel my flame!
You'll choke on those flames, Dragon! I swear it!
Don't bark orders to me, witch.
Fools! You trade a savior for tyrants!
Reman had to be both. So will I.
Are you holding back? I'm beginning to think you're not trying.
No!
Khajiit will avenge his blood-kin!
You stink of blood and sweat. Mmmmm, reminds me of my adventuring days. You finished my task, yeah?
May the Eight protect you. Naw, forget that. Sharpen your blade and protect yourself. Then come back when the job is done.
If you have a strong will or a strong sword-arm, I've got work for you. If you're going to idle about and hope some gold falls in your lap, walk on.
You earned a rest. Besides, I don't have anything else for you today. Come back tomorrow, eh?
Lo, the conquering hero returns! Can Guybert pick them, or can Guybert pick them? Ha!\n\nBut look at me, prattling on. The job's done, yes?
Well, you have things to do. Onward, eh? A gleaming fortune awaits your return!
A stolid adventurer! Excellent! If you're ready to face the perils of Elsweyr, why not earn a bit of gold along the way?\n\nCome, let's talk business!

Preparing to set out again I take it? I would offer you more work, but it seems that today's contracts have all come to a satisfying conclusion. Good news for Guybert, yes?\n\nCome back tomorrow. I'm certain I'll have something for you then.
Don't slouch, Kjarg. Make mother proud!
You will never leave this island!
Hammer wants blood!
Scatter them to the winds, Gohlla!
Hiti! Set a fire in their soul!
Bani, give these fools a taste of the Dark Arts.
Shock them to submission, Maefyn!
Sisters! Let me wield the Coven's wrath!
You won't be laughing when you're in my web!
I'll claim you all for Maarselok!
Hmm. You walk with a killer's swagger. So, the Dragons are dead?
Every moment we spend conversing brings greater chaos to Elsweyr. Enough talk. Go. Remind those Dragons why they should fear us.
Even now, Dragons choke out the sun with their broad wings and bluster. Unacceptable.\n\nYou will help Chizbari put an end to it, yes?
We resume the hunt tomorrow, walker. You will seek this one out then, yes? Good, good.
Bebbia knows this task is not a simple one, but she hopes you will retrieve all the pieces soon. She longs to see what Percius can make of them.
Hey, don't go putting off my duties. I'm providing a vital service for the Dragonguard.
You're, uh, still standing here … you waiting for me to say "dismissed" or something? Kinda like that.\n\nDismissed, recruit!
Still nothing. Let's see. Red, yellow, blue ….
Stop them!
You can't escape the New Moon's wrath!
Quick-quick now!
Senchal is an interesting place. It quite reminds me of Abah's Landing. That's both good and bad.
Ah. I forgot my purse.
Play dead, Tulip! Play dead, girl! It's only pretend.
Gimme! Gimme! Gimme!
You are pirates, yes? Khajiit can learn to sail, if you just untie this one!
Oh, well that settles it then. Our mistake! Haha!
You can be saved from this desperate toil. We can give you a new life.
You would help this pitiful cat?
What have you done? They were here to save me!
Your vile reign will end!
The rule of Dragons cannot be stopped!
This one would return home, but … Khajiit has none.
This one will collect souvenirs when the Dragon is dead. This Dragon is not yet souvenir-ready!
When facing a Dragon, sound tactics dictate more forces than are present. Retreat!
Senchal shall burn in the Dragons' fire!
The people will join us eventually … or they will burn.
Khajiit does not like the Elves. He sees how they look down their noses at us.
What is it that makes this Moon Sugar so potent?
Mask-bearer! Call upon my might!
Nahfahlaar's fire, five-claw, call it down!
Damn that Dragon's wings! Wait for him to return or force him to land!
Something big is coming! Ready your grapple-bow!
All four of the shrines are lit. I bet the door will open now!
Get ready to fight!
I'm warning you! Goharth Ironbelly isn't someone to trifle with!
Never a secret passage when you need one.
Have you heard the tale of Khunzar-ri and the Erupting Volcano? It will singe your fur for sure, walker!
Like grain before the scythe.
I'll do my best to at least feed and shelter these people. Times like these, helping is more important than profit.
You're pretty good! I guess it's time to call in the muscle.
We're going to do this, eh? All right, let's go!
Just another notch in the belt.
Karthald is ours!
Ah, you're the first one back today. Hopefully not the only one. Walk me through your findings, if you'd be so kind?

The Coterie's work can be dangerous, but such is the price of enlightenment. Just think of the work that your findings might inspire!\n\nSpeaking of … if you haven't, you should speak with the author of the study straightaway!
The Coterie of Organized Scholars has need of individuals with a fondness for practical research and very few personal connections. And a sense of adventure, of course!\n\nCan I count on you?

The Coterie of Organized Scholars' pursuit of knowledge is relentless, but even the most assiduous of scholars needs time to digest such inscrutable findings.\n\nConsider this a brief respite. We'll have more work for you soon enough.
I'm not impressed with the offerings so far.
By all means. Take in the view. It's the last thing you'll ever see.
What's the word on the task I gave you? Is Skyrim a little safer today?
I'm hoping you earn your reward. Mostly, so I can earn my commission.
The Swords of Solitude are short on volunteers and full on trouble. There's honest gold a plenty if you've got enough spine for the work.
Problems are not in short supply. Return tomorrow and I'm certain to have something for you to deal with.
I'm always willing to kill a few more.
Yandir wonders, who wants to die first?
No turning back, now. Draw your weapons.
I have all the time in the world. What I lack is patience.
No one can fight the sea.
Hmph. No glory in a fight like that.
What a waste of blood ….
Life is a curse! Let me free you!
Don't flee! Let the madness in!
I need a volunteer! You!
I haven't tasted fresh meat in far too long.
Perhaps I made it too imposing. No, no. They would approve of peaceful subjugation. I shall make the next one even larger!
Is this dust? Dust! In my laboratory! Who last cleaned this chamber? Hm? Get out here and let these fools kill you!
Hmph, my patrons attract too many pests!
Ah, new subjects for study!
Your souls shall power our army!
His plan still thrives, swarms, breeds. Hunters gather. They know.
My lady demands your head as tribute!
How good of you to join me for dinner.
Song of dust. Simple dirt and bones. Peel the scales! Failure.
I'll feast well on your blood tonight!
There will be no graves for you. Only ashes!
You flounder in your fear!

If you're interested in our legendary instrument, and the … minor division of the College these last few years, I can tell you this.\n\nI would have expected Hrofgen to side with me, but I suppose Thaezara already had her claws in him.

If you're aware of the current bardic schism, stranger, you might have formed an opinion. Mine? I believe that Maestro Viatrix makes a good case for preserving Bardic heritage.\n\nI just hope Thaezara doesn't get mad at me for not siding with her.

You may wondering how a Breton rises to the rank of Headmaestro of the Solitude Bards College? Well, I'll tell you, it's not talent.\n\nAll the bards here have talent. It takes study. Hard work. I had to be undeniably perfect for the job.
Looking for another adventure, my friend? You need to learn to relax for awhile.\n\nEat, drink, find a companion. Life's too short for anything else.
This will only hurt until you die.
My genius triumphs again! Haha!
Now, die!
I cast the bones, and your future is bleak!
Release the husks!
Your blood is mine to use! Mine to control!
Watch it! That one looks mean!
Muffins! Want a nice sweetroll?
You look a little bloated, Muffins. Are you feeling all right?
Try my new skeever kabobs! They're better than they sound!
That's it! It's disintegration for you! For all of you!
Now! Ignition!
Experiment's integrity unaffected. Same cannot be said for test subjects.
It's about to explode! Haha!
This frigid mixture can't be handled without very wooly gloves.
Note to self: artificial snow would make this feel more like home.
Reset to room temperature! I have another test!
You'll make a fine sacrifice to the harrowstorm!
The loss of one pike will not dispel this ritual.
So long as one pike remains, the ritual will continue!
There will be other storms. You won't live to see them!
Protect the gray reliquary and feast on these vermin!
Nature and family, what else does one need?
I can tell you're no stranger to slaying beasts.
Enjoying the hospitality of our fair city so far? In need of banking services? Your treasures will stay safe with us. Our vault was blessed by the Divines during its creation, so rest easy.
Whether you fish or explore ruins, we have you covered in terms of safe banking.
I can't believe how many bones are down here. How many were left to die down here?
Fill your stomachs, beasts! Hoag no gragh!
Beast is hurt? Brunag gul tog. Yandir fixes it!
Fight Yandir, and you fight the cold!
Thunder! Wrath! Glory!
You kill beast, Yandir kills you!
Bring them down! Die in glory!
Ghal nah boorg! Up, spirits! Up!
Wait until I tell Elle, you criminals!
Take positions! Now, burn them alive!
Four flowers, two flowers … but six sconces? Ugh. Why must everything be a puzzle?
Conjurer! Summon more warriors, or I feed you to the sea!
I cannot wait to cut open your skull.
Look, more pit bait!
I hate looking over my shoulder for everything. Can barely get any work done.
I thought for sure the crows were going to pick our bones!
My pickaxe isn't enough to keep the beasts of Blackreach away.
Tireless effort produces the greatest results!
Don't slow down, we've got a lot of ground to cover.
Death is on your shores! Come and face it!
Cowardly! Weak! Flee while you can!
Can't believe the Overseer is working us this hard.
How much more of this can we take?
My eyes are never going to get used to all this dark.
How are we supposed to work when everything wants to attack us?
We conquer storm and raging sea! We will conquer you, too!
No hope! Ha! You have no hope!
Time to slake my thirst!
Keep shadowing the hold's patrols. They suspect something.
There won't be any need for abductions once we invade the surface.
Heard a pack tried to defy Exarch Ulfra. She drug them off in chains to who knows where.
Someone has to keep the supply lines running. Just don't see why it's got to be us.
An error has occurred. Please resolve it.
I expected to do better with the ladies down here.
Heard Jerralf broke his ankle, stumbling around in the dark.
Keep away from any of them Dwarf ruins. Not worth the risk.
At least with other jobs, you get to see the sun once in a while. Not down here.
The Gray Host will soon conquer Skyrim, Oblivion, and death itself.
We're planning to raze my hometown soon. I'm looking forward to it.
Hey, some of my best friends are werewolves.
The harrowed aren't zombies despite how much they resemble them.
When did your clan swear loyalty to the Ashen Lord?
The harrowstorms are doing all the work for us, but they're taking all the fun out of the conquest.
Has the pentarch heard anything? I'm tired of waiting for new orders.
I can't tell whether those stone husks are aware of us or not. It's unsettling.
With the return of the Exarchs, the Gray Host will be whole.
I hear someone coming. Be on your guard.
They're conjuring something!
Whose watch was it?
The skies are darkening!
I think this place might have had some religious significance once.
Who's afraid of some dark clouds?
There is no shelter from me!
Pierce the clouds! Call the lightning!
Kragha val! More hands! I need more hands!
Take a seat!
Kragh na! Fish on the hook!
Gulgha toch! Fog and thunder!
Initiate the exchange!
A bountiful harvest!
Step forth and join your comrades in this world!
This makes no difference! There will be other harrowstorms. You'll never stop them all.
This place is cursed or something!
Watch your flanks!
Where'd Lothrum go? He was just here!
Gods!
What is this place?
What strange magic is this?
Ah, more fresh meat!
Savages should not be so hard to kill.
Ah, this one hungers!
Very difficult, yes?
Wonderful, more death and dismemberment.
They were skilled. Good thing we're better.
Keep your wits about you!
This place isn't worth the trouble!
Am I dreaming this?
Is this real?
More meat for the pack!
I'm too old for this.
I gain honor in your death.
Ha, a hard battle! Good for the blood.
Woe! Sorrow! Terror!
Go, children, and drink your fill!
You dare? The night belongs to me!
I'll make you regret the damage you've done this day!
You'll find I've improved the Dwarven designs.
Now friend, I'm ready!
I think you've figured it out!
No, not that valve!
You think you can save yourself? You are mistaken.
Fall. Fall. Fall! She rejoices. Closer now.
You're not going anywhere this time!
Come to me! Shatter these fools!
Step into my domain!
Don't feed me this trash!
Make me work for it. The blood becomes even sweeter!
Ah! I was just wondering what happened to you. What can you tell me?
Not all Reach clans are bloodthirsty and obsessed with power, but those do exist. Watch yourself out there.
I need hardy adventurers to assist me in helping the clans of the Reach. I'm willing to pay, if you can complete the task at hand.
My contacts in the Reach appreciate the work we've been doing for them. \n\nI'll let you know when they need something else. And remember, I pay well for services rendered!
You bring good news, I hope?
Good luck out there. You must decide for yourself if you are the hunter or the hunted today.
If you've got the spine for dealing with threats to the Reach, the Ard's Stonehands could use you. Might be able to pull something out of the Markarth vaults to reward you for it, too.
The ard can't see to every crisis himself, and the Reach is full of threats. We will have need of you soon, I'm sure.
Prey.
He's making me so angry! Grah!
What a shocking development! Only joking. I work from a precise model.
Adequate. Just adequate. We'll make Gray Host of you yet.
Defend the castle at all costs!
There may have been a small misunderstanding with the local guard this morning.\n\nIf anyone asks, tell them that Biro-dar was at home the entire day, yes?
Someone's here. Time for fun!
Our hounds will gnaw on your bones!
I shall receive my Lady's blessing!

There may have been a small incident at the merchant's shop today.\n\nBiro-dar had nothing to do with it, of course. This one studied without pause all day long. All day. Certainly, Biro never left this house. Not even once.
Did I ever mention that I learned how to brew in the Mages Guild?\n\nThat's not what the assignment called for, but my instructor got too sloshed on my Dremora blood beer to complain.
Just the entertainment I need!
Your trespass stops here!
Ooo, excuse me. That was a big one. The fizzy drinks always do that to me, but I like the fizzy drinks.\n\nThe bubbles tickle my whiskers.
I was—hic—working out a spell to—hic—stop the hiccups, but—hic—I can't finish the damn—hic—incantation. Ugh.
So many people in civilized towns don't carry weapons. What if they have to kill someone in a hurry? Do they plan to ask them to wait while they fetch a blade from home?
Folk outside the Reach talk too much. If you put a sharp blade against their neck, though, they usually shut up and let you go about your business.
This is interesting. An academic from House Ravenwatch took an interest in my work.\n\nFunny, I never knew a noble house to be interested in scholarly pursuits before.

Fascinating! It seems that Herminius Sophus is doing some significant work out in the Alik'r Desert. I so wish I were a field scholar sometimes.\n\nOf course, every time I attempted it, the results were disastrous.
I will bury you among these old books!
Come then! Try your best!
My lord shall be pleased.
<<Wheezing, heavy breaths.>>
Let's see how many bones I can break before you can no longer work.
Approach, and suffer!
Such pitiful combatants.
The Reachfolk ask to keep odd things with us, so don't worry that we'd see anything you deposit as problematic. It's probably tame by comparison.
The Dwarven architecture here utterly fascinates me. Look at this place, as an example. Ready-made and unassailable vaults in which to store your treasures.
Stole some of that High Elf banker's cleaning powders. They really do get rid of smells! For a few days, anyway.
Mistakes were made. All yours.
Genius conquers all!
Cut them down!
Lend me a hand here!
Diplomatic missions are one thing. Intelligence gathering is quite something else. What? No, forget I said anything.\n\nI'm here for relaxation, nothing more.

Like most Nords, I am an accomplished warrior. Of course, I have yet to prove myself in an actual battle. My father won't allow it.\n\nStill, if you ever get to see me fight, you'll immediately notice how good I am.
The hardest thing about being away from home is finding good places to eat. Especially when one follows a restricted diet. \n\nOh, do not concern yourself. Adusa will make do.
I have a taste for blackbird pie. Not that Nord abomination. A right proper Reach pie, made with whole blackbirds, beaks and all!\n\nWrothgar Orcs make a decent crow trifle, but it's not the same.

I was supposed to be the head of the ard's Stonehands by now, wrestling Giants and pummeling Nords from the back of a bull mammoth. But Caddach got too comfy on his stone throne. He didn't much care for my counsel on the state of his sorry arse.
I'm only here because of Bienghar. Talk to him, he's the hunter with the big ideas.
I like Markarth. These stones have been here for a long time, seen a lot. Makes you think.
I like watching the water, listening to it. Reminds me of roaming far and wide across the hills when I was young.\n\nEoline will probably be along soon, telling me to come home.
I heard that the jarls in Western Skyrim dress all fancy-like. Seems impractical to me.
The strangest thing about Markarth? People from all over Tamriel seem to wind up here. Never know who you're going to meet.
It seems to me that convincing Ard Caddach to let mages of other lands study and catalog Nchuand-Zel might lend his rule some legitimacy.\n\nSomeone should suggest that to him.
Don't tell Thella, but I'm half-hoping that Ard Caddach denies us permission to explore Nchuand-Zel. \n\nThings are tense here in Markarth and I'm not sure it's wise for us to linger.
One of the reasons I signed on as Tahzim's bodyguard was to see Markarth. Not sure I would want to stay here all the time, but it is impressive.
I came here because I'm clanless. It's a hard world for someone with no kin and no friends. \n\nAnd no, I don't want to talk about why.
I don't understand what Ard Caddach sees in that witch of his, Lady Balloon. She's not one of us. Not to be trusted.
The rumors are definitely untrue. No Dark Brotherhood contracts have been issued for the Skald-King. Not a one. As for me, I'm not important enough for anyone to want to kill.\n\nMore's the pity.

Understand, House Ravenwatch is a noble house. Known far and wide as an influential faction in Rivenspire. The Ravenwatch, on the other hand, must remain secret. The mortal world doesn't need to know about the nightmares we deal with to keep it safe.
No matter how many times Adusa warns the villains she faces, they always decide to fight. And it never ends well for them.\n\nNo one ever listens to Adusa.
I was worried you might not return this time. I was a fool to doubt you. You were victorious, were you not?
The people talk about you. About the harrier that hunts vampires like rabbits. Whatever your reasons, I'm glad you're on our side.\n\nNow, go and take care of that threat we discussed.

If we do our jobs, the common folk of the Reach never need to know about the threats the still lurk in the dark. That's our burden to bear.\n\nReturn later and I'll have a threat for you to deal with.
Our enemies need to fear us, but in truth the Wayward Guardians are spread thin. Like too little jam trying to cover too much bread.\n\nWill you lend your aid, harrier?
The flame brings life!
Stand with me!
You go no further!
Time for blood!
Is this it? Is this all you bring?
There is no more for you!
You lacked the will, fledgling.
[frustrated grunt]
I believe he just compared you to a rodent.
Are you predator or prey, hunter?
I hear someone coming. Be on your guard.
Hmm. Is this some sort of ritual site?
It's just clouds! A little rain won't hurt you!
Your weakness is a disgrace to my blade.
Run, hide, stand, fight …. It doesn't matter!
I'm ready to face anything!
For glory!
That's over with, I suppose.
They're conjuring something!
Whose watch was it?
You need to start taking this seriously.
We need to destroy those power cells, and that muck may be the key.
Is this all you could muster?
You underestimate your chances!
No, no, no, no.
It can't end like this!
The lord knows how to bring your suffering!
This shall not go quickly.
Such incredibly foolish bravery.
Stews are not the same as soups. Anyone who insinuates such a claim adds insult to their ignorance. They are as different as dragonflies and hackwings. I do not make stew.

A good soup is like a lake. The surface may be rife with activity, but the true greatness lies underneath. The surface is just the introduction. Get to know the flavors before you take the plunge.\n\nAnd if you find the spoon I dropped, let me know.

I visited one of your Aedric temples recently. The mortals there seemed to hold an entirely unwarranted regard for those tiresome entities. When was the last time a so-called god actually answered a prayer or smote an enemy?
I'm beginning to think I just picked the wrong cult. There's a lot to recommend the cult of Azura. It's very fashionable right now, and not at all murderous.\n\nWell, not too murderous.
I'm a former member of a Daedric cult. Form-er. I am in no way a murderous worshiper of some pagan religion. At least, I'm not any more.\n\nThe robes? Hey, I just like the way they look!

Have you ever considered that you might advance your position through murder and assassination? Happens among my kind all the time.\n\nYou see, if you eliminate your rivals, they never trouble you again! You have no idea how convenient that can be.
I ventured into a mortal city recently and encountered—oh, what were they called again?—ah, mimes, that was it. I encountered mimes for the first time. They are absolutely horrifying. Well done.
Not good enough! You must bring that fluid closer to me.
Don't stop now. Try again mortal.
We shall not stop!
You'll find yourselves in cages!
My freedom approaches mortal. Stay sharp down there.
Ah! I was just wondering when I would see you next. I hope everything went well. What can you tell me?
I need hardy adventurers to assist me in helping the city of Leyawiin. I am willing to pay, if you can complete the task at hand.
You return with good news, I hope?

If you've got the spine for dealing with the worst threats to Blackwood's peace and security, we could use you. And I think we might be able to find something from the city's vaults to reward you for your trouble, too.
My freedom won't happen if you ignore that oil Drathas found.
So you want that kind of fight!
Should have brought salamander traps!
Another try! That beast isn't so tough!
I don't think this minotaur will negotiate, but you're welcome to try.
Glad I brought plenty of arrows!
An eternity of disappointment.
My eternal duty lies in killing those who seek me.
Do you even know what you seek?
Is it really so hard?
Each life you take wrongly cuts away a bit of your soul. Keep on like that, and there will be nothing left.
What are we waiting for? Are we meeting someone here?
Foul thing. Leave us be!
Take that, foul creature!
Looking to lighten your load? Coin, belongings, dry goods—we store it all!
I won't draw this out—I'm certain you have treasures to claim and beasts to slay.\n\nDeposit or withdrawal?
Face my fury!
Come! Fall!
Feel honored! You bear witness to the spark that will ignite it all.
I am but the first. While you wait, hordes prepare.
So small.
Such weakness. Your souls are merely a snack for Xalvakka.
This is the best that the mortals have to offer?
Patience. Something few mortals possess.
It is good to be rich, but it is better to be smart. Even better to be both smart and rich. The smart and rich crow never wants for gold!\n\nWhat can I do for you today?
You have more shinies than you know what to do with, am I right? Here, let me help relieve you of some of them.
Ugh!
What can I do for you?
Where the Mundus hides wisdom the Divines place their treasure. Or so the Psijic Order says.
This is definitely not a smuggling operation.
Wait for Stibbo!
No water for Stibbo!
Stibbo am waiting.
I can't stop thinking about what might be in that old letter. Let's find that ring already.
We've lightened their burden a bit, but it might not be enough. Look for other focal crystals.
Naxhosa pretends to treat us well. But he takes more than his share.
I think it's time we started thinking bigger!
I still don't know what, if anything, I want to do about Lord Silvelle. Perhaps Count Auzin had his reasons. Lord Silvelle's motives seem more selfish. The gall of misleading me all those years!
Abominable strength with no equal!
None will be spared from her hunger!
Why is it everyone around me who isn't a shambling corpse is a complete wretch? I am surrounded by incompetence!
Remember, it's important to stab between the ribs of the sacrifice. You don't want the knife to stick on the bones.
Why is it everyone around me who isn't a shambling corpse is a complete wretch? I am surrounded by incompetence!
Thieves! Spies! Rise, my pets! Rise!
The twin rams come of age.
We have kept the twins safe, as the emperor commanded.
Is this necessary? It feels like we've been running forever.
Travel, excitement, new faces! It feels like the whole world is before us. I like it!
I always try to be kind to people and give them reason to believe in the goodness of others. Set the example I'd like to see others follow.
Please stop that!
Your flesh shall burn away!
The armies of Xalvakka are endless!
You pose no threat to what awaits.
You won't be forgotten.
I need a healer!
You dare mock me with your confidence! I'll reduce your soul to cinders.
Get out of there! You'll be killed!
