Problem? What can I do?
You need something?
That's the way!
It is too late to stop us! Chaos shall rule over all!
Care for another opinion?
Do people eat you? Getting to be that big, they probably can't, huh?
You dare invade the domain of Mehrunes Dagon?
Can your insignificance be more apparent?
Do you see that mountain of flame before you? It's about to consume you.
Cherish this victory, mortal. While you can.
Damn it! Why can't I remember?
Death's eye pierces your hearts!
Hate them! I hate them!
You will not interfere with our work!
You won't get passed me.
Die for Dagon!
Stand. Still.
Choke on this!
Coming here was a mistake.
Do not fear pain.
Show me your spine and face the interloper.
If you want to die so badly, I'll happily help you.
Stay back.
You think you can beat me? Here?
Lovely armor, such a shame it'll be a charred heap when I'm done with you.
You will bleed.
At least put up a good fight.
I'll make you scream like the sacrifice you are.
Don't waste your strength, succumb to us.
I see you, you wont get passed me.
You're not worth Dagon's attention.
Feel your doom calling yet?
Coming here? Your mind must be as dull as the weapons you carry.
You call that an attack? Ha!
Deadlands take your entrails you interminable cur!
What? You think your heroics are going to be enough to best me?
Avoid tragedy! Avoid fate! Avoid an upset stomach from that strange berry you ate!\n\nLet this one tell your fortune. A few coins is a small price for defending against disaster.
Books are whetstones that sharpen the mind and allow it to keep its edge.
Have you found something?
Greed, stupidity, and violence. How many innocent victims suffered at this bandit's hands?
I can't abide a bully. You're better than that.
Stop that. You're hopeless!
They're going to catch you and take your hand off at the wrist.
I love the smell of rain and growing things.
Look out!
You're paralyzed! Don't think. Move!
Shake it off! You can do it!
Careful now! We're down an ally!
Prepare to die, villain!
Nothing creates allies faster than a common danger.
It'll be good to get away from the family a bit.
Uh, you lead!
In a big family, you have to know how to scrap.
I'm going to be ill. I can't even look at you.
Lost in thought, or just lost?
Aaaargh!
Hope we find something interesting today.
There's an old saying about those who forget history. I don't remember it, but it's really good.
Who taught you to ride? A book?
I can see why mom has been so reluctant to settle in at home. There's too much to this world to spend our time on it in one place.
Vehk save us now!
I could use a healer!
Cutting it close!
Something you need, partner?
If it's not going to get us paid, I don't care.
I love maps and old books. I can lose myself in a library or booksellers for days on end! I'm also a bit of an oenophile. It means I like wine. A lot.
This should help!
Yeah! Keep knocking them around!
Never met a Goblin that didn't deserve that. Not one.
It's only stealing if you get caught, right?
The Morag Tong are bad enough, but at least they don't kill for fun!
Dig in! Don't let them separate us!
Keep your guard up until you've got your footing!
The enemy is this way!
No! They were just starting to like me.
We're doing this? All right, I guess we're doing this!
It's a route!
Guest. I must admit, I have rarely been on this side of that word. How does one behave as a guest? Please, you will let me know if I do anything wrong, won't you?
I wonder if there's anything to drink around here. I find doing nothing builds up a powerful thirst, and I am simply parched!
When I travel with Lady Laurent, we tend to set up camp in the most inhospitable places. So, having a roof over my head during this retreat is rather unusual. And refreshing!

Maybe I should disguise my voice when I'm the Lady Twilight? I think it might add another layer of mystery and hide my identity. Oh, or I could even be Lord Twilight!\n\nHmm, that doesn't have quite the same ring.

Seeks once smuggled me onto a pirate ship in an orange barrel. Unfortunately, they loaded me on the bottom of the stack. Could have been worse. I didn't get scurvy and the citrus scent was pleasant enough—for the first few days.
Enough of this! The master wants this realm and he will have it!
[Goblin nervously attacking the player like please don't hurt me]
Behold the power of Mehrunes Dagon!
Haha hee hee hahahaha hoo hoo ho ho hahaha!
You see that, uncle? I said did you see that? Well, there's no need to shout.
To be honest, I'm glad the Empire fell. Abandoning the pretense of interrogation has made my work so much more fulfilling.
I am the rending of this world made manifest. Beg for my Lord's mercy!
They were lucky to die so quickly. Come, Martus, we have catching up to do.
I was born to topple nations, not crush insects.
Just have your brains tell your stomach not to fear!
Fate has brought you to this place, only to die.
Her clan will never stop hunting her. We may be on the run for the rest of our lives, but at least we will be together.
Roll to the side!
I see you still have some hope left. I'll crush it into the wine of despair.
Claw over yourselves for an escape.
Focus on Cyronin! I won't let this thing near you.
I've made a defensible position!
Don't worry, I'll try to save a couple for you two to play with.
Off you go!
Taste my heel!
No escape!
Charge!
Watch your step!
Help me even the odds!
I'll save you this time. Don't you forget it.
Scatter like the roaches you are!
Bask in these glorious rays!
You're surrounded, surrounded.
We must train more bearers before the bastion is breached again. I will not humor this a second time.
You're back? That was quick. At least, quicker than I expected.\n\nHow did it go? Was your mission successful?
I'm looking for adventurers who don't panic easily—not even in small, dark spaces.\n\nDoes that happen to describe you?
I've gotten word about your assignment from others, but I want to hear it from you, is it done?
Complete a job for the Saraathu Tong and you might just earn some coin and make some allies. Oh, and the Saraathu Tong will know that you're trustworthy, that's invaluable.
Crunch!
Expect no mercy. No quarter. This battle you've chosen ends with your shattered bodies tossed from my battlements.
Die with honor.
Show your back and die!
I can pierce your very soul.
Run! Run and pray!
Defend the bastion with your lives!
Those artifacts would be the end of you, if we weren't going to end you right now.
He's vulnerable again, thanks to me.
What hope did you have against the conquerors of Oblivion?
Courage brings victory.
<Idle humming.>
Wariness is a good sign in an investor. I promise I hold no love for money. It's the calculations that drive me. \n\nMake them worth my time.
Make this financial transaction with as little outward speech as possible. Your mortal tongue offends my ears.
Do not be concerned by my … expired state. It's not as much of a drawback here as it would be back in the mortal world.\n\nNow, how can I help you today?
Too cold? I suppose they don't call it the Shivering Isles for nothing.
Here, goat. Here, goat. Got some nice tasty garbage for you.
Did you prefer that form? I never bothered to ask.
Where's the fun in summoning if you know what you're going to get?
Stand still, would you? I'm trying to make toad stools out of you!
Now, don't ask what this one's made of. They're very self-conscious.
Whew, that one was ripe! Can smell you from here!
Come, earth and fire! Obey!
It is often said that children should be seen and not heard. Yet it seems to M'aiq that children are neither seen nor heard in too many places.
I wonder if there's anything to drink around here. I find doing nothing builds up a powerful thirst, and I am simply parched!
When I travel with Lady Laurent, we tend to set up camp in the most inhospitable places. So, having a roof over my head during this retreat is rather unusual. And refreshing!
Ah, another of M'aiq's devoted followers! Remind this one to give you an "I like M'aiq" button the next time we meet. I have an abundance of them.

Only the proudest champions of the Blackfeather Court rise to knighthood. What I need is a quest. Yes! A grand adventure! What should I seek? An ogre's eye? A Hagraven's mole-hair? No, no, those won't do.\n\nWait! I have it! A pewter spoon! Yes!
I wonder if there's anything to drink around here. I find doing nothing builds up a powerful thirst, and I am simply parched!
When I travel with Lady Laurent, we tend to set up camp in the most inhospitable places. So, having a roof over my head during this retreat is rather unusual. And refreshing!

I have to commend the Fighters Guild. Attacking Molag Bal's Dark Anchors takes guts. My lessons on fighting Daedra involved a lot more than a sturdy weapon and grit, but somehow that seems to work for them.

Seeks once smuggled me onto a pirate ship in an orange barrel. Unfortunately, they loaded me on the bottom of the stack. Could have been worse. I didn't get scurvy and the citrus scent was pleasant enough—for the first few days.
I'll keep watch for any more of his surprises.
The Cellar was thirsty for a little fresh blood.
Your problem is you always think too small. You can't even imagine what the Prince of Ambition has planned.
No need to imagine when it ends here.

I demand food, featherless! Carrion for feasting! Decaying flesh to savor and enjoy! \n\nOur proud Knight of Marrow once told me, "Eat the entrails first. They dry the fastest." I bet you don't even eat entrails! Feh! More for me!

Sometimes I marvel at the creativity of hedge-mages and lay practitioners. I only ever learned how to shatter stone and melt steel, not sear a steak or wash my hair. There are so many subtle uses for magic beyond blowing up fortifications.
Are they fighting out there? Maybe the Spire is finally mounting a rescue.
Consider this preparation against the Waking Flame.
Once you know the Undertaker's strengths and weaknesses you'll know how best to make use of it.
Just imagine it's a very intense training dummy!
Let's see how much the Waking Flame enjoys fire.
The Undertaker rarely had to deal with Daedric souls in the past, but I promise its powers make no distinction.
The Grim Warden is at your service.
Take some pride in your work, or haven't you done any?
Take'em to the stockades to contemplate their work ethic.
Qukikh, I said we were expected at Shyillakh's to torture mortals! Do you see any mortals to torture here?
I'm not one to harp, but are you lost?
You'd think I'd have all the time in the world down here to keep my ledgers in shape, but no. \n\nDeposit or withdrawal?
You hit like a cub!
Maybe parting with your precious coins will teach your time-shrunken brain to think.
Your kind knows no honor!
You're doing that wrong.
Ha! That mortal just stole from you!
Oh, the machinations of a criminal genius.
Watch it! Bloodstains are tenacious.
I wonder what the guards will do to you.
Slip on your own guts, mortal!
This one's mad! Sound the alarm!
You'd better not let me see what you're doing.
I don't have time to deal with whatever foolishness this is.
I've caught you! Leave or I will have you removed!
I prefer talking to Scamps over wanted mortals.
That's as far as you go, mortal. Pay up or be flayed alive.
You cannot escape!
That's enough of that, mortal.
Thieving? Bold, but foolish.
It's a criminal! Boil them alive!
It's only murder if they don't deserve it.
You know the guards will kill you eventually.
Guard! This mortal's making a mess!
That's enough! Guard!
Don't you have work to do?
You aren't supposed to be here.
Seems someone has a death wish.
Settle things with the guards. Then we can talk.
You like wearing skin? Repay the debt of your actions. Then you can keep the skin.
Oblivion calls!
Why must mortals act so oddly around us?
Stealing worthless baubles. How petty.
You force my hand to call the guards, mortal.
Bring more here to witness this death!
Look over your shoulder. They hunt you now.
Simple violence. Embarrassing.
Put this one in chains!
Your skills fail you. Cease this.
I see our security has failed once again.
Your banishment shall please me!
I cannot endanger what I have built.
Just the scum I was looking for. Pay your bounty then scramble back to the shadows with the rest of the Scamps.
Yes! Fight me, mortal!
What's this? Someone in need of correction?
Petty theft by a petty being.
That showed guts. Pity the guards will pull them out.
More blood in the streets. Praise Dagon!
Your fate is sealed, criminal. Accept it!
Sloppy. So sloppy!
You'll pay for that!
Skulking about? Mephala guide you.
Move along, you scamp.
Yes, stay. See what happens.
Impressive work. But sloppy. Off you go.
Ah, this is the one I seek. Will it pay its fine, or will it choose death? I await its answer.
Oh, you marvelous fool! How do you think this ends?
I do not understand. Are you trying to provoke me, mortal?
Run, mortal, run! The game is on!
You gamble your life against such low stakes? Curious.
Murder. Ahh. Someone's feeling lucky!
There is nowhere to hide, miscreant!
Consequences ensue, mortal.
Sins require penance, mortal.
What is the point of your mischief there?
An anomaly? It does not belong here.
By Dagon's four arms! You vex me. Now go!
Off you go, mortal. I have a reputation, you see.
Very not sorry to interrupt your little crime spree. Let's settle the bounty.
Oh, you're a fun one, eh? Let's do this!
If you seek to get arrested, keep doing what you're doing.
You're the worst thief I've witnessed. You deserve your fate.
Your little blunders bore me. Oh, guards? Let's have fun.
Now you've done it, murderer! Help!
I can't believe you just did that! Someone help!
Help! Violent mortal here!
Guard! This one needs a beating!
What are you—? No, no. I mustn't get distracted.
Stick around, and you'll find trouble.
You're not worth my time. The guards can handle you.
Don't waste my time. Go pay up first.
Your actions have consequences, mortal. There is a cost to such things.
A very unwise decision. Intriguing.
Oh, I am quite curious about what you think you're doing.
The guards will do more than slap you upon the hand, mortal.
Is your life not short enough? Why put a target on yourself?
The guards will be quite displeased with you.
My, you're a bold one, aren't you?
Innocent blood, my favorite.
You'll pay, mortal. Guard! Guard!
A mortal sneaking around, how curious.
This is no place for your kind.
Get out before I throw you out!
Later, mortal. When there are less hounds on your trail.
Why couldn't you leave your lawless ways outside the city for once?
I will not be duped by the likes of you!
How are you going to get away with that?
My superiors won't let me steal that brazenly.
Try that with me and see how far you get.
Save your bloodlust for better venues!
Your kind's inferiority is on display and the law keepers will hear of it.
I hope you're killed for that!
Wrangle this unlawful cur!
Breaking the laws are we? This should be fun.
I used to delight in trespassing. Now, it's just foolish.
Having fun? Leave.
I won't talk to a known lawbreaker.
Come, fools! Challenge me if you dare!
I've heard of these kind of phenomena before. They're worse than I imagined.
Not again ….
It is often said that children should be seen and not heard. Yet it seems to M'aiq that children are neither seen nor heard in too many places.
So be it.
Don't you miss Nirn? The food here is terrible.
Did you hear something? Never mind. Probably just a daedrat.
Your world is mine, mortals.
These rivers of sand hide many secrets. I can tell you what I have learned, if you have coin to spare.
I rest in the mud of knowledge. Come and wallow, beeko.

That is enough.\n\nSo, do you know why there are no mirrors in Fargrave? The Xivilai are compelled to defeat their reflections in combat. I have seen them sneer at their own faces when inspecting a blade. There is a madness in them that has no cure.

Remember, no one rules Fargrave.\n\nWhen a Scamp declared itself King of Fargrave, the Grasp determined there was nothing preventing it in the Stricture. So, they built a small throne room and bricked him inside. As far as I know, he is still there.
Do you wish to sell your goods? Proceed when ready.\n\nPlease note that all exchange rates conform to observed market trends and are not negotiable.
Searching for AIOS signal. Signal not found. Transitioning to standard banking array.\n\nGreetings. I am prepared to allocate storage space for any goods or gold you provide.
Come, let us wreak havoc on the weak and the unworthy. My talents grow stale in this place!
These accommodations are comfortable enough … for mortals. I can think of several refinements that would better serve a discerning Daedra such as myself. Would you like a list?
Hmm, you look far too worldly to help me. If you by chance happen to know a mortal who wouldn't mind gambling their life away to a Dremora, do let me know!\n\nPurely for research, you understand.
I can't wait to start my work as an assistant. I know that probably sounds strange, but assistants are the real backbone of the Psijic Order! They get to be a fleshfly on the Ritemaster's wall!
What do you wish of me, mortal? What favor do you beg of the mighty Arox?\n\nI can be generous, when the mood strikes me.
Hezehk needs minions to command. Underlings to oppress. Something smaller and weaker that can wait on my every whim! Is that so much to ask?
Hmm, you look far too worldly to help me. If you by chance happen to know a mortal who wouldn't mind gambling their life away to a Dremora, do let me know!\n\nPurely for research, you understand.
All will pay their debts in blood.
The paths of the Deadlands thirst for blood!
Your corpses will fetch a high price!
Ha! Your death approaches!
When I'm done with you, Jakarn's next.
You're going to die in Jakarn's place. How utterly tragic.
Did you come to correct that courier's mistake? You fools. He, at least, wasn't aware of the trap he walked into.
I require a minion of my own, master. Perhaps a Banekin or a Scamp? There is enough room. Barely.
Don't get too comfortable out there. Remember, a well-rounded fighter beats a one-trick echatere every time.
Perhaps batting you around a bit will loosen Jakarn's tongue.
<Baa! Baaa! Baaah!>
You've got the look of someone who's just seen a battle. Although I get that a lot from our hired adventurers, to be honest.

You look strong and brave. Or at least capable. And resourceful! Did I mention that?\n\nCan I interest you in a job that involves much danger and requires a small group to complete? The pay is good, I assure you!
Back again? Well, if you have the time, I have the gold! I happen to have a task that needs taking care of, and I'm sure you can deal with it by yourself.\n\nWant to hear what I have available?
Ember has seen much in her young life, not all of it good. Yet she retains an enthusiasm for learning. It's rather admirable for one of her circumstances.
Should we toss a few more thralls to the wolves while we wait?
I don't want to kill you. I can't shackle and whip you if you're dead.
You really thought you had me on the run, didn't you? Adorable.
I feel bad adding that win to our record.
I rule over everything on this island. Even you.
That was the best the Duforts could muster? Gonfalon Bay will be easy pickings.
It's a little too early to fly your flag here, chum-fodder.
Now there's a proper brawl!
You're just a distraction. Try to be an entertaining one.
That's the flag you'll be buried in.
Hope you like the taste of brine and defeat.
You wish to ride the maelstrom? I'll abide!
Za'ji can see your form needs work from here. Keep on your toes. Your toes!
If you put this much effort into your work, you wouldn't have to fear me.
Stick together, you fools! This is a team effort.
Don't raise your hand to me, whelps!
Working your way up the Tribute rankings, I see. It seems we have a shared ambition.\n\nHave a seat. Let's play.
Ho there! I've got new decks fresh out of the packaging. Let's break them in, shall we?
<Mrooo?>
Ah, the clitter-clatter of unwanted things. Music to my ears!\n\nYou just hand over your junk. I'll make you a fair offer in useful goods!
Five years hard labor for every Dreadsail you've killed. If the adders don't make a meal of you first.
For the Dreadsail's pride!
Come on, dreugh chum. Fight!
I left my ship for this? Feh.
…any…
They're a bore, brother. I don't think we're even going to get a warmup out of this.
Is that all you've got?
Your skills are weak.
Is that an Undaunted banner? I think I've heard of them, brother. This might be an interesting bout after all.
I'm pretty sure that's not how we're supposed to do this.
Let the games begin!
Za'ji just needs a better vantage!
Stay dead this time!
Watch me, Turli. This is how it's done!
You pass. Barely.
Think you're the best Tribute player around? Shuffle those cards and prove it.
In cards, as in swordplay, there can be only one victor. Come. Let us put each other to the test!
Come, cerum! Have a seat. I just acquired a new deck and I'm dying to try it out!
I was about to head out, but I suppose I've got time for one more humiliating defeat.
Got something to prove? So do I. Shuffle those cards, sera. Let's play.
Ignore the rumors, walker. This one never cheats at Tribute. The truly clever never need to!
I see you have a Tribute deck. This warms my scales. Shall we play?
Want to play Tribute, eh? I tell you, I haven't had this much fun since I wrestled that mammoth outside Riften!
So, what's your status these days, eh? Single? Hitched? Little of both? You know what, forget I asked. No offense, but the last thing I need is another well-armed, battle-tested ex!
You are powerless before us.
My hounds will sear your flesh!
Let my hounds' icy teeth numb the pain.
Bury them in molten iron!
Your turn, atronach. Liven up the show. Well, the opposite of that.
You can't handle that power.
Letting the cold in will only see you freeze.
Another victory for the reigning champions!
In unison!
Let's team up a while.
Time for the finale!
That's teamwork.
You're primed to explode.
You're ready to learn what piercing cold really means.
The reefs are alive and they heed my call.
The veins of this island are coursing with power now!
Fit them for slave collars, mates! I want this lot wiping my arse by the end of the battle.
Keep their heads in one piece! I want them dangling from the bow of my ship when I go sink the Lofte Empyrean.
Oh, you're close now. Ha ha! I can't wait for you to see how futile all this was.

Don't mind me. I'm sort of between jobs at the moment.\n\nOn an unrelated note, have you heard about any gold caravans rolling through the area? Or jeweler's exhibits? Maybe a rare coin show? That sort of thing? No? Fair enough.
In that ruinous cage ….
'Neath the decks, ironclad ….
'Til you've all had your fill.
Let's not stand on ceremony, friend. Shuffle your cards and deal.
Seems we've both made a name for ourselves in the Roister's Club. Let's find out who's name soars higher.
King Emeric himself couldn't beat this deck, and I hear he's actually pretty good! Have a seat! Let's play a round.
Tribute player, eh? Me too. Let's see how our decks stack up.
You ready to see a master at work? Take a seat and deal those cards.
Tales of Tribute isn't a matter of life and death—but to win, you have to play like it is. Have a seat and I'll show you.
Hail. If you seek an opponent, you will not find better. Sit there, and we can begin.
The eyes of our ancestors, the Divines, and the Roister's Club are all upon us. Come. Let us give them a match to remember!
My last opponent … well, they hardly measured up. Let's see if you can do any better!
So … are you here to buy me a drink, or to lose a game of Tribute? I'm happy to indulge you either way.
Hmm. Sure, I've got time for one more match. Wasn't hungry anyway.
You're really good at this game, aren't you? Well, uh … so am I! One of the best, actually! In fact, you should probably just concede now!
I'm in no mood for small talk. Just sit down and deal, all right?
Looking for a challenge? Well, you've found one. Deal the cards, sera.
Tribute is not so serious. Win or lose, this one is always smiling. Remember, it is only a game, yes?
Two great Tribute players, here, whisker-to-whisker. What are the odds? Ha!\n\nWell? Let's play!
A game of cards is fertile ground for friendship. Have a seat. Let's play.
Father Sithis tells us that victory and defeat are not so different. Even so, I mean to win.
There's a Tribute player! I'm right, aren't I? Ha! Yeah, I am! Have a seat!
You mean to use those Tribute cards or just look at them? Come on, let's have a match!
We're the toughest gang on Amenos!
An ornaug almost bit my arm off when I tried to feed it the other day…
Don't draw attention to us! Keep some distance!
These crystals have to work. The Hadolids can't stay here.
<Fierce yelling.>
I want more! Who else can we smack around?
Did we really just do that?
Ooh, a tough one!
Is … Is it over?
Phew! Thanks for keeping me alive!
Fish biscuits! A little help here?
Shake it off, come on!
Don't give in!
Get up, get up, I need you!
They won't try that again! You're too fast!
If that doesn't scare them, nothing will!
Here's the Ember special!
Come on, let's do this together!
Lots of good opportunities for pickpocketing here. Just saying.
You always take me to such nice places.
And up we go.

When I was a kid, I'd get up early in the morning and sit in the middle of Skywatch to watch the whole place wake up. I loved watching everyone go about their routines, smelling all the smells, seeing the sun rise. It was like a play, just for me.
Hey, a bag! Go on, peek inside!
Places like this make me remember how small I am … y'know, in the grand scale of things.
This sorcerer is sorcering better than ever before! Sorcering, that's a word, right?
Chests like that can be misleading. Either full of jewels or full of rotten fish.
One time, I reached into a sack like that and found a bunch of live frogs. That was a strange day.
Keep that close to you. A pickpocket will make a killing off of something like that!
Watch out, everyone. This adventurer isn't slowing down anytime soon!
You're just like Magister Irin, always wanting to stop and talk. Are you going to lecture me on the properties of magicka?
Am I in trouble? Sorry, I just always assume.
Need some magic done?
Pickpocketing is somewhat of a passion of mine. It warms my heart to relieve oblivious people of their possessions.
Oh good, I was so bored!
I need to go before I do something I'll regret.
That's right! Don't get any dog slobber on you!
That's what you get, werewolf!
Thanks for bringing me along, I love seeing what the Thieves Guild is up to.
You're spoiling me with these things.
Glad we helped the locals out, things should be better for them now.
Pfft, bunch of sticks in the mud.
Ha, someone's going to be missing that.
Another pocket picked!
I love watching you do that. Makes them look dumb.
Hope you got something good and not just … a book of spells. Eugh.
Looks like it's your lucky day!
Not so safe anymore, is it?
Can we stay here for a while? I love the atmosphere.
A chance to sneak around? You're spoiling me.
You going to enchant something with that? Can I watch?
Watching you play is better than actually playing myself. You've got interesting strategies.
Is it wrong that I'm fantasizing about how much coin you're going to get from all that?
You going to treat your favorite Khajiit to a drink with all that coin?
Oh, great. That's just embarrassing.
Maybe if fish didn't stink so bad, I'd find this more enjoyable.
When I lived with Magister Irin, he tried to lock me out of all the fun places in Tor Draioch's tower. I like that I have a bit more freedom here.
We've got this!
Think of all the lives we've saved.
That was just a normal day for you, wasn't it? Always exciting!
Fight now, stories later. Haha.
Your prowess was befitting a knight. Well done.
Thanks for the heal!
I'm wounded! Stendarr save me!
Guard up, get moving!
Steady on, shake it off!
Draigh! Get back on your feet!
You've got them staggered!
That's sure to leave an impression!
This could turn the tide!
Let's do this together!
If you see a pawn shop, give a shout. I want to get a gift for Aurelia.
Thanks for bringing me along. Think of the stories we can tell!
Back in the saddle.

I am reading this incredible book right now! I know, I'm a lass of noble birth who likes to read. How original. Remember, I grew up as a squire and kitchen urchin. So my idea of an exotic adventure was a particularly spicy romance tale.
Might be something useful in that sack over there.
What do you think about all of this? Incredible.
I've learned so much riding with you, my friend.
Another find for your pack.
You've got a keen eye for wealth, my friend.
Hmm, anything good?
What's the story behind this, I wonder?
You're always striving to learn something new. One of my favorite things about riding with you.
I pray to Stendarr that you'll change your ways. What is it?
What would you ask of me?
New tales to tell, eh? What needs doing?
I've always had a bit of a sweet tooth. \n\nI grew up eating the saltwater taffies of High Isle, and to this day it's a guilty pleasure I allow myself from time to time.
Ahh, good to see your face again.
I have pressing matters to attend to elsewhere.
Tell your dark master who sent you!
Magnificent! I could sense when the battle swung in our favor!
I wonder what Bolgrul's favorite delve is? We should ask him one day.
Nothing like helping keep the home isle safe. Stendarr bless you.
Draigh, I will never get tired of fights like that.
I want to ask Glirion to go drinking someday. I bet he'd have some fascinating tales to tell.
Are you going to keep that, or sell it, I wonder.
I'm not drooling over your delicious food. That would be unknightly.
Wise to keep your gear in good repair. Very wise.
As a knight in your service, your actions reflect on my honor.
Stendarr, please try to forgive them their transgressions.
Their blood may feed your thirst, my friend. But it also stains your soul.
So much wealth. But everyone here is so poor in spirit.
I can smell the blood on their hands. We should go.
I know you'll do better next time. We all make mistakes.

All right, this is my final list. No more deliberation. Candied Walnuts, one. Sweetrolls, two. Hmm. Banana Bread, three. Saltwater Taffy from back home, four. And … oh. Moonsugar Candies, five. That's it. Done.
Seems the Divines favor you.
Just as I planned.
Just my luck ….
It's about time that paid off!
It's always the same ….
You nervous yet?
It could not be avoided.
Perfect!
How did you—? Ugh
Ah, there we are. Splendid.
Should have seen that one coming.
Ha! Something's finally going my way!
I suppose you think that was clever.
You're going to love this.
How could this one miss that?
Baan Dar provides!
I play like a dry frog today ….
This will serve, I think ….
I need another drink ….
How do you like this?
I feel so weak. Thank you for getting me out of that horrible thing.
Rigurt can drink! Once put away seven casks of mead in one sitting! Rigurt couldn't remember the rest of the evening, and head hurt for four days, but totally worth it!
The secret to good diplomacy? Talk loud, interrupt constantly, bang fists a lot, and never forget to hand out cultural presents. \n\nAmbassadors love cultural presents. Especially Rigurt's!
Nature is a most patient teacher, but some of Y'ffre's lessons can be very hard.
People must learn to feed themselves. Even in a city, one can tend a garden or go catch fish. These acts remind us of Y'ffre's bounty.

So glad I got the invite for this place. I needed a change of scenery. Less distractions here … and fewer debt collectors.\n\nOn a related note, if anyone comes around waving receipts and old ledgers, you haven't seen me.

I heard the Roisters Club is always hard at work on new decks of cards! The bookmakers are taking bets on what the next theme will be. I put ten gold on Vvardvarks.\n\nLong odds, I know. But the longer the odds, the greater the payout!

How's everyone's favorite Tales of Tribute champion doing? You've got that golden glow about you. \n\nMy glow? Still purple and mottled green, thanks for asking. I'm not complaining, though. Better to be bruised and free than bruised and indentured!
Defend us. Help. Help!
I saw a bear tear into one of those corpses.
Archdruid Devyric should have let us make them bury the others.
You won't make it past me.
You won't last long in this fight.
Please, we have to stop them!
Root rot. Burn it out. Out, out!
You can't stop me from taking the seed. But, you're welcome to try.
Bones for the dirt and blood for the roots.
The seed is where it should be, in the Firesong's care!
Y'ffre bless this kill.
Y'ffre bless your passing!
Did you hear them call out to Y'ffre to save them? Ha!
The grass will welcome your sacrifice.
Ugh, that last Stonelore wrenched my shoulder out of place.
Archdruid Devyric said you had to die.
Root out all the Stonelore. Leave none behind!
We can't let this corrupted spirit do more damage.
Our grove. We defend. We keep from insects like you!
Feed us. Your voice. Your blood.
Your challenge is an insult. I'll crush you with one paw!
You won't keep me from my goal!
You have my thanks for freeing me. And soon I'll have your blood.
I'll quench my thirst with your blood!
Down, down you came to meet me. Wait no longer.
No match for simple cubes.
Go to ground. To ground!
To us. Fauns. To us!
Today's challenges are ready, walker! And the prizes—! The prizes … they are not ready. But they will be! Kishka's word is her bond.\n\nNow, where did they go?
Defeating commoners in Tribute is good, but defeating adventurers is even better, yes?\n\nTake this challenge! Marunji is right—you will see!
Wriggle like worms, little morsels!
Behind the stone pillar. Quickly!
Please, keep amusing me.
Tremble before my mountainous power!
I need no large beast to end you.
The pack never hunts alone.
I'll bury you in stone!
Surrender beneath my paws!
You should not be standing!
You won't survive this form!
I'll crush you with my hands, not paws.
It can wait much longer than you can.
Such a pitiful attempt.
Does that hurt? I no longer remember pain.
Take no prisoners! No prisoners! Squawk!
Some stains can never be washed away.
My wife's at home. Just let me see her.
I'll take his heart!
It never ends. Over and over and over again.
How could you? This is your fault!
Could be worse. Could be back on Betnikh.
Got my hands on a new Tribute deck. Want to play me later?
A bit chilly in here, isn't it?
Let this one and her sword dance for you.
I'm behind enough as it is. I just want to get back to work.
This establishment should have a dress code.
Blasted ornaug snatched my bait!
You'll come back. They always do.
Did Najhivad make a fool of himself again?
Don't lay your egg there! You know it's just going to roll downhill ….
I'm tired of Darroll running his mouth about the druids. Why would they ever take him?
Perfect spot to sit and think.
Ah, back at last! I was starting to get nervous for you.
I appreciate you taking this on. Not much of a fighter, myself. This brawn is best for whittling wood and tending gardens.
There's no shortage of work on this island. We always seem to have some new plight. Are you here to help?

Zeht's tears, it's been some time since I've had a moment to stop and take in my surroundings. Too often these days, I've got my nose buried in a book. Ha, never thought I'd say that about myself. My old crew would laugh themselves silly.

If I'd had magic during my days at sea, things would have been a lot different. When I was young, I solved most problems with blades and blood. Didn't know another way. \n\nNow magic gives me new options—and it can be just as violent, thankfully.
When Clan Mother Tadali speaks, you would be wise to listen. She is much older and more experienced than you.
What does Tadali need with thumbs? She has others to fumble and grasp at tools when she bids them to.

How much more of this ghost nonsense must I put up with? If this prank is your doing, I insist you cease at once! I have a ship to prepare for war, and this distraction is no longer amusing. If not you, point me at the cur and I'll deal with them!
Don't just stand there like a landlubber! Raise the sails and batten down the hatches! We've got a war to win, sailor!
Now there's my favorite sellsword. How did Galen treat you? Not too harshly, I hope?
I wish more visitors had your zest for adventure. Our tours would be already in full swing! Unfortunately, I don't have any contracts for you now. Come by tomorrow for more work!
There's still so much to get done before we can invite guests! Any chance you're looking for a job?
I had that nightmare again … I've got to find a way to keep my mind busy.
Y'ffre, avert your gaze from my thoughts and actions.
I'm half tempted to mix a sleeping powder into this.
This place … could there be two roads to the True Way?
Stonelore and outsiders everywhere. I just want one moment of quiet and peace.
I did it!
Careful. Don't slip on the rocks.
I barely hear the falls anymore.
I need something to keep the phoenix moths away.
No monsters left to kill today, my friend. You might instead kill some time at the Jaded Ornaug just around the corner.
Scourge! Fight me!
After everything, now you're afraid?
Death by my hand was your fate.
Time brought me wisdom and strength.
Your flag means nothing to me!
Come on then, Scourge!
I'll take my time with you!
Your scourge is over!
Your strength is ours. Your will is ours. You are ours! Ours!
Lackwits. Know your place!
This beast posed no trouble for me. What makes you different?
I am grateful for the calm seas and clear skies. My claws no longer tremble at the thought of fire and storms.\n\nI am a sturdy tree standing strong in the sea breeze and warm light of the sun.
It'll soon be the anniversary of my starting work here. With everything going on, I nearly forgot.\n\nI wonder if Varisse would be interested in drinks. Perhaps I'll ask her. Perhaps.
I don't know how Varisse does it. Always on top of her work and always so cheery.\n\nWe could all learn a little something from her, it seems. Or, maybe just me.
I once had a hireling who took the job on top of her full-time commitment to the local theater. \n\nShe had to quit when they couldn't tolerate her wooden delivery.
Humidity getting to you too, dear? I swear, I haven't felt fully dry since I arrived here. But I suppose you can get used to anything in time. \n\nHow can I help you?
That rug's crooked, isn't it? Oh well. I suppose there's bigger things to worry about at the moment. \n\nCome in and rest awhile, will you?
If rumors were worth their sum in gold, I'd have enough to retire early. But as they're worth nothing, I'll just keep them to myself.
Some people accuse me of stealing, but the only stealing I participate in are these prices! Get it? Because they're so low? You going to buy something or what?
I could hear that coin purse walking up the hillside. How about we doing something about that?
Why get all dirty fighting for scraps on this island when you can just come here and buy everything you need!
Down you go!
This one's mine!
Pray that this frog digests me!
Submit to the Firesong!
Ugh, I touched something clammy. I hate caverns so much.\n\nPlease look for information on the relic. I want to get out of here.
Do business or move along to another line. I have no time to haggle.
Veloth guide my hand!
I am the inferno!
First you, then all who oppose the Ivy Throne!
I know the old fool lives. But if you're his protector, he won't live for long.
The old fool has his Watcher, but look at the majesty I command!
Thy pen be stilled. Thy hands scribe no more.
The Lady of Whispers favors me yet again.
Mock me? I'll end the record of your life.
I'll defeat you under the Golden Eye's watch.
You dare mock me with your confidence! I'll reduce your soul to cinders.
The staff is mine by right. I am the Magnastylus.

I haven't been able to properly commune since Octin left. There was just something about his smile … it's ruined my concentration. I must speak to Marwig. He's the only thing that's been able to help me forget Octin.
Do not tell anyone, but we are planning a huge mission. The most essential ingredient? Kumquats from the Gold Coast. Shh. Tell no one.
Pacrooti is shocked that you are still his friend. He would have said it is far easier for a mammoth to pass through the eye of a needle, if it is slightly greased.
This one is impressed!
This one is impressed!
Pacrooti can see you are out of crates. You can always purchase more, if you like.
There are many wonderful rewards that a crate could contain. In the gem store, you can see this magnificent selection and even buy rewards with the gems you collect.
Uncover your rewards to collect them. Some rewards are better than others, and some are so valuable they make Pacrooti's claws tingle!
The cards will bring what the cards will bring. Let us see what Pacrooti has dealt ….
Sleek! So many gems!
Shh, listen, you can hear it buzzing around, can't you?
The leftover shell bits of a mudcrab make for a great broth. Also ensures you're using every part of the crab in your cooking.
Take note of the intricate carvings all along the stone facades. Beautiful, aren't they?
My father always said a sword is only as good as your grip on its handle. My old man's advice is always bumbling about in my head.
Can you imagine if I had two maces? One in each hand? I'd be unstoppable.
You seek to improve yourself? Good. Let's try a new approach ….
The things you people find valuable. Hmph. \n\nHere, give me what you've got. I'm sure I'll find a buyer back at the crossroads.
When the earth shakes, the water laps at my legs like a needy pup.
I'm not sure if we can ever trust the Firesong again.
Trying again isn't my problem. It's knowing when to quit.

I think my father sometimes worried that I'd be reckless enough to someday take to the sea and never come back. I'd never shirk my duty to House Mornard like that, but even if I'd been tempted, there was far too much on Galen to explore first.

I find myself wondering how things might have been different had I been raised on the mainland. How I might have been different. I feel the weight of the world on Galen and yet I'm constantly reminded how small the archipelago is in comparison.
Nothing's too big or too powerful for me to challenge. I may not always win, but they always know they were in a fight.
Never interrupt a Khajiit's naptime. It could be bad for both our healths.
My sword is a relic, a true warrior's blade. And like all true blades, it bears a name. It is called Daesul Brohad—he who consumes my brother's soul.
The last time I stopped for supplies, the merchant I spoke to was quite brusque. I don't see why. I even gave her several tips to get vampire blood out of her rugs. Such rudeness.
Don't touch the arrows.
<<Wheezing, heavy breaths.>>
This stack might contain something important.
I don't want to rush you, but Keshargo is waiting for us.
I'm everywhere!
A fragment has broken off!
Ragh!
Insolent cur!
Come in! Come in! Tell me all about how you slew those light-fingered vermin.
To arms! We're under attack. Save the keys. Save the chests!
I command the realms of knowledge!
My power fills these tomes.
Knowledge, give me reserves.
I've held the horrors at bay. You are nothing.
The rifts move faster than you.
I'll fill books with your blood.
Lamikhai? No. You'll pay for this.
Your little rebellion will burn.
You think running will save you?
One spark is all it takes to change the future.
Every initiate knows to dodge fire.
Magic brings nothing but suffering and lies.
Come back here, Vanton. Twelvane knows you believe her.
Vanton will fall for Vaermina's glory. I control this realm—you cannot win!
Nothing will ever stop me.
Come on out Vanton. We have much to discuss.
This was always going to happen. You had no hope of defeating me here.
Challenge or no, you were never leaving here alive.
The malpracticers have to die.
You're too weak to stop the Mages Guild.
You clearly don't know who you're challenging here.
You won't save Vanton. He's already falling.
Challenge me? You barely made it here alive.
I thought for certain I would not see you again. I'm pleased to see I was wrong. That doesn't happen often. What news?
Do you hesitate? There will be no renegotiating, I am afraid. I'd advise getting back to the job at hand.
I don't hire any common adventurer to work for the Tribunal Temple. Do you think you have the sort of spirit which can serve the Three?
B'vek! You've managed to keep yourself in one piece so far. I must say I'm impressed. \n\nYou may want to rest and heal up for when I have more work available for you.
*Remorseful Gibberish*
*Remorseful Gibberish*
Let's see if this works.
Good to see you! You return with good news, I hope?
This task isn't mysteriously going to take care of itself. You should get a move on.
We're looking for able-bodied fighters who are unafraid to get their hands dirty. We can make it worth your while.
I'm afraid I don't have any tasks for you now. Check with me later, though.
An intruder?
I can get you some room to breathe.
Get away from the fires!
I wonder …. Woah!
Hermaeus Mora forgive me.
Feel the currents of fate flow through you!
Leramil's gift protects us both!
<Hoarfrost rests easily, prepared to return with your trade to the Fourth Sinus of Takubar.>
<The Atronach makes ready, set to spirit away your possessions to the blazing vaults of Infernace.>
My work to develop the Fateweaver Key was actually inspired by conversations I had with Martina. I'm curious what she will think of my advancements.
I find it hard to sleep when it's too quiet. Sometimes I'll sneak out into the night and start a brawl in a nearby tavern or merchant camp just so I can get some shut eye.
Always keep a sharp knife handy. It can make the difference between life and death. You ever try to crack a clam open with a dull blade? Torture on the high seas.

Howler makes this cute chirp when you come around. Like a little clicking of his teeth. He's either happy to see you or the sight of you makes him very hungry. Maybe keep your fingers in your pockets, just to be safe.

J'baanluk once had a glass of wine in Summerset. It was so tart it made this one's whiskers curl. The Elf who provided it got a good laugh at J'baanluk's expense, but a quick snarl between sips made her ears quiver.
Yes, J'baanluk is very tall. Pahmar-raht is the word you are looking for, adventurer. The strongest of furstock are the Pahmar-rahts. You would do well to remember that.
Peryite welcomes anyone, all faiths and credos. He really is the best of the Daedric Princes—despite what those thick-headed followers of Boethiah always say.

And now for a reading from my work in progress, Tenets of Holy Diseases. Ahem. \n\n"The first rule a follower of Peryite must know is that there are no rules! Well, there are a few, but nobody follows them, so the point is moot."
A nightmare you can't wake from.
You don't care about Vanton. Leave him.
This isn't me, is it?
You're wrong. I know who I am and this isn't me.
I love it when mortals fight back. It makes destroying them more fun.
This should tangle you up.
This isn't right … is it?
There he is.
You have some power, but not enough.
It begins. Can't you see it?
It's a simple illumination sequence and you still failed?
Stumped by a riddle? Stupid and weak!
Go to sleep. Shoo!
I hope you feel every second of this.
You're staying here. Forever!
I'm sure I put it down right here.
I've been looking for these spells for longer than you've lived in that book. Give it back.
Your presence here changes nothing.
Ooh! A new victim.
Make Twelvane proud.
Where do you think you're going?
This isn't your dream.
Ansuul will rip your world to shreds.
Killing you will be enjoyable.
For Yaseyla!
You don't matter here.
Surround them!
You're never going to defeat us.
You're not warriors, not really.
You won't drop anything else once I'm done with you!
Help me!
He's so cute, I really want to befriend him.
Someone kill these things!
The wall pushes back.
Why are we trapped here?
Are we dead? I think we're dead.
Let's see what you're made of.
And stay down.
That was great. When's the next one?
You won't live to regret this.
Who's better than us? Nobody.
Still standing!
Can't hold on much longer.
Roll out of there!
Focus!
If you don't get up, I'm taking your stuff!
Good! Now make 'em bleed!
That's right. Make them pay!
Let's see how you handle this!
Watch your pockets.
I'd rather explore the nastiest delve than the nicest city. Let's go.
Ready to ride.
I hate salvaging good books. Never want to get rid of them, but they're a pain to lug around. I like finding bad books, then recommending them to people. Always makes me laugh.
Treasure? Must be our lucky day.
I could see us resting here. Just for a moment, though.
Always room for improvement.
Building up a stash? Good thinking.
Someone left this here? It's yours now.
Heh. Ours now.
Plenty you can do with that.
Look at you.
Hm?
Need something?
What's your worry?

I don't mind if you pick a few pockets here and there. Just make sure it's from someone who deserves it. Not someone who's just trying to get by, or who works hard like you and me. \n\nOh, and don't get caught.
I'm not always the most productive when I tag along with you, but it seems like time well spent.
Look, if I'm quiet, don't take it the wrong way. I went a long time without having someone around to share my thoughts with.
Ready to move out.
Let's go our separate ways.
Ugh. Sets my teeth on edge.
Haunt someone else, why don't you?
Ordinators couldn't take care of it, huh? Shame. We did just fine.
The Huntmaster considers you a clanfriend? I guess I shouldn't be surprised, I'm just … what is this feeling? Jealousy? Am I jealous?
Always worth stocking up.
Sated and ready to take on the world, huh?
Now that's the type of catch worth bragging about.
Hmph. What a waste.
Walked right into that.
I don't like this.

Life's a grind, then you die. Bad things come for you whether you want them to or not.\n\nSo you have to fight your hardest to survive and seek out the good in the world. What little of it there may be.
Onward and upward!
I like your tireless zeal. Hah!
I think this one wants a ruckus!
A most gratifying resolution.
My next wound could be fatal!
Get free, posthaste!
Dither no longer!
Our research isn't over yet. Get up!
A meritorious move!
You make a formidable ally!
Tentaculus Eruptum!
Let's see what we can learn here.
If we must.
I'm reminded, for some damnable reason, of my parents today. It might be hyperbole to say they regretted having me. But it might not. Luckily they have my older brother to carry on the family name.
You see that? Could be useful.
An opportunity for erudition! Hah!
Another chance at perfection.
More funding for our research!
Hmm, well? What did you get?
A premium asset!
Your accomplishments just compound, one upon the other.
Are we done here?
Collaborator. Confrere. Companion?
An opportunity for cogitation? Let's get into it.

Though the Antiquarian Circle itself bores me to tears, seeking out antiquities is thoroughly compelling! Scrying, procuring leads for rare and difficult to find treasures. It engages both my mind and my constitution!
Early days yet in this collaboration. But I have high hopes, cohort!
An ongoing project. Further study is required, but I'm enjoying the process.
Let the research begin!
What's that? Ah, yes, I hear you. Excuse me, my research needs me.
Yes! Chop off their claws!
Memorable. Confrontational? Thought-provoking.
Is there a tea shop here? Can you imagine the exotic herbal blends we could procure here?
Thought-provoking.

Cooking a good meal is a way I can exert some control over my environment, calm the mind. Each recipe is a little agenda, you see? \n\nYou set out your ingredients, plan your time, and delicious food is summoned from the incantation. Most reassuring.
Excellent! But we can always do better.
It's pleasant when the environmental and geographic elements of a locus are so … neat.
It's him! It's really him. Truly him. Really ….
Knowledge is power, and you are unlearned!
That'll leave someone reeling. Nice work.
Let me give you some advice. If at first you don't succeed, then teleportation magic isn't for you.
Mistake. Forgot the book!
Let me fix that complexion for you!

I have a potted Arkay's Lash back in the Manor of Masques. Beautiful little plant. As delicate as it is thorny. I suppose that's how I like to present myself. Alluring, but ready to strike should an audience member become too confident.

It's rumored that a former Moth Priest is a member of the House of Reveries. I imagine they'd make an amazing fortune teller, wouldn't you agree? What would their masked name be? \n\nI suppose Moth would be too on the nose. Perhaps Bright-Light?
I miss the days when rich Breton galleons were free for the taking. But I'll honor King Fahara'jad's alliance even if it makes me a beggar.
I suppose I understand High Elves and Wood Elves sticking together. But if you ask me, the alliance between Elsweyr and Summerset makes for a strange marriage.
Hermaeus Mora finds mortals fascinating. You are the only thing in existence that can surprise him. Sometimes.
Another day, another meaningless drop of mediocrity in the ocean of infinite despair.
First you, then all who oppose the Ivy Throne!
I usually throw back the small ones. Always wonder if they're thankful that today's not their day.
You can't stop me. Not really.
I will drown you in ink.
We strike fear with our strength!
I reflect creatures more fractured than me.
I pour my knowledge into ink.
Can you dodge me now?
I have no need of this anymore.
Learn to fear your actions.
Return to me, creature of ink.
Did you not like my creature of Craglorn?
Next time I'll pull from another book.
Did you think this was over?
My other selves continue our search.
The strings of fate sever before me.
You can never stop me. I am the library.
I know your limits.
Fighting you makes me stronger.
Barrier protocol activated.
Support assembly initiated.
Of course, sinking buildings. Why not?
How does she keep doing this?
Temperature manipulation too?
I need your help. More pages are missing. Scattered to who knows where in the Infinite Archive. You have to help me recover them!

This is an archive filled with things to fight. I'm sure it's much more entertaining out there than it is in here. So please … go have fun somewhere else. And don't disturb anything in my space here. It's just how I want it.
Come back soon, all right? \n\nMy next project is stymied until I get more of those pages.
I haven't stopped thinking of your return since you left. Do you have the pages? Please tell me you do.
The Planemeld obverse—it begins!
None shall be spared.
The light has seared you clean.
Your lives are hers, as they have always been.
Hide! For all the good it will do!
All is ruin! All is sorrow! Die!
There's good eating tonight!
Blasted goats.
My eternal duty lies in killing those who seek me.
Right. Let's put this nymic to work.
Please come closer. Tho'at's sure to be upset when I use the nymic.
Tho'at Replicanum, I call to you. Obey!
There will be no graves for you. Only ashes!
The filers are excited about another path. They say it probably doesn't have maligraphies. Might be worth exploring.
Step into my domain!
Got Verses. Got potions. Got nourishment. Could exchange. Possibly.
Feel how the mammoth's cold heart still seeks to gore.
These serpents will swallow your soul.
I will boil the marrow in your bones.
A wamasu kills simply by existing.
I have no tears left for you.
Die with honor.
What hope did you have against the conquerors of Oblivion?
You're skilled. I'm honored to fight with you.
I hate all fools, but witless fools are the worst.
Once I was a scholar … and so much more. Now? Now I am simply an effigy of joy and wonder.

Mizzik remembers his first mystery well. This one's mother told young Mizzik a thief broke in and stole the spots off his precious pet dragon frog!\n\nPoor little Jazbay was never the same after that. It is a mystery that eludes Mizzik to this day.

Mizzik works hard to keep up his dapper appearance. It is important to remain approachable to any potential clients. Even if it is a nightmare keeping this one's velvet doublet free of stray bits of fur.
People think working as a bodyguard is a lot more exciting than it really is. Lot of standing around while people talk.\n\nLike this, really. I should be getting paid for this.
I'm not inclined to magic and I can count the number of mages I trust on one hand. You'd think I'd feel different, growing up in High Rock and all. But that's exactly the reason I feel this way.
I'm not the type to keep in touch, but it's good to see you again. You still finding trouble out there? What am I saying. Of course you are.
I took care of one.
You're a bookish monster without a spine.

Oh good. A filer just came back with a message from the translator here in the archive. My summoning spell for the copies of Tho'at Replicanum was correctly deciphered. \n\nDo you want to hunt down another? Same arrangement as last time.
When you return, think on this fight. You'll do better.
A challenger approaches? I hope you're prepared.
I recognize this one. And if I were here for academic purposes, that'd be a good thing.
If only my pupils were as talented as you, maybe then they would have pressured me for my title. I can see you getting it one of these days. You could usurp me as the greatest duelist in Valenwood.

What was that thing you did at the end there? That was brilliant. I haven't witnessed timing and fortitude such as yours in ages. That was incredible. An amazing duel. \n\nI only wish we had an audience to marvel at our skill.
I knew the fight would be difficult, but I was not expecting that.
There's so much still to research. Why couldn't Hermaeus Mora be the Prince of Naps?
There are more to fight, but I'll leave that in your capable hands.
Orcs talk up Malacath's vengeance, but if this is what it is, I'm not scared.
You're hesitating. Is it because you're scared?
Can't handle the forge's heat? How do you think you're going to fare fighting in it?
Looks like that oath wasn't good for anything after all.
I should tell Aradros the Orc's dead.
The Oathsworn were supposed to be inspiring. I'm disappointed.
You think you can beat us?
Hello, sorry about killing you.
You made a mistake coming here.
You're definitely not surviving this now.
No one stops the Recollection!
Such confidence. I hope you can back that up with skill.
We beat Khurga, we'll beat you.
Take your time, I'm in no rush to beat you.
Ha! You died! Next time, try not to do that.
Do not fear the blood, embrace it to pass!
I am in no hurry, but do you really need all this time?
I didn't think you needed me to specify that death was another way to lose.
Conquer the most points to ensure victory.
I'm looking forward to this. Don't keep me waiting.
Focus on your own health. You cannot lead from the grave.
To the larger army goes the victory. Good luck.
Some hero you are. Now we're stuck like this.
My friend says you're going too slow.
Put me back together, I need to find my friend.
Ah, if only my old cohort were back from Cyrodiil. But at least you have returned. Were you able to accomplish the task I assigned to you?
If you encounter any problems as you go about this task, remember that the Legion may not be available to assist you. We're spread so thin across the region as it is.\n\nThat's why we hired you.

West Weald has needs that the local Imperial Legion cohorts aren't quite equipped to deal with at the moment. I am authorized to pay very well for any services rendered. Would you be interested in such work?
My day is done and so is yours, adventurer. Get some rest and we can find you more work on the morrow. Skingrad and the Legion can certainly use the help.
Oh good, you're back. I need a break from filing reports. Please tell me I have one less disaster to worry about.

Return with news of success and I'll sing your praises to the Legion! Well, at the very least, my report will be filed correctly and my superiors will get multiple copies. \n\nBureaucracy is its own form of glory.
Unlike my comrades, I don't care whether you're a trained warrior or a mercenary. If you know how to swing a sword and have allies you can count on, I'll gladly accept your assistance.
Your dedication is admirable, adventurer, but I must focus on bureaucratic matters for now. Never fear. I'm sure I'll have work for you again soon.
Bye for now, thanks for your help.
Trust me, you'll need my powers.
Oh good, the tomeshells are gone. Take your reward.
Hunting tomeshells was a simple task, but still too difficult for mortals.
Those tomeshells aren't going to hunt themselves.
Stop running away!
I will get you.
You just killed the love of my life.
I'll enjoy butchering you.
Mutton's no sweetroll, but it still tastes good.
My fires forge pain.
There is no stability here.
I will crush you.
Is safety assured? No enemies left upright? Excellent.
You're still alive! Mortals who don't die are quite hard to come by.
I expected … well I can't tell you what I expected. But you exceed it.
It's strange, usually I don't experience your mortal emotions. But now I'm happy this place is quiet again.
The fires of the forge keep on giving.
Which tome was affected?
I want to see what you make of this battlefield.
Wait! Let me get a good vantage point.
Don't mind me, I'm just noting the issues here.
I studied mortal combats. It seems enjoyable.
This beats just reading about great battles.
Be careful of that book. It looks suspicious.
Malkhest said you'd be done in here soon.
Death is my domain. I won't be bested at it.
Is this your best?
You're no challenge!
Crush the newcomers!
An enemy of the Blind Path!
I'll wait to be impressed by this gift until you fight it.
Don't hold off on my account. Every moment you spend here only gives the Blind more time.
Don't be disappointed, master.
Is it over? I hoped for a much longer fight.
You fell before me. Just like I thought you would.
Finally, something fun to fight!
You want to fight? Let's fight!
It is time. We fight!
You think you can fight us?
I think that banner upsets the Atronach. Good.
You awakened something new in that creature. I hope you can handle it.
Try not to die!
Take notes, Tutor!
You should be more concerned with fighting me than you are with impressing our host.
I will claim the Echonir.
No ward can stop me!
Have a taste of my fire.
Testing sequence on standby.
Testing protocol initiated.
Integrity compromised. Ceasing all functions.
It was foolish to come back here.
You think you can defeat us?
Oh look, we have a hero on our hands.
I was hoping for a fight.
No one survives us.
Leave no survivors.
Leave me the last kill.
You won't get away.
You see this area and you know there's something interesting here. Not like the spot Filer Tezurs claimed.\n\nPlus, I have more variety of stock. See for yourself.
One of the local merchants sends a dog to bring in her deposits. Those transactions are my favorite.
I am called progressive by my contemporaries. Those who have known me since I was a hatchling and remember my fixation on the ancient Saxhleel must think this some grand joke.

I expected more of my Black Fins to leave after I announced my governorship of Gideon. I worried many would not wish to abandon the glory of war. But they stayed with me.\n\nI could not have chosen better companions.

I never had a family. A birth family, I mean. Raised in an orphanage. But meeting little Hilde changed that. She became the sister I always wanted.\n\nThen we joined the Brotherhood and gained a new family. We even bicker like real blood relatives!
Always enjoyed fighting. That's why I originally became a soldier. But soldiering turns out to be more about standing around and waiting than fighting. So I moved on to a different profession.

Before I met my big brother Kor and we became part of our family, my birth parents forced me to drink the blood of were-beasts. It tasted awful, but it made me what I am today. Don't worry. I will let you know if I feel a change coming on.
Maybe it is the wolf in me, but I prefer the great outdoors. So many colors to take in and smells to explore.
Take no heed of me. I'm delighted to act as your humble nymic courier.
Master Malkhest must have this nymic fragment. It's a matter of some urgency, he says.
Where is the nymic fragment? Oh, there it is. Master Malkhest says you do good work.
Where is that fragment? Aha! Don't worry, I have it. See? All safe with me.
Jolly good and well done. These enemies were hardly a challenge for you.
This is the perfect spot to create the next portal. It has the best temporal elasticity.
This wing doesn't look too out of sorts, but I'll have to do a full inventory to be sure.
I heard you fought well. Your rewards are here if you want them.
Construct, stop playing with them.
That's enough!
This tree is about to be kindling.
Fire isn't enough to stop me.
The axe! Look out!
My blood outnumbers yours. We continue!
The battlefield is mine, the trial continues.
The trial isn't over yet, I have the largest army. Fight on!
Aha! Too slow!
Go and conquer!
Your blood is my blood!
We can stop training when the Green reclaims our mouldering corpses. Let's begin.
<If a construct could regard you with fondness, this one does.>
(Goblin GIbberish 04)
We're safe, but you aren't.
Choke on fire!
Speed this up. The fights are far more entertaining.
It teleports!
Split your focus. There's not that many.
I will reclaim what you took!
I'm not going to fight you. I'm here to watch and enjoy!
Let the combat commence!
I hope you remembered all of that.
Out of my way!
I have you now.
Not dead yet? See if you can dodge this!
The Atronach is sharp. Don't get cut!
I could listen to this thing's shrieks all day!
By the Ashpit! There are so many!
Pitiable creatures. How is it you aspire to be more than food?
Master, I don't think they know about the light.
You wreak of poison, go wash off.
Well, this is definitely memorable.
I know where every item is in our vaults. I keep it all in my mind and can send a runner at once to fetch it. What I don't know is not worth knowing.
Let that which has been forgotten be remembered.
Destroy the intruders!
We cannot be stopped!
Plants in the lake. Protect!
Spill blood for the lake!
Try not to hurt them too badly!
I'm happy to be here, but the diet takes some adjustment. Not all these people are strict followers of the Green Pact, but many inherited the traditional cuisine.
Are you paying attention?
Weapons are much better than fists!
The Oathsworn burned and so will you.
You always want to leave the bodies to rot. Let's eat them this time!
Nothing stands in my way. Not this barrier and not you.
Take your time. I'm just considering where to mount you.
We agreed that I was going to choose what happened to these ones.
Your death means less than my victory!
Take your time. I'm just considering where to mount you.
No one survives us!
Mortals always fight battles they can't win.
Psh. I'll show you the error of your overconfidence.
None will be spared from her hunger!
Defend the citadel!
Stop the mortals!
Care to join us?
You'll stay here forever!
Let's see how you fight.
You should have stayed outside.
I bet you think you can fight.
You won't get the best of me!

The only thing waiting this way is a long drop and an impeccable view. Not sure which one is more dangerous. \n\nYou could test it and see which one kills you faster, but then you wouldn't stop the Blind.
It is quiet and calming here. These outcroppings are useful places since all warriors need space to connect to themselves.
I'm happy to be here, but the diet takes some adjustment. Not all these people are strict followers of the Green Pact, but many inherited the traditional cuisine.
Let's make this quick. I'm in a bidding war with Madam Whim over an iridescent swamp jelly. Adorable.
<Something behind you catches Eri's eye, but he isn't distracted long. He's a professional.>
I'm working up an appetite.
Which camp is this one from?
These Goblins are so stupid.
Anyone want to help me here?
Mortals must learn to kneel.
This realm belongs to Mirrormoor now!
Yes, I'm with the Morag Tong. But let's not spread that around. I hate bloodying my axes without a proper writ in place. Plus, I was just beginning to enjoy the ambiance of this place.
I could be here to complete a writ, but let's assume I'm not. And let's assume the writ doesn't have your name on it. \n\nYeah, let's go with that for now.
Stay away from me, monster!
Do not let it hit you!
Do not lose hope.
I am destined to hold the knot!
You do not know what I am capable of.
Die alone or together. Your choice!
I want to see this from all angles!
Stop trying.
Bring down the barrier!
Not now! We are exposed here.
This room is familiar!
Bring the knot back to camp.
Mercy! I'm too young to die.
Soon I'll have everything I'm owed and you'll be dead.
Change the mirrors!
This one thinks you can trick that creature.
You're challenging them? Do you think that will make them kill you faster?
Stop fighting. You can't win!
Erase all evidence of their existence!
I don't believe this.
I can see you trying to rally against them.
I'll ensure your defeat!
Given what just happened, I thought I should offer some discounts on my goods. \n\nDon't believe me? You should have seen what I was charging before.
I didn't want to be here! I thought it would be a good opportunity for me, but it isn't at all. I nearly died!\n\nSorry. I need to calm down. Get what you need and give me some space. Please.
Oh really? The wisps tell me you are mighty and powerful, and don't need their advice to attain your goals. Excellent!
My accommodations here are somewhat less … prestigious than I'm used to. But it's worth it, to ensure you're adequately supplied in the pursuit of Scribing.
Unseen goddess guide my hand, and let the winds be a crutch to my soul.\n\nWell met, traveler.
Turn the mirrors!
(Goblin GIbberish 04)
Let that which has been forgotten be remembered.
Let that which has been forgotten be remembered.
I thought you were better than this.

I should probably mention that sometimes I walk around in my sleep. It's really important that you don't try to wake me up, especially if my tattoos are glowing. If you do, well. You know what? It's been ages. Probably nothing to worry about.
Let's go, let's go, let's go!
I've still got room to grow.
You're going to regret this.
Woo! I was just getting started.
I love it when you do that!
Look at us go!
Stay light on your feet.
Don't let them get to you!
Let's show'em what we're made of.
Give me a moment, I think I pulled something.
I think I'm going down.
I'm lucky to have you around!
What do you say, up for another?
Did it work? I closed my eyes.
Nice! Follow it up!
What are the chances this is a cozy delve?
There's so much to see out here.
Love the wind in my hair.
I see treasure. Act casual.
Let's not linger. Too many familiar faces.
Find anything good?
The best stuff is free stuff.
I'll take that if you don't want it.
Inspiring.
Stay with me, friend!
Enough. I am leaving.

Being parted from my body for so long did no favors for my figure. I remember being far more limber. But I should not complain. Azurah could have seen fit to return me to a shambling pile of bones instead.
Shall we find some mischief?
What is this strength? The might of Alkosh, perhaps?
I will watch over you.
May your spirit know peace.
Miir traj'zho! Such power!
Like twin moons!
Fif zhat! Move, quick!
Unshackle your mind, tamiit!
For the Hidden Moon!
Your path ends here.
Moon Mother … spare me ….
You glow with S'rendarr's light, my friend.
Fajh'na! That was intense.
By the power of the Hidden Moon!
Perfect form, my friend!
Fear not, tamiit. I am ready to explore.
What gems we stumble upon, just by exploring together.
Fif'zah!
Something useful or valuable there. Perhaps both.
Make some well-placed bets, and you may be lucky enough to double that find.
I sensed Ja'kh and suspected mischief. This is a nice surprise.
Brushed by Noctra's wings.
Hunting greatness with the determination of Hircine.
Very clever playing, tamiit. I wish I had the wits to play like you.
You are free from servitude.
A new dawn upon your soul, dark one.
Our essence is not yours to take.
Ah. Liquid treasure.
A gift of vitality. Ahzith rabah, tamiit.
Fascinating. I had not thought a clash between those decks would play out quite that way.
I feel the Mother Cat smiling upon such charity.
I had not figured you as one so overly cautious.
A good deed done, and gold to thank us for it. I can see why so many choose the adventurer's life.
May that find better use in your hands.
An unnatural place housed in a realm of torment. Please, tamiit. We should not stay long.
And I am supposed to watch as you slake your thirst so?
What can I say that would compel you to stop? Tamiit. Please do not follow this path of darkness.
You wound your soul, committing acts of this wanton nature.
These items mean nothing to you, but could mean everything to their owner.
We're making a name for ourselves.
And don't come back!
Sorry bees, but this one's ours.
Should make the next bit fun.
Are we going to drink that now? Or?
Have at thee!
Next time can I muddle the herbs?
You're getting good at this.
I swear I could hear it speaking.
I haven't found the knot. But stopping you will please Xoryn too.
This will be your last fight.
Pity. I thought you'd last longer.
You're good. But I'm better.

I once investigated a woman and her bird. She claimed to still hear her beloved creature's song weeks after her pet's tragic death.\n\nTurns out the fox who ate the bird now sang the very same tune outside her window each night. Quite eerie.

Adusa-daro's clarity of mind never fails to impress me. I try to mimic her decisiveness, but often get lost in the analysis of details.\n\nShe has trained me in some excellent taunts, though. May your fur itch and grow patchy! See?
Jone and Jode, no!
I guess knowing the tentacle guy comes in handy.
This is even more fun than I imagined!
Are you going to make me one? Ooh!
The key when shopping is never to have your heart set on just one thing. I offer so many treasures, so many secrets. \n\nI mean how can you choose just one? Take a look.
Chroniclers in the Mages Guild have a policy of neutrality. I'll happily sell to anyone, as long as the price is right.
Really coats your throat, huh?
A realm of vivified ink. The perfect place to hone our abilities! It would be easy to forget our obligations to Nirni in a place like this.
This chapter ends here, She of Vivified Ink. And what a story it was.
One wonders if such a being was fated to find us. And therefore fated to meet its end.
I hope you sharpened your blade or honed your spellcraft. Whatever it is you do to fight. Frankly, I don't care if you fight with your fists, so long as you help me.

If you lose all your threads of fate in the archive without fulfilling my wishes, I will be very inconvenienced. \n\nI have all of eternity to see those abominations punished for what they did to me. But, I am not known for my patience.

I never considered that it would be difficult for the dead to gather the means to pay others for their services! I am unhireable as a ghost!\n\nCome back later if you want to avenge me. I can't pay you now.
You have a look of … triumph. Did you avenge me?
Feel the currents of fate flow through you!
Your pounding heart betrays you!
Now you're mine!
Warmongers!
Still their traitorous hearts!
I killed innumerable soldiers. It's nice to get to fight someone for a change.
You're outclassed, Lucilla. You're always my shadow.
I hope you're readying yourself and not considering the coward's route.
No one will stop you, Lord Albus!
If this is the best you could scavenge to stop us, then the Battlespire truly has fallen.
Come on. Get back up!
Surrender or die!
Ready your blades!
Alliance sympathizers!
Enjoy your last breaths.
I found you wanting. Nothing you do will change my mind.
You won't stop us. I will ensure that.
If it is a swift demise you want, I'd be more than happy to supply.
Your disruptions end here!
I hope we're as capable as that banner makes us seem.
Keep it distracted!
I failed, yet I lied. I died, yet I walk. My fate is a warning. Heed me!
You decided. Remember that.
Go on. Perpetuate the violence you're accustomed to!
You already lost.
He was my little boy!
This is your fault. Murderer!
Let's have some fun.
You go no further.
Orpheon remembers the people who help him. And the people who stand in his way.
You don't look like Hel Netu. Good. My gryphons could use a varied diet.
No more delays. I have a war to end.
This was the best help you could muster? Pathetic.
Back to scouting, Alcunar.
Ready your blades!
You won't last long.
Such confidence. And when you're so badly outnumbered too.
For Emperor Orpheon!
We cannot be stopped.
I am unstoppable!
They weren't so tough.
Fine. Test my skills.
Not incompetent. Your parents must be so proud.
Another challenger to crush!
Breathe deeply, adventurers. This smoke is the last air you'll taste!
Try to get past!
I'm everywhere!
Death by my hand was your fate.
Admirable performance! Especially on this terrain.
Try not to stand in puddles when you're fighting.
This is one of Filer Eru's wings. But I'm sure that was evident.
Falling will only lead to more troubles. Stay on your feet, mortal.
Once more, my friend. The fray awaits!
Have you practiced fighting recently? You're good at this.
The way you dispatched the last one was incredible!
Don't let me distract you.
You won't suffer too long.
Who will be the weak link?
