I heard that the Thornroot clan made a fort for themselves in the old ruins at Briar Rock. That's a place for all the wandering clans, not just one. So I say.
Figured I'd be safer behind thick stone walls than out in the wilds. Longer I stay here, the less safe I feel.
I haven't slept in days. Wait. Yes I have. I slept all day yesterday.
What does a prince do? Everything, that's what! The kingdom would grind to a halt if I wasn't there.\n\nWhat am I doing here then? You ask too many questions.
Stay sleek and remain fragrant, my friend. This one prefers you just the way you are.

Adusa is so happy she could purr! This one cut down a pack of marauding werewolves, ended a murderous vampire, and saved a wandering merchant from a ravenous wamasu.\n\nAll in all, Adusa had a fine day!
Enough interruptions!
Let's finish this and move on!
Taste the flame!
You don't belong here!
Burn it all! Burn it all!
Come! Say hello!
The forest grows strong from your corpse.
[begrudgingly impressed grunt]
You possess all the skill of a child.
Do not run like some base coward!
Let's see what's around the next bend.
Oblivion take you!
That's it. Are you hurt?
I'm starting to think you enjoy dying.
Come no closer!
What? Now? I will not allow it!
Flawed beings coming for blood.
I will not allow you any further!
Just fuel for the fires.
Today I make crawdad tails in a saltrice infused broth. Very salty, but not very wriggly. Some soups wriggle, some do not.
Hmm. I seem to be going through ingredients more quickly than I anticipated.\n\nIs five soups a day too many soups? No, of course not! What a ridiculous question.

This creature called a songbird. What a devious creation! This winged nuisance erodes sanity with its incessant chirping. What a brilliant form of torture!\n\nLet's just make sure that one doesn't nest near here.

Several of my friends have been attending Sanguine's revels lately. I don't think they're very sincere in their worship, but they rave about the wine. Lots and lots of wine.\n\nI might give it a try. In the spirit of exploring my options, you know?

Did you know that Mehrunes Dagon wrote a book? It's called the Mysterium Xarxes. I'd like to read it someday and see if the teachings of the Waking Flame adhere to Dagon's actual words.\n\nMy guess? Not so much.

Ah, my delicious morsel. Whose downfall shall we plot today? Surely you must know some poor fool who deserves your vengeance. Tell me about them and we'll orchestrate something particularly inspiring!

I went to pay a visit to a mortal I hadn't seen in some time—a mage by the name of Hireneia. Evidently, she has been dead for some nine hundred years, which I understand you regard as a significant span of time.\n\nHow very inconsiderate of her.
You think you can best us?
You can't delay the inevitable!
How could I know that I'd need my special minotaur-killing arrows?
A step even closer to my release.
No. Ancestors help me ….
Murder is a sin, no matter how necessary or justified you think it may be. Do not forget that.
I'm a great fan of doing nothing. I just don't think we should make a habit of it.
Look out!
If only I could assist you!
You will pay for disrupting our work!
You! Will not! Remain!
You have come so far. Attack! Let me tear soul from meat.
Perhaps you find yourself in over your head?
Not even hurt.
You fall much too soon. I was working up a hunger.
The opportunity is now. Seize your fate.
Stingy customers are the best customers. Oh, but not stingy with us! You should give us more of your shinies to hold. Store them all with us!
What an honor it is to have me as your personal merchant.
I'm done for!
Always ready to help!
Fascinating. The Psijics manipulate magical forces to bypass the limitations of the physical world, creating mystical impossibilities like that portal.
How did Quistley stand it down here? It's not what I'd call luxurious.
Stibbo stay close!
Wet! No wet! No!
Stibbo stand here.
Another one down. Did you see any others?
We should make sure to barricade the entrances.
Those weapons we found can cut through anything.
Slavers in Stormhaven? Appalling. I mean, it's appalling anywhere, but this feels like it's right under the High King's nose.
If something's chasing us, I don't need to outrun it. I just need to outrun you.
Is this likely to be a long ride? We'll want to pace our mounts for the distance.
I'm not afraid of death in the slightest, but I'd like to put it off as long as possible.
Whatever is troubling you, hurting something defenseless won't fix it.
Let flames rain down and burn the land!
Xalvakka feasts on your soul!
I'll make them pay!
I'm not going to make it.
Get your guard up!
At your service!
I'm still here.
Well done!
I have a recommendation.
I've never seen something like you before. How do you eat with that mouth?
The Deadlands are no place for a mortal flea.
Bravery will get you far. But not far enough.
Don't bother running!
Just what I needed, an end to the boredom.
What have you done? Our work cannot be interrupted!
Why won't you just die?
A hero? Here?
Burn!
Don't be a coward, attack.
Don't let them come near me.
Are you brave or just stupid?
You won't live to take one more step.
You will not interfere with our lord's plan.
Get away from me.
You won't stop us.
Even if you kill me, you won't stop our plan.
You think you can stop us? Ha.
Lets see if you're worth my time.
I'll make sure you welcome death when it's granted to you.
You think you're powerful? Don't make me laugh.
You'll pay for your arrogance.
With that stance, you must worship chaos as well.
I can't wait to hear your cries of pain when I crush you.
My wrath will not end with you. You've doomed your family line by coming here.
I will slam your insignificant face through a Watcher's eye!
Nothing is quite so powerful as the temptation to look through someone else's bookshelves.
Luck. It must be luck.
Brigands prey on the weak. To me, that's the definition of evil.
What are you doing? I can't believe this is really necessary!
You may feel no shame at being a criminal, but I'd sooner die of starvation.
Greed is a demanding master. Once you give it power over you, it will never let you go.
Steady there! Deep breaths!
What happened to your companion?
Careful! I'm not sure what we're up against here.
Some threats are bigger than one hero. Or two.
Mom and dad give their best.
All right, but don't cry for mommy.
I never used to fight this much, until I met you.
<Idle humming.>
Vehk save me!
Who knew you could be so patient and careful?
Either I've gotten shorter or these stirrups have stretched out.
You know, I don't think I've ever posted a handbill of my own. Maybe adventurers are just bad at asking for help. Or maybe just me.
Hang in there! I'll—I'll do something!
Ow, that fetching smarts!
Pull back!
Signal when ready!
That broke their concentration!
These little fetchers will infest anything if you let them run wild.
If it helps, I'm scared too!
I'm sorry about your pet.
This could get dicey.
Right back to Oblivion, or wherever they came from!
Despite her constant complaining, Lady Laurent actually likes my cooking. I'm an excellent chef, if I do say so myself. I'm known for making a stupendous fish stew.
Since arriving, I haven't once been turned into vermin, frozen in ice, or possessed by evil spirits. While it's strange to admit it, I miss such occurrences!

When m'lady lost her tent as we crossed the Nabia River, I gladly lent her mine. As it would be improper to share, I curled up in the hollow of a tree. How was I to know there was already a spriggan in residence?
My partner, Seeks. He's always telling me not to bite my nails. He says long nails are useful for a thief, but I'm starting to think it just annoys him when I do that.
I don't really miss the Green. Sure, I'd love to hear the spinners weave tales about me once I make it big as Lady Twilight, but Valenwood doesn't provide many opportunities for flashy heists.
[mad laughing Goblin attacking player]
You will die like your brother, Calia!
Don't keep me waiting! I hate being kept waiting!
You can't imagine what the Waking Flame has accomplished here, with me. Maybe I'll let you live long enough to see it.
Swear fealty to Lord Dagon and he may share with you his ambitions rather than his wrath.
Do not attempt tricking me! You must drink them all.
You bear the soul of a champion. All the more delicious to feast upon.
If you listen carefully, you can still hear all their screams.
Grovel and plea! I want to feast on your tears!
Come on, you cowards! I'm even letting you make the first move!
Could use a little reinforcement.
Oh fine, your ego's the only thing I wanted to get beaten.
In league with the Daedra? You fools bargain with powers meant to be dominated!
The powers of Oblivion will soon take your life, pray it is the Divines that take your soul.
Turn and fight!
You've earned a merciful death.
I strike through Oblivion itself!
Witness me, bearers! This is the power you all may soon wield!
Time can be invested, spent, or wasted, but however you use it, you never get it back.
Dealing with Ashlanders is dangerous, but they really are a great source for my Daedra research.
Baaa! Wait, goats don't baa. They ahhhhhhhhhhhhh!
If you don't kill that fool soon I'm going to stop changing you back on principle.
I will cast you into the earth's fiery maw!
Why is it that the door leading to your goal only seems to open once you have already found what you seek? The gods like to challenge us, yes?
Since arriving, I haven't once been turned into vermin, frozen in ice, or possessed by evil spirits. While it's strange to admit it, I miss such occurrences!

When m'lady lost her tent as we crossed the Nabia River, I gladly lent her mine. As it would be improper to share, I curled up in the hollow of a tree. How was I to know there was already a spriggan in residence?

Good to see you again, friend! Where was it we last met? Grahtwood? Shadowfen? No matter. M'aiq may be called the Liar, but these words are true. M'aiq loves you.\n\nNo not like that. Like a sibling, yes?

I demand food, featherless! Carrion for feasting! Decaying flesh to savor and enjoy! \n\nOur proud Knight of Marrow once told me, "Eat the entrails first. They dry the fastest." I bet you don't even eat entrails! Feh! More for me!
Since arriving, I haven't once been turned into vermin, frozen in ice, or possessed by evil spirits. While it's strange to admit it, I miss such occurrences!

When m'lady lost her tent as we crossed the Nabia River, I gladly lent her mine. As it would be improper to share, I curled up in the hollow of a tree. How was I to know there was already a spriggan in residence?

You're wondering why I don't just join the Mages Guild. It's because they're too neutral. I can't stand on the sidelines while the whole of Tamriel falls apart. Now is not the time to write theories and chase fame. Not for a mage worthy of the title.
I don't really miss the Green. Sure, I'd love to hear the spinners weave tales about me once I make it big as Lady Twilight, but Valenwood doesn't provide many opportunities for flashy heists.

What is that shiny thing your wobbling, fat-legged knights wear upon their heads? A helm, yes? Perhaps I just need one of those to become a knight.\n\nYes! And the larger the better! Just think of how many rat carcasses I could fit in there!

It probably seems strange to remain loyal to an Empire that no longer exists. It's strange, but the Empire didn't evaporate without a trace. We're all still here—the pieces. We're just waiting for someone to put everything back together.
Ugh, this would go a lot faster if I could just touch anything.
Clear out, shirkers, or I'll clear you out.
Really Qukikh? You opened our portal right in front of where someone else was walking? How rude!
Is the massage over? Hit me like you mean it!
Pay for the laws you've broken. Quickly. I'm tired of looking at you.
Right in front of a guard? That's bold, mortal.
Scum! Thief! You won't get away with this insubordination!
Mortal crimes? I do not have time to deal with this. Guard!
I should end you myself for sullying these streets!
Psh! We Daedra would never go on a crime spree.
Show civility. We have laws!
All mortals are criminals and there's about to be proof.
Another Daedrat … just like all the others. Pay your bounty, mortal, then get out of my sight.
If you want a flogging, by all means continue.
If the guards catch you thieving, they'll have your head.
You really think you can escape? Intriguing.
The guards frown upon murder, Nirnling.
Guard! This mortal begs for death!
I have a few others you can kill.
Whatever you're doing, make it quick.
No running for you, little creature. Pay me the bounty that you owe.
I doubt you would survive the jails here.
Just like a mortal to take what is not theirs.
Your petty actions will have consequences!
I saw what you did. And I will tell everyone.
You can't hide! Not after what you've done!
I cannot allow this here!
I will call those blasted guards.
The laws of Mundus are mere paper. Our laws are flame. Now, pay in coin or you'll pay in blood.
Continue with this and your flesh is forfeit.
Stole something? Ha! How long can you keep it?
Call the guard! I want to hear this hoodlum squeal!
No one stays dead for long, murderer!
This one defies our laws! Eviscerate them!
You've stirred up the clannfear now!
None escape my gaze, mortal.
Oh, mortal, I thank you for your misdeeds! Now you can pay … or we can play. Which shall it be?
Please, go on. Just give me a reason to flay your hide.
That does not belong to you, mortal!
You bore me. Take your petty wickedness from my sight.
Oh, now what? Killings in the street?
You dare to show yourself? You are hunted!
Now you've done it. The guards come.
Go on, mortal. Continue. I want to see how this turns out.
Halt! Your vices may have gone unnoticed elsewhere, but not here. Bounty. Now.
Ah, looking to be nicked by the best guard around?
Do better next time, skrid! I've called the guard.
Someone get this misbegotten miscreant!
I'd hoped not to need guards, but you forced my hand, slayer!
Filth! Get out of my sight before the guards drag you off.
Guards. Detain this skrid.
Whatever you're up to, stop it and stay out of my way.
Pay your bounty and be done with this, mortal.
This is not Nirn, mortal. Do not be so arrogant.
Guard! This Daedrat is stealing!
Guards! Slit their throat! I want to see blood!
Such martial prowess, delicious.
The guards will bleed you dry, Nirnling.
Do you mind? I just cleaned my boots.
How fun! What is it you're doing?
Maybe parting with your gold will teach you respect!
I'd stop that if I were you. You have an audience.
If you value your hands, you won't steal from me like that.
You disrespect your betters? Mortal, know your place!
Violence against your betters? If only it were so simple.
Can you not keep your criminal inclinations to yourself for once mortal?
That attack is ineffectual.
Ugh. You mortals must bathe in your own lawlessness.
Come, mortals. Face me!
M'aiq has been called the Liar on many occasions. But does truth depend on the mouth that speaks or the ear that hears it?
Take it.
Your destruction is inevitable.
Mortals without an appetite for knowledge do not last long in Fargrave. Come. I will share what I know. All I ask is coin and an attentive ear.
Come speak with me, pilgrim!

Each of the flying books you see in the bazaars orbit a master tome. Unless you cross the book's title out in blood, they cannot be separated. So, be wary of any merchant offering to sell you one. If you purchase it, you won't keep it for long.

Save for a few outliers, only low-caste Daedra do business with mortals.\n\nFrom what I have been told, it has less to do with looking down on mortals than it does with mortals being unable to gather enough debts and favors in a single lifetime.
My primary function— My primary function— Dreaming … Smooth stone. Ripples.\n\nApologies. My primary function is commerce. Shall we begin?
Grade-six strongbox protocol engaged.\n\nI assure you that your goods and gold will remain inaccessible to all persons while in my custody.

Do not be misled by this wretched form I currently wear. I shall let you in on a little secret. In reality, I am a mighty Daedra of enormous size and power. Truly!\n\nDo you doubt the word of Arox the Mutilator?
Hezehk needs minions to command. Underlings to oppress. Something smaller and weaker that can wait on my every whim! Is that so much to ask?
Oh, Litaalar is going to be so jealous when she reads my thesis! She's always been so smug about her research into the demiplanes of Oblivion. I'll show her!
The small, flying things that haunt the mortal realm? Birds, I think they are called. Yes.\n\nDispose of them. I do not like them.
The drink of this realm tastes strange. Why, I almost miss Nzerru's ridiculous potions! I haven't felt my organs shine since I departed Fargrave.
Oh, Litaalar is going to be so jealous when she reads my thesis! She's always been so smug about her research into the demiplanes of Oblivion. I'll show her!
Face me, mortals. Your death is my burden!
Enough cowering, children of Nirn. Face me!
Wretched pawns. You'll die in ignorance.
I have been eager to fight an opponent that doesn't reek of brine, but it seems you've been soaking in cowardice instead.
Swords, axes, bows … they're like hammers and shovels. What matters is having the right tool for the job.
Oh, are you going to hurt me, little rats? I am so scared!
We've won hundreds of battles, but this may be the first time we win a staring contest.
I control this island. Land, sea, and air. I'll control you too, soon enough.
Throw yourselves at my feet and beg for the privilege to lick my boots. Then, maybe, I'll let you keep your tongues.
Time to send the admiral my proper regards.
Put up a good fight and I might keep your heads as trophies instead of letting the gulls pick out your eyes.
…strike…
You down there. Puny one. Go on and jump off the platform. You won't do.
You're no match.
Disappointing.
Careful there!
Now the real fight begins.
Don't get up, Ly. This will just be a moment.

Don't mind me. I'm sort of between jobs at the moment.\n\nOn an unrelated note, have you heard about any gold caravans rolling through the area? Or jeweler's exhibits? Maybe a rare coin show? That sort of thing? No? Fair enough.
The alliances will fall. It's inevitable!
Splinter these constructs all you like, more will rise to replace them.
You can try hiding down with the sea leeches and lampreys, but it won't save you.
Watch your step. Be a shame if you came this far just to take a plunge.
Wake up, Dreadsails! There's bilge that needs washing off our decks!
That's right, kill 'em all! Show me how tough you are! Hahaha!

Ever think about the future? I've been toying with the idea of retirement. I mean, granted, with a body like this, I've got another ten years of snatching jewels and jumping out windows, easy. \n\nEven so, the scoundrel's life is murder on my knees!
And devours their bones a la carte!
If you stand in the open, you'll die!
Or until you can no longer swim!
This is gonna be fun!
Not so big and bad now, are you?
We can take this one! No problem!
Aw, I was just getting started!
Not sure if I can keep going!
You can get back on your feet, come on!
Good reflexes!
Amazing! Look at you go!
Here's the Ember special!
Together!
Cities can be just as fickle as people, but just as beautiful too.
I don't even want to think about the kind of creepy-crawlies that are in here.
And we're off!

Magister Irin gave me a few books to bring with me while adventuring. Said it would be good for me to continue at least some kind of study. I like sticking them in bookshelves wherever we go. Someone will read them, I'm sure.
Street urchin golden rule: never pass up an unattended pack.
I wish I could paint. This would make quite the picture.
Do I look stronger to you? What about my smell? I feel like I smell stronger!
You've got a talent for finding those.
Anything valuable in there?
You don't find something like that every day.
How do you keep getting stronger? It's amazing! Tell me the secret!
Ugh, again? What now?
You want to talk about something?
I'm always here to listen.
I hate standing around and twiddling my thumbs. Any activity that I could fall asleep during is usually one I won't enjoy.
I'm here! Lucky you!
I'm leaving before I hit you with something.
Your big teeth don't scare me!
Big, dumb, smelly, and now dead.
We do a lot of fun things together, but the Thieves Guild stuff is always my favorite.
What'd you get?
What did you get?
Think someone will arm wrestle me in here?
Doing something with magicky?
What a sale!
Look, I like adventuring with you, but I don't have the attention span for this. I was born without it.
People think it's strange that I don't talk like other Khajiit. I mean … I could try! This one, that one, you one, me one. How's that?
Stendarr, protect us from harm.
Can't wait to tell that story at the inn later!
Riding with you is never dull. Lay on!
I do believe we're good at this.
I'm hurt, bad! I need aid!
You're not alone, I'm with you!
Strike now, you've got them!
<Pleased laughter.>
This could turn the tide!
Side by side, let's work together!
Hmm. I bet I can bang the dents from my armor while we're in town.
Stendarr keep us safe, your children walk a dangerous path.
Hyah.

Did you always want to be an adventurer? I always wanted to be a knight, even when I was a little girl. I'd see them charging across the tourney grounds and I'd think to myself … someday. Heh. And now look at me. Look at us! Hah!
Hmm. There's a sack of supplies over there. What's inside?
Draigh! To think I'd see this one day ….
Our travels together have taught me so much.
Oh nice. What did you find?
Buy a lady a drink at the next inn?
That's going to come in handy.
Oh! That's quite valuable, isn't it?
Draigh! I didn't think you could get more powerful.
You do not make it easy to be your companion. What do you want?
Ready to write the next chapter of our tale?
Stendarr smiles when we're together. What can I do for you?

If you're up for it, my training as a knight has me itching to take on some tougher enemies. I've heard stories about them lurking out in the wilds, or in the depths of delves. \n\nAnd, of course, perhaps we could net some good stories as well.
Where will our adventures take us today?
A knight cannot serve someone she cannot trust.
Draigh, disgusting creatures. We'll be smelling them for hours.
Stendarr please bless my good friend here, for they are mighty and somewhat frightening.
Hahaha. That was bracing!
Do you think Maj noticed us returning to the enclave? I hope she did.
Hmm! Even my old blacksmith friend at Castle Navire would be impressed!
Is there any chance you made extra? I'm just curious.
Repair your blade to keep the Daedra away. Little rhyme I told myself as a squire.
Stendarr forgive you.
I wish you could see you as I see you. Better than this.

Next time we go back to my parents' house I'll have to show you my little shrine to Stendarr. It's so cute. My father helped me carve this little war horn out of driftwood, and my mom and I painted it silver to look just like the real thing.

Trolls take those snooty ambassadors! Yes, Rigurt should respect his foreign colleagues, but they can be so annoying! One Dark Elf called Rigurt a menace! \n\nHe did not mean it in a good way. I am almost sure.

Rigurt once saw the cutest kitten in Rimmen. It had the softest fur. \n\nBut who knew that petting a talking house cat was frowned upon in Khajiit lands? Or that the little creature had such sharp claws?
The Systres Archipelago is my home, and to those islands I shall always return. But I wish to walk in many lands before I rest. Which is why I am grateful to receive shelter here.
The Stonelore Druids know old tales about other circles that once roamed Tamriel's forests. I sometimes wonder if any of them might still be out there, doing Y'ffre's will.

Found any Tribute cards out there? I thought I found one in my boot the other day. Turns out it was just some barrister's calling card. Always a good thing to have on hand, I guess. \n\nFor, you know … legal emergencies.

I bet the Solitude Chapter of the Roisters Club wishes it could get its mitts on a player like you. Nobody likes playing there, though. Ever tried shuffling cards during a Skyrim freeze? It's no picnic in the park!
We have thorns and claws and teeth. We are defended!
Feels good to let loose after all those years of staying passive.
I liked it best when they screamed.
Surrender and we'll kill you quickly.
This isn't your fight.
Why would Archdruid Devyric do this?
Voices. Too many voices. Find seed. Many seeds.
My leader sent me to get this seed. You can't stop me.
Voices in the roots. Fading.
This is what happens to anyone who opposes us.
You're plant fertilizer.
You will die quickly.
Don't touch that! Y'ffre's light still flickers here.
We'll put you with the others.
Have you ever fought alongside one of those Stone Atronachs before?
Such fragile flesh, so easily torn. Give your red waters to me, my shape is eternal.
Don't fear. This won't take long.
Are you frightened? Come closer.
Ahahahaha!
We grow. We sprout!
Horns and hooves. Help. Help!
Hear that? You're being hunted.
Your blood will coat my snout!
The bear is too powerful, this can't end yet.
My attention wanes at your abject cowardice!
My fun has ended. Shame.
Squawk! Your mother was a sload! Sload!
Clouds gather. Darkness hangs over Galen.
We shouldn't be here!
Throw the coward overboard!
Tell my daughter I'm here.
We can't be lost! Not here!
Wonder if the druids have some remedy for this back of mine.
That's a dumber idea than when you planted nirnroot in this cavern.
I think this castle's haunted.
Has anyone seen Veroine's mace?
What was I doing here again?
I hardly have the stomach to watch the desperate squander what little coin they have.
Come on, let's reel in something I can fry up for dinner ….
My mother used to say I was as ugly as I was lucky.
I'm not going to go looking. I was just curious.
Everybody's gotta eat!
Wonder if I could go for a swim.
I wonder if Amenos takes voluntary surrenders.

Many currents flow through life, and we abandon some in order to sail others. If you spend your time wondering what might have been, you'll always drag your anchor behind you. There's no moving forward like that.

I have to be mindful when I tell stories. When I drink, I tend to forget my audience. Not everyone wants to hear about an old sea dog's adventures in all their bloody glory. One time, a lass at the next table fainted just as I got to the good part.
A Nord once asked Tadali why she wore such funny clothes. This one asked him the same question.
This one would not refuse a well-sweetened cake. If there was such a thing to be found here. And perhaps a bowl of milk, yes?
I love to stand on the prow as the King's Jest sails across the waves. Salt water in my face, sea wind in my hair. It's exhilarating! Fastest ship in the fleet, mark my words!

I lost friends and family to the Thrassian Plague. A lot of them. So of course I signed up for the All Flags Navy when Baron-Admiral Bendu put out the call. House Davaux has never shirked from its duties, and we're not about to start now.
There's so much dirt under my nails.
You will work. You will obey.
Should I die, my brethren shall destroy you!
Your evil ends here!
We act in the name of the Prince of Fate. So act! Face me.
Hand over the Itinerant Staff and I'll have Lamikhai kill you quickly.
The Golden Eye closes on your journey.
You're as feeble as the old fool you followed.
You won't give me the staff? Fine. I'll take it.
This one welcomes you, and wishes you good luck! Pacrooti thinks we place too high a value on the luck of the early bird. Isn't the early worm even luckier?
My compliments!
Inspiring! Remarkable!
You will need to purchase a crate from the store to continue, my friend.
There are many spectacular rewards that a crate could contain. You can view this excellent selection by previewing a crate.
Shall we get started? First you must select your crate and open it!
Bright Moons, bright gems!
I was stung as a young child and it was the nastiest pain I'd ever experienced. Even breaking my arm chasing an elk through the woods wasn't as painful.
My wife says I'm getting too old to be diving into the water and pulling out these crab cages, but I argue it's exactly what has kept me so spry.
The fruits the druids grow are so sweet and delectable I'd eat them for every meal if I could.
Being a steward is hard work, don't let anyone tell you otherwise. It isn't flashy, but a good steward can keep a knight from death's sharp blade.
My father was an axe man. It's clear that I do better with a mace. Makes sense now why we didn't always get along.
You don't seem very intimidating. Let's try to resolve that.
Don't … don't flirt with me. I'm here for commerce. What do you have to trade?

Have you tried druid-made spirits? They're quite strong. When I studied with the Stonelore Druids, I thought I'd partake in a bit of celebrating with the other boys. They warned me, but I didn't listen. I woke up naked on the beach, hugging a fern.

I've long admired Druid Laurel. Even as children, she was always the more fearless of the two of us. She wasn't shy about chastising me for my soft, noble ways, either. I developed quite a tough skin from her teasing, I like to think.
New members of my crew always ask for advice before their first battle, and I always tell them the same thing. Don't die.
Got any plum brandy around here? I could go for a bowl of the good stuff!
I feel far more at home in the wilds of our beautiful world than I do in cities. The glint of firelight on a bloodfiend's eyes is so much easier to see at a camp than in an alleyway.
Are you familiar with the town of Phaer in Auridon? Some fairly shocking reports of bloodstarved beasts in the hills there. Hmm.\n\nWell, that's tomorrow's problem, yes?
<<Gagging, about to vomit.>>
The portal is safe, I promise. You can go through.
Just in time!
I show you … power!
Pain!
Stay still. Let me put a book through your skull.
I'll burn everyone in my way.
I'd wager you can't even avoid these.
Even wamasu won't eat her tainted flesh.
Vanton fully believes in our cause. This one can see it.
Give up. This battle is not yours. This mind is not yours. It's mine. And I do not lose.
The last defenders have fallen, the Mages Guild will burn.
We will make this dream a reality, Vanton.
Foolish little fleshbags. You were never going to win.
What are you doing here? You don't belong in this dream.
Yes. Face me and die.
*Horrified Gibberish*
*Horrified Gibberish*
If only tempers could cool this fast.
I hope this works!
Keep out of its reach!
We can't dally. Keshargo needs us.
Get out of our way!
<The cold eyes of Hoarfrost lay fixed on your own, ready for your next transaction.>
<Pyroclast gazes at you impassively, prepared to whisk your belongings to safety in Oblivion.>
The Unseen are a mystery. In a Daedric realm rife with mystery and secrets. Hmm.

I'm a sailor by trade, a thief by necessity, and a pirate by reputation. I'm also quite adept at disguises. If you come back later and see a potted fern or an innocent-looking rhododendron, that's probably me.

I've been practicing my brewing skills of late. I made a wonderful honey ale while drunk off my arse in the middle of a storm near the coast of Stros M'Kai. It was amazing! Unfortunately, I have no idea what I put in it. Hence, the practicing.

This one knew a skilled Khajiit who could pick pockets with the tip of his tail. J'baanluk has tried this on occasion, but with little success. Not to steal gold, but to swipe an extra sweet at dinner.\n\nAlas, this one's tail never cooperates.
Once, a Dark Elf rogue made a weak attempt to stab J'baanluk while he slept by a fire. It was like the pinprick of a cactus. This one barely noticed, rolled over, and went back to sleep.

Have you seen the sacred scribbles? Ingenious, really. Only true believers know that the skeever is an honored creature, raised up by Peryite as a carrier of disease. If you see such a drawing, know that the Order of the Sacred Skeever is near.
Our sacred Prince Peryite is the pus in the wound, the disease that wracks your belly, and the rot that makes the flesh on your arms slough off. Oh, to be blessed with such ailments!
The worst horrors come from the mind.
This is my domain. Get out.
I didn't want this. Make her stop!
I never should have listened to you, Ansuul. This stops now.
You're an annoyance that I'll enjoy crushing.
I can sense your mind.
It hurts. She's hurting me.
Let's begin.
This one underestimated you. Never again.
This one's power builds.
Such mental prowess. Twelvane trembles in her robes.
The power belongs to Twelvane, not you.
It worked. Now make them stop attacking.
Why isn't there a spell to shield books from tomeshells yet?
I tire of your incompetence! You are as inept as a rock!
They're everywhere!
I don't want it to end like this!
Are we being punished?
Never a dull moment.
Tsh. I'd be mad if I went out like that.
Enjoy your last moments. Or don't. I don't care.
Stay ready. Never know what else might be headed our way.
Might have to go on without me.
No. Not like this.
Hit 'em twice for flinching!
Yes!
Let's see how you handle this!
Can't even hear myself think here.
This looks nice and inviting. You ready?
Hup!
I used to think companionship was having someone to outrun if something dangerous was chasing me. Never thought I'd meet someone who'd just face the danger with me.
Mm, I see something shiny.
I never noticed places like this when I was on my own.
Didn't think I had much more to learn. Guess you're proving me wrong.
Useful. Hold on to that.
Their loss. Our gain.
A whole stack? Very nice.
Huh! You get all the luck.
Didn't think you could get any stronger.
Spit it out.
What can I do?
Something on your mind?

I'll do my best to let you know if we pass by something worth looting or collecting. \n\nAlways stuns me how often people leave perfectly good resources just lying around. Especially if you can use it to craft something useful, like poison.
On the hunt.
Get rusted.
Should've crossed over instead of crossing me.
Been on the lookout for that.
Impressive. See? Work is for people who don't know how to fish.
Not even gonna put up a fight?
Let's go cast some lines instead.
I try not to think too much about who I was before my memories got ripped from me.\n\nI mean, what's more scary—the thought that I was someone completely different? Or that I was exactly the same?
Make better choices!
Clearly brutality is the only option here!
That was intellectually stimulating.
Agitation! Laceration! Wounded!
Aetherius can wait!
Tremendous!
[pleased laughter]
Tentaculus Eruptum!
A new opportunity for experiential research. Top notch!
Ow, ow, ow.

Ahh. I could go for some tea. Do you have a particular favorite? I like some of the rarer varietals, like Thrassian or Pyandonean. But the simple sweetness of Pink Profundity is a mainstay I will return to time and time again.
Might be something to aid your craft, there.
Onward and upward!
Hmm. Good find, cohort.
Libations are on you next time. Hah!
A most auspicious find.
Accumulate wealth and smile all the while.
Extraordinary! Astounding! Congratulations.
Let me return to my own research.
Ah! Yes. I'm here.
What can an arcanist do for you today?

I'm enthralled by Aurbisal conjunctions! I believe lay people call them portals. Specifically those seen in Blackwood and the Deadlands, and the bizarre juxtapositions on the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha. Lead me to them!
And now: adventure!
More, more! Kill the disgusting things.

I worked a number of jobs as a cook before my tome found me. The most memorable? Hubalajad Palace. The head chef quit the night of an enormous banquet! I took command of a ragtag crew and we served a thousand people. Still a moment I remember fondly.
Have to write a paper on that someday.
Quite the memorable locale. Delightful.
You're here … but you were there … weren't you? Am I there? Where is here?
You will not survive my magics!
Don't mix me up with any other soul gems you come across. I'd hate to end up tethered to some rusty old sword. Troll guts are not a good look on me.
Right place, wrong time. Be back.

Some of the most talented alteration scholars can turn iron into gold, but none of their magics can match the miracle of this mask. Every day I see the sunrise through these eyes is an act of creation. Every new breath is alchemy itself.

Have you ever performed in the mud of Black Marsh? Sung songs among the Hist? As a new player, I cut my teeth with an audience of Argonians.\n\nThere's no greater teacher than having to earn the chittering laughter of the lizard-folk.
Master Kasan always warned me about spending too much time ashore. A sailor belongs on the sea.
Back before the war, I spent a winter iced into port up in Skyrim. I'm still trying to warm up. I'll take sand and sun over fog and chill every time!
Ooo, ooo, spasm in my lower left tentacle! I feel a contradiction in the tides of fate coming on. \n\nNo, no. It passed. Probably just gas.
Adventurers! Do you have any idea how much work mortals like you create for me? Every time you alter someone's fate, you force me to update the records of Apocrypha.
Even if I don't get any bites, watching them dart around—I don't know. It relaxes me.
Kill me all you want, I will still be here.
Little reflections, little power.
This shape is slow, but it is strong.
What do you know of monsters?
I possess the wisdom to end you. Quickly.
You challenged me unprepared?
Hmm. Fate echoes unfavorably.
You're strong, but are you smart?
Finally, a mortal who lives up to their words.
So, you can defeat the mantikora. Interesting.
Oh yes. Focus on the Dragon.
This fight is just getting started.
I am unending. I am not defeated.
I thought you'd be more fun.
Are you trying to silence me?
Order falls before me!
I am not some bookworm to be hunted!
Fascinating. Terrifying, but fascinating.
Be careful. She's up to something.
Ink should not be sentient.
This flame will darken your soul!
Bend the soul! Rend the flesh!
A weak goat, but still good for the slaughter!
Dead. Like you should be.
This is the right place. Hold on.
Don't rush on my account. I'm still figuring out how to use this nymic.
You can't hide. I command you. Show yourself!
My Thorn Legion shall storm across all of Skyrim!
Two portals for you this time. One leads to more maligraphies, but the other has a Verse. Your choice.
Become the feast!

I found all these. I get to decide where they get filed. The other filers want everything on shelves. No! These are my treasures. If I want them filed with you, I pick that.\n\nDo you want that? Can we exchange?
Winter's beast beckons.
You may outrun the snake, but never the venom.
The powers of Oblivion will soon take your life, pray it is the Divines that take your soul.
I concede this round. I'll need a rest before we again meet in combat.
One good thing about my current state is that I am adorable.
My greatest fear is a dog mistaking me for a chew toy.
Mizzik is always happy to travel beyond Riverhold. Dragons! In his own homeland! What else must he do but flee?

Investigations are similar to hunting antiquities, Mizzik thinks. Both involve leads, insight, patience, focus, finding lost things and speculating at their uses. \n\nAnd in the most extreme cases, excavation with heavy shovels.
I was raised by my Aunt Murog. She's an ex-hearthwife, straight out of Orsinium. Just decided to call it quits one day and left to find her brother in Shornhelm. Always respected her for that.

The Fighters Guild has my respect. Not often I get to say that about an organization. You see something Daedric or undead, you kill it before it causes trouble. That's the kind of institution I can get behind.
Never been good at sneaking around, but you know that. I guess if you've got any tips ….\n\nOh, who am I kidding. Never been sneaky before in my life. Why start now?
Erased that one.
All those books and you're still a fool.
Blast these maligraphies! They keep getting unleashed on the filers and me. Will you please go deal with them and the copies of Tho'at Replicanum? I'd give anything for some peace and safety.
I am a professional duelist. There's no shame in losing to me.
Finally, an opponent!
Phew. Don't hesitate to return to the Index if you need to resupply.
Watch for your opponent's intent, don't believe everything they tell you. Follow that advice and I know you'll do better the next time we meet.

I can't believe I lost. How did you do it? Did you cheat? \n\nUgh, I should accept this loss with grace. Very well, I will reflect on the lessons you taught me and I will become all the stronger for it.
Is it over? Are we sure? Well, it's never really over with Tho'at Replicanum.
I should check on the filers. If I leave them alone for too long, they start filing my desk.
There are more Replicanum to fight. I made a portal for you.
Maybe you don't care about this Orc at all. That's why you're waiting so long.
I spent my life in combat and by Mauloch that's how I'll spend my afterlife.
Take a moment, survey the battlefield, think hard on your next movements.
This trial isn't even all that difficult. I mastered it well before I became the Pitmaster.
My friend says that this is why we can't trust the living.
I know you can herd those lights faster than that.
Put me back together or face the consequences.
I hope that never happens again.
You should be a Watcher. You can be a Watcher!
That's the last of those pests. Good riddance and well done.
Don't feel bad, mortal. I'm sure you did your best.
You're here to cull the tomeshells. Get to it.
There's nowhere to run.
You look delicious.
She made the best goat stew!
You'll pay for what you did.
Hmm. The goats usually last longer.
Flames will cleanse your presence.
The floor trembles before me.
Ah, so that is how you resolve this conflict.
That was fantastic! Truly a battle worth witnessing.
It's clear! Thank you, mortal.
And there goes the last of the excitement here. You work quickly, mortal.
Roast in the belly of the pit!
Prepare your mind for our crusade.
It's been far too long since there was some action around here!
What have they done to my beautiful filing system?
I hope you know what you're doing. This place is chaotic enough as is.
Can you justify your movements? For our records.
Marvelous. Positively martial!
Make the maligraphies pay!
Do these maligraphies know who you are?
Take them out and move on.
You won't make it far.
Tutor, have we seen this tactic before? I doubt other warriors take this long to prepare.
What do you think they're waiting for, Tutor? The Darkshard isn't going to flinch.
Don't give up. You were so close to hitting the Darkshard.
Don't take too long!
Let the battle commence!
Only fools try to stop me.
Purged in shadow!
Flames, just for you.
Don't ask about what's in those jars. Filer Eru is in charge of this section and he thought they looked jolly content here.\n\nYou can ask about my wares. I file those so I know where they should go.

Growing up, I saw the plight of my people. I raised the Black Fin Legion, fought Dark Elf slavers. Battled Akaviri invaders. Even helped form the Ebonheart Pact and served as a general in the Three Banners War. Now I seek only peace.

I heard complaints about a certain Nord diplomat and his antics as a cultural ambassador. Mostly from Nords saying he makes them look ridiculous.\n\nThese Nords have a skewed self-image. They could do far worse than be represented by Rigurt the Brash.
This place has plenty of charm and the sound echoes almost perfectly. Makes eavesdropping very simple. And you never know when that will come in handy.

People always ask me, why are you so loud, Kor? Aren't people in your line of work supposed to be stealthy and quiet?\n\nThat's the wrong way to think about it! I make other people stay silent. Forever.

Others in my family have much stronger beliefs about Sithis and Night Mother than I do. I think I am a bit jealous of that. It gives them a clearer purpose.\n\nI'll take them over Hircine any day, though.
I don't like to talk about why I ran away from my clan. It may be interesting to other people, but I find the memory quite painful.\n\nIt led me to Kor, though, which I wouldn't trade for anything.
Confound my timing! I missed it. Ah well, I'm sure you fought well.
Blast it, the axe!
My ranks fill!
Claim the farthest reaches for me!
Keep up or lose the trial!
The bloom of tactical development starts within, warrior. Let's tend to that bud.
<Tzozabrar readies itself to scuttle back to the depths of a Dwarven construct with your unwanted gear.>
(Goblin GIbberish 05)
I will protect what's left of my pack.
No one survives me.
The solution was like that, only different.
More enemies means more things to fight.
Mauloch's martyrs, you're fast!
Was that just a practice round?
Move or die!
We're not through!
I'll tear you down with the barrier!
The fight is going rather well.
Don't worry, warriors. We see your efforts!
A full army just means there are more Atronachs to kill.
Is it your intention to bore me to death?
What do you think master? This fight shows promise.
Let Mirrormoor reign again!
You'll fall before me.
Famed warriors? No one can compare to me.
The fire's heat calls you!
Yes. You're right. They are quite a bit smaller this time around.
You're surprisingly hard to kill, Keshargo. But I think I'll succeed this time.
If you're worried about harming this magnificent specimen, that should be least of your concerns.
I knew it was going to end this way.
If you're worried about harming this magnificent specimen, that should be least of your concerns.
Fight someone else.
The Blind can't appreciate the majesty of the Hall of Barons, that much is clear. But you stopped to see what's here. Curious.
Visitors mistake these areas for unfinished rooms in the hall. That's incorrect. These areas have many purposes and I think they give the hall a meditative quality.
The death of Nantharion … well, it doesn't impact my diplomatic mission in Vashabar. Yet I still regret it. All deaths impact the living to one degree or another.
I can count on one tentacle the number of customer complaints I've received. Let's keep it that way.
<You contemplate if scritches will result in better service from this very good banker.>
I see a lot of buyer's remorse in my line of work. Assassinations have that effect on people.

The Morag Tong is nothing like the Dark Brotherhood. Our practices, as morbid as they may seem, are perfectly legal and firmly established in Dark Elf traditions. We avoid most of the religious overtones and pretentious implications.
Get out of the way!
You are powerful.
You are nothing!
This is my destiny!
Your friends will get you killed!
You can't hide from the citadel!
You're not seeing correctly!
That barrier is powered by something.
Work quickly and work together!
The large mirror. We are almost there!
The knot is unstable. Go!
Go back to your little camp. Fighting these two will just give you more dead to bury.
Don't let it continue!
Use your enemy against themselves.
You're delaying the inevitable.
Show them your power!
You will die. I just need to rest.
Your plan isn't going to work.
I'll defeat you myself.
Well, that's interesting. The wisps say your future is a muddle. Undetermined. Unresolved. That's odd, since they are usually so sure of themselves.
I live by that old saying: idle gold doesn't do anyone any good.\n\nPut yours to work with some scripts or grimoires!
(Goblin GIbberish 05)
Let Mirrormoor reign again!
Let Mirrormoor reign again!

I'm not much of a reader, but I love quirky adventure novels. Have you read the one about the pirate captain who searches for her long lost love? It turns out that Nirn is hollow! It's bad but so good! I should have a copy in my pack somewhere.
Where to first?
I didn't think I could get any better.
Hey, it's your funeral.
Let's do this again some time.
That'll teach them!
Teamwork!
Let's hit'em hard. Hah!
Who got that point? Me or you?
Ow. A little help?
Just try and stop me.
Quick thinking!
Hello? Hello. Hello. Hello.
This was well worth the trek.
No time to waste.
See that? Bet there's something nice inside.
I almost miss this city. Almost.
Don't leave anything behind.
You found all that in there?
You always find the good stuff.
I'll drink to that!
I can't lose you too!
It is nice to have someone with which to share meditative silences again. Heheh, heheh, heheh. Of course, by saying this, I have broken said silence. Ahh … besha ahnz'ii, tamiit.
Moons' blessings to you.
Tamiit! We are made stronger together.
What are they thinking?
Mafala keep your shame.
[awed laughter]
Tamiiti cannot be stopped!
Noctra's luck be with us.
Invigorating display, tamiit.
The Crossing beckons once more.
By the power of the Hidden Moon!
Dur dad'na! Now, give them death!
Little more than danger ahead, I think. But when has that stopped us before?
Look around us, tamiit. I would not have you miss the beauty of this place.
Rahdiit! Hai!
What generous spirit left such treasure, I wonder?
Enjoy this good fortune, tamiit.
Wander on, little spirit. May you guide us to riches again soon.
Such luck! Let us hope it continues.
I am blessed to see such growth in you, tamiit.
May the earth grind you to dust.
See now? The dark deceived you.
Fajh'na tah! Your feast fights back.
You will make fine potions with that, I am sure.
Ah, I thought it might end that way. Well played, both of you!
Ksss. A vile practice, tamiit.
It's not as fun knowing they're immortal.
I love the smell of a freshly picked flower.
Let's take advantage of that.
To think I wanted to be a pirate.
Show off.

Even before my condition, vampirism fascinated me. The disease seemed to corrupt people spiritually as well as biologically. I felt sympathy for those transformed against their will.\n\nNow I understand that, for many, the corruption is a choice.

I definitely see Kallin's usefulness as a blood source. All the members of House Ravenwatch treat him with the utmost respect and kindness. To claim that I haven't filled my flask from him would be a lie. But, yes, it's a very odd arrangement.
Fajh'na. You cannot leave me like this!
Now's our chance to show off.
Each one is a little surprise!
I'm glad I'm here, these adepts can barely look out for themselves without someone with a little experience to guide them. Eh?\n\nNot your problem, what can I get you?
Ah, hello! Always happy to see your countenance bless these hallowed halls. What do you need?
Am I getting warmer?
Run, little rat, run!
If you fight for the alliances, you'll die for the alliances.
You meddle in affairs you can't possibly comprehend.
Breaking Cato's ward will take time. I hope you're prepared for that.
You're leaving all the work to me?
You know your task.
This is for Caecilius. You're ruining it!
First with a kill gets promoted!
For Orpheon!
Didn't I kick some rocks at you? I suppose not everyone can tell when they're unwanted.
By all means. Try to stop us.
Orpheon doesn't want the Moth Priest dead. But I could say it was an accident.
Alcunar! No! Let the little ones feast first.
Let's kill them quickly!
Fatal mistake!
Just in time!
I love this wing. The danger. The chaos!
This wing poses some dangers to your mortal flesh.
I never realized this wing was so inconvenient to bipeds such as yourself.
None of the books here are too damaged to form maligraphies?
Bask in your hard-earned glory!
Hurting maligraphies before they harm you is optimal.
You're getting rather good at this.
You're so deadly with so few appendages. That's not common.
Keep your teeth and appendages to yourself and I'll let you look at my inventory.
<<Gagging, about to vomit.>>
<<Gagging, about to vomit.>>
We learned to control Atronachs as children!
I can deal with all your tricks, Vandorallen!

Narsis Dren and the Vengeful Vampire. Narsis Dren and the Mournful Mummy. Narsis Dren and the Scary Scamp. \n\nOh, don't mind me. Just testing out titles for my next book. I haven't had any of these adventures yet, but that's just a formality.

Please, don't be intimidated by my academic prowess. Or my dashing good looks. Or my many successful adventures. Narsis Dren is nothing if not humble.\n\nIt's one of my many positive attributes. I describe them all in my autobiographies.
Yes?
Something on your mind?
Something on your mind, friend?
Have you ever looked into the eyes of an indrik? There's so much love in those little black eyes. If I ever saw anyone hurt one, I think I'd go feral. I'd start biting!
A talking mortal? How exciting! Of course, you're probably just some sort of trick. Mortals can't talk. \n\nNot like I do, anyway!
Who's a good boy? Let me tell you, I've always struggled with that one. Is it Barbas? Maybe, but you wouldn't know it the way my master treats me.

You should see the sorts of little machines my friend Hyacinth builds. Hummingbirds that can pick locks. Snakes that turn into impromptu lamps. He likes to say he hates whimsy, but come on, seriously?

This one … er … no, I am sorry. I try, but I cannot adopt this way of speaking. It is closer to a direct translation of the dialect spoken today, but Ta'agra and Cyrodiilic are closer companions now. In my time, they were mere acquaintances.
What?
You have a questioning look about you.
My ears are open to you, tamiit.

I am pleased to drive the undead from the world, wherever we may travel. Slaying vampires or destroying skeletons is but one way to liberate souls in subjugation.\n\nIf this is our mission, I will never think our time ill-spent.
Your interferences go too far!
You will never make it out of here.
This fight is stale.
Better full pockets than empty.
Good find, tamiit.
Burn under my hooves!
By the black wind, I command you!
Jerensi, toy with them!
Storm winds will cool those fires!
I'm stronger than you and I always have been.
Looks like our power is evenly matched now.
I don't know how you live with yourself if you support this war.
What you're doing is wrong. You have to see it.
Drag this fight out as long as you want, I won't even be tired after you're dead.
You think you're grown, but I still see the same child who cried as he left the Battlespire.
Sorrow's the only thing that remains.
Almost there!
Nothing hides from you!
You mortals just see things as they are. Allow me to unmake what you have to restore the perfection of your materials.
Dibella teaches us that beauty exists in all people, all things. I try to reveal that beauty in my humble wares. Come see what Dibella offers.
Don't run. Stand and fight!
Where did you learn to aim? High Rock?
I shall have to teach you a lesson.
Oooh! Maybe your mind is sharper than your blades.
Hey!
Separate!
Die gasping!
I will not be cornered.
Breathe your last!
Looks like the fight is not over!
You're no threat to us.
You were fools coming here.
Kill them all!
Stand your ground!
Let's see how much pain you can take.
Drive them back!
Adventure awaits us, zha'al! And since it is already waiting, adventure will not mind if we nap first. \n\nAnd have a bite of lunch. And perhaps a drink or two, yes?
Ah! The sea has always called to Za'ji. To be free upon the waves, sailing before a fine breeze! There is nothing like it.
Point your catapults somewhere else!
Join the dance!
<Tur stares at you, until every moment stretches out into a terrible stillness. What will you choose?>
I forgot his smile.
Give me a moment, I think I pulled something.
Khenarthi, make this swift.
Go, my pets!
Do you want us all to burn?
That frost orb looks volatile!
That shock orb might explode!
Surrender. I am clearly superior.
The tides of Oblivion have been kind today. What can this old bag of bones do for you?
More meat for my beasts! Yes!
Cheers to you! Hah! May you fight and die and fight again, as the Lord of Revelry wills!

I don't always agree with the Order of the Iron Knot's leader, Sir Moric. I just don't understand why they chase glory on the battlefield when the same adoration can be won in the tourneys—and with less chance of permanent injury or death.

I am only a New Life Herald during the festival. Otherwise, I run a lumbermill.
Look at those gems! Quite valuable!
Mmm hmm!
Mmmmm?
Ha.
<yawn 3>
Hmmmm.
Did you know that pregnant dogs are filled with puppies?
Mmmmm?
Hand over the pig and nobody gets hurt!
You can have the best cut! Just stop!
I thought the horned raiders were just rumors … I should have listened.
I was sure they'd take me next. They only take the weak to the Forge.
The Dreadhorn claim this land!
What could that noise have been?
Finally! Now this should be—still completely wrong.
These energies consume me!
A deal? What do you have in mind?
Are we done yet?
Me no smell!
Bite off nose! Bite off nose!
Step foot in Falkreath and we'll bury you here, Reach-scum!
It's collapsing! Look out!
Fall before the Dreadhorn clan!
Stupid windup toys!
Stop this at once, apostle!
Deactivation mode initiating.
By your word, I wind my gears.
Perhaps I should give my integral of reason another checkup ….
Alert! Physical assault occurring!
Alert! Homicidal resident observed.
Thievery is not authorized in Clockwork City.
All misconduct will be reported to the authorities, resident.
Criminal: category pick-pocket detected.
Assault in progress. Initiating defense.
Criminal acts will lead to arrest and containment.
You are not permitted in this current area, resident.
What does she think of me? Does she think of me at all?
Our lady of the night, whisper us your darkest desires!
You call us breathtaking. We find that fitting.
Detection array fully calibrated. Awareness rating: ninety four percent.
The Clockwork City welcomes you.
Increasing visual clarity by fifteen percent.
Dreaming …. Burning tapestry. Screaming.
Ha!
Pacrooti welcomes you! So much of his business is carried out through couriers, it is nice to finally place names with faces!
Did you know that pregnant dogs are filled with puppies?
Make your choice!
Pacrooti can't wait to see what you got!
Most excellent!
Haa!
Most fragrant!
Excellent!
I should thank you for the opportunity to try out my masterpiece before I reveal it to the world. But I won't.
Most excellent!
Pacrooti's good luck must be rubbing off on you!
Your next crate is right here!
Ohh! Pacrooti knew that crate was special.  He was going to keep it for himself…
You could wait until tomorrow, but why? You could also buy some crates for us to open now!
Don't be too long!
We'll purge it all. Wipe it clean.
Wipe them out. Make it clean.
We are the natural order.
I feel my blessing, oozing within.
They mock us. Despise us.
They mock us. Mock us!
You dare disrupt our research?
Let your sickness … consume you.
Scalecaller will bring new order!
Feel our blessing! Oozing! Pulsing!
I'll stop your laughing! Your scorn!
Become one of us. Blessed.
New test subjects, yes, oh, yes. Just what the doctor ordered.
Do you truly think you can stand against my shadows?
You're safe with the pack. Calm down, calm down. You're safe.
I did not need to deal with hunters today!
This is our home. How dare you invade it!
Vykosa never does mind if I eat a prisoner or two.
My pack hungers, adventurers. And your flesh shall feed them!
The Silver Dawn fell, but not I. I became something greater.
Do you truly crave death? Join us. Know what is to hunt with a pack by your side.
Its power runs through me. Controls me. Soon it will control you as well.
Soon, I'll have the power I crave. Then no one will dare stand in my way!
Blubberless fish bait!
My power flows through the abyssal pearl.
What stubborn creatures these mortals be!
A single battle isn't a war, dirt-crawlers.
A single battle isn't a war, mortal.
Nocturnal has survived worse than this.
Z'Maja's shadow magic seems to stem from her amulet. I've never seen its like!
Bring glory to Orgnum!
I only cast spells when it's absolutely necessary.
I'll make captain one day, mark my words!
I leave nothing but ash and blood in my wake.
Keep to the shadows.
Embrace your prey, broodlings. Feed on their misery.
This will be a fine place to begin a new brood.
Can you smell that? Sweat. Fear. A mortal is among us.
(Goblin GIbberish 06)
Hey, I wrote you a song! You're going to love it, mate. It's a brisk sixteen hours long—very up tempo. And there's only a … I don't know, twelve percent chance it will cause a stroke?
Let the hunters come. After all, I'm feeling peckish. Ha!
<Loud snarling.>
I'm hungry! I need to hunt, I need to feed!
<Aggressive roar.>
What a feast I see before me!
<Loud snarling.>
You won't leave this keep alive!
<Aggresive roar.>
Care to have a look?
<sinister Goblin gibberish.>
<angry Goblin gibberish.>
<Proud Goblin gibberish.>
Who will weep for you?
Undeath and corruption will be purged from my realm.
Your challenge isn't over yet!
It's time to finish this fight!
The challengers have won!
Come on, challengers! Give us a fight worth watching!
Oh! We may need to start recruiting after this fight!
These challengers are nothing against the Blackguards!
Make them bleed, Blackguards!
Come on Blackguards, get it together!
These are our challengers? Hmm.
Looks like these limp-fins can't take much more.
This is what you bring us, Drakeeh? I remain unimpressed.
Finally, some real entertainment. I was starting to grow bored.
What a thrilling fight!
It looks like the challengers are having a spot of trouble.
I command the power of death!
Something I can do for you?
Watch out!
An old sorcerer once told me my goods are part of a set. What might that mean, I wonder?
You there, with the stench of adventure!
Hijack a Dominion ship? That's insane!
I raise the spine of get the xuth out of my face!
We plundered a cargo ship and all I got was a sack of flour.
The merchants are late with their payment again. Time for another lesson.
Let's plunder a village today!
Not now. Can't you see that I'm busy?
This is my share? It feels a little light.
Here's the plan. We hit them and we hit them hard!
Seven with one arrow? I don't believe it!
A new ship arrived? When do we hit it?
Has anyone seen the cursed relic? It was right here just a moment ago.
Last chance. Step away from my cook pot, kuuda.
Fall in! That village won't raid itself, you know.
What did you say to me, dryskin?
Xulunaht voss!
Is that all?
Dro'zakar is thirsty. Kind of you to offer your throats.
Feh. You taste of vermin.
Gnats who think themselves wolves. Ah, what folly.
It must know you're not supposed to be here.
With so many wars going on, no one even notices our little operation. And that's just the way I like it.
That wine we got on the last raid? Delicious. Pity I only got a few cups.
Lay down your sword, outsider. You already belong to the Akaviri.
She doesn't want us here!
They burned it all. Everything in flames.
The lizard tricked us! Lies! All lies!
Dark Moons, what have we done?
Some doors, when opened, cannot be shut again. This is why windows are better options.
Trade with Khajiit, hmm?
What do you require of Ezabi, fragrant employer?
You forget about the spine until someone rips one out in front of you.
That noise … No! This one is too old for this!
Sometimes portals just open up around me. That's when I say, oh good! A new adventure! And then I wind up somewhere horrible—Daggerfall, for instance.
The influential mage risks all. There is no reward for those who never try.
I say the following with all sincerity. No matter how deeply you study this tome, you will never match the genius of Abnur Tharn.
Does jester have one "s" or two?\n\nOh, apologies. You must want the Impresario. She's around here somewhere!
You've missed her! The Impresario, I mean. She'll be back soon, I'm almost totally certain!
There! It's within you! Get to my ward!
Try not to slip.
I won't lie to you. This is going to hurt.
You came to do battle. Let's get on with it.
I trust there won't be any further interruptions?
Remember your training, students!
Unite behind me, sisters! Let me channel your power!
Another few steps ….
Oh. I really should stay away from the skooma.
Sit, Tulip. Sit! It is possible for you to sit shaped like that, isn't it?
Do not groom your legs after wading in the shoal. Trust this one on that.
She hopes the next batch is safe. Even sugar-tooths won't buy skooma that drives you mad.
Khunzar-ri and the Night of Seven Hundred Paramours? Oh, Zar remembers it well! But there weren't more than six-hundred-and-fourteen, this one is sure.
Meet your end!
Perhaps I will use you. Yes, there is some decent flesh beneath that armor.
This place makes Blackreach seem comforting.
Warning: Throne Aligned orientation fix invalid.
This changes nothing! There are many more where that came from!
Stand closer together. It needs to arc. Arc. Like an arrow. Oh, never mind!

Biro hoped one of these dusty tomes would provide us with the location of a lost ancient treasure. But no such luck. How is this one expected to recover relics without more information?\n\nFor posterity, of course.
It may not seem like Biro-dar works very hard, but appearances can be deceptive. This one is a very diligent scholar!\n\nBiro even visited the library. Once. About a month ago. Or was it two?

Hmm? What? I was just starting to doze off! Now I'm going to have to start counting bottles again. But these are empty. I can't count empty bottles. Bring me some new bottles!\n\nAnd make sure they're full this time!

Ever had moon-sugarcane cider? So sticky sweet it coats your tongue and the little bubbles tickle your throat. Like Jone and Jode showering you with kisses. Ah, but it sours too quickly. You only find it brewed on sugar farms.
I heard once that it was Sangiin who gave Khajiit the secret of wine by spilling the blood of the grapes. I don't care much for Daedra or Divines, but him?\n\nHim I like.

I had to go out for supplies today and some great goon of a guard had the audacity to ask me about my business.\n\nI have half a mind to go back, find his house, and burn it to the ground. That would show him.
For as often as I hear people outside the Reach frown upon Daedric worship, you'd be surprised how many also honor the Princes in secret.\n\nHow many? Well, I'll never tell.
What is this word? Sky's-Horn or Sky-Shorn? What would that even mean?\n\nSometimes academic endeavors can be so perplexing!
Cup, porcelain. Recent Cyrodilic style. A strange residue at the bot—\n\nOh, never mind. That's last week's tea.
Good test subjects are so hard to find.

My father is disappointed that I don't play an instrument or sing. Gods, I don't even write poetry!\n\nI think he was hoping to have a father-son duet at the next royal feast, but that's not going to happen.

If my father brings up marriage and tells me I need to sire an heir one more time …. It's like he thinks I can't find a mate on my own. Or that I know nothing about wooing and courtship.\n\nIt's embarrassing.

Mortals! Sometimes Adusa wonders why she bothers. Do they ever thank us? Do they ever look upon us as anything other than monsters, no matter how often we save their furless arses? Sigh.\n\nDo not mind me. Adusa gets grumpy when she hasn't fed.

What it's like to grow up in the Reach? You raise yourself in the wild, squeezing juice out of strangler vines for nourishment and wrestling bristleback piglets for a rare taste of sow meat. And that's while we're still crawling on all fours!
You happen to know the way to the Clockwork City? I've had a go at two of the three Tribunals and I'll be damned if I don't get a notch in my belt for the third.
Look, I'm not one for idle talk. Try my friend, he'll talk to anyone.

There's an ache in my left elbow. Means a storm will be blowing through soon. \n\nAye, that arm's been wise to the weather ever since it got broke by a bear. I stumbled upon it in a cave. Lucky I made it out with the arm still attached.

Jorunn the Skald-King isn't just my father. He's the strongest man I've ever known. I hope to someday be half the man he is. Hopefully in time to carry on his legacy.\n\nIt's a burden I struggle with every day.
This one comes and goes. Like the phases of the Moons. It is her way.
Is Adusa-daro a hero? This one has never referred to herself as such. If you want to say it, Adusa will not disagree with you, though.\n\nThis one is nothing if not polite.
Pitiable creatures. How is it you aspire to be more than food?
Rested and ready for anything!
Let's go!
Huzzah!
I make soups wherever I go. Different places provide different ingredients. While I am here, I must make use of everything I can find and create new soup recipes. It is what I do.
I prefer not to be watched while I cook. A watched pot never boils, and a watched cook always becomes cross.\n\nWell, yes, I am always cross. But I can become much crosser if you vex me.
Considering your pitifully short lifespans, why do you little mortals waste so much of your day lying unconscious in a bed? Ridiculous.
The Waking Flame promised me a revolution, and that seemed like a good idea at the time.\n\nThe cataclysm stuff, not so much.

They promised that I'd be part of something important. Something significant. But I don't think the Order of the Waking Flame valued my contributions at all. \n\nI do look good in their robes, though.
I am concerned that you do not have enough enemies. A Dremora is judged by the quality and quantity of her vendettas, after all. Is it not the same for mortals?
I have been studying the beliefs of some of your Daedric cults. Ah, the sweet ignorance of these deluded fools! They have no idea what they are actually dealing with.
I don't like the look of that smoke. Let's not waste too much time here.
It's pointless to teach someone a lesson by killing them.
What is it we're doing now? Meditating? Considering our options? Waiting for a wagon?
She! Will arrive!
Destruction waits for you. Either now, or once Xalvakka arrives.
Your courage wanes? Such is the way of mortals.
More! Bring more!
The flames shall scorch your bodies while I feast!
Ah, our featherless client! And how may we assist you and your pretty shinies today?
Some help here!
Is there something I can do?
Forgive me, but … are we there yet?
Why is it that the next adventure always seems to be a long ride off?
Be nice to strangers. You can always take a harsher stand later, but once you've treated someone badly, they won't believe the nice.
Stop this cruelty. I mean it!
May the Divines welcome your soul.
I'm getting my arse kicked!
Use a healing potion!
Is everything all right?
Now what?
That's it! Don't let them finish!
Can I make a suggestion?
Never trust anyone who doesn't see the value in reading.
Maybe there's no such a thing as magical clairvoyance. It seems more guesswork than wizardry to me.
Stealing from hapless travelers and preying on the those who can't fight back is despicable.
You can't heal yourself by hurting another.
I'm losing my patience with your itchy fingers.
Nothing good can come from this. You weave a tangled web with choices like this.
Careful there!
You're fighting without a defender.
Take care! We shouldn't underestimate this one.
That was something I hope I don't see again.
All right, so how much trouble are you in?
I guess this is a fight now.
Would it kill them to run away? Well, no, I guess it wouldn't. Maybe they should try that.
What's going on in that head of yours?
It really is remarkable how much knowledge is just resting below the dirt.
I know there's more to life than wine, but wine sort of makes up for not having them.
Oh, fetching fetch! Fetch! Fetch!
I'll try to distract them!
All prepared!
That's right! Keep the fight on our terms!
Come on! We'll avenge them!
I was thinking things were too easy today.
We sent them packing!

Oh, the tales I could tell! I have accompanied Lady Laurent on many of her most-thrilling adventures.\n\nOf course, I often wind up in dire straights during her escapades … but I'd rather not think about that right now.
Do you suppose anyone would mind if I swept the floor or dusted or something? I feel guilty not engaging in my usual manservant activities and I'd hate to let my skills dull from lack of use.
Can I get you something? Tea, wine, a nice foot rub?\n\nOh, my apologies. For a moment, I forgot I was a guest and not a manservant today.

Most people look down on small folk. Well, naturally, but I mean all judgie-like. To a thief though, tiny means it's easier to be overlooked and slip through the cracks. Most folk don't leave their valuables on the high shelves anyway.

You ever think about what you'd do if you didn't do what you do? I mean, I'm obviously going to forge my legend as the Lady Twilight, but if that wasn't so obviously my calling—what then?\n\nMaybe I'd join the House of Reveries! I do like masks.
[Goblin singing a strange song to herself]
I want pie. Do you have pie? Why didn't you bring pie?
What's the saying? That which does not kill me, makes me stronger? Oh, ho ho ho. If only they knew.
I can keep this up until the void overtakes us all!
Can't wait to see what happens after a swift kick between the legs with these.
You recognize the futility of your fight. Come and meet your end with some dignity.
You won't even feel this.
Oblivion awaits!
Killing time is dangerous. Eventually time will return the favor.
What do you say we try some of the local fare? I'm famished.
Many are the stories M'aiq knows!\n\nSome of them are even true.
Do you suppose anyone would mind if I swept the floor or dusted or something? I feel guilty not engaging in my usual manservant activities and I'd hate to let my skills dull from lack of use.
Can I get you something? Tea, wine, a nice foot rub?\n\nOh, my apologies. For a moment, I forgot I was a guest and not a manservant today.

What is that shiny thing your wobbling, fat-legged knights wear upon their heads? A helm, yes? Perhaps I just need one of those to become a knight.\n\nYes! And the larger the better! Just think of how many rat carcasses I could fit in there!
Do you suppose anyone would mind if I swept the floor or dusted or something? I feel guilty not engaging in my usual manservant activities and I'd hate to let my skills dull from lack of use.
Can I get you something? Tea, wine, a nice foot rub?\n\nOh, my apologies. For a moment, I forgot I was a guest and not a manservant today.

For all its faults, the Battlespire certainly lives up to its reputation. Imagine a fortress that encompasses the entirety of a realm. Ramparts that tower over the edges of Oblivion. Beyond them, only the Void.\n\nIt filled me with both fear and awe.

You ever think about what you'd do if you didn't do what you do? I mean, I'm obviously going to forge my legend as the Lady Twilight, but if that wasn't so obviously my calling—what then?\n\nMaybe I'd join the House of Reveries! I do like masks.

Unflinching bravery? Yes. Svelte yet powerful physique? Check. Gentility befitting the Court? Absolutely!\n\nWhat else must a crow do to become a knight, featherless? Kill a bear, maybe? Find me a bear that I might slay it!
It's been an adjustment sleeping here. Tamriel, I mean. The hours I've kept had nothing to do with the rise and fall of celestial bodies. I never quite feel in alignment with this world.
Ah, Qukikh. You discovered yet another new location that we weren't looking for. You're a marvel, you are.
Be violent elsewhere!
Don't do that here!
Bloodshed? Already?
You'll find the guards harder to kill.
You wish for correction? It comes.
Get out of my face. Guards!
The guards will be here shortly.
This mortal's gone feral!
Houses tell stories too, you know. Sometimes they even lie. After all, a poor merchant might set a rich table so their guests think them wealthy.
It's yours.
I am the Lord of Fire and Flood!
Value appraisal systems functioning at ninety-three percent capacity—acceptance threshold met.\n\nShall we exchange items for gold?
Warning: your belongings exceed recommended weight threshold. Shall I store them for you?

I find myself puzzled by the notion of currency. Do not the strong simply take from the weak? Do not the weak attempt to steal from the strong?\n\nWhy complicate matters with this strange barter system?
The drink of this realm tastes strange. Why, I almost miss Nzerru's ridiculous potions! I haven't felt my organs shine since I departed Fargrave.
No one believed I'd have the nerve to finish my studies in Oblivion. None of them gambled away their pants in a Fargrave alley, though, did they? Not likely!
Mortal rats lack ambition. I cannot seem to interest them in my schemes of conquest. Or even in a nice game of Agony and Affliction.
Is it odd that I miss the Constrictions of Moath? Every time Oruuzyn compresses me, I swear to myself that I will never agree to it again. And yet, I feel as if my back needs another realignment.
I'm really not supposed to talk about the Psijic Order. Or Artaeum. Or Daedric relics for that matter. So let's see. What does that leave us?\n\nRead any good tomes or scrolls lately?
Know the difference between a tavern brawler and a proper fighter? Preparation.\n\nSo, let's get to work, eh?
I'll return your bodies to the admiral … at the bottom of the sea.
You cleared out the trash in my ranks. My thanks.
…here…

Ever think about the future? I've been toying with the idea of retirement. I mean, granted, with a body like this, I've got another ten years of snatching jewels and jumping out windows, easy. \n\nEven so, the scoundrel's life is murder on my knees!
Seems that one's eager to spawn.
Can you feel its pulse quickening? You don't have long now.
People always ask me what weapon I favor. Truth is, I favor anything within arm's reach that's heavier than a pillow.\n\nI tried to fend off a rival with a pillow once. Ah, that was adorable.
<Excited laughter.>
Phew! Glad we managed to beat that one!
We did it!
I've been waiting to try this out!
Together!
Oh good, I didn't want to walk.
I get all my worst ideas when I'm standing around like this. My head just churns them out. See, like right now, I'm thinking about a fishing rod that boils the fish with magic, and stealing pants.
Are you seeing this? Incredible!
Do I look stronger to you? What about my smell? I feel like I smell stronger!
You're looking especially strong lately, I like it!
I don't do well with authority. I just don't respect people thinking a fancy symbol on their chest or a title makes them powerful.
Let's go do something exciting!
Try barking now!
The more werewolves we take out, the better.
Another successful day for sticky fingers!
Couldn't have done it better myself!
Expertly done, they didn't suspect a thing!
Places like this make me feel safer than anywhere else, is that strange?
Watching you harvest is exciting, I can't wait to see what you're going to do with that!
Got any plans for that load of coin?
Ugh, fish creep me out. Their weird little eyes and mouths ... I hate looking at them.
I have a suspicion that my mother was from Elsweyr, but no real proof. I suppose I'll never know, but it's fun to imagine.
On my honor!
Draigh! That was an ugly one, wasn't it?
That's the end of that tale.
Stendarr, give me strength!
Side by side, let's work together!
What do you think we'll find around the next corner?
Be nice to get off my feet.

Someday you'll have to tell me what your secret weakness is. You already know mine. If I smell the glaze of a sweetroll, or moon-sugar syrup, or those little Dark Elf candies … oop. Just a little drool. Ahem.
Stendarr's grace hangs around us here. I can feel it.
Our travels together have taught me so much.
Your quest to improve never ends. Just like a knight.
