Draigh, the Undaunted are impressive. I wish I'd known about them when I was a lass. Across the world, a band of adventurers explores the depths and fights monsters.\n\nAnd they sing! 'Who knows no fear of Daedric blades? We are Undaunted!' Hah!
Did someone call for a knight?
We'll be cleaning our weapons all night, now. Ugh.
I will never get tired of watching you fight like that. Well done!
That was way more fun than squire training.
I've watched how Chief-bane holds herself, and that lady knows combat. I'd love to spar with her someday.
Draigh. C'mon. Don't be like this.

I'm making a list of places I want to visit now that I'm a knight-errant, out in the world. Where would you like to go? I've got Summerset for sure. I've heard incredible things about those beaches. And maybe Elden Root? I'll keep thinking about it.

Mammoth dung! Skald-King wants Rigurt to go on diplomatic mission, but Rigurt just got back from one! The work of Cultural Exchange never ends, it seems. \n\nAlso, Rigurt thinks Jorunn prefers it when Rigurt not in palace. No idea why.

Rigurt feels so important! Jorunn the Skald-King promised to take Rigurt the next time he meets with other alliance leaders. Says Rigurt makes Jorunn look like smartest Nord in room when Rigurt is present.
Three seasons ago I took passage on a ship bound for Southpoint to see the mighty Valenwood, greatest of forests. I almost didn't want to return home. What a marvelous place!
If you find a new variety of torchbug or butterfly, make a note of the location for me. I would like to go see them in their natural environment.
Nice place this, eh chum? So, where do they keep the Tribute cards? I just like to examine other people's collections. Professional curiosity, you understand.

Want to hear something weird? Just the other night I had a dream that I was the patron of a Tribute deck! Only problem, the theme of the deck was financial ruin. \n\nDon't need to visit a soothsayer to figure that one out.
The Spirit, it's—all right, all right. We can stop this.
Pulling the roots. Protect our grove. Our grove.
Are you already scared? I've barely begun.
All your defenders are dead, Laurel. The seed is mine.
Strike when it's least expected!
I also admire the dwarves' handiwork.
No one shall find your grave.
Sway as we kiss! Sway as we kiss! Squawk!
I should never have ventured here.
More rain on the way! Just perfect.
Slammed a spider shut in one of the spell books. Guess that'll be a nice little surprise for the next person that opens it.
If anyone needs me, I'll be right here. All day.
Why use two blades when one can do the trick?
I keep getting distracted! Need to stay focused ….
My pockets feel delightfully empty for the moment. How delicious.
Really ought to get a boat for this sort of thing.
Another earthquake, huh? Wanna place bets on the damage?
I'm not looking for him. I've got more important things to take care of.
One, two three … did one of you get out?
Sometimes I think about running off to the woods to become a druid too … but there's work to be done.
If I stay here until someone notices I'm gone, I'll be here a long time.

You haven't known pain until someone drops a blue sandcrab down your pants. Tava's breath! That prank was old when I was a young sea rat taking my first voyage. Those dogs and sons of dogs I called my crew loved it. Damn, those claws were sharp!

The Stonelore Druids saved my old carcass once upon a time. I remember being transfixed by their way of life, their magic. I also remember a certain druid practicing thrusts with my cutlass and asking me to teach her the foulest swear words I knew.
Hmm … there must be a suitable ray of sunshine somewhere in this domicile. If you spot it, it's not for you. It is for Tadali, yes?
While Khenarthi's Breath Temple is Clan Mother Tadali's home, she followed the breeze to this place. Why Khenarthi led this one here, Tadali has not yet determined. But she will. She will.
Hey, I just heard a good one. How many Sloads does it take to make Tamriel ill? Only one, those slugs make people sick just by looking at them!\n\nNo? Too soon? Yeah, probably right.

Baron-Admiral Bendu Olo is a brilliant tactician. His battle stratagems are works of art, and he truly inspires every last sailor and marine in the fleet. We all believe in his plan to rain justice down upon the Sloads.
I wonder if the druids have any treats for sale at the Vine District today.
Only your brute power is of use to me!
Oh, I found Druid Lysse in here.
You will be judged!
No one makes it through the rift gates.
The spiders will eat well.
Hello, my friend! You seem to think that Pacrooti is a good egg, even though you know he is slightly cracked. Pacrooti appreciates that.
Terrific!
What a sweet reward!
Your crates are gone! But there are always more available.
Listen to Pacrooti. Rewards wait within the crates. You have no crates right now, but you can purchase one if you'd like to begin.
Would you like to begin? You must open your crate to see what is inside.
Ahh, shiny gems.
Is it absurd to want chain mail for hornet stings? I think it'd be practical.
You've got to throw the little ones back in. Even a fish deserves to have a full life before it ends up on my dinner plate.
Sometimes, when the light is just right, the carvings look like they're moving. Silly, I know, but I still keep my eye on them.
I tried to put armor on my horse once. She hated it. Now those shiny armor plates just sit at home gathering dust. Maybe I'll give it another try.
Isn't this just the most elegant weapon you've ever seen? \n\nI can't wait to actually use it.
It does not matter what weapons you favor. What matters is how you make use of them. Let's explore the possibilities ….
I don't know what you've heard about Dark Seducers, but I'm here to trade.

I've been told that I don't know when to quit. That's … not an unfair assessment. I think I get that trait from my father. Has it served me well in the past? Sure. Has it gotten me into trouble? Most certainly. Perhaps it's neither good nor bad.

I tried to end the sour relations between the Mornards and the Duforts a number of times, but to no avail. It's a shame the only thing we can ever agree on are the unsavory dealings of my house. Anything with a possibility to do good? Not a chance.
I'm a simple Senche-raht. I see an enemy, I kill it. I see a treasure, I take it. Anything more just complicates things.
This place is nice, but I get restless. I need full sails and the breeze at my back. I can't wait to see where the wind carries me next.
My quarry today proved most vexing, and upon cornering her, she spoke of a calling, one that saw her overcoming her vampiric blood. I spared her. Perhaps I grow soft in my dotage.

I kneel not to the Tribunal, nor to the Pact. As a hunter of the scions of Bal, I have traveled all across the world. I would drive my blade into the breast of Sotha Sil himself, if it meant extinguishing the plague of vampirism from this world.
I see your plans!
Now to find that mage Twelvane was talking to.
I will see my world created.
No mortal can withstand my might. You all crumble before me.
*Confused Gibberish*
*Confused Gibberish*
All fires cool.
I cast a trap. The rest is up to you.
I always knew they had magic, but this….
We don't have time for this.
Well, if I have to interfere …
Martina was much more venturesome than I. She was always willing to push the boundaries to learn something new.

I've sailed on a great many ships, as part of a great many crews. But I always like signing on with Captain Kaleen. She really knows the seas like the back of her hand and keeps a tight ship. I appreciate that in a captain.

Any fighting pits around here? Maybe a tavern where the regulars enjoy a good brawl? I can feel barnacles growing while I sit and do nothing. Not that I don't appreciate the accommodations, but too much relaxing is hazardous to one's health.

When J'baanluk enters a new town, he listens for the hiss of hot metal being quenched in cold water. An active smith means the local economy is strong. And there is a place to have work done on one's armor and weapons.
This one smells plum brandy nearby. J'baanluk does his best to refrain, but with no battle on the horizon …. Well, a little taste won't do any harm.

I study the many mysteries of the divine skeever. And you can, too! Well, as soon as we figure out all the specifics. Dues, uniforms, rituals … who knew there was so much involved in setting up a Daedric sect?
Who knows more about the natural order than Peryite? No one, that's who! Certainly not that grand-standing Y'ffre or any of those pompous Divines! They are as guar poo compared to the Lord of Blight!
Your presence is a nuisance.
I can't fight her. Not in here.
You can't hide from me.
I have him.
The chimera's power lights Twelvane's path.
If you need a hint, this fight will end before it's even begun.
Your failure is this one's success!
These texts are worth more than you and yet you still have the audacity to drop them.
Let's go.
No surprises there.
Skill issue.
Face my better nature!
Looks like a quick little adventure. I'm game.
Let's move.
Ugh. Morndas, am I right? … is it Morndas? I don't know what day it is.
I've seen this place marked on maps. Never would have sought it out on my own.
Didn't think I had much more to learn. Guess you're proving me wrong.
Always finding room for improvement.
Look, if I see an enchantment on your weapon or armor run low, I'm going to call it out. \n\nI'd want someone to do the same if it were me.
Let's get out there.
Seems like the less you care about something, the better it seems to go.\n\nEver notice that? Hmm. Maybe it's just me.
Your fate is sealed!
Mora's twitching tentacles, I'm glad that's done.
Ruinous Ebullition!
Peerless, perhaps we'll discover something new here!
(old man noises)

I've never understood reading books for fun. I know some consider it a pleasant distraction, but for me every book is a battlefield. An arena where my intellect can be honed. A new territory to be conquered!
Onward and upward!
Hah! Your search for knowledge continues.
I need more books! Papers! Research! Anything and everything written down. If you see it, grab it. We can apologize later.
Ah, cohort!

The first time I left Nirn was quite the adventure! I was still refining my control of the tome, still aligning myself with Apocrypha's might. \n\nThankfully, my accidental-inaugural portal took me to Fargrave. Or we might not be chatting here today.
There's more where that came from!
I've got the damnedest yearning for scrib jelly. Not the glop you get these days—the good stuff! Boiled until it's thick as tar.

I once traveled with a talented performer named Ashflower. She could breathe fire like a Dragon and dance as gracefully as flame itself. I hear she performs atop a volcano now. And that her audience sits enraptured even as lava nips at their heels.

I'm proud to say I've even made the Skald King break out in laughter. A stoic one, that Jorunn. He was once a bard himself after all, so no simple performance would suffice. No. It took my impression of Rigurt the Brash to finally chisel that stone.
It's bad luck to kill a seagull. I once had a shipmate who tested his marksmanship on a gull. The next day he slipped and fell from the crow's nest.
I've pulled off some pretty epic heists in my day. Both on land and at sea. Oh, I'm totally all law and order now. For the most part.
I'm sorry. I know you want to tell me something about your doings, but, well, uhh …. I just don't care.
Hermaeus Mora instructed me to observe this realm for a while. Ugh. I have no idea what I did to offend him.
People say fish smell bad. I say anything smells bad if you leave it out long enough.
I am one of many. You cannot find us all.
You will pay the price.
My glass consists of fire and sharp edges.
New life is so exciting!
Now for scales and fear!
Swords are sharper than quills.
Enough of this.
Your attacks grow dull.
All good tales have a twist!
Another version of me will fight you, reflection.
If only all things were this simple.
Think you can best me again?
You cannot comprehend my scope.
My turn, reflection.
Unexpected terrain changes. My favorite.
Again? Wasn't the building enough?
Tho'at continues to surprise us.
All shall serve me!
I'm not used to summoning. Hope I get this right.
Please don't stand back there. Daedra get upset when you use their nymics.
I know you. I control you. I summon you here!
There's more to the archive than the maligraphies. You can explore, if you want. It won't be fruitless.
The archive. The Infinite. Great place to find valuables. \n\nGive me something from inside and I'll trade you for something I have out here.
So that's where your strength lies. I'll remember it.
Once I was a merciless agent of justice. Now I'm a merciless child's toy!
I am not cuddly-wuddly, despite appearances to the contrary.

Mizzik shudders to hear of unsolved murders being attributed to a weapon called the Blade of Woe. A summoned blade, never once compounded as evidence.\n\nSurely such a weapon is only a myth, yes? Yes?

Playing Tales of Tribute is such a diverting way to pass the time, yes?\n\nThe trouble is, Mizzik gets woozy whenever his opponent uses the Black Sacrament on one of his agents! Mizzik did not expect such violence in a game of cards.

When I was small, my aunt used to send me to summer with her family in Orsinium. I think she came to regret it after I brought back vosh to play with the local Breton kids. \n\nThey just can't take a heavy wooden ball to the face the way an Orc can.

I read some book once detailing how to perform the Black Sacrament. You know, to summon the Dark Brotherhood?\n\nIt's got to be a joke, right? I mean, if you can source fresh body parts for the ritual, what in Oblivion do you need an assassin for?

I like hanging around little Alfiq like Marekki. Outside Elsweyr, people give her the strangest looks when she opens her mouth and starts talking. And she just gets so defensive! Guess she's kind of like an Orc in that way.
I think we're winning!
Look at me, Tho'at. I'm a distraction!
Ready to take on Tho'at Replicanum and all her copies? \n\nI can get a reward together while you battle her maligraphies.
A valiant attempt!
Test your skills against mine!
The maligraphies should fear you. But I doubt they can feel fear.
Your technique is … well, it's all right. But you didn't fight like you loved it. Put your heart into the next duel and I'm sure you'll fare better.
Who taught you to fight like that? You're incredible. And you don't hold back. I look forward to our next meeting.
Take the time to stretch if you need to. I'd hate to win just because you were cold.
Are you ready yet? Even I don't like wasting time.
At least this can't be worse than dying.
My friend says there's not much time left.
Help me or I'll turn you into ghost lights.
We thought death would be more peaceful.
Tomeshells fear Watchers. Now you are one!
I believe in you. Those tomeshells don't stand a chance.
You'll make delicious stew.
I'm going to cook you for a long time.
Your reward is justified and waits there patiently, mortal.
Such feats of strength and violence. I look forward to your next demonstration.
Hmm. Not much damage to the general structure. This is salvageable.
I don't appreciate violence as much as Eru. But, that was somewhat enjoyable.
Which name is preferable? Ink slayer? Text wrangler?
Ah, good. I haven't missed the big show.
Oh no. No. This is all wrong. I didn't file any of these books there!
It's going to take me literally forever to reorganize this wing.
You move so fluidly, I wonder how many years that took to master.
Crush the enemies. Show them what for!
Don't damage the books!
Well, this doesn't seem like it'll last too long.
Don't get crushed!
These seals are mine!

I hope you don't have your mind set on any one thing. The archive doesn't provide a steady supply of anything apart from books. \n\nYou mortals are supposedly good at adapting. I hope you're not an exception.
War makes you lose all perspective on death. The first cold raindrop may be keenly felt, but one grows numb to a downpour. \n\nThis is why I left for Gideon. I had stood long enough in the rain.

Leadership is not simply how you lead, but who you lead. You must surround yourself with the right people. More importantly, a leader must trust that when those that follow are in need of guidance, you will be the one they turn to.

While hunting elk some time ago, my foot got caught in a trap. Shor's bones, it hurt! Blood sprayed everywhere when I pried it off. Took all my strength but I eventually got free.\n\nSo here's the lesson—always watch where you step.
If you ever find yourself on the run from mercenaries, take my advice. Get yourself a vicious werewolf as a traveling companion. Once word gets out, the sellswords tend to leave you alone.

It's not fair when the others find hair around the sanctuary and blame me. I am not that hairy most of the time! Everyone else has hair, too. Well, most everyone. People should not leap to conclusions.
People have told me that my wolf form and my human form have very different personalities. I like that, honestly. Maybe one day I'll have control over each side and they'll come together as one.
Never fear, the cavalry has arrived! Oh, they're all gone. Well then.
Steel yourself!
My army grows!
Conquer! Conquer! Conquer!
Your weakness is my victory!
Look within yourself. Seek your bellagor, your secret storm. Channel that piece of the Green beyond yourself and you will dominate the battlefield.
<Wheels poised, Tzozabrar readies to zip off at a moment's notice.>
(Goblin GIbberish 06)
I regret to inform you, that wasn't correct.
I hope you're warmed up now.
This will hurt.
Get back here!
My power only grows with time!
Try not to get hit.
Keep waiting, mortals. It won't change anything.
I should thank you for the opportunity to try out my masterpiece before I reveal it to the world. But I won't.
Everything is as it should be.
I should thank you for the opportunity to try out my masterpiece before I reveal it to the world. But I won't.
How can your frail mortal body handle the weight of all those treasures? Allow me to lighten your load.
<The friendliest banker you have ever worked with snuffles where he sits, contemplating doggy dividends.>
Now, it's not like I'm one of those Dark Brotherhood nut jobs. I'm sanctioned by the Great Houses and only kill when I have an official writ. Usually.

They call me "the Quiet Blade." My associate Naryu tells everyone that's one of those ironic titles, as she claims I don't know when to keep my mouth shut. But when I'm on the job, I'm silent and deadly.\n\nSilent. And deadly.
Get out of my way!
I will be powerful!
Suffer together!
Your reflection will hurt!
I am everywhere!
It's always crystals here.
Look at you. Standing there like you can stop me. I thought of everything!
That's it. Destroy them! End their tiny lives.
Oh, that's unpleasant. My wisps see a storm, a battle, and darkness. Bad tidings all around. Step carefully, friend.
(Goblin GIbberish 06)

I think I was always destined to be an adventurer. You ever feel that way? If it wasn't spycraft or questing alongside you, I think I would have sailed the seas. There's so much we don't know about Nirn. Why stop at Tamriel?
Hey! What's going on?
I didn't think I could get any better.
Cute. You think you'll win.
Thanks, I needed a stretch.
Couldn't have done it better myself.
Teamwork!
Nothing we can't handle.
Woo! And we didn't even stretch!
Let me show you how it's done.
Sweat, dust, and mildew. Ahh. Smells like adventure.
Wouldn't hate setting up camp here.
Where to?
I wonder if my family is still around.
I love the sound of free gold.
I wish I had your luck.
Like a true troublemaker.

Among the Hidden Moon, we were close to death every day. It was important to meditate on life. To recognize Nirni's children crawling in every corner on this plane. Even in death, in Namiira's decay, life feasts and thrives.
Who might we aid today?
Tamiit! We are made stronger together.
You will not last.
Ka'iir! Begone.
Send them running!
Tamiiti cannot be stopped!
Khenarthi, lend us haste!
Thus is the way of the Hidden Moon.
Azurah, witness my devotion!
This place is fraught with dark purpose. Let us bring light to its corners.
Are we stopping here? It seems a fine place to take in the sights.
We move with the wind.
That lock did not stand a chance.
I wonder which spirit bestows such fortune upon you?
Jo'zhet! You are stronger every moment.

While I still have duties to House Ravenwatch, I'd love to experience more of Tamriel. I want to study ancient Argonian rituals in Black Marsh, and I long to see the haunted Dunmeri mushroom forests.\n\nWherever something's uncanny, I want to go there.

Rivenspire is a … fine place to live. It's the seat of House Ravenwatch, so I shouldn't criticize it. But, by the stars is it dreary! Maybe I can eventually convince the others to at least buy a summer home. Even Skyrim would be better.
The key when shopping is never to have your heart set on just one thing. I offer so many treasures, so many secrets. \n\nI mean how can you choose just one? Take a look.
My work will bring about an end to this dreaded war. And you seek to destroy that?
The alliances are hypocrites and yet you fight to protect them.
You lost? That can't be right. You said you were going to help me stop the Albuses!
Everyone said they understood. But they didn't. No one did.
That was fun. Shame it didn't last longer.
I told Orpheon we could do it!
I see your plans!
You're a marvelous combatant. These fights are to die for!
You're on pace to break archival records.
Please don't get surrounded. It's too stressful.
You almost make it look easy.
What do you want!\n\nOh, right. I'm a merchant. You want to buy something. That's allowed.

The wisest adventurers know when to let others go first. Like my apprentices. After all, the best way to determine where the traps are located is by walking right into them.\n\nI would never deprive anyone of such a valuable learning experience.

People often ask which adventure was my favorite. The truth is, I don't have a favorite. My adventures are simply source material for my most profitable venture—my books! Anything with a catchy title always sells like cold mazte on a hot day.
Some kids get really into horses or dragons, but me? Gryphons. I see a gryphon flying around? Full stop. Staring, probably crying a little. Beautiful creatures.

I'm going to let you in on a little secret if you promise not to tell anyone. I'm not only a talking dog. I'm the companion and loyal servant of Clavicus Vile, the Daedric Prince of Bargains and Wishes.\n\nReally! Ask anyone.
Is there something you really, really want? Something special? I know a guy who's pretty good at granting wishes. For a reasonable fee.

You ever really try to get a nickname to stick? Most of my friends call me Bogcup which, let me tell you, does not impress the ladies. A friend once called me Spitfire, almost as a joke. I'd always hoped it would catch on.
Have you seen the little spirit cat, Ja'kh? I think he is here somewhere. Keep an eye on any cups or vases, especially those near a ledge. I am certain he plans some mischief.
Sources of water were few in the Elsweyr of my day. I am always grateful to find and collect water in our travels. I would rather not be scarce of it.
Crush them Equi!
Feel our pain!
Lead the spiders to their doom!
They're coming! Run. Hide!
Everything holds a shadow of its former nature. Allow me to unmake what you have. Show you what it can be again.
I often trade in handcrafted items and artisanal creations. But there is joy in even the simplest transaction. What do you have for me?
Ooh a back and forth. How exciting!
Can't you see that Za'ji is grieving? He has misplaced his very expensive bottle of plum brandy before even popping the cork! Oh, the cruelty of fate! How can Za'ji go on?
This one must admit, he first went to sea because he thought it unlikely his mother would find him there. She hates getting her fur wet.
We need more light!
<Tur blinks, and for a moment you sense a burning ember of recognition. And perhaps respect. What will you choose?>
Did it work? I closed my eyes.
Off your perches!
Once heard a man say it's good to be rich, but better to be smart. Why not be both, says I? What do you have for me?
Yes! To the Hunt! Hah!
Don't listen to your training. Listen to the blood! What does your heart tell you to do?

I was once quite smitten with a knight of the Oaken Order. A skilled druidic spellblade who conjured a crown of flowers atop my head while he cradled my cheek in his hand.\n\nAlas, I believe a bear ate him.

There are many bards employed by taverns across the Systres, each trying to make a name for themselves by recounting the exploits of adventurers—average or otherwise.\n\nIf you desire a song singing your praises, come spend a summer on the isle.

Years ago, I bought a fake mammoth snout from a vendor in Stormhold. That silly gag gift really came in handy when I acquired Muffins! I'd use it to pet her, or circle it around her as she slept. And yes, more than once I used it to bathe her.
Someone once asked if Muffins was a timber mammoth, on account of her size. Timber mammoth! Can you believe it? Some people really don't know their mammoths.
It's all connected. They're all connected. They hide it from us, but I can see it now.
Put the spurs to it! Give it all you've got!
It's hotter than a Dragon's innards! Let's cool it down some.
Maybe we should move to Markarth. We have family there.
Maybe we should move to Whiterun. We have family there.
Other Orcs want to fight. Me? I fish.
No, no.
That will never work …
Are you just pushing the same button over and over again?
Where's the rest of the Pact army? Are they hunting that giant?
Where's the rest of the Pact army? Are they hunting that giant?
It's all double-shifts from now on!
The Mallari-Mora no longer binds me here. Free of the curse!
I know we don't have time, but I should rest.
I hope the Silvenar can hold out long enough.
Tippi makes the cutest noises when she sleeps.
The Farseer's wisdom guides us.
I bought a book. The Art of Love and Swordplay. I hope the story's good.
What did these cruel bandits hope to find here? Did they want our fish?
So many valuable things!
Please, I want to hear this.
They'll never stop us!
Do you believe this alliance? Dark Elves, Nords, and Argonians working together. It can't end well.
Play something Nordish!
Don't you have more important things to do?
The wise woman's voice, by the fire last night. It's like she was singing just for me. Have you ever felt that way?
How could I forget?
Can anyone hear me? I need help!
Wizard of Mystery, mind the clockwork at Nirn's heart.
The Heart of Mara beats beneath the breast of every mer, connecting us by blood and spirit.
Oh, this day will never end.
Kill it! Kill it!
The Withered Hand are savages.
Without the Ansei Wards, we're doomed!
The Forebears forget that Crown rule keeps the peace.
The Heart of Mara beats beneath the breast of every mer, connecting us by blood and spirit.
Say that again and you go to the Cave!
If it were up to me, I'd toss every last one of you into the cave!
I wouldn't let you lick my boot, much less become a Thalmor guard!
No mercy. No prisoners.
If you'll be staying a while, check out the Shadehome Inn. Best place in Riften, for my money.
I meekly follow.
By the Whisperer's command, we shall obey.
You can't take us all!
I'll cut you up into little pieces.
Keep one of them alive, maybe they know the way in.
Tend to your duties. Let me wallow in my misery!
Young wives should always pay deference to Mara, for no child comes into this world without the goddess's blessing.
Die! Die so I live!
Taste my salted steel!
Is it there? Is it still there?
My own father, divines save his soul, was torn to pieces by just such a pack!
Monkey rum butter, the butter so dark. Not sweet and creamy, the contrast is stark!
Your motions must be as inevitable as the coming tide!
Accalia gave the other relics to his lieutenants. Lucky bastards!
Just give up and let your mind unhinge. For only madness brings peace in this dread realm.

I never get to meet anyone new and exciting. Just the same old faces every day, day in and day out. It's so depressing! Why won't some hero wander in and sweep me off my feet and take me away?\n\nBut no one new ever comes to Everfull Flagon.
They are inconsiderate neighbors, yes.
We sometimes admire our prey, and secretly applaud when it cheats our snares.
Thrashing you thoroughly will please me, mortal.
My plan comes to fruition, mortal. You serve me now as a vessel of destruction.
When oath-bonds are weak, there is pain, and shame, and darkness.
Your strength will be rewarded. One day.
The plan shall go on, with or without you.
Rise and protect the roots!
Seems warfare is still a grisly business.
You can't fool me. I know you've been watching us!
Daedric worship? What is this blasphemy?
Blood … hungry … need blood ….
Great Julianos, patron of knowledge and wisdom, may you grant unto us the ability to distinguish between truth and madness.
Good fortune! Might we borrow your innards, to settle a wager?
Raz, remind me to give you extra treatums when we get back to the palace.
Vaermina's letters, dreams and nightmares, should never be trusted. They are knowledge counterfeit.
Wrong answer!
I heard the author himself is directing this one!
If you stay much longer, your granny Alyxe will have to show you her favorite toadstool. It's dry and crispy, just like her sweet tender nibbles.
Generosity is a virtue of the Divines, O wayfarer.
You know they're ugly when an axe in the face is an improvement!
Get away from me! I don't want to kill you, but I'm so hungry!
And for the Pact, the kinship we share with beast and bird and tree, now.
Yes, scorn my beliefs in front of me. I don't mind.
Shouldn't have crossed paths with us, dungheap.
You know—sometimes I have better things to do than speak to you. Can't say what they are, but they're there!
Thanks for your help, traveler. Almost didn't make it out of that one.
No! Why?
It's going to tear us in half!
Keep a look out.
Someone help me fight this thing!
M'aiq speaks with many in his travels. After a time, they seem to repeat themselves. Strange.
M'aiq thinks more people should get to the point. Not you, of course.
M'aiq was one of the Six Companions, but was asked to leave. Another was jealous of his whiskers.
The Learned One is kind not to kill you where you stand.
And thus your life comes to an end.
M'aiq finds Dark Elves to be quite pleasant. One offered him a matching set of bracelets, but he declined.
You think I feared fighting you?
For you, there is no tomorrow.
Savor your last few moments!
Your friends are receiving a taste of Nirn's future.
Your death was pointless. You should have run. The mortals of Nirn will follow you, shortly.
Perhaps you should go back to fighting with the practice mannequins. They don't hit nearly as hard as the living opponents.
We'll show you what it means to challenge the Scaled Court!
Kailstig the Axe is one of our bravest members. And you can take him down a peg if you take the Undaunted pledge!
If the lamia won't finish the job, we will!
Kailstig the Axe plumbs the deepest dungeons, and throws fists of gold to tavern wenches. Show him you are greater than he. Take the pledge.
Prepare to greet the new day—and burn in it.
You'll never leave this place!
You know a delve is successful when you stink afterward. Yours must have been especially good. You want your reward?
Come and greet the new day. It will be your last.
Shifting cargo is thirsty work.
Only a few more shipments until this one goes home to nap.
I'll guard your delivery until it is time to depart.
Quality is your watchword—I can tell from your goods.
Why is the cargo always so heavy? Are people shipping rocks?
This work is exceptional!
He'll be back. Run!
Flee! He's never gone long.
You fight boldly, but without skill.
Who did that?
Oh no.
Your souls will make fine prisoners!
Chase me, little rat!
The Emperor sentences you to death!
Your weakness amuses me.
Your blood shall be ours!
By Imperial decree, I sentence you to death!
Come, friends—join the festivities!
We shall feast on your corpses!
The Lady is hungry!
Now, restore me!
Burn them!
My slaves will throw you into the heart of the device, and you shall endure the tortures of the damned.
The birthskins shall kneel and beg!
You have demonstrated the error of your ways. I suppose you'll pay your fine now?
No one breaks the law on my watch. Hand over the bounty.
My stars you are quick! You should become a guard. The pay is lousy, but-- Hold, you owe me a bounty!
You simply must pay your bounty! Neither of us wishes you to become a fugitive.
I'd hate to get your blood all over my freshly cleaned armor. Do me a favor and just pay up, yes?
You can pay your debt in coin or in blood, vermin. Which is it?
The only law your kind understands is the law of intense pain! So, will you pay or will you suffer?
Pay up or it shall go bad for you, felon!
I demand you pay your .... Oh, how interesting! Was that a bird? I mean, pay your bounty, criminal!
Rights? You have no rights! But if you pay your bounty and stop annoying me, I might be lenient.
Criminal acts are the last resort of the desperate and the damned. Pay up and it will be easier for you.
Would you mind surrendering and pay your bounty? Then I would not need to crack your skull.
Pay the fine in gold or I promise you will pay it in blood.
Know what is really humiliating? Being beaten down by the guards. Spare yourself the embarrassment.
If you cause a scene and refuse to pay your fine, I will be forced to get belligerent on your arse.
I have orders to collect your bounty. Save your protests for someone who cares.
Keep your hands away from your weapons ... or just stand there like an idiot. That works too, I guess.
The mud of justice has finally caught up with you. You're under arrest.
There are many paths through the forest of life. For you? I think your best option is to pay your fine.
I erect the spine of urgency. Render payment on your bounty now. Quickly, dryskin.
I don't know why people can't just be nicer. I mean--pay the bounty, criminal scum.
It's the bounty or a shallow grave--you decide.
Don't you get cocky with me, criminal! Pay your fine or face my wrath!
Criminal, will you pay your fine before I ... wait, what was I saying? Anyway, about your bounty.
Pay your bounty, criminal scum. Just pay it! I was having a bad day before I saw your ugly face.
We must all face the consequences of our actions eventually. That's just how the river flows.
Surrender and full restitution are the only viable options available to you, felon.
Listen. I have to fine you or people will get suspicious. Just play along.
If I'm not interrupting anything important, I'd like to secure your bounty now.
I can take your gold now.
You can pay the fine. Or I can send you to Sithis.
My scales blush at your beauty, but I must ask for your bounty.
You know how this works. I don't want to fight you, but you've got a bounty to pay.
Even corruption has its limits. Pay the fine.
The manual says I have to demand you pay your fine, but it says I only have to ask once.
If you pay your bounty with the same flair you use to commit your crimes, we'd be done by now.
I'll take something from you ... your bounty or your life. It matters not to me.
In the long run, we're all dead. Doesn't make what you did any less wrong.
Like last night's dinner, justice is served! Damn, now I'm hungry.
You're in trouble now, scum.
I'm sorry it's come to this, but I sort of have a duty to uphold here. Will you pay your bounty?
It's not exciting work, but I do have to collect your bounty now.
Just my luck, I actually caught you. Oh, very well! Please pay your fine, if you'd be so kind.
Y'ffre helps those who walk the forest path. You? I think your best option is to pay your bounty.
Says here you've got a hefty fine to pay.... You don't want me to read the rest of it do you?
Most criminals never learn. Are you the exception? Let's see if you pay your fine.
Cooperate, pay your fine, and it'll all work out.
I can't fathom why you'd choose a life of crime. Bounties are so costly! Speaking of which ....
What a sorry affair! You're a victim of circumstances, but I still need you to pay your fine.
If you pay your bounty, we can avoid an unfortunate turn of events.
I'm not usually attracted to criminals, but for you I'd make an exception. After you pay your bounty, of course.
You keep running from the law and it's only going to get worse. Come on now. Give me the bounty.
You cannot spit in society's face and then avail yourself of its luxuries. You must atone.
The law demands you pay your bounty. Me? I'm going to ask nicely and hope you agree.
It's not everyday I catch such a daring rogue! It is an honor to claim your bounty, truly!
The law requires I inform you that if you do not pay your fine, there will be severe consequences.
If it were up to me, I'd put you in a cell and throw away the key.
Your options are exhausted, outlaw! Your only chance is to fall on the mercy of the law and pay your fine.
Stop, Criminal. Hand over that bounty, or ... or else!
Let's not get excited. I don't want any trouble. Pay me your bounty and I'll be on my way.
I'm sorry, but I'm going to have to ask for your payment. You seem nice, but business is business.
I don't like hurting people, but I do it when I have to. Do you want to pay or learn for yourself?
You need to pay your bounty. Don't make this harder than it has to be.
Your bounty will cover the next few rounds of drinks. We all appreciate your contribution.
Want to get rich, huh? You picked the wrong profession. Law enforcement's where the gold is. Your gold.
If you're a criminal, then I'm an Argonian's uncle! But I'll take your bounty if it will make you happy.
And once again a varlet has succumbed to the long arm of justice. Will you pay your fine?
You can pay the bounty or fight, and I love to fight.
Lawbreakers like you make me sick. Pay the bounty and get out of my sight.
Can we hurry this up? I have a prior appointment and he hates it when I'm late.
The law demands recompense for your criminal acts.
Well now. Neither of us wants to be here. Sooner you pay, sooner we can go.
You owe a bounty. Don't even think of running. My knees aren't what they used to be.
You have your crimes and I have my orders. Now pay up! I have more to do than just deal with you.
I dare you--just give me an excuse and I'll bash your ugly teeth into the back of your head.
This notice says you owe a bounty for committing a crime. Pay up so I don't have to keep reading.
The crime you commit is your bondage. Pay the bounty and be free.
Look. I'm a talker, not a fighter. I-I don't want this to get ugly, but I have to confront you.
You probably don't even have the gold, but I have to give you a chance to pay your bounty.
I understand the appeal of a life of crime. So many good memories. But I learned to pay my bounty. Have you?
Though the criminal mind is rarely rational, I'm sure you can comprehend the value in paying promptly.
Run like a frightened skeever or pay up like a five-clawed warrior. Your choice.
Stop what you're doing and pay the fine.
Do not be enslaved by your criminal passions. Pay your bounty. Make yourself right with the world.
This one sees how you look at her. But we are from different worlds. It would never work out. Pity.
Don't bother running. I have ways of finding you. Best to pay the bounty now.
This one has caught you. Pay your fine. Or don't. I could use the exercise.
Every action has a consequence. Your actions require payment in full.
This one has caught you? I mean, this one has caught you! Will you pay your bounty now?
Pay your bounty, you skeever-faced culprit, or I'll flay the skin from your bones!
Look here. Another fine upstanding citizen who's falsely accused, yes? Just pay the bounty.
In the name of the law, this one demands your swift and peaceful compliance.
This one knows that crime tastes sugar-sweet. But only when you are not caught, yes?
Stay your arms and render payment. Making me wait would be unwise.
You have escaped justice for long enough. Pay your bounty now and you may live to face judgment.
You owe a bounty. No running.
You're the one who decided to break the law, so you're the one who has to pay the fine.
Pay your bounty, friend, and perhaps we can work something out later.
What's the matter? Can't hold down a real job? Got to commit crimes for a living?
My back hurts and my eyes are tired, but justice will be served.
Surrender and pay, scum!
Caught in the act! I know the feeling. Sorry to rain on the parade, but you've got a bounty to pay.
Don't be a milk-drinking horker! Pay your bounty and set your mind at ease.
If your crimes were more drastic, I'd be required to attack on sight. Instead, you may simply pay.
Drunk? Of course I'm drunk! What of it? Give me more lip and I'll double your fine!
My mood is like a winter's storm, cold and unpredictable! Care to try your luck or will you pay up?
The law is reasonable, but you continue to snub your nose at it. Now you must pay.
Can you just help me out and pay your bounty? If I lose another one I'm out of a job!
I've dealt with hundreds of criminals. I know how to handle your kind. So pay me and go.
I love collecting bounties! I can just hear those little coins jangling. Sounds like justice to me!
Has anyone said you have a fabulous jaw? After you pay your fine, I'll tell you more.
I know you! You're the Three-Fingered Masked Burglar of ... no, we arrested that guy last year.
Two ways this can go. Pay me and I'll pretend I didn't see you, or refuse and I smash your face.
I always wanted to be a guard. Poorly paid, hated, feared, given tasks no one else wants ... I love it.
You're caught, runt! Pay the fine or else!
Crime doesn't pay! So pay me .... Wait. Crime doesn't pay you--it pays me. Ugh! My head hurts.
I guess you can't help yourself. Doesn't make what you did any less wrong.
Say you're sorry! I mean, pay your bounty! Well, you can apologize, too. If you want.
Do you think I'm the friendly sort? Well think again! And while you're at it, pay me your bounty.
You know ... this guard duty's a lot more fun after a little frothy. Now I get to collect your bounty.
Gore and glory, you're a healthy heifer! Pay your bounty, and I'll buy you a drink! After my shift, of course.
If you don't pay, you'll be punished. That's the way of things.
I'm here to collect your bounty. Pay it or fight. I don't give a damn--it's all the same to me.
Justice is blind--and so am I, for the right price.
Your gold or your ... now how does that go again? Oh, damn it, just pay me your bounty!
Think you can get away from me? Some have tried. They're all dead.
You're the first name on my bounty list today. Congratulations!
So, what will it be? Gold for your bounty or a healer for your wounds?
Save yourself some trouble and just pay your fine.
My thesis on crime argues that all criminals are idiots. Care to pay your bounty and prove me wrong?
Did you forget something, dishonorable one? There's the matter of your bounty.
Be joyful, criminal! Your time of redemption is at hand! I will take your bounty now.
I do not wish to harm you, lawbreaker, but I will if you refuse to pay the bounty.
You're caught. Now, the bounty.
Crime and punishment create a vicious cycle. Better to make restitution and get off the crooked path.
I see you made my list. Another fool who thought they could avoid the law. Well, you failed.
If it were up to me, we'd bury criminals like you, no questions. But instead we collect a bounty.
Did you expect I wouldn't find out? No matter, just pay the bounty and everything is good.
I am not a patient man. I will not abide delays.
The law has no tolerance for those who flaunt it. Pay the bounty.
Times are tough, but crime is never the answer.
The smart criminals know to avoid the guards, but I don't suppose smart is one of your strong points.
It has reached my ears that you are wanted by the law. I have come to claim your bounty.
Drop your weapons and render payment. Delay would be unhealthy.
So it finally turned up, did it? That notice has been posted for a while. Glad you found it.\n\nSomeone will be happy.
Why yes, I did ask for these. How did you know? It's been so long, I had given up. \n\nYou have my thanks, stranger. I'll pay you what I was to pay them.

You must be tired of chasing your friends and associates. Not to mention how you had to wear that unflattering Enforcers garb. \n\nWell, let me welcome you back and remind you about the opportunities our organization offers.
I don't know what those sewer-dwelling outlaws did to sway you, but I hope you'll come to your senses. Otherwise, I'll have to beat them into you.
Ilia Colatorius.
I recommend not letting them hit you so often!
Fear not! There's more where that came from!
Your run of good luck is about to end!
There's no doubt who won that one! Well fought!
Savage and merciless! Yes, indeed!
Don't want your help. Don't need your help. Just get out of my way.
All to the surface! All must come!
May Corintthac's vines pierce your heart!
Oh! I've never seen anything like this!
Ragh! Rugh! Raaaagh!
You shall travel to many exotic places before your adventure comes to an end.
It's kind of strange seeing so many Orcs around. I mean, I'm used to city Orcs, but these clan Orcs? They're a bit too intense, even for me.

Skordo has been a godsend! He's smarter than he lets on and is an excellent judge of character. He calls it his "gut instinct."\n\nI'm glad he agreed to continue working with me now that we've reached Orsinium.
Who disturbs my rest? You shall be punished. All shall be punished.
Take whatever you want, but don't ask me to carry anything!
Hail Trinimac, hail the Vosh Rakh.
Go away and I'll pretend I never saw you.
I pity those who deny my rule.
The death of my mother will never be forgotten!
Traitorous scum! Burn!
You ever kill someone? Where was that, exactly? No? You're right, it doesn't matter.
Some feel gold burdensome, a curse. They should give theirs to this enchanting foreign merchant, yes?
Too much gold weighing you down? Shall we unburden you?
There's always more work to be done, isn't there?
These seals are mine!
What may I whisk away for you today?
Elam and the Matron work me to the bone.
Who put that in there?
Hangman coming.
Hangman coming.
Safeguard is only a step behind you.
Presents, for me?
Safeguard is only a step behind you.
Presents, for me?
These will avail us well. We're obliged to you.
Every one must do her part in the struggle.
Oh, I could just eat you all up.
This one finds it funny that a bird is the only animal you can throw, and still be helping it.
Welcome back, good friend! It is always a pleasure to talk nonsense with someone, and to have his nonsense respected.
May luck follow you.
Will you try again? This could be your lucky day!
Why not?
Congratulations!
Tip-top!
A spotless choice!
<Kinda Mean Laugh>
Has steeping in death for so long dulled your appetite for life? Claim your reward and see if that thrills you into action once more.
Sound advice, on the house. My rare and impeccable home goods will turn your hovel into a palace!
Marvelous rewards!
This one recommends that you purchase a crate from the store.
Pacrooti is waiting!
Come to deliver our little 'private contract'?
Thought you'd be done a while ago.
You already had that, so you got gems instead. Very nice!
<yawn>
Ahhhhh!
Hooo hoo hoo!
Hmm hmm hmm!
This one finds it funny that a bird is the only animal you can throw, and still be helping it.
Ahhhhh!
They butchered my brother just for meeting their gaze … they're animals!
Shor forgive me! It's your blood on my hands!
<Beastial roar.>
Hello? I mean you no harm.
This is getting ridiculous.
Kill it! Don't worry about freeing me!
You're not fit to lick my boot.
No one plays me for a fool.
It comes.
Fool? That's other wretch.
Bastards! You'll pay for this!
Sure, let's fight more of these things. Why not?
This is not what I was built for!
Forgive me, Lord Sotha Sil.
I am bound to your service!
I do hope Lord Sotha Sil is doing all right. Why, I haven't washed his hair in centuries.
Unauthorized combat is not permitted.
Murder observed and reported.
Please return all illicitly obtained items, resident.
Your actions are not allowed within the Fortress.
Minor criminal activity detected.
Structural integrity compromised.
Unlawful actions will not be tolerated in the Fortress.
Trespassing observed. Reporting actions to authorities.
How my mistress mingles with the night ….
The shadows cling like cobwebs. Loose threads waiting for a weaver.
Let it out. Your last breath. Your quiet sigh of resignation.
Sweep detects zero intruders. Restart initialized.
Farewell res—. Greeting error, eight two seven.
Detection array calibrating. Awareness rating: sixty two percent.
Apologies. This partition is not designed for conversation.
Ooooh!
Ah, my friend returns! This one thinks there is nothing better than a good friend, unless it is a good friend bearing moonsugar treats.
This one finds it funny that a bird is the only animal you can throw, and still be helping it.
Pacrooti sees that you are ready to play! Excellent!
This is exciting!
Exceptional!
Ooooh!
You've done well!
This is exciting!
Amazing! How do you do it, my friend?
Open another of your crates?
Incredible! Pacrooti is speechless!
You don't have to wait until tomorrow you know? You can buy more crates and we can open them up together now!
So blessed am I.
Blessed. I am blessed.
My blessing consumes me.
They'll all be purged.
Our blessing will kill them all. Slowly.
Festering, rotting corpses. Oh, yes.
Shall we start the tests? And have no worries, I am a medical professional.
Darkness shall reign across Summerset!
I could control you with a single thought!
Kill as many as you want. I'll send more.
Why do you continue to resist my will?
Savor this victory while you can.
This battle belongs to you, but wait until next time.
Nocturnal is the dark, and the dark is endless.
The fool wouldn't know his stern from a seashell.
Don't burn the books, idiot. Knowledge is more valuable than gold.
And then he sailed into the shallows and sank on a coral reef!
We should take captives. We could use a good cook.
Warm flesh nears. Ripe. Delicious.
Our mistress demands we feed. And so we shall.
Don't kill them too quick. Keep them alive. Warm.
I must check my webs. Perhaps some prey has been caught.
(Goblin GIbberish 07)
Huh? Oh, sorry. I was busy planning my next holiday. Picture this, mate: the moons! Exciting, eh? I'd invite you along if you could survive up there. Sidenote—you cannot survive up there.
Do you wish for more? Very well!
At long last, our champion emerges!
The gauntlet has a new victor!
Feel the savagery of the Blackguards!
A sturdy blow from the challengers!
Care to bargain?
The discerning adventurer knows: A comely merchant with mysterious goods is always a boon. Probably.
I hate splitting the loot. Why can't I keep what I found?
When do we get to hijack another ship?
What's the plan? I'm ready to hurt somebody!
Beating on delinquent deadbeats is so exhausting!
We need to pillage something before my scale dry out.
The next one of you idiots to complain about your share gets an empty sack, mark my words!
Rub fins? You aren't good enough to polish my scales!
If I hear Famia's name one more time ….
I'll take that! You lost the game, fair and square.
That's the plan? And how many of us do you expect to survive?
Ruheeva u xul-vahat!
When will we face a real challenge?
Simple creatures. Blind to your own insignificance. I admire your audacity.
Don't …! Dwemer technology is touchy about trespassers.
Don't stop now! This is the best bloodshed I've seen in ages!
Hello? You're not squawking, by chance? Ziss!
Did I ever tell you about the Charge of the Dozen Banekin? A harrowing ordeal—until they ran into my knees and knocked themselves silly.
Warriors and steel are much alike. When either loses its temper, it also loses its worth.
Step closer and listen well. Believe in yourself and success will follow. Unless it doesn't. Not everyone is cut out for success.

I'm sorry, but the Impresario isn't in right now. She said something about needing more feathers. Or was that flowers?\n\nPlease do come back soon. I'm sure she'll have something wonderful to share with you then!
Use the ward! Get that corruption out of you!
I'll drown you in blood.
Stand firm, students! Take my aid!
This doesn't look like a sanctum ….
Please, Tulip. You're making me look bad in front of the stranger.
Ah, if this one still had his flesh … oh, what adventures we would have, dear friend!
This land is ours!
If something happens, please don't leave my body down here.
Error. Dreaming …. Missing Location Information.
For every harrowstorm you stop, we will summon a dozen more!

This one needs a distraction from his studies. The books, they contain so many words!\n\nBiro has an idea! Entertainers! Just the thing to lift the cloud of boredom that hangs over Biro like a shroud! Do you know any?

Biro-dar would love to explain the point of his studies, but fears you would find it all terribly boring. And quite beyond your current level of comprehension.\n\nThis one often finds it beyond his comprehension as well, so don't feel bad.
Haha, did I ever mention …? Did I ever tell you—what was it—that … when I was doing the thing? With the words and the glowing? \n\nNo, I'm sure I told you. That was great, wasn't it? Good times!
What are you looking at? You're staring at my tummy? I see you staring at my tummy.\n\nDon't even think about it.
Hey. Why don't you fetch some more pillows, or maybe a nice box? I'm running out of places to nap.
Walls. Do people in civilized settlements think they really provide any protection from a well-equipped Reach raiding party?\n\nAre they really so naive?
I can't recall the last time I witnessed a good knife-fight.\n\nHow do civilized folk settle their differences these days?

You'd think historical figures would do a better job of writing down their reasoning before they commit some epic mistake to paper. You would think.\n\nAlas, no. And it falls to historians such as I to clean up the mess.
Don't just stand there. What's the name of the sixth king of Camlorn?\n\nQuick, now! This is important!
So, do you have an overbearing parent who just happens to be the world-famous Skald-King? No? How fortunate for you.\n\nSometimes I suspect I'll never live up to his expectations.

Yes, Adusa is a vampire. Surely you have learned by now that not every vampire is a monster. This one hopes her nature doesn't make you uncomfortable, because Adusa likes it here and isn't ready to leave just yet.

Find one of my Scrolls of Glorious Battle. They're brilliant! Didn't know a lick of magic at the time, but that didn't stop me. I beat those words into the pages by sheer force of will.\n\nImagine the outcome if I could actually read and write!
You look like someone stuffed a horker into a Goblin and then beat it with a dead mammoth.\n\nRough night?
I heard a rumor that Caddach can read. All that time in the Imperial City, I suppose. \n\nNot good for a person, I say.

Strategy is my forte. Strategy and diplomacy. Well, maybe not diplomacy. My father the Skald-King tells me I have to work on that. So here I am, out among the little people, trying to be diplomatic.\n\nHow am I doing so far?
Most cannot see Adusa-daro. Not unless she wishes to be seen. Like a shadow, this one is.\n\nConsider yourself privileged, five-claw.
Please, friend, do not tell anyone that Adusa is here. This one prefers to maintain a low profile when she is working.
Is it your intention to bore me to death?
Let's go find someone to help.
Attack!
They made their choices. So be it.

Excuse the smell, but you must deal with it. Boiled fish for today's soup. I do not trust a fish soup if it does not waft in all directions.\n\nI will admit, though, that this one is particularly … pungent.

I once met a Nord who asked if I would make a soup with mead. By the Egg, I thought them mad. But once I perfected the recipe, it turned out delicious.\n\nNow, don't go getting any ideas. I still hate taking requests.

I confess I have been rather critical of mortal frailties and your so-called food. But there is something to be said for the substance you refer to as cake.\n\nDo you happen to have any more lying around?
I think the Waking Flame just doesn't understand the real message of Mehrunes Dagon. It's about change, not destruction.\n\nMostly.

You'd be surprised how many Daedric cultists come from wealthy families. Must have something to do with all the leisure time and disposable income.\n\nAnd boredom. Boredom can lead to truly stupid pursuits.
For my own curiosity, could you recount the experience of your birth? It sounds like a perfectly awful way to begin one's existence on this plane, but I require more details to know for sure.
The best advice I can give a mortal is this: Never ask a question to which you do not want to know the answer. Ignorance can be a kindness, my sweet morsel.
There's a difference between killing in battle and killing in cold blood. I think you've forgotten that.
Killing time is dangerous. Eventually time will return the favor.
Healing! Please!
How can I help?
They always stumble, who run too fast. Haven't you heard that one?
You know the hardest thing about riding this fast? The ground!
I don't have a romantic partner back home, but I know a girl who would get mad if she heard me say that.
Farewell, my friend.
I think I'm bleeding!
Retreat and heal yourself!
I'm here for you!
What is it now?
You're getting good at that.
Got a moment to talk?
You can't go back and make a new beginning, but you can always start over and make a new ending.
Fight through it!
They got your minion!
Best not take any chances with this one.
Miss me?
I really don't like your odds.
Was that the last of them? Thank Vehk.
Dunmer are long lived, but we can die of boredom.

I sometimes wonder what it must be like for Daedra. Going through their lives with no real sense of time passing them by. Where loss and death are annoying trivialities. No wonder they feel powerful, and hollow.
Don't you die on me!
I think they're getting flustered!
Loyal to the end.
This is going to be a fight. Let's not make it our last.
I do a great deal of worrying in my daily life. It's nice to put that behind me for a bit.
Perhaps I should develop a hobby. Tailoring? No, too much like sewing the tears in Lady Laurent's undergarments. Beekeeper? No, I'm dreadfully afraid of the stings.\n\nI shall need to ponder further.
I spend many of my days fretting over one thing or another. And worrying. I do a lot of worrying.
I heard Argonians are fond of juicy grubs, just like the Wood Elves. But Seeks and Walks-Softly both wrinkled their snouts at me when I offered them a handful. They were fresh, too.
Why do so many hideouts have to be in sewers? I mean, I know most people's curiosity stops at the smell, but is that worth taking your meals in the city latrine?
[frustrated Goblin gibberish about how minotaur smell bad]
Repeat to yourself—my gullet feels no pain!
I like places where things have happened, even if they were sad things.
Some people don't like the bustle of cities, but I come from a big family, so it reminds me of home.
M'aiq has been called the Liar on many occasions. But does truth depend on the mouth that speaks or the ear that hears it?
Perhaps I should develop a hobby. Tailoring? No, too much like sewing the tears in Lady Laurent's undergarments. Beekeeper? No, I'm dreadfully afraid of the stings.\n\nI shall need to ponder further.
I spend many of my days fretting over one thing or another. And worrying. I do a lot of worrying.

I have been practicing my rhetoric, featherless. All the greatest knights possess tongues of silver! Let us face off in a battle of words! Words!\n\nThe viewpoint to discuss—the superiority of crows above all creatures. Debate me at your own peril!
Perhaps I should develop a hobby. Tailoring? No, too much like sewing the tears in Lady Laurent's undergarments. Beekeeper? No, I'm dreadfully afraid of the stings.\n\nI shall need to ponder further.
I spend many of my days fretting over one thing or another. And worrying. I do a lot of worrying.

Sometimes I marvel at the creativity of hedge-mages and lay practitioners. I only ever learned how to shatter stone and melt steel, not sear a steak or wash my hair. There are so many subtle uses for magic beyond blowing up fortifications.
Why do so many hideouts have to be in sewers? I mean, I know most people's curiosity stops at the smell, but is that worth taking your meals in the city latrine?

People call us Daedra! Can you imagine? Daedra … feh. Like the Blackfeather Court has anything in common with that ugly rabble! Do those ugly, toddler-sized Banekin have knights and ladies? I think not!

I find cities to be rather overwhelming. All the sights, sounds … smells.\n\nA battlemage requires years of ascetic training. Study, isolation, practice, and little else. I do want to experience everything I've missed, but preferably not all at once.
Qukikh, you forgot to carry the one again, didn't you? I thought so. Right. Back we go.
As you walk the roads of Tamriel, keep your eyes on the path ahead. You never know when M'aiq might wander by.
By my will.
What do you wish of me, mortal? What favor do you beg of the mighty Arox?\n\nI can be generous, when the mood strikes me.

Heh! Just think of it. While Nass toils away with her books and her accounts, I am free to do anything I like! But how can I tell Nass I'm malingering unless I return to the House of Whims to rub it in her face?\n\nDecisions, decisions ….
I'm really not supposed to talk about the Psijic Order. Or Artaeum. Or Daedric relics for that matter. So let's see. What does that leave us?\n\nRead any good tomes or scrolls lately?
I am no one's curio or pet. I am Arox the Mutilator, the Ruin of Varondo, Terror of the Burning—hey! Hey! Down here!

You don't know the House of Whims? It's only the most fabulous and enticing establishment in all the realms of Oblivion! If you don't believe Hezehk, just ask Madam Whim. She tells us these words constantly.
I may be a lowly member of the Psijic Order, but my experiences in Oblivion are going to be invaluable! I'll prove myself and advance in rank in no time!
Back again? Good! We can stop training when we're dead!
…appen…
People always ask me what weapon I favor. Truth is, I favor anything within arm's reach that's heavier than a pillow.\n\nI tried to fend off a rival with a pillow once. Ah, that was adorable.
Braving the vortex might save you, if you don't die thrashing and gasping for air.
The best thing about being a professional raconteur? The freedom! Followed closely by the ability to call yourself a professional raconteur.\n\nIntroductions like that really make an impression!
This is so much better than reading!
Aw, I was having fun with that one!
Yay, us!
I've been waiting to try this out!
Wahoo!

Sometimes I think about who I'd be if I didn't have magic. The answer is a thief, probably, but who knows? Maybe if I hadn't figured out a way to zap my enemies with lightning I'd have chosen a less risky profession. A baker, maybe?
I would have never seen anything like this if I'd stayed at Tor Draioch.
I feel amazing! I've learned more with you than I ever learned with Magister Irin.
You're looking especially strong lately, I like it!
I love any excuse to sneak around, so long as I never get caught. That just ruins the fun of it.
Magic cat, ready for business.
Bullying dumb dogs feels good.
Die, ugly!
Nice!
You're almost too good at that.
I had no idea that was worth so much!
I prefer to be optimistic about life. I mess up a lot, probably more than your average Khajiit, but at least I learn something every time. And I keep things exciting that way.
You don't want to do this!
When we tell the story of that fight later, let's exaggerate … just a bit.
What do you say to some celebratory sweets?
Stendarr, give me strength!
Let's go.

Can I tell you a secret? Daedra terrify me. It's part of why I feel, I know, we have to fight them. They're just wrong. I'd never claim to know the plan the Divines have for us. But whatever it is, those things play no part in it.
You know, I've read about this place. Amazing!
Hah. A new chapter for Dame Isobel! … Too much?
Your quest to improve never ends. Just like a knight.

Some of my favorite tales are those of the alliance leaders. And the Companions, the adventuring group? Incredible. \n\nEspecially Lyris Titanborn. She's so … impressive. Ahem. Never mind. Forget I said anything.
Isobel Veloise, at your service.
Stendarr, bar that thing from a swift return.
You're like the hero of a fantastic tale. And I get to ride with you. Hah!
Blessings to Stendarr, his might was with us.
Each time we approach the enclave I get a little bit excited. Do you feel the same way?
I'm thinking of starting up a letter correspondence with Knight Commander Jourvel, my mentor back on High Isle. I bet she'd like that. She seems so lonely these days.
Do you like stinky fish? Rigurt loves stinky fish! The fishmonger in Lower Yorgrim sells the stinkiest!
Rigurt goes where the winds of diplomacy take him. And wherever the Skald-King sends him. As long as there's mead. And rabbit meatballs. \n\nRigurt loves rabbit meatballs.
Y'ffre provides a banquet every day, free to all who heed his teachings.
I love torchbugs. Y'ffre's joy, or so my mentor once called them. I have a feeling there's more to these creatures than we suspect.

Don't tell anyone, but you know what I discovered recently that I just absolutely adore? Salad!\n\nI couldn't believe it. I mean, it's just a bowl of leaves, right? I feel like a goat or a deer or something eating them. But, they're so darn tasty!

Ever been to Gonfalon Bay? It's fine, but I'd like it better if there was a decent mug of rotmeth to be had in the city. I mean, what's the problem? It's not like it requires a royal vineyard. Just squeeze some rats over a bucket and you're all set!
Has your courage faded?

Where I hail from, most people don't trust magic. Not all of them, mind you, but by Tu'whacca's tail, the ones that don't will sure as sand let you know it.\n\nI never understood that, even before I joined the Mages Guild.

I'm not an old barnacle when it comes to the study of magic. I came to the art later in life, but I seem to have quite the aptitude for it. If I'd started sooner, who knows where I'd be now? \n\nHmm. Doesn't matter. That me would be boring as sand.
A comfortable enough dwelling for Tadali to visit. This one is pleased.
Have you traveled much, walker? This one is curious what draws another to explore the width and breadth of Tamriel.

Why the Divines spared me from the Thrassian Plague, I have no clue. But since they did, I'm going to make it count. That's why I signed up for this crazy expedition. Some call it Olo's Folly, but I'm proud to be a part of the All Flags Navy!

A visitor to this charming domicile had the audacity to claim that I had died at the battle of Thras. Don't they realize it's bad luck to make predictions such as that, even in jest!\n\nI had half a mind to make them walk the plank, curse their bones!
Obey me or watch the others suffer!
Welcome back, good friend! It is always a pleasure to talk nonsense with someone, and to have his nonsense respected.
Congratulations!
This one sees you are out of crates. You will need to purchase more to continue, my friend.
You have no crates just now. More can be found on the store, my friend.
Your friend Pacrooti is here when you need him.
Ahh, these gem shine like the moons!
Time is no consequence to me. I will be ready to advise you until the last day you draw breath.

You look strong and fit. I have no doubt you'd make a good sparring partner. I admit, these days I'm far too busy to clash swords with anyone in the training fields, but I do miss it dearly. There's nothing like a challenge to get the fluids flowing.

Green preserve us, I've spent my life on Galen and it still manages to surprise me. There are secrets there that have yet to be unlocked—not even the druids know the whole story of this land. It's a fascinating place. Visit, if you haven't already.
If there's anyone you need me to knock some sense into, just say the word.
The Pounce is a fine ship. And if anyone says anything different, I'll bite their head off.

The hunt leaves me precious little time to form long-lasting bonds, let alone make friends. I was asked once by another hunter to have dinner together in an informal setting. He was … quite handsome. And also, of course, a vampire. So it goes.
I have, on occasion, crossed blades with the Morag Tong. I despise politics of any stripe. The blood politics of lazy, indolent merchant lords and narcissistic wizard princes positively sickens me.
*Suffering Gibberish*
*Suffering Gibberish*
Ice is my specialty.
This is incredible! And scary.
My spells are so much more powerful!
Stand still.

I got my start looting treasure from shallow shipwrecks. I had an eye for finding scattered coins and jewels half-buried in the sand. And it helped that I was faster than the local mudcrabs. You don't want to get a finger caught in those pincers!

Here's a little known tip. You can sharpen your knife against the hard shell of a mudcrab. Just make sure to get them nestled between your boots so they can't scuttle away. And do mind their claws. They don't take kindly to this sort of treatment.

This one once made the mistake of joining some soldiers in a drinking competition. It seems size does not equate to skill in this particular area. It took only three pints to send J'baanluk into the fields, bellowing songs from his childhood.

If you ever anger a Pahmar-raht, remember that flattery goes a long way to stay their blade. For instance, this one is partial to compliments about his fur or kind words regarding his deep and penetrating eyes.

We really try not to use the word cult. We're the Order of the Sacred Skeever!\n\nWell, I am. And my friend Marthine. And a couple of nice people who took a pamphlet. Well, they looked at it. And put it back. But we'll be a proper society in no time!
Feel my head. Do I feel warm to you? I've been trying to develop a raging fever all week, but Peryite has yet to bless me with one. I wonder what I did to anger the Father of Skeevers this time.
This should stop you.
No mage or fighter will stop what's started here.
Even the simplest of adepts and casters solved this puzzle.
Take all the time you need, it won't change anything.
This one's mine.
Gotta be better than that.
You good? Of course you are.
Face my better nature!
Here we go.

Did a job once collecting Nordic Barnacles for this Imperial provisioner. Said it was for some holiday she called Fishing Day. Never heard of it before, but I think it ought to catch on. Actually, I take it back. Every day should be Fishing Day.
It's nice to look at, sure. But let's not let it slow us down.
Getting stronger every day.
Always finding room for improvement.
I'll never stop saying it: repair your gear. Pay someone, or get a kit and do it yourself. \n\nIf you get caught somewhere with broken gear, I'm not gonna be happy.
What are we up to today?

I'm trying to get better at Tales of Tribute. I just can't understand how some people play whole entire games without the Crows patron.\n\nIf you can't rake in piles of gold every turn, what's the point of playing at all?
I'm still feisty!
Going to need a moment. I'm not a young man.
Ruinous Ebullition!
(disgruntled grumble)

On reflection, I wish I'd had the chance to repair my relationship with Martina before she died. Back then, it seemed logical to conclude our collaboration. It no longer served either of us. But … perhaps something more was lost, as well.
Enlightenment! Progress!
Hah! Your search for knowledge continues.

I hate … for lack of a more scholarly term … icky creatures. You know, stink monsters like ogres, harpies, trolls. And do not get me started on the likes of dreugh, chaurus or … mudcrabs. Those tiny pincers. Those beady eyes. Nightmare fuel!
What will we learn today?

My older brother was in the Fighters Guild. Imagine the contrast between us! He was wounded fighting were-vultures, or some damned thing, and came home to a hero's welcome.\n\nI was quite acerbic about the whole experience, I'll be honest.
When's the last time you took a good look through this rucksack of yours? There's an old sweetroll in here with more mold than Sadrith Mora.

Once, a group of bandits mistook my troupe for defenseless. A silly thought, really. After all, you must learn how to swing a sword before you can fight on a stage. Each of my troupe is as skilled a sword fighter as they are a performer.

Have you read the Warrior-Poet Vivec's work? It's no wonder that moonlet hangs still over his city. I, too, froze in my tracks the first time I read his verse. It's both a lullaby and a battle cry. Beauty and terror. And still l do it no justice.
I'm going to let you in on a little secret. Rats … unsettle me. Whether on land or at sea, I insist on keeping my ship swabbed and clean. I just can't stand rats.
Strange thing. I hated it when the Spearhead was beached at Stros M'Kai. But now, I kind of miss that place.
I have some ideas about organizing the mortal realm. There are obvious places for improvement. But why bother? Your existence barely lasts a blink of my smallest ocular orb.
Do you hear that? It's the entropic disintegration of all matter and thought, rushing toward us from the end of time. Nothing to be done about it. It will be here soon enough.
This isn't the end of our fight.
You will die before your questions are answered.
I couldn't beat you before. Whatever will I do?
I create kindred creatures of chaos!
Which draws your focus? The ground or the sky?
I'll cut through fate.
Change is good. Embrace it.
Don't hurt me.
Surprise.
You haven't begun to stop me.
Dusk falls and the stars resume their nightly search.
I have more power than you know.
You are a rebellious reflection of me.
The search will continue.
This is not how the archive is supposed to behave.
She just enjoys toying with us.
Leave the ink alone, Tho'at.
Well, isn't this place nice. Tho'at couldn't furnish it?
Stand by me when you want me to call on Tho'at.
I call your essence from wherever you are. Join us here!
Ah, the filers found a secondary location. No maligraphies, but a Verse. If you want it.
Mortals trade. I trade too. Take what you want and give me what I want. Equal. Agreed. No sadness. Yes?
A wonderful showing. You'll perform excellently in front of a crowd.
Now don't run away. There's a perfectly reasonable explanation for this. It's rather humiliating, but my soul is trapped inside this ludicrous toy.
In my line of work, getting encased inside a doll is an occupational hazard, darling.

There are bigger mysteries than just murder. Grand, exciting mysteries! The disappearance of the Dwarves, for example. \n\nOn second thought, Mizzik feels fine investigating smaller mysteries for now.

For many people, the allure of correcting someone is far more fragrant than holding one's tongue.\n\nTherefore, Mizzik says that if you ever want to get someone to talk, tell them what you know—but tell it wrong.
I like getting out there to see new places. Just a matter of figuring out how to get paid at the same time.

You read up on this All Flags fleet at all? History's funny. Something bad comes along, it brings folks together. Then once it's past, they all go right back to fighting each other. Trust me. I've seen it happen firsthand.
These things don't die easily.
I'm the one who summoned you, Tho'at.
If you want to join my students, I'd be happy to teach you what I know.
The great Aramril is always prepared for a duel!
Filer Xess told me to check on you, but I think you can handle this.
Those sweetrolls aren't for you.
I can run as long as you can, goat.
Moonlight … a fool's refuge!

Ah, a mortal. If you want to survive out there in the infinite, it's good you stopped here.\n\nTake a breath. Look around. Buy something. Your life's too short to go running into danger without the necessary precautions.
My name, Keshu, means stands apart in the language of Jel. \n\nDespite this, I have always found it far more beneficial to stand together.

One struggle during my time as a Pact general was learning to speak in a way that my allies could digest.\n\nOur scales are moist, but our words are dry. Still, any habit can be broken in time, just like my reliance on analogies to teeba-hatsei.

I wandered alone through the forests a lot as a child. Learned valuable hunting skills. Hunger is great inspiration for teaching you how to catch food. Now I use those skills for other reasons. And I get my food from the market same as everyone else.

Ever heard of this Morag Tong? Sounds to me like they're just in it for the money. Sending souls into the Void gives me a higher purpose beyond simple profit.\n\nThough, I wouldn't mind buying that Naryu a mead or three. She's a looker!
Don't be alarmed, but could you show me in advance where the privy is? My wolf side has learned some manners while in polite company, but apparently some basic etiquette still eludes her.

The Silver Dawn hunted my clan when I was young. We had to wander through Skyrim for years to stay ahead of their blades. I haven't felt comfortable living in one place ever since. But I'm working on it.
Right this way, mortal. To me and your well deserved rewards!
Watch for the axe!
Another joins my ranks.
Swiftly, my allies.
Fight back with all your skill!
Battles are won or lost on the battlefield of your mind, warrior. Gather the Green about you and master the conflict within.
<Tzozabrar looks at you. You look back at Tzozabrar. Sometimes communication goes beyond mere words.>
(Goblin GIbberish 07)
It's interesting you thought that would work.
Seekers tremble and lurkers shriek at the sight of my bargain prices.
A favor given becomes a favor returned. Eventually. Remember that, friend.
I don't have any specific opinions on the Tribunal. I try to ignore religion and hope religion leaves me alone in return.
You will not hold me back!
I will be fulfilled!
I hope this hurts.
These mirrors see everything!
Look and panic!
Get rid of the barrier!
Accept your fate quietly!
(Goblin GIbberish 07)

Even after everything she put me through. I sometimes see a breathtaking sight or a feat of magic and think of my mom. Strange, isn't it? How a person can break you down to nothing, but still leave you feeling grateful.
Let's cause some trouble.
Nothing will hold me back!
Let's teach them a lesson.
Agh, I forgot to keep score!
(Excited screaming).
Just another obstacle.
Think it had anything good?
Let me show you how it's done.
Ahh. It's so nice here.
Here we go! Hah!
Do people still bury treasure, or no?
What a find!
You're a natural.

There was this old clan-mother I knew. I would roll my eyes every time she spoke of the good old days of her youth. Now, the things I hear myself say … I sound very much like her. It seems nostalgia rivals skooma in its potency.
May we walk paths as many as Akha.
Jo'zhet! A new level of strength and understanding.
A fight, is it?
Silence. At last.
With the wrath of Boethra!
Spirits of the sky, see us to victory!
Besha, Azurah. Besha.
Azurah, witness my devotion!
The spirits smile upon this place. Bebaj tsin'rajiit.
Hah!
Ah. Something nice?
Kss. You get all the luck, tamiit.
Bebaj'ay! Blessed moons smile upon you.
