Blood? An acquired taste. My first few days as a vampire required choking down that viscous liquid.\n\nBut I've come to accept and even appreciate its nuanced flavors. My favorite comes from a highly relaxed Nord. I would describe it as crisp.

My interest in the healing arts began as a way to study alchemy, but it's since grown very important to me. Once I became a creature that typically heralds death, I wanted to move in the other direction. Sustaining life feels more valuable now.
Have you scribed that perfect skill yet? Spilled ink to perfect your favorite spell? \n\nLet's see, maybe I can help.
Squash them! Make them rue the day they challenged you.
Were you always this violent? Or is it a learned trait?
Have I mentioned how much I value our alliance?
More maligraphies incoming. Prepare yourself!
I studied up. I prepared. I can do this. I can be a merchant. \n\nIf you just indicate what you want, we can trade for it and all will be well.

Not only an author and adventurer, the great Narsis Dren is also a remarkable teacher. I give my apprentices hands-on experience. That's why they often come back from their adventures a little worse for wear. All part of my esteemed tutelage.

Not all treasure is created equal. It takes years of study to discern the fine details between, say, traditional Dwemer beard bands and earrings. Very minute stuff. Luckily, people don't ask many questions when something is sufficiently ancient.
I don't know the first thing about wine, but the second I'm feeling flirty, I pretend to have an encyclopedic knowledge. I just can't stop myself from digging a wine barrel sized hole every time.
Hey, you know what would be fun? Let's sneak out and bite some unsuspecting peasants! Ah, good times! Good times.
I think we can help each other. I have some big ideas, and you … well, you have opposable thumbs.

One time, just because I felt like it, I broke into the Alinor Archeological Society to steal back a Khajiiti relic. This beautiful idol carved from an enormous chunk of moonstone. You should try it sometime. Very cathartic.
Do not mind me staring at your garments. I am from a different time, and I have never been good at hiding my curiosity. My scrutiny should feel nothing less than complimentary.

I have always admired those whose healing energies can pull others back from the brink of death.\n\nHad I not been called by Azurah to a warrior's creed, I would have liked to follow a healer's path myself.
Your pathetic attacks bore me!
Feel what Cato feels!
Atronachs are not immune to the cold.
This never ends.
Well, this place is not exactly the Perfect Pounce, but it is quite nice in its own way. Za'ji thinks it could use a few more anchors, though.
A palace may be grand and fine, but you see very little of the world from it windows. That is why Za'ji likes to roam. The view is much, much better.
We dance your doom!

My fondest memories of my father revolve around the winery's tasting room. I'd sit on his lap while he hummed and gave orders to the staff. A man of few words.\n\nI like to think I inherited his even temperament, or at least his love of fine wine.

My mother's senses were at their sharpest in a ballroom. Every whisper, every sip of wine, every playful touch or naughty glance—nothing escaped her notice. She'd tell me everything on the carriage ride home, laughing the whole way.

Never imagined that caring for Muffins would get me into alchemy, but I'm very allergic to mammoth dander. I make a special tonic every day so I don't break out in hives when I bury my face in Muffins' fur. Tastes foul but I'm working on that.

I rescued Muffins while sneaking around a Riekr camp during my travels in the far north. She was so tiny! And she made the most feeble little trumpet sound. It was love at first sight.\n\nI saved her. But sometimes it feels like she saved me.
I feel so hot. The mud outside was so cool. Could I go lie down in it?
Keep it coming. The heat's rising, but we're not there yet.
We're almost there! Just a little more.
Don't suppose you've got a few coins to spare?
Don't suppose you've got a few coins to spare?
Sub-optimal.
They'll never believe this …
The Pact soldiers spend their time watching for looters. Looters! There are undead skulking around town, and they're worried about looters.
The Pact soldiers spend their time watching for looters. Looters! They're the least of our problems.
This is war. There's no time for romance!
What's this? The curse is gone? My freedom has returned.
Once we get what we need, it'll be up to you.
I'm sorry we're not any use in a fight.
I'm not sure how I feel about trading with outsiders. I must trust the Farseer's judgment, though.
Mud huts don't have a lot going for them, but at least they don't really burn.
<<1>> has to have more rare books around here somewhere.
Could you come back later?
Her voice is amazing.
Do you fear your own death? I look forward to it.
Muckspunge? The Ashkhan likes grilled muckspunge? I thought only crones ate muckspunge.
Something so important!
Someone dig me out!
The body of the divine wills us into being. Venerate the gods as one. For we are one with the gods.
Kill it again! Make it die!
I've heard the Withered Hand raise the dead.
Tradition means nothing to those Forebear lunatics. Just burn down the spires, I say.
The body of the divine wills us into being. Venerate the gods as one. For we are one with the gods.
Maybe a night in the Cave will help your attitude!
Are you crying? Good!
Oh, I'm sure your friends won't die in the cave. Well. They might, I suppose …
You're no match for us.
Don't judge Riften by what you see now. It's not always this messy.
You would like the sands, I think.
Let them see her wisdom.
Take one of 'em alive so we can have some fun later.
You're dead!
You're not gonna leave here alive.
Damn you for leaving me with these idiots, Telenger!
No society stands after Stendarr has deserted it. Make offerings to the god of righteous rule so that Daggerfall remains strong and pure.
With your flesh I shall hunt!
Time to cut you up and feed you to the sharks!
The cheese is testing me. I'll show her!
Can you not feel the hatred that burns within its belly! Bars barely contain its hunger!
That was terrible! Let's go get into a real fight now!
Flow through your enemies and you will wash them away!
I've heard the Chalice of Mara has mystical properties. Maybe that's why the Stonefire Cult wants it.
Your weariness and despair are my meat and drink, and I am famished!
I'm afraid of Sangur.
Weakling. Pathetic piece of filth. Leave while yet you can.
The armies of Coldharbour are upon you! Submit to their rule!
It is you who will strike the final blow at our enemies. You are almost ready.
The ends and the means are one. And you are both.
This will not finish me!
I am patient. This world will one day be mine.
I knew you were coming for me.
How could Lavinia do this?
May your guiding hand aid in the endeavors of your lowly children.
I knew it would be you. I knew it! You were known!
The Black Books have always been … and not.

I met a drunk Bosmer hunter the other day, small and stringy, not too bright. \n\nThought he'd make a nice pet, but he didn't stay long after he woke up. Ran off into the woods screaming … your granny Alyxe has that effect sometimes.
Be beneficent, wanderer, and may Zeht enlarge you!
Well, that's done. Now, where'd I put my jagga? I need a drink.
I can't believe you just did that.
Weaklings, all of you!
This can't be all there is to the afterlife. Must be some way to pass onto the next plane. Some cliff I could jump off. Maybe a tiger could eat me.
Why? Why is this happening?
It smells of wet fur and death!
Why do you insist on continuing down this path? You are not wanted here.
We cut the Nedes of old to ribbons. You will fare no better.
M'aiq thought High King Emeric would have the tallest castle. Oh, well.
There won't be enough left of you to bury.
The crowd demands carnage!
I will drive Men and Mer from Nirn.
Nirn of old was nearly uninhabitable by the likes of you. I will see that it returns to that state.
Good show! I haven't heard my master laugh so hard in an Elf's age!
It's too late to flee! You're prey for the Court, now!
The Serpent will not suffer your presence! Die!
So many mortals this day. More to feed the flames!
You know not what you challenge!
You get used to the splinters. In case you wonder.
This one sees that you've been working hard.
We do not share the delivery route. You never know who spies for bandits.
Inbound shipments are delayed. I can't move these until the wagon arrives.
I don't know if I'm cut out for this work. Too much lifting and receipt-writing.
With goods like these, the Daedra won't stand a chance—not even in their own home.
Freed but still dead. This is ironic.
I cannot be seen like this! Avert your eyes!
One day I'll be free. And nothing will stop the nightmares from taking you.
Show yourself!
Something's falling.
Did you come here to be processed, mortal? We will indulge you!
Time to die!
The White-Gold Tower is mine!
A feast awaits us!
Bring the prisoners before me, for my judgment!
Come out! Protect your master!
Let me wrap you in the finest silks!
Serve me, my minions!
I give you new life, my pets!
These bloodsacks shall burst before me.
I do not suppose you predicted this, but now is the moment when you surrender and pay your bounty.
You know the law. You commit a crime, you pay a bounty.
Let us keep this quick. Pay up and I ... wait, am I supposed to let you go? That does not sound right.
Come now, surrender. Do not make this some sort of crime binge.
Pay the fine and you'll receive fair treatment. Honestly! Would the Guard ever lie to you?
Too late to run, you writhing maggot. Your bounty, or your life.
Why does the criminal element insist on being difficult? Pay your fine and save us both some grief.
You simply must surrender and pay your fine. That is the way things are done here.
Pay up, lawbreaker, or we will have stern words! As soon as I remember where I put my weapon ....
Another half-wit attempts to elude the law, and another half-wit fails. Spectacular!
Your actions prove your guilt, but there is no need to die this day. Pay your bounty.
I need you to pay your bounty. For your crimes. And because, you know, justice.
Time to pay up. You can run if you want, but believe me, you will not enjoy the catching part.
Yes, yes. It is just a misunderstanding. I know. Nonetheless, I must demand you pay the bounty.
Will you pay your bounty, criminal, or must I draw my weapon and smite you repeatedly?
Stay your arms and render payment. Quickly, now. I have more rats to round up today.
Surrender, scum! That means 'give up.' I know, I know ... small words, short sentences.
I'm probably wasting my time, but I'll ask anyway. Will you pay your bounty?
When life hands you a rotten mudcrab, your only option is to pay your fine and beg for the law's mercy.
Your crime spree is at an end, milk-blood. Pay your bounty now. I make this demand only once.
If you run, you won't get away. Because I'll run after you. So just pay the bounty.
Forget something, toad? Resist if you want, but it's tough to hop away with broken legs.
You haven't paid for your crimes. Hand over you bounty so I can get back to the tavern.
Pay your fine, villain, or we will battle! As soon as I remember where I left my sword ....
I've got you surrounded. Don't make me nervous! I get all twitchy when I'm nervous.
I'm sorry, but I must demand your bounty. I'm sure you understand.
I ask you to yield, as I detest violence. That doesn't mean I won't get violent if required to, however.
You'll pay now, criminal scum. (Was that good? Did I sound authoritative?)
You'd think I'd find this more exciting, but no. Anyway, will you yield and pay your fine?
The captain says you must pay 'restitution.' Whatever that means.
Bounty's too nice for the likes of you.
Even the prettiest saplings must be pruned. Especially when they branch into criminal activity.
In the name of the law, I demand ... or, y'know ... politely request payment on your bounty.
Scum like you gives scum like me a bad name. Now, come quietly.
Some guards demand payment. Me? I just stare and make you feel uncomfortable until I gut you.
As much as it pains me to do so, I must ask you to lay down your weapons and pay your fine.
We know what you've done--you can't escape. But you're going to try, aren't you? Pity.
You'll  most likely flee, but I have to ask you anyway: will you pay your bounty?
Justice strikes like hot butter through a knife! Wait, that doesn't sound right.
Cooperate, or I will put you down.
Surrender, villain! Can I call you villain? Do you prefer scoundrel? Hooligan? Whatever works for you.
I suppose I should be excited to stop a criminal, but I can't muster the energy. Just ... just pay your bounty.
Guilty? Innocent? What do I know of such things? Pay your bounty and I'm sure we can clear this up.
As Y'ffre is my witness, I will smite you if you refuse to pay your bounty.
I'm here to collect your bounty. Please don't make me chase you. I hate chasing people.
This is usually a waste of my time, but I'll ask anyway. Lawbreaker, will you pay your bounty?
Why'd you have to ruin a perfectly comfortable day?
Just pay the bounty. No need to die for your crimes today.
Halt, you vile offender! As much as this depresses me, I must uphold the letter of the law!
If you refuse to settle your accounts, then I'm afraid you will leave me no choice.
If you pay your bounty like a good criminal, I may let you see my collection of antique riding crops.
Oh yes. I know who you are. So do the other guards. You're smart, you'll just pay up now.
Only the gods can truly judge you, but society demands that you account for your crimes.
I'm sure you hate hearing this over and over, but it's my job. Will you pay your bounty?
What a catch! I'll certainly have a story to tell tomorrow at muster! Now, about that bounty ....
The book of laws is clear--pay your bounty or your punishment will be more than you can bear.
Punishing parasites like you is the reason I get up in the morning.
Let me state this plainly so that you clearly understand. Pay your bounty or there will be pain.
I-I don't want to inconvenience you, but ... I-I have to ask for your bounty.
Make restitution, say you're sorry, and this will all go away. I promise.
You've got a bounty to pay, but don't fret.  Play your cards right and you'll be on your way before you know it.
No one can skirt the law forever, friend. Now why don't you pay up and we can call it a day?
Hand over your bounty. If you reach for your weapons, I'll kill you where you stand.
You aren't going to run, are you? Just pay off your bounty so I can get back to my drink.
Crime only pays if I get a cut, s'wit. Remember that for next time.
If you were a real criminal, I don't suppose I would've caught you. You still need to pay me, though.
Ah! Another flotsom of crime washes up to my shore! Will you pay your bounty now?
I have a poem for you: What oh what will the criminal do? Pay the bounty or get run-through?
I don't suppose it's your fault. I suppose your parents simply didn't teach you any better.
My, you have been a busy scoundrel! Well, lucky for you I'm here to collect what you owe.
The law is clear. Pay your bounty or face the ramifications of your act.
Your crimes have caught up with you. It is time to pay your bounty.
Almsivi knows your crimes ... as do I. Pay up, s'wit.
I am in an ill temper, so just pay your bounty and be on your way.
If it was up to me, I'd just have criminal filth like you killed on sight. It'd be less of a hassle.
I'm here to collect the bounty. For that unfortunate incident? Look, don't make me spell it out.
The gods will have justice for your crimes, one way or the other.
I don't know if I can do this guard job. My heart is pounding! I don't like confronting people.
Oh! Look what crawled up from the dung-heap—a pathetic criminal. I hope you can pay your bounty.
If my superiors weren't watching, we could deal with this in a different fashion. However ....
For many, the bounty is the warning they need that their life has gone awry. I hope it's the same for you.
This one knows who you are. All the guards do. Your only chance is to pay your bounty.
Surrender at once! Don't make another move without paying the fine!
It's not this one's place to judge, only to collect the bounty that is owed.
I enjoy a good chase, but did you consider what happens next? Let's collect that bounty and find out, yes?
Smart, but not as smart as me. Pay the bounty, or I'll be forced to get creative.
So tell me, walker. Do you feel that luck is on your side or will you pay your fine?
Surrender and pay your fine, if you please, and this one will not beat you until you bleed.
Guilty? Who am I to judge? But I must insist you pay your bounty, if you would be so kind.
This one has decided he doesn't want you to pay your fine. Resist so that I can hurt you very badly.
Yet another criminal who dares to cross this one's path? Pay your bounty, you dungy coward.
It is this one's duty to demand payment in accordance with local and regional statutes.
Pay me your bounty, walker. This one will put it to good use by ... uhm ... giving it to the poor. Yes.
Your crime spree is over, walker. Pay the fine or face the consequences. There will be no second warning.
Will you yield and make compensation, or must I sheathe my weapon in your soft and tender flesh?
You don't move until you've paid the fine.
No one can evade the guards forever. Just pay your bounty and then it's no longer a problem.
Will you pay your bounty, must I introduce your face to the ground?
All right. Pay your bounty. What's the delay? Do I have to count it out for you?
If you make me run any more, I will beat you. Now, pay your fine, villain.
This ends now, outlaw!
Next time you break the law, make sure I'm not watching. Not that you're hard on the eyes.
You know how to clear your record? Just pay your bounty! I can take care of that for you.
There are laws here, and it's my duty to enforce them. You have a bounty and I must collect it.
I almost never drink on duty, but I'm having a bad day. Don't ask. Just pay your bounty and go away.
I have a thought. Pay your bounty and I won't pull your arms from their sockets.
Your actions scream guilt. I see no contrition. That pains me, it really does.
I ... I need you to pay your bounty. If you refuse someone will probably chase you. Just fair warning.
Let's see. So that's what you did, huh? Why am I not surprised? Just pay your bounty and you can go.
I remember the old days when we would just pound your head in after a crime. This is much easier!
I know, I'm irresistible. I hear that all the time. Let's keep this professional and settle your account.
Pay the bounty or pay the price! Now, where did I put my weapon?
Getting caught stinks like rotten chaurus eggs, doesn't it? Why not give me the gold and keep walking?
Ah, there must be some mistake. How could someone as upstanding as you wind up on my bounty list?
All right ogre-bait, I'm giving you to the count of three to pay your bounty! One …. Two….
You're gonna pay your bounty, right? If not, I'll put the hurt on you!
Here we go again: Cooperate and I won't have to kill you.
I am this close to losing it! This close! So pay your bounty and stop aggravating me!
There's one way to make this all go away. It requires gold and a sincere apology, you skeever.
Shh! Don't tell anyone I was drinking on duty. Just ... just pay your bounty and be on your way.
I could suggest another way to pay your debt to society, but it wouldn't be proper.
Make the right decision and pay up. I won't give you another opportunity.
Yeah, yeah--let's skip the protests, all right? You're caught. Just pay the bounty and you can go.
Sloppy! How do you expect to get rich owing bounties like this?
I'm supposed to ask for your gold, but I have no idea why. Anyway, will you? I need to settle your bounty.
Try to run from me, will you? Do that again and I'll put you in the ground.
You look like a mean son of a troll! I'd love to fight, but you'd probably prefer to pay your fine.
I suppose I could beat you for a while and then just take your bounty. That sounds good to me.
Pay your bounty. Now. What? Were you expecting words of comfort? From me?
I can recommend a good book to get your life back in order. It's called, 'Pay Your Bounty, Criminal Scum.'
Enough! Pay your bounty or pray to your gods, for if you refuse me you will surely join them today!
I hear and obey the law. Do you? Prove it by paying your bounty now.
This storm will pass and you will see that you were wrong. Pay the bounty.
You were sloppy--and it's going to cost you.
I will accept your bounty now. Do you have the appropriate amount of gold upon you?
I couldn't help but notice your bulging pouch of gold. I suppose that means you can pay your bounty?
Don't try to flee, criminal. You won't get anywhere.
I can forget I saw you do that, but you must first pay the bounty.
Lawbreaker. You have a bounty to pay.
The law requires remuneration for your crimes. Pay or else.
I'm sorry, friend, but I have to ask for payment on your bounty.
So, infidel dog, did your crime profit you? I hope so, for now I must collect your bounty.
Hear and obey, offender! Make restitution for your transgressions and all will be well.
You will pay your bounty. You have no other option. Don't make me ask you again.
Do you have all of them? No need to count. That looks about right. I trust you won't need to stand here and count the coins too, eh?
For me? You shouldn't have! I've looked forward to having these for so long, but never thought I'd actually get them.\n\nA kindness deserves a kindness. Thank you.
So, what did you learn during your time with the Enforcers? No, wait! Tell me later. I'm awfully busy and I'm sure you want to hear about the opportunities our organization provides.
I hope you'll change your mind about the outlaw life. Believe me, it's not that crime doesn't pay … it's that the Enforcers pay so much better.
Aquillius Juventius.
Put a bit more swagger in your swing!
This next bout should be memorable!
Ha ha! Wait till you see what's coming next!
And that's how it's done! Well played!
I felt that one all the way up here!
No no no! Now, from the back! Rush!
If I don't kill you, the hagravens will!
That was some move! Now do it again!
Your deeds speak louder than your boasts and brags.
I am reborn as a pale shadow of the master. I claim this realm for him.
Mother. I will end this!
I will end you!
I will send you to the depths of Oblivion!
I know someone who wants to buy soulgems, no questions asked. You interested? No? Another time, then.
Some day, this one shall seek shade under boughs of gold. On a seat of gold. Eating goldfish.
Come see what absurd amounts of gold can get you!
Don't mind me. I'm here to load the goods and send them off.
Moonlight … a fool's refuge!
This one works a special kind of alchemy: theft to gold.
Well, that's discouraging.
Liar!
Liar!
I am not your bodyguard, but I will deliver custody to your next of kin.
No charge for flattery, it's all part of the service.
I am not your bodyguard, but I will deliver custody to your next of kin.
No charge for flattery, it's all part of the service.
You've traveled far and endured much hardship, I see. Your sacrifice will not be forgotten.
I swear, these gifts will not be misused.
Is that how you dress for a meal? Slip in to something more comfortable, please.
When Pacrooti was young, he often ran in circles trying to catch his own tail.  Then he decided it was much easier to catch his friends' tails.  Pacrooti had fewer friends after that.
Our friendship pleases Pacrooti. He believes that a  good friendship is like peeing his pants in public. Everyone can see it, but only Pacrooti can feel the warmth inside.
Goodbye, my friend.
Perseverance is a virtue, my friend.
Perfectly reasonable.
This should please you!
Quite valuable!
Very nice.
<Super hateful laugh>
Trees grow rings as you wait, Undaunted. Don't you want your reward?
Exquisite home goods, guaranteed to put a twinkle in Almalexia's eye. Or Vivec, if that's your preference.
An excellent selection!
Pacrooti is still waiting. This one has endless patience.
This one thinks you may have fallen asleep. Select your crate and open it, and then we can begin!
Most clients don't like to be kept waiting. Hurts a reputation, you know.
Kept me waiting, didn't you?
Hmmmm.
Ha ha ha!
Hmm hmm!
When Pacrooti was young, he often ran in circles trying to catch his own tail.  Then he decided it was much easier to catch his friends' tails.  Pacrooti had fewer friends after that.
Hmmmm.
I feel like we're being watched. Don't trust these woods.
They're preparing for war! This is just the beginning, I'm sure!
<Howling.>
That's odd, I could have sworn I heard something.
Oh, come on!
The pain. The darkness. It keeps me alive.
That will not end well for you.
The Master's plan unfolds nicely.
No. No. No. Yes? No.
Liar! Lying liar that lies!
They're monsters! All of them!
Whatever are you doing?
And so it ends.
Glad to see you in one piece, apostle.
Nothing grinds my gears more than a messy home.
The Brass Fortress does not allow unsolicited assault.
Please present yourself for arrest, murderer.
It is not advised to take items without permission.
Discontinue your unlawful behavior, resident.
Personal items detected missing. Cause: minor larceny.
Do not assault me, resident.
Cease your actions and present yourself to the nearest guard.
Unlawful behavior recorded. Category: trespassing.
The tears have bled my heart raw.
Pull the shadows to your ear and listen to the whispers of the night.
Why do you struggling? Slip away with us forever.
Temperature variance detected. Documenting.
Wonder. Labor. Create.
Excess corrosion detected. Maintenance required.
Welcome to Lord Seht's gleaming city.
Haaa!
Bright moons! Pacrooti welcomes you and prays that the Divines grant you luck and great fortune!
When Pacrooti was young, he often ran in circles trying to catch his own tail.  Then he decided it was much easier to catch his friends' tails.  Pacrooti had fewer friends after that.
Select your crate and we can begin. Most crates contain four rewards, but sometimes you will get a special fifth reward!
The mystery of the unflipped cards is Pacrooti's favorite part!
Pacrooti is envious!
Haaa!
Tip-top!
Pacrooti loves this!
This one is impressed!
Open your next one then?
Must continue the research. Yes, the research.
The sickness spreads, and spreads, and spreads.
Scalecaller shall cleanse Tamriel. Purge it.
Festering, rotting. Puss filled corpses.
Our research is going too slowly.
May our blessing spread to all.
You've caused quite the ruckus, yes. Quite the stir. Nasty, nasty guests.
I can wait. After all, your deaths are inevitable.
The Abyssal Cabal claims Summerset for the Sea Sload!
You test my patience, mortal fools.
I am darkness. I am death.
Well done, but let's see how you fare next time.
Oh next time will be different, mortals.
Nocturnal is the night, and the night goes on forever.
I get a cut of the booty, right?
I prefer to cast spells from the back of the line.
Altmer blood on my tunic! I'll never get that out!
If we empty the sea, what will we eat?
Keep all of your eyes open. And be still.
You'll get use to the darkness, I promise. Eternal darkness.
Why do they fight us? They cannot hope to win.
A mortal lurks nearby. I can smell their panic.
(Goblin GIbberish 08)
You know the worst thing about near-omniscience? Every time someone laughingly says, "have you heard this one?" you have to say yes. Or in my case, you have to glow and scream until they run away.
Will this next bout be your undoing? Let's find out!
Very good! But how will you fair against our champion?
And the match goes to the challengers!
Come now, challengers, put up a fight!
At last, the fight gets interesting!
Come, let me get a look at you. And, more pointedly, you should buy from me.
It was that Jee-Lar! He's faster than a buzz-bug!
Ow! Maybe those dryskin historians aren't completely spineless, after all.
Plundering and pillaging is all well and good, but I miss marauding.
Can the Bright-Throats show any more weakness?
Who ate my beetle porridge? I was saving that!
Lilmoth's guards don't intimidate me.
Want to sneak away and find an empty patch of swamp?
Why am I surrounded by dryskins and kuudas?
To the Void with you!
Are you ignorant to your own mortality? Tragic.
Oh! I didn't know he had that in him. Now it's everywhere.
I hear squawking. Wait. It's behind me, isn't it? Time to leave!
Have you heard? Lyranth the Dremora wore white to Molag Grunda's blood sacrifice. Caused a scandal! They'll be talking about that for centuries, I'm quite certain.
Sometimes a simple lie saves a few lives. Imagine the benefit of a complex deception.
I don't pay much attention to the gods, and as far as I can tell they don't care all that much about me. Works out fine for all of us.

Feel free to pet the indriks, but please don't feed them. For such marvelous creatures, they have unusually sensitive stomachs.\n\nBy the way, the Impresario is away on business, but she'll return in time for the next festival or celebration!
Don't mind me. Mage problems ….
Such a place of honor! And for Khunzar-ri! Do not make Zar blush, dearest friend.
Together now!
I've decided never to be buried. Put me on a pyre and Kyne whisk me away.
Lost resource adjustment. Desynchronized unit detected.
A meaningless victory! You've destroyed one of hundreds. Your struggle is doomed to failure!
A little moon-sugar might help make all this reading more interesting, yes? Alas, this one is all out of moon-sugar.
Biro-dar urges caution, my friend. This one has it on good authority that a cutpurse operates in this very neighborhood.\n\nHow does this one know? Well … Biro is a scholar, yes?
Don't ever touch me while I'm sleeping. Or throw things at me. Even if I'm snoring!\n\nThose who interrupt my beauty rest get the Evil Eye. And the Stabby Claw.

Some might abandon the last dregs at the bottom of a bottle, but I know a trick to make sure not a drop goes to waste. Azurah gave Khajiit tails for a reason, yes?\n\nI don't know what that reason was, but mine soaks up alcohol quite nicely.
Stand right there. Lift up your pant leg. Perfect!\n\nNow, don't mind me. I need something to scratch.
You know what that civilized settlement needs? A good pillaging! \n\nNothing teaches heathens the value of their possessions like losing them in a good pillaging!
Haven't talked to a Hagraven in weeks. Haven't even spoken to a werewolf, for that matter!\n\nThat's the trouble with civilization. It's too civilized.
Sigh. Why do Nords have such terrible handwriting? And Argonians! Don't get me started on the quill work of Argonians!
Definitely my handwriting, but this makes no sense at—oh. \n\nPages are out of order. Don't mind me.
Yes, I'm a prince. Yes, I'm that prince, in fact. Don't spread it around. I'm not in the mood to fend off every eligible maiden in the area right now.
Is it just Adusa, or do all furless mortals look alike?

I could have been the ard if I hadn't let Caddach take the Markarth throne. You're probably thinking, "but Hroltar, didn't you want to rule the Reach?" Never!\n\nThrones are nothing but traps for arses, and my arse refuses to be tied down!

What a night! Wandered into a cave full of wispmothers. Looked like some sort of Nord sewing circle, except for the floating lights. Thought I was in for a battle, but they just wanted some company.\n\nLuckily, Hroltar knows how to please the ladies.
Traveling always makes me homesick for the simple things. My room in the Palace of Kings. My personal chef. My storehouse full of Voljar's mead.\n\nThe simple things.

I had a disagreement with a priest of Arkay today. She was not pleased that this one was a vampire. I told her I was not pleased she was a bigoted deist.\n\nIf she asks about me, tell her you never heard of anyone by the name of Adusa-daro.
Ravenwatch Castle, in Rivenspire, is Adusa's home. But as far as nice places to stay when I can't be there, this location suits Adusa's needs.
I'll be just a step behind you.
Come and take us!
That's got it!

No, you cannot have bread or crackers with my soups. A good soup does not need it! The flavor should speak for itself.\n\nMy soups do not need elaboration, substitution, or additional components in order to be enjoyed.

Soup for everyone! Soon, soon. Two kinds today, but you must eat both. There is no choosing one over the other. Mostly because I still had to cook them in the same pot.\n\nI really should look into purchasing another cooking vessel.
I've observed that many mortals spend their brief existences toiling to avoid death, but end up dying anyway.\n\nIf there's a point to all that, please enlighten me.

I never felt very welcome in temples of the Eight Divines. No one looks like they're having fun there. Would it kill them to sponsor just a little debauchery for the faithful every now and then?\n\nI'm sure that would help with recruitment.

As a former Daedric cultist, I have absolutely no interest in a summoning ritual some of my old associates plan to conduct tonight. Absolutely no interest whatsoever. Nope.\n\nIf I'm not around later, that's definitely not where I'll be.

What you mortals fail to appreciate is your ability to surprise me. Ninety-nine times out of a hundred I can predict exactly what a mortal will do. But the hundredth time? No idea.\n\nThat is why you interest me.
The mortal seems to be addressing us. Does it desire something from me? Perhaps if I remain quite still, it will simply go away.
You either make decisions or life makes them for you. Let's do … something.

A drunken Nord comes home carrying a duck. His wife says: What have you got there? The Nord says: This is the dragon I told you about. The wife says: That's a duck, you idiot! The Nord says: Quiet, you! I was talking to the duck!
Wake up! Clear your head!
I could go for a bit of excitement.
Vehk I hope you're watching!
I'm still here. Thanks for asking.
How did you ever get through these long periods of quiet without me?
It's odd not to have someone that depends on me at all hours of the day and night. I love my work as a manservant, but a little time off is … liberating.

I picked up some sweets but I can't bring myself to eat them. As much as I want to, I keep imagining Lady Laurent's disappointed expression. She doesn't allow such treats at her estate or even when we're traveling.

Love. Have you ever been?\n\nI have a fair petunia, but she doesn't feel the same. At least, I don't think she does. I've never worked up the courage to reveal my desires. And, since we work together, I don't want to make things awkward between us.

Technically, I'm still a probationary member of the Thieves Guild, but I'm sure the only reason I'm not a footpad yet is because they don't want to show any special treatment. Got to pay my dues like the rest. That's what the mentors always say.
The guildmaster says I'm a diamond in the rough. Just need a little polish and I'll shine! \n\nSeeks says I'm more like a pebble in his shoe, but that's just his way of showing affection.
[Goblin gibberish bragging about the size of her sword]
Cities are as alive, fickle, and uncertain as people. Some are good; some are bad. Some give you gifts; others rob you blind.
There's an old saying about those who forget history. I don't remember it, but it's really good.
Some bold travelers wish to go to Thras and fight the Sload. M'aiq regards it as an experience to be avoided. One might catch something.

I picked up some sweets but I can't bring myself to eat them. As much as I want to, I keep imagining Lady Laurent's disappointed expression. She doesn't allow such treats at her estate or even when we're traveling.

Love. Have you ever been?\n\nI have a fair petunia, but she doesn't feel the same. At least, I don't think she does. I've never worked up the courage to reveal my desires. And, since we work together, I don't want to make things awkward between us.

Unflinching bravery? Yes. Svelte yet powerful physique? Check. Gentility befitting the Court? Absolutely!\n\nWhat else must a crow do to become a knight, featherless? Kill a bear, maybe? Find me a bear that I might slay it!

I picked up some sweets but I can't bring myself to eat them. As much as I want to, I keep imagining Lady Laurent's disappointed expression. She doesn't allow such treats at her estate or even when we're traveling.

Love. Have you ever been?\n\nI have a fair petunia, but she doesn't feel the same. At least, I don't think she does. I've never worked up the courage to reveal my desires. And, since we work together, I don't want to make things awkward between us.

It probably seems strange to remain loyal to an Empire that no longer exists. It's strange, but the Empire didn't evaporate without a trace. We're all still here—the pieces. We're just waiting for someone to put everything back together.
The guildmaster says I'm a diamond in the rough. Just need a little polish and I'll shine! \n\nSeeks says I'm more like a pebble in his shoe, but that's just his way of showing affection.

Being a squire is hard work. We polish our knights' talons, organize their piles of shinies ….\n\nWhen I finally earn my knighthood, I'll treat my ward with nothing but respect. Until they step out of line. Then I'll really let them have it!
Free time makes me anxious. I'm used to schedules being prescribed and regimented. Now that I have no one dictating what I need to do, I'm at a loss far too much of the time.
Once again, Qukikh, you opened a portal to an unknown destination. Are you trying to get us lost? Try again!
A good conversation is its own reward. Why, once M'aiq spent an afternoon in Solitude talking to a bottle!
As you will.

This realm is sadly lacking in a sufficient supply of minions to suit my taste. Churls. Drudges. Scamps. I require a legion! A multitude which I can condemn to an eternity of toil on my behalf!\n\nLook into that, mortal.
Is it odd that I miss the Constrictions of Moath? Every time Oruuzyn compresses me, I swear to myself that I will never agree to it again. And yet, I feel as if my back needs another realignment.

I wonder where I'll put my collection of Daedric urns? I have close to thirty now. A few of them are still full.\n\nOne of these days I'll get around to cataloging them. I don't think they contain anything too dangerous, but you never can tell.
Gaze upon me and be astounded, mortal. My name means doom across half the planes of Oblivion!\n\nWhat? Have I not explained? This isn't my original form. I've been cursed! Mortals. They never listen.
Don't tell Madam Whim, but I found a way to shave eons from my debt. By the time I finish, she will owe me. And oh, she'll hop and run at Hezehk's command! That is the dream!
All the Daedra I've ever met were bored with their immortality. Ha! Can you imagine? Being bored with a place as fathomless as Oblivion?
The right armor, plus the right weapons, plus the right techniques adds up to victory. Simple arithmetic.
…end…
The best thing about being a professional raconteur? The freedom! Followed closely by the ability to call yourself a professional raconteur.\n\nIntroductions like that really make an impression!
Did you think you have things under control? I'm afraid this won't be that easy.

People say a wink and a smile can disarm someone as well as any sword. Just know your audience, all right? Winking and smiling at someone you stole from can leave you with a black eye and a loose tooth.\n\nTrust me. I know.
I've been waiting to try this spell out!
That was just embarrassing.
You were amazing!
Get a load of this!
Yes! Are we going to race?
I catch myself wondering about your past a lot. What were you like as a kid, where you grew up, who your friends were. You'll have to tell me about it some day. I bet you've got good stories.
I feel amazing! I've learned more with you than I ever learned with Magister Irin.
Look at you! Pretty impressive!
Harvesting runestones soothes me in a strange way. Maybe it's the sound, or just all the potential ideas of stuff to make, I'm not sure!
Ha! I knew you missed me.
I could do this all day!
Full moon freak!
And no one's any the wiser!
They'll be missing that.
People who are too careful with their magic are missing out on the fun! Part of the draw is the risk!
This is not the end of our tale!
I hope I did you proud in that fight.
Any battle we can walk away from, eh?
<Strained shouting.>
Ready to ride.

I'm pretty sure that the Knight Commander deliberately hid the existence of the Undaunted from me. If tiny Isobel had known there was a guild of dungeon explorers out there, she'd have been out the door faster than you can say terrible life choices.
Hah. A new chapter for Dame Isobel! … Too much?
Stendarr is with you. I can feel it.
What new tale will we tell?
Stendarr forgive me, but I hate those things. Good riddance.
Riding with you never stops surprising me. Well fought!
We can do this kind of thing anytime you want.

I just spoke to my mother the other day. She was wearing this beautiful hat from Wayrest. Apparently they're all the rage right now. Nice to look at, but I could never pull off something like that. Not very practical in a pitched battle.
Rigurt has no qualms about mingling with most important dignitaries from all the foreign lands. Even the awful ones!

The Three Banners war drags on. Makes Rigurt feel like failure, even though I have many diplomatic successes. I blame Skald-King and other leaders. \n\nBut don't tell them I said that. Rigurt is still in trouble for last time he said that to Jorunn.
I am a druid of the Stonelore Circle. As such, I shall not attempt to convert you to the ways of Y'ffre. I simply let my good works speak for themselves.
Each day leaves its mark upon the living earth. Heat, frost, wind, rain—they write their tales in the rock so that we can read them.

Can I give you a bit of friendly advice before you get too involved with the cards? You have a tell. It's subtle, but I can see it. The trick is to always imagine your opponent as the most boring person alive. \n\nLike, you know, the opposite of me.
Word of advice—never take a Black Marsh Argonian for granted when it comes to cards. I can't tell you how many people fall for the whole, I'm-a-simple-lizard-lost-in-the-big-city routine.

I enjoy getting away from the Mages Guild sometimes. Zeht's tears, it can get stuffy in there. You crack one joke about a sailor losing a finger to a slaughterfish, and they react like you've set the place on fire!

Once, I wrestled a tuna the size of a duneripper to get it aboard our ship. The line broke as I reeled the damned thing in! And I, young and stupid as I was, decided to settle things man to fish.\n\nEarned a broken rib, but we ate good that night.
The breath of Khenarthi carries many things through the world. Today it carries Tadali to this house. Tomorrow? Who can say?
Do not be surprised that you think Clan Mother Tadali is wise. She is. You would do well to listen to this one.\n\nClan Mother Tadali knows of what she speaks!
I come from a long line of Davaux's back in Wayrest. Our house has been serving High Rock and Tamriel for generations. When the call of duty sounded, of course I answered it!

If I were a ghost, why in Nirn would I haunt this place? It makes no sense! I'm as alive as Bendu Olo or Liniwen. Now, if anyone was walking around dead, I'd put my gold on Captain Ghorguzal of the Jolly Goblin. That's a ghost ship if ever I saw one!
Our friendship pleases Pacrooti. He believes that a good friendship is like a delicious meal. It makes him smile, and Pacrooti can feel the warmth inside.
This should please you!
Pacrooti is still here! More crates are available to purchase, my friend.
I am here, my friend. Sleek as can be. Let Pacrooti know when you need him.
As your advisor, I suggest you avoid boasting. Only the wretched and foolish boast.

I haven't given myself time to relax like this in … well, honestly I can't remember. I found myself napping earlier today! Me! Napping! Can you imagine? I had myself a good laugh when I woke up and realized what happened.

I prefer the outfits of the Stonelore Druids. What I wore when I studied with them. Before then, all I'd known were stuffy silk shirts and armor. I made quite the case for changing our customs when I returned to court, much to my father's chagrin.
Privateers are often confused with pirates, but there's a world of difference. Privateers have permission to take your stuff. And we're usually more polite about it.
Try not to get too close. It's early and I haven't had my bowl of warm sweetmilk yet.

My calling has been a long, often lonely road. But looking back I do not regret a single day. The lives I have saved. The fiends I have ended. And perhaps most importantly, the damned I have released from their thirst.

I find myself thinking of my homeland's cuisine. In all my travels, it remains the food that satisfies my soul.\n\nBeetle-cheese poutine, cliff-racer ragout, kwama scrib risotto … and of course, sweet slaughterfish tea to wash it down. Delicious!
It's casting. Can't you feel it?
Do you want me to turn you to ice?
You don't have to attack us.

Everyone wants my secret for the perfect disguise. Now, I'm loathed to reveal too much, but here's a hint. Total confidence. And an uncanny ability to truly believe you're someone or something else. \n\nBesides, most people are stupid and easy to fool.

Ever shared a cabin with a sailor who refused to wash on a regular basis? Drives me mad quicker than getting caught in a lull on the open sea. I threw one inconsiderate cur over the side once just to give them a proper bath!
While it is good to travel, this one admits to already missing home. While some may see Northern Elsweyr as an unforgiving desert, this one knows the true warmth and comfort its sands provide.
Adventurer, have you had a chance to sample the dishes of Elsweyr? Some find our cuisine to be too spicy, but J'baanluk enjoys the way the heat curls his tongue and brightens his cheeks.
Our sacred mission is to demonstrate the sickening power of Peryite and welcome more followers into the fold! So, if I sneeze or cough in your direction, consider it a blessing!

One of the tenets of the Order of the Sacred Skeever is to pay homage to our patron animal. I spent the last few nights in a skeever den, letting them nip at my fingers and toes. Don't I smell horrendous? Oh, Peryite is certain to reward my devotion!
I don't have time for you.
Each sequence builds this one's power.
Look, Vanton. Bask in the intelligence of your saviors.
Ha! You can't even solve a simple puzzle.
Watch it!
Wasn't going to end any other way.
Got to be better than that to stop us.
(battle roar)
I'm with you.

Found out the hard way that I still know a bit of Jel from my life before. Ended up snorting my drink all over someone who asked me to be their uxith-beeko for the night at some tavern in Helstrom. Haven't been back since.
Getting stronger every day.
Impressive.
I don't really care about appearances. You always look fine to me. \n\nIf you like to pamper yourself, just do it on your own time, all right?
Got here as quick as I could.
It's a nice place. If I didn't know who lived here, sure, I'd probably try robbing it.
Apocrypha take you!
(old man noise)
(unleashed power shout)
(clearing his throat, annoyed)

My focus tends to shift a bit, over time. Is that your experience as well? Previous interests have included life prolongation, deep-aether travel, the history of the Imperial Battlemages, and the culinary legacy of chef Orzorga.
Enlightenment! Progress!
Mora has his eyes on you. I can feel it.

Nothing gives me greater glee … no, well. I take that back. Few things give me greater glee than stealing from the Psijic Order. Nab as many of their incantatum as you can from those highfaluting portals. Jubilance!
Arrival. Anticipation.

I was just thinking of Martina Abor, my old colleague. We used to make a little game of positing the strangest notion we could think of, and then attempting to defend it from rigorous valuation. \n\nWe would laugh and laugh. Ahh.
You remind me an awful lot of my cousin. He was adventurous, driven, curious about everything, and always charging headlong into danger. Good old Hlaro. Wonder if they ever found his body?

On occasion, the House of Reveries provide tinctures of fluster fume to Hopefuls who suffer from stage fright. Just a few drops and even the most tongue-tied performer will take to the stage in song. Some great talents just need a little nudge.

Have you ever seen Hardshell perform his famous mudcrab juggle? Remarkable sight. I once wondered aloud how he managed to accomplish such a feat without getting pinched. \n\nTurns out, the secret is learning not to yelp.
A word of advice? Never drink alone in a strange port. Go with your shipmates, or don't go at all.
If you ever find yourself in Anvil, watch your back. Seems like everyone there is ready to stick a knife in it.
Can we go find a mortal tavern? I enjoy watching mortals imbibe poison for their own amusement.
Were we destined to meet today? Is this part of some grand purpose in the annals of destiny? Or just another meaningless act of coincidence?\n\nWho can say? Fate works in mysterious ways.
You are skilled. I will not forget it.
You interrupt my search?
I'm not strong enough! Oh wait, I am.
I need more arms.
Feel my teeth around your throat!
Let the ink flow.
This is too sharp for you.
Oh no. Your attacks are so strong.
Did you miss me?
You won this fight. I'll win the next.
You followed your fate. Foolish reflection.
You will be good practice for my reflections.
I exist everywhere.
I hoped we would fight again.
This is why I stick to research.
Don't let her distract you.
Another painful ability for the records.
I'm not going to use Tho'at's nymic with you behind me.
Tho'at Replicanum hear your name and obey!
I felt the tides of fate pull in a second direction. Your choice, more maligraphies or see where the other path leads?
Vengeance, crieth the cute talking doll! \n\nYes, I have issues.
I'm just here because I need a quiet place to plot revenge. \n\nI mean, reflect on my life choices. Ja, that is it.
Do not worry. Mizzik is not as light-fingered as many tend to assume about his kind.\n\nUnless there happens to be a sweetroll left unattended nearby. In that case, Mizzik makes no promises.

Mizzik likes taking unsolved mysteries. Bringing a new perspective, stirring the pot. Like making jam, things float to the surface, ready to skim off with a spoon so as to leave behind a tasty treat. Yum!\n\nWhat were we talking about, again?

You have to learn to trust your gut. The last time I ever ignored a feeling down there was when I tried to make some coin chugging warm rotmeth on a dare.\n\nMy gut let me know real quick what a bad idea that was.
Some people get really into this antiquity hunting. You hear about this? Digging up old junk people threw away? Plenty of coin in it, but I don't see the appeal.
Just how many can she manifest?
Hey, you! Clattering collection of consonants!
I'll never turn down an opportunity to duel.
I hope you faced this maligraphy before.
Stay still.
You'll make a good entree.
I was raised in a tiny village far to the south, but I grew bored with provincial life. I longed to learn about the ancient Argonians. To bring some of that lost civilization back to my people.

I do not seek to change Saxhleel traditions, but I believe some are worth examining. Forsaking all Shadow-born hatchlings to serve Sithis, for example. These are sensitive topics even among the enlightened, so I tread carefully.
Some people have accused me of being quick to anger. Can you believe that? I never get angry. And I'll bash the head in of anyone who disagrees!\n\nHaha, just kidding. I know I have quite the temper.

Some of my brothers and sisters find the Shadowscales unsettling. Something about being raised from birth under the dark eyes of Sithis changes how people see you.\n\nNot me! The more beast-people in our family the better, I say!

My first trip into the city scared me so bad I couldn't stop shaking. The shouting, people moving around, and the smells, ugh! So many smells! Too overwhelming.\n\nI manage fine now. Maybe one day I can see one of those bard shows I've heard about.

Fear of werewolves makes sense, but I would never hurt anyone. Well, aside from our contracts. But that is in service of our Dread Father and not personal.\n\nNot all werewolves come from the same mold. I hope you keep that in mind.
Just the mortal we needed. None shall best your ink-slaying prowess!
Get out of the way!
From the Ashpit to the fires of war!
Claim these lands for me.
Let me cut you!
Valenwood never stops growing. Neither should you. Let's get into it.
<You think you hear a slight whirring from within the brass shell of Tzozabrar. A connection to a distant Dwarven ruin?>
(Goblin GIbberish 08)
Maybe … no.
A dark monolith rises in a time-lost sea. Script upon its stone foretells the savings you'll find with me.
Why are you still talking to me? Don't you have anything better to do? There must be a quest or an animal in distress or something. Isn't that what you adventurer types live for?
I'm a professional. I don't play games with my targets. Just execute the writs and move along. Who has time for any of that Khajiit-and-mouse nonsense?
You are weak!
You have no part in my future!
End them! I don't care how!
(Goblin GIbberish 08)
Just out of curiosity, has anyone ever tried flirting with the Daedric Princes? I think there's a good chance some of them would mellow out if they got just a little kiss on the head. Just an idea.
What's the plan?
Nothing will hold me back!
Be warned, I fight dirty.
Too easy!
Want to go again? I could go again.
Want to see something really fun?
Let's get out of here!
Hehe. Everyone is going to be so jealous.
Never hurts to learn something new.

I catch many puzzled looks when I speak Ta'agra to the Khajiit of this time. Only scholars may make sense of my differing dialect. Such is the nature of language, I suppose. Ever-shifting, like desert sand.
Together again.
Jo'zhet! A new level of strength and understanding.
You give me no choice!
Bebaj-var. It is done.
A victory worth dedicating to Azurah.
Dusk and dawn, ignite within me!
With haste!
The purpose of tamiiti made manifest. We make each other stronger.

Oh, have no fear! I never partake of unwilling blood donors! House Ravenwatch only ever uses paid and willing blood servants. We treat them very well, never drink to excess, and compensate them for their service.

Even before my present condition, I rarely drank alcohol. But, I always kept a filled flask to offer people with useful information. Many investigations back then relied on a well-lubricated source letting slip a secret or two.
Scripts and grimoires. I have them, and you can too, if the price is right. Care to take a look?

If the ancient people of Tamriel didn't want us to disturb their tombs, then why did they leave so many signs pointing to their exact locations? In ancient texts, they're often marked with skulls or crossed bones. They couldn't be more obvious!

Have you seen my apprentice? Oh, I'm sure he's all right. I sent him to scout a totally unremarkable Ayleid tomb. For my next book, you see. It was a perfectly reasonable request. Hardly any chance of danger. As far as I could tell. From a distance.
Being the child of powerful mages, they really instilled in me a fear of Daedra. I don't know if they predicted I'd fight them as much as I do now? But they sure did prepare me for it.
Grrr! Ruff! Ruff—ha ha!\n\nOh, I'm sorry. If you could only see your face right now!
People are always so surprised to meet a talking dog named Barbas. Is Barbas really that unusual a name?

My tattoos were meant to lock away my magical abilities. For years I hated my mother for carving these runes into me. Now, I can't help but smile every time I chip away at these seals. Every new spell I learn proves her wrong.
Ahh. The acoustics in here are interesting. I do not remember enough of the moon-singer hymns to do them justice, so I will abstain from any attempt. But if I had the voice, I would sing.
It is common in this time to subjugate souls, yes? To entrap them in soul gems.\n\nIf you insist on doing this, please do not do it in my company.
I control the battlefield.
Be consumed by the darkness!
Lure them into my storm!
They can't see me. Can't hear me.
Why do some pirates bury their treasure? Za'ji has never looked at a chest full of gold and gems and thought to himself, "Ooh! This one should run and get a shovel."
Za'ji has learned it is wise to eat, drink, and dance whenever you can. The wind may change at any moment and regrets only weigh you down!

If ever you're in need of a skilled martialist, you'd be hard pressed to find anyone better than the knights of the Iron Knot. From halberds to long swords to the thickness of their own skulls, their skill with weapons is legendary.

Once, when I was little, I sneaked a pheasant out of the kitchen and hid it in my bedroom. Fed it grains and pastries until the day it escaped. I often wonder how little Mariena is doing. I hope she's raiding a bakery somewhere.

My parents always ask why I can't be more like my sister, Elfbetta. Making a name for herself by coddling some hot-headed adventuring type.\n\nNot that I don't do my fair share of coddling. But at least Muffins likes me back!

I get asked a lot about mammoth cheese. You know, if it can be made from pocket mammoths the way Giants make it from the bigger mammoths.\n\nI won't bother you with the unpleasant details. Just take my word that it's more trouble than it's worth.
More! Make this fire remind me of Sentinel's sands!
When we're done, you'll be as good as me! Keep adjusting the temperature!
Must revise.
Who would've thought …?
I want this post running smooth and by the numbers.
The curse is gone. Finally I am at peace. Thank you.
These bastards have taken prisoners!
My Kami wouldn't leave me!
Cliff Racer! Play Cliff Racer!
There's a special plane of Oblivion for people like you.
Gods, Fara. Help me remember.
For the love of Stendarr! Help me!
This is all your fault, father!
King Fahara'jad will protect us.
Deal with these trespassers.
Tred lightly, stranger. We won't put up with any more trouble.
We've got you now!
Let's loosen some teeth.
Were Telenger here, I would strip the flesh from his bones!
Your supple flesh will be mine, creature!
I'll swab the deck with your scalp!
It's so fuzzy!
For five gold, gaze into its eyes! Peer into the face of death itself!
Do you think it's going to bring us bad luck, stealing from a chapel?
As your mind unravels, try to dwell on your fear and suffering.
And if Maruin is telling Valenwood a story, are we just characters?
Fool! Did you think Molag Bal, the Lord of Domination, would be defeated so easily?
Your pathetic attempts to save this world amuse me.
Ah, it's my unwitting tool. Return to my realm and serve me.
The Prophet is a fool, and you are a greater one for following him.
My subjects failed me. They deserve to be destroyed.
Are you still working for the dim one?
Not if I kill you first!
What do we do?
Guide the philosophers and wizards, holding them gently in your sway. Teach them your sublime wisdom.
Knowledge is better glimpsed by a half-yielding eye than gazed upon full by a naked one.
Ever tried baked kwama eggs? Like crispy potstickers mixed with guts and ash. Mix it into your gums to feed the tooth worms. \n\nIf you want a sample, give your granny Alyxe a kiss, eh?
Um … a bit rude, that?
You should have dropped your weapons.
No! Why would you attack me, Hircine?
Frost trolls! All around us!
The Learned One does not tolerate intruders.
The master demands your death. I hear and obey.
The fire and light take you.
Your head will be my trophy!
Come. Entertain me as your friends die.
The shining cities of man and mer will become their graves—when I tear them to the ground.
You know what they say. If at first you don't succeed … just give up.
Come, fight us! Die your pointless death!
The master will devour your corpses when we're done with you!
Mortals lives are so fleeting. Just lie down and die.
You're bold. But foolish!
I'll go to the tavern after this. Have some drinks.
Do not think this one lazes in the sun all day. It is hard work, loading the wagons.
Honor to you. Your delivery is welcome.
Deliveries would be so much easier if we could move them through portals. A bit pricey, though.
I could really go for some rotmeth. Where did I leave my flask?
I need to spread the word about our supply deficiency, but what more can I do?
You vanquished the wraith. I can leave!
If only I had killed him!
Lord Bal won't suffer a servant of his treated this way. He'll come for me. For you.
Who blew that horn?
Who did that?
The Lord Warden will adore your innards on a plate!
Supplicants, come and pay homage!
Come quicky, banekin! I command you!
Claws rend, teeth gnaw!
Perhaps we'll find a resilient mortal to break, this day.
Looks about right, there. Don't see too many of these lately. My contact will be so pleased to find so many intact.
I'm not one to stomach such violent acts, but after what that monster did, I'd say good riddance. I appreciate you taking the time to tell me.

Some of our associates consider you a spy. I told them that of course you were a spy. A spy inside the Enforcers who works for us! \n\nNow let's get you signed up again so you can take advantage of all our opportunities and benefits.
You should consider yourself lucky. If I didn't like you so much, I'd gut you once for being an outlaw and a second time for betraying our friendship.
Phaedra Vesnia.
Keep this up and you'll definitely get a mention in my next book!
Now it comes! I've been waiting for this!
Well fought … but now things get serious!
And the challenger is the clear victor!
That's what we want! Keep it up.
Smash heads! Crush bones! Attack!
Our savior will destroy you with smoke and crows!
Uh-oh! This can't last much longer!
The person you least expect admirers you from afar.
Little mortal. You shall be tested in ways you cannot fathom.
I hear we're going to raid the palace. When exactly? No? You're right, I don't need to know.
Money can't buy love, they say! You'll disagree when you see my wares.
You! Yes, you! Come, spend your money!
My arms grow weary. Your shipments are heavy.
Ah, my favorite customer.
Not helpful.
Hungry.
Hungry.
The spoils of your conquest are secure.
If you're sore, I can teach you some of the fifty-two sacred stretches.\n\nThey'll keep you limber, I promise.
The spoils of your conquest are secure.
If you're sore, I can teach you some of the fifty-two sacred stretches.\n\nThey'll keep you limber, I promise.
"Water is sweet on laborers' lips, but turns to dust in mouths of the idle."
"Today's work is tomorrow's profit."
Let me weave you something … nice and snug.
This one finds it frustrating to know all the answers because nobody ever asks Pacrooti any questions.
Pacrooti welcomes you! Are you interested in excitement and valuable rewards? This one can help!
Return soon, my sleek friend. This one is always pleased to see  you!
Once more, my good friend?
Appropriate.
Excellent!
Stupendous!
Excellent!
<Giddy, taunting laugh>
Impress your guests! Make your home the envy of your friends and enemies! Just imagine how this will look inside your four walls.
Fortune truly favors you!
This one grows bored with waiting. Perhaps you should purchase a crate to entertain us both!
The longer clients wait, the less patient they become. If you know what I mean.
You're not my only client, you know.
Hmmm.
Hoooo, haaaa!
Hm hmm hmm!
This one finds it frustrating to know all the answers because nobody ever asks Pacrooti any questions.
Hmmm.
Our blades thirst!
Great, now I'm hearing things.
I'll drag you all the Sovngarde!
Ouch!
I offer everything to my mistress and yet it's never enough.
Gather shadows, snuff out the light. Gather shadows, snuff out a life.
We just want to be close. We just want to hold you tight, and never let go.
Core rotation initialized.
To every machine, a purpose.
Searching area for hostile entities.
We must all serve our purpose.
Hmm!
Pacrooti would like to remind you that tips are appreciated. It is far easier for a mammoth to pass through the eye of a needle, if it is slightly greased, yeah?
This one finds it frustrating to know all the answers because nobody ever asks Pacrooti any questions.
Which one will you open?
What's under there?
Quite valuable!
Hmm!
Stupendous!
Yes, my good friend!
Pacrooti is truly impressed!
This is fun!
Why would you try to stop our blessing, hmm? Very mean, very mean.
Die, you meaningless worms!
Impenetrable darkness waits at the bottom of the sea.
Can you feel my cold touch, mortals?
Next time will be different, worms.
Nocturnal would be impressed if this victory meant anything.
When the day ends, Nocturnal lives.
Stupid captain. Made me scrub the deck for a week!
What did I say? Don't burn the expensive houses until all the plunder has been removed!
Fight on! The ghost fleet gets no conscripts today!
Should I call down another storm? That should knock the fight out of them.
We follow the will of our mistress.
Come closer, my siblings. A meal approaches.
Should we kill them quickly, or do we have time to play?
They shall die within my silken web. Slowly. Painfully.
(Goblin GIbberish 09)
You're not going to use me as a paperweight are you? What's that all about anyway? Paperweights. Honestly, is paper that anxious to escape? Oh, my paper's getting away! Ludicrous!
At last, a fight worth watching!
Impressive! But now it is time to face our champion!
Quite the show! Give a cheer for our victors!
Strike quick and true, Blackguards!
Come on, Blackguards! Fight back!
Treat with me, look over my goods, and give me a good story. I dare you.
I forget. Are we hitting Bright-Throat or Dead-Water today?
If Cyrodilic Collections get in our way again, destroy them!
That Walks-Like-Thunder … scares the scales off my back!
The Dead-Water refuse to cooperate. Maybe it's time for another lesson.
The river runs in our direction, my friends!
Remind me. Are we looking for relics or artifacts again?
There's a Khajiiti ship in port! That means sparkle syrup and moon-sugar rum!
I really wanted to be a part of the marauding team.
Let blood mingle with water.
There really is nothing like the sound of heads exploding.
Lost my mount? Yes. Not enough sleep? Yes. Chased by a large bird? Yessss!
I forget. Did you send for me or did I summon you? Or maybe this meeting was purely coincidental? Well, no matter! We're both here, so that's something, I suppose.
If you assume that everything is a trap, then you're always ready for any challenge.
Welcome! Make yourself at home! Stay as long as you like!\n\nThe Impresario should be back soon, but to tell you the truth, she never informs me of her comings and goings.
Dearest friend, how is Zar to sleep when you constantly bother him with questions?
Please wait. Searching for AIOS signal.
Impossible! This summoning must have been flawed. Such mistakes will not be repeated!
Enough with the books already! Even a scholar must exercise his other muscles occasionally.\n\nHmm, this one wonders what Tara the Nimble is up to right now.
This research and study can wait until tomorrow. Biro-dar is ready to do something fun for a change. Something to get the fur ruffled, so to speak.\n\nYou have gold, yes?

I have a third cousin, twice removed, who woke up in a bag the other day. She gets carried away with her drinking—not like me—and then gets carried away. In a bag.\n\nMaybe I'll chaperone next time. Drink her wine. For her benefit, of course.

What? I was not just staring at nothing! There was definitely something there. Something … unusual. You just couldn't see it. Takes the proper mix of alcohol and magecraft to see what isn't there.\n\nAnd now I need more alcohol ….

Hey, hey Baandari girl, swing your tail in stride! Woo! I love that song. \n\nSay, why am I the only one singing? Where's the music? Don't you know how to play instrument? We need music, damn it! Now!
I was out and about today. Ran into a herder. She wasn't minding her sheep, so I helped myself to one. \n\nMutton stew for dinner!

Letters are such an impersonal means of communication. If you have something important to say, you should always do it in person. That's why I burn every letter I receive.\n\nHave I burned any addressed to this house? No. Why do you ask?

Listen closely. This is very important. The next time you visit a dungeon, don't forget to read anything you find—plaques, scrolls, dusty tomes. You never know what you're going to learn from the words of history!
Lady Laurent. Her writings are certainly exciting, I'll grant you that. But the academic quality of her conclusions leave much to be desired.

When he was my age, my father, Jorunn the Skald-King, was adventuring around the world with the Pack of Bards. But can I step outside the Palace of Kings without a dozen royal guards snapping at my heels?\n\nNot in this lifetime.

The Ravenwatch. We are a group of good vampires determined to keep menaces of a supernatural disposition in check. Evil vampires, rampaging werewolves, destructive spirits … we deal with clawless monsters of every stripe and color.

I love climbing mountains, but it's dangerous business! I once scaled the highest peak in the Druadachs only to find myself staring into the eyes of a Giantess. Hey, it was dark. And there was a blizzard. Still, it was the best climb I ever made!

Reachfolk say: Hroltar, what are you doing in the Undaunted? Undaunted say: Hroltar, why aren't you back in the Reach? Hroltar says: dobber off and mind your own business. Hroltar is exactly where he's supposed to be.\n\nFor the most part.
Do you know of a nearby tavern or inn that serves horker stew? I haven't had a good horker stew in a guar's age.
Adusa-daro keeps her claws as sharp as razors!\n\nDo not fear, though. The curtains and furnishings remain safe. This one has a scratching post.
Adusa may be on a mission. Maybe not. She really can't say. The Ravenwatch prefers we keep those kinds of details on a need-to-know basis.
What's new?
Taste our steel!
That was easy.

I am not a personal chef. I do not take orders. I'm an artist!\n\nI make the soup I want to make. No more, no less. If you do have a special request, leave a note and maybe I will consider it for next time. Maybe.

Someone said one of my soups made them ill. As if that were a possibility! My soups provide sustenance and cure illnesses! No one ever got sick from eating my soup! And certainly no one has ever died.\n\nAt least, no one I know about.
I don't see why you little mortals form attachments. You die, they die, someone will die. And then someone will be sad. A waste of effort, if you ask me.
I have to admit, I miss the fires. Mehrunes Dagon rituals always had lots of fires. I loved staring into the dancing flames.

The Daedric Princes often get unduly vilified. And their followers, they receive the very negative appellation of cultist. You don't see anyone treating the Divines and their followers that way. It's appalling, that's what it is.\n\nI'm just saying.

I forget. Is the Empire in Cyrodiil the same Empire that the so-called Saint Alessia founded? I can't be bothered keeping track of such things. \n\nAnd time. It behaves differently here. Not like in Oblivion at all. Very disconcerting.
Hope is the cruelest torture of all, little mortal. Have you not yet learned this lesson?
We live our lives through action, not indecision. Shall we get on with ours, then?
My only regrets are things I haven't done yet, so I prefer to think of them as goals.
Did I miss anything interesting?
Off with you, s'wit!
I think I'm getting good at this. I probably shouldn't be proud of that.
I've had so many near death experiences since I met you. I really need to go make an offering to the Three before they think me ungrateful.
I am but a humble manservant in the employ of the remarkable adventurer and treasure hunter, Lady Clarisse Laurent.\n\nPerhaps you've heard of her? She's really quite famous.
This vacation has given me time to catch up on my reading. Have you perused the new Investigator Vale mystery yet? This one's a real page turner!
I think I'll take a nice, long soak. I deserve it. Lady Laurent has a splendid tub, but I'm barely allowed to clean and fill it, let alone bathe in it.
When it comes to locks, you really get what you pay for. Most of the time Seeks doesn't even pick the cheap ones. They just come apart if you know about the weak points.
Seeks-the-Dark can be a grumpy teacher, but there's no one I'd rather learn the trade from. He's not afraid to let me fail.\n\nI mean, he yells a lot, but I still get the experience.
[slow growling threat in Goblin babble]
The warrior who has never been defeated is the warrior who has never truly fought.
I shouldn't have had that last snack.
Houses tell stories too, you know. Sometimes they even lie. After all, a poor merchant might set a rich table so their guests think them wealthy.
This vacation has given me time to catch up on my reading. Have you perused the new Investigator Vale mystery yet? This one's a real page turner!
I think I'll take a nice, long soak. I deserve it. Lady Laurent has a splendid tub, but I'm barely allowed to clean and fill it, let alone bathe in it.

This place is much better than Evergloam. Nocturnal's realm is full of weeping spirits. Always with the wailing and the sobbing and the sniffling! What do spirits have to cry about?\n\nOther than not being crows, I mean. Everyone should cry about that!
This vacation has given me time to catch up on my reading. Have you perused the new Investigator Vale mystery yet? This one's a real page turner!
I think I'll take a nice, long soak. I deserve it. Lady Laurent has a splendid tub, but I'm barely allowed to clean and fill it, let alone bathe in it.

If I could pick any era to live in, it would have to be Reman's golden age. Marching out with the greatest army in history, chasing Dragons to the ends of the world. I wonder if we'll ever see glory like that again.
Seeks-the-Dark can be a grumpy teacher, but there's no one I'd rather learn the trade from. He's not afraid to let me fail.\n\nI mean, he yells a lot, but I still get the experience.

The Blackfeather Court's Code of Chivalry demands that you give me five of your shiniest treasures, featherless. Demands!\n\nWhy do you scowl? I don't make the rules. If you have a complaint, take it up with the Duke of Crows!

I'm surprised by how much Daedra worship is accepted in the provinces. The Empire was practically founded on crushing their vile influence in the name of the Eight. At least until Emperor Leovic came along.\n\nNever turn a blind eye on Oblivion, I say.
M'aiq has heard that the Reach is a good place to meet werewolves. That seems like a reason to avoid the region, yes?
Of course.
Tell me of your plans for conquest. What role does Arox the Mutilator play in your next triumph?

You don't know the House of Whims? It's only the most fabulous and enticing establishment in all the realms of Oblivion! If you don't believe Hezehk, just ask Madam Whim. She tells us these words constantly.
I may be a lowly member of the Psijic Order, but my experiences in Oblivion are going to be invaluable! I'll prove myself and advance in rank in no time!
I do not stand on ceremony. You may address me as Lord Arox or the Mutilator. When we are alone. And no one else can hear.
The trouble with the mortal realm is that it's full of mortals. I would almost like the place if it weren't so crowded with so many of your kind. No offense.
The food in Oblivion is strange, but I think I got used to it during my travels. Everything back in the mortal realm just tastes so … cautious by comparison.
Remember to move those feet, eh? You're not an ogrim, so don't fight like one!

Did you know I stole a ruby right out of a troll's eye socket? Found him sleeping in his lair. I plucked it out so carefully, I never made a sound. Anyway, turns out he wasn't sleeping. He was dead. \n\nYeah, not as impressive as it could have been.
Oh, you've made it angry. Kidding, it doesn't feel anger. Or pain. Or pity.

Know any good jokes? I just learned one about an Orc and a stork, and whoo! Let me tell you, the forge wife of the Morkul clan did not care for it one bit.\n\nActually, you know what? I'm gonna keep it to myself. Trust me, I'm doing us both a favor.
Let's go!
Nothing is too big or too bad for us to handle!
Bet they weren't expecting that!
Get a load of this!
Yes! Are we going to race?
Do you ever get scared? Actually, that's a dumb question, don't answer that. I just … you always seem so fearless, I've never met anyone like you. You know it's fine to be scared sometimes, right?
Every day I feel like I understand more about magic than I did before.
Look at you! Pretty impressive!
I love playing Tales of Tribute. I'm not all that talented at it, so I don't win much, but the playing is fun anyway. I meet all sorts of people that way.
Hey, you.
Take that, dog!
I'm having way too much fun with this!
I've been working on a new spell to clean windows. I enchanted a broom and I'm calling it the Broom of Sparkle. Good, right?
Together!
Haha! We've done it!
I take no pleasure in killing. But I'm glad we're alive and they're not.
<Strained shouting.>
Ready to ride.

At some point when I was a squire words like honor, duty, service … they stopped being just words and became something more. My honor as a knight is a contract that I've made with myself, something I try to live up to. Every single day.
Your guidance has made me a better knight. Thank you.
Stendarr is with you. I can feel it.
Stendarr protect us. Let's get out there.
Vile thing. Stay gone!
Yes!
Do you think I'd be any good as an author? I suppose I've seen enough interesting things to fill a book or two now. We should come up with a nom de plume! Hmm.
Ladies can't resist fancy cultural garb! Even men treat you differently when you wear such finery! \n\nIf you want, Rigurt can set you up with an outfit of your own.
Rigurt is happier than a skeever in cheese shop! Must be this place. Rigurt thinks it is the mammoth's meow!\n\nIs that sound mammoth makes? Yes, yes, what else would it be?

Some assume druids are pacifists because we have little interest in the quarrels of kings and queens. That assumption is wrong. Violence and death are part of nature, too.\n\nWhich is why I always carry a weapon.
Yes, we druids see death as the natural end for all living things. But we also fight fiercely for each day in the sun. That is also natural.

You know, cards are great, but my true passion is dice. It's primordial, understand? Throwing bones, reading little scrawls on the faces. Makes you feel a bit like a mystic.\n\nOr a cultist. One or the other.

Legends abound about decks of Tribute cards stashed in secret places in the wilderness. I'd go look myself, but secret places tend to be high up or full of dangerous creatures. Have I mentioned that I'm scared of heights?\n\nEh, probably just a story.

I never had the urge to settle down and start a family. Life at sea doesn't leave much room for it, and by the time I was done with that I was onto another adventure. But my life's been full. There's more than one way to have a family, aye?
