What kind of trouble we getting into?
I spent so many years sleeping on the street with the stars as my ceiling … it feels strange to be all surrounded. Not bad, just new. I feel a little out of my element.
<Yelling.>
I hope I was of some assistance!
Here we go.
You're always striving to learn something new. One of my favorite things about riding with you.
I am your shield.
Draigh! I think I left something back at the castle. Well, it's your own fault Izzy. Like Erlibru used to say: you'd have lost your head years ago if it weren't stitched to your neck.

Rigurt loves all cultures! That's why he volunteered for service as diplomat! \n\nAnd by volunteer, Rigurt means Skald-King gave Rigurt choice—ambassador or banner-bearer in Alliance War. It was easy decision.
I had a good crew years ago. Loved them like brothers and sisters. When we lost one, it was like losing a limb. Tu'whacca blesses those kind of bonds, as I'm sure you know.
A High Elf once asked Tadali to shed her clothes to spy on our foes. Tadali told her she would be happy to do so if the High Elf did the same.
Most excellent!

When I was younger, I hated seafood. It drove my father mad. On Galen, that's practically unheard of. It was Archdruid Rahval who actually got me to eat my first piece of fish. He prepared it with such skill, I was in awe. Now, I love it all.
Have you met my captain, Za'ji? His heart's in the right place. His head, not so much.
I tend to prefer a stiff drink of spirits, or perhaps one of those spine-straightening Nord ales. Anything but red wine, for reasons you can rightly imagine.

Always know what's being brought aboard your ship. Turning a blind eye for a few extra coins may fill the coffers, but having a crate break open and disgorge a hungry hackwing does terrible things to a crew's morale.

An added benefit to being so tall is that no one steps on this one's tail. Though, J'baanluk does have to mind where his tail wanders. As the clan mothers tell us, a Khajiit's tail is a curious creature.
Have you ever noticed how people look askance and go out of their way to avoid anyone who has been blessed with a pox or blight? It's downright shameful, I say!
You're gonna regret this.
And down they go.
Let's ride.
Look at you.
Well? I'm here.
I read somewhere that spiders are the leading cause of death in Tamriel. So if I see a spider in here, I'm killing it. No need to thank me.
I am a scholar, damn it!
(pleased laughter)
We can't take a portal?
Your accomplishments just compound, one upon the other.
Arcanist here.

The tome speaks to us, you know. Not with words. At least, not for me. Hmm, that would be quite interesting. \n\nBut it certainly communicates, shifting content and context, showing us what we need to know. And things we absolutely should not. Heh.
I suppose I ought to figure out how to free myself from this crystal. But I have to say, your rucksack carries me to some interesting places.

I've been known to fling a ball of fire or two in my time. Mesmerizing thing, magic. So much potential. For good and bad, of course. A flick of the wrist could make the difference between a dazzling display of fireworks and a raging inferno.
Master Kasan always told me not to be too quick to drop anchor. Sitting in one place too long gets you barnacles on your bottom.
I've had all the adventuring I can stand. It's tiresome, dangerous, and usually pointless in the end. But you go enjoy yourself. No judgment.
If you know what is good for you, do not poke my tummy.
Another mystery is right around the corner. Mizzik can feel it in his little gray hairs.
I thought about putting roots down in Betnikh once, but I don't know. Too contested. Too political. Though I guess there's not many places in the world where that isn't the case.
Have I told you how great it is that you do all the fighting?
I have been meaning to return to Hissmir. It has been some time since I communed with the Hist. I am certain it has plenty to say after so much time away.
I know.\n\nScares the torchbugs out of the haystacks every time!

People assume that since I'm a werewolf I only eat bloody meat torn from the bone. I've learned to be much more civilized of late. Kor showed me how to use a fork and I almost never forget to use my napkin. I still like food rare, though.
(Goblin GIbberish 13)

My associate Naryu asked me a perplexing question the other day. What do I plan to do when I retire? Now just the thought is keeping me up at night! What, indeed? I suppose I should try to develop some other skill, but nothing springs to mind.
(Goblin GIbberish 13)
I knew you were thinking about me.
Hey, you asked for this.
We showed them!
And the crowd goes wild!
Did it work? I closed my eyes.
Lead the way.
How do you do it?
Everything is brighter when we travel together.
Dur dad'na!
Evil never sleeps of its own accord.
We are victorious, by the strength of Alkosh.
Ahzith rabah.
Alkosh smiles upon you.

When I encounter a bloodfiend, revulsion washes over me. They exist as pure desire made manifest.\n\nAt first I tried to deal with them rationally. Maybe a positive conversation could reach their minds, I thought. Most definitely not so.

I can't count the number of apprentices I've trained over the years. They don't tend to stay with me very long, which is a testament to my unparalleled teaching methods. One adventure with me equals is usually more than enough for the uninitiated.

I have a complicated relationship with my master, Clavicus Vile. He gives me tasks, I sometimes make a mess of things, and I wind up banished or in the doghouse for a century or two. I mean, what's he expect? I'm just a talking dog!

I like to think I'm good at alchemy, but apparently I'm not make your own soap good at alchemy. At least, that's what my friends say. The friends who organized an intervention to explain how badly I smelled.
I question the sanity of those who seek to learn Ta'agra as a second tongue. All these tricky patterns of speech! If I was not born to it, I do not know if I would have the fortitude to learn.
Zha'al, you were not sent here by Clan Mother Tadali, were you? She has many ideas about how this one should spend his days and Za'ji despises every one of them.

I've found that certain smells transport me right back to my childhood. For instance, the combination of saw dust on the ocean breeze. Takes me right back to holding my father's hand while he inspected our shipyards. Fond memories.

I don't know if Muffins can swim, but she can fish! Rather, I've taught her to suck up schools of minnows with her snout and snort them into a bucket. I sell the minnows to anglers as bait and use the coins to buy her sweetrolls.
We know where they are!
Your soul is mine. I own you! Come. Let us play.
If I cannot control your world, I will destroy it.
Throw aside the pawns, my knight. Until one day you are taken unawares.
The Tharns and their trinkets. It is weakness to rely on toys for strength.
You've done nothing, mortal.
I await you at the next anchor.
To challenge me is to die. To flee is to become prey.
You should replace that so-called warrior you have there. With allies like that, you can't afford to have any enemies!
"Lift with the legs. Always, the legs."
Ah, very fine work. Your skill shows.
I shall commend your name when I deliver these.
There are reports of bandits on the roads. All rumors, I say. Your delivery shall be safe enough.
Next time you make a delivery, slip me a spare? I'm good for it. Usually.
Cyrodiil is a bleak land of sudden, vicious murder … but compared to Coldharbour, it's a basket of kittens.
None shall take my plunder from me.
I never expected anyone to be able to complete that job. Really singular work, stranger. Really singular.\n\nOh, right. Your reward!
I bet a friend of mine that what you did was impossible. I'm glad to be proven wrong. My friend passed in a Daedra attack not long ago, so I'll pay you what I owed him on that bet.
Oh, what an adventure we're having!
Ah, very fine work. Your skill shows.
Over here!
Over here!
Trust in me.
If times are tough, I'll gladly buy the shirt off your back. Maybe a few other articles while I'm at it.
Trust in me.
If times are tough, I will gladly buy the shirt off your back. Maybe a few other articles while I'm at it.
I collect these goods on behalf of the Star-Gazers.
The Star-Gazers are in your debt.
Very nice.
Very sleek!
My compliments!
Pacrooti's good luck must be rubbing off on you!
Ooo.
<gasp!>
Hmm!
Ooo.
The brush of a thief's fingers can open my heart, but emptiness will be their only reward.
Security coils indicate zero intruders.
Virtue through design. Design through faith.
Maintaining detection state five.
Please direct all queries to the nearest Clockwork Apostle.
Haa!
Pacrooti will help you open a crate which contains special rewards. Some of these are so spectacular, just thinking of them makes Pacrooti's fur stand on end!
<humming>
Ha!
Haaaa!
This could be good!
You are a very keen player.
Perhaps you only think the island is sinking.
Rise, my yaghra! Destroy them all!
You took something from me, so I take something from you.
Perhaps you only think you won, dirt-crawler.
The Sea Sloads' pearls belong to me now and Summerset will fall.
You accomplished nothing, mortal worm.
I love it when the High Elves scream and run away!
Keep the gold. I found something better.
(Goblin GIbberish 14)

So you're a Psijic now, eh? I'd keep that to yourself, mate. If people find out, it'll be nothing but "negotiate this treaty!" and "settle this matter of succession!" and "what fork should I use for salad?"
[Goblin gibberish as she pleads with a bigger monster]
You want the truth? The thing I hate most about cheese is that it does terrible things to my digestion.
I've had so many near death experiences since I met you. I really need to go make an offering to the Three before they think me ungrateful.
M'aiq once spoke with a traveler who was looking for their own head. Couldn't find it with both hands and the help of the brigadines of Leyawiin.\n\nNo, no, it is true!

The Duke is a generous ruler, featherless. Generous and fair. When the Knight of Marrow drove off the Dread Tabby Peaches, the Duke rewarded him with a pumpkin full of dead mice!\n\nOne day I shall earn a feast for gallantry, just you watch!
Free time makes me anxious. I'm used to schedules being prescribed and regimented. Now that I have no one dictating what I need to do, I'm at a loss far too much of the time.
I have been working to exert my dominion over the rats of the mortal world. Simple tools, but with them I shall build an empire of ash and ruin!

No! I won't do it and you can't make me! \n\nHeh. Forgive me, mortal. That is something poor Hezehk never gets to say. I simply wanted to try it out once, while Madam Whim isn't around to reprimand me.

What can I tell you about the Psijic Order without betraying my oath? Hmm. We're the oldest monastic group of Tamriel. And we're devoted to the study and practice of Mysticism. The Old Ways. And we live on Artaeum.\n\nHmm. Maybe I've said too much.
People say variety's the spice of life. Don't know if that's true, but it sure makes killing folks a whole lot easier.

You know, looking around here really makes me think I should get a place of my own. Something modest. Nothing fancy! Just nine rooms would do. Plus a parlor. Everyone needs a good parlor. \n\nAnd a wine cellar, of course. Got to have one of those.
Time to bring the lightning!
Ooh, that one was satisfying!
Anyone else?
And up we go.
How do you keep getting stronger? It's amazing! Tell me the secret!
What kind of trouble we getting into?
Some frown upon stealing but I've never thought there was any moral attachment to it. For a lot of people, it's necessary. And for others, it's just fun!
<Confident laughter.>
That was it, right? Sometimes its hard to tell.
Back in the saddle.
Draigh! I didn't think you could get more powerful.
I am your shield.
We should hit a tavern sometime, when you have a moment. I love to hear bards perform. I'm a beef-wit when it comes to singing, but I love to listen.
Magic. Rigurt has never understood how such wonderment works. It's like … magic! \n\nHmm. Must be where name comes from. Makes sense.

I love a good drink as much as the next sailor, but Tu'whacca's arse, I've not had nearly enough of them!\n\nHere's a secret I learned during my pirating days. When in port, always ask for whatever the locals are drinking. You won't be disappointed!
Do you feel the breath of Khenarthi on your shoulders? She is blowing you somewhere else. Go now, so Tadali can get her beauty sleep.
Very sleek!

The other knights would tease me about the time I spent with the druids and my crush on Druid Laurel. Of course, that was until they saw her. One look at her and she had those young men and women either running for their lives or trying to court her.
Hobbies? Fighting, drinking, carousing. Caterwauling. That's rather fun. \n\nAnd fighting. Did I mention I like to fight?
This is a turbulent age we live in. Alliances at war. Dark threats manifest on every horizon. These are the times that try our very souls. Only within ourselves can we find salvation.

Did you hear about the time I stole the Wayrest Ruby? Spent an entire day disguised as a maid's broom. One rather fetching servant used me to sweep the castle, then when night fell I just grabbed the gem and ran. \n\nI made a clean get-away!

Growing up in Northern Elsweyr, one learns to appreciate water. A few drops can mean the difference between life and death. That is why this one enjoys wading through rivers as he travels. So much water in one place is a rare treat for a desert son.

Some say the Daedric Princes are evil. That's a rather narrow view, don't you think? Is Peryite evil for cleansing the world with blights and plagues? And how could anyone so favored by adorable skeevers be bad? Not possible, I say.
(Intimidating shout)
Who's next?
Ready to ride.
Didn't think you could get any stronger.
Well? I'm here.
You ever notice how different homes have distinct smells? All depends on who's living there.\n\nThis place, it's … tolerable. Nice, even. If it wasn't, you wouldn't catch me staying here.
If we must!
(amused cackle)
If we must.
Extraordinary! Astounding! Congratulations.
A fated arrival.

Of all the places beyond the good old Mundus, I believe Fargrave might be my favorite. Filled with unique individuals to talk to, surrounded by massive and mysterious corpses. \n\nAnd the food at the House of Whims? Pure luxury!
Some advice from a Dark Elf who lived 314 years—you're not eating enough roughage. No one does.

All the best audiences have something in common. A gleam in the eye. That spark of curiosity. Not to prove or invalidate, but to enjoy. Savor. After all, there's music in a trick wall. A song in a false knife. And they just want to sing along.
I admit I've never taken much pleasure in reading for reading's sake. I just don't have the patience for it.
I'm not entirely sure what Hermaeus Mora sees in this place. Your plane of existence, that is. I find it … tedious.
What is the search for knowledge without an inadvertent transformation? Things like this happen more often than you think.

The mystery stories Mizzik has read gave him some unrealistic expectations of investigators and their adventures.\n\nGetting lost in the eyes of a captivating suspect, however—that's happened about as much as Mizzik was led to expect.

I had a cousin growing up who dreamed about fighting in the Blessed Crucible and claiming something he called the Brimstone Crown.\n\nI say I had a cousin because I haven't heard from him in ages. I can only assume he followed his dreams.

A network of spies can be as invaluable as an army and often save exponentially more lives. I am fortunate to have known my spymaster, Tee-Wan, since we were hatchlings.\n\nMost people have never heard of him, which only speaks to his skill.

My associate Elam thinks he's an excellent vossa-satl player, but we all know the truth. He's not that great. And the sanctuary's echoes make it worse.\n\nI would never discourage him, though. He's trying and I respect that.

I love Kor. He is my brother. He cares for me when I need it, and he believes in me. I would do anything for him.\n\nBut if he tries to sing one more damned Nord drinking song, I will tear his head off.
(Goblin GIbberish 14)

I had a nix-hound once. Named Blinky. Sweetest thing. Very affectionate. Unfortunately, a writ kept me away from home for too long and when I returned ….\n\nWell, let's just say I should have left out larger bowls for his food and water.
(Goblin GIbberish 14)
Troublemakers, ready to cause trouble!
Give it your all!
And that's how it's done.
They really made us work for it.
Just try and stop me.
Lead the way.
Inspiring.
Many paths await us.
To arms, tamiit!
Peace. For now.
Boethra's path leads us to victory.
Ahzith rabah.
Hunting greatness with the determination of Hircine.

I'm told that some people find me attractive. My sister Gwendis said that a woman in Northpoint called me cute. I find this confusing, but not unwelcome. Romantic relationships have eluded my investigations so far. Maybe that should end.

A person's favorite author will tell you everything you need to know about them. Really!\n\nFor example, if the esteemed Narsis Dren is their favorite, then I know they are a person of great intellect and distinguished taste.
Be careful, mortal. My master likes to give your kind exactly what they wish for. Exactly.

I'll admit that I'm about as gentle as a gryphon in an antiques shop, but here's the thing. I decided a long time ago that I don't need to be delicate. Refined. Controlled. And I'm happier for it. Life is better when you let things get messy.
If I summoned a skeletal construct to fetch me a glass of water, would I frighten anyone in this home? Not that I would ever use my necromancy for something so vain and self-serving. Hah.
True happiness includes the helm of the Perfect Pounce in Za'ji's claws, the wind in his fur. Oh, and Queen Ayrenn by his side!\n\nAlas, she never responds to any of Za'ji's letters.

You're probably honored to meet someone of my station. Don't be. I may be a duchess, but I put my slippers on one foot at a time. Sure, I'm wealthy and powerful. And dare I say more beautiful than most. But otherwise, we're exactly the same.

My brother makes the best mammoth snout pie. But ever since I rescued Muffins, I haven't had the stomach for it.\n\nI was worried I'd offend him, but his whole family stopped eating elk after his boys saved an abandoned calf. We all have our limits.
Let's go get our families back.
The end of Nirn is at hand. Come forth and destroy!
Destroy this anchor and scores more will take its place!
You entertain me, mortal. Well done. Now, entertain me more!
The Battlemage has the amulet, but you have true power. Fight for me.
May your soul burn.
The effort was not for naught. Until next time ….
That's looks like it hurt. Did it hurt? Oh yes, I'm sure that hurt.
Let me know if you sell those at market. My cousin could use a set.
Someone will benefit greatly from your shipment. Who, exactly? This one does not know.
Might I purchase some of those as a gift for my kinswoman? At a later date, of course.
I could do with less turmoil on the roads. Also, more predictable schedules.
You don't do custom work, do you? No reason, just a side job. Shouldn't have mentioned it.
We need more goods like these. Anything you can provide will help.
Mortal whimpering enlivens me!
A fair number of things surprise me, but rarely am I impressed.\n\nToday, however, that's most certainly the case.
And you ran straight here? Why, you deserve a medal!\n\nAll I can offer are some worthless gold coins.
A day with Narsis Dren is an exciting day indeed!
Wherever this goes, it will see much use.
You there, halt!
You there, halt!
My word is carved in stone and my back forged of iron.
Who knew you could make fetching look so fetching?
My word is carved in stone and my back forged of iron.
Who knew you could make fetching look so fetching?
I would love a skin of wine, but there is still so much to do!
Your gifts bring a blessing on your children and your children's children.
This will come in handy.
Ooooh.
Mmm hmm?
Ooooh.
Our hearts are bound in sorrows from which there is no release.
Accessing combat subroutines.
Please remain at a safe distance, resident. Core malfunction detected.
Audio anomalies detected. Documenting.
Apologies. My current designation prohibits conversation.
ha!
Most crates contain four rewards, but sometimes you will get a special fifth reward!
<humming 2>
ha!
<gasp>
A lucky day!
Pacrooti could play with you all day.
My mind will overwhelm you!
My servants shall overwhelm you.
You thought you defeated me? How naive.
My army will never halt its march, land-dweller.
My power flows through the pearls. Next time, you won't be so lucky.
Whenever darkness falls, I'll be there.
Anyone seen the rest of my landing party?
Can't believe I let that Altmer stick me!
(Goblin GIbberish 15)

If you find another crystalline entity, you'll bring it back here, right? I could use some decent conversation. Not that you—. Don't get me wrong, our conversations are just … you know, just really great.
[how a gibbering Goblin gives orders]
I always try to be kind to people and give them reason to believe in the goodness of others. Set the example I'd like to see others follow.
Feeling chatty, are we?
M'aiq is puzzled. Sometimes people simply disappear right in front of his eyes! Where do they go, he wonders?

Featherless battles are so uncivilized. Not like crow duels! Crow duels are courtly and dignified.\n\nMy first duel featured a splendid display of crow manners. My foe was roosting quietly, so I snuck into his nest and pecked him to bits!

Did military service ever appeal to you? Obviously, it did to me. Once.\n\nIronically, there's a certain freedom to relinquishing your liberty. But it requires being able to trust fully. When trust is lost … well, so goes those feelings of freedom.
Mortal rats lack ambition. I cannot seem to interest them in my schemes of conquest. Or even in a nice game of Agony and Affliction.
Oh, I know that I complain about mortals and their habits, but you shouldn't take it personally. \n\nHezehk doesn't like anybody. Mortal, Daedra, or whatever.
I wish I had another three arms to help me write down all my research. I'm going to fill up an entire library! Good thing the Psijic Order has so many of the blasted things.
I've been at this a long time, but I wager you could teach me a thing or two. What are you thinking?

Just got out of jail. Again. Normally, I escape right away, but there was a gorgeous Wood Elf three cells down. We were really hitting it off!\n\nTurns out, she likes to set things on fire. Including her previous three lovers. So, that one's on me.
I'm gonna show off a little!
Ooh, that one was satisfying!
Whew! That was fun!
And up we go.
How do you keep getting stronger? It's amazing! Tell me the secret!
Did I miss anything good?
Fish biscuits! I enchanted a spoon and now it's gone! I would say it didn't just get up and walk away but … it actually might have.
Shining steel!
Stendarr see you safely to your rest.
Back in the saddle.
Draigh! I didn't think you could get more powerful.
I'm right beside you. Let's get out there.

A friend of mine when I was young moved out of Gonfalon Bay to join her family at a druid enclave. I think about her sometimes, still. Wonder what became of her. Amazing people, druids, but they take their commitment to nature so seriously ….
Nord culture revolves around honor and warriors, but there's more to it than that. My favorite part of our culture are mead and food. \n\nAnd mead. Rigurt really likes mead.

I punched a horker once. Tu'whacca strike me down if I'm lying and let me eat sand!\n\nIt followed our ship for a week, sneaking aboard and gobbling our rations. It wasn't even hungry! Just taunting us. I had to teach it a lesson before we starved.
The world drowns in foolishness. Try not to add more to it, yes?
Sweet as moon sugar!

I never felt comfortable at court when I was young. I could never remember the etiquette and protocol for every little interaction. And what were all those spoons for at court dinners? I still get confused about that at feasts and banquets.
Moons above, can't a Khajiit nap in peace?
My crusade is a constant, unending call to arms. If you hear rumors of bloodfiends on the rise, speak the word and I shall be there.

Always hide a few pieces of gold on your person. You never know when a crewmate's going to double cross you and throw you overboard with nothing but the clothes on your back. A bit of gold goes a long way toward enacting your revenge.

This one's favorite dish is a Riverhold beef pasty. J'baanluk loves to hold one in each paw, and the cook at Banished Regrets makes them in Pahmar-sized portions! Oh, now J'baanluk is hungry! Do any nearby inns make such delights, this one wonders.
Starting a religious order is a lot harder than I expected. So many potential followers display no interest whatsoever.
(Aggravated growl)
Psh. Easy.
Ready to ride.
Didn't think you could get any stronger.
Let's get it done.
Don't worry—if I go fishing, I'll eat my catches before they stink up the place. Don't even need to cook them. Unless you'd like me to share.
Confound it!
Bah, to Apocrypha with you.
If we must.
Extraordinary! Astounding! Congratulations.
A fated arrival.

The benighted realm of Nocturnal is actually quite lively if you know where to look. I managed to procure an invitation to a Blackfeather Court soiree some years ago and it was an intense experience. \n\nTook me weeks to regain feeling in my face. Hmm.
It turns out your ghost wears whatever clothes you were wearing when you died. Makes me wish I'd put on my good smallclothes that last day.

Some see our masks and believe them concealing. An obfuscation. But that's simply not true. These masks allow us to show who we truly are. After all, doesn't your armor provide a sort of freedom? The kind that makes a leap into the unknown possible?
It's no good waiting for the sunny isle your heart is set on. You need to take the helm and go find it.
I encountered a band of mortals who tried to beat me with a stick. Is that a common greeting around here?
You know what I miss? A properly made Bloody Mara.\n\nCome to think of it, I miss eating and drinking in general.

Sometimes Mizzik thinks the one who commits a crime makes a victim of themselves. Mizzik imagines the misdeeds weighing upon one's heart. And being forbidden to speak of them must be a unique kind of torment.
Cold water doesn't bother me. I grew up swimming in the Sea of Ghosts, so anything without ice floes feels like a nice, warm bath.

Sometimes I wonder about the life I would have led if I stayed in Seekhat-Xol. A Keshu who had not made a name for herself among outsiders. But I suppose she would not stand apart, and so her name would not be Keshu.

This Three Banner's War? Feh—bad for business.\n\nPrayers for secret assassinations drop when people can just kill each other in battle. Sure, we'll get sacraments for cowardly nobles who won't fight, but it's not the same.

Being a werewolf has complications, yes. I'd prefer if it was more predictable, but I don't want a cure. Astara says I'm the best tracker in the Brotherhood, and I can serve the Night Mother this way. I need to be happy with who I am.
(Goblin GIbberish 15)
Did you hear the one about the two Morag Tong agents that walked into a corner club?\n\nIt's hilarious, but if I told you the punchline, I'd have to kill you.
(Goblin GIbberish 15)
Aye, aye captain! Ha! Sorry.
Hit them where it hurts!
That was fun!
They really made us work for it.
Just try and stop me.
Giddy up!
Inspiring.
In light or shadow, I am here.
Swift as Khenarthi!
Expertly done, tamiit.
Boethra's path leads us to victory.
We ride.
Hunting greatness with the determination of Hircine.

Alchemy is my first love and my constant passion. The anticipation for an unknown reaction is unlike any other. If you haven't tried the art, I highly recommend it. Many find the experience intoxicating. And sometimes you can drink the results!

What I wouldn't give for the glint of gold and a puzzle to solve! I'm wasted above ground. Although I must admit it's rather nice not to be running from monsters. Or trapped in a crypt. Or zapped by a spell.\n\nHmm, maybe I need a vacation.
I don't suppose you know where I can get some mead? Dogs get thirsty, too, you know.

Summerset society was built on high ideals, a grand culture. So many twist that for their own gain. And if we stay complacent, we just feed that corruption. If we want a better future for the Dominion, for Tamriel, we all have to fight for it.
We practiced forms of the claw dances during my time in the Hidden Moon. All that time stretching felt like such a waste. Now, at this age? I wish I had stretched far more.

Za'ji fears that Queen Ayrenn may not feel the same way about Za'ji as Za'ji does about her. How does one win the heart of a queen? Perhaps she'd appreciate a tasty glazed skeever loaf. Or some jumping rodent morsels.\n\nAnd now Za'ji is hungry ….

Do you play Tales of Tribute? I've become somewhat obsessed with the dalliance. Even started traveling with my favorite decks.\n\nAlas, my steward tells me I've become too competitive and has forbade me from indulging until we return to the palace.

Muffins can sleep standing up, she just chooses not to. Just like she chooses to sleep in my bed.\n\nYes, the tusks are a problem. I've tried using wine corks. They always fall off. But look at her! She's worth the occasional puncture wound.
Give me a weapon, and I'll fight!
You are unworthy to kiss my feet. Begone with you!
Drink in your victory. It won't last long.
Fool! Every drop of blood you spill to defeat me only gives me more strength.
Where is that failed Sword-Saint now? Brooding in some sandy cave on the edges of Oblivion?
When you destroy the next, this one will have returned.
Good. I grant you permission to strengthen yourself with my minions.
You need to end this. There's only so much punishment the mortal form can withstand. Sit down. Rest. I'll get you a sweetroll and a cup of sour milk tea.
I'm told not to say, but your work is the best I've seen. Our secret, eh?
This one will leave soon. The road is not unfriendly, but the horse is skittish.
There were bandits on the road last time, but I did not let them claim a thing.
The fighting in Cyrodiil causes most shipping delays, I'm sure of it.
I think your shipment's headed for Cyrodiil. Unless it gets lost on the way. Which it won't! Of course it won't.
Where are all the people who need these supplies? Lost? Something worse?
That's quite an accomplishment. Here. You deserve every coin.

If a proper emperor were sitting on the throne, you'd be given a parade for works like that. Maybe a title and a holiday, too.\n\nAs it is, you'll have to settle for a 'thank you' and a weary refugee's coins.
Don't let them bite you! The dead are full of nasty illnesses.
I'm off soon. There's much to cart, and I have no horse.
Won't stop bleeding.
Won't stop bleeding.
Do not let my physique intimidate you. I can be quite gentle when needed.
Have you ever been told to act more ladylike? Like there's only one way for a lady to act.
I am sworn to carry your burdens.
Lead the way, I love a man who takes charge.
I hope you encountered no trouble on your way here.
Take care as you journey in Craglorn, wayfarer.
Well deserved.
Hoooo.
Hoooo.
Ahem.
For every end, a new beginning. A fool's words.

Greeting array corrupted. Please try again.
All functions are working as intended.
By His will, we are sustained.
ah!
There are many spectacular rewards that a crate could contain.  You can view this excellent selection by previewing a crate.
<humming 3>
Ah!
Nice!

No one minds me roosting here, do they? I think this place has a lot to teach me. Such as how best to bother someone.\n\nIf I can annoy a hero of your stature, for example, harassing simple bumpkins should be as easy as plump-liver pie!

I wonder sometimes what my life would have been like if my talent for magic hadn't been discovered so early. Would I have joined the Legion as a regular soldier, or taken an entirely different path? I honestly can't say.
I am no one's curio or pet. I am Arox the Mutilator, the Ruin of Varondo, Terror of the Burning—hey! Hey! Down here!
Feh. Hezehk had higher hopes for the mortal realm. Surely, I thought, there must be something on Nirn that Hezehk would find interesting. Alas ….\n\nPresent location notwithstanding!
I hope the Psijic Order is ready for someone like me! I'm told I can be quite the handful.
Some folks say killing a bear's just like killing a man, but harder. Know what happens to them? They get eaten by bears.\n\nEvery fight's different, so be prepared.

This is nice. I can always use a sprinkle of domesticity. If I had a little plot, I honestly don't know what I'd put in it. Boots, maybe? Yeah, like a shelf full of boots. A rogue in ill-fitted boots … well, frankly, that's hard to look at.
Big mistake!
Not so big and bad now, are you?
We're the best!
Oh good, I didn't want to walk.
I'm here! Lucky you!
We'll see it done!
Stow your weapons, my friend. We've won.
Be nice to get off my feet.
Where will our adventures take us today?
Milk-drinker. Why did that become such a terrible Nord insult, I wonder. Milk is good for you! I love the stuff! Not as much as I love mead, but it's a close second. \n\nMaybe third.

Wish I had someone like you on my crew back in the day. Aye, I can see it in your eyes. You've got what it takes. Not many people do.\n\nIt's a special kind of heart that can take to the sea and survive. You should be proud.
I sense greatness in your spirit. You must have a bit of Alfiq in your blood, yes?

If I hear one more complaint today, I will truly lose years off my life. I have no patience for either nobles or commoners at the moment.\n\nOh, not you, friend. The rest of the nobles and commoners. You're perfectly delightful.
As first mate of the Pounce, it's my job to keep the crew in line and make sure the ship is fit to sail. I also keep one eye on our captain, Za'ji. \n\nHe needs all the help he can get.

When I look into your eyes I see hunger. No, not for a sweetroll. The kind that rouses you in the night and makes you reach for the hilt of the dagger you keep under your pillow. \n\nI recognize that look. I see the same one when I look in a mirror.

Someday Peryite will end all suffering with a plague that sweeps across Nirn. Only the most faithful followers of the Prince of Pestilence will survive. If continuing to live interests you, let me tell you about the Order of the Sacred Skeever ….
You asked for it.
That'll teach them not to cross us.

I don't react well to people touching me. Doesn't matter the intention. Especially if it's a surprise.\n\nThink twice about putting a friendly hand on my shoulder, unless you'd like to lose it.
(snarky laughter)

It's kind of nice no longer having to eat, or sleep, or hurry off to the privy. I don't really mind being a ghost … the cold embrace of death notwithstanding.

There are many skilled crafters who call the House of Reveries home. Wood carvers, stone hewers, dye makers. Each of their skills as integral to our performances as any singer or dancer that takes the stage. Do remember that when next we perform.

I've spent a lot of time recently examining works of mortal fiction. Insipid drivel, without a single mind-shattering truth to justify the time spent creating them, let alone reading the uninspired words.

This form is all right, but I sometimes imagine what it would be like if they had stuck me in a different plaything. A toy trebuchet, for example. Oh, the destruction I could cause with some choice projectiles!
Mizzik has a weak disposition for violence. Some have accused him of playing up this aspect to get others to underestimate him as an investigator.\n\nOh, if only Mizzik were that good an actor!

I have been invited to Seekhat-Xol by my egg-tender friend Peek-Ereel to witness this year's hatch. \n\nWhile I have compassion for hatchlings, I do not know if I have the patience for them. We shall see.

I don't have many places I'm welcome to visit right now, so I'm glad I have somewhere I can let my guard down. At least for a moment.\n\nAnd, truth be told, I like it here.

What? Oh, my apologies, mortal. I was lost in a pleasant recollection. My talons rending flesh, the screams of the damned, the towers of Ald Sotha tumbling down. You should have been there. It was glorious!

Oh, what does Whim want now? Am I supposed to entertain her patrons? Dazzle them with my wit? Perhaps caper and sing like one of those mortal bards who pollute the streets of Fargrave with their maliferous tones? I think not. Hezehk has standards.
You're good. Damn good. But I know you can be better. Come on. Let's get to work.

Looking good! I'm amazed at the gear you adventuring types find just lying around. I met a warrior recently who was wearing this shimmering Elven breastplate. Where'd you get it, I asked? An ogre's dung pile! Clearly, I'm in the wrong profession.

When I was first learning magic, I lit my head on fire. I produced a small flame and Tu'whacca's arse, it caught onto a bit of my hair and just like that, my head was an inferno!\n\nDunked my head in nearby water barrel, but it was too close.

Children can be so disappointing, walker. They begin life as cute bundles of fur and fluff, but do not let them fool you. They are terrors waiting to grow up and make you regret every decision you ever made.\n\nTrust Tadali. She knows.
Any idea how much food it takes to maintain my girlish figure? Let's just say I could go for a roast guar right about now. Maybe two.

Saddest I've ever been was when I watched a crate full of Alik'r spirits sink into the deep. My crew had to hold me down so I wouldn't dive in after it. \n\nI guarantee you, those fish had the best night of their lives.
